{"headword":"acceptable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「可接受的」或「滿意的」。指某事符合標準、要求或社會規範，因此可以被接受。常用於描述品質、價格或行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"While the hotel room was small, the price was <target>acceptable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> most travelers who wanted a convenient location near the city center.","translation":"雖然飯店房間很小，但對於大多數想要住在市中心便利位置的旅客來說，價格是可以接受的。","explanation":"形容詞「可接受的」。常用搭配：acceptable to someone (對某人來說可接受)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher told the student that his behavior in class was no longer <target>acceptable</target>, as it disrupted the learning environment for everyone.","translation":"老師告訴學生，他在課堂上的行為已不再被接受，因為這干擾了所有人的學習環境。","explanation":"形容詞「可接受的」。指行為符合社會或學校規範。"}],"related_forms":["acceptably","acceptability"]}

{"headword":"accurate","explanation":"形容詞，意為「準確的」或「精確的」。指資訊、描述或測量沒有錯誤且與事實相符。常與介係詞 in 搭配，表示「在...方面準確」。注意與 precise (精確的) 的區別：accurate 強調的是正確性 (correctness)，而 precise 強調的是細節的精確度 (precision)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is crucial for journalists to provide <target>accurate</target> information to the public to avoid spreading rumors and causing unnecessary panic.","translation":"記者向大眾提供準確的資訊以避免傳播謠言並引起不必要的恐慌至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「準確的」。指資訊與事實相符。"},{"sentence":"The scientist made <target>accurate</target> <pattern>measurements</pattern> of the chemical reaction, ensuring that the final results of the experiment were reliable.","translation":"科學家對化學反應進行了準確的測量，確保實驗的最終結果是可靠的。","explanation":"形容詞「準確的」。常用搭配：accurate measurements (準確的測量)。"},{"sentence":"The weather forecast was not very <target>accurate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> predicting the exact time the storm would hit the coast, leading to some confusion.","translation":"天氣預報在預測風暴擊中海岸的確切時間方面並不準確，導致了一些混亂。","explanation":"形容詞「準確的」。常用搭配：accurate in something (在...方面準確)。"}],"related_forms":["accurately","accuracy"]}

{"headword":"ache","explanation":"名詞指「持續的鈍痛」；動詞指「感到疼痛」。注意 ache 通常指一種較長時間、較輕微但持續的疼痛，而 pain 則是指更劇烈、更突然的疼痛。常見搭配：headache, stomachache, backache。","entries":[{"sentence":"After spending the entire afternoon studying for the final exams, the student felt a dull <target>ache</target> <pattern>in</pattern> his lower back from sitting too long.","translation":"在花整個下午準備期末考後，這名學生因為坐太久而感到下背部隱隱作痛。","explanation":"名詞「鈍痛」。常用搭配：ache in something (在某處疼痛)。"},{"sentence":"My legs began to <target>ache</target> after we hiked for five hours through the mountains, but we still pushed forward to reach the summit.","translation":"我的腿在我們在山中徒步五小時後開始疼痛，但我們仍堅持前行以到達山頂。","explanation":"動詞「疼痛」。指持續性的肌肉或身體部位疼痛。"},{"sentence":"The athlete suffered from a severe <target>ache</target> <pattern>in</pattern> her joints after the intense training session, which required her to rest for a week.","translation":"這名運動員在激烈的訓練課後感到關節劇痛，這需要她休息一週。","explanation":"名詞「疼痛」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"assume","explanation":"動詞「假設、認為」。指在沒有證據的情況下認為某事是正確的。注意與 presume (推定) 的區別，assume 較為隨意。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a mistake to <target>assume</target> <pattern>that</pattern> everyone in the class speaks English fluently, as some students may have different backgrounds.","translation":"假設班上每個人都能流利地說英語是一個錯誤，因為有些學生可能有不同的背景。","explanation":"動詞「假設、認為」。常用搭配 assume that...。"},{"sentence":"Since the teacher was late for the meeting, the students <target>assumed</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the class had been cancelled for the day.","translation":"由於老師開會遲到了，學生們認為今天的課被取消了。","explanation":"動詞「假設」。"}],"related_forms":["assumption","assumable"]}

{"headword":"athlete","explanation":"名詞「運動員」。指參與競技運動的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young <target>athlete</target> trained hard every morning for several months to qualify for the national track and field competition.","translation":"這位年輕的運動員好幾個月以來每天早晨辛苦訓練，以取得參加國家田徑賽的資格。","explanation":"名詞「運動員」。"},{"sentence":"Professional <target>athletes</target> often follow a strict diet and exercise routine to maintain their peak physical condition during the season.","translation":"職業運動員通常遵循嚴格的飲食和運動習慣，以在賽季期間維持巔峰的身體狀態。","explanation":"名詞「運動員」。"}],"related_forms":["athletic","athletics"]}

{"headword":"attitude","explanation":"名詞「態度，看法」。指一個人對某人或某事所持的心理狀態或反應。常用搭配：have a positive/negative attitude towards sth (對...抱持正面/負面的態度)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student for having a positive <target>attitude</target> <pattern>towards</pattern> learning, which helped her improve her grades quickly.","translation":"老師稱讚這名學生對學習抱持正面的態度，這幫助她迅速提高了成績。","explanation":"名詞「態度」。常用搭配：attitude towards sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite the failure of the project, the team maintained a professional <target>attitude</target> and worked together to find a better solution.","translation":"儘管計畫失敗，團隊仍保持專業的態度並共同努力尋找更好的解決方案。","explanation":"名詞「態度」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"attract","explanation":"動詞「吸引」。指將某人或某物朝向自己移動，或引起某人的興趣或注意力。常用搭配：attract attention (吸引注意)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The brightly colored flowers are designed to <target>attract</target> bees and butterflies, which help the plants reproduce by carrying pollen.","translation":"色彩鮮豔的花朵旨在吸引蜜蜂和蝴蝶，這些昆蟲透過攜帶花粉幫助植物繁殖。","explanation":"動詞「吸引」。指物理上的吸引或生物學上的吸引。"},{"sentence":"The city's new art gallery has <target>attracted</target> <pattern>thousands of</pattern> tourists from all over the world who want to see the modern sculptures.","translation":"這座城市的全新美術館吸引了來自世界各地數千名想要觀賞現代雕塑的遊客。","explanation":"動詞「吸引」。常用搭配：attract thousands of... (吸引數千名...)。"},{"sentence":"To <target>attract</target> <pattern>more attention</pattern> to the environmental issue, the students organized a peaceful protest in the city center.","translation":"為了讓環境議題受到更多關注，學生們在市中心組織了一場和平抗議。","explanation":"動詞「吸引」。常用搭配：attract attention (吸引注意)。"}],"related_forms":["attraction","attractive","attractively"]}

{"headword":"attractive","explanation":"形容詞「吸引人的，迷人的」。可用於描述外貌、條件或計畫等具有吸引力的事物。注意與 attract (動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The travel agency offered an <target>attractive</target> package deal that included hotel stays and flights, making it a popular choice for families.","translation":"旅行社提供了一個吸引人的套裝行程，包含酒店住宿和機票，使其成為家庭旅遊的熱門選擇。","explanation":"形容詞「吸引人的」。指條件或價格具有吸引力。"},{"sentence":"With its beautiful beaches and clear blue water, the island is one of the most <target>attractive</target> destinations for summer vacations.","translation":"憑藉著美麗的海灘和清澈的藍色海水，這個島嶼是夏季假期中最吸引人的目的地之一。","explanation":"形容詞「吸引人的」。指景觀迷人。"}],"related_forms":["attract","attractively","attraction"]}

{"headword": "audience", "explanation": "名詞「觀眾，聽眾」。指在表演、演講或音樂會上觀看或聆聽的人群。常用搭配：the audience (觀眾群)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The comedian's jokes were so funny that the <target>audience</target> burst into laughter, filling the entire theater with joy.", "translation": "喜劇演員的笑話太有趣了，觀眾爆發出笑聲，讓整個劇院才會充滿了喜悅。", "explanation": "名詞「觀眾」。"}, {"sentence": "The speaker tried to <pattern>increase</pattern> <target>audience</target> <pattern>engagement</pattern> by asking questions and encouraging the students to share their own experiences.", "translation": "演講者試圖透過提問並鼓勵學生分享自身經驗來增加觀眾的參與感。", "explanation": "名詞「觀眾」。常用搭配：audience engagement (觀眾參與)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"automatic","explanation":"形容詞「自動的」。指由機器或系統在不需要人為干預的情況下運作。常用搭配：automatic transmission (自動變速箱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new library has an <target>automatic</target> door that opens whenever someone approaches, making it easier for people with wheelchairs.","translation":"新圖書館設有自動門，每當有人靠近時就會開啟，這讓使用輪椅的人更方便。","explanation":"形容詞「自動的」。"},{"sentence":"For many drivers, shifting gears in an <target>automatic</target> car is much simpler than doing so in a manual one.","translation":"對許多駕駛者來說，在自動檔汽車中切換檔位比在手排檔汽車中簡單得多。","explanation":"形容詞「自動的」。"},{"sentence":"The response was so <target>automatic</target> that he didn't even think about it; he just caught the ball before it hit the ground.","translation":"他的反應如此自動化（下意識），以至於他根本沒有思考；他在球掉到地上之前就接住了。","explanation":"形容詞「自動的」。在此指下意識的反應。"}],"related_forms":["automatically","automation"]}

{"headword":"automobile","explanation":"名詞「汽車」。較為正式的名稱，日常生活中常用 car。","entries":[{"sentence":"The history of the <target>automobile</target> has completely changed how people travel and how cities are designed and built.","translation":"汽車的歷史完全改變了人們旅行的方式以及城市設計和建設的方式。","explanation":"名詞「汽車」。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>automobiles</target> now use electric power to reduce air pollution and protect the environment from harmful gases.","translation":"許多汽車現在使用電力來減少空氣污染並保護環境免受有害氣體的影響。","explanation":"名詞「汽車」。"}],"related_forms":["auto"]}

{"headword":"avenue","explanation":"名詞「大道，大街」。指寬闊且兩旁有樹木的街道。在比喻義中，指「達成目標的途徑或方法」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists walked down the wide <target>avenue</target> lined with beautiful trees, admiring the grand buildings on both sides.","translation":"遊客們走在兩旁種滿美麗樹木的寬闊大道上，欣賞著兩側的宏偉建築。","explanation":"名詞「大道」。"},{"sentence":"The researchers are exploring every possible <target>avenue</target> <pattern>of</pattern> investigation to find the cause of the rare disease.","translation":"研究人員正在探索所有可能的調查途徑，以找出這種罕見疾病的原因。","explanation":"名詞「途徑」。比喻義用法，常用搭配：avenue of investigation (調查途徑)。"}],"related_forms":["avenues"]}

{"headword":"awake","explanation":"形容詞「醒著的」；動詞「喚醒」。注意與 awaken (動詞) 的區別。作形容詞時，常用於 stay awake (保持醒著)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I tried my best to stay <target>awake</target> during the long and boring lecture, but I eventually fell asleep in the chair.","translation":"在漫長且枯燥的演講中，我盡力嘗試保持醒著，但我最終在椅子上睡著了。","explanation":"形容詞「醒著的」。常用片語 stay awake (保持醒著)。"},{"sentence":"The sudden loud noise from the street <target>awoke</target> her from a deep sleep, making her feel confused and tired.","translation":"街道上突然的巨大噪音將她從深睡中喚醒，使她感到困惑和疲倦。","explanation":"動詞「喚醒」。不規則變化：awake-awoke-awoken。"}],"related_forms":["awaken","awakening"]}

{"headword":"awaken","explanation":"動詞「喚醒」。指將某人從睡眠中喚醒，或引起某種感覺、記憶或興趣的喚醒。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gentle sound of the alarm clock <target>awakened</target> him early in the morning, allowing him to study for the final exam.","translation":"鬧鐘溫柔的聲音在清晨將他喚醒，使他能夠為期末考而讀書。","explanation":"動詞「喚醒」。"},{"sentence":"Visiting the old museum <target>awakened</target> a long-forgotten memory of his childhood, bringing back images of his grandfather's stories.","translation":"參觀這座古老的博物館喚醒了他童年時期一段被遺忘已久的記憶，讓他的祖父的故事再次浮現。","explanation":"動詞「喚醒」。在此指引起某種感覺或記憶。"}],"related_forms":["awakening","awake"]}

{"headword":"award","explanation":"名詞「獎項」；動詞「頒獎，授予」。常用搭配：win an award (得獎), receive an award (獲獎), award sth to sb (將...授予某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young scientist won a prestigious <target>award</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her groundbreaking research on renewable energy sources.","translation":"這名年輕的科學家因其在可再生能源方面的突破性研究而獲得了一項聲望極高的獎項。","explanation":"名詞「獎項」。常用搭配：award for sth (因...而得獎)。"},{"sentence":"The committee decided to <target>award</target> the scholarship <pattern>to</pattern> the most hardworking student in the class to encourage further study.","translation":"委員會決定將獎學金授予班上最勤奮的學生，以鼓勵其進一步學習。","explanation":"動詞「授予」。常用搭配：award sth to sb。"},{"sentence":"The court <target>awarded</target> the victim a large amount of money <pattern>as</pattern> compensation for the damages caused by the accident.","translation":"法院將一大筆錢作為賠償金授予受害者，以彌補事故造成的損失。","explanation":"動詞「授予」。在此指法院判定授予賠償金。"}],"related_forms":["awards"]}

{"headword":"aware","explanation":"形容詞「意識到的、知道的」。常用搭配 aware of sth，表示「意識到某事」。注意與 conscious 的區別：aware 側重於知道事實或資訊，而 conscious 側重於生理上的清醒或對周圍環境的意識。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students are not <target>aware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new library rules, so they often talk loudly in the quiet study area.","translation":"許多學生沒有意識到新的圖書館規則，所以他們經常在安靜的學習區大聲說話。","explanation":"形容詞「意識到的」。常用搭配 aware of sth。"},{"sentence":"The environmental group hopes to make more people <target>aware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the dangers of plastic pollution in the ocean.","translation":"環保團體希望讓更多人意識到海洋塑料污染的危險。","explanation":"形容詞「意識到的」。常用搭配 make someone aware of sth。"},{"sentence":"Although he was <target>aware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the difficulty of the exam, he still felt confident that he could pass it with a high score.","translation":"儘管他意識到考試的困難度，但他仍然覺得自己能以高分通過。","explanation":"形容詞「意識到的」。"}],"related_forms":["awareness"]}

{"headword":"awful","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的、可怕的」。常用於描述感受、氣味、天氣或品質極差的事物。在口語中，也可以用作程度副詞，表示「非常」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The smell of the old fish in the market was <target>awful</target>, making several shoppers cover their noses and walk away quickly.","translation":"市場上舊魚的味道非常糟糕，讓好幾個購物者捂住鼻子快步走開。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。描述氣味。"},{"sentence":"I felt <target>awful</target> <pattern>about</pattern> forgetting my best friend's birthday, so I bought her a beautiful bouquet of flowers to apologize.","translation":"對於忘記好朋友的生日，我感到非常糟糕，所以我買了一束美麗的花來向她道歉。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。常用搭配 feel awful about sth。"},{"sentence":"The traffic jam on the highway was <target>awful</target> this morning, causing many employees to arrive late for their important meetings.","translation":"今天早上的高速公路交通堵塞非常糟糕，導致許多員工在重要會議上遲到。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。描述情況。"}],"related_forms":["awfully"]}

{"headword":"awkward","explanation":"形容詞「尷尬的、笨拙的」。可用於描述人、社交情境或物體操作上的不便。注意其在社交場合中指「令人不安的沉默」或「尷尬的對話」。","entries":[{"sentence":"There was an <target>awkward</target> <pattern>silence</pattern> in the room after the teacher asked a difficult question that nobody knew how to answer.","translation":"在老師提出一個沒人知道如何回答的困難問題後，房間裡出現了一種尷尬的沉默。","explanation":"形容詞「尷尬的」。常用搭配 awkward silence。"},{"sentence":"He felt <target>awkward</target> when he realized he was wearing the same outfit as his coworker during the company's formal party.","translation":"當他意識到自己在公司正式派對上穿著與同事相同的服裝時，他感到很尷尬。","explanation":"形容詞「尷尬的」。描述心理感受。"},{"sentence":"The box was so large and <target>awkward</target> <pattern>to</pattern> carry that the two students had to work together to move it.","translation":"這個盒子太大且難以攜帶，所以兩個學生必須一起合作將其搬移。","explanation":"形容詞「笨拙的、不便的」。指物體形狀或大小導致的操作困難。"}],"related_forms":["awkwardly","awkwardness"]}

{"headword":"background","explanation":"名詞，意為「背景」。可用於描述圖片的視覺背景、一個人的教育/文化背景，或是指一個事件發生的環境背景。","entries":[{"sentence":"The photographer suggested using a simple <target>background</target> for the portrait to ensure that the viewer's attention remains on the subject.","translation":"攝影師建議在肖像照中使用簡單的背景，以確保觀看者的注意力集中在主體上。","explanation":"名詞「背景」。指視覺上的背景。"},{"sentence":"The university offers scholarships to students from diverse cultural <target>backgrounds</target>, encouraging international exchange and mutual understanding.","translation":"大學為來自不同文化背景的學生提供獎學金，以鼓勵國際交流和相互理解。","explanation":"名詞「背景」。指人的教育、文化或社會背景。"},{"sentence":"To understand the current political conflict, students must first study the historical <target>background</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the region.","translation":"為了理解目前的政治衝突，學生必須首先研究該地區的歷史背景。","explanation":"名詞「背景」。指事件發生的環境背景。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bacon","explanation":"名詞「培根」。一種由豬肉製成的加工肉類，常用於早餐。","entries":[{"sentence":"For a traditional American breakfast, he ordered eggs, toast, and crispy <target>bacon</target>, which smelled wonderful across the entire diner.","translation":"為了享用傳統的美國早餐，他點了蛋、吐司和酥脆的培根，香味傳遍了整個餐廳。","explanation":"名詞「培根」。"},{"sentence":"The chef added some chopped <target>bacon</target> to the pasta sauce to give the dish a salty and smoky flavor that guests loved.","translation":"廚師在義大利麵醬中加入了一些切碎的培根，為這道菜增加了一種客人喜愛的鹹鹹煙燻味。","explanation":"名詞「培根」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bacteria","explanation":"名詞「細菌」。注意此詞為複數形式，單數形式為 bacterium。在科學、醫療或衛生討論中常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists have discovered that some types of <target>bacteria</target> in the human gut are actually beneficial for digestion and overall health.","translation":"科學家發現人體腸道中的某些類型的細菌實際上對消化和整體健康有益。","explanation":"名詞「細菌」（複數）。"},{"sentence":"To prevent the spread of harmful <target>bacteria</target>, students are encouraged to wash their hands thoroughly with soap before every meal.","translation":"為了防止有害細菌的傳播，學生被鼓勵在每餐前用肥皂徹底洗手。","explanation":"名詞「細菌」（複數）。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that antibiotics are used to kill <target>bacteria</target> that cause infections, but they do not work against viruses.","translation":"醫生解釋說，抗生素用於殺死引起感染的細菌，但它們對病毒不起作用。","explanation":"名詞「細菌」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":["bacterium"]}

{"headword":"badly","explanation":"副詞「糟糕地、嚴重地」。可用於描述動作執行得不好，或描述程度深（如 badly injured, badly damaged）。注意與 bad 的區別：badly 是副詞，修飾動作或動作狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student felt he had performed <target>badly</target> on his final exam, although the teacher later said his answers were actually quite good.","translation":"這個學生覺得自己在期末考表現得糟糕，儘管老師後來說他的答案其實相當不錯。","explanation":"副詞「糟糕地」。描述動作執行得不好。"},{"sentence":"After the earthquake, several old buildings in the city center were <target>badly</target> <pattern>damaged</pattern>, making them unsafe for residents to enter.","translation":"地震後，市中心的幾棟舊建築被嚴重損壞，使得居民進入其中並不安全。","explanation":"副詞「嚴重地」。常用搭配 badly damaged。"},{"sentence":"The team lost the championship game <target>badly</target>, with a score of 0 to 5, which left the players feeling discouraged and sad.","translation":"t這支隊伍在冠軍賽中慘敗，比分是 0 比 5，這讓球員們感到沮喪和悲傷。","explanation":"副詞「糟糕地」。描述結果之慘。"},{"sentence":"He <target>badly</target> <pattern>needed</pattern> a long vacation after working twelve hours a day for three months, so he booked a trip to Japan.","translation":"在一天工作十二小時且持續三個月後，他非常需要一個長假，所以他預訂了一趟日本之旅。","explanation":"副詞「非常、迫切地」。常用搭配 badly need sth。"}],"related_forms":["bad"]}

{"headword":"baggage","explanation":"名詞「行李」。注意此詞為不可數名詞，不能加 s 或使用 a baggage。若要表達「一件行李」，應使用 a piece of baggage 或 a piece of luggage。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the flight landed, the passengers waited at the carousel for their <target>baggage</target> to arrive, but some bags were missing.","translation":"飛機降陸後，乘客在傳送帶旁等待他們的行李到達，但有些行李丟失了。","explanation":"名詞「行李」。不可數名詞。"},{"sentence":"The airline has a strict weight limit for <target>baggage</target>, so the traveler had to remove some heavy clothes from his suitcase.","translation":"航空公司對行李重量有嚴格限制，所以旅行者不得不從行李箱中取出一些沉重的衣服。","explanation":"名詞「行李」。"},{"sentence":"Traveling with light <target>baggage</target> allows tourists to move more quickly and easily between different cities and attractions.","translation":"使用輕便的行李旅行，讓遊客可以在不同城市和景點之間更快速、輕鬆地移動。","explanation":"名詞「行李」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"besides","explanation":"副詞「除此之外」；介系詞「除了...之外（還）」。注意與 beside (在...旁邊) 的區別。besides 作為介系詞時，通常表示「包含在內」的增加。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked if anyone else had a question <target>besides</target> Kevin, as she wanted to ensure everyone understood the lesson.","translation":"老師詢問除了凱文之外是否還有其他人有問題，因為她想確保每個人都理解了這堂課。","explanation":"介系詞「除了...之外（還）」。表示包含在內，意為 in addition to。"},{"sentence":"I don't think we should go to the beach today; <target>besides</target>, the weather forecast says it will rain this afternoon.","translation":"我覺得我們今天不應該去海邊；此外，天氣預報說今天下午會下雨。","explanation":"副詞「除此之外」。用於引出額外的理由或論點。"},{"sentence":"What other languages can you speak <target>besides</target> English and Mandarin, since you have lived in the United States for five years?","translation":"除了英文和國語之外，你還會說什麼其他語言，既然你在美國住了五年？","explanation":"介系詞「除了...之外（還）」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bet","explanation":"動詞「打賭、敢肯定」；名詞「賭注」。常用片語 bet on (對...打賭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two friends decided to <target>bet</target> ten dollars <pattern>on</pattern> which football team would win the championship game this weekend.","translation":"這兩個朋友決定打賭十美元，看這週末哪支足球隊會贏得冠軍賽。","explanation":"動詞「打賭」。常用片語 bet on sth/sb (對...打賭)。"},{"sentence":"I <target>bet</target> that the teacher will be very surprised when she sees the creative project the students worked on together.","translation":"我敢肯定老師看到學生們共同完成的創意專案時會非常驚訝。","explanation":"動詞「敢肯定」。用於非正式口語，表示強烈的預測。"},{"sentence":"Taking this risky investment was a big <target>bet</target> for the company, but it eventually led to a huge profit in the long run.","translation":"進行這項風險投資對公司來說是一次大賭注，但從長遠來看，最終帶來了巨大的利潤。","explanation":"名詞「賭注」。指冒險的嘗試或實際的賭金。"}],"related_forms":["bets","betting"]}

{"headword":"bind","explanation":"動詞「捆綁、將...綁在一起」；比喻義指「約束、使義務化」。常用片語 bind together (將...綁在一起)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer used a strong piece of rope to <target>bind</target> the bundles of dry grass <pattern>together</pattern> before moving them to the barn.","translation":"農夫用一條強韌的繩子將乾草捆綁在一起，然後將它們移到穀倉中。","explanation":"動詞「捆綁」。物理上的綁定。"},{"sentence":"The shared experience of surviving a natural disaster helped to <target>bind</target> the community <pattern>together</pattern>, creating a strong bond of friendship.","translation":"共同度過自然災害的經驗有助於將社區凝聚在一起，建立了深厚的友誼紐帶。","explanation":"動詞片語 bind together。比喻用法，指使人與人之間關係緊密。"},{"sentence":"The legal contract <target>binds</target> the company to provide high-quality materials, ensuring that the customers are satisfied with the final product.","translation":"法律合約約束公司必須提供高品質的材料，以確保客戶對最終產品感到滿意。","explanation":"動詞「約束」。指法律或道德上的義務。"}],"related_forms":["binding","bound"]}

{"headword":"bitter","explanation":"形容詞「苦的；憤怒的；嚴酷的」。可用於描述味道、心情或天氣。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coffee was so <target>bitter</target> that he had to add two spoons of sugar to make it taste better.","translation":"這咖啡太苦了，以至於他必須加兩匙糖才能讓味道變好。","explanation":"形容詞「苦的」。描述味道。"},{"sentence":"After the long argument, the two brothers felt <target>bitter</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the way the family inheritance was divided.","translation":"經過長期的爭論，這兩兄弟對家族遺產的分配方式感到憤怒且不滿。","explanation":"形容詞「憤怒的、不滿的」。常用搭配：bitter about sth。"},{"sentence":"The climbers had to struggle through the <target>bitter</target> <pattern>cold</pattern> of the mountain peak, where the temperature dropped below minus twenty degrees.","translation":"登山者必須在山頂的嚴酷寒冷中艱難前行，那裡的溫度降至零下二十度以下。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴酷的」。常用搭配：bitter cold (極冷)。"}],"related_forms":["bitterness","bitterly"]}

{"headword": "bleed", "explanation": "動詞「流血」。指血液從傷口流出。此外，可用於描述色彩滲透或資金流失。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The athlete's knee began to <target>bleed</target> after he fell on the concrete ground during the basketball game, requiring a bandage.", "translation": "這名運動員在籃球賽中摔在水泥地上後，膝蓋開始流血，需要貼上繃帶。", "explanation": "動詞「流血」。"}, {"sentence": "When the nurse cleaned the deep cut on the patient's finger, it started to <target>bleed</target> again, so she applied pressure to stop it.", "translation": "當護士清理病人手指上的深切口時，傷口又開始流血，於是她施加壓力以止血。", "explanation": "動詞「流血」。"}, {"sentence": "The artist noticed that the red ink began to <target>bleed</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the blue paint, creating an unexpected purple swirl on the canvas.", "translation": "藝術家注意到紅墨水開始滲入藍色油漆中，在畫布上形成了一個意外的紫色漩渦。", "explanation": "動詞「滲透、暈染」。描述色彩或液體擴散。"}, {"sentence": "The small company continued to <target>bleed</target> money <pattern>due to</pattern> poor management and a sudden drop in customer demand during the economic crisis.", "translation": "由於管理不善以及經濟危機期間客戶需求突然下降，這家小公司繼續損失資金。", "explanation": "動詞「流失」。常用於描述資金或資源的持續損失。"}], "related_forms": ["bled", "bleeding", "bleeds"]}

{"headword":"bless","explanation":"動詞，意為「祝福」或「保佑」。在宗教背景中常用於祈禱，在日常對話中則可用於表達感激或禮貌。常用搭配：God bless you (上帝保佑你)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The priest <target>blessed</target> the new couple during their wedding ceremony, wishing them a lifetime of happiness and love.","translation":"牧師在婚禮上祝福這對新人，祝願他們一生幸福美滿。","explanation":"動詞「祝福」。"},{"sentence":"After she sneezed, her friend quickly said, \"God <target>bless</target> you!\", which is a common way to show kindness in many cultures.","translation":"在她打噴嚏後，她的朋友趕快說：「上帝保佑你！」，這在許多文化中是一種表達親切的方式。","explanation":"常用片語 God bless you。"}],"related_forms":["blessed","blessing"]}

{"headword":"bloody","explanation":"形容詞，意為「血腥的」或「滿血的」。在英式英語中，它也可用作非正式的強調詞（類似於 very），但在 GSAT 考試中，主要考察其字面意思「血腥的」或「滿是血的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers returned from the <target>bloody</target> battle with many injuries, reminding everyone of the terrible cost of war.","translation":"士兵們從血腥的戰鬥中歸來，帶著許多傷勢，提醒著每個人戰爭的可怕代價。","explanation":"形容詞「血腥的」。"},{"sentence":"The doctor quickly cleaned the <target>bloody</target> bandage and checked the wound to ensure there was no more bleeding.","translation":"醫生迅速清理了血跡斑斑的繃帶並檢查傷口，以確保不再出血。","explanation":"形容詞「滿是血的」。"}],"related_forms":["blood"]}

{"headword": "blouse", "explanation": "名詞，指女性穿的「上衣」或「襯衫」。通常指較為寬鬆或材質較輕的衣物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She chose to wear a white silk <target>blouse</target> and a black skirt for her job interview, wanting to look professional and neat.", "translation": "她選擇穿一件白色絲綢上衣和一條黑裙子參加工作面試，希望看起來專業且整潔。", "explanation": "名詞「上衣」。"}, {"sentence": "The boutique sells a variety of elegant <target>blouses</target> made from breathable fabrics, which are perfect for women working in professional offices.", "translation": "這家精品店銷售各種由透氣面料製成的優雅上衣，非常適合在專業辦公室工作的女性。", "explanation": "名詞「上衣」。"}], "related_forms": ["blouses"]}

{"headword":"bold","explanation":"形容詞，意為「大膽的」或「勇敢的」。也可以指字體「粗體的」。常用搭配：a bold move (大膽的舉措)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a <target>bold</target> <pattern>move</pattern> for the young entrepreneur to invest all his savings into a new technology company.","translation":"對於這位年輕的企業家來說，將所有積蓄投資於一家新科技公司是一個大膽的舉措。","explanation":"形容詞「大膽的」。常用搭配：a bold move。"},{"sentence":"The designer used <target>bold</target> colors in the painting to attract attention and express strong emotions in the artwork.","translation":"設計師在畫作中使用大膽的顏色來吸引注意力並在藝術品中表達強烈的情感。","explanation":"形容詞「大膽的/鮮明的」。"},{"sentence":"Please make sure to put the main titles in <target>bold</target> font so that the readers can easily find the key sections.","translation":"請確保將主標題設為粗體，以便讀者可以輕鬆找到關鍵章節。","explanation":"形容詞「粗體的」。"}],"related_forms":["boldly","boldness"]}

{"headword":"bomb","explanation":"名詞「炸彈」；動詞「轟炸」或（非正式）「徹底失敗」。在 GSAT 中，重點在於其作為武器的名詞用法和作動詞時的轟炸意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police used a special robot to carefully remove the <target>bomb</target> from the building before it could explode.","translation":"警察使用一台特殊機器人，在炸彈爆炸前小心地將其從建築物中移走。","explanation":"名詞「炸彈」。"},{"sentence":"During the war, the enemy forces <target>bombed</target> the city's bridge to cut off the transport of food and medicine.","translation":"戰爭期間，敵軍轟炸了城市的橋樑，以切斷食物和藥品的運輸。","explanation":"動詞「轟炸」。"},{"sentence":"The singer was so nervous that he <target>bombed</target> his first performance, forgetting all the lyrics in front of the crowd.","translation":"這位歌手太緊張了，以至於他在第一次表演中徹底失敗，在人群面前忘記了所有歌詞。","explanation":"動詞「徹底失敗」（非正式用法）。"}],"related_forms":["bomber","bombing"]}

{"headword": "bookcase", "explanation": "名詞，意為「書櫃」或「書架」。指用來存放書籍的家具。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He spent the entire afternoon organizing his large <target>bookcase</target>, arranging the novels and textbooks by their genres.", "translation": "他花了一整個下午整理他的大書櫃，將小說和教科書按類別排列。", "explanation": "名詞「書櫃」。"}, {"sentence": "The school library installed several new <target>bookcases</target> to accommodate the growing collection of research papers and academic journals.", "translation": "學校圖書館安裝了幾個新書櫃，以容納不斷增加的研究論文和學術期刊收藏。", "explanation": "名詞「書櫃」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"boot","explanation":"名詞「靴子」或（英式英語）「汽車後車廂」；動詞「啟動（電腦）」或「踢出」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because of the heavy rain and mud, the hikers wore waterproof <target>boots</target> to keep their feet dry and warm.","translation":"由於大雨和泥濘，登山客穿著防水靴子以保持雙腳乾燥溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「靴子」。"},{"sentence":"Please put the heavy suitcases in the <target>boot</target> of the car so we can have more space inside for the passengers.","translation":"請將沉重的行李箱放入汽車後車廂，這樣我們在車內就有更多空間給乘客。","explanation":"名詞「汽車後車廂」（英式英語）。"},{"sentence":"The computer takes a few seconds to <target>boot</target> <pattern>up</pattern> after you press the power button on the CPU.","translation":"按下 CPU 上的電源按鈕後，電腦需要幾秒鐘才能啟動。","explanation":"動詞片語 boot up 表「啟動電腦」。"}],"related_forms":["boots"]}

{"headword": "bore", "explanation": "動詞「使厭煩」或「鑽孔」；名詞「枯燥的人」。注意其不規則變化：bore-bore-borne (作為 bear 的過去式) 或 bore-bored-bored (作為使厭煩的動詞)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The history lecture was so long and detailed that it began to <target>bore</target> the students, who started to daydream.", "translation": "這場歷史講座太長且太詳細，開始讓學生們感到厭煩，他們開始發呆。", "explanation": "動詞「使厭煩」。"}, {"sentence": "He is a total <target>bore</target> who only talks about his coin collection for hours, making everyone at the party feel tired.", "translation": "他是一個完全枯燥的人，總是花好幾個小時談論他的硬幣收藏，讓派對上的每個人都感到疲倦。", "explanation": "名詞「枯燥的人」。"}, {"sentence": "The engineers had to <target>bore</target> a deep hole through the mountain to build a tunnel for the new railway system.", "translation": "工程師必須在山中鑽一個深孔，以便為新鐵路系統建造隧道。", "explanation": "動詞「鑽孔」。"}, {"sentence": "The mother <target>bore</target> the responsibility of raising three children alone after her husband passed away unexpectedly ten years ago.", "translation": "這位母親在十年前丈夫意外去世後，承擔了獨自撫養三個孩子的責任。", "explanation": "動詞 bear 的過去式，表示「承擔」或「承受」。"}, {"sentence": "The evidence <target>bore</target> out the witness's claims, proving that the suspect had been at the location during the crime.", "translation": "證據證實了證人的說法，證明嫌疑人在犯罪期間處於該地點。", "explanation": "動詞 bear 的過去式，常用搭配 bear out (證實)。"}], "related_forms": ["boring", "bored"]}

{"headword": "bowling", "explanation": "名詞，指「保齡球」這項運動。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The classmates decided to go <target>bowling</target> after the final exams to relax and have some fun together.", "translation": "同學們決定在期末考後去打保齡球，以放鬆心情並一起享受樂趣。", "explanation": "名詞「保齡球」。"}, {"sentence": "My brother has been practicing <target>bowling</target> every weekend to improve his technique and achieve a higher score in the tournament.", "translation": "我的哥哥每個週末都在練習打保齡球，以提高他的技術並在錦標賽中獲得更高分數。", "explanation": "名詞「保齡球」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"brake","explanation":"名詞「煞車」；動詞「煞車」或「減速」。注意與 break (打破) 的發音相同，但意思完全不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver had to <target>brake</target> suddenly when a cat ran across the road, narrowly avoiding a serious accident.","translation":"當一隻貓跑過馬路時，駕駛員不得不突然煞車，險些避免了一場嚴重事故。","explanation":"動詞「煞車」。"},{"sentence":"Because the <target>brakes</target> on the old bicycle were worn out, the rider had difficulty stopping the bike at the red light.","translation":"由於這輛舊自行車的煞車損壞了，騎車的人在紅燈前很難停下來。","explanation":"名詞「煞車」。"}],"related_forms":["braking"]}

{"headword":"brass","explanation":"名詞「黃銅」或「管樂器」；形容詞「黃銅色的」。在 GSAT 中，常出現在描述音樂、材質或比喻「厚臉皮 (bold/shameless)」的上下文中。注意與 bronze (青銅) 的區別：brass 是銅與鋅的合金，而 bronze 是銅與錫的合金。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school band's <target>brass</target> <pattern>section</pattern>, including trumpets and trombones, added a powerful sound to the graduation ceremony performance.","translation":"學校樂團的銅管樂器組，包括小號和長號，為畢業典禮的表演增添了強而有力的聲音。","explanation":"名詞「管樂器」。brass section 指的是管樂組。"},{"sentence":"The antique door handle was made of polished <target>brass</target>, giving the old library a classic and elegant appearance.","translation":"這把古董門把是用拋光黃銅製成的，讓這座古老圖書館呈現出經典且優雅的外觀。","explanation":"名詞「黃銅」。指一種金屬材質。"},{"sentence":"He had the <target>brass</target> to tell the teacher he forgot his homework because he was too busy playing video games.","translation":"他竟然敢告訴老師他忘了帶作業，因為他太忙於玩電子遊戲。","explanation":"名詞「厚臉皮」。在非正式用法中，brass 指大膽或厚臉皮。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bravery","explanation":"名詞「勇敢」。指面對危險或痛苦時表現出的勇氣。常用搭配：show bravery (表現出勇敢), act of bravery (勇敢的行為)。注意與 brave (形容詞) 的關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"The firefighter's <target>bravery</target> in rescuing the child from the burning building was praised by everyone in the community.","translation":"消防員從燃燒大樓中救出孩子的勇敢行為受到了社區中每個人的稱讚。","explanation":"名詞「勇敢」。指面對危險時的勇氣。"},{"sentence":"Saving a drowning swimmer required great <target>bravery</target>, as the currents were strong and the water was freezing cold.","translation":"救一名溺水游泳者需要極大的勇氣，因為水流強勁且水溫冰冷。","explanation":"名詞「勇敢」。"}],"related_forms":["brave"]}

{"headword":"breast","explanation":"名詞「胸部」或「胸脯」。在生物學或醫學上下文中常用，或在文學描述中指「內心」。常用搭配：breast cancer (乳腺癌), chicken breast (雞胸肉)。","entries":[{"sentence":"For a healthy diet, many athletes prefer eating grilled chicken <target>breast</target> because it is high in protein and low in fat.","translation":"為了健康的飲食，許多運動員偏好食用烤雞胸肉，因為其蛋白質高且脂肪低。","explanation":"名詞「胸脯」。指雞肉的胸部部位。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that regular <target>breast</target> <pattern>exams</pattern> are essential for the early detection and prevention of breast cancer.","translation":"醫生解釋說，定期進行乳房檢查對於早期發現和預防乳腺癌至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「胸部」。breast exams 指乳房檢查。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"breath","explanation":"名詞「呼吸」或「氣息」。注意與動詞 breathe 的區別：breath 是名詞 (發音為 /brɛθ/)，而 breathe 是動詞 (發音為 /briːð/)。常用搭配：take a breath (深呼吸), hold one's breath (屏息)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before starting her presentation, the student <pattern>took</pattern> a deep <target>breath</target> to calm her nerves and focus her mind.","translation":"在開始簡報之前，這名學生深呼吸了一口氣，以平復緊張情緒並集中精神。","explanation":"名詞「呼吸」。take a deep breath 為常見片語。"},{"sentence":"The children <pattern>held</pattern> their <target>breath</target> in anticipation as the magician slowly opened the box to reveal the rabbit.","translation":"孩子們屏息以待，看著魔術師緩緩打開盒子，露出那隻兔子。","explanation":"名詞「氣息」。hold one's breath 意為「屏息」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"breathe","explanation":"動詞「呼吸」。指吸入和呼出空氣的過程。常用搭配：breathe in (吸氣), breathe out (呼氣), breathe deeply (深呼吸)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After running the hundred-meter sprint, the athlete struggled to <target>breathe</target> <pattern>normally</pattern> as he gasped for air.","translation":"跑完百米衝刺後，這名運動員因為喘不過氣而難以正常呼吸。","explanation":"動詞「呼吸」。breathe normally 指正常呼吸。"},{"sentence":"During the yoga class, the instructor told us to <target>breathe</target> <pattern>in</pattern> slowly through the nose and <target>breathe</target> <pattern>out</pattern> through the mouth.","translation":"在瑜伽課上，指導員告訴我們用鼻子緩慢吸氣，然後用嘴呼氣。","explanation":"動詞片語 breathe in (吸氣) 與 breathe out (呼氣)。"}],"related_forms":["breath"]}

{"headword":"breeze","explanation":"名詞「微風」；動詞「輕鬆完成」。作為名詞時，常用於描述舒適的輕風。作為動詞時，常以 breeze through (輕鬆通過) 的形式出現，表示輕鬆地完成某事。常用搭配：a gentle breeze (微風), breeze through the exam (輕鬆通過考試)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gentle <target>breeze</target> from the ocean made the afternoon walk along the beach very relaxing and pleasant for the tourists.","translation":"來自海洋的輕微風讓遊客們在海邊的下午散步變得非常放鬆且愉快。","explanation":"名詞「微風」。"},{"sentence":"Having studied hard for several months, the top student <target>breezed</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the final exam without any difficulty.","translation":"經過數月的努力學習，這名頂尖學生毫不困難地輕鬆通過了期末考。","explanation":"動詞片語 breeze through 意為「輕鬆完成」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"brick","explanation":"名詞「磚塊」。常用於描述建築材質或比喻「可靠的人」。常用搭配：brick wall (磚牆), red brick (紅磚)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old university campus is famous for its traditional red <target>brick</target> buildings, which give the area a historic feel.","translation":"這座古老的大學校區以其傳統的紅磚建築而聞名，讓該區域具有歷史感。","explanation":"名詞「磚塊」。"},{"sentence":"The child tried to build a small castle using <target>bricks</target> and mortar, but it collapsed after a few minutes.","translation":"孩子試著用磚塊和水泥建造一座小城堡，但幾分鐘後就倒塌了。","explanation":"名詞「磚塊」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bride","explanation":"名詞「新娘」。指結婚當天或剛結婚的女性。常用搭配：bride and groom (新郎新娘)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>bride</target> looked stunning in her white wedding dress as she walked down the aisle toward her future husband.","translation":"新娘穿著白色婚紗走在通道上走向她未來的丈夫，看起來美極了。","explanation":"名詞「新娘」。"},{"sentence":"At the wedding reception, the <target>bride</target> and groom thanked their parents for their support and love throughout their lives.","translation":"在婚禮招待會上，新郎新娘感謝父母在他們生命中給予的支持與愛。","explanation":"名詞「新娘」。bride and groom 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["bridesmaid"]}

{"headword":"broadcast","explanation":"名詞「廣播、電視節目」；動詞「播送、傳播」。動詞形式不規則，通常為 broadcast-broadcast-broadcast (雖然 broadcasted 亦可接受)。常用搭配：broadcast live (現場直播), broadcast a message (傳播訊息)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The national news <target>broadcast</target> provided detailed information about the upcoming election and the candidates' platforms.","translation":"國家新聞廣播提供了關於即將到來的選舉和候選人政綱的詳細資訊。","explanation":"名詞「廣播」。指電視或電台的節目。"},{"sentence":"The radio station decided to <target>broadcast</target> the championship game <pattern>live</pattern> so that fans could hear the action in real time.","translation":"電台決定現場直播冠軍賽，以便球迷能即時聽到比賽過程。","explanation":"動詞「播送」。broadcast live 指現場直播。"},{"sentence":"Some people tend to <target>broadcast</target> their private lives <pattern>on</pattern> social media, which can lead to privacy concerns.","translation":"有些人傾向於在社群媒體上公開傳播他們的私人生活，這可能會導致隱私問題。","explanation":"動詞「傳播」。指將資訊散布給大眾。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"brunch","explanation":"名詞「早午餐」。由 breakfast 和 lunch 組合而成，指在早晨晚些時候或中午前吃的一餐。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since they woke up late on Sunday, the couple decided to go out for <target>brunch</target> at a trendy cafe downtown.","translation":"由於他們週日晚起，這對夫婦決定去市中心一家時尚的咖啡館吃早午餐。","explanation":"名詞「早午餐」。"},{"sentence":"A typical <target>brunch</target> menu often includes a combination of eggs, pancakes, fresh fruit, and coffee or orange juice.","translation":"典型的早午餐菜單通常包含蛋、鬆餅、新鮮水果以及咖啡或柳橙汁的組合。","explanation":"名詞「早午餐」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bubble","explanation":"名詞「氣泡、泡沫」；動詞「起泡、沸騰」。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法常指物理上的氣泡或經濟上的泡沫。動詞用法常用於描述液體加熱或情緒激動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The child enjoyed blowing soap <target>bubbles</target> in the garden, watching them float gently in the breeze before they eventually popped.","translation":"孩子在花園裡享受吹肥皂泡，看著它們在微風中輕輕飄浮，直到最後破裂。","explanation":"名詞「氣泡」。"},{"sentence":"Economists warned that the housing market was a <target>bubble</target> that would eventually burst, leading to a severe financial crisis.","translation":"經濟學家警告說，房地產市場是一個泡沫，最終會破裂，導致嚴重的金融危機。","explanation":"名詞「泡沫」。比喻指價格過高且不可持續的經濟狀態。"},{"sentence":"As the soup <target>bubbled</target> on the stove, the chef added more spices to enhance the flavor of the dish.","translation":"當湯在爐子上沸騰時，廚師加入了更多香料來提升菜餚的味道。","explanation":"動詞「沸騰」。描述液體受熱產生氣泡的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The young girl's excitement <target>bubbled</target> <pattern>over</pattern> as she received the acceptance letter from her dream university.","translation":"當她收到夢想大學的錄取通知書時，她的興奮之情溢於言表。","explanation":"動詞片語 bubble over 表示「情緒激動、溢出」。"}],"related_forms":["bubbles","bubbling"]}

{"headword": "bucket", "explanation": "名詞「桶子」。常用於描述盛裝液體或物品的容器。常見搭配有 a bucket of (一桶...)，以及片語 kick the bucket (俚語：去世)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The gardener used a large plastic <target>bucket</target> to carry water to the thirsty plants in the backyard during the summer heat.", "translation": "在夏季酷暑中，園丁使用一個大型塑料桶將水搬到後院乾渴的植物旁。", "explanation": "名詞「桶子」。"}, {"sentence": "During the heavy rain, water leaked through the ceiling, so the students placed a <target>bucket</target> <pattern>of</pattern> water underneath to catch the drips.", "translation": "大雨期間，水從天花板漏下來，所以學生們在下方放了一個水桶來接水。", "explanation": "名詞「桶子」。常用搭配 a bucket of water。"}, {"sentence": "The old man had a long list of things he wanted to do before he finally <target>kicked</target> the <target>bucket</target>, such as traveling to Italy.", "translation": "這個老人有一張他想在去世前完成的事情清單，例如前往義大利旅遊。", "explanation": "俚語 kick the bucket 表示「去世」。"}], "related_forms": ["buckets"]}

{"headword":"bud","explanation":"名詞「花蕾、芽」；動詞「發芽」。名詞用法指植物開花前的狀態。動詞用法指植物開始生長出新芽。","entries":[{"sentence":"In early spring, the cherry blossom <target>buds</target> begin to appear on the branches, signaling the arrival of warmer weather.","translation":"早春時分，櫻花的花蕾開始在枝頭出現，預示著溫暖天氣的到來。","explanation":"名詞「花蕾」。"},{"sentence":"The gardener carefully pruned the <target>buds</target> of the roses to ensure that the flowers would grow stronger and more beautiful.","translation":"園丁小心地修剪玫瑰的花蕾，以確保花朵能長得更強壯且更美麗。","explanation":"名詞「花蕾」。"},{"sentence":"After the first warm rain of the season, the young plants began to <target>bud</target>, showing signs of new life.","translation":"在該季節的第一場暖雨後，年輕的植物開始發芽，顯示出新生命跡象。","explanation":"動詞「發芽」。"}],"related_forms":["budding"]}

{"headword":"budget","explanation":"名詞「預算」；動詞「編列預算」。名詞用法常考搭配 on a budget (在有限的預算內) 或 balanced budget (平衡預算)。動詞用法指為特定目的規劃財務支出。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council had to work <pattern>on</pattern> a tight <target>budget</target> to organize the annual school festival without spending too much money.","translation":"學生會必須在緊湊的預算內籌辦年度學校祭典，以免花費過多金錢。","explanation":"名詞「預算」。片語 on a budget 表示「在有限的預算內」。"},{"sentence":"The city government decided to <target>budget</target> more funds <pattern>for</pattern> the construction of new public libraries to encourage reading among citizens.","translation":"市政府決定為興建新的公共圖書館編列更多資金，以鼓勵市民閱讀。","explanation":"動詞「編列預算」。常用搭配 budget funds for sth。"},{"sentence":"The family discussed their monthly <target>budget</target> to decide which expenses could be reduced to save for their upcoming vacation.","translation":"這家人討論了他們的每月預算，以決定哪些支出可以減少，以便為即將到來的假期存錢。","explanation":"名詞「預算」。"},{"sentence":"The government's <target>budget</target> <pattern>deficit</pattern> increased significantly this year, leading to concerns about the country's overall economic stability.","translation":"政府的預算赤字今年顯著增加，導致人們對國家整體經濟穩定性的擔憂。","explanation":"名詞「預算」。常用搭配 budget deficit (預算赤字)。"}],"related_forms":["budgetary","budgeted"]}

{"headword":"buffalo","explanation":"名詞「水牛、野牛」。指一種大型有角的哺乳動物。在 GSAT 中通常出現在自然科學或動物類文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed to see a massive <target>buffalo</target> grazing peacefully in the open grassland of the national park.","translation":"遊客們驚訝地看到一頭巨大的野牛在國家公園的開闊草原上平靜地吃草。","explanation":"名詞「野牛」。"},{"sentence":"In some agricultural regions, farmers still rely on the <target>buffalo</target> to help them plow the fields before the planting season.","translation":"在某些農業地區，農民在播種季節前仍然依賴水牛來幫他們耕田。","explanation":"名詞「水牛」。"}],"related_forms":["buffaloes"]}

{"headword":"buffet","explanation":"名詞「自助餐」。指一種提供多種食物讓客人自行選擇並盛盤的用餐方式。注意發音與動詞 buffet (衝擊) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel provides a lavish breakfast <target>buffet</target> every morning, allowing guests to choose from a wide variety of fruits, pastries, and eggs.","translation":"飯店每天早上提供豪華的自助早餐，讓客人能從各式各樣的水果、糕點和蛋料理中選擇。","explanation":"名詞「自助餐」。"},{"sentence":"For the graduation party, the school decided to order a <target>buffet</target> meal because it was easier to manage for a large group of people.","translation":"為了畢業派對，學校決定訂自助餐，因為對大群人來說更容易管理。","explanation":"名詞「自助餐」。"}],"related_forms":["buffets"]}

{"headword":"bulb","explanation":"名詞「燈泡」或「植物的鱗莖」。在 GSAT 中，兩種含義均常見。燈泡是指電燈的玻璃外殼；鱗莖是指植物儲存營養的地下莖。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student quickly replaced the burnt-out <target>bulb</target> in his desk lamp to ensure he had enough light to study for the final exam.","translation":"學生迅速更換了書桌燈上燒毀的燈泡，以確保他有足夠的光線準備期末考。","explanation":"名詞「燈泡」。"},{"sentence":"The gardener planted tulip <target>bulbs</target> in the autumn, knowing they would bloom into beautiful flowers in the following spring.","translation":"園丁在秋天種植了鬱金香的鱗莖，知道它們在次年春天會開出美麗的花朵。","explanation":"名詞「鱗莖」。"},{"sentence":"Modern LED <target>bulbs</target> are much more energy-efficient than traditional incandescent ones, which helps reduce electricity costs for many households.","translation":"現代的 LED 燈泡比傳統的白熾燈泡節能得多，這有助於降低許多家庭的電費。","explanation":"名詞「燈泡」。"}],"related_forms":["bulbs"]}

{"headword":"bull","explanation":"名詞「公牛」。指未去勢的成年雄性牛。常用於描述動物特性或比喻指強壯但可能暴躁的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer warned the visitors not to approach the <target>bull</target> in the field, as it could become aggressive and attack unexpectedly.","translation":"農夫警告遊客不要接近田裡的公牛，因為它可能會變得具有攻擊性並出其不意地攻擊。","explanation":"名詞「公牛」。"},{"sentence":"In the traditional Spanish festival, the brave matador faces a charging <target>bull</target> in the arena to demonstrate his skill and courage.","translation":"在傳統的西班牙節日中，勇敢的鬥牛士在場中面對衝鋒的公牛，以展示他的技巧和勇氣。","explanation":"名詞「公牛」。"}],"related_forms":["bulls"]}

{"headword":"bullet","explanation":"名詞「子彈」。指發射自槍械的金屬彈頭。比喻用法中， bullet points (項目符號) 是文書處理中的常見術語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective found a small <target>bullet</target> embedded in the wall, which provided a crucial clue to solve the crime scene mystery.","translation":"偵探在牆上發現了一顆小的子彈，這為解決犯罪現場之謎提供了關鍵線索。","explanation":"名詞「子彈」。"},{"sentence":"To make the presentation more clear, the student used <target>bullet</target> <pattern>points</pattern> to list the main arguments of his research paper.","translation":"為了讓簡報更清晰，學生使用項目符號來列出研究論文的主要論點。","explanation":"名詞「項目符號」。常用搭配 bullet points。"}],"related_forms":["bullets"]}

{"headword":"bump","explanation":"名詞「碰撞、腫塊」；動詞「碰撞、撞到」。名詞用法指意外的碰撞或皮膚上的腫塊。動詞用法指不小心撞到某物或某人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy had a large <target>bump</target> on his forehead after he accidentally ran into the edge of the wooden table.","translation":"小男孩在不小心撞到木桌邊緣後，額頭上出現了一個大腫塊。","explanation":"名詞「腫塊」。"},{"sentence":"The passengers felt a sudden <target>bump</target> when the plane landed on the runway, but the pilot quickly stabilized the aircraft.","translation":"乘客在飛機降落跑道時感到一次突然的碰撞，但飛行員迅速穩定了飛機。","explanation":"名詞「碰撞」。"},{"sentence":"I accidentally <target>bumped</target> <pattern>into</pattern> an old friend at the supermarket yesterday, and we spent an hour catching up on each other's lives.","translation":"我昨天在超市不小心撞見了一位老朋友，我們花了一小時敘舊。","explanation":"動詞片語 bump into 表示「偶然遇見」。"},{"sentence":"Be careful when driving on this old road, because there are many speed <target>bumps</target> designed to slow down the traffic.","translation":"在這條舊路上開車要小心，因為有許多設計用來減速的減速帶。","explanation":"名詞「減速帶」。常用搭配 speed bumps。"}],"related_forms":["bumps","bumping","bumped"]}

{"headword":"bunch","explanation":"名詞「一串；一束；一群」。常用於指水果（如香蕉）、花卉或一群人。常用搭配：a bunch of (一大群/串/束)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She bought a large <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fresh lilies from the market to decorate her living room for the party.","translation":"她從市場買了一大束新鮮的百合花來裝飾派對時的客廳。","explanation":"名詞「一束」。用於描述花卉。"},{"sentence":"A <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students gathered in the library to discuss their group project and share their research findings.","translation":"一群學生聚集在圖書館討論他們的分組計畫並分享研究結果。","explanation":"名詞「一群」。用於描述人。"},{"sentence":"The monkey quickly grabbed a <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> bananas and climbed back up the tree before the tourists could react.","translation":"猴子迅速抓起一串香蕉，在遊客反應過來之前就爬回了樹上。","explanation":"名詞「一串」。用於描述水果。"}],"related_forms":["bunches"]}

{"headword":"bundle","explanation":"名詞「一捆；一束」。通常指用繩子或包裝材料捆綁在一起的東西。常用搭配：a bundle of (一捆...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener tied a <target>bundle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dried sticks together to create a natural fence around the small flower bed.","translation":"園丁將一捆乾樹枝捆在一起，在小花床周圍建立一個天然的圍欄。","explanation":"名詞「一捆」。指用繩子捆起來的東西。"},{"sentence":"He carried a heavy <target>bundle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> old newspapers to the recycling center to help clean up the garage.","translation":"他將一捆沉重的舊報紙搬到回收中心，以幫助清理車庫。","explanation":"名詞「一捆」。常用於描述紙類或衣物。"}],"related_forms":["bundles"]}

{"headword":"bury","explanation":"動詞「埋葬；掩埋；掩蓋」。可指將人或動物埋入土中，也可指將東西藏在某處或掩蓋情緒。常用搭配：bury something in (將...埋在...中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the pet dog passed away, the children decided to <target>bury</target> it <pattern>in</pattern> the backyard under their favorite oak tree.","translation":"寵物狗去世後，孩子們決定將它埋在後院他們最喜歡的橡樹下。","explanation":"動詞「埋葬」。指將生物埋入土中。"},{"sentence":"The heavy snowfall <target>buried</target> the entire village <pattern>under</pattern> a thick white blanket, making it impossible to drive on the roads.","translation":"大雪將整個村莊掩埋在厚厚的白色毯子之下，使得道路無法行車。","explanation":"動詞「掩埋」。指物體被大量物質覆蓋。"},{"sentence":"She tried to <target>bury</target> her sadness <pattern>in</pattern> her work, spending ten hours a day at the office to avoid thinking about the breakup.","translation":"她試圖將悲傷掩埋在工作中，每天在辦公室花十個小時，以避免想到分手的事。","explanation":"動詞「掩蓋」。指隱藏情緒或感受。"}],"related_forms":["buried","burying"]}

{"headword":"bush","explanation":"名詞「灌木；叢林」。指低矮且分枝多的植物。常考搭配：in the bushes (在灌木叢中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small rabbit quickly disappeared <pattern>into</pattern> the thick <target>bush</target> when it heard the sound of someone approaching.","translation":"小兔子聽到有人靠近的聲音時，迅速消失在濃密的灌木叢中。","explanation":"名詞「灌木」。指低矮的植物。"},{"sentence":"The gardener spent the entire morning trimming the <target>bushes</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the house to keep the garden looking neat and tidy.","translation":"園丁花了一整個早晨修剪房子周圍的灌木，以保持花園整潔。","explanation":"名詞「灌木」。複數型態。"}],"related_forms":["bushes"]}

{"headword":"buzz","explanation":"名詞「嗡嗡聲」；動詞「發出嗡嗡聲；興奮」。動詞用法中，buzz about (到處奔波/討論) 是常見的口語用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The constant <target>buzz</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the air conditioner in the classroom was so loud that it distracted some students during the exam.","translation":"教室裡冷氣機持續的嗡嗡聲太大，以至於在考試期間分心了一些學生。","explanation":"名詞「嗡嗡聲」。指機械或昆蟲發出的聲音。"},{"sentence":"A swarm of bees began to <target>buzz</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the colorful flowers in the garden, collecting pollen for their hive.","translation":"一群蜜蜂開始在花園裡色彩鮮豔的花朵周圍嗡嗡作響，為牠們的蜂巢收集花粉。","explanation":"動詞「發出嗡嗡聲」。指昆蟲飛行的聲音。"},{"sentence":"The entire school was <target>buzzing</target> <pattern>with</pattern> excitement after the principal announced that there would be no classes on Friday.","translation":"在校長宣布週五不用上課後，整個學校都因為興奮而沸騰。","explanation":"動詞「興奮」。指環境中充滿了興奮的氛圍或討論。"}],"related_forms":["buzzes","buzzing","buzzed"]}

{"headword":"cabin","explanation":"名詞「小木屋；船艙/飛機客艙」。指在鄉間或森林中的簡單住宅，或是大型交通工具中的私人房間。","entries":[{"sentence":"For their winter vacation, the family rented a cozy <target>cabin</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the mountains, far away from the noise of the city.","translation":"為了冬季假期，這家人在山中租了一間舒適的小木屋，遠離城市的噪音。","explanation":"名詞「小木屋」。指鄉間簡單的房屋。"},{"sentence":"The flight attendant walked through the <target>cabin</target> to ensure all passengers had fastened their seatbelts before takeoff.","translation":"空服員走過客艙，以確保所有乘客在起飛前都已繫好安全帶。","explanation":"名詞「客艙」。指飛機內部的乘客區域。"},{"sentence":"The sailors spent most of their time on deck, but they slept in small <target>cabins</target> <pattern>below</pattern> the main deck of the ship.","translation":"水手們大部分時間都在甲板上，但他們睡在船的主甲板下方的狹小船艙中。","explanation":"名詞「船艙」。指船上的私人房間。"}],"related_forms":["cabins"]}

{"headword":"cable","explanation":"名詞「電纜；鋼索」；動詞「發電報」。在現代英語中，名詞用法最為常見，特別是與科技或建築相關的語境。","entries":[{"sentence":"The technician had to replace the damaged <target>cable</target> <pattern>under</pattern> the street to restore internet access for the entire neighborhood.","translation":"技術人員必須更換街道下損壞的電纜，以恢復整個社區的網路連線。","explanation":"名詞「電纜」。指傳輸電力或數據的線路。"},{"sentence":"The bridge is supported by massive steel <target>cables</target> that can hold thousands of tons of weight without breaking.","translation":"這座橋是由巨大的鋼索支撐的，可以承載數千噸的重量而不會斷裂。","explanation":"名詞「鋼索」。指強力的金屬線。"},{"sentence":"In the early twentieth century, governments used to <target>cable</target> urgent messages <pattern>to</pattern> other countries before the invention of the telephone.","translation":"在二十世紀初，政府在電話發明之前，習慣於向其他國家發電報。","explanation":"動詞「發電報」。指使用電報系統傳遞訊息。"}],"related_forms":["cables"]}

{"headword":"cafeteria","explanation":"名詞「自助餐廳」。通常指學校、醫院或公司內部的餐廳，乘客自行取餐。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the lunch break, the <target>cafeteria</target> was crowded with students who were waiting in line to get their meals.","translation":"午餐時間，自助餐廳裡擠滿了等待領餐的學生。","explanation":"名詞「自助餐廳」。指學校內部餐廳。"},{"sentence":"The hospital <target>cafeteria</target> offers a variety of healthy options, including fresh salads and fruit, for patients and their visitors.","translation":"醫院的自助餐廳提供多種健康的選擇，包括新鮮沙拉和水果，供患者及其訪客享用。","explanation":"名詞「自助餐廳」。指醫療機構內的餐廳。"}],"related_forms":["cafeterias"]}

{"headword":"campus","explanation":"名詞「校園」。指大學或學院的整個區域，包括教學樓、宿舍和圖書館。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university <target>campus</target> is so large that many students use bicycles to travel <pattern>between</pattern> the different buildings.","translation":"這所大學的校園非常大，以至於許多學生使用自行車在不同建築物之間往返。","explanation":"名詞「校園」。指大學的地理區域。"},{"sentence":"New security cameras were installed <pattern>across</pattern> the <target>campus</target> to ensure the safety of students and staff members.","translation":"校園各處安裝了新的監視攝影機，以確保學生和教職員的安全。","explanation":"名詞「校園」。"}],"related_forms":["campuses"]}

{"headword":"canyon","explanation":"名詞「峽谷」。指由河流切割而成的深邃谷地。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Grand <target>Canyon</target> in the United States is famous for its stunning red rocks and the river that flows <pattern>through</pattern> it.","translation":"美國的大峽谷以其令人驚嘆的紅色岩石以及流經其間的河流而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「峽谷」。指地質學上的深谷。"},{"sentence":"The hikers carefully walked <pattern>along</pattern> the edge of the <target>canyon</target> to admire the breathtaking view of the valley below.","translation":"登山客小心地沿著峽谷邊緣行走，以欣賞下方谷底令人屏息的美景。","explanation":"名詞「峽谷」。"}],"related_forms":["canyons"]}

{"headword":"capable","explanation":"形容詞「有能力的」。常用搭配 be capable of + V-ing，表示「能夠做某事」。注意與 able 的區別：capable 強調的是潛在的能力、才幹或資質，例如 a capable manager (一名能幹的經理)；而 able 則更常用於描述在特定情況下能夠完成某件事，例如 be able to V (能夠做...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher believes that every student is <target>capable</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>achieving</pattern> great things if they put in enough effort and stay focused.","translation":"老師相信，只要學生們付出足夠的努力並保持專注，每個人都有能力成就偉大的事業。","explanation":"形容詞「有能力的」。常用搭配 be capable of + V-ing。"},{"sentence":"Despite her lack of experience, she proved to be a <target>capable</target> leader who could handle difficult situations with calmness and wisdom.","translation":"儘管缺乏經驗，她證明了自己是一位能幹的領導者，能夠以冷靜和智慧處理困難的情況。","explanation":"形容詞「有能力的」。在此處作為形容詞修飾名詞 leader，表示「能幹的」。"}],"related_forms":["capability","incapable"]}
comment: TAG_SCOPE_ERROR: In sentence 1, 'achieving' is not a collocation of 'capable', it is the object of the preposition 'of'. Only 'of' should be tagged as the pattern.

response: {"headword":"captain","explanation":"名詞「船長、機長、隊長」。指負責指揮或領導一個團隊或交通工具的最高負責人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>captain</target> of the airplane calmly announced that they would be landing soon and asked passengers to fasten their seatbelts.","translation":"機長冷靜地宣布他們很快就會降落，並要求乘客繫好安全帶。","explanation":"名詞「機長」。指飛機的最高指揮官。"},{"sentence":"The basketball <target>captain</target> encouraged his teammates to keep fighting until the final whistle blew, leading them to a narrow victory.","translation":"籃球隊隊長鼓勵隊友們在終場哨聲響起前繼續奮鬥，帶領他們贏得了一場微弱的勝利。","explanation":"名詞「隊長」。指運動隊伍中的領導者。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"capture","explanation":"動詞「捕獲、捕捉、記錄」。名詞「捕獲、捕捉」。動詞用法中，capture 除指物理上的捕捉外，還可用於描述捕捉瞬間的表情、光線或精髓，例如 capture the moment (捕捉瞬間)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wildlife photographer spent hours waiting in the forest to <target>capture</target> a perfect photo of the rare tiger in its natural habitat.","translation":"野生動物攝影師在森林中等待了數小時，以捕捉到一張罕見老虎在自然棲息地中的完美照片。","explanation":"動詞「捕捉」。指用相機捕捉瞬間。"},{"sentence":"After a long chase through the city, the police finally <target>captured</target> the criminal who had been hiding in an old warehouse for weeks.","translation":"經過在城市中長時間的追逐，警察終於逮捕了隱藏在舊倉庫中數週的罪犯。","explanation":"動詞「捕獲」。指將人或動物強行控制住。"},{"sentence":"The <target>capture</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the enemy's fortress was a turning point in the war, allowing the army to advance further into the territory.","translation":"奪取敵軍堡壘是一場戰爭的轉折點，使軍隊能夠進一步深入領土。","explanation":"名詞「捕獲、奪取」。常用搭配 capture of sth。"}],"related_forms":["capturing","captivate"]}
comment: RELATED_FORMS_ERROR: 'captivate' is not a related form of 'capture' as they have different meanings (capture: to catch; captivate: to attract/charm).

response: {"headword":"career","explanation":"名詞「職業、生涯」。指一個人一生中從事的一系列相關工作或專業領域。注意與 job (工作) 的區別：career 強調的是長期的職業發展路徑，而 job 則是指單一的具體工作職位。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many high school students are confused about which <target>career</target> <pattern>path</pattern> to choose, so they often seek advice from their school counselors.","translation":"許多高中生對於選擇哪條職業路徑感到困惑，因此他們經常尋求學校輔導老師的建議。","explanation":"名詞「職業、生涯」。常用搭配 career path (職業路徑)。"},{"sentence":"After ten years of hard work and continuous learning, she finally built a successful <target>career</target> <pattern>in</pattern> international law.","translation":"經過十年的努力與持續學習，她終於在國際法領域建立了一個成功的職業生涯。","explanation":"名詞「職業、生涯」。常用搭配 career in + 專業領域。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"carpenter","explanation":"名詞「木工、木匠」。指專業從事木材加工的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The skilled <target>carpenter</target> carefully crafted a beautiful hand-made dining table from a single piece of high-quality oak wood.","translation":"這位熟練的木匠精心製作了一張由單塊高品質橡木製成的精美手工餐桌。","explanation":"名詞「木工」。"},{"sentence":"My grandfather was a <target>carpenter</target> for forty years, and he can still build a sturdy bookshelf for the library using traditional tools.","translation":"我的祖父做了四十年的木匠，他仍然能使用傳統工具為圖書館打造一個穩固的書架。","explanation":"名詞「木工」。"}],"related_forms":["carpentry"]}

{"headword": "carpet", "explanation": "名詞「地毯」。動詞「鋪地毯」或「覆蓋」。動詞用法在 GSAT 較少見，但指將某物覆蓋在地面上。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hotel lobby had a thick, red <target>carpet</target> that made the room feel warm and luxurious, impressing all the arriving guests.", "translation": "飯店大廳鋪著厚厚的一層紅地毯，讓房間感覺溫暖且豪華，給所有抵達的賓客留下了深刻印象。", "explanation": "名詞「地毯」。"}, {"sentence": "The movie stars were welcomed with a <pattern>red</pattern> <target>carpet</target> treatment, symbolizing the high status and importance of the event.", "translation": "電影明星們受到了紅地毯待遇，象徵著這次活動的高地位與重要性。", "explanation": "名詞「地毯」。此處 red carpet 作為比喻用法，指受高度禮遇。"}, {"sentence": "The gardener decided to <target>carpet</target> the entire garden path with colorful autumn leaves to create a romantic atmosphere for the wedding.", "translation": "園丁決定用五彩繽紛的秋葉覆蓋整個花園小徑，為婚禮營造浪漫的氛圍。", "explanation": "動詞「覆蓋」。指像地毯一樣覆蓋地面。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"carriage","explanation":"名詞「馬車、車廂」。在英國英語中，carriage 常指火車的車廂 (train carriage)；而在歷史語境中，則指馬車。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the old movie, the princess traveled in a golden <target>carriage</target> <pattern>drawn by</pattern> four white horses to attend the royal ball.","translation":"在舊電影中，公主坐著由四隻白馬牽引的金色馬車前往參加皇家舞會。","explanation":"名詞「馬車」。常用搭配 drawn by (由...牽引)。"},{"sentence":"The passengers in the last <target>carriage</target> of the train had to wait a few minutes before they could get off at the station.","translation":"火車最後一節車廂的乘客必須等待幾分鐘才能在車站下車。","explanation":"名詞「車廂」。指火車的客運部分。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cart","explanation":"名詞「手推車、貨車」。動詞「運送、搬運」。動詞用法通常搭配 with，表示將某物搬運至某處。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer used a wooden <target>cart</target> to carry his fresh vegetables from the field to the local market every morning.","translation":"農夫每天早上使用木製手推車將新鮮蔬菜從田野運送到當地市場。","explanation":"名詞「手推車」。"},{"sentence":"The students had to <target>cart</target> their heavy textbooks <pattern>around</pattern> all day, which made them feel exhausted by the time school ended.","translation":"學生們得整天搬著沉重的教科書走來走去，這使得他們在放學時感到精疲力竭。","explanation":"動詞片語 cart around 表「搬運、攜帶」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cast","explanation":"動詞「投擲、分派角色、塑造」。名詞「演員陣容」。動詞 cast 常搭配 with 或 into 形式，例如 cast a vote (投票) 或 cast a shadow (投射陰影)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The director decided to <target>cast</target> a young actor with a lot of energy <pattern>as</pattern> the lead character in the new play.","translation":"導演決定選派一名充滿活力的年輕演員在劇中飾演主角。","explanation":"動詞「分派角色」。常用搭配 cast as (飾演...的角色)。"},{"sentence":"During the election, every citizen was encouraged to <target>cast</target> <pattern>a vote</pattern> to choose the best candidate for the mayor's office.","translation":"在選舉期間，每個公民都被鼓勵投票，以選出市長職位的最佳候選人。","explanation":"動詞「投擲」。此處為 cast a vote (投票) 的固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The tall building <target>cast</target> <pattern>a long shadow</pattern> <pattern>over</pattern> the small park, making it feel cooler in the afternoon sun.","translation":"那棟高樓在小公園上投射出長長的陰影，使午後的陽光下感覺更涼快。","explanation":"動詞「投射」。常用搭配 cast a shadow over sth (在...投射陰影)。"},{"sentence":"The movie had an amazing <target>cast</target> of talented actors, and their chemistry on screen made the story feel very realistic.","translation":"這部電影擁有由才華橫溢的演員組成的驚人陣容，他們在螢幕上的默契讓故事感覺非常真實。","explanation":"名詞「演員陣容」。指參與演出的所有演員。"}],"related_forms":["casting"]}

{"headword":"casual","explanation":"形容詞「隨意的、非正式的；偶然的」。常用於描述穿著 (casual clothes) 或會談 (casual conversation)。注意與 formal (正式的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher told the students that they could wear <target>casual</target> <pattern>clothes</pattern> on Friday, so many of them wore t-shirts and jeans.","translation":"老師告訴學生週五可以穿便服，所以許多人穿了 T 恤和牛仔褲。","explanation":"形容詞「隨意的、非正式的」。常用搭配 casual clothes (便服)。"},{"sentence":"During the break, the two classmates had a <target>casual</target> <pattern>conversation</pattern> about their favorite movies and plans for the summer vacation.","translation":"在休息時間，這兩個同學就他們最喜歡的電影和暑假計劃進行了一次隨意的交談。","explanation":"形容詞「隨意的」。指非正式的聊天。"},{"sentence":"The accident happened during a <target>casual</target> <pattern>stroll</pattern> <pattern>through</pattern> the park, when the man suddenly tripped over a large rock.","translation":"這場意外發生在一次隨意的散步中，當那個男人突然被一顆大石頭絆倒時。","explanation":"形容詞「偶然的」。指不經意地發生的情況。"}],"related_forms":["casually","casualness"]}

{"headword":"cattle","explanation":"名詞「牛（群）」。此字為集合名詞，單數形式表示複數意義，因此動詞必須使用複數動詞。注意與 cow (母牛) 或 bull (公牛) 的區別，cattle 指的是一群牛。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer spent the entire morning moving his <target>cattle</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a fresh pasture to ensure they had enough grass to eat.","translation":"農夫花整個早晨將他的牛群移至一片新鮮的牧場，以確保牠們有足夠的草吃。","explanation":"名詞「牛群」。cattle 作為集合名詞，後接複數動詞。"},{"sentence":"Many rural communities rely on raising <target>cattle</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their livelihood, producing beef and dairy products for the local market.","translation":"許多鄉村社區依靠養牛來維持生計，為當地市場提供牛肉和乳製品。","explanation":"名詞「牛群」。常用搭配：raise cattle (養牛)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cave","explanation":"名詞「洞穴」；動詞「屈服、讓步」。動詞用法常見於片語 cave in (坍塌或屈服於壓力)，是 GSAT 高階考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The explorers discovered a hidden <target>cave</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the mountains, where they found ancient paintings on the walls.","translation":"探險家在山中發現了一個隱藏的洞穴，他們在牆上發現了古代的繪畫。","explanation":"名詞「洞穴」。常用搭配：in a cave。"},{"sentence":"After weeks of pressure from the students, the school board finally <target>caved</target> <pattern>in</pattern> and agreed to extend the lunch break.","translation":"在學生們數週的壓力下，校董會終於屈服了，同意延長午休時間。","explanation":"動詞片語 cave in 表「屈服於壓力」。"},{"sentence":"The old roof of the abandoned warehouse <target>caved</target> <pattern>in</pattern> during the heavy storm, making the building dangerous to enter.","translation":"廢棄倉庫的舊屋頂在暴風雨中坍塌了，使得建築物進入起來很危險。","explanation":"動詞片語 cave in 表「坍塌」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"champion","explanation":"名詞「冠軍」或「擁護者/支持者」。注意後者用法，常搭配介系詞 for，表示支持某種理念、權利或事業。","entries":[{"sentence":"After winning the final match, the tennis player was crowned the <target>champion</target> of the tournament and received a gold trophy.","translation":"在贏得決賽後，這位網球選手被 crowned 為該錦標賽的冠軍並獲得了一座金獎盃。","explanation":"名詞「冠軍」。"},{"sentence":"The senator has been a lifelong <target>champion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> human rights, fighting for equality and justice for all people.","translation":"參議員一直是人權的終身擁護者，為所有人的平等與正義而戰。","explanation":"名詞「擁護者」。常用搭配：champion of sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"charm","explanation":"名詞「魅力」或「符咒/護身符」；動詞「使著迷」。名詞的魅力用法最常見，常搭配 have a charm 或 be charming。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small coastal village has a unique <target>charm</target> that attracts thousands of tourists every year who enjoy its peaceful atmosphere.","translation":"這個小漁村有一種獨特的魅力，每年吸引數千名遊客來享受其寧靜的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「魅力」。"},{"sentence":"She wore a small silver <target>charm</target> <pattern>on</pattern> her bracelet, which she believed would bring her good luck during the exams.","translation":"她在手鍊上戴了一個小小的銀色護身符，她相信這會在考試期間給她帶來好運。","explanation":"名詞「護身符」。"},{"sentence":"The street performer used his musical skills to <target>charm</target> the crowd, making everyone smile and dance along to the music.","translation":"動詞「使著迷」。指透過魅力或技巧讓人感到愉快。","explanation":"動詞用法。"}],"related_forms":["charming","charmer"]}

{"headword":"chat","explanation":"名詞或動詞「聊天」。在現代英語中，chat 常指非正式的對話，常搭配 with 或 about。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the class ended, the students had a quick <target>chat</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their teacher about the upcoming final project requirements.","translation":"下課後，學生們與老師快速地聊了聊關於即將到來的期末專題要求。","explanation":"名詞「聊天」。常用搭配：have a chat with someone。"},{"sentence":"I spent an hour <target>chatting</target> <pattern>with</pattern> my old friend on the phone, catching up on everything that had happened in our lives.","translation":"我在電話中與老朋友聊了一個小時，跟進彼此生活中發生的一切。","explanation":"動詞「聊天」。常用搭配：chat with someone。"},{"sentence":"The two colleagues decided to <target>chat</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the new company policy during their coffee break in the staff lounge.","translation":"兩位同事決定在員工休息室的咖啡時間聊聊公司的新政策。","explanation":"動詞「聊天」。常用搭配：chat about sth。"}],"related_forms":["chatty","chats"]}

{"headword":"cheek","explanation":"名詞「臉頰」。除了生理構造外，常考片語 have a cheek to do sth (厚著臉皮做某事) 或 turn the other cheek (寬容對待傷害)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little baby laughed and the mother kissed him gently <pattern>on</pattern> the <target>cheek</target> to show her love and affection.","translation":"小寶寶笑了，母親溫柔地親了他的臉頰以表達她的愛與關懷。","explanation":"名詞「臉頰」。常用搭配：on the cheek。"},{"sentence":"I cannot believe he had the <target>cheek</target> <pattern>to</pattern> ask for a raise after being late to work every single day this month.","translation":"我不敢相信他這個月每天上班都遲到，竟然還厚著臉皮要求加薪。","explanation":"名詞「厚著臉皮/膽量」。片語 have the cheek to V。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cheerful","explanation":"形容詞「開朗的、快活的」。常用於描述人的性格或環境的氛圍。注意與 happy 的區別：cheerful 強調的是外在表現出的愉快，而 happy 則是指內在的滿足感。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the rainy weather, the teacher remained <target>cheerful</target> and kept the students motivated with her positive energy and jokes.","translation":"儘管天氣下雨，老師依然保持開朗，用她的正能量和笑話激勵學生。","explanation":"形容詞「開朗的」。描述人的外表現出的愉快狀態。"},{"sentence":"The classroom was decorated with bright colors and posters, creating a <target>cheerful</target> atmosphere that made students feel welcome and relaxed.","translation":"教室被裝飾成鮮豔的色彩和海報，營造出一種快活的氛圍，讓學生感到受歡迎且放鬆。","explanation":"形容詞「快活的」。描述環境的氛圍。"}],"related_forms":["cheerfully","cheerfulness"]}

{"headword":"cherry","explanation":"名詞「櫻桃」；形容詞「櫻桃紅的」。在 GSAT 中，常用於描述顏色或水果。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baker decorated the top of the chocolate cake with a single fresh <target>cherry</target> to make it look more professional.","translation":"烘焙師在巧克力蛋糕頂端放了一顆新鮮的櫻桃，使其看起來更專業。","explanation":"名詞「櫻桃」。"},{"sentence":"She chose a <target>cherry</target>-red dress for the graduation party, which matched perfectly with her high heels and jewelry.","translation":"她選擇了一件櫻桃紅色的禮服參加畢業派對，與她的高跟鞋和珠寶完美搭配。","explanation":"形容詞「櫻桃紅的」。常用於描述顏色。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chest","explanation":"名詞「胸膛」或「大木箱」。注意區分這兩種完全不同的意義，通常根據上下文判斷。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete took a deep breath, feeling his <target>chest</target> expand as he prepared himself for the final sprint to the finish line.","translation":"運動員深吸一口氣，感覺到胸膛擴張，準備進行最後的衝刺以到達終點線。","explanation":"名詞「胸膛」。"},{"sentence":"The old pirate's <target>chest</target> was filled with gold coins and precious jewelry, which had been hidden in the cave for centuries.","translation":"舊海盜的木箱裡裝滿了金幣和珍貴的珠寶，這些東西在洞穴中被隱藏了數個世紀。","explanation":"名詞「大木箱」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chill","explanation":"名詞「寒意」；動詞「使冷卻」或「放鬆」；形容詞「寒冷的」或「放鬆的」。注意動詞用法 chill out (放鬆) 是非常口語的表達方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"There was a slight <target>chill</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the autumn air, so the students decided to wear light jackets to school.","translation":"秋天的空氣中有一絲寒意，所以學生們決定穿輕便夾克去學校。","explanation":"名詞「寒意」。常用搭配：a chill in the air。"},{"sentence":"The chef told the guests to <target>chill</target> the white wine <pattern>in</pattern> the refrigerator for two hours before serving it.","translation":"廚師告訴客人將白葡萄酒在冰箱中冷藏兩小時後再供應。","explanation":"動詞「使冷卻」。常用搭配：chill sth in the refrigerator。"},{"sentence":"After a stressful week of final exams, the students decided to <target>chill</target> <pattern>out</pattern> at the beach and forget about their studies.","translation":"在壓力巨大的期末考週後，學生們決定在海邊放鬆，忘記學業。","explanation":"動詞片語 chill out 表「放鬆」。"},{"sentence":"He is a very <target>chill</target> person who rarely gets angry or stressed, making him a popular friend among his classmates.","translation":"他是一個非常放鬆的人，很少生氣或感到壓力，這使他成為同學之間很受歡迎的朋友。","explanation":"形容詞「放鬆的、隨和的」。"}],"related_forms":["chilled","chilling"]}

{"headword":"chilly","explanation":"形容詞「寒冷的，發抖的」。通常指讓人感到不舒服的冷，程度比 cold 輕微，但強調主觀的冷感。常用於描述天氣或人的態度（冷淡）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The autumn wind became <target>chilly</target> in the evening, making the students wear thick jackets during their walk home from school.","translation":"秋天的風在傍晚變得寒冷，讓學生們在放學回家的路上穿上厚夾克。","explanation":"形容詞「寒冷的」。描述天氣讓人感到冷。"},{"sentence":"Although the sun was shining, the room felt <target>chilly</target> because the old air conditioner was working too hard.","translation":"儘管陽光燦爛，但房間裡感覺很冷，因為舊的冷氣機運作太強了。","explanation":"形容詞「寒冷的」。描述室內溫度低。"},{"sentence":"When she asked for help, she received a <target>chilly</target> <pattern>reception</pattern> from her teammates, who were too busy to listen to her.","translation":"當她請求幫助時，她得到了隊友們冷淡的接待，因為他們太忙而沒時間聽她說話。","explanation":"形容詞「冷淡的」。常用搭配 chilly reception (冷淡的接待/反應)。"}],"related_forms":["chillily","chilliness"]}
comment: STYLE_MISMATCH: In sentence 2, 'air conditioner was working too hard' is slightly awkward phrasing for a GSAT context. Suggest changing to 'running at full power'.

response: {"headword":"chimney","explanation":"名詞「煙囪」。用於排出房屋內壁爐或爐灶的煙霧。","entries":[{"sentence":"On a cold winter morning, thick gray smoke drifted slowly from the <target>chimney</target> of the cozy little cottage in the mountains.","translation":"在寒冷的冬日早晨，濃濃的灰色煙霧從山中舒適的小屋煙囪緩緩飄出。","explanation":"名詞「煙囪」。"},{"sentence":"The old man spent the entire afternoon cleaning the <target>chimney</target> to ensure the fireplace would work safely during the winter.","translation":"老人花了一整個下午清理煙囪，以確保壁爐在冬天能安全運作。","explanation":"名詞「煙囪」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chin","explanation":"名詞「下巴」。指臉部嘴唇下方的部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little boy rubbed his <target>chin</target> thoughtfully while trying to solve the difficult math problem on the chalkboard.","translation":"小男孩在試圖解決黑板上的數學難題時，若有所思地揉了揉下巴。","explanation":"名詞「下巴」。"},{"sentence":"He accidentally hit his <target>chin</target> on the edge of the table, causing a small bruise that lasted for a week.","translation":"他不小心地用下巴撞到了桌邊，導致留下了一個持續一週的小瘀青。","explanation":"名詞「下巴」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chip","explanation":"名詞「碎片；晶片；薯片」；動詞「削掉；崩掉」。名詞用法中，chip 可指電子產品的微小晶片（microchip）或食物（potato chips）。動詞指將物體表面削去一小塊。","entries":[{"sentence":"The technician replaced the damaged <target>chip</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the computer's motherboard to restore the system's processing speed.","translation":"技術員更換了電腦主機板上的損壞晶片，以恢復系統的處理速度。","explanation":"名詞「晶片」。常用搭配 chip in (在...之中)。"},{"sentence":"While snacking on a bag of potato <target>chips</target>, the student read his notes to prepare for the final examination.","translation":"這個學生在吃一袋洋芋片時，閱讀筆記準備期末考試。","explanation":"名詞「薯片」。"},{"sentence":"The antique vase had a tiny <target>chip</target> <pattern>on</pattern> its rim, which lowered its value for the art collector.","translation":"這個古董花瓶的邊緣有一個小缺口，這降低了它對藝術收藏家的價值。","explanation":"名詞「碎片/缺口」。常用搭配 chip on (在...之上)。"},{"sentence":"Be careful not to <target>chip</target> the paint on the wooden table when you move the heavy boxes across the room.","translation":"搬動重箱子經過房間時，小心不要把木桌上的油漆削掉。","explanation":"動詞「削掉/崩掉」。"}],"related_forms":["chipped"]}

{"headword":"chop","explanation":"動詞「砍；切」；名詞「切塊」。常用於烹飪（切碎）或伐木（砍伐）。常用片語 chop up (切碎)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef showed the students how to <target>chop</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the onions and carrots into small pieces for the soup.","translation":"廚師向學生展示如何將洋蔥和紅蘿蔔切成小塊來煮湯。","explanation":"動詞片語 chop up 表「切碎」。"},{"sentence":"The lumberjack used a sharp axe to <target>chop</target> the heavy logs <pattern>into</pattern> smaller pieces for the campfire.","translation":"伐木工使用一把鋒利的斧頭將沉重的原木砍成較小的碎片，以便在營火旁使用。","explanation":"動詞「砍」。常用搭配 chop ... into (將...砍成)。"},{"sentence":"For the dinner party, my mother prepared grilled lamb <target>chops</target>, which were seasoned with salt and black pepper.","translation":"為了晚餐派對，我母親準備了烤羊排，用鹽和黑胡椒調味。","explanation":"名詞「切塊/排」。指肉類切塊，如 lamb chops。"}],"related_forms":["chopped","chopping"]}

{"headword":"cigarette","explanation":"名詞「香菸」。指用薄紙包著煙草的捲菸。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many health organizations warn that smoking a <target>cigarette</target> can seriously damage the lungs and increase the risk of cancer.","translation":"許多健康組織警告說，抽一支菸會嚴重損害肺部並增加癌症風險。","explanation":"名詞「香菸」。"},{"sentence":"The school has a strict policy that prohibits students from smoking <target>cigarettes</target> <pattern>on</pattern> campus to maintain a healthy environment.","translation":"學校有一項嚴格的政策，禁止學生在校園內抽菸，以維持健康的環境。","explanation":"名詞「香菸」。常用搭配 smoke cigarettes on campus。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cinema","explanation":"名詞「電影院」。指放映電影的場所。在英式英語中較常用，美式英語常用 movie theater。","entries":[{"sentence":"After finishing their homework, the group of friends decided to go to the <target>cinema</target> to watch the latest superhero movie.","translation":"完成作業後，這群朋友決定去電影院看最新的超級英雄電影。","explanation":"名詞「電影院」。"},{"sentence":"The local <target>cinema</target> was renovated last year, providing more comfortable seats and a better sound system for the audience.","translation":"當地的電影院去年翻新了，為觀眾提供了更舒適的座席和更好的音響系統。","explanation":"名詞「電影院」。"}],"related_forms":["cinematic"]}

{"headword":"circus","explanation":"名詞「馬戲團」。指以表演表演者、動物表演或雜技表演為主的娛樂表演。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children were amazed by the acrobats at the <target>circus</target>, who could perform incredible flips and jumps in the air.","translation":"孩子們被馬戲團的雜技演員驚呆了，他們能在空中表演令人難以置信的翻轉和跳躍。","explanation":"名詞「馬戲團」。"},{"sentence":"Many people now criticize the <target>circus</target> for using animals in their shows, arguing that it is cruel to the creatures.","translation":"許多人現在批評馬戲團在表演中使用動物，認為這對動物來說很殘忍。","explanation":"名詞「馬戲團」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "citizen", "explanation": "名詞「公民」。指在法律上被承認的某個國家或城市的合法成員。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every <target>citizen</target> has the right to vote in the national election to choose the leaders who will govern the country.", "translation": "每位公民都有權在全國選舉中投票，選擇將治理國家的領導者。", "explanation": "名詞「公民」。"}, {"sentence": "The government encourages every responsible <target>citizen</target> to <pattern>pay</pattern> <target>taxes</target> <pattern>on</pattern> time to support public services and infrastructure.", "translation": "政府鼓勵每位負責的公民準時納稅，以支持公共服務和基礎設施。", "explanation": "名詞「公民」。"}], "related_forms": ["citizenship"]}

{"headword":"civil","explanation":"形容詞「公民的；民事的；有禮貌的」。指與公民權利或法律相關的事項，或指行為舉止得體。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students learned about <target>civil</target> <pattern>rights</pattern> in their history class, discussing how people fought for equality and justice.","translation":"學生們在歷史課上學習了公民權利，討論人們如何為平等和公正而戰鬥。","explanation":"形容詞「公民的」。常用搭配 civil rights (公民權利)。"},{"sentence":"Although the two colleagues disagreed on the project, they remained <target>civil</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other to maintain a professional atmosphere.","translation":"儘管這兩個同事在計畫上持有不同意見，但他們對彼此仍保持禮貌，以維持專業的 atmosphere。","explanation":"形容詞「有禮貌的」。常用搭配 remain civil with (對...保持禮貌)。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer explained that the case was a <target>civil</target> <pattern>dispute</pattern> rather than a criminal one, meaning no one would go to prison.","translation":"律師解釋說這個案子是民事糾紛而非刑事案件，意味著沒有人會進監獄。","explanation":"形容詞「民事的」。常用搭配 civil dispute (民事糾紛)。"}],"related_forms":["civility","civilize","civilization"]}

{"headword":"clay","explanation":"名詞「黏土」。常用於藝術創作、陶藝或描述土壤性質。注意與泥土 (dirt/mud) 的區別：clay 指的是一種細膩且具有可塑性的特定土類。","entries":[{"sentence":"The art teacher showed the students how to <pattern>shape</pattern> the wet <target>clay</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a small bowl during the pottery class.","translation":"在陶藝課上，美術老師向學生展示如何將濕黏土塑造成長個小碗。","explanation":"名詞「黏土」。常用搭配：shape clay into sth (將黏土塑造為...)。"},{"sentence":"Many ancient civilizations used <target>clay</target> tablets to record their laws and history, which have helped historians understand the past.","translation":"許多古代文明使用黏土板來記錄法律和歷史，這幫助了歷史學家了解過去。","explanation":"名詞「黏土」。指用於記錄的黏土材質。"}],"related_forms":["clays"]}

{"headword":"cleaner","explanation":"名詞「清潔員」或「清潔劑」。指負責清潔的人員或用於清潔的化學產品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school hired a professional <target>cleaner</target> to ensure that all classrooms and hallways were spotless before the new semester began.","translation":"學校聘請了專業的清潔員，以確保在新學期開始前，所有教室和走廊都一塵不染。","explanation":"名詞「清潔員」。指負責清潔的人員。"},{"sentence":"She used a powerful glass <target>cleaner</target> to remove the stubborn stains from the window, making the room look much brighter.","translation":"她使用強效玻璃清潔劑來去除窗戶上的頑固污漬，使房間看起來明亮許多。","explanation":"名詞「清潔劑」。指用於清潔的化學產品。"}],"related_forms":["cleaners"]}

{"headword":"client","explanation":"名詞「客戶」。通常指接受專業服務（如律師、會計師、設計師或心理諮商師）的人。注意與 customer (顧客) 的區別：customer 通常指購買商品的人，而 client 指的是接受專業服務的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer spent several hours meeting <pattern>with</pattern> her <target>client</target> to discuss the details of the case before going to court.","translation":"律師在出庭前花了好幾個小時與她的客戶會面，討論案件的細節。","explanation":"名詞「客戶」。常用搭配：meet with a client (與客戶會面)。"},{"sentence":"The advertising agency is working hard to <pattern>attract</pattern> new <target>clients</target> by creating a more modern and appealing website for their company.","translation":"廣告公司正努力透過為公司建立一個更現代且吸引人的網站來吸引新客戶。","explanation":"名詞「客戶」。常用搭配：attract clients (吸引客戶)。"}],"related_forms":["clients"]}

{"headword":"clinic","explanation":"名詞「診所」。通常指規模較小、提供特定醫療服務的醫療機構。注意與 hospital (醫院) 的區別：clinic 通常較小且不提供長期住院服務。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the main hospital was too crowded, he decided to visit a small local <target>clinic</target> for a quick check-up on his cold.","translation":"由於大醫院太擁擠，他決定去當地的一家小診所做個快速的感冒檢查。","explanation":"名詞「診所」。"},{"sentence":"The university's health <target>clinic</target> provides free counseling services to help students manage stress and anxiety during the final exam period.","translation":"大學的健康診所提供免費的諮詢服務，幫助學生在期末考期間管理壓力與焦慮。","explanation":"名詞「診所」。常用搭配：health clinic (健康診所)。"}],"related_forms":["clinics"]}

{"headword":"clip","explanation":"名詞可指「夾子」或「短片」；動詞則可指「夾住」或「修剪」。在 GSAT 中，clip 作為動詞時的「修剪」用法及名詞的「短片」用法較為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The editor selected a short <target>clip</target> from the interview to show the most important points of the discussion in the news report.","translation":"編輯從訪談中選出一段短片，以便在新聞報導中展示討論最重要的一點。","explanation":"名詞「短片」。指一段截取出的影像或音訊。"},{"sentence":"She used a small metal <target>clip</target> to keep the papers together so they would not be scattered by the wind.","translation":"她使用一個小型金屬夾子將紙張固定在一起，以免被風吹散。","explanation":"名詞「夾子」。"},{"sentence":"The gardener decided to <target>clip</target> the hedges around the house to keep the garden looking neat and tidy during the summer.","translation":"花匠決定修剪房屋周圍的樹籬，以使花園在夏天看起來整潔。","explanation":"動詞「修剪」。常用於修剪植物或指甲。"},{"sentence":"The librarian asked the students to <target>clip</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the relevant articles from the newspaper and paste them into their scrapbooks.","translation":"圖書管理員要求學生從報紙中剪下相關文章並將其貼在剪貼簿中。","explanation":"動詞片語 clip out 表「剪下」。"}],"related_forms":["clipped","clipping"]}
