{"headword":"closet","explanation":"名詞「衣櫥」。指一個小型封閉的空間用於存放衣物或雜物。注意與 wardrobe (衣櫃) 的區別：closet 通常指建築物內建的儲物間或小房間。","entries":[{"sentence":"He spent an hour organizing his <target>closet</target>, throwing away old clothes that he no longer wore to make more space.","translation":"他花了一個小時整理他的衣櫥，扔掉不再穿的舊衣服以騰出更多空間。","explanation":"名詞「衣櫥」。"},{"sentence":"She kept her favorite novels and school supplies in a small <target>closet</target> under the stairs, keeping the room tidy.","translation":"她將她最喜歡的小說和學校用品放在樓梯下的一個小衣櫥中，使房間保持整潔。","explanation":"名詞「衣櫥/儲物間」。"}],"related_forms":["closets"]}

{"headword": "clothe", "explanation": "動詞「給...穿衣」。較少見於口語，常用於描述正式或歷史背景下的著裝。注意與 clothes (名詞，衣服) 的區別：clothe 是動詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In the past, poor families struggled to <target>clothe</target> their children in warm garments during the harsh winters of the northern region.", "translation": "過去，貧困家庭在北部地區寒冷的冬天裡，很難為孩子們提供溫暖的衣服。", "explanation": "動詞「給...穿衣」。常用搭配：clothe someone in sth (讓某人穿上某物)。"}, {"sentence": "The charity organization works tirelessly to <target>clothe</target> the homeless population, ensuring they have basic necessities for survival in the city.", "translation": "慈善組織不懈地工作以提供無家可歸者衣服，確保他們在城市中擁有生存的基本必需品。", "explanation": "動詞「提供衣服」。"}], "related_forms": ["clothed", "clothing"]}

{"headword":"clown","explanation":"名詞「小丑」。動詞則可指「像小丑一樣開玩笑或表現得愚蠢」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children laughed loudly when the <target>clown</target> performed a funny trick with balloons at the birthday party.","translation":"在生日派對上，小丑用氣球表演有趣的小技巧時，孩子們大聲地笑了。","explanation":"名詞「小丑」。"},{"sentence":"Stop <target>clowning</target> <pattern>around</pattern> and focus on your homework, or you will not finish it before dinner time.","translation":"別再胡鬧了，專注於你的作業，否則你在晚餐時間前無法完成。","explanation":"動詞片語 clown around 表「胡鬧、開玩笑」。"}],"related_forms":["clowns","clowning"]}

{"headword":"clue","explanation":"名詞「線索」。指用於解決問題或揭開謎團的資訊。常用片語 a clue to (某事的線索) 或 have no clue (完全不知道)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective looked for a <target>clue</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the murderer's identity, searching every corner of the crime scene carefully.","translation":"偵探尋找著兇手身分的線索，仔細地搜索每個犯罪現場的角落。","explanation":"名詞「線索」。常用搭配：a clue to sth (某事的線索)。"},{"sentence":"I have no <target>clue</target> how to solve this difficult math problem, so I will ask my teacher for help tomorrow.","translation":"我完全不知道如何解決這個困難的數學問題，因此我會明天請教老師。","explanation":"名詞「線索」。片語 have no clue 意為「完全不知道」。"}],"related_forms":["clues"]}

{"headword":"coach","explanation":"名詞用法包括「教練」和「長途巴士」。動詞用法則為「指導、訓練」。注意在 GSAT 中，coach 作為教練和指導的用法最為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The basketball <target>coach</target> gave the players a strict training schedule to help them prepare for the final game of the season.","translation":"籃球教練給了球員一個嚴格的訓練計劃，以幫助他們為本賽季的最後一場比賽做準備。","explanation":"名詞「教練」。"},{"sentence":"Many students hire a private <target>coach</target> to <pattern>improve</pattern> their speaking skills before taking the international English test.","translation":"許多學生在參加國際英語測試前聘請私人指導老師來提高他們的口說能力。","explanation":"名詞「指導者/教練」。"},{"sentence":"The group of tourists decided to travel by <target>coach</target> to visit several different cities in Europe over two weeks.","translation":"遊客團決定搭乘長途巴士旅行，在兩週內參觀歐洲的幾個不同城市。","explanation":"名詞「長途巴士」。"},{"sentence":"The experienced teacher <target>coached</target> the students <pattern>on</pattern> how to write a professional essay, providing detailed feedback on their drafts.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的老師指導學生如何寫一篇專業的論文，並對他們的草稿提供詳細的回饋。","explanation":"動詞「指導」。常用搭配：coach someone on sth (指導某人關於某事)。"}],"related_forms":["coaches","coaching"]}

{"headword": "cock", "explanation": "名詞，指「公雞」。在某些上下文中也可用於指「開關」或「扳機」，但在 GSAT 範圍內，主要指雄性雞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer woke up early every morning to the sound of a <target>cock</target> crowing loudly in the nearby barn.", "translation": "農夫每天早晨在附近穀倉裡公雞大聲啼叫的聲音中醒來。", "explanation": "名詞「公雞」。"}, {"sentence": "In many folk tales, the <target>cock</target> is often portrayed as a symbol of vigilance and the arrival of a new day.", "translation": "在許多民間故事中，公雞常被描繪成警覺和新一天到來的象徵。", "explanation": "名詞「公雞」。"}], "related_forms": ["cocks"]}

{"headword":"cocktail","explanation":"名詞「雞尾酒」。指由酒精飲料、果汁或其他配料混合而成的飲料。亦可用於比喻，指「混合物」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The guest at the party enjoyed a refreshing <target>cocktail</target> made with pineapple juice and a small amount of vodka.","translation":"派對上的客人享用了一杯由鳳梨汁和少量伏特加調製而成的清爽雞尾酒。","explanation":"名詞「雞尾酒」。"},{"sentence":"The city's atmosphere was a colorful <target>cocktail</target> <pattern>of</pattern> different cultures, languages, and architectural styles from around the world.","translation":"這座城市的氛圍是來自世界各地不同文化、語言和建築風格的繽紛混合體。","explanation":"名詞「混合物」。比喻用法，常用搭配：a cocktail of sth (某種混合物)。"}],"related_forms":["cocktails"]}

{"headword":"coconut","explanation":"名詞「椰子」。指椰子樹所結的果實。常用於描述熱帶地區的植物或食物。","entries":[{"sentence":"While walking along the beach, the tourists found a <target>coconut</target> that had fallen from a tall palm tree.","translation":"遊客在海邊散步時，發現了一顆從高椰子樹上掉下來的椰子。","explanation":"名詞「椰子」。"},{"sentence":"Many people enjoy drinking fresh <target>coconut</target> <pattern>water</pattern> when they visit tropical islands because it is hydrating and sweet.","translation":"許多人在訪問熱帶島嶼時喜歡喝新鮮的椰子水，因為它能補充水分且味道甜美。","explanation":"名詞「椰子」。常用搭配：coconut water (椰子水)。"}],"related_forms":["coconuts"]}

{"headword":"collar","explanation":"名詞，指「衣領」或「項圈」。動詞則可指「逮捕」。在 GSAT 範圍內，主要關注名詞用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher noticed that the student's shirt <target>collar</target> was folded incorrectly, so she gently reminded him to fix it.","translation":"老師注意到學生的襯衫領子折疊不正確，所以她溫柔地提醒他將其修正。","explanation":"名詞「衣領」。"},{"sentence":"The owner put a leather <target>collar</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his dog to attach a name tag and a phone number for safety.","translation":"主人在狗的脖子上戴了一個皮革項圈，以附上姓名牌和電話號碼以策安全。","explanation":"名詞「項圈」。常用搭配：collar on sth (在...上戴項圈)。"}],"related_forms":["collared"]}

{"headword":"collection","explanation":"名詞「收藏品、收集」。指將相同類型的物品聚集在一起的行為或結果。常用於藝術、郵票、或資料收集。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local museum houses an impressive <target>collection</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ancient coins that date back to the Roman Empire.","translation":"當地博物館收藏了令人印象深刻的古羅馬帝國時期的古幣收藏。","explanation":"名詞「收藏品」。常用搭配：collection of sth (某物的收藏)。"},{"sentence":"The biology student spent the entire summer gathering a <target>collection</target> <pattern>of</pattern> rare insects to study their physical characteristics.","translation":"生物學學生整個夏天都在收集稀有昆蟲，以研究其身體特徵。","explanation":"名詞「收集」。常用搭配：collection of sth (某物的收集)。"},{"sentence":"The library's vast <target>collection</target> <pattern>of</pattern> digital books allows students to access a wide variety of information from home.","translation":"圖書館龐大的電子書藏書量讓學生能在家中獲取多種資訊。","explanation":"名詞「藏書、收藏」。常用搭配：collection of sth。"}],"related_forms":["collect","collective","collector"]}

{"headword":"colony","explanation":"名詞「殖民地、群落」。指由一個國家在海外建立的定居點，或指動物（如螞蟻、蜜蜂）的聚集地。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the past, many European nations established <target>colonies</target> in North America to exploit natural resources and expand their power.","translation":"過去，許多歐洲國家在北美建立了殖民地，以開發自然資源並擴張權力。","explanation":"名詞「殖民地」。"},{"sentence":"The researchers observed a large <target>colony</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ants working together to build a complex underground nest.","translation":"研究人員觀察到一群巨大的螞蟻群落共同合作建立一個複雜的地下巢穴。","explanation":"名詞「群落」。常用搭配：colony of ants/bees (螞蟻/蜜蜂群落)。"}],"related_forms":["colonize","colonial","colonist"]}

{"headword":"colorful","explanation":"形容詞「色彩鮮豔的、豐富多彩的」。可用於描述視覺上的顏色，也可比喻指生活或故事內容豐富。","entries":[{"sentence":"The garden was filled with <target>colorful</target> <pattern>flowers</pattern> that attracted many butterflies and bees during the spring season.","translation":"花園裡開滿了色彩鮮豔的花朵，在春季吸引了許多蝴蝶和蜜蜂。","explanation":"形容詞「色彩鮮豔的」。常用搭配：colorful flowers (色彩鮮豔的花朵)。"},{"sentence":"The elderly man shared <target>colorful</target> <pattern>stories</pattern> about his adventures traveling across Asia many decades ago.","translation":"這位年長的男子分享了關於他數十年前在亞洲旅行探險的豐富多彩的故事。","explanation":"形容詞「豐富多彩的」。比喻用法，常用搭配：colorful stories (精彩的故事)。"}],"related_forms":["colorfully","colorfulness"]}

{"headword":"column","explanation":"名詞，指「圓柱、欄位、專欄」。在 GSAT 範圍內，常用於建築、表格數據或報紙雜誌的專欄。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient Greek temple was supported by several massive marble <target>columns</target> that were beautifully carved with patterns.","translation":"這座古希臘神廟由幾根巨大的大理石圓柱支撐，上面刻有美麗的圖案。","explanation":"名詞「圓柱」。"},{"sentence":"Please enter your personal information in the second <target>column</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the registration form to ensure the data is correct.","translation":"請在註冊表單的第二欄填寫您的個人資訊，以確保數據正確。","explanation":"名詞「欄位」。常用搭配：column of the form (表單的欄位)。"},{"sentence":"The famous journalist writes a weekly <target>column</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a national newspaper, discussing current social issues and politics.","translation":"這位著名的記者為一家國家報紙撰寫週刊專欄，討論目前的社會議題和政治。","explanation":"名詞「專欄」。常用搭配：column for a newspaper (報紙專欄)。"}],"related_forms":["columnist"]}

{"headword":"comfort","explanation":"名詞「舒適、安慰」；動詞「安慰」。注意區分 comfort (舒適/安慰) 與 comfortable (舒適的) 之區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soft pillows and warm blankets provided a great sense of <target>comfort</target> to the tired hikers after their long journey.","translation":"柔軟的枕頭和溫暖的毯子為疲憊的登山客在長途旅行後提供了極大的舒適感。","explanation":"名詞「舒適」。"},{"sentence":"After the student failed the important exam, his teacher <target>comforted</target> him <pattern>with</pattern> encouraging words and advised him to keep trying.","translation":"在學生未能通過重要考試後，他的老師用鼓勵的話語安慰他，並建議他繼續努力。","explanation":"動詞「安慰」。常用搭配：comfort someone with sth。"},{"sentence":"Knowing that her family was safe after the earthquake gave her a feeling of immense <target>comfort</target>.","translation":"知道地震後她的家人平安無事讓她感到極大的安慰。","explanation":"名詞「安慰」。"}],"related_forms":["comfortable","comfortably","comforting"]}

{"headword":"comma","explanation":"名詞「逗號」。用於句子中暫停或分隔項目的標點符號。","entries":[{"sentence":"The English teacher reminded the students to place a <target>comma</target> <pattern>after</pattern> the introductory phrase to avoid confusion in the sentence.","translation":"英文老師提醒學生在引導句之後加上逗號，以避免句子中出現混淆。","explanation":"名詞「逗號」。常用搭配：comma after sth (在...之後加逗號)。"},{"sentence":"When listing several items, such as apples, oranges, and grapes, a <target>comma</target> is used to separate each item clearly.","translation":"在列舉多個項目，如蘋果、橘子和葡萄時，使用逗號來將每個項目清楚地分開。","explanation":"名詞「逗號」。"}],"related_forms":["commas"]}

{"headword":"committee","explanation":"名詞「委員會」。指一群被選出或指派來處理特定任務或做出決定的組織。常用於校園、公司或政府語境。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school <target>committee</target> met last Friday to discuss the budget for the upcoming graduation ceremony and select a theme for the party.","translation":"學校委員會上週五開會討論即將到來的畢業典禮預算，並為派對選擇一個主題。","explanation":"名詞「委員會」。指負責管理或決策的團體。"},{"sentence":"After hours of debate, the organizing <target>committee</target> finally reached a consensus on the date and location for the international student exchange program.","translation":"經過數小時的辯論，籌備委員會終於就國際學生交流計畫的日期和地點達成了一致。","explanation":"名詞「委員會」。常用搭配 organizing committee (籌備委員會)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"communicate","explanation":"動詞「溝通、交流」。注意其搭配介系詞 with (與某人) 或 to (向某人傳達)。常用片語 communicate with someone (與某人溝通)。","entries":[{"sentence":"International students often find it challenging to <target>communicate</target> <pattern>with</pattern> local residents at first, but their language skills improve with practice.","translation":"國際學生起初常發現與當地居民溝通具有挑戰性，但他們的語言能力會隨著練習而提高。","explanation":"動詞「溝通」。搭配介系詞 with 表示與某人交流。"},{"sentence":"The captain used a radio to <target>communicate</target> his instructions <pattern>to</pattern> the crew during the storm, ensuring everyone's safety on the ship.","translation":"船長在風暴期間使用無線電將指令傳達給船員，以確保船上每個人的安全。","explanation":"動詞「傳達」。搭配介系詞 to 表示將訊息傳遞給某人。"}],"related_forms":["communication","communicative"]}

{"headword":"comparison","explanation":"名詞「比較」。常用搭配：in comparison with (與...相比), by comparison (相比之下)。注意與 compare (動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to write a short essay <pattern>in</pattern> <target>comparison</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the two different styles of modern art and traditional painting.","translation":"老師要求學生寫一篇短文，將兩種不同的現代藝術風格與傳統繪畫進行比較。","explanation":"名詞「比較」。片語 in comparison with... 意為「與...相比」。"},{"sentence":"The old city center was noisy and crowded; <pattern>by</pattern> <target>comparison</target>, the new residential area was peaceful and quiet.","translation":"舊市中心吵雜且擁擠；相比之下，新的住宅區則寧靜且安詳。","explanation":"名詞「比較」。片語 by comparison 意為「相比之下」。"}],"related_forms":["comparable","comparative"]}

{"headword":"compete","explanation":"動詞「競爭、比賽」。常用搭配：compete with/against (與...競爭), compete for (為了...而競爭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many athletes from different countries come to the Olympics to <target>compete</target> <pattern>with</pattern> one another for the gold medal.","translation":"許多來自不同國家的運動員來到奧運會，為了金牌而彼此競爭。","explanation":"動詞「競爭」。搭配 with 表示與對手競爭。"},{"sentence":"Small local bookstores often struggle to <target>compete</target> <pattern>against</pattern> large online retailers who offer lower prices and faster delivery.","translation":"小型當地書店經常掙扎於與提供較低價格和更快配送的大型線上零售商競爭。","explanation":"動詞「競爭」。搭配 against 強調對抗性質。"},{"sentence":"Students in the class <target>competed</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the top spot in the final exam, studying late into the night every day.","translation":"班上的學生為了期末考的最高分而競爭，每天熬夜到深夜學習。","explanation":"動詞「競爭」。搭配 for 表示競爭的目標。"}],"related_forms":["competition","competitive","competitor"]}

{"headword":"complain","explanation":"動詞「抱怨」。常用搭配：complain about (對...抱怨), complain to (向...抱怨)。注意與 complaint (名詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students began to <target>complain</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the amount of homework given by the history teacher, claiming it was too much to finish.","translation":"學生們開始抱怨歷史老師布置的作業量，聲稱太多而無法完成。","explanation":"動詞「抱怨」。搭配 about 表示抱怨的對象或內容。"},{"sentence":"If you are not satisfied with the hotel service, you should <target>complain</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the manager immediately to resolve the issue.","translation":"如果你對飯店服務不滿意，你應該立即向經理抱怨以解決問題。","explanation":"動詞「抱怨」。搭配 to 表示抱怨的接收者。"}],"related_forms":["complaining"]}

{"headword":"complaint","explanation":"名詞「抱怨、投訴」。常用搭配：make a complaint (提出投訴)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After receiving a wrong order at the restaurant, the customer decided to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>complaint</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the staff about the service.","translation":"在餐廳收到錯誤的訂單後，顧客決定向員工提出投訴，抱怨其服務。","explanation":"名詞「投訴」。片語 make a complaint 表示「提出投訴」。"},{"sentence":"The company received numerous <target>complaints</target> <pattern>from</pattern> customers regarding the poor quality of the new smartphone model.","translation":"該公司收到許多顧客關於新款手機型號品質低劣的投訴。","explanation":"名詞「投訴」。複數形式 complaints。"}],"related_forms":["complain"]}

{"headword":"concert","explanation":"名詞「音樂會、演唱會」。常用於描述表演藝術或娛樂活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of fans gathered outside the stadium to wait for the <target>concert</target> to start, hoping to see their favorite singer perform.","translation":"數千名粉絲聚集在體育場外等待演唱會開始，希望能看到他們最喜歡的歌手表演。","explanation":"名詞「演唱會」。"},{"sentence":"The university's music department organized a classical <target>concert</target> for the public, featuring a talented young pianist from France.","translation":"大學音樂系為大眾組織了一場古典音樂會，由一名來自法國的天才年輕鋼琴家演出。","explanation":"名詞「音樂會」。"}],"related_forms":["concerts"]}

{"headword":"conclusion","explanation":"名詞「結論、結尾」。常用搭配：come to a conclusion (得出結論), draw a conclusion (得出結論)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After analyzing the data from the experiment, the scientists finally <pattern>came</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> the <target>conclusion</target> that the new drug was effective.","translation":"在分析實驗數據後，科學家終於得出結論，認為這款新藥是有效的。","explanation":"名詞「結論」。片語 come to a conclusion 意為「得出結論」。"},{"sentence":"The detective <pattern>drew</pattern> a <target>conclusion</target> based on the evidence found at the crime scene, identifying the suspect's identity.","translation":"偵探根據在犯罪現場發現的證據得出了一個結論，辨識出嫌疑犯的身份。","explanation":"名詞「結論」。片語 draw a conclusion 意為「得出結論」。"},{"sentence":"The writer spent the last chapter of the book to bring the story to a satisfying <target>conclusion</target>, tying up all the loose ends.","translation":"作者在書的最後一個章節將故事推向一個令人滿足的結尾，將所有懸而未之的處處理好。","explanation":"名詞「結尾」。指故事或事件的終點。"}],"related_forms":["conclude","conclusive"]}

{"headword":"cone","explanation":"名詞「圓錐體、圓錐形物」。常用於描述形狀（如冰淇淋圓錐筒）或生物學（如圓錐細胞）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little girl was very happy when her father bought her a large <target>cone</target> of vanilla ice cream at the beach.","translation":"小女孩在父親在海邊買給她一個大圓錐筒香草冰淇淋時非常開心。","explanation":"名詞「圓錐筒」。指冰淇淋的圓錐形容器。"},{"sentence":"Traffic officers placed orange <target>cones</target> along the road to warn drivers that the lane was closed for repairs.","translation":"交通警察沿路放置了橘色圓錐筒，以警告駕駛者該車道因維修而封閉。","explanation":"名詞「圓錐筒」。指道路上的交通警示圓錐筒。"}],"related_forms":["cones"]}

{"headword": "confirm", "explanation": "動詞「確認、證實」。常用於確認預約、航班或證實某事屬實。注意其搭配：confirm that... (確認...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hotel manager called the guest to <target>confirm</target> the reservation for next week, ensuring that the room was ready.", "translation": "飯店經理致電顧客以確認下週的預約，確保房間已準備好。", "explanation": "動詞「確認」。指確認預約或安排。"}, {"sentence": "The police used security camera footage to <target>confirm</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the suspect had entered the building at midnight.", "translation": "警察使用監視器畫面來證實嫌疑犯在半夜進入了建築物。", "explanation": "動詞「證實」。搭配 that 子句表示證實某事屬實。"}], "related_forms": ["confirmation", "confirmed"]}

{"headword":"confuse","explanation":"動詞，意為「使困惑」或「混淆」。常用搭配 confuse A with B (將 A 與 B 混淆)。注意與 confusion (名詞) 及 confused (形容詞，指人感到困惑) 與 confusing (形容詞，指事物令人困惑) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students <target>confuse</target> the two grammar rules <pattern>with</pattern> each other, leading to frequent mistakes in their writing assignments.","translation":"許多學生將這兩條文法規則混淆，導致在寫作作業中經常出錯。","explanation":"動詞「混淆」。常用搭配 confuse A with B。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's complex explanation of the quantum physics theory <target>confused</target> the students, who then asked for a simpler example.","translation":"老師對量子物理理論的複雜解釋讓學生們感到困惑，隨後他們要求一個更簡單的例子。","explanation":"動詞「使困惑」。指使人感到不明白。"},{"sentence":"Please speak more clearly, because your accent might <target>confuse</target> the listeners who are not familiar with your native language.","translation":"請說得更清楚一些，因為你的口音可能會讓那些不熟悉你母語的聽眾感到困惑。","explanation":"動詞「使困惑」。"}],"related_forms":["confusion","confused","confusing"]}

{"headword":"connect","explanation":"動詞，意為「連接」或「聯繫」。常用搭配 connect A to/with B (將 A 與 B 連接)。在科技語境中，常用於描述設備連接網路或電源。","entries":[{"sentence":"To start the presentation, you need to <target>connect</target> your laptop <pattern>to</pattern> the projector using an HDMI cable.","translation":"為了開始簡報，你需要使用 HDMI 線將筆記型電腦連接到投影機。","explanation":"動詞「連接」。常用搭配 connect A to B。"},{"sentence":"The detective tried to <target>connect</target> the suspect <pattern>with</pattern> the crime by looking for fingerprints at the scene.","translation":"偵探試圖透過尋找現場的指紋，將嫌疑犯與這起犯罪聯繫起來。","explanation":"動詞「聯繫」。常用搭配 connect A with B。"},{"sentence":"The new bridge was built to <target>connect</target> the two towns, making it much easier for people to commute to work every day.","translation":"這座新橋被建造起來以連接這兩個城鎮，讓人們每天通勤上班變得容易許多。","explanation":"動詞「連接」。"}],"related_forms":["connection"]}

{"headword":"conscious","explanation":"形容詞，意為「意識到的」或「清醒的」。常用搭配 be conscious of (意識到)。注意與 subconscious (潛意識的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the loud noise, the student was <target>conscious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the teacher's gaze, so he quickly stopped talking to his classmate.","translation":"儘管噪音很大，這名學生意識到老師的目光，所以他趕快停止與同學交談。","explanation":"形容詞「意識到的」。常用搭配 be conscious of。"},{"sentence":"After the car accident, the driver remained <target>conscious</target> and was able to tell the paramedics where he lived.","translation":"形容詞「清醒的」。指在醫療或意外情況下未失去意識。","explanation":"形容詞「清醒的」。"},{"sentence":"Many people make a <target>conscious</target> <pattern>effort</pattern> to reduce plastic waste by using reusable bags when they go shopping.","translation":"許多人有意識地努力減少塑料垃圾，在購物時使用可重複使用的袋子。","explanation":"形容詞「有意識的」。常用搭配 conscious effort (有意識的努力)。"}],"related_forms":["consciousness","unconscious"]}

{"headword":"considerable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「相當大的」或「顯著的」。常用於描述數量、程度或規模。注意與 consider (動詞) 的區別，considerable 指的是量多或程度深，而非指「考慮」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The project required a <target>considerable</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> time and effort, but the final result was worth the hard work.","translation":"這個計畫需要相當多的時間和努力，但最終的結果證明這些辛苦是值得的。","explanation":"形容詞「相當大的」。常用搭配 considerable amount of。"},{"sentence":"There has been <target>considerable</target> <pattern>interest</pattern> in the new electric car model, leading to a surge in pre-orders this month.","translation":"對這款新電動車型號有著相當大的興趣，導致本月預訂量激增。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。常用於描述興趣、進展或影響。"},{"sentence":"The city spent a <target>considerable</target> <pattern>sum of</pattern> money to improve the public transportation system and reduce traffic congestion.","translation":"該市花費了相當大的一筆錢來改善大眾運輸系統並減少交通擁堵。","explanation":"形容詞「相當大的」。常用搭配 considerable sum of money。"}],"related_forms":["considerably"]}

{"headword":"constant","explanation":"形容詞「持續的；恆定的」；名詞「常數」。形容詞用法中，constant 指的是重複發生或不間斷的狀態，常用於描述壓力、噪音或改變。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baby was crying with <target>constant</target> <pattern>noise</pattern>, which made it very difficult for the new father to concentrate on his work.","translation":"嬰兒不斷地哭鬧，這讓新手爸爸很難專注於工作。","explanation":"形容詞「持續的」。指重複發生或不間斷的。"},{"sentence":"In mathematics, a <target>constant</target> is a value that does not change, unlike a variable which varies depending on the equation.","translation":"在數學中，常數是一個不會改變的值，不像變數會根據方程式而改變。","explanation":"名詞「常數」。"},{"sentence":"The athlete maintained a <target>constant</target> <pattern>speed</pattern> throughout the race, allowing him to finish with a strong and steady pace.","translation":"這名運動員在整個比賽過程中保持恆定的速度，使他能以強而穩定的步伐完賽。","explanation":"形容詞「恆定的」。指不變的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["constantly"]}

{"headword":"continent","explanation":"名詞，意為「大陸」或「洲」。指地球上巨大的陸地塊。常用於地理或歷史討論中。","entries":[{"sentence":"Asia is the largest <target>continent</target> <pattern>on</pattern> Earth, containing a huge variety of cultures, languages, and diverse landscapes.","translation":"亞洲是地球上最大的洲，包含極其多樣的文化、語言和多樣的景觀。","explanation":"名詞「大陸/洲」。"},{"sentence":"The early explorers traveled across the <target>continent</target> to discover new lands and establish trade routes with distant countries.","translation":"早期的探險家跨越大陸去發現新土地並與遙遠的國家建立貿易路線。","explanation":"名詞「大陸」。"}],"related_forms":["continental"]}

{"headword":"controller","explanation":"名詞，意為「控制器」或「管理員/控制者」。可指電子設備的控制裝置（如遊戲控制器）或職位名稱。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gamer complained that his <target>controller</target> was not responding quickly enough, which caused him to lose the game.","translation":"這名遊戲玩家抱怨他的控制器反應不夠快，導致他輸掉了比賽。","explanation":"名詞「控制器」。指電子產品的控制裝置。"},{"sentence":"The air traffic <target>controller</target> worked carefully to ensure that planes landed and took off safely without any collisions.","translation":"航空交通管制員小心地工作，以確保飛機安全地起降而沒有任何碰撞。","explanation":"名詞「管制員/控制者」。指特定職務名稱。"}],"related_forms":["control"]}

{"headword":"cooker","explanation":"名詞，意為「炊具/電鍋/爐灶」。注意與 cook (名詞/動詞) 的區別：cooker 指的是設備，而 cook 指的是做菜的人（廚師）。","entries":[{"sentence":"My mother bought a new electric <target>cooker</target> to make cooking healthier and more efficient for the whole family.","translation":"我母親買了一個新的電鍋，為了讓全家人的飲食更健康且更高效。","explanation":"名詞「炊具/電鍋」。指做菜的設備。"},{"sentence":"Before leaving the house, please make sure that the gas <target>cooker</target> is turned off to prevent any potential fire accidents.","translation":"離開家之前，請確保瓦斯爐已關掉，以防止任何潛在的火災事故。","explanation":"名詞「爐灶」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"costly","explanation":"形容詞，意為「昂貴的」或「代價高昂的」。常用於描述價格高或某個錯誤導致嚴重後果（代價大）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company decided to cancel the <target>costly</target> <pattern>project</pattern>, as it was spending too much money without any clear profit.","translation":"公司決定取消這個代價高昂的計畫，因為它花費太多錢卻沒有明顯的利潤。","explanation":"形容詞「昂貴的/代價高昂的」。"},{"sentence":"Making a <target>costly</target> <pattern>mistake</pattern> in the final exam can lead to a lower overall grade, so students should check their answers carefully.","translation":"在期末考中犯一個代價高昂的錯誤可能會導致總分較低，因此學生應仔細檢查答案。","explanation":"形容詞「代價高昂的」。常用搭配 costly mistake (代價高昂的錯誤)。"},{"sentence":"The jewelry store sells many <target>costly</target> <pattern>items</pattern>, such as diamond rings and gold necklaces, that only wealthy people can afford.","translation":"這家珠寶店販售許多昂貴的物品，如鑽戒和金項鍊，只有富人才能買得起。","explanation":"形容詞「昂貴的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cotton","explanation":"名詞，意為「棉花」或「棉織物」。也可作形容詞使用，指「棉製的」。常用於描述衣物材質。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people prefer wearing <target>cotton</target> <pattern>shirts</pattern> in the summer because the fabric is breathable and keeps the skin cool.","translation":"許多人在夏天喜歡穿棉質襯衫，因為這種布料透氣且能讓皮膚保持涼爽。","explanation":"名詞/形容詞「棉花/棉織物」。常用搭配 cotton shirts。"},{"sentence":"The farmers in this region have grown <target>cotton</target> <pattern>for</pattern> centuries, exporting the raw material to textile factories around the world.","translation":"這個地區的農民數世紀以來一直種植棉花，將原材料出口到世界各地的紡織廠。","explanation":"名詞「棉花」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cough","explanation":"可作為名詞或動詞，意為「咳嗽」。注意搭配介系詞 from (因為...而咳嗽) 或 describe something as a cough (將某事描述為咳嗽)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the student to cover his mouth <pattern>with</pattern> a tissue when he <target>coughed</target> to avoid spreading germs in the classroom.","translation":"老師要求學生在咳嗽時用面紙遮住口鼻，以避免在教室中傳播病菌。","explanation":"動詞「咳嗽」。"},{"sentence":"After the long hike in the dusty air, he developed a persistent <target>cough</target> <pattern>that</pattern> lasted for several weeks despite taking medicine.","translation":"在多塵的空氣中長時間徒步旅行後，他患上了持續數週的咳嗽，儘管服用了藥物。","explanation":"名詞「咳嗽」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"countable","explanation":"形容詞「可數的」。常用於語言學討論名詞分類，與 uncountable (不可數) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"In English grammar, students must learn to distinguish <pattern>between</pattern> <target>countable</target> nouns and uncountable nouns to use articles like 'a' or 'an' correctly.","translation":"在英文文法中，學生必須學習區分可數名詞與不可數名詞，以便正確使用 'a' 或 'an' 等冠詞。","explanation":"形容詞「可數的」。"},{"sentence":"While water is uncountable, apples are <target>countable</target> nouns because we can easily determine the exact number of items present.","translation":"雖然水是不可數的，但蘋果是可數名詞，因為我們可以輕易地確定存在的物品確切數量。","explanation":"形容詞「可數的」。"}],"related_forms":["count"]}

{"headword":"county","explanation":"名詞「郡、縣」。指行政區域的一種。注意與 country (國家) 的拼寫相似，容易混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family decided to spend their weekend exploring the scenic countryside of the <target>county</target>, visiting small villages and local farms.","translation":"這家人決定花週末時間探索該郡的風景優美鄉間，參觀小村莊和當地農場。","explanation":"名詞「郡、縣」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>county</target> <pattern>government</pattern> announced a new plan to improve the public transportation system, including more bus routes for rural residents.","translation":"郡政府宣布了一項新計畫，旨在改善公共交通系統，包括為鄉村居民提供更多巴士路線。","explanation":"名詞「郡、縣」。常用搭配：county government (郡政府)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"crab","explanation":"名詞「螃蟹」。單複數同形或複數加 s。在描述生物或食物時使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"During their trip to the beach, the children enjoyed watching the small <target>crabs</target> scuttling across the sand toward the ocean waves.","translation":"在海邊旅行期間，孩子們很喜歡看小螃蟹在沙灘上向海浪方向快步爬行。","explanation":"名詞「螃蟹」。"},{"sentence":"The seafood restaurant is famous for its grilled <target>crab</target> served with lemon butter, which is a favorite dish among tourists.","translation":"這家海鮮餐廳以其搭配檸檬奶油的烤螃蟹聞名，是遊客最喜愛的菜餚。","explanation":"名詞「螃蟹」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cradle","explanation":"名詞「搖籃」；動詞「搖籃般地抱著」。名詞可比喻指某事物的發源地。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new mother gently rocked the <target>cradle</target> to help her baby fall asleep after a long day of crying.","translation":"新媽媽輕輕搖著搖籃，幫助她的寶寶在哭了一整天後入睡。","explanation":"名詞「搖籃」。"},{"sentence":"Ancient Mesopotamia is often described as the <target>cradle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> civilization, where the first cities and writing systems were developed.","translation":"古美索不達米亞常被描述為文明的搖籃，那是第一個城市和文字系統發展的地方。","explanation":"名詞「搖籃」（比喻用法）。常用搭配：cradle of civilization (文明的搖籃)。"},{"sentence":"He <target>cradled</target> the injured bird <pattern>in</pattern> his hands, carefully moving it to a safe place for medical treatment.","translation":"他將受傷的鳥兒輕輕抱在手中，小心地將其移至安全處接受治療。","explanation":"動詞「搖籃般地抱著」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"crane","explanation":"名詞可指「起重機」或「鶴（鳥類）」；動詞指「伸長脖子」。注意區分其不同意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The construction workers used a giant <target>crane</target> to lift the heavy steel beams to the top floor of the skyscraper.","translation":"建築工人使用一台巨大的起重機將沉重的鋼樑提升至摩天大樓的頂層。","explanation":"名詞「起重機」。"},{"sentence":"The photographer waited patiently for hours to capture a beautiful image of a <target>crane</target> flying over the lake at sunrise.","translation":"攝影師耐心地等待了數小時，以捕捉一張日出時分鶴在湖上飛行的美圖。","explanation":"名詞「鶴」。"},{"sentence":"The curious student <target>craned</target> his neck <pattern>to</pattern> see the famous painting at the back of the crowded art gallery.","translation":"好奇的學生伸長脖子，想看清楚擁擠的美術館後方那幅著名的畫作。","explanation":"動詞「伸長脖子」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"crash","explanation":"名詞或動詞，意為「碰撞、毀壞、崩潰」。可用於交通事故、電腦系統或聲音描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver was lucky to survive the car <target>crash</target> without any serious injuries, although the vehicle was completely destroyed.","translation":"駕駛人很幸運地在車禍中倖存而沒有嚴重受傷，儘管車輛被完全摧毀。","explanation":"名詞「碰撞、車禍」。"},{"sentence":"My computer suddenly <target>crashed</target> while I was writing my final essay, and I lost all the work I had not saved.","translation":"當我在寫期末論文時，我的電腦突然崩潰了，我失去了所有未保存的工作。","explanation":"動詞「崩潰」。指電腦系統停止運作。"},{"sentence":"A loud <target>crash</target> came from the kitchen, and they realized the shelf of glass plates had fallen and broken.","translation":"廚房傳來一聲巨響，他們意識到玻璃盤子的架子掉下來並破碎了。","explanation":"名詞「巨響」。指碰撞產生的聲音。"},{"sentence":"The stock market <target>crashed</target> unexpectedly, causing many investors to lose a significant amount of money in a short period.","translation":"股市意外崩潰，導致許多投資者在短時間內損失了大量資金。","explanation":"動詞「崩潰」。指經濟或市場的劇烈下跌。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"crawl","explanation":"動詞或名詞，意為「爬行」。常用於嬰兒、昆蟲或交通緩慢地移動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baby began to <target>crawl</target> <pattern>across</pattern> the living room floor, trying to reach the colorful toys near the sofa.","translation":"寶寶開始在客廳地板上爬行，試圖觸及沙發旁的彩色玩具。","explanation":"動詞「爬行」。"},{"sentence":"During the rush hour, the traffic on the highway <target>crawled</target> <pattern>along</pattern> at a very slow speed due to a heavy accident.","translation":"在尖峰時段，由於一起嚴重事故，高速公路上的交通緩慢地前行。","explanation":"動詞「爬行」。比喻指交通移動極慢。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers had to <target>crawl</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the tall grass to avoid being seen by the enemy soldiers in the distance.","translation":"士兵們必須在長草叢中爬行，以避免被遠處的敵軍士兵發現。","explanation":"動詞「爬行」。"}],"related_forms":["crawler"]}

{"headword":"creative","explanation":"形容詞「有創造力的」。常用於描述人的能力或解決問題的方法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The art teacher encouraged the students to be more <target>creative</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their paintings, using unusual colors and materials.","translation":"美術老師鼓勵學生在繪畫中更具創造力，使用不尋常的顏色和材料。","explanation":"形容詞「有創造力的」。常用搭配：creative with sth。"},{"sentence":"To solve the complex problem, the team had to come up with a <target>creative</target> <pattern>solution</pattern> that no one had thought of before.","translation":"為了解決這個複雜的問題，團隊必須提出一個此前無人想到的創造性解決方案。","explanation":"形容詞「有創造力的」。常用搭配：creative solution。"}],"related_forms":["creativity","create","creator"]}

{"headword":"creator","explanation":"名詞「創造者、創作者」。指創造出某物的人，如藝術品、軟體或故事。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>creator</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the popular mobile app explained how the software helps users organize their daily schedules more efficiently.","translation":"這款熱門手機應用程式的創作者解釋了該軟體如何幫助使用者更高效地組織其日常行程。","explanation":"名詞「創造者」。常用搭配：creator of sth。"},{"sentence":"After reading the novel, the students discussed the <target>creator</target>'s vision and the main themes of the story in their English class.","translation":"讀完小說後，學生在英文課上討論了創作者的願景以及故事的主題。","explanation":"名詞「創造者」。"}],"related_forms":["create","creative","creativity"]}

{"headword": "creature", "explanation": "名詞「生物、生物體」。通常指動物，但也可指虛構的生物或人。常用於描述生物的特徵或習性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The deep ocean is home to many strange <target>creatures</target> that have adapted to high pressure and complete darkness.", "translation": "深海是許多奇怪生物的家園，這些生物已經適應了高壓和完全黑暗的環境。", "explanation": "名詞「生物」。指生活在自然界中的生物。"}, {"sentence": "In the movie, the scientist accidentally created a monstrous <target>creature</target> in his laboratory, which eventually escaped into the city.", "translation": "在電影中，科學家在實驗室中不小心創造了一個巨大的怪物，最終逃到了城市中。", "explanation": "名詞「生物」。此處指虛構的怪物。"}, {"sentence": "After losing everything in the fire, the old man became a pitiful <target>creature</target> who relied entirely on the kindness of strangers.", "translation": "在火災中失去一切後，這位老人變成了一個可憐的生物，完全依賴陌生人的善意。", "explanation": "名詞「生物」。此處指人，用以表達同情或憐憫。"}], "related_forms": ["creatures"]}

{"headword": "credit", "explanation": "名詞可用於「信用」、「學分」或「功勞」；動詞意為「相信」或「將...歸功於」。注意 credit for (功勞) 與 give credit to (歸功於) 的搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university allows students to earn <target>credits</target> <pattern>by</pattern> completing online courses and participating in community service projects.", "translation": "大學允許學生透過完成線上課程和參與社區服務計畫來獲得學分。", "explanation": "名詞「學分」。指教育體系中的學分。"}, {"sentence": "The young artist received a lot of <target>credit</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the success of the exhibition, although she had a small role.", "translation": "這位年輕藝術家因展覽的成功而獲得了許多讚賞，儘管她扮演的角色很小。", "explanation": "名詞「功勞、讚賞」。常用搭配：credit for sth。"}, {"sentence": "Because he had a high <target>credit</target> <pattern>score</pattern>, the bank approved his loan application quickly without requiring any additional collateral.", "translation": "因為他有有很高的信用分數，銀行迅速批准了他的貸款申請，而不需要任何額外的抵押品。", "explanation": "名詞「信用」。常用搭配：credit score (信用分數)。"}, {"sentence": "The manager <pattern>gave</pattern> <target>credit</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the whole team for the project's success, rather than taking all the praise for himself.", "translation": "經理將計畫的成功歸功於整個團隊，而不是將所有讚美據為己有。", "explanation": "名詞「功勞」。在此句中，give credit to 為固定搭配，意為將功勞歸於某人。"}, {"sentence": " Few people would <target>credit</target> the story about the alien spaceship landing in the forest, as it sounded too unbelievable to be true.", "translation": "很少有人會相信關於外星飛船落在森林裡的那個故事，因為它聽起來太不可思議而不能是真的。", "explanation": "動詞「相信」。"}], "related_forms": ["credited", "crediting"]}

{"headword": "crew", "explanation": "名詞「工作人員、船員、機組人員」。指共同工作的一群人，尤其是飛機、船隻或電影拍攝組。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The flight <target>crew</target> provided excellent service during the long journey, making sure all passengers were comfortable and safe.", "translation": "機組人員在長途旅程中提供了卓越的服務，確保所有乘客都感到舒適和安全。", "explanation": "名詞「機組人員」。"}, {"sentence": "Before the movie started filming, the camera <target>crew</target> spent several hours setting up the equipment and checking the lighting.", "translation": "在電影開始拍攝前，攝影組花了好幾個小時安裝設備並檢查燈光。", "explanation": "名詞「工作人員」。指電影拍攝組。"}, {"sentence": "The ship's <target>crew</target> worked together efficiently to navigate through the dangerous storm, preventing the vessel from sinking.", "translation": "船員們高效地共同工作以在危險的風暴中航行，防止船隻沉沒。", "explanation": "名詞「船員」。"}], "related_forms": ["crews"]}

{"headword": "cricket", "explanation": "名詞，有兩種截然不同的意思：一種是運動項目「板球」，另一種是昆蟲「蟋蟀」。在 GSAT 考題中，兩者均有出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "<target>Cricket</target> is a popular sport in India and England, where players use a bat and ball to score runs on a field.", "translation": "板球在印度和英國是一項受歡迎的運動，球員使用球棒和球將球擊出以在場上得分。", "explanation": "名詞「板球」。指運動溫度。"}, {"sentence": "On a quiet summer night, you can often hear the rhythmic chirping of a <target>cricket</target> hiding in the grass.", "translation": "在一個安靜的夏夜，你經常能聽到隱藏在草叢中蟋蟀的節奏性鳴叫聲。", "explanation": "名詞「蟋蟀」。指昆蟲。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"criminal","explanation":"形容詞「犯罪的、刑事的」；名詞「罪犯」。注意 criminal record (犯罪紀錄) 和 criminal law (刑事法) 的搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The judge determined that the man's actions were <target>criminal</target>, and he was sentenced to ten years in prison.","translation":"法官判定該男子的行為是犯罪的，他被判處十年監禁。","explanation":"形容詞「犯罪的」。"},{"sentence":"The police arrested a suspected <target>criminal</target> who had stolen several expensive paintings from the national museum last month.","translation":"警察逮捕了一名涉嫌從國家博物館偷走幾幅昂貴畫作的罪犯。","explanation":"名詞「罪犯」。"},{"sentence":"Because he had a <target>criminal</target> <pattern>record</pattern>, he found it difficult to find a professional job after being released from jail.","translation":"因為他有犯罪紀錄，在出獄後發現很難找到一份專業的工作。","explanation":"形容詞「犯罪的」。常用搭配：criminal record (犯罪紀錄)。"}],"related_forms":["criminally"]}

{"headword":"crispy","explanation":"形容詞「酥脆的」。常用於描述食物的口感，如 crispy chicken (酥脆的雞肉) 或 crispy fries (酥脆的薯條)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef used a special frying technique to make the skin of the roast duck <target>crispy</target> and full of flavor.","translation":"廚師使用一種特殊的油炸技術，使烤鴨的皮變得酥脆且充滿風味。","explanation":"形容詞「酥脆的」。"},{"sentence":"I love eating <target>crispy</target> <pattern>fries</pattern> with a bit of salt, as the crunchiness makes them much more enjoyable to eat.","translation":"我喜歡吃帶有少許鹽的酥脆薯條，因為那種脆感讓它們吃起來更享受。","explanation":"形容詞「酥脆的」。常用搭配：crispy fries (酥脆薯條)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"crop","explanation":"名詞「農作物」；動詞「修剪、剪掉」。名詞用法常見於 agriculture (農業) 相關主題；動詞用法常見於照片編輯或頭髮修剪。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the severe drought this year, many farmers suffered a huge loss because their <target>crops</target> failed to grow.","translation":"由於今年嚴重的乾旱，許多農民遭受了巨大的損失，因為他們的農作物無法生長。","explanation":"名詞「農作物」。"},{"sentence":"The government provided financial aid to the farmers to help them protect their <target>crops</target> <pattern>from</pattern> pests and diseases.","translation":"政府提供了財務援助給農民，以幫助他們保護農作物免於病蟲害。","explanation":"名詞「農作物」。常用搭配：protect crops from... (保護農作物免於...)。"},{"sentence":"The photographer decided to <target>crop</target> the image to remove the distracting background and focus on the main subject.","translation":"攝影師決定裁剪圖像，以移除干擾的背景並將焦點集中在主體上。","explanation":"動詞「裁剪」。指將照片的一部分剪掉。"},{"sentence":"She decided to <target>crop</target> her hair short for the summer, making it much easier to manage in the hot weather.","translation":"由於夏天，她決定將頭髮剪短，使其在炎熱的天氣中更容易打理。","explanation":"動詞「剪短」。指修剪頭髮。"}],"related_forms":["cropped"]}

{"headword":"crown","explanation":"名詞「皇冠」；動詞「加冕、封為...」。注意 crown (皇冠) 與 coronation (加冕禮) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The queen wore a beautiful golden <target>crown</target> decorated with diamonds and rubies during the official coronation ceremony.","translation":"女王在正式的加冕典禮上戴著一頂裝飾著鑽石和紅寶石的精美金皇冠。","explanation":"名詞「皇冠」。"},{"sentence":"After winning the international chess tournament, the young player was <target>crowned</target> the champion of the world.","translation":"在贏得國際象棋錦標賽後，這位年輕選手被封為世界冠軍。","explanation":"動詞「封為」。常用於比喻義，指被認為是最高地位的人。"},{"sentence":"The ancient ruins showed that the king's <target>crown</target> was once a symbol of absolute power and divine right.","translation":"古代遺址顯示，國王的皇冠曾是絕對權力和神聖權利的象徵。","explanation":"名詞「皇冠」。"}],"related_forms":["crowning"]}

{"headword":"cruel","explanation":"形容詞「殘忍的、刻毒的」。常用於描述人的行為或待人方式。注意與 kind (親切的) 相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is <target>cruel</target> to keep wild animals in small cages, as it prevents them from behaving naturally and causes stress.","translation":"將野生動物關在小籠子裡是很殘忍的，因為這會阻止它們自然行為並造成壓力。","explanation":"形容詞「殘忍的」。"},{"sentence":"The villagers were shocked by the <target>cruel</target> treatment of the prisoners by the guards during the war years.","translation":"村民們對戰爭期間衛兵對囚犯的殘忍對待感到震驚。","explanation":"形容詞「殘忍的」。常用搭配：cruel treatment (殘忍的對待)。"}],"related_forms":["cruelty","cruelly"]}

{"headword":"cupboard","explanation":"名詞「櫥櫃、碗櫥」。通常指有門的儲物櫃，常用於廚房或房間內。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please put the clean glasses and plates back into the kitchen <target>cupboard</target> after you finish drying them.","translation":"請在擦乾後將乾淨的玻璃杯和盤子放回廚房櫥櫃中。","explanation":"名詞「櫥櫃」。"},{"sentence":"She searched through the entire <target>cupboard</target> for her favorite snack, but found that her brother had eaten it all.","translation":"她在整個櫥櫃中搜尋她最喜歡的零食，但發現她的哥哥已經把它全部吃光了。","explanation":"名詞「櫥櫃」。"}],"related_forms":["cupboards"]}

{"headword":"dairy","explanation":"名詞「乳製品」。通常指由牛奶製成的產品，如起司、奶油。注意與 diary (日記) 的拼法區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people choose to avoid <target>dairy</target> <pattern>products</pattern> because they are lactose intolerant, opting for almond or soy milk instead.","translation":"許多人選擇避免乳製品，因為他們有乳糖不耐症，因此選擇杏仁奶或豆奶代替。","explanation":"名詞「乳製品」。常用搭配：dairy products (乳製品)。"},{"sentence":"The local <target>dairy</target> farm provides fresh milk and butter to the entire village, supporting the community's agricultural economy.","translation":"當地乳牛場為整個村莊提供新鮮牛奶和奶油，支持著社區的農業經濟。","explanation":"名詞「乳製品/乳牛場」。在此指生產乳製品的場所。"}],"related_forms":["dairies"]}

{"headword":"dam","explanation":"名詞「水壩」；動詞「築壩、攔截」。名詞常用於討論環境或能源，動詞常用於描述阻止水流或情感的流露。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to build a massive <target>dam</target> across the river to generate hydroelectric power and prevent seasonal flooding.","translation":"政府決定在河流上建造一座巨大的水壩，以產生水力發電並防止季節性洪水。","explanation":"名詞「水壩」。常用於描述發電或防災設施。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists warned that the new <target>dam</target> could disrupt the migration patterns of fish, potentially damaging the local ecosystem.","translation":"環境保護主義者警告說，新水壩可能會干擾魚類的遷徙模式，進而可能損害當地生態系統。","explanation":"名詞「水壩」。"},{"sentence":"The heavy rains caused the small stream to overflow, prompting the villagers to <target>dam</target> the water using sandbags and stones.","translation":"大雨導致小溪氾濫，促使村民們使用沙袋和石頭來攔截水流。","explanation":"動詞「築壩、攔截」。指用構造物阻止水流。"},{"sentence":"She tried to <target>dam</target> her feelings of sadness after the loss of her pet, but tears eventually flowed from her eyes.","translation":"她試圖壓抑悲傷的情緒，但在失去寵物後，淚水最終還是流了下來。","explanation":"動詞「攔截、壓抑」。比喻用法，指阻止情感的流露。"}],"related_forms":["dams"]}

{"headword":"dare","explanation":"助動詞或動詞「敢、挑戰」。作為助動詞時，常用於否定句或疑問句，且後接原形動詞。作為一般動詞時，常用於 dare someone to do something (挑戰某人做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I <pattern>don't</pattern> <target>dare</target> to open the mysterious old box in the attic, fearing that it might contain something frightening.","translation":"我不敢打開閣樓裡那個神秘的舊盒子，擔心裡面可能裝著可怕的東西。","explanation":"助動詞用法，表示「不敢」。後接 to V 或原形動詞。"},{"sentence":"The brave student <target>dared</target> <pattern>to</pattern> speak the truth during the meeting, even though he knew it might make him unpopular.","translation":"這名勇敢的學生敢於在會議中說出真相，儘管他知道這可能會讓他不受歡迎。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「敢於」。常用搭配：dare to V。"},{"sentence":"His friends <target>dared</target> him <pattern>to</pattern> jump into the cold lake, but he refused, prioritizing his health over a silly challenge.","translation":"他的朋友們挑戰他跳入冰冷的湖中，但他拒絕了，因為他認為健康比愚蠢的挑戰更重要。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「挑戰某人」。常用結構：dare someone to V。"}],"related_forms":["daring","dared"]}

{"headword":"darling","explanation":"名詞「親愛的、心愛的人」；形容詞「可愛的」。常用於對親近的人或寵物的愛稱。","entries":[{"sentence":"The grandmother called her grandson her little <target>darling</target>, kissing his cheek every time he visited her on weekends.","translation":"祖母稱呼她的孫子為她的小心肝，每次他週末來訪時，她都會親吻他的臉頰。","explanation":"名詞「心愛的人」。用於表達親暱感。"},{"sentence":"She wore a <target>darling</target> little dress for the garden party, which perfectly matched the blooming flowers around her.","translation":"形容詞「可愛的」。描述事物或人給人帶來愉悅的感覺。- 常用於英式英語中。- 常用搭配：a darling little... (一個可愛的...)","explanation":"形容詞「可愛的」。描述事物或人給人帶來愉悅的感覺。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"dash","explanation":"名詞「短跑、衝刺、破折號」；動詞「衝、猛衝」。常用片語 a dash of (少量的...)，make a dash for (衝向...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete trained hard for the 100-meter <target>dash</target>, hoping to break the record and win the gold medal at the Olympics.","translation":"這名運動員為 100 米短跑刻苦訓練，希望打破紀錄並在奧運會上贏得金牌。","explanation":"名詞「短跑、衝刺」。指極短距離的全力奔跑。"},{"sentence":"As the rain began to pour, the students <target>dashed</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the nearest shelter to avoid getting their textbooks completely wet.","translation":"當大雨開始傾盆而下時，學生們猛衝向最近的遮蔽處，以避免他們的教科書完全被打濕。","explanation":"動詞「猛衝」。常用搭配：dash for sth (衝向某物)。"},{"sentence":"To make the cake taste better, the chef added a <target>dash</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cinnamon to the batter, giving it a warm aroma.","translation":"為了讓蛋糕味道更好，廚師在麵糊中加入了一小撮肉桂，使其具有溫暖的香氣。","explanation":"名詞「少量的...」。常用片語 a dash of + N (少量地)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to use a <target>dash</target> in their essays to indicate a sudden break in thought or to add detail.","translation":"老師要求學生在作文中使用破折號，以表示思想的突然中斷或增加詳細資訊。","explanation":"名詞「破折號」。指標點符號 \"-」。"}],"related_forms":["dashed","dashing"]}

{"headword":"database","explanation":"名詞「資料庫」。指儲存大量資訊的電子系統，常用於資訊科技、研究或公司管理。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university library maintains a comprehensive <target>database</target> of academic journals, allowing students to access thousands of research papers online.","translation":"大學圖書館維護著一個完整的學術期刊資料庫，使學生能夠在線訪問數千篇研究論文。","explanation":"名詞「資料庫」。指儲存資訊的電子系統。"},{"sentence":"The company's customer <target>database</target> was leaked during a cyber attack, leading to thousands of users to change their passwords immediately.","translation":"公司的客戶資料庫在一次網路攻擊中洩露，導致數千名用戶立即更改他們的密碼。","explanation":"名詞「資料庫」。常用搭配：customer database (客戶資料庫)。"}],"related_forms":["databases"]}

{"headword":"dawn","explanation":"名詞「黎明、開端」；動詞「意識到、破曉」。常用片語 at dawn (在黎明時分), the dawn of (某事的開端)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers woke up <pattern>at</pattern> <target>dawn</target> to start their journey up the mountain, hoping to see the sunrise from the peak.","translation":"登山者在黎明時分起床開始登山之旅，希望在山頂看到日出。","explanation":"名詞「黎明」。指太陽升起之前的一段時間。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of fire marked the <target>dawn</target> <pattern>of</pattern> human civilization, changing the way ancient people lived and cooked.","translation":"火的發現標誌著人類文明的開端，改變了古代人類生活和烹飪的方式。","explanation":"名詞「開端」。常用片語 the dawn of + N (某事的開端)。"},{"sentence":"It slowly <target>dawned</target> <pattern>on</pattern> him that he had forgotten his wallet at home after he reached the checkout counter.","translation":"當他到達結帳櫃檯後，他才慢慢意識到自己把錢包忘在家里了。","explanation":"動詞片語 dawn on someone 意為「某人突然意識到」。這是 GSAT 常考的高階用法。"},{"sentence":"The sky began to <target>dawn</target> as the birds started singing, signaling the start of a new, peaceful morning.","translation":"天空開始破曉，隨之而來的是鳥兒的開始歌唱，預示著一個新的、寧靜的早晨的開始。","explanation":"動詞「破曉」。指太陽升起。"}],"related_forms":["dawns","dawned"]}

{"headword":"dealer","explanation":"名詞「交易商、經銷商」。指從製造商購買商品並將其賣給消費者的商人。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you want to buy a reliable used car, it is often better to go to a licensed <target>dealer</target> rather than a private seller.","translation":"如果你想買一輛可靠的二手車，通常最好去持有執照的經銷商那裡，而不是找私人賣家。","explanation":"名詞「經銷商」。常用搭配：car dealer (汽車經銷商)。"},{"sentence":"The antique <target>dealer</target> spent years searching for rare books and paintings to sell to collectors who appreciate fine art.","translation":"古董交易商花年時間尋找稀有書籍和繪畫，以賣給欣賞美術的收藏家。","explanation":"名詞「交易商」。指買賣特定商品的人。"}],"related_forms":["dealers"]}

{"headword": "decade", "explanation": "名詞「十年」。指一個十年的時間段。常用搭配 for a decade (十年之久)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The technology for smartphones has changed dramatically over the last <target>decade</target>, making communication much faster and easier.", "translation": "智慧型手機的技術在過去十年中發生了劇烈變化，使得通訊變得更快且更簡單。", "explanation": "名詞「十年」。常用於描述時間跨度。"}, {"sentence": "My grandfather has lived in the same small village <pattern>for</pattern> a <target>decade</target>, enjoying the peaceful atmosphere and the company of his neighbors.", "translation": "我的祖父在同一個小村莊住了十年之久，享受著寧靜的氛圍和鄰居的陪伴。", "explanation": "名詞「十年」。常用片語 for a decade (持續十年)。"}], "related_forms": ["decades"]}

{"headword":"deck","explanation":"名詞，指「甲板」或「一副牌」。在 GSAT 中，常指船隻或巴士的頂層甲板。注意其動詞用法，指「裝飾」或「deck out」，意為「精心裝飾」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The passengers gathered on the <target>deck</target> of the cruise ship to watch the sunset over the horizon, enjoying the fresh sea breeze.","translation":"乘客們聚集在郵輪的甲板上，觀賞地平線上的日落，享受新鮮的海風。","explanation":"名詞「甲板」。指船隻的頂層平面。"},{"sentence":"The magician shuffled a <target>deck</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cards before performing a trick that amazed everyone in the room.","translation":"魔術師在表演一個讓房內所有人驚訝的魔術之前，先洗了一副牌。","explanation":"名詞「一副牌」。常用搭配：a deck of cards (一副牌)。"}],"related_forms":["decks"]}

{"headword":"decorate","explanation":"動詞「裝飾」。指透過添加物品使其更美觀。常用於節日佈置或室內設計。注意與 decorate (裝飾) 與 dedicate (奉獻) 的拼寫區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every December, the students <pattern>work together to</pattern> <target>decorate</target> the school hallway <pattern>with</pattern> colorful ribbons and lights for the winter festival.","translation":"每年十二月，學生們一起合作，用彩色絲帶和燈飾裝飾學校走廊，迎接冬季節日。","explanation":"動詞「裝飾」。常用搭配 decorate sth with sth (用...裝飾某物)。"},{"sentence":"She decided to <target>decorate</target> her bedroom <pattern>with</pattern> posters of her favorite artists to make the space feel more personal and creative.","translation":"她決定用她最喜歡的藝術家的海報來裝飾她的臥室，使這個空間感覺更具個人色彩和創意。","explanation":"動詞「裝飾」。"},{"sentence":"The city council spent a large amount of money to <target>decorate</target> the main square <pattern>with</pattern> flowers and flags during the national holiday.","translation":"市議會花了大筆資金在國定假日期間用花卉和旗幟裝飾主廣場。","explanation":"動詞「裝飾」。"}],"related_forms":["decorates","decorated","decorating","decoration","decorative"]}

{"headword":"decrease","explanation":"動詞「減少」；名詞「減少」。指數量、程度或強度的下降。常用於描述數據、價格或人口。注意其反義詞 increase (增加)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to <target>decrease</target> the <pattern>amount of</pattern> plastic waste that ends up in the ocean each year.","translation":"政府實施了新法律，以減少每年流入海洋的塑料垃圾量。","explanation":"動詞「減少」。常用搭配 decrease the amount of sth (減少...的量)。"},{"sentence":"Medical experts believe that regular exercise and a balanced diet can significantly <target>decrease</target> the risk of heart disease.","translation":"醫療專家認為，定期運動和均衡飲食能顯著降低心臟病的風險。","explanation":"動詞「減少」。"},{"sentence":"There has been a steady <target>decrease</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the number of students choosing to study traditional languages in recent years.","translation":"近年來，選擇學習傳統語言的學生人數持續減少。","explanation":"名詞「減少」。常用搭配 a decrease in sth (在...方面的減少)。"},{"sentence":"The store decided to <target>decrease</target> the price of its older models to attract more customers during the summer sale.","translation":"商店決定降低舊款產品的價格，以便在夏季特賣期間吸引更多顧客。","explanation":"動詞「減少/降低」。"}],"related_forms":["decreases","decreased","decreasing"]}

{"headword":"deed","explanation":"名詞「行為」或「法律文書（如房產契據）」。在 GSAT 語境中，最常考的是指「行為」，尤其是指一種道德上的善行或惡行。常用搭配：good deed (善行)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy was praised by his teacher for his <target>deed</target> <pattern>of</pattern> helping an elderly woman cross the busy street.","translation":"這個小男孩因為幫助一位老婦人過繁忙的街道而受到老師的稱讚。","explanation":"名詞「行為」。常用搭配 a deed of sth (某種行為)。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that a single <pattern>good</pattern> <target>deed</target> can make a huge difference in someone's life and inspire others to be kind.","translation":"許多人相信，一個簡單的善行就能在某人的生活中產生巨大的影響，並激勵他人變得善良。","explanation":"名詞「行為」。常用搭配 good deed (善行)。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer checked the <target>deed</target> to the house carefully to ensure that the property had been legally transferred to the new owner.","translation":"律師仔細檢查了房產契據，以確保房產已合法轉移給新所有者。","explanation":"名詞「法律文書/契據」。指證明所有權的法律文件。"}],"related_forms":["deeds"]}

{"headword":"deepen","explanation":"動詞「加深」。可指物理上的深度增加，也可指抽象意義上的加深，如感情、理解、矛盾或危機的加深。常用搭配：deepen the understanding (加深理解), deepen the conflict (加深矛盾)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor's detailed explanation helped the students <target>deepen</target> their <pattern>understanding of</pattern> the complex scientific theories discussed in class.","translation":"教授詳細的解釋幫助學生加深了對課堂上討論的複雜科學理論的理解。","explanation":"動詞「加深」。常用搭配 deepen understanding of sth (加深對...的理解)。"},{"sentence":"The two countries' diplomatic relations continued to <target>deepen</target> after they signed a new trade agreement to cooperate on technology.","translation":"在簽署了一項旨在合作技術的新貿易協定後，兩國的外交關係繼續加深。","explanation":"動詞「加深」。指關係的加深。"},{"sentence":"The unexpected failure of the negotiations only served to <target>deepen</target> the <pattern>conflict between</pattern> the two opposing political parties.","translation":"談判的意外失敗只會加深兩個對立政黨之間的衝突。","explanation":"動詞「加深」。指衝突或矛盾的加深。"}],"related_forms":["deepens","deepened","deepening"]}

{"headword":"definition","explanation":"名詞「定義」。指對一個詞彙或概念的準確說明。常用於學術討論或字典查詢。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you encounter an unfamiliar word while reading, you should look up its <target>definition</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a dictionary to understand the context better.","translation":"如果你在閱讀時遇到不熟悉的單字，你應該在字典中查閱其定義，以便更好地理解上下文。","explanation":"名詞「定義」。常用搭配 definition in a dictionary (在字典中的定義)。"},{"sentence":"The legal <target>definition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the word 'negligence' is very specific, and lawyers must follow it strictly to win the case.","translation":"negligence（過失）這個詞的法律定義非常具體，律師必須嚴格遵守此定義才能贏得官司。","explanation":"名詞「定義」。常用搭配 definition of sth (某物的定義)。"}],"related_forms":["definitions"]}

{"headword": "democracy", "explanation": "名詞「民主」。指一種政府形式，由公民通過選舉決定領導者。常用搭配：liberal democracy (自由民主), promote democracy (推廣民主)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The citizens of the country fought hard to establish a <target>democracy</target>, ensuring that every individual had the right to vote in elections.", "translation": "該國公民努力奮鬥以建立民主制度，確保每個人在選舉中都有投票權。", "explanation": "名詞「民主」。"}, {"sentence": "Many historians argue that education is the foundation of a healthy <target>democracy</target>, as it allows citizens to make informed decisions.", "translation": "許多歷史學家認為，教育是健康民主制度的基石，因為它讓公民能做出明智的決定。", "explanation": "名詞「民主」。"}, {"sentence": "The international community continues to <pattern>promote</pattern> <target>democracy</target> and human rights in regions where authoritarian regimes still exist.", "translation": "國際社會繼續在仍存在威權政權的地區推廣民主與人權。", "explanation": "名詞「民主」。常用搭配 promote democracy (推廣民主)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "democratic", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。指符合民主原則的或由人民選擇的。注意與 democracy (名詞) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The committee decided to use a <target>democratic</target> process to choose the new class president, allowing every student to cast a vote.", "translation": "委員會決定使用民主程序來選擇新的班長，允許每位學生投票。", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。"}, {"sentence": "In a <target>democratic</target> society, the government must be accountable to the people and respect the freedom of speech for all citizens.", "translation": "在一個民主社會中，政府必須對人民負責，並尊重所有公民的言論自由。", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。"}, {"sentence": "The country held <target>democratic</target> elections last month to ensure that the new leader was chosen by the will of the people.", "translation": "該國上個月舉行了民主選舉，以確保新領導人是根據人民的意願選出的。", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。常用搭配 democratic elections (民主選舉)。"}, {"sentence": "School councils often encourage students to uphold <target>democratic</target> values by participating in student government and debating school policies.", "translation": "學校委員會經常鼓勵學生透過參與學生自治會和辯論學校政策來維護民主價值觀。", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。常用搭配 democratic values (民主價值觀)。"}, {"sentence": "The organization was founded on <target>democratic</target> principles, meaning that every member has an equal say in how the group is managed.", "translation": "該組織是基於民主原則建立的，這意味著每位成員在團體管理方面都擁有平等的發言權。", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。常用搭配 democratic principles (民主原則)。"}], "related_forms": ["democratically"]}

{"headword":"deposit","explanation":"名詞「押金；存款；沉積物」；動詞「存放；寄存；沉積」。詞性多變，需注意上下文。常考用法：make a deposit (存款/付押金), security deposit (保證金)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When renting an apartment, the landlord usually requires a security <target>deposit</target> to cover any potential damage to the property during the lease.","translation":"租房時，房東通常要求支付一筆保證金，以支付租期內房產可能產生的任何損壞。","explanation":"名詞「押金/保證金」。常用搭配 security deposit (保證金)。"},{"sentence":"The student decided to <target>deposit</target> some of his summer job earnings <pattern>into</pattern> his savings account to save for his future college tuition.","translation":"這名學生決定將他在暑假打工賺的一部分錢存入儲蓄帳戶，為未來的大學學費儲蓄。","explanation":"動詞「存款/存放」。常用搭配 deposit sth into sth (將...存入...)。"},{"sentence":"Over millions of years, layers of minerals were <target>deposited</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the river, creating the unique rock formations seen today.","translation":"數百萬年來，河流沉積了許多礦物層，形成了今天看到的獨特岩石構造。","explanation":"動詞「沉積」。指物質在某處堆積。"},{"sentence":"The bank teller asked her to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>deposit</target> for the first time, and she carefully followed the instructions to complete the transaction.","translation":"銀行櫃員請她第一次進行存款，然後她仔細地按照指示完成交易。","explanation":"名詞「存款」。片語 make a deposit (進行存款)。"}],"related_forms":["deposits","deposited","depositing"]}

{"headword": "designer", "explanation": "名詞「設計師」。指負責創造產品外觀、功能或系統的人。常用於時尚、建築或圖形設計。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young woman dreamed of becoming a fashion <target>designer</target> and spent hours sketching new clothing styles in her notebook every day.", "translation": "這個年輕女子夢想成為一名時尚設計師，每天花好幾個小時在筆記本中勾勒新的服裝款式。", "explanation": "名詞「設計師」。"}, {"sentence": "The company hired a professional graphic <target>designer</target> to create a new logo and a more modern website for their brand.", "translation": "公司聘請了一位專業的平面設計師，為他們的品牌創造一個新標誌和更現代的網站。", "explanation": "名詞「設計師」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people are willing to pay a high price for <target>designer</target> handbags, as they value the brand's reputation and the quality of materials.", "translation": "許多人願意為設計師品牌的手袋支付高價，因為他們看重品牌的聲譽和品質。", "explanation": "形容詞用法（名詞轉形容詞）。指由知名設計師設計的。"}], "related_forms": ["designers"]}

{"headword": "desirable", "explanation": "形容詞「值得嚮往的；理想的；令人 desirable 的」。指某物具有吸引力或被認為是適當且有益的。常用搭配：desirable quality (理想的特質), highly desirable (非常理想的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Having a strong command of a second language is a highly <target>desirable</target> skill for students who want to apply for international scholarships.", "translation": "對於想要申請國際獎學金的學生來說，精通第二語言是一項非常理想的技能。", "explanation": "形容詞「理想的」。"}, {"sentence": "The house is located in a <target>desirable</target> area of the city, close to the subway station and many high-quality schools.", "translation": "這房子位於城市中一個理想的區域，靠近地鐵站和許多優質學校。", "explanation": "形容詞「理想的」。"}, {"sentence": "The government believes that it is <target>desirable</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the public to have access to accurate health information during a pandemic.", "translation": "政府認為，在疫情期間大眾能獲取準確的健康資訊是很有必要的（理想的）。", "explanation": "形容詞「值得嚮往的/必要的」。常用搭配 it is desirable for someone to do sth。"}], "related_forms": ["desirability", "desire"]}

{"headword":"desire","explanation":"名詞「慾望、渴望」；動詞「渴望」。作為動詞時，比 want 更正式。常用搭配：a strong desire for (強烈的渴望), fulfill a desire (滿足慾望)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students have a strong <target>desire</target> <pattern>for</pattern> success, which motivates them to study hard and achieve their goals.","translation":"許多學生對成功有著強烈的渴望，這激勵他們努力學習並達成目標。","explanation":"名詞「渴望」。常用搭配：a strong desire for sth。"},{"sentence":"The young artist had a deep <target>desire</target> <pattern>to</pattern> travel the world and experience different cultures firsthand.","translation":"這位年輕的藝術家深切渴望環遊世界並親身體驗不同的文化。","explanation":"名詞「渴望」。常用搭配：desire to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The company is ready to fulfill the customer's <target>desires</target> by providing high-quality products and excellent after-sales service.","translation":"公司準備透過提供高品質產品和卓越的售後服務來滿足客戶的需求。","explanation":"名詞「慾望、需求」。常用搭配：fulfill a desire。"},{"sentence":"If you <target>desire</target> any further information regarding the application process, please do not hesitate to contact the admissions office.","translation":"如果您渴望獲取關於申請流程的進一步資訊，請不要猶豫聯繫招生辦公室。","explanation":"動詞「渴望」。在正式書信或公告中常用於替代 want。"}],"related_forms":["desirable","desirably","desirability"]}

{"headword":"dessert","explanation":"名詞「甜點」。注意與 desert (沙漠 / 拋棄) 的拼寫區別：dessert 有兩個 s，意為甜點，通常在正餐之後食用。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the main course, the waiter brought us a delicious chocolate <target>dessert</target> that was perfectly paired with a cup of coffee.","translation":"主餐之後，服務生為我們帶來了一道美味的巧克力甜點，與一杯咖啡搭配得恰到好處。","explanation":"名詞「甜點」。"},{"sentence":"For the school party, many students decided to bring a homemade <target>dessert</target>, such as apple pie or lemon cake.","translation":"為了學校派對，許多學生決定帶來自製的甜點，例如蘋果派或檸檬蛋糕。","explanation":"名詞「甜點」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"destroy","explanation":"動詞「破壞、摧毀」。指將某物損毀到無法再使用的程度。常用搭配：destroy the environment (破壞環境), destroy evidence (毀滅證據)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The powerful earthquake <target>destroyed</target> hundreds of houses and bridges, leaving thousands of people homeless in the rural areas.","translation":"強烈地震摧毀了數百棟房屋和橋樑，使鄉下數千人無家可歸。","explanation":"動詞「摧毀」。指物理上的徹底破壞。"},{"sentence":"To protect the secret documents, the spy <target>destroyed</target> all the evidence before the police arrived at his hidden apartment.","translation":"為了保護秘密文件，間諜在警察到達他的隱蔽公寓前毀滅了所有證據。","explanation":"動詞「毀滅」。指讓資訊或證據失效。"},{"sentence":"Pollution from factories can <target>destroy</target> the natural <pattern>habitat of</pattern> wild animals, forcing them to move to other regions.","translation":"工廠的污染會破壞野生動物的自然棲息地，迫使牠們遷移到其他地區。","explanation":"動詞「破壞」。常用搭配：destroy the habitat of sth。"}],"related_forms":["destruction","destructive","destructively"]}

{"headword": "detect", "explanation": "動詞「偵測、察覺」。指利用工具或感官發現某種不容易被察覺的事物。常用搭配：detect a signal (偵測到訊號), detect a change (察覺到變化)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The security system was installed to <target>detect</target> any unauthorized entry into the building, providing an immediate alert to the police.", "translation": "安全系統的安裝是為了偵測任何未經授權進入建築物的行為，並立即向警方發出警報。", "explanation": "動詞「偵測」。"}, {"sentence": "Experienced doctors can often <target>detect</target> early signs of a disease by carefully examining the patient's symptoms and medical history.", "translation": "經驗豐富的醫生通常能透過仔細檢查病人的症狀和病史，察覺到疾病的早期跡象。", "explanation": "動詞「察覺」。指發現隱藏或微小的跡象。"}, {"sentence": "The radar system was designed to <target>detect</target> incoming missiles <pattern>from</pattern> a long distance, providing early warnings for the city.", "translation": "雷達系統旨在從遠距離偵測飛來的飛彈，為城市提供早期預警。", "explanation": "動詞「偵測」。常用搭配：detect sth from a distance。"}], "related_forms": ["detection", "detector", "detectable"]}

{"headword":"determine","explanation":"動詞「決定、確定」。可用於表示決定做某事，或透過研究/分析來確定某個事實。常用搭配：determine to do sth (決定做某事), determine the cause of (確定...的原因)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After considering all the options, the committee <target>determined</target> <pattern>to</pattern> postpone the meeting until the next Monday morning.","translation":"在考慮所有選項後，委員會決定將會議推遲到下週一早上。","explanation":"動詞「決定」。指經過思考後的決定。"},{"sentence":"The police are conducting a thorough investigation to <target>determine</target> <pattern>the cause of</pattern> the accident that happened last night.","translation":"警方正進行徹底調查，以確定昨晚發生事故的原因。","explanation":"動詞「確定」。指透過分析找出事實。"},{"sentence":"Your attitude toward learning often <target>determines</target> your academic performance, as students with a positive mindset tend to succeed more.","translation":"你對學習的態度通常決定了你的學業表現，因為心態積極的學生往往更容易成功。","explanation":"動詞「決定」。指某事是另一件事的決定因素。"}],"related_forms":["determination","determined","determinant"]}

{"headword":"devil","explanation":"名詞「惡魔」。常用於比喻或成語中，如 the devil is in the details (細節決定成敗 / 詳情中隱藏著困難)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many ancient myths, the <target>devil</target> is described as a creature with horns and a tail who tempts people to do evil.","translation":"在許多古代神話中，惡魔被描述為一個長著角和尾巴的生物，誘使人們做惡事。","explanation":"名詞「惡魔」。"},{"sentence":"The project seemed simple at first, but as the manager said, the <target>devil</target> <pattern>is in</pattern> the details, and we must be careful.","translation":"這個計畫最初看起來很簡單，但正如經理所說，魔鬼在於細節，我們必須小心。","explanation":"名詞「惡魔」。慣用語 the devil is in the details 指細節中隱藏著問題。"}],"related_forms":["devilish","devilry"]}

{"headword":"dim","explanation":"形容詞「昏暗的、模糊的」；動詞「使昏暗」。常用於描述光線不足或記憶不清。常用搭配：dim light (昏暗的光線), a dim memory (模糊的記憶)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student tried to read the textbook in the <target>dim</target> <pattern>light</pattern> of the bedroom, but his eyes began to feel tired.","translation":"學生試圖在臥室昏暗的光線下閱讀教科書，但他的眼睛開始感到疲倦。","explanation":"形容詞「昏暗的」。常用搭配：dim light。"},{"sentence":"She had only a <target>dim</target> <pattern>memory</pattern> of her childhood home because she had moved to a different city when she was three.","translation":"她對童年的家只有模糊的記憶，因為她在三歲時就搬到了另一個城市。","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的」。常用搭配：a dim memory。"},{"sentence":"To create a more relaxing atmosphere, the waiter <target>dimmed</target> the lights in the restaurant before the romantic dinner started.","translation":"為了營造更輕鬆的氛圍，服務生在浪漫晚餐開始前將餐廳的燈光調暗。","explanation":"動詞「將...調暗」。"}],"related_forms":["dimly","dimness"]}

{"headword":"dime","explanation":"名詞「十分美分硬幣」。美國貨幣單位，價值為 10 美分。","entries":[{"sentence":"He searched through his pockets and found only a single <target>dime</target>, which was not enough to buy a bottle of water.","translation":"他搜遍口袋，只發現了一枚十分美分硬幣，不足以買一瓶水。","explanation":"名詞「十分美分硬幣」。"},{"sentence":"The phrase 'not a dime' is often used to emphasize that someone has absolutely no money at all, such as when they are broke.","translation":"片語 'not a dime' 常用來強調某人完全沒有錢，例如當他們破產時。","explanation":"名詞「十分美分硬幣」。在此處指極小額的錢。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "dine", "explanation": "動詞「用餐」。比 eat 更正式，通常指正餐（尤其是晚餐）。常用搭配：dine out (在外面用餐), fine dining (高級餐飲)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many couples prefer to <target>dine</target> <pattern>out</pattern> at a fancy restaurant on their anniversary to celebrate their love and enjoy special food.", "translation": "許多夫婦喜歡在週年紀念日去高級餐廳外面用餐，以慶祝他們的愛情並享用特別的美食。", "explanation": "動詞片語 dine out 表「在外面用餐」。"}, {"sentence": "The hotel provides a luxury <target>dining</target> experience for its guests, offering dishes from around the world prepared by top chefs.", "translation": "這家酒店為客人提供豪華的用餐體驗，提供由頂級廚師準備的來自世界各地的菜餚。", "explanation": "名詞/形容詞用法。dining experience 指「用餐體驗」。"}], "related_forms": ["dinner", "dining"]}

{"headword":"dinosaur","explanation":"名詞「恐龍」。除了指史前生物，也可比喻指過時的人或事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the natural history museum, the students admired the massive <target>dinosaurs</target> skeletons, learning about how they lived millions of years ago.","translation":"在自然歷史博物館中，學生們欣賞巨大的恐龍骨架，學習牠們在數百萬年前如何生活。","explanation":"名詞「恐龍」。"},{"sentence":"The old professor, who refused to use computers or the internet, was considered a <target>dinosaur</target> by his younger colleagues.","translation":"那位拒絕使用電腦或網路的年老教授被他的年輕同事認為是一個過時的人。","explanation":"名詞「恐龍」。在此處比喻指「過時的人」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"dip","explanation":"動詞「浸、蘸」或「短暫下降」；名詞「浸蘸」或「下降/凹陷」。在 GSAT 中，常考 dip into (動詞片語：隨機抽取、花用儲蓄) 或 a dip in (名詞：某數值的下降)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To make the dessert more flavorful, you should <target>dip</target> the apple slices <pattern>into</pattern> the melted chocolate and sprinkle some nuts on top.","translation":"為了讓甜點更有風味，你應該將蘋果片蘸入融化的巧克力中，並在上面撒一些堅果。","explanation":"動詞「蘸、浸」。常用搭配：dip sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"The company noticed a sudden <target>dip</target> <pattern>in</pattern> sales during the winter months, which forced them to rethink their marketing strategy.","translation":"公司注意到冬季月份銷售額突然下降，這迫使他們重新思考行銷策略。","explanation":"名詞「下降」。常用搭配：a dip in sth。"},{"sentence":"Since he had spent too much money on travel, he had to <target>dip</target> <pattern>into</pattern> his emergency savings to pay the rent.","translation":"由於他在旅行上花太多錢，他必須動用緊急儲蓄來支付房租。","explanation":"動詞片語 dip into sth 意為「動用（儲蓄）」或「隨意翻閱」。"},{"sentence":"After a long hike under the hot sun, the students decided to take a quick <target>dip</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the cool mountain stream.","translation":"在烈日下長途健行後，學生們決定在涼爽的山溪中快速游泳。","explanation":"名詞「短時間的游泳」。常用搭配：take a dip in sth。"}],"related_forms":["dipped","dipping"]}

{"headword":"dirt","explanation":"名詞「污垢、泥土」。注意與 dust (灰塵) 的區別：dirt 通常指較髒的污垢或土壤，而 dust 是指細小的乾粉末。在比喻用法中， dirt can also mean scandalous information (醜聞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before entering the house, the children were asked to wipe the <target>dirt</target> <pattern>off</pattern> their shoes to keep the living room clean.","translation":"進入房子之前，孩子們被要求擦掉鞋上的泥土，以保持客廳清潔。","explanation":"名詞「泥土、污垢」。常用搭配：wipe dirt off sth。"},{"sentence":"The gardener spent the entire afternoon removing <target>dirt</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the flower beds to ensure the plants had enough room to grow.","translation":"園丁花了一個下午的時間清除花床上的污垢，以確保植物有足夠的生長空間。","explanation":"名詞「泥土」。"},{"sentence":"The reporter tried to find some <target>dirt</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the politician to reveal his secrets and expose his dishonest behavior to the public.","translation":"記者試圖挖掘政治家的醜聞，以揭露他的秘密並將其不誠實的行為公之於眾。","explanation":"名詞「醜聞」。常用搭配：find dirt on someone。"}],"related_forms":["dirty"]}

{"headword":"discount","explanation":"名詞「折扣」；動詞「打折」或「不予考慮/輕視」。名詞用法常見於購物情境；動詞用法在 GSAT 中較少見，但指「認為...不重要而忽略」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The store is offering a twenty percent <target>discount</target> <pattern>on</pattern> all winter clothing to attract more customers before the season ends.","translation":"商店對所有冬季衣物提供百分之二十的折扣，以便在季節結束前吸引更多顧客。","explanation":"名詞「折扣」。常用搭配：a discount on sth。"},{"sentence":"Students can get a special <target>discount</target> <pattern>by</pattern> showing their student ID card when purchasing textbooks from the university bookstore.","translation":"學生在大學書店購買教科書時，憑學生證可獲得特別折扣。","explanation":"名詞「折扣」。"},{"sentence":"The manager decided to <target>discount</target> the old inventory to clear space for the new arrivals coming in next month.","translation":"經理決定對舊庫存打折，以便為下個月到貨的新品騰出空間。","explanation":"動詞「打折」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the evidence, the judge decided to <target>discount</target> the witness's testimony because it seemed inconsistent and unreliable.","translation":"儘管有證據，法官決定不予考慮證人的證詞，因為這看起來不一致且不可靠。","explanation":"動詞「不予考慮、輕視」。指將某事視為不重要而忽略。"}],"related_forms":["discounted"]}

{"headword":"dishonest","explanation":"形容詞「不誠實的」。常與 be dishonest about sth (對某事不誠實) 搭配。與 honest 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students that being <target>dishonest</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their homework would lead to a failing grade and a meeting with parents.","translation":"老師警告學生，對作業不誠實將導致不及格的分數以及與家長的會面。","explanation":"形容詞「不誠實的」。常用搭配：be dishonest about sth。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>dishonest</target> to take credit for work that you did not do, as it is unfair to those who actually contributed.","translation":"將自己沒做的工作據為己有是不誠實的，因為這對真正做出貢獻的人不公平。","explanation":"形容詞「不誠實的」。"}],"related_forms":["dishonesty","dishonestly"]}

{"headword": "disk", "explanation": "名詞「圓盤、磁碟」。在現代英語中，disk 通常指磁性儲存裝置 (如 hard disk) 而 disc 通常指光學儲存裝置 (如 CD, DVD) 或解剖學上的椎間盤 (spinal disc)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The computer technician explained that the <target>disk</target> drive was damaged, which is why the student could not access his saved files.", "translation": "電腦技術員解釋說，磁碟機損壞了，這就是為什麼學生無法讀取他儲存的文件。", "explanation": "名詞「磁碟」。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor told the patient that a slipped <target>disc</target> in his lower back was causing the severe pain in his legs.", "translation": "醫生告訴病人，他腰部的一個椎間盤突出導致了他的腿部劇痛。", "explanation": "名詞「椎間盤」。指脊椎之間的軟骨盤。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"dislike","explanation":"動詞「不喜歡」；名詞「厭惡、不喜歡」。常用搭配：dislike doing sth (不喜歡做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although she loves reading novels, she <target>dislikes</target> <pattern>reading</pattern> technical manuals because they are too boring and difficult to understand.","translation":"雖然她喜歡讀小說，但她不喜歡讀技術手冊，因為它們太無聊且難以理解。","explanation":"動詞「不喜歡」。常用搭配：dislike doing sth。"},{"sentence":"The two students have many similarities, but their <target>dislike</target> <pattern>of</pattern> spicy food is the only thing they truly agree on.","translation":"這兩個學生有很多相似之處，但他們對辛辣食物的厭惡是唯一他們真正同意的事情。","explanation":"名詞「厭惡」。常用搭配：dislike of sth。"}],"related_forms":["disliked"]}

{"headword":"ditch","explanation":"名詞「溝渠」；動詞「拋棄、放棄」。動詞用法在口語中非常常見，指突然停止與某人往來或放棄某個計劃。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer dug a deep <target>ditch</target> <pattern>along</pattern> the edge of the field to prevent rainwater from flooding the crops.","translation":"農夫在田邊挖了一條深溝，以防止雨水淹沒農作物。","explanation":"名詞「溝渠」。"},{"sentence":"After realizing that the project was too difficult to complete, the team decided to <target>ditch</target> their original plan and start over.","translation":"在意識到該項目太難以完成後，團隊決定放棄原計劃並重新開始。","explanation":"動詞「放棄、拋棄」。指放棄一個計劃或想法。"},{"sentence":"He decided to <target>ditch</target> his old textbooks and donate them to the library to make more space in his bedroom.","translation":"他決定扔掉他的舊教科書並將它們捐給圖書館，以便在臥室裡騰出更多空間。","explanation":"動詞「拋棄、扔掉」。"}],"related_forms":["ditched"]}

{"headword":"dive","explanation":"動詞「潛水、跳水」或「猛然下降」；名詞「潛水、跳水」。常用片語 dive into (深入研究/投入)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the summer vacation, the students learned how to <target>dive</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the deep ocean to observe colorful coral reefs and exotic fish.","translation":"在暑假期間，學生們學習如何潛入深海，以觀察色彩繽紛的珊瑚礁和奇異的魚類。","explanation":"動詞「潛水」。常用搭配：dive into sth。"},{"sentence":"The athlete performed a perfect <target>dive</target> from the ten-meter platform, earning a high score from all the judges.","translation":"該運動員從十米跳台上完成了一次完美的跳水，贏得了所有裁判的高分。","explanation":"名詞「跳水」。"},{"sentence":"Before the final exam, the students decided to <target>dive</target> <pattern>into</pattern> their history books to study the causes of the French Revolution.","translation":"在期末考前，學生們決定深入研究他們的歷史書，以研究法國大革命的原因。","explanation":"動詞片語 dive into sth 意為「深入研究」或「投入」。"},{"sentence":"Investors became nervous when they saw the stock market <target>dive</target> after the news of the economic crisis was announced.","translation":"當投資者看到經濟危機的消息公布後股市猛跌時，他們感到緊張。","explanation":"動詞「猛然下降」。指數值或價格的快速下跌。"}],"related_forms":["dived","dived"]}

{"headword":"dizzy","explanation":"形容詞「暈的」。常用於描述生理上的暈眩（如 dizziness）或比喻上的眼花繚亂。","entries":[{"sentence":"After spinning around in circles for a few minutes, the young child felt <target>dizzy</target> and had to sit down to recover.","translation":"在轉圈圈幾分鐘後，這個小孩感到暈眩，不得不坐下來恢復。","explanation":"形容詞「暈的」。"},{"sentence":"The student felt <target>dizzy</target> because he had not eaten breakfast and had spent too many hours studying in a poorly ventilated room.","translation":"該學生感到暈眩，因為他沒吃早餐，且在通風不良的房間裡學習了太多小時。","explanation":"形容詞「暈的」。"}],"related_forms":["dizziness","dizzily"]}

{"headword":"dock","explanation":"名詞「碼頭」；動詞「停泊」或「對接」。常用於船舶或太空船的對接。","entries":[{"sentence":"The large cruise ship slowly <target>docked</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the harbor, and hundreds of tourists eagerly waited to disembark and explore the city.","translation":"大型郵輪緩緩停泊在港口，，數百名遊客急切地等待下船並探索城市。","explanation":"動詞「停泊」。常用搭配：dock at sth。"},{"sentence":"The fishermen returned to the <target>dock</target> <pattern>before</pattern> sunset, unloading their fresh catch of the day into crates for the market.","translation":"漁民在日落前回到碼頭，將當天捕獲的新鮮魚類卸入板條箱準備運往市場。","explanation":"名詞「碼頭」。"},{"sentence":"The astronauts spent several hours carefully maneuvering their spacecraft to <target>dock</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the International Space Station.","translation":"太空人花了幾個小時小心地操作他們的太空船，以與國際太空站對接。","explanation":"動詞「對接」。常用搭配：dock with sth。"}],"related_forms":["docked","docking"]}

{"headword":"dolphin","explanation":"名詞「海豚」。常見於環境保護或動物行為相關的閱讀測驗中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The marine biologist spent years studying how <target>dolphin</target>s communicate with each other using high-frequency sounds and clicks.","translation":"海洋生物學家花了好幾年研究海豚如何利用高頻聲音和喀噠聲相互溝通。","explanation":"名詞「海豚」。"},{"sentence":"Many tourists enjoy swimming with wild <target>dolphin</target>s in the ocean, but experts warn that this may disrupt their natural behavior.","translation":"許多遊客喜歡在海洋中與野生海豚一起游泳，但專家警告這可能會干擾牠們的自然行為。","explanation":"名詞「海豚」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"donkey","explanation":"名詞「驢子」。常用於描述傳統交通工具或寓言故事中。","entries":[{"sentence":"In some remote mountain villages, farmers still use a <target>donkey</target> to carry heavy bags of grain up the steep paths.","translation":"在一些偏遠的山村，農民仍然使用驢子將沉重的穀物袋沿著陡峭的小徑運上去。","explanation":"名詞「驢子」。"},{"sentence":"The young boy loved the <target>donkey</target> at the local petting zoo, feeding it carrots and brushing its grey fur.","translation":"小男孩很喜歡當地寵物動物園裡的那隻驢子，餵它吃胡蘿蔔並刷牠的灰色毛。","explanation":"名詞「驢子」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "dose", "explanation": "名詞「劑量」；動詞「給藥」。最常見於醫療或健康主題。注意 dose 與 dosage 的區別：dose 指單次給藥的量，dosage 指給藥的劑量方案（頻率與總量）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The doctor told the patient to take a small <target>dose</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the medicine twice a day to avoid any side effects.", "translation": "醫生告訴病人每天服用兩次小劑量的藥物，以避免任何副作用。", "explanation": "名詞「劑量」。常用搭配：a dose of sth。"}, {"sentence": "If you accidentally take an overdose <target>of</target> the medication, you should contact emergency services immediately for medical help.", "translation": "如果你不小心服用過量的藥物，你應該立即聯繫緊急救援服務以尋求醫療幫助。", "explanation": "名詞「劑量」。常用搭配：overdose (過量)。"}, {"sentence": "The nurse carefully <target>dosed</target> the patient with the correct amount of antibiotic to treat the infection effectively.", "translation": "護理師小心地為病人給予正確劑量的抗生素以有效治療感染。", "explanation": "動詞「給藥」。"}], "related_forms": ["dosage"]}

{"headword":"doubtful","explanation":"形容詞「懷疑的；不確定的」。常用於表達對某事能否發生或是否真實的懷疑。常用搭配 be doubtful about/of sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many teachers are <target>doubtful</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the effectiveness of using tablets in every classroom, fearing it might distract students from learning.","translation":"許多老師對在每個教室使用平板電腦的成效表示懷疑，擔心這可能會讓學生分心而無法學習。","explanation":"形容詞「懷疑的」。常用搭配：be doubtful about sth。"},{"sentence":"The weather forecast is <target>doubtful</target>, so we should prepare an alternative plan in case it rains during the school sports day.","translation":"天氣預報不確定，所以我們應該準備一個替代方案，以防在學校運動會期間下雨。","explanation":"形容詞「不確定的」。"},{"sentence":"The manager remained <target>doubtful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new employee's ability to handle the project independently without any supervision.","translation":"經理對新員工能獨立處理該專案而無需任何監督的能力仍持懷疑態度。","explanation":"形容詞「懷疑的」。常用搭配：be doubtful of sth。"}],"related_forms":["doubt","doubtlessly"]}

{"headword":"doughnut","explanation":"名詞「甜甜圈」。常見於日常飲食或美國文化描述中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student bought a chocolate <target>doughnut</target> and a cup of hot coffee for a quick breakfast before his first class started.","translation":"學生在第一堂課開始前買了一個巧克力甜甜圈和一杯熱咖啡作為快速早餐。","explanation":"名詞「甜甜圈」。"},{"sentence":"For the bake sale, the girls prepared a platter of colorful <target>doughnuts</target> with different toppings like sprinkles and powdered sugar.","translation":"為了義賣活動，女孩們準備了一盤五顏六色的甜甜圈，配有像彩色糖粒和糖粉等不同的配料。","explanation":"名詞「甜甜圈」。"}],"related_forms":[]}
