{"headword":"downtown","explanation":"形容詞、副詞或名詞，意為「市中心」。作為副詞時，前面不需要加 to (例如 go downtown)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After school, many students like to go <target>downtown</target> to visit the bookstores and enjoy the trendy cafes in the city center.","translation":"放學後，許多學生喜歡去市中心逛書店並享受市中心時髦的咖啡店。","explanation":"副詞「去市中心」。注意 go downtown 不需要加 to。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to move its main office to a <target>downtown</target> <pattern>location</pattern> to be closer to other major businesses.","translation":"公司決定將其總公司搬遷到市中心的位置，以便更靠近其他主要企業。","explanation":"形容詞「市中心的」。常用搭配：downtown location。"},{"sentence":"The traffic in <target>downtown</target> is usually very heavy during rush hour, making it difficult for drivers to find parking spaces.","translation":"市中心的交通通常在尖峰時段非常擁擠，使得駕駛者很難找到停車位。","explanation":"名詞「市中心」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"drag","explanation":"動詞「拖；拉」；名詞「累贅；乏味的事」。動詞用法中，drag sth along 或 drag on (拖延) 是常見考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tired hiker had to <target>drag</target> his heavy suitcase <pattern>along</pattern> the sandy beach because there were no taxis available.","translation":"疲憊的登山客不得不沿著沙灘拖著他的沉重行李箱，因為當時沒有可用的計程車。","explanation":"動詞「拖；拉」。常用搭配：drag sth along。"},{"sentence":"The professor's lecture was so boring that it seemed to <target>drag</target> <pattern>on</pattern> for hours, even though it was only forty minutes.","translation":"教授的講座如此無聊，以至於即使只有四十分鐘，感覺卻像是拖了幾個小時之久。","explanation":"動詞片語 drag on 表「拖延，時間過得慢」。"},{"sentence":"Cleaning the entire house every Saturday morning is such a <target>drag</target>, but my parents insist that it is necessary for hygiene.","translation":"每個星期六早晨清理整個房子真是太累人了，但我父母堅持認為這對於衛生是必要的。","explanation":"名詞「累贅；乏味的事」。指一件令人厭煩且缺乏興趣的事。"}],"related_forms":["dragged","dragging"]}

{"headword":"dragonfly","explanation":"名詞「蜻蜓」。常見於自然科學描述或生態環境主題。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children watched a bright blue <target>dragonfly</target> hover over the pond, waiting for the perfect moment to catch a small insect.","translation":"孩子們看著一隻亮藍色的蜻蜓在池塘上空盤旋，等待著捕捉小昆蟲的完美時機。","explanation":"名詞「蜻蜓」。"},{"sentence":"In many cultures, the <target>dragonfly</target> is seen as a symbol of change and transformation, representing the beauty of nature's cycles.","translation":"在許多文化中，蜻蜓被視為改變和轉型的象徵，代表著自然循環之美。","explanation":"名詞「蜻蜓」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "drain", "explanation": "動詞「排乾；耗盡」；名詞「排水管」。動詞用法中，drain of sth 或 drain one's energy 是常見考點。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The plumber came to fix the clogged <target>drain</target> in the kitchen sink, which had been leaking water for several days.", "translation": "水電工來修理廚房水槽中堵塞的排水管，該水管已經漏水好幾天了。", "explanation": "名詞「排水管」。"}, {"sentence": "After the heavy rain, the city's drainage system failed to <target>drain</target> the water <pattern>from</pattern> the streets quickly enough.", "translation": "大雨之後，城市的排水系統未能快速地將街道上的積水排乾。", "explanation": "動詞「排乾」。常用搭配：drain sth from sth。"}, {"sentence": "Working ten hours a day without any break is a huge <target>drain</target> <pattern>on</pattern> a student's mental and physical energy.", "translation": "一天工作工作十小時且沒有任何休息，對一個學生的心智和身體能量是巨大的消耗。", "explanation": "名詞「消耗」。常用搭配：a drain on sth。"}], "related_forms": ["drainage"]}

{"headword": "dramatic", "explanation": "形容詞「劇烈的；戲劇性的」。常用於描述變化、影響或表演。注意與 drama (名詞) 的區別，dramatic 側重於於描述事物的性質，如 a dramatic increase (劇烈增加)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new government policy led to a <target>dramatic</target> increase in the number of tourists visiting the city each year.", "translation": "新政府政策導致每年造訪該市的遊客數量劇烈增加。", "explanation": "形容詞「劇烈的」。"}, {"sentence": "The actor gave a <target>dramatic</target> performance on stage, using powerful emotions and a loud voice to capture the audience's attention.", "translation": "演員在舞台上帶來了戲劇性的表演，運用強烈的情感和洪亮的聲音來吸引觀眾的注意力。", "explanation": "形容詞「戲劇性的」。"}], "related_forms": ["dramatically", "drama"]}

{"headword":"drip","explanation":"名詞「滴水」；動詞「滴下」。常考用法：a drip of water (一滴水)；drip-feed (滴注)。注意與 drop (掉落/水滴) 的區別：drip 強調的是液體緩慢且持續地落下，而 drop 則是指單個水滴或快速的落下動作。","entries":[{"sentence":"She could not sleep because she kept hearing the steady <target>drip</target> <pattern>of</pattern> water from the leaky faucet in the bathroom.","translation":"她無法入睡，因為她一直聽到浴室漏水水龍頭持續的滴水聲。","explanation":"名詞「滴水」。指液體緩慢且持續落下的聲音或動作。"},{"sentence":"The ice cream started to <target>drip</target> <pattern>down</pattern> his hand as the weather became warmer, making a sticky mess on the floor.","translation":"隨著天氣變暖，冰淇淋開始沿著他的手滴下，在地板上留下了黏膩的污漬。","explanation":"動詞「滴下」。常用搭配 drip down (滴下)。"}],"related_forms":["drips","dripping"]}

{"headword":"drown","explanation":"動詞「淹死；使淹死」。指人在水中沒入而死亡。常考片語：drown out (掩蓋聲音)。注意與 sink (下沉) 的區別：drown 指的是生物因缺氧而死亡，而 sink 則是指物體或生物沒入水中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lifeguard jumped into the swimming pool to save the child who was <target>drowning</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the deep end.","translation":"救生員跳入游泳池中，救出在深水區快要淹死的孩子。","explanation":"動詞「淹死」。常用搭配 drown in sth。"},{"sentence":"The loud music from the nearby party <target>drowned</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the conversation, making it impossible for the students to hear the teacher's instructions.","translation":"附近派對的大聲音樂掩蓋了對話，使學生們無法聽到老師的指示。","explanation":"動詞片語 drown out 意為「掩蓋聲音」。"}],"related_forms":["drowned","drowning"]}

{"headword":"drugstore","explanation":"名詞「藥局」。在美式英語中，drugstore 常指包含藥品和日常雜貨的綜合店面。在英式英語中，通常使用 chemist's 或 pharmacy。","entries":[{"sentence":"On her way home from school, she stopped at the <target>drugstore</target> to buy some bandages and vitamin C tablets for her cold.","translation":"在放學回家的路上，她在藥局買了一些繃帶和維生素 C 片來治療感冒。","explanation":"名詞「藥局」。指銷售藥品和個人護理產品的商店。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"drunk","explanation":"形容詞「醉的」；名詞「醉漢」。常用搭配：get drunk (喝醉), feel drunk (感覺喝醉)。注意與 drink (喝) 的區別：drunk 是 drink 的過去分詞形式，但在這裡作為形容詞使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The man was so <target>drunk</target> that he could not even stand up straight, causing him to stumble into the street.","translation":"這個男人醉得如此厲害，以至於他甚至無法直立站穩，導致他跌跌撞撞地走進街道。","explanation":"形容詞「醉的」。描述一個人喝了過量酒精後的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The neighbors complained about the <target>drunk</target> who kept shouting loudly in the middle of the night, disturbing everyone's sleep.","translation":"鄰居們抱怨那個半夜一直大聲叫喊的醉漢，擾亂了所有人的睡眠。","explanation":"名詞「醉漢」。指長期酗酒或目前處於醉酒狀態的人。"}],"related_forms":["drunkenness"]}

{"headword":"dumb","explanation":"形容詞「啞的；愚蠢的」。在正式語境中指不能說話；在非正式語境中常用於描述一個人很笨。注意：在現代英語中，使用 dumb 描述一個人愚蠢時應謹慎，因為這可能被視為不禮貌。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student felt <target>dumb</target> after making a simple mistake on the math test, although the teacher told him not to worry.","translation":"儘管老師告訴他不要擔心，但這名學生在數學考試中犯了一個簡單的錯誤後感到很笨。","explanation":"形容詞「愚蠢的」。常用於非正式語境。"},{"sentence":"In the old movie, the character was <target>dumb</target> and had to use sign language to communicate with other people in the village.","translation":"在一部舊電影中，這個角色是啞的，必須使用手語與村裡的其他人交流。","explanation":"形容詞「啞的」。指生理上無法說話。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"dump","explanation":"動詞「傾倒；丟棄；甩掉」；名詞「垃圾場」。動詞用法中，dump something on someone 意為「將責任或工作丟給某人」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The factory was fined for trying to <target>dump</target> toxic waste <pattern>into</pattern> the river, which seriously polluted the local drinking water.","translation":"這間工廠因試圖將有毒廢物傾倒入河而被處罰，這嚴重污染了當地的飲用水。","explanation":"動詞「傾倒」。常用搭配 dump sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"She felt betrayed when her boyfriend decided to <target>dump</target> her <pattern>via</pattern> a text message, which she found extremely rude.","translation":"當她的男朋友決定透過簡訊將她甩掉時，她感到被背叛，她認為這樣做非常沒禮貌。","explanation":"動詞「甩掉」。指在感情關係中突然結束關係。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to build a new <target>dump</target> on the outskirts of town to handle the increasing amount of household trash.","translation":"市議會決定在鎮外建立一個新的垃圾場，以處理日益增加的家用垃圾量。","explanation":"名詞「垃圾場」。指存放廢棄物的地點。"}],"related_forms":["dumped","dumping"]}

{"headword":"dumpling","explanation":"名詞「餃子；丸子」。指將餡料包裹在麵皮中蒸、煮或炸而成的食物。在不同文化中，dumpling 的定義略有不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the Lunar New Year, many families gather together to make <target>dumplings</target>, which symbolize wealth and prosperity in Chinese culture.","translation":"在農曆新年期間，許多家庭聚集在一起包餃子，這在中國文化中象徵著財富和繁榮。","explanation":"名詞「餃子」。"}],"related_forms":["dumplings"]}

{"headword":"dust","explanation":"名詞「灰塵」；動詞「除塵；撒粉」。注意：dust 可作為動詞時，有兩種相反的 meanings：一是 remove dust (除塵)，二是 sprinkle dust/powder (撒粉)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old books in the library were covered in <target>dust</target>, as they had not been read for many years.","translation":"圖書館裡的舊書上覆蓋著灰塵，因為它們多年來沒有被閱讀過。","explanation":"名詞「灰塵」。"},{"sentence":"Every Saturday morning, she spends an hour <target>dusting</target> the furniture in the living room to keep the house clean and tidy.","translation":"每個星期六早上，她花一小時擦拭客廳的家具以保持房屋乾淨整潔。","explanation":"動詞「除塵」。指清除灰塵的動作。"},{"sentence":"The baker <target>dusted</target> the cake <pattern>with</pattern> powdered sugar to give it a professional and delicious look before serving.","translation":"糕點師在送餐前在蛋糕上撒了糖粉，使其看起來專業且美味。","explanation":"動詞「撒粉」。常用搭配 dust sth with sth。"}],"related_forms":["dusty","duster"]}

{"headword": "eager", "explanation": "形容詞「渴望的；熱切的」。常用搭配：be eager to V (渴望做某事), be eager for sth (渴望某事)。注意與 keen 的區別：eager 強調的是一種強烈的願望或興奮感，而 keen 則側重於熱衷於某之類的事物或能力。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students were <target>eager</target> <pattern>to</pattern> hear the results of the science competition, as they had worked hard for months.", "translation": "學生們渴望聽到科學競賽的結果，因為他們已經努力工作了數月。", "explanation": "形容詞「渴望的」。常用搭配 be eager to V。"}, {"sentence": "Fresh graduates are often <target>eager</target> <pattern>for</pattern> new opportunities to gain professional experience and build their careers in the competitive job market.", "translation": "社會新鮮人通常渴望獲得新機會，以便在競爭激烈的就業市場中獲得專業經驗並建立職業生涯。", "explanation": "形容詞「熱切的」。常用搭配 be eager for sth。"}], "related_forms": ["eagerly", "eagerness"]}

{"headword":"echo","explanation":"名詞「回聲」；動詞「回響；共鳴」。動詞用法中，echo someone's sentiments 意為「認同某人的想法」。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the hikers shouted into the deep valley, they heard a loud <target>echo</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their own voices bouncing back from the mountains.","translation":"當登山客向深谷大聲叫喊時，他們聽到自己的聲音從山間回盪回來，形成巨大的回聲。","explanation":"名詞「回聲」。常用搭配 an echo of sth。"},{"sentence":"The empty hall <target>echoed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the sound of her footsteps, creating a mysterious and lonely atmosphere in the building.","translation":"空蕩蕩的大廳裡迴響著她的腳步聲，在建築物中營造出一種神秘而孤單的 atmosphere。","explanation":"動詞「回響」。常用搭配 echo with sth。"},{"sentence":"The politician's speech <target>echoed</target> the <pattern>sentiments</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> many young voters who were concerned about the environment and social justice.","translation":"這位政治家的演講認同了許多關注環境和社會正義的年輕選民的想法。","explanation":"動詞「共鳴」。指認同或重複某人的觀點或想法。"}],"related_forms":["echoes","echoed","echoing"]}

{"headword":"edit","explanation":"動詞「編輯、修改」。指對文字、影像或音訊進行修正、刪除或重新安排，以使其更準確或更適合發表。常用搭配：edit a manuscript (編輯原稿), edit out (刪除)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student spent several hours <target>editing</target> her final essay to correct grammar mistakes and improve the flow of her arguments.","translation":"這名學生花了幾個小時修改她的期末論文，以修正語法錯誤並提高論點的流暢度。","explanation":"動詞「編輯、修改」。指對文章進行修正。"},{"sentence":"The film director decided to <target>edit</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the boring parts of the movie to make the story more exciting for the audience.","translation":"電影導演決定刪除電影中枯燥的部分，使故事對觀眾來說更刺激。","explanation":"動詞片語 edit out 表示「刪除」。"}],"related_forms":["editor","editing"]}

{"headword":"editor","explanation":"名詞「編輯」。指負責檢查、修改並批准文章或影像發表的人。常用搭配：chief editor (總編輯), copy editor (文字編輯)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>editor</target> of the school magazine suggested that the writer should add more photos to make the article more appealing to students.","translation":"校刊編輯建議作者應增加更多照片，使文章對學生更有吸引力。","explanation":"名詞「編輯」。指負責修改文章的人。"},{"sentence":"After several rounds of revisions, the <target>editor</target> <pattern>in</pattern> <pattern>chief</pattern> finally approved the manuscript for publication in the prestigious journal.","translation":"經過幾輪修改，總編輯終於批准將該原稿發表在該知名期刊上。","explanation":"名詞「編輯」。editor in chief 指「總編輯」。"}],"related_forms":["edit","editorial"]}

{"headword":"educate","explanation":"動詞「教育、培育」。指透過教學、訓練或經驗使人獲得知識或技能。常用搭配：educate someone in (在某方面教育某人), be educated in (受過...教育)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government aims to <target>educate</target> the public <pattern>about</pattern> the importance of recycling to protect the environment for future generations.","translation":"政府旨在教育大眾關於回收利用的重要性，以保護後代子孫的環境。","explanation":"動詞「教育」。常用搭配：educate someone about something。"},{"sentence":"Many students who were <target>educated</target> <pattern>in</pattern> European universities often bring back diverse perspectives and new academic approaches to their home countries.","translation":"許多在歐洲大學受過教育的學生經常將多元的視角和新的學術方法帶回他們的家鄉。","explanation":"動詞「教育」。被動語態 be educated in... 指「在某處/某方面受教育」。"}],"related_forms":["education","educational"]}

{"headword":"educational","explanation":"形容詞「教育的、有教育意義的」。指與教育過程相關，或能讓人學習到知識或道理的事物。常用搭配：educational toys (教育玩具), educational background (教育背景)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Visiting the science museum was a highly <target>educational</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> for the children, as they learned about physics through interactive exhibits.","translation":"參觀科學博物館對孩子們來說是一次非常有教育意義的體驗，因為他們透過互動展品學習物理學。","explanation":"形容詞「有教育意義的」。"},{"sentence":"When applying for a scholarship, students must provide a detailed description of their <target>educational</target> <pattern>background</pattern>, including the schools they attended.","translation":"申請獎學金時，學生必須提供詳細的教育背景描述，包括他們就讀的學校。","explanation":"形容詞「教育的」。常用搭配：educational background (教育背景)。"}],"related_forms":["educate","education"]}

{"headword":"efficient","explanation":"形容詞「有效率的」。指在達成目標時能最小化時間、精力的浪費。注意與 effective (有效的) 之區別：efficient 強調的是過程的效率，而 effective 強調的是結果的達成。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new software is more <target>efficient</target> <pattern>at</pattern> processing large amounts of data, allowing the researchers to finish their work faster.","translation":"這款新軟體在處理大量數據方面更有效率，讓研究人員能更快完成工作。","explanation":"形容詞「有效率的」。常用搭配：efficient at V-ing。"},{"sentence":"To be more <target>efficient</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their study habits, students are encouraged to use a planner to organize their daily tasks and deadlines.","translation":"為了讓學習習慣更有效率，學生被鼓勵使用計畫表來組織他們的每日任務和截止日期。","explanation":"形容詞「有效率的」。常用搭配：efficient in something。"}],"related_forms":["efficiency","efficiently"]}

{"headword":"elbow","explanation":"名詞「肘部」；動詞「用肘推開」。名詞用法簡單，動詞用法常出現在描述擁擠場景中，表示強行擠進或推開他人。","entries":[{"sentence":"He accidentally hit his <target>elbow</target> against the edge of the desk while reaching for his notebook, causing a sharp pain.","translation":"他在伸手拿筆記本時，不小心用肘部撞到了桌緣，造成劇痛。","explanation":"名詞「肘部」。"},{"sentence":"The crowd was so dense that the fans had to <target>elbow</target> <pattern>their way</pattern> <pattern>through</pattern> the audience to get closer to the stage.","translation":"人群如此密集，以至於粉絲們必須用肘推開人群，才能走近舞台。","explanation":"動詞「用肘推開」。常用搭配：elbow one's way through... (強行擠過...)"}],"related_forms":["elbows"]}

{"headword":"elderly","explanation":"形容詞「年長的」。是一種比 old 更委婉、更有禮貌的表達方式。常用於描述老年人或與老年人相關的服務。常考搭配：the elderly (老年人總稱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local community center offers various free classes for the <target>elderly</target>, such as painting and yoga, to keep them active and social.","translation":"當地社區中心為年長者提供各種免費課程，如繪畫和瑜伽，以讓他們保持活躍並社交。","explanation":"形容詞「有禮貌地稱呼年長者。the elderly 指「老年人」總稱。"},{"sentence":"It is important to show respect and patience when communicating with <target>elderly</target> <pattern>people</pattern>, as some may have difficulty hearing or speaking.","translation":"在與年長者溝通時，表現出尊重和耐心是很重要的，因為有些人可能在聽力或說話方面有困難。","explanation":"形容詞「年長的」。常用搭配：elderly people。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"elect","explanation":"動詞「選舉、選出」；形容詞「候選的、選定但尚未就任的」。動詞常用搭配：elect someone as (選某人為...)，形容詞常置於名詞後方。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students in the class voted to <target>elect</target> Kevin <pattern>as</pattern> the class president because of his leadership skills and kindness.","translation":"班上的學生投票選出 Kevin 作為班長，因為他的領導能力和親切感。","explanation":"動詞「選出」。常用搭配：elect someone as something。"},{"sentence":"The <target>elect</target> president gave a short speech to the press, explaining his plans for the country before officially taking office.","translation":"候任總統向媒體發表了一篇短暫的演講，解釋他在正式就職前的國家計畫。","explanation":"形容詞「候任的」。指已被選中但尚未就職的人。"}],"related_forms":["election","elective"]}

{"headword":"election","explanation":"名詞「選舉」。指透過投票選擇代表或領導者的過程。常用搭配：general election (大選), hold an election (舉行選舉), win the election (贏得選舉)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university will <pattern>hold</pattern> an <target>election</target> next month to choose a new student council representative for the campus.","translation":"大學將在下個月舉行一次選舉，以選出校園的新學生會代表。","explanation":"名詞「選舉」。常用搭配：hold an election (舉行選舉)。"},{"sentence":"After weeks of intense campaigning, the candidate finally <pattern>won</pattern> the <target>election</target>, promising to improve the public transportation system.","translation":"經過數週激烈的競選，該候選人終於贏得了選舉，承諾將改善大眾運輸系統。","explanation":"名詞「選舉」。常用搭配：win the election (贏得選舉)。"}],"related_forms":["elect"]}

{"headword":"electricity","explanation":"名詞「電力、電」。指一種能量形式，用於驅動電器或照明。常用搭配：electricity bill (電費), cut off electricity (切斷電力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the severe thunderstorm last night, the city experienced a power outage, and the <target>electricity</target> <pattern>was</pattern> <pattern>cut</pattern> <pattern>off</pattern> in several neighborhoods.","translation":"昨晚強烈的雷雨期間，該市發生了停電，好幾個社區的電力被切斷了。","explanation":"名詞「電力」。常用搭配：be cut off (被切斷)。"},{"sentence":"Many families are trying to reduce their monthly <target>electricity</target> <pattern>bills</pattern> by switching to energy-saving light bulbs and turning off unused appliances.","translation":"許多家庭試圖透過更換節能燈泡和關掉不使用的電器來降低每月的電費。","explanation":"名詞「電力」。常用搭配：electricity bill (電費)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"electronic","explanation":"形容詞「電子的」。指利用電子元件或電腦技術運作的設備或系統。常考搭配：electronic devices (電子設備), electronic payment (電子支付)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students now use <target>electronic</target> <pattern>devices</pattern> such as tablets and e-readers to store their textbooks and take notes in class.","translation":"許多學生現在使用平板電腦和電子閱讀器等電子設備來儲存教科書並在課堂上做筆記。","explanation":"形容詞「電子的」。常用搭配：electronic devices (電子設備)。"},{"sentence":"To make shopping more convenient, the store introduced <target>electronic</target> <pattern>payment</pattern> methods, allowing customers to pay using their smartphones.","translation":"為了讓購物更方便，商店引入了電子支付方式，讓顧客可以使用智慧型手機付款。","explanation":"形容詞「電子的」。常用搭配：electronic payment (電子支付)。"}],"related_forms":["electronically","electronics"]}

{"headword":"element","explanation":"名詞「元素；要素」。指構成某事物的基本部分或核心特徵。常用搭配：an element of (一點.../某種元素), essential element (必要要素)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher explained that trust is an essential <target>element</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a healthy friendship, as it allows people to feel safe and open.","translation":"老師解釋說，信任是健康友誼的一個必要要素，因為它讓人们感到安全且坦誠。","explanation":"名詞「要素」。常用搭配：essential element of (...的必要要素)。"},{"sentence":"There was a slight <target>element</target> <pattern>of</pattern> surprise in her voice when she found out that she had won the first prize in the art competition.","translation":"當她發現自己贏得美術比賽第一名時，她的聲音中帶著一點驚訝。","explanation":"名詞「元素/一點」。常用片語 an element of sth (有一點...)。"},{"sentence":"In the chemistry class, students learned how to identify different chemical <target>elements</target> on the periodic table based on their atomic numbers.","translation":"在化學課上，學生學習如何根據原子序數在週期表上辨識不同的化學元素。","explanation":"名詞「元素」。指化學上的元素。"}],"related_forms":["elementary"]}

{"headword":"elevator","explanation":"名詞「電梯」。美式英語用法，英式英語通常使用 lift。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the <target>elevator</target> was out of order, the students had to carry their heavy books up to the fourth floor using the stairs.","translation":"因為電梯故障，學生們不得不走樓梯將沉重的書搬到四樓。","explanation":"名詞「電梯」。"},{"sentence":"The office building installed a high-speed <target>elevator</target> to reduce the waiting time for employees working on the upper floors.","translation":"辦公大樓安裝了高速電梯，以縮短在高層工作的員工的等待時間。","explanation":"名詞「電梯」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"emergency","explanation":"名詞「緊急情況」。常考搭配：in case of emergency (萬一發生緊急情況), emergency exit (緊急出口), emergency room (急診室)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school conducted a fire drill to teach students how to find the nearest <target>emergency</target> <pattern>exit</pattern> and leave the building safely.","translation":"學校舉行了一次消防演習，教導學生如何找到最近的緊急出口並安全地離開建築物。","explanation":"名詞「緊急情況」。常用搭配：emergency exit (緊急出口)。"},{"sentence":"Please keep this phone number handy <pattern>in case of</pattern> <target>emergency</target>, so that we can contact your parents immediately if anything happens.","translation":"請隨身攜帶這個電話號碼，以備不時之需，這樣如果發生任何事情，我們能立即聯繫你的父母。","explanation":"名詞「緊急情況」。常用片語 in case of emergency (萬一發生緊急情況)。"},{"sentence":"The patient was rushed to the <target>emergency</target> <pattern>room</pattern> after the car accident, where doctors worked quickly to save his life.","translation":"車禍後，病人被緊急送往急診室，醫生們迅速工作以挽救他的生命。","explanation":"名詞「緊急情況」。常用搭配：emergency room (急診室)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"emotional","explanation":"形容詞「情緒上的；激動的」。指與情感相關或在情緒上容易受到影響。常考搭配：emotional support (情感支持), emotional stability (情緒穩定度)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the graduation ceremony, many students became <target>emotional</target> as they said goodbye to their teachers and classmates for the last time.","translation":"在畢業典禮上，許多學生在最後一次與老師和同學告別時變得激動。","explanation":"形容詞「激動的」。指情緒激動地表現出來。"},{"sentence":"Having a supportive family provides the <target>emotional</target> <pattern>support</pattern> that teenagers need to deal with the stress of high school exams.","translation":"擁有一個支持性的家庭能提供青少年在面對高中考試壓力時所需的情感支持。","explanation":"形容詞「情緒上的」。常用搭配：emotional support (情感支持)。"},{"sentence":"Some people are more <target>emotional</target> than others, meaning they react more strongly to sad movies or heartwarming stories.","translation":"有些人比其他人更容易激動，這意味著他們對悲劇電影或溫馨的故事反應更強烈。","explanation":"形容詞「激動的」。"}],"related_forms":["emotion","emotionally"]}

{"headword":"emperor","explanation":"名詞「皇帝」。指統治一個帝國的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient <target>emperor</target> built a magnificent palace to show his power and wealth to the people across his vast empire.","translation":"古代皇帝建造了一座宏偉的宮殿，以向帝國境內的人們展示他的權力和財富。","explanation":"名詞「皇帝」。"},{"sentence":"History students learned about the laws and policies implemented by the <target>emperor</target> to maintain order and stability in the country.","translation":"歷史學生學習了皇帝為維持國家秩序與穩定而實施的法律和政策。","explanation":"名詞「皇帝」。"}],"related_forms":["empire"]}

{"headword":"enable","explanation":"動詞「使能夠」。常用句型：enable someone to do something (使某人能夠做某事)。注意與 allow (允許) 的區別：enable 強調的是提供工具、能力或手段，而 allow 側重於許可。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning a second language will <target>enable</target> you <pattern>to</pattern> communicate with people from different cultures and expand your global perspective.","translation":"學習第二語言將使你能夠與來自不同文化的人交流並擴展你的全球視野。","explanation":"動詞「使能夠」。常用句型 enable someone to do something。"},{"sentence":"The new software <target>enabled</target> the researchers <pattern>to</pattern> analyze large amounts of data more quickly and accurately than before.","translation":"這款新軟體使研究人員能夠比以前更快速、更準確地分析大量數據。","explanation":"動詞「使能夠」。"}],"related_forms":["enablement"]}

{"headword":"energetic","explanation":"形容詞「精力充沛的」。指充滿活力、有能量的。常考搭配：an energetic approach (積極的方法), feel energetic (感到精力充沛)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>energetic</target> puppy kept jumping around the living room, making it impossible for the owner to relax on the sofa.","translation":"那隻精力充沛的小狗在客廳裡跳來跳去，讓主人無法在沙發上放鬆。","explanation":"形容詞「精力充沛的」。"},{"sentence":"After a good night's sleep and a healthy breakfast, she felt <target>energetic</target> and ready to tackle the difficult math problems in class.","translation":"經過一夜好眠和健康的早餐，她感到精力充沛，準備好迎接課堂上的困難數學題。","explanation":"形容詞「精力充沛的」。"},{"sentence":"The coach encouraged the team to take an <target>energetic</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to the game, urging them to attack and put pressure on the opponents.","translation":"教練鼓勵球隊採取積極的方法來比賽，促使他們主動攻擊並給對手施壓。","explanation":"形容詞「精力充沛的」。這裡指採取積極、有活力的行動。"}],"related_forms":["energy","energetically"]}

{"headword": "engage", "explanation": "動詞「參與；吸引；訂婚」；名詞 engagement 「約定；訂婚；參與度」。動詞用法多變，需注意上下文。常用搭配：engage in (參與), be engaged to (與...訂婚), engagement ring (訂婚戒指)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher encouraged the students to <target>engage</target> <pattern>in</pattern> class discussions to improve their critical thinking and speaking skills.", "translation": "老師鼓勵學生參與課堂討論，以提高他們的批判性思考和口說能力。", "explanation": "動詞「參與」。常用片語 engage in (參與)。"}, {"sentence": "The new museum exhibit was designed to <target>engage</target> the visitors' interest by using interactive screens and virtual reality technology.", "translation": "新博物館展覽旨在透過使用互動螢幕和虛擬實境技術來吸引訪客的興趣。", "explanation": "動詞「吸引」。指吸引某人的注意或興趣。"}, {"sentence": "After dating for five years, Mark decided to <target>engage</target> his girlfriend, and they planned a beautiful wedding ceremony for next summer.", "translation": "交往五年後，馬克決定與女友訂婚，他們計劃在明年夏天舉辦一場美麗的婚禮。", "explanation": "動詞「訂婚」。"}, {"sentence": "She was very excited to show her friends the <target>engagement</target> <pattern>ring</pattern> that her fiancé had given her the previous week.", "translation": "她非常興奮地向朋友們展示她的未婚夫在上週給她的訂婚戒指。", "explanation": "名詞「訂婚」。常用搭配：engagement ring (訂婚戒指)。"}], "related_forms": ["engagement"]}

{"headword":"enjoyable","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。指某事或某個經驗讓人感到開心或滿足。常考搭配：an enjoyable experience (一次愉快的經驗), make something enjoyable (使某事令人愉快)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weekend trip to the mountains was an <target>enjoyable</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> for the whole family, as they spent quality time together.","translation":"這次週末去山上的旅行對全家人來說是一次愉快的經驗，因為他們共度了高品質的時間。","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。常用搭配：an enjoyable experience (一次愉快的經驗)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher used games and music to make the history lesson more <target>enjoyable</target> for the students, who usually found the subject boring.","translation":"老師使用遊戲和音樂來使歷史課對學生來說更令人愉快，因為學生通常覺得這個科目枯燥。","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。"}],"related_forms":["enjoy","enjoyably"]}

{"headword":"entry","explanation":"名詞「進入、進入處；項目、條目」。常用於指進入某地的動作、入口，或在名單、字典、競賽中的一個項目。常考片語 gain entry (進入), make an entry (參加/記錄)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The security guard prevented the strangers from <pattern>gaining</pattern> <target>entry</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the building because they did not have the proper identification cards.","translation":"保全人員阻止陌生人進入大樓，因為他們沒有適當的身分證件。","explanation":"名詞「進入」。片語 gain entry into 表示「進入」。"},{"sentence":"The university library has a side <target>entry</target> that is reserved exclusively for staff and students with special accessibility needs.","translation":"大學圖書館有一個側門入口，專門為教職員和有特殊無障礙需求的學生保留。","explanation":"名詞「入口」。指進入建築物的通道。"},{"sentence":"Each <target>entry</target> in the dictionary provides a clear definition, a pronunciation guide, and several example sentences to help learners.","translation":"字典中的每個條目都提供了清晰的定義、發音指南和幾個例句，以幫助學習者。","explanation":"名詞「條目」。指字典、名單或紀錄中的單個項目。"},{"sentence":"The art competition was open to all high school students, and the judges were impressed by the high quality of every <target>entry</target> they reviewed.","translation":"這場藝術比賽對所有高中生開放，評審對他們審閱的每個參賽作品都印象深刻。","explanation":"名詞「參賽項目/作品」。指提交給比賽的作品。"}],"related_forms":["entries"]}

{"headword":"envy","explanation":"名詞「嫉妒」；動詞「嫉妒、羨慕」。指對他人擁有某物或具備某種特質而感到不滿或嚮往。常用搭配 envy someone for something (羨慕某人某方面)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although she was happy for her friend's success, she could not help feeling a <pattern>pinch of</pattern> <target>envy</target> when she saw the award.","translation":"儘管她為朋友的成功感到高興，但當她看到獎項時，仍不禁感到一絲嫉妒。","explanation":"名詞「嫉妒」。pinch of envy 表示「一絲嫉妒」。"},{"sentence":"Many students <target>envy</target> his ability to speak four languages fluently, as it allows him to communicate with people from all over the world.","translation":"許多學生羨慕他能流利地說四種語言的能力，因為這讓他能與世界各地的人交流。","explanation":"動詞「羨慕」。指嚮往他人擁有的能力或特質。"},{"sentence":"She <target>envied</target> her sister <pattern>for</pattern> her natural confidence during public speaking, which was something she had always struggled with.","translation":"她羨慕她姐姐在公開演講時的天然自信，而這正是她一直以來感到吃力的地方。","explanation":"動詞「羨慕」。搭配介系詞 for 表示羨慕的對象或原因。"}],"related_forms":["envious"]}

{"headword":"erase","explanation":"動詞「擦除、消除」。指將寫在表面上的東西擦掉，或從記憶/紀錄中將某事消除。常用搭配 erase from memory (從記憶中消除)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>erase</target> their mistakes <pattern>with</pattern> an eraser before submitting their final essays for grading.","translation":"老師要求學生在提交最終作文進行評分前，用橡皮擦擦掉他們的錯誤。","explanation":"動詞「擦除」。指將物理上的痕跡擦除。"},{"sentence":"After the conflict, the two former rivals decided to <target>erase</target> the past and work together to achieve a common goal for the community.","translation":"衝突之後，這兩個前對手決定抹除過去，共同努力以實現社區的共同目標。","explanation":"動詞「消除」。指抽象地將過去的記憶或紀錄抹除。"},{"sentence":"Modern technology allows users to <target>erase</target> sensitive information <pattern>from</pattern> their hard drives to protect their privacy and prevent data leaks.","translation":"現代技術允許使用者從硬碟中刪除敏感資訊，以保護隱私並防止數據洩漏。","explanation":"動詞「刪除/擦除」。指將電子數據消除。"}],"related_forms":["eraser","erasable"]}

{"headword":"excellence","explanation":"名詞「卓越、優秀」。指達到極高水準的狀態。常用搭配 strive for excellence (追求卓越), academic excellence (學術卓越)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university is known for its commitment to academic <target>excellence</target>, attracting top students from across the globe to study there.","translation":"這所大學以其對學術卓越的承諾而聞名，吸引了全球頂尖學生前來就讀。","explanation":"名詞「卓越」。常用搭配 academic excellence (學術卓越)。"},{"sentence":"To achieve true <target>excellence</target> in music, one must <pattern>strive for</pattern> it through years of hard work, discipline, and constant practice.","translation":"為了在音樂方面達到真正的卓越，一個人必須透過多年的努力、紀律和不斷地練習來追求卓越。","explanation":"名詞「卓越」。片語 strive for excellence 表示「追求卓越」。"},{"sentence":"The student received a scholarship award <pattern>in recognition of</pattern> her <target>excellence</target> in mathematics and science, marking a great achievement.","translation":"這名學生因其在數學和科學方面的卓越表現而獲得獎學金，這是一個巨大的成就。","explanation":"名詞「卓越」。in recognition of 表示「為了認可...」。"}],"related_forms":["excellent"]}

{"headword":"exchange","explanation":"名詞「交換、交流」；動詞「交換、交流」。指將一件東西給予他人，並從他人那裡獲得另一件東西。常用搭配 exchange programs (交換計畫), in exchange for (作為...的交換)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school organized a student <target>exchange</target> <pattern>program</pattern> with a sister school in Japan, allowing students to experience different cultures firsthand.","translation":"學校與日本的一所姐妹校組織了一個學生交換計畫，讓學生能親身體驗不同的文化。","explanation":"名詞「交換計畫」。指兩校之間的人員交流。"},{"sentence":"She <target>exchanged</target> a smile <pattern>with</pattern> her classmate, acknowledging their shared relief after the difficult final exam was finally over.","translation":"她與同學交換了一個微笑，表達他們在艱難的期末考結束後共同的寬慰感。","explanation":"動詞「交換」。指簡單的互動行為。"},{"sentence":"He offered to help his neighbor clean the garage <pattern>in</pattern> <target>exchange</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a few homemade cookies and some fresh fruit.","translation":"他提出幫鄰居清理車庫，以換取一些手工餅乾和新鮮水果。","explanation":"名詞「交換」。片語 in exchange for 表示「作為...的交換」。"},{"sentence":"If the size of the shoes was not correct, the store manager allowed the customers to <target>exchange</target> the product <pattern>for</pattern> another one.","translation":"如果鞋子尺寸不正確，商店經理允許顧客將產品交換成另一雙。","explanation":"動詞「交換」。搭配介系詞 for 表示交換的對象。"}],"related_forms":["exchangeable"]}

{"headword":"exhibition","explanation":"名詞「展覽、展示」。指將藝術品或產品公開展示給大眾看。常用搭配 hold an exhibition (舉辦展覽), art exhibition (藝術展)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local gallery <pattern>held</pattern> an <target>exhibition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> modern art, drawing thousands of visitors who were interested in contemporary styles.","translation":"當地畫廊舉辦了一場現代藝術展，吸引了數千名對當代風格感興趣的訪客。","explanation":"名詞「展覽」。片語 hold an exhibition of... 表示「舉辦...的展覽」。"},{"sentence":"The science center's latest <target>exhibition</target> <pattern>on</pattern> space exploration provides interactive displays that teach students about the solar system.","translation":"科學中心最新的太空探索展覽提供互動式展示，教學生關於太陽系的事宜。","explanation":"名詞「展覽」。搭配介系詞 on 表示展覽的主題。"},{"sentence":"During the performance, the young pianist showed a remarkable <target>exhibition</target> of skill and emotion, leaving the audience in awe.","translation":"表演期間，這位年輕的鋼琴家展示了卓越的技巧和情感，讓觀眾感到驚嘆。","explanation":"名詞「展示」。指對某種能力或特質的公開展示。"}],"related_forms":["exhibit"]}

{"headword":"expectation","explanation":"名詞「期望、期待」。指對未來可能發生之事的預期。常用搭配 meet expectations (符合期望), beyond expectations (超出期望), high expectations (高期望)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new student's academic performance <pattern>met</pattern> the teacher's <target>expectations</target>, as he consistently achieved high scores on all his tests.","translation":"這名新學生的學業表現符合老師的期望，因為他在所有測試中都持續獲得高分。","explanation":"名詞「期望」。片語 meet expectations 表示「符合期望」。"},{"sentence":"The movie's plot was surprisingly simple, and the ending was <pattern>far</pattern> <target>beyond</target> my <pattern>expectations</pattern>, making the film truly unique.","translation":"這部電影的劇情出乎意料地簡單，而結局則遠遠超出我的預期，使這部電影真正獨特。","explanation":"名詞「期望」。片語 beyond expectations 表示「超出預期」。"},{"sentence":"Many parents <pattern>place</pattern> high <target>expectations</target> <pattern>on</pattern> their children, which can sometimes lead to excessive academic pressure and stress.","translation":"許多父母對孩子抱有高期望，於是指時常導致過度的學業壓力與壓力。","explanation":"名詞「期望」。片語 place expectations on someone 表示「對某人抱有期望」。"}],"related_forms":["expect","expectant"]}

{"headword": "experiment", "explanation": "名詞「實驗」；動詞「做實驗」。指透過測試來發現新知識或測試假設。常用搭配 conduct an experiment (進行實驗), carry out an experiment (執行實驗)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chemistry students <pattern>conducted</pattern> an <target>experiment</target> <pattern>to</pattern> see how different temperatures affect the rate of a chemical reaction.", "translation": "化學學生進行了一項實驗，以觀察不同溫度如何影響化學反應的速率。", "explanation": "名詞「實驗」。片語 conduct an experiment to V 表示「進行實驗以...」。"}, {"sentence": "The researcher <pattern>carried</pattern> <target>out</target> an <target>experiment</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the behavior of mice, discovering a new way to treat memory loss.", "translation": "研究員對老鼠的行為進行了一項實驗，發現了一種治療記憶喪失的新方法。", "explanation": "名詞「實驗」。片語 carry out an experiment on... 表示「針對...執行實驗」。"}, {"sentence": "Instead of following the textbook, the artist decided to <target>experiment</target> <pattern>with</pattern> different colors and textures to create a more unique style.", "translation": "與其遵循教科書，這位藝術家決定嘗試使用不同的顏色和質地來創造一種更獨特的風格。", "explanation": "動詞「嘗試/做實驗」。片語 experiment with sth 表示「嘗試使用...來做實驗」。"}, {"sentence": "The scientists spent months <target>experimenting</target> <pattern>with</pattern> new materials to ensure the bridge's design was safe and durable for public use.", "translation": "科學家花了好幾個月嘗試使用新材料，以確保橋樑的設計對公眾使用是安全且耐用的。", "explanation": "動詞「嘗試/做實驗」。指透過不斷嘗試來尋找最佳方案。"}], "related_forms": ["experimental", "experimentation"]}

{"headword":"explode","explanation":"動詞「爆炸、爆發」。指物體突然劇烈地破裂，或情感、數量突然劇增。常用搭配 explode into (爆發成...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old building was <target>exploded</target> by experts to make room for a new city park and a modern library for the residents.","translation":"這棟舊建築被專家爆破，以便為居民打造一個新的城市公園和一座現代圖書館。","explanation":"動詞「爆炸/爆破」。指物體物理上的爆破。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher discovered that the students had cheated on the exam, she <target>exploded</target> <pattern>into</pattern> anger, shouting at the entire class.","translation":"當老師發現學生在考試中作弊時，她憤怒地爆發，對整個班級大喊大叫。","explanation":"動詞「爆發」。explode into anger 表示「突然爆發憤怒」。"},{"sentence":"The population of the small town has <target>exploded</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the last decade, as many people moved there to work in the new factory.","translation":"這個小鎮的人口在過去十年中劇增，因為許多人搬到那裡在新的工廠工作。","explanation":"動詞「劇增」。指數量或規模的突然增加。"}],"related_forms":["explosion","explosive"]}

{"headword": "explore", "explanation": "動詞「探索、研究」。指前往某地考察或詳細研究某個主題。常用搭配 explore the possibility (探索可能性), explore the area (探索該區域)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During their summer vacation, the students <target>explored</target> the ancient ruins of Greece, learning about the history and culture of the early civilizations.", "translation": "在夏季假期期間，學生們探索了希臘的古蹟，學習關於早期文明的歷史和文化。", "explanation": "動詞「探索」。指物理上的考察。"}, {"sentence": "The committee is currently <target>exploring</target> the <pattern>possibility of</pattern> building a new gymnasium to provide more sports facilities for the students.", "translation": "委員會目前正在探索建造新體育館的可能性，以提供學生更多的運動設施。", "explanation": "動詞「研究/探索」。explore the possibility of... 表示「探索...的可能性」。"}, {"sentence": "In the final project, the students were asked to <target>explore</target> the <pattern>impact of</pattern> social media on mental health and present their findings in class.", "translation": "在期末計畫中，學生被要求研究社交媒體對心理健康的影響，並在班級中提出他們的發現。", "explanation": "動詞「研究」。指對某個主題進行詳細分析。"}], "related_forms": ["exploration", "explorer"]}

{"headword":"export","explanation":"動詞「出口」，名詞「出口貨物」或「出口」。在 GSAT 中，常考動詞用法及其對應的進口 (import)。注意動詞搭配 export sth to (將某物出口至...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Taiwan is known for its ability to <target>export</target> high-quality electronics <pattern>to</pattern> countries all over the world, boosting the local economy.","translation":"台灣以能將高品質電子產品出口到世界各國而聞名，從而提振當地經濟。","explanation":"動詞「出口」。常用搭配 export sth to...。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to find new markets to <target>export</target> agricultural products, reducing the reliance on a single trading partner.","translation":"政府正努力尋找新市場來出口農產品，以減少對單一貿易夥伴的依賴。","explanation":"動詞「出口」。"},{"sentence":"The city's main <target>exports</target> include fresh coffee beans and tropical fruits, which are highly valued in European markets.","translation":"該市的主要出口貨物包括新鮮咖啡豆和熱帶水果，這些在歐洲市場上深受重視。","explanation":"名詞「出口貨物」。"}],"related_forms":["exporter","exportation"]}

{"headword":"expressive","explanation":"形容詞「富有表現力的」。常用於描述人的面部表情、眼神或藝術作品，用以傳達情感或想法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actress gave an <target>expressive</target> <pattern>look</pattern> of surprise when she heard the news, making the audience feel her shock immediately.","translation":"女演員在聽到消息時露出了富有表現力的驚訝表情，讓觀眾立即感受到她的震撼。","explanation":"形容詞「富有表現力的」。常用搭配 expressive look/face (富有表現力的表情/臉色)。"},{"sentence":"Although he rarely spoke, his <target>expressive</target> <pattern>eyes</pattern> revealed his deep sadness and longing for his home in the countryside.","translation":"雖然他很少說話，但他的眼神富有表現力，透露出他對鄉下家鄉的深深悲傷和渴望。","explanation":"形容詞「富有表現力的」。常用搭配 expressive eyes (富有表現力的眼神)。"}],"related_forms":["expressively","expression"]}

{"headword":"extreme","explanation":"形容詞「極端的、極限的」；名詞「極端」。常用於描述天氣、觀點或情況的嚴重程度。注意搭配 in the extreme (極其) 或 extreme measures (極端措施)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers had to face <target>extreme</target> <pattern>weather</pattern> conditions, including freezing temperatures and heavy snow, during their journey to the mountain peak.","translation":"登山者在前往山頂的旅程中必須面對極端的天氣條件，包括冰凍的溫度和大雪。","explanation":"形容詞「極端的」。常用搭配 extreme weather (極端天氣)。"},{"sentence":"Some people hold <target>extreme</target> <pattern>views</pattern> on political issues, which often leads to heated arguments during class discussions.","translation":"有些人對政治議題持有極端的觀點，這經常導致課堂討論中出現激烈的爭論。","explanation":"形容詞「極端的」。常用搭配 extreme views (極端觀點)。"},{"sentence":"In <target>extreme</target> <pattern>cases</pattern> of illness, doctors may need to perform an emergency surgery to save the patient's life.","translation":"在疾病的極端情況下，醫生可能需要進行緊急手術以挽救病人的生命。","explanation":"形容詞「極端的」。常用搭配 extreme cases (極端情況)。"},{"sentence":"The government took <target>extreme</target> <pattern>measures</pattern> to stop the spread of the virus, including closing all public transportation for a week.","translation":"政府採取了極端措施來阻止病毒傳播，包括將所有公共交通工具關閉一週。","explanation":"形容詞「極端的」。常用搭配 extreme measures (極端措施)。"},{"sentence":"His behavior was <target>extreme</target> <pattern>in the extreme</pattern>, making it difficult for his classmates to understand his unpredictable reactions.","translation":"他的行為極其極端，使得他的同學很難理解他不可預測的反應。","explanation":"形容詞用法。片語 in the extreme 意為「極其」。"}],"related_forms":["extremely","extremism"]}

{"headword":"fade","explanation":"動詞「褪色、凋零、逐漸消失」。可用於描述顏色、聲音、記憶或感情的減弱。注意搭配 fade away (逐漸消失)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bright red color of the old curtain began to <target>fade</target> <pattern>after</pattern> long exposure to the strong summer sun.","translation":"這塊舊窗簾的亮紅色在長時間暴露於強烈的夏季陽光下後開始褪色。","explanation":"動詞「褪色」。"},{"sentence":"As the music slowly <target>faded</target> <pattern>away</pattern>, the audience remained silent for a moment, reflecting on the emotional ending of the play.","translation":"隨著音樂緩緩消失，觀眾們沉默了一會兒，思考著這齣戲的情感終結。","explanation":"動詞片語 fade away 表示「逐漸消失」。"},{"sentence":"Although many years had passed, the pain of losing his pet did not <target>fade</target> <pattern>over time</pattern>, remaining a vivid memory.","translation":"儘管許多年過去了，失去寵物的痛苦並沒有隨時間而褪色，依然是一個鮮明的記憶。","explanation":"動詞「逐漸消失」。常用搭配 fade over time (隨時間消逝)。"}],"related_forms":["fading","faded"]}

{"headword":"faint","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的、微弱的」；動詞「暈倒」；名詞「昏厥」。注意形容詞用法中常搭配 faint smell/sound (微弱的氣味/聲音)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Through the thick fog, the driver could only see a <target>faint</target> <pattern>outline</pattern> of the bridge, making it dangerous to continue driving.","translation":"穿過濃霧，駕駛員只能看到橋樑模糊的輪廓，使得繼續駕駛變得危險。","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的」。常用搭配 faint outline (模糊的輪廓)。"},{"sentence":"She noticed a <target>faint</target> <pattern>smell</pattern> of smoke coming from the kitchen, so she rushed inside to check if everything was okay.","translation":"她注意到廚房傳來微弱的煙味，於是趕緊跑進去檢查是否一切正常。","explanation":"形容詞「微弱的」。常用搭配 faint smell (微弱的氣味)。"},{"sentence":"The heat in the crowded room was so intense that several students <target>fainted</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the lack of oxygen and exhaustion.","translation":"擁擠房間裡的熱氣如此劇烈，以至於幾名學生因缺氧和疲勞而暈倒。","explanation":"動詞「暈倒」。常用搭配 faint from sth (因...而暈倒)。"},{"sentence":"After the sudden <target>faint</target>, the patient was rushed to the hospital to undergo a series of blood tests and physical exams.","translation":"在突然的昏厥後，病人被緊急送往醫院進行一系列血液檢查和體檢。","explanation":"名詞「昏厥」。"}],"related_forms":["faintly"]}

{"headword":"fairly","explanation":"副詞「相當地」或「公正地」。前者用於表示程度（類似 rather 或 quite），後者用於表示方式（公平地）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The physics exam was <target>fairly</target> <pattern>difficult</pattern>, but most students managed to finish it on time by staying focused.","translation":"物理考試相當困難，但大多數學生透過保持專注成功在時間內完成。","explanation":"副詞「相當地」。表示程度，修飾形容詞 difficult。"},{"sentence":"The teacher decided to divide the prizes <target>fairly</target> <pattern>among</pattern> all the team members who contributed to the project's success.","translation":"老師決定將獎品公正地分給所有對計畫成功有貢獻的團隊成員。","explanation":"副詞「公正地」。表示方式，修飾動詞 divide。"}],"related_forms":["fair"]}

{"headword":"fairy","explanation":"名詞「小仙女、精靈」；形容詞「仙女的、虛構的」。常用於童話故事 (fairy tales) 中。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many traditional <target>fairy</target> <pattern>tales</pattern>, a kind fairy uses magic to help the main character overcome difficult challenges.","translation":"在許多傳統童話故事中，善良的仙女使用魔法幫助主角克服困難的挑戰。","explanation":"名詞（作定語）「仙女的」。常用搭配 fairy tales (童話故事)。"},{"sentence":"The children were fascinated by the story of a tiny <target>fairy</target> <pattern>with</pattern> shimmering wings who lived in the deep forest.","translation":"孩子們被一個住在深林中、擁有閃亮翅膀的小仙女的故事深深吸引。","explanation":"名詞「小仙女」。"}],"related_forms":["fairies"]}

{"headword":"faith","explanation":"名詞「信心、信任、信仰」。注意常見片語 have faith in (對...有信心) 和 keep the faith (堅持信仰)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Even when the project seemed impossible, the team <pattern>had</pattern> <target>faith</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their leader's ability to find a creative solution.","translation":"即使計畫看起來不可能完成，團隊成員仍對領導者的解決能力有信心。","explanation":"名詞「信心」。片語 have faith in sb/sth 表示「對...有信心」。"},{"sentence":"Her deep <target>faith</target> <pattern>in</pattern> humanity gave her the strength to volunteer at the shelter and help homeless people every weekend.","translation":"她對人性深刻的信任賦予她力量在收容所擔任志工，每週末幫助無家可歸的人。","explanation":"名詞「信任/信仰」。常用搭配 faith in sth。"},{"sentence":"The monk spent his entire life studying ancient texts to strengthen his <target>faith</target> <pattern>and</pattern> devotion to his religious beliefs.","translation":"這位僧侶花了一輩子研究古籍，以強化他的信仰及其對宗教信仰的奉獻。","explanation":"名詞「信仰」。"}],"related_forms":["faithful","faithfully"]}

{"headword": "fake", "explanation": "形容詞「假的、偽造的」；動詞「偽造、假裝」；名詞「贗品、騙子」。常考用法：fake ID/news；fake a smile (假笑)。注意與 false, artificial 的區別：fake 側重於為了誤導或欺騙他人而刻意模仿的行為或複製品，如 fake jewelry (假珠寶) 或 fake an injury (裝受傷)；false 側重於不符合事實的錯誤狀態或是非天然的功能性配件，如 false accusations (指控不實) 或 false eyelashes (假睫毛)；而 artificial 則強調經由人力而非天然形成的過程，常用於中性的科技或材料描述，如 artificial intelligence (人工智慧) 或 artificial flavoring (人工香料)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum discovered that one of its most prized artifacts was a <target>fake</target> and had to remove it from display immediately.", "translation": "博物館發現其最珍貴的文物之一是贗品，必須立即將其撤下展覽。", "explanation": "名詞「贗品」。指模仿真品製造的假貨。"}, {"sentence": "The detective quickly realized that the witness's alibi was <target>fake</target> after finding inconsistencies in their statement.", "translation": "偵探在發現證人陳述中的不一致之處後，很快意識到證人的不在場證明是假的。", "explanation": "形容詞「假的、偽造的」。常用於描述不真實的事物。"}, {"sentence": "To avoid hurting her friend's feelings, she decided to <target>fake</target> <pattern>a smile</pattern> and pretend to enjoy the surprise party.", "translation": "為了避免傷害朋友的感情，她決定假裝微笑，並假裝享受這個驚喜派對。", "explanation": "動詞「假裝」。常指刻意表現出不真實的情緒或行為。"}], "related_forms": ["faker"]}

{"headword":"familiar","explanation":"形容詞「熟悉的」。注意常見搭配 be familiar with (對...熟悉) 與 be familiar to (對...來說是熟悉的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new student felt nervous because the school's layout was not <target>familiar</target> <pattern>to</pattern> him, and he often got lost.","translation":"新學生感到緊張，因為學校的佈局對他來說並不熟悉，他經常迷路。","explanation":"形容詞「熟悉的」。片語 be familiar to sb 表示「對某人來說是熟悉的」。"},{"sentence":"As an experienced biologist, Professor Lee is very <target>familiar</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the migration patterns of birds in East Asia.","translation":"作為一名經驗豐富的生物學家，李教授非常熟悉東亞鳥類的遷徙模式。","explanation":"形容詞「熟悉的」。片語 be familiar with sth 表示「對...熟悉」。"}],"related_forms":["familiarity","familiarize"]}

{"headword":"fancy","explanation":"形容詞「華麗的、昂貴的」；名詞「幻想」；動詞「想像、想要」。在 GSAT 中，形容詞用法最為常見，注意其與 simple/plain 的相對關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"Instead of buying a <target>fancy</target> <pattern>dress</pattern> for the graduation party, she chose a simple white one that looked elegant.","translation":"她沒有買一件華麗的禮服參加畢業派對，而是選擇了一件看起來優雅的簡單白色禮服。","explanation":"形容詞「華麗的」。常用搭配 fancy dress (華麗的禮服)。"},{"sentence":"The hotel offered a <target>fancy</target> <pattern>dinner</pattern> with seven courses, including rare seafood and expensive wines from France.","translation":"這家飯店提供了一頓有七道菜的華麗晚餐，包括稀有的海鮮和來自法國的昂貴葡萄酒。","explanation":"形容詞「昂貴的/華麗的」。"},{"sentence":"The young artist had a <target>fancy</target> <pattern>that</pattern> he could travel to another planet and paint the stars in the sky.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家有一個幻想，認為自己可以旅行到另一個星球並在天空中繪畫星星。","explanation":"名詞「幻想」。"},{"sentence":"I don't <target>fancy</target> <pattern>going</pattern> to the museum today because the weather is so hot that I would rather stay home.","translation":"我今天不想去博物館，因為天氣太熱了，我寧願待在家裡。","explanation":"動詞「想要/想像」。常用搭配 fancy V-ing。"}],"related_forms":["fancied","fanciful"]}

{"headword": "fare", "explanation": "名詞「車資、票價」。注意其動詞用法「運送」或「表現」，但在 GSAT 中最常見的是指交通費用。常用搭配 a bus fare 或 train fare。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Since the city increased the bus <target>fare</target>, many students have started walking or riding bicycles to school to save money.", "translation": "由於城市調漲了公車票價，許多學生開始走路或騎單車上學以節省金錢。", "explanation": "名詞「票價」。常用搭配 bus fare。"}, {"sentence": "The tourist was confused because he did not have enough cash to pay the taxi <target>fare</target> after arriving at the hotel.", "translation": "這位遊客感到困惑，因為到達飯店後他沒有足夠的現金來支付計程車車資。", "explanation": "名詞「車資」。"}], "related_forms": ["fares"]}

{"headword":"farther","explanation":"形容詞或副詞，意為「更遠的」。通常用於指物理距離上的遠近。注意與 further 的區別：farther 強調實體距離，而 further 強調程度、時間或額外地（如 further information）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers decided to walk a bit <target>farther</target> up the mountain to see if they could find a better view of the valley.","translation":"登山客決定再往山上走遠一點，看看是否能找到更好的山谷景色。","explanation":"副詞「更遠地」。指物理距離。"},{"sentence":"Our house is located <target>farther</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the city center than yours, so it takes me longer to commute to work every day.","translation":"我家的位置比你家離市中心更遠，所以我每天通勤上班花的時間更長。","explanation":"形容詞「更遠的」。常用搭配 farther from sth。"}],"related_forms":["farthest"]}

{"headword":"fashionable","explanation":"形容詞「時尚的、流行的」。指符合當前的流行趨勢。常用搭配 fashionable clothes 或 be fashionable。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many teenagers try to wear <target>fashionable</target> clothes to fit in with their peers and feel more confident during school events.","translation":"許多青少年試圖穿著時尚的衣服以融入同儕，並在學校活動中感到更有自信。","explanation":"形容詞「時尚的」。"},{"sentence":"The old district has become very <target>fashionable</target> recently, with many new art galleries and trendy cafes opening in the area.","translation":"這個舊區最近變得非常流行，該地區開了許多新的藝廊和時尚咖啡廳。","explanation":"形容詞「流行的」。描述地點或風格。"}],"related_forms":["fashion","fashionably"]}

{"headword":"faucet","explanation":"名詞「水龍頭」。常用於描述家居環境。常用動詞搭配 turn on, turn off 或 leak。","entries":[{"sentence":"To save water and protect the environment, the school encourages students to turn <pattern>off</pattern> the <target>faucet</target> while brushing their teeth.","translation":"為了節水並保護環境，學校鼓勵學生在刷牙時關掉水龍頭。","explanation":"名詞「水龍頭」。常用動詞搭配 turn off。"},{"sentence":"The janitor had to replace the old <target>faucet</target> in the restroom because it continued to leak water even when it was closed.","translation":"管理員必須更換洗手間的舊水龍頭，因為即使在關閉時它仍持續漏水。","explanation":"名詞「水龍頭」。常用動詞搭配 leak。"}],"related_forms":["faucets"]}

{"headword":"fearful","explanation":"形容詞「恐懼的、害怕的」。常用搭配 be fearful of sth/sb，表示對某事或某人感到害怕。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many animals are <target>fearful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> humans and will run away quickly as soon as they sense any presence of people.","translation":"許多動物害怕人類，一旦感覺到人的存在就會迅速逃跑。","explanation":"形容詞「恐懼的」。常用片語 be fearful of。"},{"sentence":"The experienced climber was <target>fearful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a sudden storm, so he decided to cancel the trip for the safety of the group.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的登山者擔心突然暴風雨，因此決定為了團隊的安全而取消這次旅行。","explanation":"形容詞「恐懼的/擔心的」。常用片語 be fearful of。"}],"related_forms":["fear","fearfully"]}

{"headword":"feather","explanation":"名詞「羽毛」。常用於描述鳥類或在比喻用法中，如 light as a feather (輕如羽毛)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young bird used its soft <target>feathers</target> to keep warm during the cold winter nights in the forest.","translation":"這隻幼鳥利用其柔軟的羽毛在森林寒冷的冬夜中保持溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「羽毛」。"},{"sentence":"After the heavy rain, the peacock displayed its colorful <target>feathers</target> to attract a mate and show its strength.","translation":"大雨後，孔雀展示其色彩繽紛的羽毛以吸引配偶並展示其力量。","explanation":"名詞「羽毛」。"}],"related_forms":["feathers"]}

{"headword":"fence","explanation":"名詞「圍欄、籬笆」。指用來分隔空間或保護區域的結構。常用搭配 build a fence 或 jump over a fence。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer built a strong wooden <target>fence</target> <pattern>around</pattern> his vegetable garden to prevent wild animals from eating the crops.","translation":"農夫在蔬菜園周圍築起一道強壯的木製圍欄，以防止野生動物吃掉農作物。","explanation":"名詞「圍欄」。常用搭配 build a fence around sth。"},{"sentence":"The mischievous dog accidentally <target>fenced</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the cat, making it impossible for the pet to escape from the backyard.","translation":"這隻調皮的狗不小心將貓關在圍欄內，使得這隻寵物無法從後院逃脫。","explanation":"動詞用法「圍起來」。"}],"related_forms":["fences"]}

{"headword":"fighter","explanation":"名詞「戰鬥者、鬥士」。可指軍事上的戰士，也可指像拳擊手或爭取權利的人（如 a fighter for human rights）。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the war, the brave <target>fighters</target> risked their lives to protect their homeland and ensure the safety of civilians.","translation":"戰爭期間，勇敢的戰鬥者冒著生命危險保護家鄉並確保平民的安全。","explanation":"名詞「戰鬥者」。"},{"sentence":"She has always been a strong <target>fighter</target> <pattern>for</pattern> environmental protection, spending years working with non-profit organizations.","translation":"她一直是一位堅定的環境保護鬥士，多年來一直與非營利組織合作。","explanation":"名詞「鬥士」。常用搭配 fighter for sth。"}],"related_forms":["fight"]}

{"headword": "firework", "explanation": "名詞「煙火」。通常以複數形式 fireworks 出現。常用搭配 set off fireworks 或 watch fireworks。", "entries": [{"sentence": "On New Year's Eve, the city <target>fireworks</target> <pattern>display</pattern> was so bright that it lit up the entire night sky with colorful lights.", "translation": "在除夕之夜，城市的煙火表演如此明亮，以至於用多彩的色光照亮了整個夜空。", "explanation": "名詞「煙火」。"}, {"sentence": "The children were excited to <pattern>set off</pattern> <target>fireworks</target> during the festival, but their parents warned them to be careful.", "translation": "孩子們很興奮地在節日期間燃放煙火，但他們的父母警告他們要小心。", "explanation": "名詞「煙火」。常用動詞搭配 set off。"}], "related_forms": ["fireworks"]}

{"headword":"fist","explanation":"名詞「拳頭」。動詞用法較少見，指「握拳」。常用搭配 clench one's fist 或 make a fist。","entries":[{"sentence":"The angry man <pattern>clenched</pattern> his <target>fist</target> in frustration, but he decided to stay calm and solve the problem through talking.","translation":"憤怒的男人因挫折而握緊拳頭，但他決定保持冷靜並透過對話解決問題。","explanation":"名詞「拳頭」。常用搭配 clench one's fist。"},{"sentence":"The boxing coach told the athlete to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>fist</target> to ensure he could strike the target with enough power.","translation":"拳擊教練告訴運動員握拳，以確保他能以足夠的力量擊中目標。","explanation":"名詞「拳頭」。常用搭配 make a fist。"}],"related_forms":["fists"]}

{"headword":"flame","explanation":"名詞「火焰」；動詞「燃燒、猛烈燃燒」。常用於描述火災或激烈的感情。注意與 fire (火) 的區別：flame 側重於可見的火苗或火舌，而 fire 是更廣泛的術語，涵蓋了燃燒的過程和產生的熱量。","entries":[{"sentence":"The campers carefully built a small <target>flame</target> to keep themselves warm and cook their dinner during the cold night.","translation":"露營者小心地生起一小簇火焰，以便在寒冷的夜晚取暖並烹飪晚餐。","explanation":"名詞「火焰」。指可見的火苗。"},{"sentence":"The old wooden house was quickly consumed by the <target>flames</target> after a short circuit in the kitchen caused a fire.","translation":"廚房短路引起火災後，這棟舊木屋很快被火焰吞噬。","explanation":"名詞「火焰」。複數形式，指大面積的火勢。"},{"sentence":"The anger in his eyes seemed to <target>flame</target> <pattern>up</pattern> when he realized that his hard work had been stolen by someone else.","translation":"當他意識到自己的心血被他人竊取時，他眼中的憤怒似乎猛烈燃燒起來。","explanation":"動詞片語 flame up 意為「猛烈燃燒」或「突然爆發（感情）」。"}],"related_forms":["flaming"]}

{"headword":"flash","explanation":"名詞「閃光」；動詞「閃光、快閃」。常考搭配：in a flash (立刻)。注意 flash 側重於極短時間內發出的強烈光線或動作。","entries":[{"sentence":"A sudden <target>flash</target> <pattern>of</pattern> light appeared in the sky, and a few seconds later, the loud sound of thunder followed.","translation":"天空中突然出現了一道閃光，幾秒鐘後，隨之而來的是巨大的雷聲。","explanation":"名詞「閃光」。常用搭配：a flash of light。"},{"sentence":"The photographer used a <target>flash</target> to brighten the dark room, ensuring that the subjects of the photo were clearly visible.","translation":"攝影師使用閃光燈來照亮黑暗的房間，確保照片中的對象清晰可見。","explanation":"名詞「閃光燈」。"},{"sentence":"She realized her mistake <target>in a flash</target>, and quickly corrected the answer on her test paper before the teacher collected it.","translation":"她立刻意識到了自己的錯誤，並在老師收卷之前迅速地在考卷上修改了答案。","explanation":"名詞片語 in a flash 意為「立刻、瞬間」。"},{"sentence":"The police officer <target>flashed</target> his badge to the security guard, allowing him to enter the restricted area of the building.","translation":"警察向保安出示（閃現）了他的徽章，使他能夠進入建築物的禁區。","explanation":"動詞「快速出示」。"}],"related_forms":["flashing"]}

response: {"headword":"flashlight","explanation":"名詞「手電筒」。一種便攜式的電燈，常用於緊急情況或黑暗環境。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the power went out during the storm, we used a <target>flashlight</target> to find our way to the basement and check the fuse box.","translation":"暴風雨期間停電時，我們用手電筒在地下室尋找路徑並檢查保險絲盒。","explanation":"名詞「手電筒」。"},{"sentence":"The hikers carried a powerful <target>flashlight</target> in their backpacks, just in case they got lost in the woods after sunset.","translation":"登山客在背包裡帶了一個強力的手電筒，以防日落後在森林中迷路。","explanation":"名詞「手電筒」。"}],"related_forms":["flashlights"]}

{"headword":"flavor","explanation":"名詞「風味、味道」；動詞「調味」。注意 flavor 側重於透過化學感官（味覺、嗅覺）感知到的綜合味道，而 taste 側重於基本的味覺（甜、酸、苦、辣）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef added a pinch of cinnamon to the apple pie to enhance its <target>flavor</target>, making it smell and taste wonderful.","translation":"廚師在蘋果派中加入了一小撮肉桂以增強其風味，使其聞起來和嚐起來都非常美味。","explanation":"名詞「風味」。"},{"sentence":"Many people prefer the <target>flavor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dark chocolate over milk chocolate because it has a stronger, more complex taste.","translation":"許多人比起牛奶巧克力，更喜歡黑巧克力的風味，因為它有更強烈且更複雜的味道。","explanation":"名詞「風味」。常用搭配：flavor of sth。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>flavor</target> the yogurt with fresh strawberries and honey to appeal to younger customers who love sweets.","translation":"公司決定用新鮮草莓和蜂蜜為優格調味，以吸引喜愛甜食的年輕顧客。","explanation":"動詞「調味」。"}],"related_forms":["flavoring","flavorful"]}

{"headword":"flesh","explanation":"名詞「肌肉、肉體」。通常指動物或人類的身體組織，與骨骼（bone）相對於。在某些上下文中，也可用於描述水果的果肉。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the infection had spread through the <target>flesh</target> of the arm, requiring immediate medical treatment to prevent further damage.","translation":"醫生解釋說，感染已經在手臂的肌肉組織中擴散，需要立即進行醫療治療以防止進一步的損害。","explanation":"名詞「肉體/肌肉」。指人體組織。"},{"sentence":"When the chef prepared the fish, he carefully removed the skin and kept only the tender <target>flesh</target> for the grilled dish.","translation":"廚師在準備魚類時，小心地去除了皮膚，僅保留嫩肉部分用於烤魚料理。","explanation":"名詞「果肉/肉質」。指動物的肉。"}],"related_forms":["fleshy"]}

{"headword": "float", "explanation": "動詞「漂浮、浮起」；名詞「漂浮物、花車」。動詞用法常考搭配：float on (在...上漂浮)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Ice cubes <target>float</target> <pattern>on</pattern> water because they are less dense than the liquid, which is a basic principle of physics.", "translation": "冰塊在水上漂浮，因為它們的密度比液體低，這是物理學的一個基本原理。", "explanation": "動詞「漂浮」。常用搭配：float on sth。"}, {"sentence": "The children spent the entire afternoon <target>floating</target> <pattern>on</pattern> their colorful inflatable tubes in the swimming pool.", "translation": "孩子們整個下午都在游泳池裡用色彩繽紛的充氣圈漂浮。", "explanation": "動詞「漂浮」。"}, {"sentence": "During the annual flower parade, the most elaborate <target>float</target> was decorated with thousands of fresh roses and lilies.", "translation": "在年度花卉遊行中，最精緻的花車被裝飾著數千朵新鮮的玫瑰和百合。", "explanation": "名詞「花車」。指遊行中被裝飾的車輛。"}, {"sentence": "The company's stock price began to <target>float</target> after the initial public offering, reflecting the real-time demand of the market.", "translation": "公司股票價格在首次公開發行後開始浮動，反映了市場的即時需求。", "explanation": "動詞「浮動」。指價格或貨幣價值隨市場變動。"}], "related_forms": ["floating"]}

{"headword":"flock","explanation":"名詞「（鳥、羊等）群」；動詞「聚集、蜂擁而至」。常考搭配：a flock of (一群...)。注意 flock 通常指鳥類或羊類。","entries":[{"sentence":"A large <target>flock</target> <pattern>of</pattern> birds flew south for the winter to find warmer climates and more abundant food sources.","translation":"一大群鳥在冬天飛往南方，以尋找更溫暖的氣候和更豐富的食源。","explanation":"名詞「群」。常用搭配：a flock of birds。"},{"sentence":"The shepherd spent his days guiding his <target>flock</target> of sheep to the greenest pastures to ensure they were healthy and well-fed.","translation":"牧羊人整天在引導他的羊群，前往最綠色的牧場，以確保它們健康且營養充足。","explanation":"名詞「群」。常用搭配： a flock of sheep。"},{"sentence":"Thousands of fans <target>flocked</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the stadium to see their favorite pop star perform live for the first time in years.","translation":"數以千計的粉絲蜂擁而至體育場，以此觀看他們最喜愛的流行歌手多年來首次現場表演。","explanation":"動詞「蜂擁而至」。常用搭配：flock to sth/sb。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"flood","explanation":"名詞「洪水、水災」；動詞「淹沒、充斥」。動詞用法常考搭配：flood with (用...充斥/淹沒)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heavy rainfall last week caused a severe <target>flood</target> that damaged many homes and roads in the low-lying areas of the city.","translation":"上週的強降雨導致了嚴重的水災，損毀了該市低窪地區的許多房屋和道路。","explanation":"名詞「洪水/水災」。"},{"sentence":"After the celebrity's scandal became public, the agency was <target>flooded</target> <pattern>with</pattern> thousands of angry emails from disappointed fans.","translation":"當這位名人的醜聞公開後，該機構被數以千計不滿粉絲的憤怒郵件所充斥。","explanation":"動詞「充斥」。常用搭配：flood with sth。"},{"sentence":"The river <target>flooded</target> the surrounding farmland after the dam broke, destroying all the crops that were ready for harvest.","translation":"河水在水壩崩潰後淹沒了周圍的農田，摧毀了所有準備收割的作物。","explanation":"動詞「淹沒」。"}],"related_forms":["flooding"]}

{"headword":"flour","explanation":"名詞「麵粉」。由穀物磨製而成，常用於烘焙。","entries":[{"sentence":"To make a perfect cake, you need to measure the <target>flour</target> accurately and mix it with sugar and butter in a large bowl.","translation":"為了做出完美的蛋糕，你需要準確地測量麵粉量，並將其與糖和奶油在一個大碗中混合。","explanation":"名詞「麵粉」。"},{"sentence":"The baker used whole-wheat <target>flour</target> instead of white flour to make the bread healthier and more nutritious for the customers.","translation":"麵包師使用了全麥麵粉代替白麵粉，使麵包對顧客來說更健康且更有營養。","explanation":"名詞「麵粉」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"flute","explanation":"名詞「長笛」。一種木管樂器，透過吹氣進入孔洞來發聲。","entries":[{"sentence":"The girl has been practicing the <target>flute</target> for three years, and she will perform a solo piece at the school's music concert.","translation":"這個女孩練習長笛已有三年，她將在學校的音樂會上表演一段獨奏。","explanation":"名詞「長笛」。"},{"sentence":"The sound of the <target>flute</target> is soft and clear, making it a popular choice for students who enjoy peaceful and melodic music.","translation":"長笛的聲音柔和且清晰，使其成為喜愛平靜且悠揚音樂的學生的流行選擇。","explanation":"名詞「長笛」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"foggy","explanation":"形容詞「多霧的；模糊的」。可用於描述天氣，或比喻地描述記憶、想法不清晰。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver had to slow down because the <target>foggy</target> weather made it difficult to see the road ahead clearly.","translation":"駕駛必須減速，因為多霧的天氣使前方道路難以清晰看見。","explanation":"形容詞「多霧的」。描述天氣狀況。"},{"sentence":"I have a <target>foggy</target> <pattern>recollection of</pattern> my first day of kindergarten, as I was only four years old at the time.","translation":"我對幼稚園第一天的記憶很模糊，因為當時我才四歲。","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的」。常用搭配 foggy recollection/memory (模糊的記憶)。"}],"related_forms":["fogginess"]}

{"headword":"fold","explanation":"動詞「折疊」；名詞「折痕；群體」。常考用法：fold up (折起來)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student carefully <target>folded</target> the map <pattern>up</pattern> and put it in his backpack before leaving the library.","translation":"學生小心地將地圖折起來，在離開圖書館前將其放入背包中。","explanation":"動詞片語 fold up 表示「折疊起來」。"},{"sentence":"To make the origami crane, you must <target>fold</target> the square piece of paper <pattern>into</pattern> several precise shapes.","translation":"為了製作摺紙鶴，你必須將正方形的紙片折成幾個精確的形狀。","explanation":"動詞「折疊」。常用搭配 fold into sth (折成...形狀)。"},{"sentence":"The laundry basket was full of clean clothes, and she spent the afternoon <target>folding</target> the shirts and trousers.","translation":"洗衣籃裡裝滿了乾淨的衣服，她花了一個下午在折疊襯衫和長褲。","explanation":"動詞「折疊」。"},{"sentence":"After the long meeting, the committee decided to <target>fold</target> the small project because they lacked enough funding and manpower.","translation":"經過長會後，委員會決定放棄該小項目，因為他們缺乏足夠的資金和人力。","explanation":"動詞「倒閉；放棄」。常用於描述公司或計劃的終結。"},{"sentence":"The tailor examined the <target>fold</target> in the fabric to see if the garment would fit the customer perfectly.","translation":"裁縫檢查布料上的折痕，以確認衣服是否能完美貼合顧客。","explanation":"名詞「折痕」。"}],"related_forms":["folded"]}

{"headword":"follower","explanation":"名詞「追隨者；粉絲」。指追隨某人的思想、信仰或在社交媒體上關注某人的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist gained thousands of <target>followers</target> on Instagram after her unique painting style went viral across the internet.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家在她的獨特繪畫風格在網路上走紅後，在 Instagram 上獲得了數千名追隨者。","explanation":"名詞「追隨者；粉絲」。指社交媒體上的關注者。"},{"sentence":"Historically, the philosopher's <target>followers</target> spread his ideas about ethics and justice to people in different parts of the world.","translation":"在歷史上，這位哲學家的追隨者將他關於倫理和正義的思想傳播給世界不同地區的人們。","explanation":"名詞「追隨者」。指支持某種思想或信仰的人。"}],"related_forms":["follow"]}

{"headword":"fond","explanation":"形容詞「喜愛的； fond of sth/sb」。注意與 like 的區別：fond 強調一種持久的、基於情感的喜好。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandmother is very <target>fond</target> <pattern>of</pattern> gardening, spending every morning tending to the colorful flowers in her backyard.","translation":"我的祖母非常喜愛園藝，每天早上都在後院照顧那些五彩繽紛的花朵。","explanation":"形容詞「喜愛的」。常用搭配 fond of sth (喜愛某事)。"},{"sentence":"As a child, he was <target>fond</target> <pattern>of</pattern> reading adventure stories, which sparked his lifelong passion for exploring the unknown.","translation":"小時候他很喜歡讀冒險故事，這激發了他終身探索未知之事的熱情。","explanation":"形容詞「喜愛的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"forever","explanation":"副詞「永遠地；極長時間地」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two old friends promised to stay in touch <target>forever</target>, no matter where their future careers took them in the world.","translation":"這兩個老朋友承諾無論未來的職涯將他們帶往世界的哪個角落，都會永遠保持聯繫。","explanation":"副詞「永遠地」。"},{"sentence":"I feel like it takes <target>forever</target> for the school bus to arrive in the morning, especially when it is raining heavily.","translation":"我覺得早上校車到達需要花極長時間，尤其是下大雨的時候。","explanation":"副詞「極長時間地」。用於誇張地描述時間久。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fortune","explanation":"名詞「財富；運氣」。常用片語 make a fortune (發財)； a fortune in... (極大金額)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The entrepreneur <target>made</target> a <target>fortune</target> by inventing a new type of biodegradable plastic that reduces environmental pollution.","translation":"這位企業家透過發明一種新型的生物可分解塑料來發財，從而減少環境污染。","explanation":"名詞「財富」。常用搭配 make a fortune (發財)。"},{"sentence":"It costs a <target>fortune</target> to renovate the old library, so the school has to seek donations from wealthy alumni.","translation":"翻新這座舊圖書館需要花費極大金額，因此學校必須尋求富有校友的捐助。","explanation":"名詞「財富」。常用搭配 cost a fortune (花費極其昂貴)。"},{"sentence":"By a stroke of <target>fortune</target>, the student found the missing textbook just before the final exam started the next morning.","translation":"幸運的是，這名學生在第二天早上期末考開始之前，剛好找到了失蹤的教科書。","explanation":"名詞「運氣」。常用搭配 a stroke of fortune (一場幸運)。"}],"related_forms":["fortunate"]}

{"headword":"fountain","explanation":"名詞「噴泉；飲水機」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists gathered around the beautiful <target>fountain</target> in the center of the city square to take photos of the dancing water.","translation":"遊客們聚集在城市廣場中心的美麗噴泉周圍，拍攝跳舞的水花。","explanation":"名詞「噴泉」。"},{"sentence":"Students usually fill their water bottles at the <target>fountain</target> in the hallway to stay hydrated during their long study sessions.","translation":"學生通常在走廊的飲水機處裝水，以便在長時間的學習過程中保持水分。","explanation":"名詞「飲水機」。"}],"related_forms":["fountains"]}

{"headword":"frank","explanation":"形容詞「坦率的；直率的」。指誠實且直接地表達想法，不刻意掩飾。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager gave a <target>frank</target> <pattern>assessment of</pattern> the employee's performance, highlighting both strengths and areas that needed improvement.","translation":"經理對員工的表現給出了坦率的評估，強調了優點以及需要改進的地方。","explanation":"形容詞「坦率的」。常用搭配 frank assessment (坦率的評估)。"},{"sentence":"To be <target>frank</target> <pattern>with</pattern> you, I don't think the proposed plan is practical enough to be implemented in our school.","translation":"坦白跟你說，我不認為提議的計劃在我們學校足夠實用，可以被執行。","explanation":"形容詞「坦率的」。常用搭配 To be frank with sb (坦白對某人說)。"}],"related_forms":["frankly","frankness"]}

{"headword":"freeze","explanation":"動詞「結冰；凍結；停止移動」；名詞「凍結」。注意動詞不規則變化：freeze-froze-frozen。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lake <target>froze</target> <pattern>over</pattern> during the severe winter, allowing people to go ice skating on its surface.","translation":"在嚴冬期間，湖泊結冰了，使人們可以在湖面上溜冰。","explanation":"動詞「結冰」。常用搭配 freeze over (完全結冰)。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher suddenly entered the classroom, the students <target>froze</target> in their seats, fearing they would be caught talking.","translation":"當老師突然進入教室時，學生們在座位上僵住了，擔心他們會被抓到在聊天。","explanation":"動詞「停止移動」。指因驚訝或恐懼而僵住。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>freeze</target> the salaries of all public employees to save money during the economic crisis.","translation":"政府決定凍結所有公務員的薪水，以在經濟危機期間節省資金。","explanation":"動詞「凍結」。指停止增加或增加的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The company announced a <target>freeze</target> <pattern>on</pattern> hiring new staff to reduce costs during the slow business season.","translation":"公司宣布凍結招聘新員工，以在淡季期間降低成本。","explanation":"名詞「凍結」。常用搭配 freeze on sth (對...的凍結)。"}],"related_forms":["froze","frozen"]}

{"headword":"freezer","explanation":"名詞「冷凍庫；冷凍櫃」。指用來將食物長期保存的電器。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please put the frozen peas and ice cream in the <target>freezer</target> so they don't melt or spoil quickly.","translation":"請將冷凍豌豆和冰淇淋放入冷凍庫，以免它們很快融化或變質。","explanation":"名詞「冷凍庫」。"},{"sentence":"The family bought a large chest <target>freezer</target> to store bulk quantities of meat and seafood for the whole winter.","translation":"這家人買了一個大型的冷凍櫃，以便在整個冬天儲存大量肉類和海鮮。","explanation":"名詞「冷凍庫」。常用搭配 chest freezer (冷凍櫃)。"}],"related_forms":["freezers"]}
