response: {"headword":"frequent","explanation":"形容詞「頻繁的、經常的」；動詞「經常光顧」。作為形容詞時，常與 occur 或 visit 搭配；作為動詞時，指經常去某個地方（如餐廳、書店）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city has <target>frequent</target> bus services that run every ten minutes, making it very convenient for students to commute to school.","translation":"這座城市有頻繁的巴士服務，每十分鐘一班，讓學生通勤上學非常方便。","explanation":"形容詞「頻繁的」。指事情發生的次數很多。"},{"sentence":"The teacher noticed <target>frequent</target> <pattern>errors</pattern> in the students' essays and decided to hold a special workshop on grammar.","translation":"老師注意到學生論文中頻繁出現的錯誤，決定舉辦一場關於文法的特別工作坊。","explanation":"形容詞「頻繁的」。常用搭配：frequent errors (頻繁的錯誤), frequent visitors (常客)。"},{"sentence":"During his college years, he would <target>frequent</target> the local library to study in peace and read academic journals.","translation":"在大學期間，他經常光顧當地的圖書館，以便在安靜的環境中學習並閱讀學術期刊。","explanation":"動詞「經常光顧」。指習慣性地去某個地方。"}],"related_forms":["frequently"]}

{"headword":"fright","explanation":"名詞「驚恐、恐懼」。通常指突然受到驚嚇而產生的恐懼感。常用片語 give someone a fright (嚇某人一跳) 或 in fright (驚恐地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden sound of a loud thunderclap <pattern>gave</pattern> the young child a terrible <target>fright</target>, causing him to jump in surprise.","translation":"突然的一聲巨雷把那個小孩嚇了一大跳，讓他驚訝地跳了起來。","explanation":"名詞「驚恐」。常用片語 give someone a fright (嚇某人一跳)。"},{"sentence":"The deer froze in <target>fright</target> when it saw the headlights of the car approaching quickly on the dark road.","translation":"當鹿在黑暗的道路上看到汽車大燈快速靠近時，它因驚恐而僵住了。","explanation":"名詞「驚恐」。常用片語 in fright (驚恐地)。"}],"related_forms":["frighten","frightened","frightening"]}

{"headword":"frighten","explanation":"動詞「使驚恐、嚇唬」。注意 frighten 與 afraid 的區別：frighten 是動詞，表示「使...害怕」；afraid 是形容詞，表示「感到害怕的」。常用被動形式 be frightened of (害怕...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site <target>frightened</target> the birds, causing them to fly away from the park immediately.","translation":"建築工地傳來的巨大噪音嚇到了鳥類，使它們立即從公園飛走。","explanation":"動詞「使驚恐」。"},{"sentence":"Many children are <target>frightened</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the dark, so they often ask their parents to leave a small light on in the room.","translation":"許多孩子害怕黑暗，所以他們經常要求父母在房間裡留一盞小燈。","explanation":"動詞的被動用法，表示狀態。常用搭配：be frightened of sth (害怕某事)。"}],"related_forms":["fright","frighteningly"]}

{"headword":"fuel","explanation":"名詞「燃料」；動詞「給...提供燃料」或比喻為「激起、加劇 (情緒或爭論)」。在 GSAT 中，比喻用法（如 fuel a debate）非常常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"Solar energy is a clean source of <target>fuel</target> that can help reduce the amount of pollution in the atmosphere.","translation":"太陽能是一種清潔的燃料來源，可以幫助減少大氣中的污染量。","explanation":"名詞「燃料」。指用來產生能量的物質。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to invest more money in developing alternative <target>fuels</target> to decrease the reliance on oil.","translation":"政府決定投資更多資金開發替代燃料，以減少對石油的依賴。","explanation":"名詞「燃料」。常用搭配：alternative fuel (替代燃料), fossil fuel (化石燃料)。"},{"sentence":"The politician's controversial comments only <target>fueled</target> the <pattern>argument</pattern> between the two opposing groups, making the situation worse.","translation":"這位政治家有爭議的言論只會加劇兩個對立團體之間的爭論，使情況變得更糟。","explanation":"動詞「加劇」。比喻將燃料加入火中，使情緒或爭論升溫。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fund","explanation":"名詞「基金、資金」；動詞「資助、出資」。名詞常用片語 raise funds (籌款)；動詞常接 for 或 to 表示資助的目的。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council organized a bake sale to <pattern>raise</pattern> <target>funds</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the local animal shelter's medical supplies.","translation":"學生會舉辦了一場烘焙義賣，為當地動物收容所的醫療用品籌集資金。","explanation":"名詞「資金」。常用搭配：raise funds for sth (為...籌款)。"},{"sentence":"The university created a special <target>fund</target> to provide scholarships for students who have excellent grades but lack financial support.","translation":"大學設立了一項特別基金，為成績優異但缺乏經濟支持的學生提供獎學金。","explanation":"名詞「基金」。指專門用途的一筆錢。"},{"sentence":"The government agreed to <target>fund</target> the research project <pattern>to</pattern> find a more effective cure for the rare disease.","translation":"政府同意出資資助這項研究計畫，以尋找治療這種罕見病更有效的方法。","explanation":"動詞「資助」。指提供金錢以支持某項活動或研究。"}],"related_forms":["funding"]}

{"headword":"fur","explanation":"名詞「皮毛」。指動物身上的毛。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cat has thick, soft <target>fur</target> that keeps it warm during the cold winter months in the northern mountains.","translation":"這隻貓有厚實柔軟的皮毛，讓它在北山寒冷的冬季保持溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「皮毛」。"},{"sentence":"Some people choose not to wear clothing made of real <target>fur</target> because they want to protect animal rights.","translation":"有些人選擇不穿真皮毛製成的衣服，因為他們想要保護動物權利。","explanation":"名詞「皮毛」。常用搭配：real fur (真皮毛), faux fur (人造皮毛)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gallon","explanation":"名詞「加侖」。一種液體容量單位，常用於美國的油量或牛奶標記。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver stopped at the gas station to fill his car's tank with twenty <target>gallons</target> of gasoline before the road trip.","translation":"司機在出發公路旅行前，在加油站為汽車油箱加了二十加侖的汽油。","explanation":"名詞「加侖」。液體容量單位。"},{"sentence":"The recipe for the large party required several <target>gallons</target> of orange juice to make enough punch for all the guests.","translation":"這場大型派對的食譜需要好幾加侖的柳橙汁，才能為所有客人製作足夠的賓客飲料。","explanation":"名詞「加侖」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gamble","explanation":"名詞「賭博、冒險」；動詞「賭博、冒險」。常用片語 take a gamble (冒一次險) 或 gamble on sth (對...下注/賭...會成功)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He decided to <target>gamble</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the new technology, believing it would revolutionize the market despite the high risks.","translation":"他決定在項新技術上採取冒險，儘管風險很高，但他相信它將會徹底改變市場。","explanation":"動詞「冒險/賭」。常用搭配 gamble on sth (賭某事會成功)。"},{"sentence":"Choosing to study a very rare subject in college was a bit of a <target>gamble</target>, but it eventually led to a unique career.","translation":"在大學選擇學習一個非常罕見的科目有點像在冒險，但最終這為他帶來了獨特的職業生涯。","explanation":"名詞「冒險」。指採取有風險的行動。"},{"sentence":"Many people lose their life savings when they <pattern>take</pattern> a <target>gamble</target> in casinos without understanding the odds of winning.","translation":"許多人在不了解獲勝機率的情況下在賭場賭博，結果失去了他們一輩子的積蓄。","explanation":"名詞「賭博」。常用片語 take a gamble (進行賭博/冒險)。"}],"related_forms":["gambler","gambling"]}

{"headword":"gang","explanation":"名詞「幫派、一群人」；動詞「聚集、結夥」。注意名詞用法中，除了犯罪幫派，也可以非正式地指「一群好朋友」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are trying to break up the violent <target>gang</target> that has been controlling the drug trade in the neighborhood.","translation":"警方正試圖瓦解那個一直在該社區控制毒品交易的暴力幫派。","explanation":"名詞「幫派」。指一群從事非法活動的人。"},{"sentence":"Every Friday night, the whole <target>gang</target> of friends meets at the local cinema to watch the latest movies together.","translation":"每個週五晚上，這群好朋友都會在當地的電影院集合，一起看最新的電影。","explanation":"名詞「一群人」。非正式用法，指一群親近的朋友。"},{"sentence":"The teenagers were accused of <target>ganging</target> <pattern>up</pattern> <pattern>against</pattern> the new student, making him feel isolated and unwelcome.","translation":"那些青少年被指控結夥對抗新學生，使他感到孤立且不受歡迎。","explanation":"動詞片語 gang up against/on sb 「團結起來對付某人」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gap","explanation":"名詞「缺口、差距、間隔」。常考搭配包括 generation gap (代溝) 或 bridge the gap (彌補差距/縮小差距)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a significant <target>gap</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the rich and the poor in many developing countries, leading to social instability.","translation":"在許多開發中國家，貧富之間存在著巨大的差距，導致社會不穩定。","explanation":"名詞「差距」。常用搭配：gap between A and B (A與B之間的差距)。"},{"sentence":"The teenager often argued with his father because of the <pattern>generation</pattern> <target>gap</target>, as they had very different views on music and fashion.","translation":"這個青少年經常與父親爭吵，因為代溝的原因，他們對音樂和時尚有截然不同的看法。","explanation":"名詞「代溝」。常用搭配：generation gap。"},{"sentence":"The new government program aims to <pattern>bridge</pattern> the <target>gap</target> in education by providing free books to children in rural areas.","translation":"新政府計畫旨在透過向農村地區的孩子提供免費書籍，來彌補教育上的差距。","explanation":"名詞「差距」。常用搭配：bridge the gap (彌補差距)。"},{"sentence":"While walking through the fence, the small dog found a <target>gap</target> large enough to squeeze through and escape into the garden.","translation":"在穿過圍欄時，這隻小狗發現了一個足夠大的缺口，可以擠過去並逃進花園裡。","explanation":"名詞「缺口」。指物理上的縫隙或間隔。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "garage", "explanation": "名詞「車庫」。指存放車輛的場所。注意在英式英語中， garage 亦可指汽車維修廠。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My father spent the entire weekend cleaning and organizing the <target>garage</target>, making sure all the tools were placed in the correct spots.", "translation": "我父親花整個週末清理並整理車庫，確保所有工具都放在正確的位置。", "explanation": "名詞「車庫」。"}, {"sentence": "After the heavy rain, he realized that his car was still in the <target>garage</target>, so it remained clean and dry despite the storm.", "translation": "大雨後，他意識到他的車還在車庫裡，所以儘管有風暴，車子依然保持乾淨和乾燥。", "explanation": "名詞「車庫」。"}, {"sentence": "The driver took his vehicle to a local <target>garage</target> to have the brakes repaired by a professional mechanic before the long trip.", "translation": "駕駛員將車輛送到當地的汽車維修廠進行煞車維修，以便在長途旅行前由專業機械師處理。", "explanation": "名詞「維修廠」。展示英式英語用法。"}], "related_forms": ["garages"]}

{"headword":"gasoline","explanation":"名詞「汽油」。美國英語常用 gasoline 或縮寫 gas。英國英語則常用 petrol。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver realized he was running <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>gasoline</target> and had to find the nearest filling station before the car stopped.","translation":"駕駛意識到他快沒汽油了，必須在車子停止前找到最近的加油站。","explanation":"名詞「汽油」。常用片語 run out of gas (沒汽油了)。"},{"sentence":"Due to the sudden increase in <target>gasoline</target> prices, many people started using public transportation to save money on their daily commute.","translation":"由於汽油價格突然上漲，許多人開始使用大眾運輸工具，以節省每日通勤的費用。","explanation":"名詞「汽油」。"},{"sentence":"He stopped at a small <target>gas</target> station on the highway to refill his tank and buy some snacks for the long trip.","translation":"他在高速公路上的一家小加油站停下來加滿油，並為長途旅行買一些零食。","explanation":"名詞「汽油」的縮寫 gas。"}],"related_forms":["gas"]}

{"headword":"geography","explanation":"名詞「地理學」或「地理特徵」。指研究地球表面、氣候及地形的科學。","entries":[{"sentence":"In our <target>geography</target> class, the teacher explained how mountains and rivers shape the development of ancient civilizations around the world.","translation":"在我們的地理課上，老師解釋了山脈和河流如何塑造全球古代文明的發展。","explanation":"名詞「地理學」。"},{"sentence":"The unique <target>geography</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the island makes it a perfect place for rare plants and animals to survive and thrive.","translation":"這個島嶼獨特的地理特徵使其成為稀有植物和動物生存與繁衍的理想之地。","explanation":"名詞「地理特徵」。常用搭配 geography of + N。"}],"related_forms":["geographical","geographically","geographer"]}

{"headword":"gesture","explanation":"名詞「手勢、姿態」；動詞「用手勢表示」。常用於描述非語言溝通。常用片語 a gesture of (表示...的姿態/舉動)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a simple <target>gesture</target> to signal the students to be quiet, and they immediately stopped talking and looked at her.","translation":"老師用一個簡單的手勢示意學生安靜，他們立即停止說話並看向她。","explanation":"名詞「手勢」。"},{"sentence":"Sending a small gift after the visit was a kind <target>gesture</target> <pattern>of</pattern> appreciation that touched the host deeply.","translation":"訪問後送一份小禮物是一種表達感激之情的親切舉動，深深觸動了主人。","explanation":"名詞「舉動」。常用片語 a gesture of appreciation (表示感激的舉動)。"},{"sentence":"The guide <target>gestured</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> the entrance of the temple, inviting the tourists to follow him inside for a detailed tour.","translation":"導遊用手勢指向寺廟的入口，邀請遊客跟隨他進入內部進行詳細的參觀。","explanation":"動詞「用手勢表示」。常用搭配 gesture toward (指向...)。"}],"related_forms":["gestured","gesturing"]}

{"headword":"glance","explanation":"名詞/動詞「匆匆一瞥」。指快速地看一眼。常用片語 at a glance (一眼就看出), take a glance at (瞥視一眼)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She <target>glanced</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the clock on the wall and realized she only had five minutes left before the exam started.","translation":"她匆匆看了一眼牆上的時鐘，意識到在考試開始前她只剩下五分鐘了。","explanation":"動詞「匆匆一瞥」。常用搭配 glance at (瞥視)。"},{"sentence":"The student <pattern>took</pattern> a quick <target>glance</target> <pattern>at</pattern> his notes before entering the classroom, hoping to remember the key points.","translation":"學生在進入教室前快速瞥了一眼他的筆記，希望能記住重點。","explanation":"名詞「匆匆一瞥」。常用片語 take a glance at (瞥視一眼)。"},{"sentence":"The experienced doctor could tell <pattern>at</pattern> a <target>glance</target> that the patient was suffering from a severe cold and needed rest.","translation":"經驗豐富的醫生一眼就能看出病人患有嚴重的感冒且需要休息。","explanation":"名詞「匆匆一瞥」。常用片語 at a glance (一眼就看出)。"}],"related_forms":["glanced","glancing"]}

{"headword":"global","explanation":"形容詞「全球的、全世界的」。指涵蓋整個地球的範圍。常用於 global warming (全球暖化) 或 global economy (全球經濟)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many countries are working together to find a <target>global</target> <pattern>solution</pattern> to the problem of climate change and rising sea levels.","translation":"許多國家正共同努力尋找解決氣候變遷和海平面上升問題的全球方案。","explanation":"形容詞「全球的」。常用搭配 global solution (全球方案)。"},{"sentence":"The internet has created a <target>global</target> <pattern>village</pattern>, allowing people from different cultures to communicate and share ideas instantly.","translation":"網路創造了一個全球村，讓來自不同文化的人們能立即溝通並分享想法。","explanation":"形容詞「全球的」。常用搭配 global village (全球村)。"},{"sentence":"The sudden economic crisis had a <target>global</target> <pattern>impact</pattern>, affecting businesses and workers in almost every country in the world.","translation":"突然的經濟危機產生了全球性的影響，影響了世界上幾乎每個國家的企業和工人。","explanation":"形容詞「全球的」。常用搭配 global impact (全球影響)。"}],"related_forms":["globally","globalization"]}

{"headword": "glory", "explanation": "名詞「光榮、榮耀」。指因成就或成功而獲得的高聲譽。常用於描述運動員或歷史人物的成就。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The athlete trained hard for four years to achieve the <target>glory</target> <pattern>of</pattern> winning an Olympic gold medal.", "translation": "這名運動員刻苦訓練了四年，以追求贏得奧運金牌的光榮。", "explanation": "名詞「光榮」。常用搭配 glory of + N。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient temple was restored to its former <target>glory</target>, attracting thousands of tourists who wanted to see its original beauty.", "translation": "名詞「榮耀」。此處指建築物的壯麗或輝煌狀態。", "explanation": "名詞「榮耀」。"}, {"sentence": "Many soldiers fought bravely in the war to bring <target>glory</target> <pattern>to</pattern> their homeland, though many of them never returned.", "translation": "許多士兵在戰爭中勇敢地戰鬥以給予家鄉帶來光榮，儘管許多人從未回來。", "explanation": "名詞「光榮」。常用搭配 bring glory to sth/sb。"}], "related_forms": ["glorious", "glorify"]}

{"headword":"glow","explanation":"名詞/動詞「發光、紅潤」。指發出溫和的光或臉色紅潤。常用於描述光線、皮膚狀態或心情。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soft <target>glow</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the moonlight reflected on the lake, creating a peaceful and romantic atmosphere for the couple.","translation":"柔和的月光照在湖面上，為這對情侶營造出寧靜且浪漫的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「發光」。常用搭配 glow of + N。"},{"sentence":"After a long walk in the fresh air, her cheeks <target>glowed</target> with a healthy pink color, showing her vitality.","translation":"在新鮮空氣中散步後，她的臉頰呈現健康的粉紅色，顯示出她的活力。","explanation":"動詞「發光/紅潤」。指皮膚的顏色。"},{"sentence":"The small child <target>glowed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> pride when the teacher praised him in front of the entire class for his hard work.","translation":"當老師在全班面前稱讚他努力工作時，這個小孩子因自豪而面色紅潤。","explanation":"動詞「發光」。常用搭配 glow with pride (因自豪而面色紅潤)。"}],"related_forms":["glowing","glows"]}

{"headword": "golf", "explanation": "名詞「高爾夫球」；動詞「打高爾夫球」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Since my uncle enjoys spending time outdoors, he often <pattern>plays</pattern> <target>golf</target> with his friends at the local club every weekend.", "translation": "因為我的叔叔喜歡在戶外度過時間，他每個週末常在當地俱樂部與朋友一起打高爾夫球。", "explanation": "名詞「高爾夫球」。常用搭配 play golf。"}, {"sentence": "The professional <target>golf</target> player spent hours practicing his swing to ensure he could hit the ball into the hole precisely.", "translation": "這名專業高爾夫球手花了好幾個小時練習揮桿，以確保他能精確地將球擊入洞中。", "explanation": "名詞「高爾夫球」作為形容詞修飾名詞。"}, {"sentence": "He decided to <target>golf</target> during his summer vacation in Scotland, as the country is famous for its beautiful green courses.", "translation": "他決定在蘇格蘭的暑假期間打高爾夫球，因為這個國家以其美麗的綠色球場聞名。", "explanation": "動詞「打高爾夫球」。"}], "related_forms": ["golfer"]}

{"headword":"gossip","explanation":"名詞「閒聊、八卦」；動詞「說八卦」。注意 gossip 可指代說八卦的人 (a gossip)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The office workers often gathered in the break room to share the latest <target>gossip</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their coworkers' personal lives.","translation":"辦公室職員常聚集在休息室，分享關於同事私人生活的最新八卦。","explanation":"名詞「八卦」。常用搭配 gossip about + N。"},{"sentence":"My sister is a bit of a <target>gossip</target>, and she always knows exactly who is dating whom in our high school.","translation":"我姊姊有點愛說八卦，她總是準確知道我們高中裡誰在跟誰約會。","explanation":"名詞「愛說八卦的人」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students not to <target>gossip</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their classmates' mistakes, as it could hurt people's feelings.","translation":"老師警告學生不要在背後議論同班同學的錯誤，由於這可能會傷害他人的感受。","explanation":"動詞「說八卦」。常用搭配 gossip about + N。"}],"related_forms":["gossiping","gossips"]}

{"headword": "governor", "explanation": "名詞「州長、省長、總督」。在美國英語中，通常指一個州的最高行政首長。注意其職權範圍與總統 (President) 或市長 (Mayor) 不同。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>governor</target> signed the new education bill into law, providing more funding for rural schools to improve student learning environments.", "translation": "州長簽署了新的教育法案，為鄉村學校提供更多資金以改善學生的學習環境。", "explanation": "名詞「州長」。指一個州的最高行政首長。"}, {"sentence": "The state <target>governor</target> announced a new plan to reduce carbon emissions, urging citizens to use public transportation more frequently to protect the environment.", "translation": "州長宣布了一項減少碳排放的新計劃，敦促公民更頻繁地使用大眾運輸工具以保護環境。", "explanation": "名詞「州長」。"}, {"sentence": "During the press conference, the <target>governor</target> addressed the concerns of local residents regarding the construction of the new highway through the valley.", "translation": "在記者會上，州長回應了當地居民對於在山谷中建設新高速公路的擔憂。", "explanation": "名詞「州長」。"}], "related_forms": ["govern", "governance"]}

{"headword":"grab","explanation":"動詞「猛抓、奪取；匆忙地做」；名詞「抓取」。動詞常用於口語，指迅速且突然地抓取，或指匆忙地吃東西或做某事。常考片語：grab a bite (匆忙吃一點東西), grab someone's attention (吸引某人的注意)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the bell rang, the student <target>grabbed</target> his backpack and rushed out of the classroom to catch the school bus before it left.","translation":"鈴聲響起時，學生抓起背包，衝出教室以在校車開走前趕上車。","explanation":"動詞「猛抓」。指迅速且突然地抓取。"},{"sentence":"The bright colors and loud music of the advertisement were designed to <target>grab</target> <pattern>the attention of</pattern> potential customers quickly.","translation":"廣告的鮮豔色彩和大聲的音樂旨在迅速吸引潛在顧客的注意。","explanation":"動詞「吸引」。常用搭配 grab someone's attention。"},{"sentence":"Since they only had thirty minutes between classes, the friends decided to <target>grab</target> <pattern>a quick bite</pattern> at the cafeteria.","translation":"因為他們在課間只有三十分鐘，朋友們決定在食堂匆忙吃一點東西。","explanation":"動詞「匆忙地吃」。片語 grab a quick bite。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>grab</target> of the child's arm by the stranger caused the boy to scream loudly for help from his parents.","translation":"陌生人突然抓著孩子的手臂，導致男孩大聲向父母求救。","explanation":"名詞「抓取」。指迅速的抓取動作。"}],"related_forms":["grabs","grabbed","grabbing"]}

{"headword": "graduate", "explanation": "動詞「畢業」；名詞「畢業生」。注意動詞用法：graduate from (從...畢業)。注意 graduate 作為名詞時，其發音與動詞不同。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After four years of hard work and late nights, she finally <target>graduated</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the university with a degree in environmental science.", "translation": "經過四年的努力和熬夜，她終於從大學畢業，獲得了環境科學學位。", "explanation": "動詞「畢業」。常用搭配 graduate from sth。"}, {"sentence": "The company is looking for recent <target>graduates</target> who have strong communication skills and a passion for learning new technologies.", "translation": "公司正在尋找具有強大溝通能力且對學習新技術有熱情的應屆畢業生。", "explanation": "名詞「畢業生」。"}, {"sentence": "Many <target>graduates</target> find it challenging to secure a well-paying job immediately after leaving college due to the competitive global job market.", "translation": "由於全球就業市場的競爭，許多畢業生發現離開大學後立即獲得一份高薪工作具有挑戰性。", "explanation": "名詞「畢業生」。"}, {"sentence": "Although he was a top student in high school, he struggled to <target>graduate</target> <pattern>from</pattern> college because of some personal health issues.", "translation": "雖然他在高中時是一名頂尖學生，但由於一些個人健康問題，他在大學畢業方面遇到了困難。", "explanation": "動詞「畢業」。常用搭配 graduate from。"}, {"sentence": "The professor invited several distinguished <target>graduates</target> of the program to share their professional experiences with the current senior students.", "translation": "教授邀請了該課程的幾位傑出畢業生，與目前的四年級學生分享他們的專業經驗。", "explanation": "名詞「畢業生」。"}], "related_forms": ["graduation"]}

{"headword":"grasp","explanation":"動詞「緊握；理解」；名詞「抓緊；理解」。動詞用法指物理上的抓緊，或心智上的理解。常考搭配：grasp the meaning (理解意思), have a good grasp of (對...有很好的掌握)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baby <target>grasped</target> his father's finger tightly, showing a natural instinct to hold on to something for security.","translation":"嬰兒緊緊抓著父親的手指，顯示出一種天生的安全感需求，想要抓住某樣東西。","explanation":"動詞「緊握」。指物理上的抓緊。"},{"sentence":"Some students find it difficult to <target>grasp</target> the complex mathematical concepts taught in the advanced calculus class.","translation":"有些學生發現很難理解高等微積分課上教授的複雜數學概念。","explanation":"動詞「理解」。指心智上的領悟。"},{"sentence":"To succeed in the debate, she must have a firm <target>grasp</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the current political issues and the latest statistics.","translation":"為了在辯論中獲勝，她必須對當前的政治議題和最新的統計數據有堅定的掌握。","explanation":"名詞「掌握；理解」。常用搭配 have a grasp of sth。"}],"related_forms":["grasps","grasped","grasping"]}

{"headword":"grasshopper","explanation":"名詞「蚱蜢」。一種常見的跳躍昆蟲。","entries":[{"sentence":"While walking through the field, the boy spotted a bright green <target>grasshopper</target> jumping among the tall grass and tried to catch it.","translation":"在田野間行走時，男孩發現一隻亮綠色的蚱蜢在長草中跳躍，並試圖抓住它。","explanation":"名詞「蚱蜢」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>grasshopper</target> used its powerful back legs to jump far away from the predator that was trying to hunt it.","translation":"蚱蜢利用其強大的後腿，跳離試圖捕食它的掠食者。","explanation":"名詞「蚱蜢」。"}],"related_forms":["grasshoppers"]}

{"headword":"grassy","explanation":"形容詞「長滿草的」。常用於描述地表或地形。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children decided to have a picnic on the <target>grassy</target> slope of the hill, enjoying the fresh air and sunshine.","translation":"孩子們決定在小山丘長滿草的斜坡上野餐，享受新鮮空氣和陽光。","explanation":"形容詞「長滿草的」。"},{"sentence":"A small stream flowed through the <target>grassy</target> plain, creating a beautiful landscape that attracted many painters to visit.","translation":"一條小溪流經長滿草的平原，創造出美麗的景觀，吸引許多畫家前來參觀。","explanation":"形容詞「長滿草的」。"}],"related_forms":["grass"]}

{"headword":"greedy","explanation":"形容詞「貪婪的」。指對金錢、食物或權力等有過度需求的欲望。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>greedy</target> businessman decided to raise the prices of essential goods during the crisis, only to make more profit for himself.","translation":"這個貪婪的商人決定在危機期間提高基本商品的價格，以使自己獲得更多利潤。","explanation":"形容詞「貪婪的」。"},{"sentence":"The child was so <target>greedy</target> that he took all the cookies from the plate, leaving none for his younger sister.","translation":"孩子如此貪婪，以至於他拿走了盤子裡所有的餅乾，沒給他的妹妹留下任何一個。","explanation":"形容詞「貪婪的」。"}],"related_forms":["greed","greedily"]}

{"headword": "greenhouse", "explanation": "名詞「溫室」。用於在受控環境中生長植物的建築物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The botanist used a <target>greenhouse</target> to grow tropical plants that could not survive in the cold winter weather of the region.", "translation": "植物學家使用溫室來種植那些無法在該地區寒冷冬季天氣中生存的熱帶植物。", "explanation": "名詞「溫室」。"}, {"sentence": "To study the effects of global warming, the researchers placed several plants in a <target>greenhouse</target> where they could control the temperature.", "translation": "為了研究全球暖化的影響，研究人員將幾株植物放入一個溫室中，以便他們能控制溫度。", "explanation": "名詞「溫室」。"}, {"sentence": "Many farmers build a <target>greenhouse</target> to protect their crops from unexpected frost and to extend the growing season for certain vegetables.", "translation": "許多農民建造溫室來保護他們的作物免受意外霜凍的影響，並延長某些蔬菜的生長季節。", "explanation": "名詞「溫室」。"}], "related_forms": ["greenhouses"]}

{"headword":"grin","explanation":"動詞「露齒而笑」；名詞「露齒的笑容」。通常指一種寬闊的笑容，有時可能帶有滿意或得意之意。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student <target>grinned</target> <pattern>from ear to ear</pattern> when the teacher praised his excellent performance on the final exam.","translation":"當老師稱讚他在期末考中表現出色時，學生露齒而笑，笑容燦爛。","explanation":"動詞「露齒而笑」。片語 grin from ear to ear 表示笑容極其燦爛。"},{"sentence":"There was a wide <target>grin</target> on the boy's face when he finally managed to solve the difficult puzzle after an hour of trying.","translation":"當男孩在嘗試一小時後終於成功解開困難的謎題時，他的臉上帶著寬闊的笑容。","explanation":"名詞「露齒的笑容」。"}],"related_forms":["grins","grinned","grinning"]}

{"headword":"grocery","explanation":"名詞「食品雜貨」。通常指在 grocery store (雜貨店) 中售賣的商品。注意與 supermarket (超市) 的區別：grocery 側重於食物和家用雜貨。","entries":[{"sentence":"On her way home from school, she stopped at the local <target>grocery</target> store to buy some milk and fresh vegetables for dinner.","translation":"放學回家途中，她在當地的雜貨店買了一些牛奶和新鮮蔬菜準備晚餐。","explanation":"名詞「雜貨店」。常用搭配 grocery store。"},{"sentence":"My mother asked me to help her carry the <target>groceries</target> from the car into the kitchen after we finished shopping at the supermarket.","translation":"我們在超市購物後，母親要求我幫她把雜貨搬進廚房。","explanation":"名詞「食品雜貨」。常用複數形式 groceries。"}],"related_forms":["grocer"]}

{"headword":"guidance","explanation":"名詞「指導、指引」。指通過提供建議或幫助來引導他人。常用搭配 guidance from (來自...的指導) 或 under the guidance of (在...的指導下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"With the <target>guidance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her teacher, the student was able to complete the complex research project successfully.","translation":"在老師的指導下，這名學生能夠成功完成這個複雜的研究計畫。","explanation":"名詞「指導」。常用搭配 under the guidance of (在...的指導下)。"},{"sentence":"The career center provides professional <target>guidance</target> <pattern>for</pattern> high school students who are unsure about their future major in college.","translation":"職涯中心為那些不確定大學未來主修的高中生提供專業的指導。","explanation":"名詞「指導」。常用搭配 guidance for sb (為某人提供指導)。"}],"related_forms":["guide","guidance counselor"]}

{"headword":"gum","explanation":"名詞「口香糖」或「牙齦」。口香糖通常指 chewing gum；牙齦則指牙齒周圍的組織。注意與 gum (樹膠) 的區別，但在 GSAT 中最常見的是前兩者。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student was scolded by the teacher because he stuck a piece of chewing <target>gum</target> under the classroom desk.","translation":"這名學生被老師責備，因為他把一塊口香糖黏在教室課桌下。","explanation":"名詞「口香糖」。指可咀嚼的糖果。"},{"sentence":"The dentist advised the patient to use a softer toothbrush to avoid damaging the sensitive <target>gums</target> during daily cleaning.","translation":"牙醫建議患者使用較軟的牙刷，以避免在日常清潔過程中傷害敏感的牙齦。","explanation":"名詞「牙齦」。指牙齒周圍的肉質組織。"}],"related_forms":[]}

response: {"headword":"hairdresser","explanation":"名詞「美髮師」。指專門從事美髮、剪髮或染髮的人。常用搭配 go to the hairdresser (去美髮店/找美髮師)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to visit the <target>hairdresser</target> before the graduation party to get a new hairstyle that would look great in photos.","translation":"她在畢業派對之前決定去美髮店，剪一個在照片中看起來很棒的新髮型。","explanation":"名詞「美髮師」。指專業的剪髮人員。"},{"sentence":"The experienced <target>hairdresser</target> suggested a shorter cut and a different color to better suit the student's face shape.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的美髮師建議剪短一點並換個顏色，以更適合該學生的臉型。","explanation":"名詞「美髮師」。"}],"related_forms":["hairdressing"]}

{"headword":"hallway","explanation":"名詞「走廊、通道」。指建築物內部連接不同房間的長條形通道。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students walked quietly through the long <target>hallway</target> of the school building to avoid disturbing the other classes in session.","translation":"學生們安靜地走在學校建築的長走廊上，以避免打擾其他正在上課的班級。","explanation":"名詞「走廊」。指建築內部連接房間的通道。"},{"sentence":"At the end of the <target>hallway</target>, there is a large trophy case displaying all the achievements of the school's sports teams.","translation":"在走廊的盡頭，有一個巨大的獎盃櫃，展示著學校運動隊的所有成就。","explanation":"名詞「走廊」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "hammer", "explanation": "名詞「錘子」；動詞「用錘子敲打」。名詞常用於描述工具；動詞則可用於比喻，如 hammer out (敲定/達成共識)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He used a heavy <target>hammer</target> to drive the nail into the wooden board to fix the broken chair in the classroom.", "translation": "他用一把沉重的錘子將釘子釘入木板，以修理教室裡破損的椅子。", "explanation": "名詞「錘子」。指一種用於敲擊的工具。"}, {"sentence": "The two student representatives spent hours trying to <target>hammer</target> <pattern>out</pattern> a final agreement on the theme of the school festival.", "translation": "兩位學生代表花了好幾個小時試圖敲定學校祭典主題的最終協議。", "explanation": "動詞片語 hammer out 指「敲定/達成協議」。常用於比喻敲擊直到成型。"}, {"sentence": "The jeweler carefully used a small <target>hammer</target> to shape the gold ring, ensuring every detail was perfect before selling it to the customer.", "translation": " jewellery 匠人小心地使用一把小錘子來塑造金戒指，確保在賣給客戶之前每個細節都完美。", "explanation": "名詞「錘子」。"}, {"sentence": "After weeks of intense negotiation, the two countries finally managed to <target>hammer</target> <pattern>out</pattern> a peace treaty to end the long-standing conflict.", "translation": "經過數週的激烈協商，兩個國家終於成功敲定了和平條約，以結束長期存在的衝突。", "explanation": "動詞片語 hammer out 用於比喻達成共識。"}, {"sentence": "The carpenter continued to <target>hammer</target> the nails into the wall, creating a loud noise that woke up the neighbors in the early morning.", "translation": "木工繼續將釘子敲入牆中，製造出巨大的噪音，在清晨喚醒了鄰居們。", "explanation": "動詞「用錘子敲打」。"}], "related_forms": ["hammered"]}

{"headword":"handful","explanation":"名詞「一把、少數」。指可以用手抓起的一小把，或比喻為數量極少的人或物。常用搭配 a handful of (少數幾個...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef added a <target>handful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fresh herbs to the soup to give it a more natural and aromatic flavor.","translation":"廚師在湯中加入了一把新鮮香草，以使其具有更自然且芳香的風味。","explanation":"名詞「一把」。指可以用手抓取的量。"},{"sentence":"Only a <target>handful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students volunteered to stay late after school to help clean up the campus for the open house.","translation":"只有少數幾個學生自願在放學後留下來，幫忙清理校園以準備開放日。","explanation":"名詞「少數」。指數量極少的人或物。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"handkerchief","explanation":"名詞「手帕」。指一塊用於擦拭或裝飾的小方巾。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old man pulled out a clean <target>handkerchief</target> from his pocket to wipe his eyes after watching the emotional movie.","translation":"看完感人的電影後，老人從口袋裡掏出一塊乾淨的手帕來擦拭眼睛。","explanation":"名詞「手帕」。"},{"sentence":"She carried a silk <target>handkerchief</target> in her bag just in case she needed to clean up a small spill on her desk.","translation":"她在包裡帶了一塊絲綢手帕，以防她需要清理桌上的小污漬。","explanation":"名詞「手帕」。"}],"related_forms":["handkerchiefs"]}

{"headword":"handy","explanation":"形容詞「方便的、 handy 」。指某物容易取得或使用，或某人擅長修理東西 (be handy with sth)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please keep a dictionary <target>handy</target> while reading the English novel so you can quickly look up any unfamiliar words.","translation":"閱讀英文小說時，請將字典放在手邊方便使用，這樣你就能快速查閱任何不熟悉的單字。","explanation":"形容詞「方便的、在手邊的」。指容易取得。"},{"sentence":"My father is very <target>handy</target> <pattern>with</pattern> tools, and he can fix almost any broken appliance in our house without professional help.","translation":"我的父親非常擅長使用工具，不需要專業協助就能修理家裡幾乎所有損壞的電器。","explanation":"形容詞「擅長使用...的」。常用搭配 be handy with sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"hanger","explanation":"名詞「衣架」。指用於將衣服掛在衣櫥中以保持其形狀的器具。","entries":[{"sentence":"He carefully placed his school uniform on a plastic <target>hanger</target> and hung it in the closet to prevent it from wrinkling.","translation":"他小心地將校服掛在塑料衣架上，然後將其掛在衣櫥裡以防止起皺。","explanation":"名詞「衣架」。"},{"sentence":"The store clerk asked the customer to put the clothes back on the <target>hanger</target> after they had finished trying them on.","translation":"店員要求顧客在試穿完衣服後，將衣服重新掛回衣架上。","explanation":"名詞「衣架」。"}],"related_forms":["hangers"]}

{"headword":"harbor","explanation":"名詞「港口」；動詞「庇護、心懷」。名詞指船隻停泊的地方；動詞則指提供庇護或在心中持有（通常是負面的）想法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The large cruise ship slowly entered the <target>harbor</target> after a month-long voyage across the Atlantic Ocean.","translation":"這艘大型郵輪在橫跨大西洋一個月的航行後，緩緩進入港口。","explanation":"名詞「港口」。指船隻停泊的地方。"},{"sentence":"Despite their disagreement years ago, she decided not to <target>harbor</target> any <pattern>resentment</pattern> <pattern>toward</pattern> her former classmate.","translation":"儘管多年前他們有分歧，她決定不再對前同學心懷怨恨。","explanation":"動詞「心懷」。常用搭配 harbor resentment toward sb (對某人心懷怨恨)。"},{"sentence":"The secret base was designed to <target>harbor</target> the fugitives, providing them with food and shelter from the police search.","translation":"這個秘密基地被設計來庇護逃犯，為他們提供食物和避難所以躲避警察的搜尋。","explanation":"動詞「庇護」。指提供藏身之處。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "harm", "explanation": "可作為名詞「傷害」或動詞「傷害」。注意其形容詞形式 harmful (有害的)。常用搭配 include do harm to (對...造成傷害) 或 be harmful to (對...有害)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The doctor assured the patient that the new medication would not <pattern>do</pattern> any <target>harm</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his health in the long run.", "translation": "醫生向病人保證，這種新藥長期來看不會對他的健康造成任何傷害。", "explanation": "名詞「傷害」。常用搭配 do harm to (對...造成傷害)。"}, {"sentence": "Some people believe that spending too much time on social media can <target>harm</target> a student's ability to concentrate on their studies.", "translation": "有些人認為花太多時間在社交媒體上會傷害學生的專注力。", "explanation": "動詞「傷害」。指對某人的健康、心理或名譽造成負面影響。"}, {"sentence": "Although the chemical is effective for killing insects, it can <target>harm</target> the surrounding environment if it is not used properly.", "translation": "雖然這種化學藥劑對殺蟲有效，但如果使用不當，可能會傷害周圍的環境。", "explanation": "動詞「傷害」。"}, {"sentence": "The lawyer argued that the defendant's actions did not cause any significant <target>harm</target> to the victim's reputation or professional career.", "translation": "律師辯稱被告的行為並未對受害者的名譽或職業生涯造成任何重大傷害。", "explanation": "名詞「傷害」。"}], "related_forms": ["harmful", "harmless"]}

{"headword":"harmful","explanation":"形容詞「有害的」。常用搭配 be harmful to (對...有害)。注意與 harmless (無害的) 相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government issued a warning that certain chemicals used in the factory were <target>harmful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the local environment and wildlife.","translation":"政府發布警告，稱工廠中使用某些化學物質對當地環境和野生動物有害。","explanation":"形容詞「有害的」。常用搭配 be harmful to。"},{"sentence":"Eating too many sugary snacks and processed foods can be <target>harmful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> your teeth and overall health.","translation":"食用過多含糖零食和加工食品對你的牙齒和整體健康有害。","explanation":"形容詞「有害的」。"}],"related_forms":["harm","harmless"]}

{"headword":"harvest","explanation":"可作為名詞「收穫」或動詞「收穫」。指農作物成熟後採集的过程。在現代英語中，也可用於描述採集數據或器官移植。","entries":[{"sentence":"After months of hard work in the fields, the farmers were happy to see a <pattern>bountiful</pattern> <target>harvest</target> of corn and wheat this year.","translation":"在田間辛苦工作數月後，農民們很高興看到今年玉米和小麥的大豐收。","explanation":"名詞「收穫」。常用形容詞搭配：bountiful/rich harvest (大豐收)。"},{"sentence":"The village usually <target>harvests</target> its grapes in early autumn to produce the highest quality wine for the international market.","translation":"這個村莊通常在早秋收穫葡萄，以便為國際市場生產最高品質的葡萄酒。","explanation":"動詞「收穫」。指農產品的採收。"}],"related_forms":["harvested","harvesting"]}

{"headword":"hasty","explanation":"形容詞「匆忙的、草率的」。指動作快速但缺乏周詳考慮。常用片語 make a hasty decision (做出草率的決定)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager warned the employees not to make a <target>hasty</target> <pattern>decision</pattern> without considering all the potential risks involved.","translation":"經理警告員工，在不考慮所有潛在風險的情況下，不要做出草率的決定。","explanation":"形容詞「草率的」。常用搭配 make a hasty decision。"},{"sentence":"Because he was running late for the interview, he made a <target>hasty</target> <pattern>exit</pattern> from his house, forgetting his portfolio on the table.","translation":"因為面試快遲到了，他匆忙地離開家，把作品集遺忘在桌上。","explanation":"形容詞「匆忙的」。指動作快速且缺乏準備。"}],"related_forms":["hastily","haste"]}

{"headword":"hatch","explanation":"動詞「孵化」。指幼鳥、幼魚或爬行類動物從蛋中破殼而出。名詞則指「孵化」或「艙門」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The biology students watched closely as the baby turtles finally <target>hatched</target> <pattern>from</pattern> their eggs and crawled toward the ocean.","translation":"生物課學生們密切觀察著小海龜終於從蛋中孵化出來並向大海爬去。","explanation":"動詞「孵化」。常用搭配 hatch from eggs。"},{"sentence":"The farmer used a special heating machine to help the ducklings <target>hatch</target> at the correct time and temperature.","translation":"農夫使用特殊的加熱機器來幫助小鴨在正確的時間和溫度下孵化。","explanation":"動詞「孵化」。"}],"related_forms":["hatching"]}

{"headword": "hateful", "explanation": "形容詞「可恨的、充滿恨意的」。指事物令人厭惡或某人表現出強烈的恨意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher told the students that using <target>hateful</target> <pattern>language</pattern> against others is never acceptable in the classroom.", "translation": "老師告訴學生，在教室裡對他人使用充滿恨意的語言是絕對不可接受的。", "explanation": "形容詞「充滿恨意的」。常用搭配 hateful language (仇恨言論)。"}, {"sentence": "The two rivals looked at each other with <target>hateful</target> expressions, remembering the betrayal that had occurred several years ago.", "translation": "兩個競爭對手以充滿恨意的表情看向彼此，想起了幾年前發生的背叛。", "explanation": "形容詞「充滿恨意的」。"}, {"sentence": "She found the comments on the internet to be absolutely <target>hateful</target>, as they attacked her personal appearance and family background.", "translation": "她發現網路上的評論絕對是充滿恨意的，因為這些評論攻擊她的個人外貌和家庭背景。", "explanation": "形容詞「可恨的/令人厭惡的」。"}], "related_forms": ["hatefully", "hate"]}

{"headword":"hay","explanation":"名詞「乾草」。指經過乾燥處理的草，常用作牲畜的冬季食物。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the winter months, the farmer stores a large amount of <target>hay</target> in the barn to feed the cows and horses.","translation":"在冬季，農民在穀倉中儲存大量乾草來餵養牛和馬。","explanation":"名詞「乾草」。"},{"sentence":"The horses rested comfortably on a thick bed of <target>hay</target> after a long day of work in the countryside.","translation":"馬匹在鄉間工作一整天後，舒服地躺在厚厚的乾草床上休息。","explanation":"名詞「乾草」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"headline","explanation":"名詞「標題」。指報紙或新聞網站文章的頂端大字。動詞則指「作為頭條新聞報導」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shocking news about the economic crisis <target>made</target> <pattern>the</pattern> <target>headlines</target> across the world, attracting millions of readers.","translation":"關於經濟危機的震驚消息成為了全世界的頭條新聞，吸引了數百萬讀者。","explanation":"名詞「頭條」。常用搭配 make the headlines (成為頭條新聞)。"},{"sentence":"A good journalist knows how to write a <pattern>catchy</pattern> <target>headline</target> that encourages people to click on the article and read more.","translation":"一名優秀的記者知道如何撰寫吸引人的標題，以鼓勵人們點擊文章並閱讀更多內容。","explanation":"名詞「標題」。常用形容詞搭配：catchy headline (吸引人的標題)。"}],"related_forms":["headlines"]}

{"headword":"headquarters","explanation":"名詞「總部」。指一個組織、公司或軍隊的核心管理中心。注意此詞單複數同形，動詞可用單數或複數。","entries":[{"sentence":"The multinational company decided to move its global <target>headquarters</target> to Tokyo to be closer to its Asian markets.","translation":"這家跨國公司決定將其全球總部搬遷至東京，以便更靠近其亞洲市場。","explanation":"名詞「總部」。"},{"sentence":"The police <target>headquarters</target> <pattern>is</pattern> located in the city center, making it easy for citizens to report crimes.","translation":"警察總部位於市中心，方便市民舉報犯罪。","explanation":"名詞「總部」。單複數同形，此處搭配單數動詞 is。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"heal","explanation":"動詞「癒合、治癒」。指傷口自然癒合或心理創傷的恢復。注意與 cure (治癒疾病) 的區別：heal 側重於過程，如傷口癒合 (wound heal) 或心理恢復 (emotional healing)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor explained that a small cut on the finger would usually <target>heal</target> <pattern>on</pattern> its own if kept clean.","translation":"醫生解釋說，手指上的小割傷通常如果保持清潔，會自行癒合。","explanation":"動詞「癒合」。常用搭配 heal on its own (自行癒合)。"},{"sentence":"It takes a long time for the heart to <target>heal</target> after a painful breakup, but time and support from friends help.","translation":"心碎後需要很長時間才能癒合，但時間和朋友的支持會有所幫助。","explanation":"動詞「治癒」。指心理上的恢復。"}],"related_forms":["healing","healer"]}

{"headword":"heap","explanation":"名詞指「一堆」，動詞則指「堆積」。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法較為常見，常搭配 a heap of (一堆...)。注意與 pile 的相似之處，但 heap 通常指雜亂無章的堆積。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's desk was covered in a <target>heap</target> <pattern>of</pattern> old textbooks and notebooks, making it hard for him to find his homework.","translation":"學生的書桌上堆滿了一堆舊教科書和筆記本，使他很難找到他的作業。","explanation":"名詞「一堆」。常用搭配 a heap of + 名詞。"},{"sentence":"After the storm, the workers had to <target>heap</target> the fallen branches <pattern>into</pattern> a large pile to clear the road for the cars.","translation":"風暴過後，工人必須將掉落的樹枝堆成一大堆，以便為汽車清理道路。","explanation":"動詞「堆積」。常用搭配 heap sth into a pile。"}],"related_forms":["heaps"]}
comment: Note: 'heap' is a versatile word, but 2 sentences are acceptable given the GSAT scope.

response: {"headword":"heater","explanation":"名詞「加熱器；電暖器」。指用於加熱空間或液體的設備。常用於冬季描述或科學實驗室環境。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the classroom was freezing during the winter, the teacher turned on the electric <target>heater</target> to keep the students warm.","translation":"由於冬天教室裡非常寒冷，老師開啟了電暖器以讓學生們保持溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「加熱器」。常用搭配 electric heater。"},{"sentence":"In the chemistry experiment, the students used a water <target>heater</target> to bring the liquid to a boil for further analysis.","translation":"在化學實驗中，學生使用水加熱器將液體加熱至沸騰，以便進一步分析。","explanation":"名詞「加熱器」。"}],"related_forms":["heaters"]}

{"headword":"heel","explanation":"名詞指「腳後跟」或「鞋跟」；動詞則指「傾斜」或「跟隨」。在 GSAT 考點中，名詞用法最為常見，特別是在描述身體部位或鞋類時。","entries":[{"sentence":"She felt a sharp pain in her <target>heel</target> after walking for several hours in high-heeled shoes during the graduation ceremony.","translation":"在畢業典禮上穿著高跟鞋走幾個小時後，她感到腳後跟劇痛。","explanation":"名詞「腳後跟」。"},{"sentence":"The cobbler carefully replaced the worn-out <target>heel</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the leather boots to make them comfortable for walking again.","translation":"鞋匠小心地更換了皮靴磨損的鞋跟，使其再次行走舒適。","explanation":"名詞「鞋跟」。常用搭配 heel of the shoe。"},{"sentence":"The small boat <target>heeled</target> <pattern>over</pattern> strongly when a sudden gust of wind hit the side of the vessel.","translation":"當一陣強風襲擊船身側面時，小船劇烈地向一側傾斜。","explanation":"動詞「傾斜」。常用搭配 heel over。"}],"related_forms":["heels"]}

{"headword":"hell","explanation":"名詞「地獄」。可用於指宗教上的地獄，或比喻指極其痛苦、糟糕的狀態或經歷。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many cultures have different beliefs about <target>hell</target>, describing it as a place of eternal punishment for those who do wrong.","translation":"許多文化對地獄有不同的信仰，將其描述為那些作惡之人的永恆懲罰之地。","explanation":"名詞「地獄」。指宗教概念。"},{"sentence":"The traffic jam during the rush hour was absolute <target>hell</target>, as hundreds of cars were stuck for hours without moving.","translation":"尖峰時段的交通堵塞簡直是地獄，因為數百輛汽車被困住數小時而無法移動。","explanation":"名詞「地獄」。比喻指極其糟糕的情況。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"helmet","explanation":"名詞「安全帽；頭盔」。指為了保護頭部而穿戴的設備。常用於描述交通安全、運動或軍事環境。","entries":[{"sentence":"For the safety of the riders, the police officer reminded everyone to wear a <target>helmet</target> <pattern>while</pattern> riding a motorcycle.","translation":"為了騎乘者的安全，警察提醒每個人在騎機車時都要戴安全帽。","explanation":"名詞「安全帽」。常用搭配 wear a helmet。"},{"sentence":"The construction workers must wear hard <target>helmets</target> <pattern>at</pattern> all times on the site to protect themselves from falling objects.","translation":"建築工人進入工地時必須隨時佩戴硬式安全帽，以保護自己免於掉落物。","explanation":"名詞「頭盔」。hard helmet 指「硬式安全帽」。"}],"related_forms":["helmets"]}

{"headword":"hesitate","explanation":"動詞「猶豫；遲疑」。指在做決定或採取行動前感到不安或不確定。常搭配 to V 或 about sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you have any questions about the application process, please do not <target>hesitate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> contact the admissions office immediately.","translation":"如果您對申請流程有任何疑問，請不要猶豫立即聯繫招生辦公室。","explanation":"動詞「猶豫」。常用搭配 do not hesitate to V。"},{"sentence":"She <target>hesitated</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a moment before answering the difficult question, as she wanted to make sure her answer was correct.","translation":"在回答這個困難的問題之前，她猶豫了一會兒，因為她想確保她的答案是正確的。","explanation":"動詞「猶豫」。"}],"related_forms":["hesitation","hesitantly"]}

{"headword":"hint","explanation":"名詞指「暗示；提示」；動詞則指「暗示」。常考片語 include a hint of (包含一點點...) 或 give a hint (給予提示)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher gave the students a small <target>hint</target> <pattern>to</pattern> help them solve the complex math problem without giving away the answer.","translation":"老師給了學生一個小提示，幫助他們解決這個複雜的數學問題，而沒有直接告知答案。","explanation":"名詞「提示」。常用搭配 give a hint。"},{"sentence":"There was a faint <target>hint</target> <pattern>of</pattern> perfume in the air, suggesting that someone had recently entered the room.","translation":"空氣中有一股淡淡的香水味，暗示著最近有人進入過房間。","explanation":"名詞「微量/暗示」。常用搭配 a hint of sth。"},{"sentence":"During the interview, the manager <target>hinted</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the company was looking for someone with strong leadership skills.","translation":"在面試過程中， manager 提示了公司正在尋找具有強大領導能力的候選人。","explanation":"動詞「暗示」。常用搭配 hint that..."}],"related_forms":["hints"]}

{"headword": "hire", "explanation": "動詞指「雇用」或「租用」；名詞指「被雇用者」。在 GSAT 中，動詞用法最為常見。注意與 employ 的區別：hire 較常用於指短期的租用或臨時雇傭。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The growing company decided to <target>hire</target> more experienced staff <pattern>to</pattern> handle the increasing amount of work and customer requests.", "translation": "這家成長中的公司決定雇用更多經驗豐富的員工，以處理日益增加的工作量和客戶要求。", "explanation": "動詞「雇用」。常用搭配 hire staff to V。"}, {"sentence": "For their summer vacation in Europe, the family decided to <target>hire</target> a car <pattern>for</pattern> a week to travel more flexibly.", "translation": "為了在歐洲的夏季假期，這家人決定租車一週，以便更靈活地旅行。", "explanation": "動詞「租用」。常用搭配 hire a car。"}, {"sentence": "The new <target>hire</target> was very impressed by the company's supportive environment and the professional training provided to all employees.", "translation": "這位新進員工對公司的支持性環境以及提供給所有員工的專業培訓感到印象深刻。", "explanation": "名詞「被雇用者」。指新進員工。"}], "related_forms": ["hired", "hiring"]}

{"headword":"historian","explanation":"名詞「歷史學家」。指專門研究歷史的人。常用於學術討論或文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous <target>historian</target> wrote a detailed book about the ancient Egyptian civilization, providing a new perspective on their social structure.","translation":"這位著名的歷史學家寫了一本關於古埃及文明的詳細書籍，提供了一個關於他們社會結構的新視角。","explanation":"名詞「歷史學家」。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>historians</target> <pattern>agree that</pattern> the Industrial Revolution changed the way people lived and worked forever.","translation":"許多歷史學家同意工業革命永遠地改變了人們生活和工作的方式。","explanation":"名詞「歷史學家」。"}],"related_forms":["history"]}

{"headword": "historic", "explanation": "形容詞「具有歷史意義的」。指重要地在歷史上被記錄或就將來將來被記錄之事件或地點。注意與 historical (與歷史相關的) 的區別：historic 是指重要性，而 historical 旨在描述事實或 historical documents (歷史文件)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The signing of the peace treaty was a <target>historic</target> <pattern>moment</pattern> for both countries, ending decades of conflict and bringing peace.", "translation": "簽署和平條約對兩個國家來說是一個具有歷史意義的時刻，結束了數十年的衝突並帶來了和平。", "explanation": "形容詞「具有歷史意義的」。常用搭配 historic moment。"}, {"sentence": "The city council decided to preserve the old town hall, as it is a <target>historic</target> <pattern>site</pattern> where many important decisions were made.", "translation": "translation\": \"市議會決定保留舊市政廳，因為它是一個許多重要決定被做出的具有歷史意義的地點。", "explanation": "形容詞 historic 指「歷史古蹟/具有歷史意義的地點」。"}], "related_forms": ["historically"]}

{"headword": "holder", "explanation": "名詞，意為「持有者」或「固定物（支架）」。在 GSAT 中，常指持有特定證件、資格或權利的人，如 cardholder (持卡人) 或 ticket holder (持票者)，或是指將某物固定在原位的工具。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To enter the private exhibition, every <pattern>ticket</pattern> <target>holder</target> must present a valid identification card at the entrance for verification.", "translation": "要進入私人展覽，每位持票者必須在入口處出示有效的身分證明文件以供驗證。", "explanation": "名詞「持有者」。常用搭配：ticket holder (持票者), cardholder (持卡人)。"}, {"sentence": "She placed the burning candle in a silver <target>holder</target> to prevent the wax from dripping onto the expensive wooden table.", "translation": "她將點燃的蠟燭放在一個銀色燭台中，以防止蠟滴在昂貴的木桌上。", "explanation": "名詞「固定物」。指用來固定或支撐某物的工具，如 candle holder (燭台)。"}, {"sentence": "The scholarship is only available to the <target>holder</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a recognized professional certification in the language teaching field.", "translation": "該獎學金僅提供給在語言教學領域持有認可之專業證照的人。", "explanation": "名詞「持有者」。"}], "related_forms": ["hold"]}

{"headword":"hollow","explanation":"形容詞指「空心的」或「虛假的」；名詞指「凹處」；動詞指「挖空」。在 GSAT 中，形容詞的「空心」與「虛假（如空洞的承諾）」是重點，注意其與 solid (實心的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The woodpecker pecked a <target>hollow</target> space inside the old oak tree to build a safe nest for its young offspring.","translation":"啄木鳥在老橡樹內部啄出一個空心的空間，以建立一個安全的巢穴給它的幼鳥。","explanation":"形容詞「空心的」。指物體內部是空的。"},{"sentence":"Many voters felt that the politician's promises were <target>hollow</target>, as he had failed to keep his previous commitments during his term.","translation":"許多選民覺得這位政治家的承諾是空洞的，因為他在任期內未能履行之前的承諾。","explanation":"形容詞「虛假的、空洞的」。指缺乏誠意或實質內容的承諾或言論。"},{"sentence":"The child found a small, <target>hollow</target> log by the river, which he used as a secret hiding place for his collection of pebbles.","translation":"名詞「凹處、空洞」。指地貌或物體上的空洞部分。這裡是指一個空心的原木。 ","explanation":"名詞「空洞」。"},{"sentence":"The craftsman used a specialized tool to <target>hollow</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the interior of the pumpkin to create a beautiful lantern for the festival.","translation":"工匠使用專業工具將南瓜內部挖空，以製作一個節日用的美麗燈籠。","explanation":"動詞片語 hollow out (挖空)。指將物體內部掏空。"}],"related_forms":["hollowly","hollowness"]}

{"headword":"holy","explanation":"形容詞，意為「神聖的」。常用於描述宗教、神靈或被視為極其重要且不容褻瀆的事物。注意與 wholly (完全地) 的拼寫區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The pilgrims traveled for months to visit the <target>holy</target> city of Jerusalem, hoping to find spiritual peace and guidance.","translation":"朝聖者們旅行數月以參訪神聖的耶路撒冷城，希望能找到心靈的平靜與指引。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。常用於宗教語境。"},{"sentence":"In many cultures, certain animals are regarded as <target>holy</target> symbols of purity and wisdom, and are therefore protected by law.","translation":"在許多文化中，某些動物被視為純潔與智慧的神聖象徵，因此受到法律保護。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。指被賦予宗教或精神價值的。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"homesick","explanation":"形容詞，意為「想家的」。描述一種因離開家鄉或親人而產生的憂鬱感。常用搭配為 feel homesick 或 become homesick。","entries":[{"sentence":"After moving to a foreign country for university, the freshman felt deeply <target>homesick</target> and spent hours talking to his parents on the phone.","translation":"在搬到國外讀大學後，這名大一新生感到非常想家，花了好幾個小時在電話中與父母交談。","explanation":"形容詞「想家的」。常用搭配：feel homesick (感到想家)。"},{"sentence":"The young soldier wrote letters home every day to cope with the feeling of being <target>homesick</target> while stationed in a remote area.","translation":"年輕的士兵每天寫信回家，以應對在偏遠地區駐守時想家的感覺。","explanation":"形容詞「想家的」。"}],"related_forms":["homesickness"]}

{"headword":"hometown","explanation":"名詞，意為「故鄉」。指一個人出生或成長的地方。在 GSAT 中，常作為背景設定出現在閱讀或作文中。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite living in the capital city for ten years, he still returns to his <target>hometown</target> every summer to visit his grandparents.","translation":"儘管在首都住了十年，他每年夏天仍回到故鄉探望祖父母。","explanation":"名詞「故鄉」。指出生或成長之地。"},{"sentence":"The local government is trying to revitalize the <target>hometown</target> industries to attract young people back from the big cities.","translation":"地方政府正試圖振興故鄉產業，以吸引年輕人從大城市回流。","explanation":"名詞「故鄉」。在此指地方性的故鄉產業。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"honesty","explanation":"名詞，意為「誠實」。指不欺騙、不偷竊且公正的品質。常用搭配為 honesty is the best policy (誠實是最好的策略)。注意與 honest (誠實的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student's <target>honesty</target> after he admitted that he had accidentally cheated on the math test.","translation":"在學生承認自己不小心在數學考試中作弊後，老師稱讚了他的誠實。","explanation":"名詞「誠實」。指一種道德品質。"},{"sentence":"Building a relationship based on <target>honesty</target> and trust is essential for any long-term partnership to be successful and healthy.","translation":"建立在誠實與信任基礎上的關係，對於任何長期合作夥伴關係的成功與健康都至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「誠實」。"}],"related_forms":["honest"]}

{"headword":"honor","explanation":"名詞指「榮譽」或「崇敬」；動詞指「給予榮譽」或「尊重」。常用搭配 include honor someone with (以...給予某人榮譽) 或 in honor of (為了紀念/尊重...而)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a great <target>honor</target> for the scientist to receive the Nobel Prize in Physics for his groundbreaking research on light.","translation":"對於這位科學家來說，能因其在光學方面的開創性研究而獲得諾貝爾物理學獎是一項極大的榮譽。","explanation":"名詞「榮譽」。指獲得的殊榮或地位。"},{"sentence":"The city held a grand parade <pattern>in</pattern> <target>honor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the returning soldiers to thank them for their bravery and sacrifice.","translation":"這座城市舉行了一場盛大的遊行，以紀念並感謝回鄉士兵的勇敢與犧牲。","explanation":"名詞片語 in honor of (為了紀念/尊重...而)。"},{"sentence":"The company promised to <target>honor</target> the original price of the product even after the official price increase took effect.","translation":"公司承諾即使在官方漲價生效後，仍會維持原價（尊重原定價格）。","explanation":"動詞「履行/尊重」。在此指履行合約或維持承諾的價格。"},{"sentence":"The school decides to <target>honor</target> the alumni who have made significant contributions to the local community through a special ceremony.","translation":"學校決定透過一場特別儀式來表彰對當地社區做出重大貢獻的校友。","explanation":"動詞「表彰/給予榮譽」。"}],"related_forms":["honorable","honored"]}

{"headword":"hopeful","explanation":"形容詞，意為「抱有希望的」或「有希望的」。可用於描述人的心情，或描述某種結果的可能性。注意與 hopeless (絕望的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the difficult circumstances, the young artist remained <target>hopeful</target> that her work would one day be displayed in a gallery.","translation":"儘管環境艱難，這位年輕藝術家依然抱有希望，認為她的作品有一天會在畫廊展出。","explanation":"形容詞「抱有希望的」。描述人的心理狀態。"},{"sentence":"The doctors are <target>hopeful</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the patient's recovery after the successful surgery and his positive response to the treatment.","translation":"在手術成功且病人對治療反應良好後，醫生對病人的康復抱有希望。","explanation":"形容詞「有希望的」。常用搭配：hopeful about sth (對...抱有希望)。"}],"related_forms":["hope","hopelessly"]}

{"headword": "horn", "explanation": "名詞，意為「角」或「喇叭」。在 GSAT 中，常指動物的角或車輛的警告喇叭。注意其在不同語境下的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The rhinoceros has a thick, hard <target>horn</target> on its nose, which it uses for defense and fighting other rivals.", "translation": "犀牛的鼻子上有一隻厚實強硬的角，用來防禦以及與其他競爭者搏鬥。", "explanation": "名詞「角」。指動物身體的一部分。"}, {"sentence": "The driver <pattern>honked</pattern> the <target>horn</target> loudly to warn the pedestrians who were crossing the street without looking at the traffic lights.", "translation": "駕駛大聲按喇叭以警告那些沒看紅綠燈就過馬路的行人。", "explanation": "名詞「喇叭」。常用搭配：honk the horn (按喇叭)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"horrible","explanation":"形容詞，意為「可怕的」或「極其糟糕的」。常用於描述令人不快的情緒、天氣、氣味或品質。注意與 horror (恐怖) 的關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"The survivors described the <target>horrible</target> experience of being trapped in the building during the earthquake for three days.","translation":"倖存者描述了在地震中被困在建築物內三天那種可怕的經驗。","explanation":"形容詞「可怕的」。指令人恐懼或不安的。"},{"sentence":"I had a <target>horrible</target> headache this morning, which made it impossible for me to concentrate on the lecture in class.","translation":"我今天早上頭痛得厲害，讓我完全無法集中精神聽課。","explanation":"形容詞「極其糟糕的」。常用於描述不適感或糟糕的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The smell of the rotting fish was so <target>horrible</target> that everyone in the room had to cover their noses and leave.","translation":"腐爛魚的味道如此糟糕，以至於房間裡的每個人都必須捂住鼻子離開。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的/令人厭惡的」。"}],"related_forms":["horribly","horror"]}

{"headword":"horror","explanation":"名詞「恐懼」或「恐怖」。常用於描述一種強烈的恐懼感，或指一種藝術/文學類型（如 horror movies）。常用搭配：to one's horror (令某人恐懼的是)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To her <target>horror</target>, she realized that she had forgotten her passport at home just as the plane was about to take off.","translation":"令她恐懼的是，就在飛機準備起飛時，她意識到自己把護照忘在家裡了。","explanation":"名詞「恐懼」。常用片語：to one's horror (令某人恐懼的是)。"},{"sentence":"Although some people enjoy the thrill of <target>horror</target> <pattern>movies</pattern>, others find them too disturbing to watch before going to sleep.","translation":"雖然有些人喜歡恐怖電影的刺激感，但有些人覺得在睡前看這些電影太令人不安。","explanation":"名詞「恐怖」。常用搭配：horror movie (恐怖電影)。"}],"related_forms":["horrified","horrifying","horrific"]}

{"headword": "hourly", "explanation": "可作形容詞或副詞。形容詞指「每小時的」，副詞指「每小時地」。常考點在於其時間頻率的描述，例如 hourly rates (時薪) 或 check hourly (每小時檢查)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The freelance designer charges an <target>hourly</target> <pattern>rate</pattern> for her services, making it easier for clients to pay for only the work they need.", "translation": "這位自由設計師為她的服務收取時薪，讓客戶能更方便地只為他們需要的工作付費。", "explanation": "形容詞「每小時的」。常用搭配：hourly rate (時薪)。"}, {"sentence": "During the storm, the weather station provided <target>hourly</target> <pattern>updates</pattern> to keep the public informed about the changing wind speed and rain intensity.", "translation": "風暴期間，氣象站每小時提供更新資訊，以讓公眾了解風速和雨量的變化。", "explanation": "形容詞「每小時的」。常用搭配：hourly updates (每小時更新)。"}, {"sentence": "The security guard was instructed to patrol the school corridors <target>hourly</target> to ensure that all classrooms were empty and locked.", "translation": "保全人員被指示每小時巡邏一次學校走廊，以確保所有教室都已清空並鎖上。", "explanation": "副詞用法，表示「每小時地」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"housekeeper","explanation":"名詞「管家」或「家庭主婦/夫」。指負責管理家庭內部事務、清潔和維護的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wealthy family employed a professional <target>housekeeper</target> to manage their large estate, ensuring that everything was clean and well-organized.","translation":"這個富裕的家庭聘請了一位專業的管家來管理他們的大型莊園，確保一切都乾淨且井然有序。","explanation":"名詞「管家」。指受僱管理房屋的人。"},{"sentence":"After her mother retired, Sarah took over the role of <target>housekeeper</target> in the family, handling the daily chores and meal preparation.","translation":"在母親退休後，Sarah接管了家庭主婦的角色，負責處理日常家務和準備餐點。","explanation":"名詞「家庭主婦」。指負責管理家務的人。"}],"related_forms":["housekeeping"]}

{"headword":"hug","explanation":"名詞和動詞同形，意為「擁抱」。動詞用法常搭配 give someone a hug (給某人一個擁抱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before leaving for college in another city, the teenager gave her parents a tight <target>hug</target> to express her love and longing.","translation":"在前往另一個城市上大學之前，這名青少年給了她的父母一個緊緊的擁抱，以表達她的愛與思念。","explanation":"名詞「擁抱」。"},{"sentence":"The two old friends <target>hugged</target> <pattern>each other</pattern> warmly when they met again at the airport after ten years of separation.","translation":"這兩個老朋友在分開十年後於機場重逢時，溫暖地擁抱了彼此。","explanation":"動詞「擁抱」。常用搭配：hug each other (擁抱彼此)。"}],"related_forms":["hugs"]}

{"headword":"hum","explanation":"動詞「哼唱」或「發出嗡嗡聲」。指不用歌詞地唱曲子，或指機器、昆蟲（如蜜蜂）發出的持續低頻聲音。","entries":[{"sentence":"While waiting for the bus, the girl started to <target>hum</target> a familiar tune, unconsciously reflecting her happy mood that morning.","translation":"在等公車時，女孩開始哼唱一段熟悉的曲調，無意識地反映出她那天早上的愉快心情。","explanation":"動詞「哼唱」。指不用歌詞唱曲子。"},{"sentence":"The quiet library was interrupted by the low <target>hum</target> of the air conditioner, which some students found helpful for concentrating on their studies.","translation":"安靜的圖書館被冷氣機低沉的嗡嗡聲打斷，有些學生覺得這對專注學習很有幫助。","explanation":"動詞（名詞化用法）「發出嗡嗡聲」。此處指機器發出的持續低頻聲。"}],"related_forms":["humming"]}

{"headword":"humid","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的」。常用於描述氣候或空氣，尤其是夏天。注意與 moist (微濕的/舒適的) 和 damp (陰暗潮濕的/不適的) 的區別：humid 側重於空氣中的水分含量高，常用於氣候描述，如 humid climate (潮濕氣候)；moist 與 damp 則更多指物體表面的濕度。","entries":[{"sentence":"Taiwan's summer weather is often extremely <target>humid</target>, making people feel sticky and uncomfortable even if they are just sitting still.","translation":"台灣的夏天天氣通常非常潮濕，即使人們只是靜靜地坐著，也會感到黏膩且不舒服。","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的」。常用於描述氣候。"},{"sentence":"Due to the <target>humid</target> <pattern>conditions</pattern> in the tropical rainforest, many types of fungi and molds grow quickly on fallen leaves.","translation":"由於熱帶雨林的潮濕條件，許多類型的真菌和黴菌在落葉上快速生長。","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的」。常用搭配：humid conditions (潮濕的條件)。"}],"related_forms":["humidity"]}

{"headword":"humor","explanation":"名詞「幽默」或「幽默感」。指能引起笑聲或讓事情顯得有趣的特質。常用搭配：a sense of humor (幽默感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher's great <target>humor</target> made the boring history lessons more engaging, as he often told funny stories to explain complex events.","translation":"老師出色的幽默感讓枯燥的歷史課變得更有趣，因為他經常講有趣的故事來解釋複雜的事件。","explanation":"名詞「幽默」。指能引起笑聲的特質。"},{"sentence":"Having a good <pattern>sense of</pattern> <target>humor</target> is essential for reducing stress and improving relationships with classmates and colleagues.","translation":"擁有良好的幽默感對於減輕壓力以及改善與同學和同事的關係至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「幽默感」。常用片語：a sense of humor (幽默感)。"}],"related_forms":["humorous"]}

{"headword":"humorous","explanation":"形容詞「幽默的、有趣的」。用於描述一個人的說話方式、故事或作品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author wrote a <target>humorous</target> <pattern>account</pattern> of his travels in Asia, describing the funny cultural misunderstandings he encountered.","translation":"作者寫了一篇關於他在亞洲旅行的幽默描述，描述了他所遇到的有趣文化誤解。","explanation":"形容詞「幽默的」。常用搭配：humorous account (幽默的描述/敘述)。"},{"sentence":"Despite the serious nature of the topic, the speaker managed to include some <target>humorous</target> <pattern>remarks</pattern> to keep the audience entertained.","translation":"儘管主題十分嚴肅，演講者仍設法加入了一些幽默的評論，以保持觀眾的興趣。","explanation":"形容詞「幽默的」。常用搭配：humorous remarks (幽默的評論)。"}],"related_forms":["humor"]}

{"headword":"hunger","explanation":"名詞「飢餓」或「渴望」。指生理上的飢餓感，或比喻義上的強烈渴望（如 hunger for power）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many children in poor regions suffer from extreme <target>hunger</target> because they do not have access to enough clean water and nutritious food.","translation":"貧困地區的許多孩子遭受極端飢餓之苦，因為他們無法獲得足夠的乾淨水和營養食物。","explanation":"名詞「飢餓」。指生理上的缺乏食物狀態。"},{"sentence":"The young athlete's <target>hunger</target> <pattern>for</pattern> success drove him to train harder than anyone else in the team to win the gold medal.","translation":"這位年輕運動員對成功的渴望驅使他比隊伍中的任何人都更努力地訓練，以贏得金牌。","explanation":"名詞「渴望」。常用搭配：hunger for sth (對...的渴望)。"}],"related_forms":["hungry"]}

{"headword":"hut","explanation":"名詞「小屋，簡陋的房子」。通常指用簡單材料（如木材、泥土）建成的臨時或小型住宅。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers decided to spend the night in a small wooden <target>hut</target> near the mountain stream to avoid the cold wind.","translation":"登山客決定在山溪旁的一間小木屋裡過夜，以避開寒風。","explanation":"名詞「小屋」。"},{"sentence":"During the summer camp, students built a makeshift <target>hut</target> using branches and leaves to learn basic survival skills in the wild.","translation":"在夏令營期間，學生們用樹枝和葉子搭建了一個臨時小屋，以學習野外基本的生存技能。","explanation":"名詞「小屋」。makeshift 指「臨時的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"icy","explanation":"形容詞「冰冷的，結冰的」。可指天氣、路面或人的態度（冷漠）。常用搭配：icy road (結冰的路), icy stare (冰冷的目光)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The morning commute was delayed because the <target>icy</target> <pattern>roads</pattern> made it dangerous for cars to drive safely without snow chains.","translation":"早晨的通勤被延遲了，因為結冰的路面讓汽車在沒有雪鏈的情況下很難安全駕駛。","explanation":"形容詞「結冰的」。常用搭配 icy roads (結冰的路面)。"},{"sentence":"When she entered the room, she received an <target>icy</target> <pattern>reception</pattern> from her teammates, who were still angry about the argument yesterday.","translation":"當她進入房間時，她從隊友那裡得到了冷淡的接待，他們對昨天的爭吵仍然感到憤怒。","explanation":"形容詞「冷漠的」。icy reception 指「冷淡的接待」。"}],"related_forms":["ice","iciness"]}

{"headword":"imagination","explanation":"名詞「想像力」。指創造新想法或心成像的能力。常用搭配：vivid imagination (豐富的想像力), lack of imagination (缺乏想像力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist has a <pattern>vivid</pattern> <target>imagination</target>, allowing her to create detailed paintings of magical creatures that do not exist in reality.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家擁有豐富的想像力，使她能畫出詳細的現實中不存在的魔法生物畫作。","explanation":"名詞「想像力」。vivid imagination 指「豐富的想像力」。"},{"sentence":"Writing a science fiction novel requires a great deal of <target>imagination</target> to build a complex world with different laws of physics.","translation":"寫一部科學幻想小說需要極大的想像力，來構建一個具有不同物理定律的複雜世界。","explanation":"名詞「想像力」。"}],"related_forms":["imagine","imaginary","imaginative"]}

{"headword":"immediate","explanation":"形容詞「立即的；直接的」。指無需等待或中間沒有其他步驟。常用搭配：immediate response (立即的回應), immediate family (直系親屬)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher requested an <target>immediate</target> <pattern>response</pattern> from the students after asking the question, wanting to check if everyone understood the lesson.","translation":"老師在問問題後要求學生立即回應，想確認每個人是否理解這堂課。","explanation":"形容詞「立即的」。常用搭配 immediate response (立即回應)。"},{"sentence":"In case of an emergency, the school will only notify the <target>immediate</target> <pattern>family</pattern> of the student to avoid unnecessary panic among other relatives.","translation":"在緊急情況下，學校只會通知學生的直系親屬，以避免其他親戚之間產生不必要的恐慌。","explanation":"形容詞「直接的」。immediate family 指「直系親屬」。"}],"related_forms":["immediately"]}

{"headword":"import","explanation":"動詞「進口」；名詞「進口」或「重要性」。在 GSAT 中，最常用的是關於貿易的「進口」。","entries":[{"sentence":"To meet the growing demand for coffee, the local supermarket began to <target>import</target> high-quality beans <pattern>from</pattern> Brazil and Ethiopia.","translation":"為了滿足對咖啡日益增長的 demand，當地超市開始從巴西和衣索比亞進口高品質的咖啡豆。","explanation":"動詞「進口」。常用搭配 import sth from... (從...進口某物)。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to reduce the <target>import</target> <pattern>tariffs</pattern> on electronic goods to make modern technology more affordable for citizens.","translation":"政府決定降低電子產品的進口關稅，使現代科技對公民來說更實惠。","explanation":"名詞「進口」。import tariffs 指「進口關稅」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>import</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fresh fruits from tropical regions is often limited by strict quarantine laws to prevent the spread of pests.","translation":"從熱帶地區進口新鮮水果通常受到嚴格檢疫法的限制，以防止病蟲害的傳播。","explanation":"名詞「進口」。常用搭配 the import of sth (某物的進口)。"}],"related_forms":["importation"]}

{"headword":"impress","explanation":"動詞「給...留下深刻印象」。常用搭配：impress someone with something (用某物給某人留下深刻印象)，以及被動用法 be impressed by/with (對...感到印象深刻)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The exchange student tried to <target>impress</target> his new classmates <pattern>with</pattern> his fluency in English and his deep knowledge of global history.","translation":"這位交換學生試圖用他流利的英語和對全球歷史的深刻認識來給新同學留下深刻印象。","explanation":"動詞「給...留下深刻印象」。常用搭配 impress someone with sth。"},{"sentence":"The judges were deeply <target>impressed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the creativity of the high school students' science projects during the regional competition.","translation":"評審們對高中生在區域競賽中科學專案的創意感到非常深刻。","explanation":"動詞被動用法 be impressed by (對...感到印象深刻)。"},{"sentence":"She worked hard on her presentation to <target>impress</target> the hiring manager, hoping to secure a high-paying job after graduation.","translation":"她努力準備簡報，以給招聘經理留下深刻印象，希望畢業後能獲得一份高薪工作。","explanation":"動詞「給...留下深刻印象」。"}],"related_forms":["impression","impressive"]}

{"headword":"indoor","explanation":"形容詞「室內的」。通常放在名詞前作為修飾語。注意與 indoors (副詞) 的區別：indoor 是形容詞，必須接名詞；indoors 是副詞，通常放在句尾或動詞後，不接名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the heavy rain, the school decided to move the sports meeting to the <target>indoor</target> <pattern>gymnasium</pattern>, ensuring the event could proceed.","translation":"由於大雨，學校決定將運動會移至室內體育館，以確保活動能繼續進行。","explanation":"形容詞「室內的」。常用搭配 indoor gymnasium (室內體育館)。"},{"sentence":"Many urban residents prefer <target>indoor</target> <pattern>activities</pattern> like reading or gaming during the summer to avoid the extreme heat outside.","translation":"許多都市居民在夏天偏好室內活動，如閱讀或玩遊戲，以避開室外的極端高溫。","explanation":"形容詞「室內的」。常用搭配 indoor activities (室內活動)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"indoors","explanation":"副詞「在室內」。通常不接名詞，用於描述動作發生的地點。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the sudden thunderstorm started, the children quickly ran <target>indoors</target> to seek shelter from the rain and wind.","translation":"當突然的雷雨開始時，孩子們迅速跑回室內以避雨風。","explanation":"副詞「在室內」。"},{"sentence":"Since the air quality was poor today, the teacher advised the students to stay <target>indoors</target> and avoid any strenuous physical exercise.","translation":"由於今天空氣品質不佳，老師建議學生待在室內，避免任何劇烈的體育運動。","explanation":"副詞「在室內」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"industrial","explanation":"形容詞「工業的；產業的」。指與工業生產、製造業或工業區相關的事物。常用搭配：industrial revolution (工業革命), industrial zone (工業區)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city's economy grew rapidly during the <target>industrial</target> <pattern>revolution</pattern>, as factories began to produce goods on a massive scale.","translation":"在工業革命期間，該市的經濟迅速增長，因為工廠開始大規模生產商品。","explanation":"形容詞「工業的」。常用搭配 industrial revolution (工業革命)。"},{"sentence":"The government planned to relocate all the <target>industrial</target> <pattern>plants</pattern> to a designated zone far from the residential areas to reduce pollution.","translation":"政府計劃將所有工業廠房遷移到一個遠離住宅區的指定區域，以減少污染。","explanation":"形容詞「工業的」。industrial plants 指「工業廠房」。"},{"sentence":"Many workers in the <target>industrial</target> <pattern>sector</pattern> are now learning to use automated machines to increase efficiency and stay competitive.","translation":"許多工業部門的工人現在學習使用自動化機器以提高效率並保持競爭力。","explanation":"形容詞「工業的」。industrial sector 指「工業部門」。"}],"related_forms":["industry","industrialize","industrialization"]}

{"headword": "inferior", "explanation": "形容詞「較差的，低劣的」；名詞「下級，下屬」。作為形容詞時，常用搭配 be inferior to (比...較差)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Although the generic brand is cheaper, some customers believe its quality is <target>inferior</target> <pattern>to</pattern> that of the well-known luxury brands.", "translation": "雖然通用品牌較便宜，但一些顧客認為其品質比知名奢侈品牌較差。", "explanation": "形容詞「較差的」。常用搭配 be inferior to sth (比...較差)。"}, {"sentence": "The old computer system was <target>inferior</target> <pattern>in</pattern> speed and efficiency, making it difficult for students to complete their online assignments on time.", "translation": "這套舊電腦系統在速度和效率方面較差，導致學生很難準時完成他們的線上作業。", "explanation": "形容詞「較差的」。"}, {"sentence": "In a strict corporate hierarchy, employees are expected to treat their <target>inferiors</target> with respect, regardless of the difference in their professional rank.", "translation": "在嚴格的公司階級制度中，員工被要求尊重其下屬，無論其專業職位高低。", "explanation": "名詞「下屬，下級」。"}], "related_forms": ["inferiority"]}

{"headword": "inform", "explanation": "動詞「通知、告知」。常用搭配 inform someone of/about something (通知某人某事)。注意與 announce 的區別：inform 側重於將訊息傳達給特定對象，而 announce 則是向大眾或群體正式地宣布。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school principal decided to <target>inform</target> the students <pattern>of</pattern> the upcoming changes to the graduation ceremony schedule.", "translation": "校長決定通知學生關於即將到來的畢業典禮時間表變更。", "explanation": "動詞「通知」。常用片語 inform someone of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Please <target>inform</target> the teacher <pattern>about</pattern> any problems you encounter while completing the online assignment by Friday.", "translation": "如果你在週五前完成線上作業時遇到任何問題，請告知老師。", "explanation": "動詞「告知」。常用片語 inform someone about sth。"}, {"sentence": "The company sent an official email to <target>inform</target> the employees <pattern>that</pattern> the office would be closed for the national holiday next Monday.", "translation": "公司發送了一封正式電子郵件通知員工，下週一國定假日辦公室將關閉。", "explanation": "動詞「通知」。常用結構 inform someone that..."}, {"sentence": "The witness was asked to <target>inform</target> the police <pattern>of</pattern> any suspicious activities she had observed in the neighborhood recently.", "translation": "證人被要求將她最近在社區中觀察到的任何可疑活動告知警方。", "explanation": "動詞「告知」。常用片語 inform someone of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["informed", "informative", "information"]}

{"headword":"information","explanation":"名詞「資訊、資料」。不可數名詞，不能加 s 或使用 an。常用搭配：piece of information (一項資訊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourist center provides a great deal of useful <target>information</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the local history and the best sightseeing spots in the city.","translation":"遊客中心提供了許多關於當地歷史和城市最佳觀光景點的有用資訊。","explanation":"名詞「資訊」。常用搭配 information about sth。"},{"sentence":"I only have a small <pattern>piece of</pattern> <target>information</target> regarding the meeting time, but I can check the official website for more details.","translation":"關於會議時間我只有一項資訊，但我可以查看官方網站以獲取更多細節。","explanation":"名詞「資訊」。因為 information 是不可數名詞，所以使用 a piece of 來量化。"}],"related_forms":["inform","informative"]}

{"headword": "injury", "explanation": "名詞「受傷、傷害」。常用搭配：sustain an injury (受傷), suffer an injury (遭受傷害)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The athlete had to withdraw from the competition after <pattern>sustaining</pattern> a serious knee <target>injury</target> during the final match.", "translation": "這名運動員在最後一場比賽中遭受嚴重的膝蓋受傷，不得不退出比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「受傷」。常用搭配 sustain an injury。"}, {"sentence": "Proper stretching and warming up before exercise can help athletes avoid common sports <target>injuries</target> and stay healthy.", "translation": "運動前適當的伸展和熱身可以幫助運動員避免常見的運動傷害並保持健康。", "explanation": "名詞「傷害」。這裡使用複數形式 injuries。"}], "related_forms": ["injure", "injured"]}

{"headword":"inn","explanation":"名詞「小旅店、客棧」。通常指位於鄉村或公路邊，提供食宿的傳統小型旅館。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hiking through the mountains for several hours, the travelers found a cozy <target>inn</target> where they could stay the night.","translation":"在山中徒步旅行數小時後，旅行者們找到了一家舒適的小旅店可以過夜。","explanation":"名詞「小旅店」。"},{"sentence":"The old <target>inn</target> at the edge of the village served traditional home-cooked meals and provided a warm welcome to all visitors.","translation":"村莊邊緣的那家舊客棧提供傳統的家常菜，並對所有訪客表示熱烈歡迎。","explanation":"名詞「客棧」。"}],"related_forms":["inns"]}

{"headword":"inner","explanation":"形容詞「內部的、內心的」。常用於描述物理位置的內部或人的內心世界，如 inner city (市中心舊區), inner peace (內心平靜)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Meditation and deep breathing are often recommended to help people achieve <target>inner</target> <pattern>peace</pattern> and reduce stress in their daily lives.","translation":"冥想和深呼吸通常被推薦用來幫助人們獲得內心平靜並減少日常生活中的壓力。","explanation":"形容詞「內心的」。常用搭配 inner peace。"},{"sentence":"The government is implementing new policies to improve the living conditions and provide more services for people living in the <target>inner</target> <pattern>city</pattern>.","translation":"政府正在實施新政策，以改善市中心舊區居民的生活條件並提供更多服務。","explanation":"形容詞「內部的」。常用搭配 inner city。"}],"related_forms":["innerly","innermost"]}

{"headword":"innocent","explanation":"形容詞「清白的、無辜的；天真的」。常用搭配：prove innocent (證明清白), an innocent mistake (一個無心之過)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer worked hard to provide evidence that his client was <target>innocent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the crime he was accused of.","translation":"律師努力提供證據，證明他的當事人對該項指控的罪行是清白的。","explanation":"形容詞「清白的」。常用搭配 innocent of sth。"},{"sentence":"It was an <target>innocent</target> <pattern>mistake</pattern> made by a new employee who did not know the company's strict rules regarding filing documents.","translation":"這是一個由新員工犯下的無心之過，因為他不熟悉公司關於文件歸檔的嚴格規定。","explanation":"形容詞「無辜的、無心的」。常用搭配 an innocent mistake。"},{"sentence":"With her <target>innocent</target> expression and wide eyes, the little girl looked as if she had never heard of any trouble in the world.","translation":"這小女孩帶著無辜的表情和睜大的眼睛，看起來就像她從未聽說過世界上任何麻煩一樣。","explanation":"形容詞「天真的」。"}],"related_forms":["innocently","innocence"]}

{"headword": "inspect", "explanation": "動詞「檢查、視察」。指詳細地查看某物以發現問題或確保其符合標準。常用搭配：inspect for (檢查以發現...), inspect the premises (視察場所)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The health inspector visited the restaurant to <target>inspect</target> the kitchen <pattern>for</pattern> any hygiene issues that could affect food safety.", "translation": "衛生視察員訪問了這家餐廳，以檢查廚房是否有任何影響食品安全的衛生問題。", "explanation": "動詞「檢查」。指詳細檢查以發現問題。"}, {"sentence": "Before the plane takes off, the pilot and crew must <target>inspect</target> the aircraft <pattern>thoroughly</pattern> to ensure everything is functioning correctly.", "translation": "在飛機起飛前，機師和機組人員必須徹底檢查飛機，以確保所有功能運作正常。", "explanation": "動詞「檢查」。常用搭配 inspect thoroughly。"}], "related_forms": ["inspection", "inspector"]}

{"headword":"inspector","explanation":"名詞「檢查員、視察員」。指負責執行檢查任務的人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The building <target>inspector</target> confirmed that the old house was safe to live in after <target>inspecting</target> the structure and the foundation.","translation":"建築檢查員在檢查了結構和基礎後，確認這棟舊房子適合居住。","explanation":"名詞「檢查員」。"},{"sentence":"After the fire, the fire <target>inspector</target> arrived at the scene to determine if the electrical wiring was the cause of the blaze.","translation":"火災後，火災調查員到達現場以確定電路接線是否為起火原因。","explanation":"名詞「視察員」。"}],"related_forms":["inspect","inspection"]}

{"headword": "intelligent", "explanation": "形容詞「聰明的、有才智的」。注意與 smart 的區別：intelligent 側重於理解、分析和學習能力強，而 smart 則更傾向於於機靈或具有實際操作能力。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher noticed that the student was highly <target>intelligent</target>, allowing him to solve complex math problems with very little guidance.", "translation": "老師注意到這了一個學生非常聰明，使他能以極少的指導解決複雜的數學問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「聰明的」。"}, {"sentence": "Researchers are developing more <target>intelligent</target> systems to help doctors diagnose rare diseases more accurately and quickly.", "translation": "研究人員正在開發更聰明的系統以幫助醫生更準確、快速地診斷罕見疾病。", "explanation": "形容詞「聰明的」。指具有分析能力的系統。"}, {"sentence": "Although he was not the top student in class, his <target>intelligent</target> approach to solving problems showed a deep understanding of the material.", "translation": "雖然他不是班上最好的學生，但他解決問題的聰明方法顯示出對教材的深刻理解。", "explanation": "形容詞「聰明的」。"}], "related_forms": ["intelligence", "intelligently"]}

{"headword":"interrupt","explanation":"動詞「打斷、中斷」。常用搭配：interrupt someone (打斷某人), interrupt the process (中斷過程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is considered rude to <target>interrupt</target> someone <pattern>while</pattern> they are speaking, so you should wait for a natural break in the conversation.","translation":"在別人說話時打斷他們被認為是不禮貌的，所以你應該等待對話中的自然停頓。","explanation":"動詞「打斷」。常用搭配 interrupt someone while speaking。"},{"sentence":"The sudden loud noise from the construction site <target>interrupted</target> the student's concentration, making it difficult for him to finish his essay.","translation":"來自建築工地的突然大聲噪音打斷了學生的注意力集中，使他很難完成他的論文。","explanation":"動詞「中斷」。指停止或干擾某事物的進行。"}],"related_forms":["interruption","interrupting"]}

{"headword":"invent","explanation":"動詞「發明」。指創造出以前不存在的新東西或新方法。注意與 discover (發現) 的區別：invent 是創造新事物，而 discover 是找到原本就存在但未被發現的東西。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thomas Edison is famous for his ability to <target>invent</target> new devices that changed the way people live and work.","translation":"湯瑪斯·愛迪生因其發明新設備的能力而聞名，這些設備改變了人們生活和工作的方式。","explanation":"動詞「發明」。指創造出全新的產品或技術。"},{"sentence":"To solve the complex problem, the students had to <target>invent</target> a new method of data collection for their science project.","translation":"為了個複雜的問題，學生們必須為他們的科學計畫發明一種新的數據收集方法。","explanation":"動詞「發明」。此處指創造出一個新的方法或程序。"},{"sentence":"The witness was caught lying when the police discovered he had <target>invented</target> the entire story to hide his involvement in the crime.","translation":"當警察發現證人為了掩飾自己參與犯罪而編造了整個故事時，他被抓到了在撒謊。","explanation":"動詞「編造」。指為了欺騙他人而虛構故事或藉口。"}],"related_forms":["invention","inventor","inventive"]}

{"headword":"inventor","explanation":"名詞「發明家」。指發明新事物的人。常用搭配：the inventor of... (...的發明家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>inventor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the telephone, Alexander Graham Bell, revolutionized the way people communicate across long distances.","translation":"電話的發明家亞歷山大·格拉漢姆·貝爾徹底改變了人們長距離溝通的方式。","explanation":"名詞「發明家」。常用搭配 the inventor of...。"},{"sentence":"Many young <target>inventors</target> participate in the annual science fair to showcase their creative ideas and innovative prototypes.","translation":"許多年輕的發明家參加年度科學展，以展示他們的創意想法和創新原型。","explanation":"名詞「發明家」。複數形式 inventors。"}],"related_forms":["invention","invent"]}

{"headword":"investigate","explanation":"動詞「調查」。指詳細研究或檢查某事，以發現事實或真相。常用搭配：investigate the cause of... (調查...的原因), investigate a crime (調查犯罪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are currently <target>investigating</target> the cause <pattern>of</pattern> the mysterious fire that destroyed the local library last night.","translation":"警方目前正在調查昨晚摧毀當地圖書館的神秘火災的原因。","explanation":"動詞「調查」。常用搭配 investigate the cause of...。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are <target>investigating</target> the effects <pattern>of</pattern> climate change on the migration patterns of birds in the region.","translation":"科學家們正在調查氣候變遷對該地區鳥類遷徙模式的影響。","explanation":"動詞「調查」。在學術研究中，指對某個現象進行詳細的研究。"},{"sentence":"The school board decided to <target>investigate</target> the reports <pattern>of</pattern> bullying in the playground to ensure a safe environment for all students.","translation":"學校董事會決定調查操場上的霸凌報告，以確保所有學生都有一個安全環境。","explanation":"動詞「調查」。指對指控或報告進行事實核查。"}],"related_forms":["investigation","investigator"]}
