{"headword":"invitation","explanation":"名詞「邀請」。常用搭配：send an invitation (發送邀請), accept/decline an invitation (接受/拒絕邀請), by invitation (受邀)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Sarah was delighted to receive an <target>invitation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> her best friend's birthday party, which would be held at a fancy restaurant.","translation":"莎拉很高興收到好友生日派對的邀請，派對將在一家高級餐廳舉行。","explanation":"名詞「邀請」。常用搭配 invitation to...。"},{"sentence":"Due to a sudden family emergency, he had to politely <pattern>decline</pattern> the <target>invitation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the graduation ceremony.","translation":"由於突發的家庭緊急情況，他不得不禮貌地拒絕畢業典禮的邀請。","explanation":"名詞「邀請」。常用搭配 decline an invitation。"},{"sentence":"The exclusive art gallery only allows visitors who have been <target>invited</target> by a formal <pattern>invitation</pattern> to enter the exhibition.","translation":"這家高級藝術畫廊僅允許持有正式邀請函的訪客進入展覽。","explanation":"名詞「邀請函」。指實體的邀請信件。"}],"related_forms":["invite"]}

{"headword":"ivory","explanation":"名詞指「象牙」，形容詞指「象牙色的」。在 GSAT 中，常出現在關於環境保護、動物權益或藝術品討論的文本中。注意 ivory trade (象牙貿易) 是常見術語。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many countries have banned the <target>ivory</target> trade to protect elephants from being killed by illegal poachers for their tusks.","translation":"許多國家已禁止象牙貿易，以保護大象免於被非法盜獵者為了象牙而殺害。","explanation":"名詞「象牙」。指大象牙齒的材質。"},{"sentence":"The antique piano keys were made <pattern>of</pattern> <target>ivory</target>, which is why the museum now uses synthetic materials as replacements.","translation":"這台古董鋼琴的琴鍵是用象牙製成的，這就是為什麼博物館現在使用合成材料作為替代品。","explanation":"名詞「象牙」。常用搭配 made of ivory。"},{"sentence":"The bride chose an <target>ivory</target> dress for her wedding, as she preferred the soft, creamy white color over a bright white one.","translation":"新娘選擇了一件象牙色的禮服參加婚禮，因為她比起亮白色更喜歡這種柔和的奶油白色。","explanation":"形容詞「象牙色的」。指一種淺黃色的白色。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "jail", "explanation": "名詞「監獄」，動詞「監禁」。注意 jail 通常指較短期的監禁或地方性監獄，而 prison 通常指長期服刑的監獄。常用搭配：go to jail (入獄), be sent to jail (被送入監獄)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The thief was <pattern>sent</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> <target>jail</target> for six months after the judge found him guilty of stealing the jewelry.", "translation": "在法官判定該名小偷偷竊珠寶罪名成立後，他被判處六個月的監禁。", "explanation": "名詞「監獄」。片語 sent to jail 表示「被送入監獄」。"}, {"sentence": "The suspect remained in <target>jail</target> while awaiting trial, as the court believed he might try to escape if released.", "translation": "嫌疑犯在等待審判期間一直留在監獄中，因為法院認為如果釋放他，y可能會嘗試逃跑。", "explanation": "名詞「監獄」。"}, {"sentence": "The corrupt official was <target>jailed</target> for his crimes, serving a long sentence to pay for his dishonesty and abuse of power.", "translation": "該名貪汙官員因其罪行而被監禁，服刑多年以償還其不誠實和濫用權力的行為。", "explanation": "動詞「監禁」。"}], "related_forms": ["jailing"]}

{"headword":"jar","explanation":"名詞「罐子」。通常指玻璃製的、寬口的容器。常用搭配：a jar of... (一罐...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She kept a large <target>jar</target> <pattern>of</pattern> homemade strawberry jam on the kitchen counter for her children to enjoy with toast.","translation":"她在廚房檯面上放了一大罐自製草莓果醬，讓孩子們在吃吐司時享用。","explanation":"名詞「罐子」。常用搭配 a jar of...。"},{"sentence":"The students carefully placed the captured insect in a glass <target>jar</target> to observe its behavior before releasing it back into nature.","translation":"學生們小心地將捕捉到的昆蟲放入玻璃罐中，在將其放回大自然前觀察其行為。","explanation":"名詞「罐子」。"}],"related_forms":["jars"]}

{"headword":"jaw","explanation":"名詞「下顎；下巴」。常用於生物學或醫學描述，或在某些慣用語中。常用搭配：drop one's jaw (大吃一驚)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The crocodile has powerful <target>jaws</target> that allow it to grip its prey tightly and pull it underwater without letting go.","translation":"鱷魚擁有強而有力的下顎，能讓它緊緊抓住獵物並將其拉入水中而不放手。","explanation":"名詞「下顎」。指口部的骨骼結構。"},{"sentence":"When the magician performed the final trick, the audience's <target>jaws</target> <pattern>dropped</pattern> in amazement at the impossible illusion.","translation":"當魔術師表演最後一個魔術時，觀眾驚訝得目瞪口呆。","explanation":"名詞「下顎」。片語 drop one's jaw 意為「大吃一驚」。"}],"related_forms":["jaws"]}

{"headword":"jazz","explanation":"名詞「爵士樂」。一種源自美國的音樂風格。常用搭配：play jazz (演奏爵士樂), jazz music (爵士樂)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the festival, several bands performed <target>jazz</target> music, attracting a crowd of music lovers who appreciated the complex rhythms.","translation":"節日期間，幾支樂團演奏了爵士樂，吸引了一群欣賞其複雜節奏的音樂愛好者。","explanation":"名詞「爵士樂」。"},{"sentence":"He spent years studying <target>jazz</target> in New Orleans, the city widely recognized as the birthplace of this unique musical genre.","translation":"他在紐奧良學習爵士樂多年，該城市被廣泛認為是這種獨特音樂流派的誕生地。","explanation":"名詞「爵士樂」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"jealous","explanation":"形容詞「嫉妒的；吃醋的」。指對他人擁有的事物或成就感到不滿，或擔心他人搶走自己的東西。常用搭配：be jealous of... (嫉妒...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The younger brother was <target>jealous</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his sister's academic achievements, which led to frequent arguments between them.","translation":"弟弟嫉妒姐姐的學業成就，導致他們之間經常爭吵。","explanation":"形容詞「嫉妒的」。常用搭配 be jealous of...。"},{"sentence":"She felt a bit <target>jealous</target> when she saw her best friend spending more time with a new classmate than with her.","translation":"當她看到好友比跟她相處的時間更多時，她感到有些吃醋。","explanation":"形容詞「吃醋的」。指對人際關係中的嫉妒。"},{"sentence":"Some people are naturally more <target>jealous</target> than others, often struggling to feel satisfied with what they already have in life.","translation":"有些人天生比其他人更容易嫉妒，經常難以對生活中已有的事物感到滿足。","explanation":"形容詞「嫉妒的」。"}],"related_forms":["jealously","jealousy"]}

{"headword":"jeep","explanation":"名詞「吉普車」。一種強壯的越野車，常用於崎嶇的地形。","entries":[{"sentence":"The explorers drove their <target>jeep</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the dense forest to reach the hidden temple before sunset.","translation":"探險家們開著他們的吉普車穿過茂密的森林，以便在日落前到達隱藏的神廟。","explanation":"名詞「吉普車」。常用介系詞 through 表示穿過地形。"},{"sentence":"Because the road to the village was muddy and rough, a <target>jeep</target> was the only vehicle capable of making the trip.","translation":"因為前往村莊的道路泥濘且崎嶇，吉普車是唯一能完成這次旅程的車輛。","explanation":"名詞「吉普車」。強調其越野能力。"}],"related_forms":["jeeps"]}

{"headword": "jelly", "explanation": "名詞「果凍」或「果醬」。在美國英語中，jelly 通常指用果汁製成的透明果凍狀果醬，而 jam 則包含果肉。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For a light dessert, the students shared some strawberry <target>jelly</target> served with fresh whipped cream to celebrate their project's completion.", "translation": "作為一種輕便的甜點，學生們分享了一些搭配新鮮鮮奶油的草莓果凍，以慶祝他們完成專案。", "explanation": "名詞「果凍」。指一種甜點。"}, {"sentence": "The mother spread some grape <target>jelly</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the toast for her daughter's breakfast, ensuring she had enough energy for the school day.", "translation": "母親在女兒的早餐吐司上抹了一些葡萄果醬，為她女兒的早餐準備，確保她有足夠的能量迎接學校的一天。", "explanation": "名詞「果醬」。常搭配介系詞 on 表示在吐司上。"}], "related_forms": ["jellies"]}

{"headword": "jet", "explanation": "名詞「噴射機」；動詞「噴出」。名詞常用於 jet lag (時差) 或 jet set (頂層富豪)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The wealthy businessman traveled by private <target>jet</target> to attend the international conference in New York, saving a lot of time.", "translation": "這位富有的商人乘坐私人噴射機前往紐約參加國際會議，節省了大量時間。", "explanation": "名詞「噴射機」。指快速的飛機。"}, {"sentence": "After flying from Taipei to London, Sarah felt exhausted due to severe <target>jet</target> <pattern>lag</pattern>, making it hard to wake up.", "translation": "從台北飛往倫敦後，莎拉因為嚴重的時差而感到精疲力竭，導致很難醒來。", "explanation": "名詞搭配 jet lag 表示「時差」。"}, {"sentence": "Water <target>jetted</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> the broken pipe with great force, flooding the basement within a few minutes.", "translation": " equipe 水以巨大的力量從破損的水管中噴出，在幾分鐘內淹沒了地下室。", "explanation": "動詞「噴出」。常用片語 jet out of 表示從...噴出。"}, {"sentence": "Members of the <target>jet</target> <pattern>set</pattern> often spend their weekends visiting luxury resorts in Europe, showcasing their immense wealth and status.", "translation": "頂層富豪群體經常在周末前往歐洲的豪華度假村旅遊，展示其巨大的財富和地位。", "explanation": "名詞搭配 jet set 表示「頂層富豪」。"}], "related_forms": ["jets"]}

{"headword": "jewel", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶、寶石」。指寶貴的石頭。常用片語 crown jewel (最寶貴的部分)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The national museum recently displayed a rare blue <target>jewel</target> that had been unearthed from an ancient mine in India centuries ago, attracting thousands of historians.", "translation": "國家博物館最近展出了一顆數世紀前在印度一座古老礦坑中發現的罕見藍色寶石，吸引了數千名歷史學家。", "explanation": "名詞「寶石」。指珍貴的礦石。"}, {"sentence": "The small coastal town, with its stunning beaches and crystal-clear water, is often regarded as the <target>jewel</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the region's tourism industry.", "translation": "這個小海濱城鎮擁有迷人的海灘和清澈的水質，常被視為該地區觀光業的明珠。", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶/明珠」。常用片語 the jewel of sth 表示某地最寶貴的部分。"}, {"sentence": "The new high-tech research center is considered the <pattern>crown</pattern> <target>jewel</target> of the university's campus, showcasing the institution's commitment to scientific innovation.", "translation": "這座新的高科技研究中心被認為是這所大學校園內最寶貴的設施，展示了該機構對科學創新的承諾。", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶」。常用片語 crown jewel 指最寶貴或最重要的部分。"}], "related_forms": ["jewels"]}

{"headword":"jewelry","explanation":"名詞「珠寶、首飾」。是一個不可數名詞，指所有珠寶首飾的總稱。注意與 jewel (單顆寶石) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"She carefully placed her expensive <target>jewelry</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a locked box to ensure it would not be stolen during the trip.","translation":"她小心地將昂貴的首飾放在一個鎖住的盒子裡，以確保旅途中不會被偷。","explanation":"不可數名詞「首飾」。常用搭配 in a box。"},{"sentence":"The store sells a wide variety of handmade <target>jewelry</target>, including necklaces and bracelets made from recycled glass.","translation":"這家店販售各種手工首飾，包括用回收玻璃製成的項鍊和手鍊。","explanation":"名詞「首飾」。指首飾的總稱。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"journey","explanation":"名詞「旅程」；動詞「旅行」。名詞常用於 a long journey (長途旅行)。注意與 trip (短途/目的明確的旅行) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>journey</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the remote mountain village took three days by bus, passing through many beautiful landscapes.","translation":"前往遙遠山村的旅程坐公車花了三天，途中經過許多美麗的風景。","explanation":"名詞「旅程」。常用介系詞 to 表示目的地。"},{"sentence":"Learning a new language is often described as a <target>journey</target> <pattern>of</pattern> self-discovery and continuous growth over many years.","translation":"學習一種新語言常被描述為一段長年的自我發現與持續成長的旅程。","explanation":"名詞「旅程」。此處為比喻用法，指過程。"},{"sentence":"The brave explorers <target>journeyed</target> <pattern>across</pattern> the desert for weeks, searching for the lost city mentioned in old legends.","translation":"勇敢的探險家們在沙漠中旅行了數週，尋找古老傳說中提到的失落之城。","explanation":"動詞「旅行」。常用介系詞 across 表示橫跨。"}],"related_forms":["journeys"]}

{"headword": "joyful", "explanation": "形容詞「快樂的、令人高興的」。通常描述心情或場合。常用於描述慶祝活動或團圓。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The family experienced a <target>joyful</target> reunion after a decade of separation, with each member sharing heartfelt stories and laughing about their shared memories.", "translation": "在分離十年後，這家人經歷了一場快樂的團圓，每位成員都分享了由衷的故事並對共同的回憶大笑。", "explanation": "形容詞「快樂的」。描述心情或場合。"}, {"sentence": "The atmosphere in the lecture hall was <target>joyful</target> when the professor announced that the entire class had passed the challenging final examination with flying colors.", "translation": "當教授宣布全班學生都以優異成績通過了困難的期末考試時，演講廳內的氣氛非常愉快。", "explanation": "形容詞「快樂的」。描述場合的氛圍。"}], "related_forms": ["joyfully", "joyfulness"]}

{"headword":"juicy","explanation":"形容詞「多汁的」。常用於描述水果或肉類。比喻用法可指「有趣的、八卦的」資訊。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer picked a <target>juicy</target> red apple from the tree, and the sweet juice ran down his chin as he bit into it.","translation":"農夫從樹上摘了一個多汁的紅蘋果，當他咬下去時，甜美的汁液沿著他的下巴流下。","explanation":"形容詞「多汁的」。描述水果。"},{"sentence":"The chef grilled a <target>juicy</target> steak for the customer, ensuring the meat remained tender and flavorful throughout the meal.","translation":"主廚為顧客烤了一塊多汁的牛排，確保肉質在用餐過程中保持嫩且美味。","explanation":"形容詞「多汁的」。描述肉類。"},{"sentence":"The teenagers spent the whole afternoon sharing <target>juicy</target> <pattern>details</pattern> about their classmates' secret romances during the break.","translation":"青少年們整個下午都在休息時間分享關於同學秘密戀情的有趣細節。","explanation":"形容詞「有趣的、八卦的」。常用搭配 juicy details (有趣/八卦的細節)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"jungle","explanation":"名詞「叢林」。通常指熱帶地區茂密的森林。常用片語 concrete jungle (水泥叢林/都市)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many rare animals, such as tigers and monkeys, live in the deep <target>jungle</target> where the sunlight barely reaches the ground.","translation":"許多稀有動物，如老虎和猴子，生活在陽光幾乎無法到達地面的深處叢林中。","explanation":"名詞「叢林」。指熱帶茂密森林。"},{"sentence":"Moving from a quiet village to a big city felt like entering a <pattern>concrete</pattern> <target>jungle</target>, with tall buildings and constant noise.","translation":"從安靜的村莊搬到大城市感覺就像進入了一個水泥叢林，到處是高樓大廈和不斷的噪音。","explanation":"名詞「叢林」。片語 concrete jungle 比喻大城市。"}],"related_forms":["jungles"]}

{"headword":"junior","explanation":"形容詞「較年少的、職位較低的」；名詞「後輩、低年級學生」。常用於職稱或學校年級。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a <target>junior</target> member <pattern>of</pattern> the debate team, he had to listen more than speak during the first few meetings.","translation":"作為辯論隊的一名較年少成員，在最初的幾次會議中，他必須多聽少說。","explanation":"形容詞「較年少的」。常用搭配 junior member of sth。"},{"sentence":"The <target>junior</target> accountant was assigned to help the senior partner with the basic bookkeeping tasks for the new client.","translation":"這位初級會計師被指派協助資深合夥人處理新客戶的基本簿記工作。","explanation":"形容詞「職位較低的」。指工作經驗較少的人。"},{"sentence":"In the American high school system, a <target>junior</target> is a student in the eleventh grade who is preparing for college applications.","translation":"在美國高中系統中，junior 是指準備申請大學的十一年級學生。","explanation":"名詞「低年級學生/十一年級學生」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"junk","explanation":"名詞「垃圾、廢物」。動詞「丟棄、廢棄」。注意 junk food (垃圾食物) 為常見搭配，且 junk 作為動詞時常指將不再有用或損壞的設備丟棄。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old garage was filled with piles of <target>junk</target>, including broken furniture and rusty tools that had not been used for years.","translation":"舊車庫裡堆滿了垃圾，包括破舊的家具和多年未用的生鏽工具。","explanation":"名詞「垃圾、廢物」。指不再有用的物品。"},{"sentence":"Many health experts advise students to avoid eating too much <target>junk</target> <pattern>food</pattern> because it lacks essential nutrients and can lead to weight gain.","translation":"許多健康專家建議學生避免吃太多垃圾食物，因為它缺乏必要的營養，且可能導致體重增加。","explanation":"名詞「垃圾」。常用搭配：junk food (垃圾食物)。"},{"sentence":"The IT department decided to <target>junk</target> the old computers and replace them with newer models to improve the school's network speed.","translation":"資訊部門決定將舊電腦廢棄並更換為較新的機型，以提升學校的網路速度。","explanation":"動詞「丟棄、廢棄」。指將不再有用的設備丟掉。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "kangaroo", "explanation": "名詞「袋鼠」。一種原產於澳洲的有袋類動物。常用於描述其跳躍方式或育兒袋。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During their biological study tour to Australia, the students observed <target>kangaroos</target> migrating across the open grasslands to find water sources during the dry season.", "translation": "在前往澳洲的生物學習之旅中，學生們觀察到袋鼠在乾季期間橫跨開闊的草原以尋找水源。", "explanation": "名詞「袋鼠」。"}, {"sentence": "The mother <target>kangaroo</target> possesses a specialized pouch on her belly, which allows her to protect and nurture her baby, known as a joey, until it is developed.", "translation": "袋鼠媽媽肚子上有一個專門的育兒袋，讓她能夠保護並哺育她的幼崽（稱為 joey），直到幼崽發育完全。", "explanation": "名詞「袋鼠」。"}], "related_forms": ["kangaroos"]}

{"headword": "keyboard", "explanation": "名詞「鍵盤」。可指電腦鍵盤或音樂鍵盤（如鋼琴）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university library provides ergonomic <target>keyboards</target> for students who spend long hours typing academic papers to prevent repetitive strain injuries in their wrists.", "translation": "大學圖書館為需要花長時間打學術論文的學生提供人體工學鍵盤，以防止手腕出現重複性勞損。", "explanation": "名詞「鍵盤」。指電腦輸入設備。"}, {"sentence": "In the advanced music theory course, students are required to demonstrate their understanding of harmony by performing complex pieces on an electronic <target>keyboard</target>.", "translation": "在進階音樂理論課程中，學生被要求透過在電子鍵盤上演奏複雜的曲目來展示他們對和聲的理解。", "explanation": "名詞「鍵盤」。指音樂演奏設備。"}], "related_forms": ["keyboards"]}

{"headword":"kidney","explanation":"名詞「腎臟」。人體內負責過濾血液和產生尿液的器官。常用於醫療或生物學討論。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the <target>kidneys</target> <pattern>filter</pattern> waste products <pattern>from</pattern> the blood to keep the body's internal environment balanced.","translation":"醫生解釋說，腎臟過濾血液中的廢物，以保持身體內部環境的平衡。","explanation":"名詞「腎臟」。常用搭配：filter waste from blood。"},{"sentence":"After the accident, the patient required a <target>kidney</target> <pattern>transplant</pattern> to restore normal organ function and save his life.","translation":"事故後，病人需要進行腎臟移植以恢復器官的正常功能並挽救他的生命。","explanation":"名詞「腎臟」。常用搭配：kidney transplant (腎臟移植)。"}],"related_forms":["kidneys"]}

{"headword": "kilometer", "explanation": "名詞「公里」。公制長度單位。注意其拼寫在美國英語中常寫作 kilometer，在英國英語中寫作 kilometre。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The urban planning committee decided to extend the subway line by several <target>kilometers</target> to provide better access for residents living in the outskirts of the city.", "translation": "城市規劃委員會決定將地鐵線延伸數公里，以便為住在城市郊區的居民提供更好的交通便利。", "explanation": "名詞「公里」。"}, {"sentence": "The environmental report indicated that the pollution levels remained high for several <target>kilometers</target> <pattern>away from</pattern> the industrial zone's primary waste disposal site.", "translation": "環境報告指出，在工業區的主要廢棄物處理場周圍數公里內，污染程度仍然很高。", "explanation": "名詞「公里」。常用搭配：... kilometers away from... (距離...多少公里)。"}], "related_forms": ["kilometers"]}

{"headword": "kindergarten", "explanation": "名詞「幼稚園」。指兒童進入小學之前的教育階段。注意其詞源來自德語，意為 children's garden。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Educational psychologists argue that the early social interactions in <target>kindergarten</target> are crucial for developing a child's emotional intelligence before they enter primary school.", "translation": "教育心理學家認為，幼稚園時期的早期社交互動對於兒童在進入小學前發展情商至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「幼稚園」。"}, {"sentence": "Many modern <target>kindergarten</target> curricula emphasize a play-based learning approach, allowing children to explore their environment through guided activities and creative games.", "translation": "許多現代幼稚園的課程強調以遊戲為主的學習方法，讓孩子們透過引導活動和創意遊戲來探索他們的環境。", "explanation": "名詞「幼稚園」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"kingdom","explanation":"名詞「王國」。指由國王或女王統治的國家，或在生物分類學中指「界」（如 Animal Kingdom 動物界）。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the fairy tale, the brave prince traveled across the entire <target>kingdom</target> to find the magic mirror that could reveal the truth.","translation":"在童話故事中，勇敢的王子穿越整個王國去尋找能揭露真相的魔鏡。","explanation":"名詞「王國」。指統治領土。"},{"sentence":"In biology class, the teacher explained that all animals belong to the animal <target>kingdom</target>, which is divided into various groups based on their characteristics.","translation":"生物課上，老師解釋說所有動物都屬於動物界，並根據其特徵分為不同的類群。","explanation":"名詞「王國/界」。常用搭配：animal kingdom (動物界)。"}],"related_forms":["kingdoms"]}

{"headword": "kit", "explanation": "名詞「工具箱、成套設備、裝備」。指為了特定目的而準備的一組工具或材料。常見搭配：first-aid kit (急救箱), model kit (模型組裝套件)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school nurse insisted that every student carry a <pattern>first-aid</pattern> <target>kit</target> during the wilderness hiking trip to ensure immediate medical assistance in case of emergencies.", "translation": "學校護理師堅持要求每位學生在野外健行之旅中攜帶急救箱，以確保在緊急情況下能立即獲得醫療協助。", "explanation": "名詞「工具箱/套件」。常用搭配：first-aid kit (急救箱)。"}, {"sentence": "The engineering student spent several weekends assembling a complex robotics <target>kit</target>, meticulously following the technical manual to ensure the robot could move precisely.", "translation": "這位工程系學生花了好幾個週末組裝一個複雜的機器人套件，細心地遵循技術手冊以確保機器人能精確地移動。", "explanation": "名詞「工具箱/套件」。指一組組裝所需的材料。"}], "related_forms": ["kits"]}

{"headword": "knight", "explanation": "名詞「騎士」。歷史上指受封的騎士，現在指受封爵位的人。注意其開頭的 k 不發音。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Historical scholars often analyze how the medieval <target>knight</target> functioned as a military leader and a land-owner, rather than just a warrior in legends.", "translation": "歷史學者經常分析中世紀騎士如何作為軍事領袖和地主，而非僅僅是傳說中的一名戰士。", "explanation": "名詞「騎士」。"}, {"sentence": "In the Middle Ages, a <target>knight</target> was expected to adhere to a strict code of chivalry, which mandated that they protect the vulnerable and maintain absolute honor.", "translation": "在中世紀，一名騎士被要求遵守嚴格的騎士道精神，規定他們必須保護弱小者並保持絕對的榮譽。", "explanation": "名詞「騎士」。"}], "related_forms": ["knights"]}

{"headword":"knit","explanation":"動詞「編織」；名詞「編織物」。注意其過去式和過去分詞可以是 knit 或 knitted。常用片語 knit together (緊密結合/團結)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the winter break, my grandmother taught me how to <target>knit</target> a warm scarf using colorful wool and two long needles.","translation":"寒假期間，我奶奶教我如何用彩色羊毛和兩根長針編織一條溫暖的圍巾。","explanation":"動詞「編織」。"},{"sentence":"The community worked hard to <target>knit</target> the diverse residents <pattern>together</pattern>, creating a strong sense of belonging for everyone in the neighborhood.","translation":"社區努力將多元的居民緊密結合在一起，為鄰里間的每個人創造了強烈的歸屬感。","explanation":"動詞片語 knit together 表「緊密結合/團結」。"},{"sentence":"She wore a hand- <target>knit</target> sweater that was both soft and stylish, which she had spent months carefully making for herself.","translation":"她穿著一件手工編織的毛衣，既柔軟又時尚，她花了好幾個月時間為自己精心製作。","explanation":"形容詞用法（由分詞衍生），表示「編織的」。"}],"related_forms":["knitting","knitted"]}

{"headword":"knot","explanation":"名詞指「結」或「木材中的節」，動詞指「打結」。注意 knot 也可以指速度單位「節」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sailor tied a strong <target>knot</target> to secure the boat to the dock, ensuring it would not float away during the storm.","translation":"水手打了一個牢固的結將船固定在碼頭上，以確保在風暴期間船不會漂走。","explanation":"名詞「結」。指繩索等打出的結。"},{"sentence":"She struggled to untie the <target>knot</target> in her shoelaces, which had become too tight to pull apart easily.","translation":"她努力地解開鞋帶上的結，因為那個結已經太緊而無法輕易拉開。","explanation":"名詞「結」。"},{"sentence":"The carpenter noticed a large <target>knot</target> in the piece of oak wood, which made the table look more natural and rustic.","translation":"木工注意到橡木板上的一個大節，這使得桌子看起來更自然且具有鄉村風格。","explanation":"名詞「木材中的節」。"},{"sentence":"The wind was so strong that the fishing line <target>knotted</target> <pattern>up</pattern>, making it impossible for him to catch any fish.","translation":"風太大了，導致釣魚線打結了，讓他無法釣到任何魚。","explanation":"動詞「打結」。常用搭配：knot up。"}],"related_forms":["knotted"]}

{"headword": "koala", "explanation": "名詞「無尾熊」。澳洲特有種，通常與 eucalyptus (尤加利樹) 相關聯。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Wildlife conservationists are working tirelessly to protect the <target>koala</target> populations from the devastating effects of habitat loss and recurring bushfires in Australia.", "translation": "野生動物保育人士正不懈地努力保護無尾熊種群免受澳洲棲息地喪失和反覆發生山火的毀滅性影響。", "explanation": "名詞「騎士」。"}, {"sentence": "Because the <target>koala</target> relies almost exclusively on eucalyptus leaves for nutrition, it has evolved specialized digestive systems to break down the toxic components of the leaves.", "translation": "由於無尾熊幾乎完全依賴尤加利樹葉作為營養，它演化出了專門的消化系統來分解葉片中的毒性成分。", "explanation": "名詞「無尾熊」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"label","explanation":"名詞指「標籤」或「唱片公司」，動詞指「貼標籤」或「給...貼標籤(定義)」。注意 label sth as sth 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure to <target>label</target> your folders <pattern>with</pattern> your name and class so the teacher can organize them easily.","translation":"請務必在你的資料夾上貼上姓名和班級的標籤，以便老師能輕鬆地整理。","explanation":"動詞「貼標籤」。常用搭配：label sth with sth。"},{"sentence":"The clothing <target>label</target> on the back of the shirt was scratchy, so she decided to cut it off before wearing it.","translation":"襯衫背後的衣物標籤很刺，所以她決定在穿之前把它剪掉。","explanation":"名詞「標籤」。"},{"sentence":"The music student finally signed a contract with a major record <target>label</target> after his songs became popular on social media.","translation":"這位音樂學生在歌曲於社群媒體上流行後，終於與一家大型唱片公司簽約。","explanation":"名詞「唱片公司」。"},{"sentence":"It is unfair to <target>label</target> a student <pattern>as</pattern> lazy just because they struggle with one particular subject in school.","translation":"僅僅因為一名學生在學校某個特定科目上遇到困難，就將其標記為懶惰是不公平的。","explanation":"動詞「定義/貼標籤」。常用搭配：label sth as sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "lace", "explanation": "名詞指「蕾絲」或「鞋帶」，動詞指「繫鞋帶」或「用蕾絲裝飾」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The fashion historian explained that the intricate patterns of the <target>lace</target> dress reflected the high social status and wealth of the nobility during the Renaissance.", "translation": "時尚歷史學家解釋說，蕾絲禮服的精細圖案反映了文藝復興時期貴族的社會地位和財富。", "explanation": "名詞「蕾絲」。"}, {"sentence": "After realizing his <target>laces</target> were loose, the athlete paused briefly to tie them securely, avoiding any potential risk of tripping during the high-stakes competition.", "translation": "在意識到鞋帶鬆了之後，這位運動員短暫地停下來將其繫牢，以避免在激烈的競爭中面臨絆倒的風險。", "explanation": "名詞「鞋帶」。"}, {"sentence": "The competitive runner had to <target>lace</target> <pattern>up</pattern> her professional racing shoes tightly to ensure maximum ankle stability and prevent injuries during the sprint.", "translation": "這位競速跑者必須將她的專業賽跑鞋繫緊，以確保在衝刺期間腳踝的最大穩定性並防止受傷。", "explanation": "動詞「繫鞋帶」。常用搭配：lace up。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"ladder","explanation":"名詞「梯子」。常用搭配：climb the ladder (爬梯子/晉升)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The painter used a tall <target>ladder</target> to reach the ceiling and paint the corners of the room a bright white.","translation":"油漆工使用一個高梯子來觸及天花板，並將房間的角落塗成亮白色。","explanation":"名詞「梯子」。"},{"sentence":"In many large companies, employees work hard to climb the corporate <target>ladder</target> and reach a higher management position.","translation":"在許多大公司中，員工努力工作以攀登企業階梯，以達到更高的管理職位。","explanation":"名詞「梯子」。在此處為比喻用法，指晉升路徑。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "lately", "explanation": "副詞「最近」。與 recently 相似，但 lately 常位於句末或用於完成式句型中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students have been feeling increasingly overwhelmed by the competitive nature of their academic environment <target>lately</target>, leading to a rise in stress-related health issues.", "translation": "許多學生最近對競爭激烈的學術環境感到壓力日益增加，導致與壓力相關的健康問題增加。", "explanation": "副詞「最近」。"}, {"sentence": "The local government has implemented several new environmental policies <target>lately</target> in an attempt to reduce the carbon footprint of the city's industrial zones.", "translation": "地方政府最近實施了幾項新的環境政策，試圖減少城市工業區的碳足跡。", "explanation": "副詞「最近」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "laughter", "explanation": "名詞「笑聲」。由動詞 laugh 演變而來。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sound of children's <target>laughter</target> filled the park, creating a happy and peaceful atmosphere for everyone visiting.", "translation": "孩子們的笑聲充滿了公園，為每個遊客營造了一個快樂且和平的氛圍。", "explanation": "名詞「笑聲」。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the stress of the final exams, the students shared a moment of <target>laughter</target> together in the library.", "translation": "儘管期末考的壓力很大，學生們在圖書館裡共同分享了一刻的笑聲。", "explanation": "名詞「笑聲」。"}, {"sentence": "As soon as the comedian told the punchline of his joke, the entire audience <pattern>burst</pattern> <pattern>into</pattern> <target>laughter</target>, echoing throughout the hall.", "translation": "喜劇演員一說出笑話的笑點，全場觀眾隨即哄堂大笑，笑聲在禮堂中迴盪。", "explanation": "名詞「笑聲」。常用搭配：burst into laughter (突然大笑)。"}], "related_forms": ["laugh"]}

{"headword":"laundry","explanation":"名詞「洗滌物」或「洗衣店」。常用搭配：do the laundry (洗衣服)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a long week of school, she spent Saturday morning <pattern>doing</pattern> the <target>laundry</target> to prepare her uniforms for next week.","translation":"經過一週的學校生活後，她利用週六上午洗衣服，為下週準備制服。","explanation":"名詞「洗滌物」。常用搭配：do the laundry。"},{"sentence":"He forgot to pick up his <target>laundry</target> from the cleaners, so he had to wear his second-best suit to the interview.","translation":"他忘了從洗衣店取回他的洗滌物，所以他不得不穿著他的第二套西裝去面試。","explanation":"名詞「洗衣店/洗滌物」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lawn","explanation":"名詞「草坪」。常用搭配：mow the lawn (剪草)。","entries":[{"sentence":"My father spends every Sunday morning <pattern>mowing</pattern> the <target>lawn</target> to keep the grass short and neat for the neighborhood.","translation":"我父親每個週日早晨都會修剪草坪，以保持草地短而整齊，讓鄰居們覺得好看。","explanation":"名詞「草坪」。常用搭配：mow the lawn。"},{"sentence":"The hotel has a large, green <target>lawn</target> where guests can relax and enjoy the fresh air after a long trip.","translation":"這家酒店有一個巨大的綠色草坪，客人可以在長途旅行後在此放鬆並享受新鮮空氣。","explanation":"名詞「草坪」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"leak","explanation":"名詞指「漏洞」或「洩漏」，動詞指「漏出」或「洩漏秘密」。注意 leak out (洩漏出)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The plumber was called to fix a small <target>leak</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the kitchen pipe, which had caused water to pool on the floor.","translation":"水管工被請來修理廚房水管的一個小漏洞，這個漏洞導致水在地板上積聚。","explanation":"名詞「漏洞」。常用搭配：leak in sth。"},{"sentence":"The old roof began to <target>leak</target> during the heavy rain, so we had to put buckets under the drips to save the carpet.","translation":"大雨期間，舊屋頂開始漏水，所以我們必須在滴水處下方放置水桶以保護地毯。","explanation":"動詞「漏出」。"},{"sentence":"It was a shock to everyone when the confidential details of the new project <target>leaked</target> <pattern>out</pattern> to the press before the official announcement.","translation":"當新計畫的機密細節在正式公告前洩漏給媒體時，每個人都感到很震驚。","explanation":"動詞「洩漏」。常用搭配：leak out。"}],"related_forms":["leaky"]}

{"headword":"leap","explanation":"動詞「跳躍」；名詞「跳躍、飛躍」。指大幅度的跳躍或進展。常用片語：take a leap of faith (冒險嘗試)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The excited dog took a sudden <target>leap</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the air to catch the frisbee, surprising everyone at the park.","translation":"那隻興奮的狗突然跳向空中去接飛盤，讓公園裡的每個人都大吃一驚。","explanation":"名詞「跳躍」。"},{"sentence":"After months of hard work, the company's sales made a giant <target>leap</target> <pattern>forward</pattern> due to the new marketing strategy.","translation":"經過數月的努力，由於新的行銷策略，公司的銷售額有了巨大的飛躍。","explanation":"名詞「飛躍」。常用片語 a leap forward 表示「重大進展」。"},{"sentence":"Seeing the deep puddle in front of him, the athlete decided to <target>leap</target> <pattern>across</pattern> it to keep his shoes clean.","translation":"看到面前深的水窪，這名運動員決定跳過去以保持鞋子乾淨。","explanation":"動詞「跳躍」。常用搭配 leap across sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite having no guarantee of success, she decided to <target>leap</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the unknown and start her own business.","translation":"儘管沒有成功的保證，她還是決定冒險嘗試，開始經營自己的事業。","explanation":"動詞「跳入/進入」。在此指比喻義的冒險嘗試。"}],"related_forms":["leaps","leaped","leapt","leaping"]}

{"headword":"learning","explanation":"名詞「學習、學問」。指獲取知識的過程或所獲取的知識總量。常用搭配：lifelong learning (終身學習), machine learning (機器學習)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university encourages lifelong <target>learning</target>, urging students to continue seeking knowledge even after they graduate from college.","translation":"大學鼓勵終身學習，敦促學生即使在大學畢業後也要繼續尋求知識。","explanation":"名詞「學習」。常用搭配：lifelong learning (終身學習)。"},{"sentence":"Many students find that <target>learning</target> a second language opens up new opportunities for travel and understanding different cultures.","translation":"許多學生發現學習第二語言為旅遊和理解不同文化開闢了新機會。","explanation":"名詞「學習」。"},{"sentence":"The professor's deep <target>learning</target> in the field of ancient history was evident in every lecture he gave to the class.","translation":"教授在古代歷史領域的深厚學問在他在課堂上的每一次演講中都顯而易見。","explanation":"名詞「學問」。指獲取的知識量。"}],"related_forms":["learn"]}

{"headword":"leather","explanation":"名詞「皮革」。指經過加工的動物皮。常用搭配：genuine leather (真皮), synthetic leather (人造皮)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He decided to buy a high-quality <target>leather</target> jacket for the winter, as it provides excellent protection against the wind and cold.","translation":"他決定買一件高品質的皮革夾克來過冬，因為它能提供極佳的防風防寒保護。","explanation":"名詞「皮革」。作為形容詞修飾 jacket。"},{"sentence":"The luxury handbag was made of genuine <target>leather</target>, making it more durable and expensive than the synthetic versions.","translation":"這個豪華手提包是由真皮製成的，使其比人造皮版本更耐用且更昂貴。","explanation":"名詞「皮革」。常用搭配 genuine leather (真皮)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"leisure","explanation":"名詞「閒暇、餘暇」。指沒有工作或義務時的空閒時間。常用搭配：at your leisure (在你方便時), leisure activities (休閒活動)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the summer vacation, students have more <target>leisure</target> time to pursue their hobbies, such as painting, hiking, or playing music.","translation":"在暑假期間，學生有更多的閒暇時間來追求他們的愛好，例如繪畫、登山或彈音樂。","explanation":"名詞「閒暇」。常用搭配 leisure time (閒暇時間)。"},{"sentence":"Please review the application documents and send them back to the office <pattern>at</pattern> your <target>leisure</target> by next Friday.","translation":"請在下週五之前，在你方便的時候審閱申請文件並將其寄回辦公室。","explanation":"名詞「閒暇」。片語 at one's leisure 表示「在某人方便之時」。"},{"sentence":"The city government built several new parks to provide more space for <target>leisure</target> <pattern>activities</pattern>, improving the quality of life for residents.","translation":"市政府建造了幾個新公園，以提供更多休閒活動的空間，提高居民的生活品質。","explanation":"名詞「閒暇」。常用搭配 leisure activities (休閒活動)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lemonade","explanation":"名詞「檸檬水」。一種由檸檬汁、水和糖製成的飲料。","entries":[{"sentence":"On a hot summer afternoon, nothing is more refreshing than a cold glass of <target>lemonade</target> with a few ice cubes.","translation":"在炎熱的夏季午後，沒有什麼比一杯冰涼的、加了幾顆冰塊的檸檬水更令人清爽了。","explanation":"名詞「檸檬水」。"},{"sentence":"The children set up a small stand on the sidewalk to sell homemade <target>lemonade</target> and raise money for the local animal shelter.","translation":"孩子們在人行道上設置了一個小攤位來販售自製檸檬水，為當地的動物收容所籌集資金。","explanation":"名詞「檸檬水」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"leopard","explanation":"名詞「豹」。一種大型貓科動物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wildlife photographer spent weeks in the jungle, hoping to capture a clear picture of a rare <target>leopard</target> hunting its prey.","translation":"野生動物攝影師在叢林中度過了數週，希望能拍到一張罕見豹子捕食的清晰照片。","explanation":"名詞「豹」。"},{"sentence":"Unlike lions, <target>leopards</target> are known for their ability to climb trees and carry their kills high up to avoid other predators.","translation":"與獅子不同，豹以其攀爬樹木並將獵物帶到高處以避免其他掠食者的能力而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「豹」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lettuce","explanation":"名詞「萵苣，生菜」。一種常用的沙拉蔬菜。","entries":[{"sentence":"For a healthy lunch, she prepared a fresh salad with crisp <target>lettuce</target>, cherry tomatoes, and a light balsamic vinegar dressing.","translation":"為了健康的午餐，她準備了一份新鮮的沙拉，裡面有脆的生菜、櫻桃番茄和輕盈的義大利黑醋醬。","explanation":"名詞「生菜」。"},{"sentence":"The gardener carefully watered the <target>lettuce</target> in the vegetable patch, ensuring the leaves remained green and tender for the harvest.","translation":"園丁小心地為菜圃裡的生菜澆水，確保葉子在採收時保持綠色且鮮嫩。","explanation":"名詞「生菜」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"liberty","explanation":"名詞「自由」。指不受拘束或被囚禁的狀態。常用搭配：take liberties with (擅自更改/冒犯), restrict liberty (限制自由)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The statue in the harbor is a world-famous symbol of <target>liberty</target> and democracy, welcoming immigrants from all over the world.","translation":"港口裡的那尊雕像是一個世界聞名的自由與民主的象徵，歡迎來自世界各地的移民。","explanation":"名詞「自由」。"},{"sentence":"The prisoners fought for years to regain their <target>liberty</target> after being wrongly accused and imprisoned for a crime they did not commit.","translation":"囚犯們為了在被錯誤指控並囚禁於他們未曾犯下的罪行後重新獲得自由而奮鬥了多年。","explanation":"名詞「自由」。"},{"sentence":"The editor decided to <pattern>take</pattern> some <target>liberties</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the original text to make the story more exciting for the general readers.","translation":"編輯決定擅自更改原著的部分內容，使故事對普通讀者來說更精彩。","explanation":"名詞「自由」。片語 take liberties with sth 表示「擅自更改」或「對...採取不恰當的自由」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lick","explanation":"動詞「舔」；名詞「舔的一下」。常用於描述動物或人的動作。","entries":[{"sentence":"The puppy greeted its owner with a friendly <target>lick</target> on the face, showing its excitement after being away for several hours.","translation":"小狗用親切地舔了主人臉一下來迎接主人，表現出它分開幾個小時後的興奮。","explanation":"名詞「舔的一下」。"},{"sentence":"The curious cat started to <target>lick</target> its paws carefully after eating a fish, cleaning itself to maintain its hygiene.","translation":"這隻好奇的貓在吃完魚後開始小心地舔它的爪子，為了維持衛生而清理自己。","explanation":"動詞「舔」。"}],"related_forms":["licks","licked","licking"]}

{"headword":"lifetime","explanation":"名詞「一生，終身」。指一個人或事物存在的所有時間。常用搭配：once-in-a-lifetime (一生一次的), a lifetime of (一生的...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Visiting the Great Wall of China is a <pattern>once-in-a</pattern> <target>lifetime</target> experience for many travelers who want to explore ancient wonders.","translation":"對於許多想要探索古代奇蹟的旅客來說，參觀中國長城是一個一生一次的體驗。","explanation":"名詞「一生」。常用搭配 once-in-a-lifetime experience (一生一次的體驗)。"},{"sentence":"The elderly man spent a <target>lifetime</target> <pattern>of</pattern> hard work and dedication to his craft, eventually becoming a master artist.","translation":"這位老人花了一生的努力和奉獻於他的工藝，最終成為一名大師級藝術家。","explanation":"名詞「一生」。常用搭配 a lifetime of sth。"},{"sentence":"The new medical treatment is designed to provide a <target>lifetime</target> cure for the disease, eliminating the need for daily medication.","translation":"這項新醫療方案旨在為該疾病提供終身治癒，消除對每日服藥的需求。","explanation":"名詞「終身」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lighthouse","explanation":"名詞，意為「燈塔」。主要用於描述引導船隻安全航行或在文學中象徵希望與指引。常用搭配：build a lighthouse (建造燈塔), the light of a lighthouse (燈塔的光)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old <target>lighthouse</target> stood on the rocky cliff, guiding ships safely <pattern>through</pattern> the dangerous waters during stormy nights.","translation":"那座古老的燈塔屹立在岩石峭壁上，在暴風雨之夜引導船隻安全地通過危險海域。","explanation":"名詞「燈塔」。"},{"sentence":"Many tourists visit the historic <target>lighthouse</target> to learn about how keepers used to maintain the light to prevent shipwrecks.","translation":"許多遊客參觀這座歷史悠久的燈塔，以了解守燈人以前如何維護燈光以防止船難。","explanation":"名詞「燈塔」。"}],"related_forms":["lighthouses"]}

{"headword": "lightning", "explanation": "名詞，意為「閃電」。注意與 light (光) 或 lighten (使輕盈/明亮) 的區別。常用搭配：a bolt of lightning (一道閃電), a flash of lightning (一次閃電)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A sudden <pattern>flash</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>lightning</target> lit up the dark sky, followed by a loud clap of thunder that shook the windows.", "translation": "一道突然的閃電照亮了黑夜，隨後是一聲巨大的雷鳴，震動了窗戶。", "explanation": "名詞「閃電」。常用搭配：a flash of lightning (一道閃電)。"}, {"sentence": "The forest fire was started by a <pattern>bolt</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>lightning</target> that struck a dry pine tree during the summer storm.", "translation": "森林大火是由夏日風暴中一道閃電擊中一棵乾燥的松樹而引起的。", "explanation": "名詞「閃電」。常用搭配：a bolt of lightning (一道閃電)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"lily","explanation":"名詞，意為「百合花」。常用於描述自然美景或在文化中象徵純潔。","entries":[{"sentence":"The garden was filled with beautiful white <target>lilies</target> that released a sweet fragrance into the air every spring morning.","translation":"花園裡開滿了美麗的白色百合花，每個春天的早晨都將甜美的香味散發到空氣中。","explanation":"名詞「百合花」。"},{"sentence":"She chose a bouquet of fresh <target>lilies</target> as a gift for her mother, knowing that they were her favorite flowers.","translation":"她選擇了一束新鮮的百合花作為送給母親的禮物，因為她知道那是母親最喜歡的花。","explanation":"名詞「百合花」。"}],"related_forms":["lilies"]}

{"headword":"limb","explanation":"名詞，意為「肢體」或「樹枝」。在生物學或醫學語境中指手臂或腿；在植物學中指較粗的樹枝。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete suffered a serious injury to his lower <target>limb</target> during the final race, which forced him to miss the next season.","translation":"這名運動員在最後一場比賽中下肢受了重傷，導致他不得不缺席下個賽季。","explanation":"名詞「肢體」。指手臂或腿。"},{"sentence":"A heavy branch from the old oak tree fell on the car, as the thick <target>limb</target> could no longer support its own weight.","translation":"古老橡樹的一根粗樹枝落在車上，因為那根粗壯的樹枝已無法承受自身的重量。","explanation":"名詞「樹枝」。"}],"related_forms":["limbs"]}

{"headword":"litter","explanation":"名詞可指「垃圾」或「一胎所生的幼崽」；動詞指「亂丟垃圾」。注意 litter (垃圾) 與 garbage/trash 的區別：litter 通常指散落在公共場所的小件垃圾，如紙屑、菸蒂。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local government encourages citizens to stop <target>littering</target> <pattern>in</pattern> public parks to keep the environment clean and healthy for everyone.","translation":"地方政府鼓勵市民停止在公共公園亂丟垃圾，以保持環境整潔，對每個人都有益。","explanation":"動詞「亂丟垃圾」。"},{"sentence":"After the outdoor music festival, the grass was <target>littered</target> <pattern>with</pattern> plastic bottles and food wrappers left behind by the crowd.","translation":"戶外音樂祭結束後，草地上遍佈著人群留下的塑膠瓶和食物包裝紙。","explanation":"動詞「佈滿」。常用搭配：be littered with (佈滿垃圾)。"},{"sentence":"The animal shelter manages a large <target>litter</target> <pattern>of</pattern> kittens, providing them with food and medical care until they find new homes.","translation":"動物收容所照顧著一胎的小貓，為牠們提供食物和醫療照顧，直到牠們找到新家。","explanation":"名詞「一胎所生的幼崽」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lively","explanation":"形容詞，意為「活潑的、熱鬧的、充滿活力的」。常用於描述人、氣氛或音樂。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students had a <target>lively</target> <pattern>discussion</pattern> about the environmental issues, sharing different perspectives and ideas with great enthusiasm.","translation":"學生們對環境問題進行了熱烈的討論，以極大的熱情分享了不同的觀點和想法。","explanation":"形容詞「熱烈的」。常用搭配：lively discussion (熱烈的討論)。"},{"sentence":"The city center is always <target>lively</target> <pattern>on</pattern> weekends, with many street performers and tourists filling the crowded sidewalks.","translation":"市中心在週末總是熱鬧非凡，有許多街頭表演者和遊客填滿了擁擠的人行道。","explanation":"形容詞「熱鬧的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"loaf","explanation":"名詞，意為「一條/塊（麵包）」。這是量詞，常用於指長方形的吐司或大塊麵包。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baker carefully placed a fresh <target>loaf</target> <pattern>of</pattern> bread on the shelf, filling the bakery with a warm, delicious smell.","translation":"麵包師傅小心地將一條新鮮的麵包放在架子上，讓麵包店裡充滿了溫暖、美味的香味。","explanation":"名詞「一條/塊」。常用搭配：a loaf of bread (一條麵包)。"},{"sentence":"My mother bought a whole <target>loaf</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sourdough bread from the local market to make sandwiches for the whole family.","translation":"我母親從當地市場買了一條完整的酸種麵包，為全家人製作三明治。","explanation":"名詞「一條/塊」。"}],"related_forms":["loaves"]}

{"headword":"lobby","explanation":"名詞，意為「大廳」或「遊說」。作為大廳時，指建築物入口處的空間；作為遊說時，指影響政府決策的行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"The guests were asked to wait in the hotel <target>lobby</target> until their rooms were ready for check-in.","translation":"客人被要求在飯店大廳等待，直到他們的房間準備好可以辦理入住。","explanation":"名詞「大廳」。"},{"sentence":"Environmental groups tried to <target>lobby</target> the government <pattern>to</pattern> pass a new law that restricts the use of single-use plastics.","translation":"環保團體試圖遊說政府通過一項限制使用一次性塑膠的新法律。","explanation":"動詞「遊說」。"}],"related_forms":["lobbying","lobbyist"]}

{"headword":"locate","explanation":"動詞，意為「位於」或「尋找」。注意 locate (位於) 與 location (位置) 的區別。常用搭配：be located in/at (位於...之中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new campus library is <target>located</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the center of the university, making it easy for students to access.","translation":"新校園圖書館位於大學中心，方便學生使用。","explanation":"動詞「位於」。常用搭配：be located in/at (位於...之中)。"},{"sentence":"The rescue team used satellite technology to <target>locate</target> the missing hikers who were lost in the deep mountains.","translation":"救援隊使用衛星技術來尋找失蹤的登山客，他們在深山中迷路了。","explanation":"動詞「尋找」。"}],"related_forms":["location"]}

{"headword":"location","explanation":"名詞，意為「位置、地點」。常用於指特定的地理位置或拍攝地點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company spent several months searching for the perfect <target>location</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their new office, considering traffic and convenience.","translation":"公司花了幾個月時間尋找新辦公室的最佳位置，考慮到了交通和便利性。","explanation":"名詞「位置」。常用搭配：location for sth (某事的位址)。"},{"sentence":"The film director decided to shoot the entire movie on <target>location</target> <pattern>in</pattern> Italy to capture the authentic atmosphere of the city.","translation":"電影導演決定在義大利實地拍攝整部電影，以捕捉該城市的真實氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「地點」。on location 意為「在實地、在現場拍攝」。"}],"related_forms":["locate"]}

{"headword": "lock", "explanation": "動詞「鎖上」；名詞「鎖」。動詞片語 lock up (鎖起來)；lock out (反鎖在外)。名詞片語 under lock and key (妥善保管)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before leaving for the long holiday, she always remembers to <target>lock</target> all the doors and windows to ensure her apartment's safety.", "translation": "在去長假之前，她總是記得鎖上所有的門窗，以確保公寓的安全。", "explanation": "動詞「鎖上」。常用搭配 lock the door/window。"}, {"sentence": "The old wooden chest had a rusty <target>lock</target> that made it difficult to open, hinting at forgotten treasures inside.", "translation": "這個舊木箱上有一把生鏽的鎖，很難打開，暗示著裡面有被遺忘的寶藏。", "explanation": "名詞「鎖」。"}, {"sentence": "The mischievous children accidentally <target>locked</target> their parents <pattern>out</pattern> of the house, causing panic before they found the spare key.", "translation": "調皮的孩子們不小心把父母反鎖在屋外，在他們找到備用鑰匙之前引起了一陣恐慌。", "explanation": "動詞片語 lock out 表「反鎖在外」。"}], "related_forms": ["locked", "unlock"]}

{"headword":"log","explanation":"名詞可用於「原木」或「紀錄（日誌）」，動詞則表示「紀錄」或「登入（log in/into）」。在 GSAT 中，log in/into (登入) 是極為重要的片語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The campers spent the entire afternoon gathering dry <target>logs</target> to build a fire for cooking their dinner and keeping warm.","translation":"露營者花了一整個下午收集乾原木來生火煮晚餐並取暖。","explanation":"名詞「原木」。指砍伐後未經加工的樹幹。"},{"sentence":"The captain kept a detailed <target>log</target> of the ship's journey, recording every change in weather and position each day.","translation":"船長對航行過程做了詳細的紀錄，每天記錄天氣和位置的每一次變化。","explanation":"名詞「紀錄、日誌」。指對事件按時間順序記錄的詳細清單。"},{"sentence":"Please remember to <target>log</target> <pattern>into</pattern> your student account using your ID number to access the online library resources.","translation":"請記得使用你的學號登入學生帳號，以使用線上圖書館資源。","explanation":"動詞片語 log into sth 意為「登入」。這是現代科技環境中最常見的用法。"},{"sentence":"The security guard <target>logged</target> the time and date of every visitor who entered the building to maintain a strict record.","translation":"保全人員記錄了每個進入建築物的人的時間和日期，以維持嚴格的紀錄。","explanation":"動詞「紀錄」。指將資訊正式地記錄在日誌或電腦系統中。"}],"related_forms":["logs","logged","logging"]}

{"headword":"lollipop","explanation":"名詞「棒棒糖」。一種將糖果固定在小棍子上的甜點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little girl was happily chewing on a colorful <target>lollipop</target> while waiting for her parents to pick her up from school.","translation":"小女孩在等父母接她放學時，開心地咬著一顆彩色棒棒糖。","explanation":"名詞「棒棒糖」。"},{"sentence":"As a reward for finishing her homework early, the teacher gave each student a <target>lollipop</target> during the class break.","translation":"作為早早完成作業的獎勵，老師在課間給每位學生一顆棒棒糖。","explanation":"名詞「棒棒糖」。"}],"related_forms":["lollipops"]}

{"headword":"loose","explanation":"形容詞「鬆的、寬鬆的」。常用於描述衣服尺寸過大或某物未被固定住。注意與 lose (失去) 的拼寫與發音區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shirt was too <target>loose</target> for him, so he decided to exchange it for a smaller size at the clothing store.","translation":"這件襯衫對他來說太寬鬆了，所以他決定在服飾店將其更換為較小的尺寸。","explanation":"形容詞「寬鬆的」。描述衣服不合身。"},{"sentence":"The climber felt a <target>loose</target> <pattern>rock</pattern> beneath his feet and quickly grabbed a nearby branch to avoid falling.","translation":"登山者感覺到腳下有一塊鬆動的岩石，趕快抓住附近的樹枝以避免墜落。","explanation":"形容詞「鬆動的」。常用搭配：loose rock (鬆動的岩石)。"},{"sentence":"She noticed that a <target>loose</target> <pattern>thread</pattern> was hanging from her sweater, so she carefully pulled it out with a pair of scissors.","translation":"她注意到毛衣上有一根鬆掉的線頭，於是小心地用剪刀將其剪掉。","explanation":"形容詞「鬆的」。常用搭配：loose thread (鬆掉的線頭)。"}],"related_forms":["loosen","loosely","looseness"]}

{"headword":"lord","explanation":"名詞「領主、主」。常用於歷史背景描述或宗教語境中。在現代英文中，也可用於特定稱謂。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the Middle Ages, the peasants worked on the <target>lord</target>'s land in exchange for protection and a place to live.","translation":"在中世紀，農民在領主的土地上工作，以換取保護和居住地。","explanation":"名詞「領主」。指在封建制度中擁有土地的權力者。"},{"sentence":"The noble <target>lord</target> held a grand banquet in his castle to celebrate the victory of the royal army in the war.","translation":"那位貴族領主在他的城堡裡舉辦了一場盛大的宴會，以慶祝皇家軍隊在戰爭中的勝利。","explanation":"名詞「領主」。"}],"related_forms":["lords"]}

{"headword":"loser","explanation":"名詞「失敗者」。通常指在比賽或競爭中輸掉的人，在非正式語境中也可用作對人的侮辱。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he was the <target>loser</target> of the tennis match, he shook hands with his opponent and congratulated him on his victory.","translation":"雖然他是網球賽的失敗者，但他與對手握手並祝賀對方的勝利。","explanation":"名詞「失敗者」。指競爭中的輸家。"},{"sentence":"Some people call him a <target>loser</target> because he has no steady job, but he is actually a very talented artist.","translation":"有些人稱他為失敗者，因為他沒有穩定的工作，但實際上他是一位非常有才華的藝術家。","explanation":"名詞「失敗者」。在此處為非正式的貶義稱呼。"}],"related_forms":["lose"]}

{"headword":"lover","explanation":"名詞「愛好者、戀人」。除了指浪漫關係中的對象外，常指對某事有強烈熱情的人，如 music lover (音樂愛好者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a passionate <target>lover</target> <pattern>of</pattern> classical music, she spends most of her weekends visiting concert halls and reading music scores.","translation":"作為一名古典音樂的熱愛者，她大部分的週末都花在參觀音樂廳和閱讀樂譜上。","explanation":"名詞「愛好者」。常用搭配：lover of sth (某事的愛好者)。"},{"sentence":"The two <target>lovers</target> walked hand in hand along the beach, enjoying the sunset and talking about their future together.","translation":"這對戀人手牽手沿著海邊散步，享受著夕陽並討論他們共同的未來。","explanation":"名詞「戀人」。指具有浪漫關係的人。"}],"related_forms":["love"]}

{"headword": "luggage", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。注意 luggage 是不可數名詞，不能加 s 或使用 a luggage，若要表示一件行李，需使用 a piece of luggage。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After arriving at the airport, the passengers were asked to leave their <target>luggage</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the conveyor belt for security screening.", "translation": "到達機場後，乘客被要求將行李放在傳送帶上進行安全檢查。", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。不可數名詞。常用搭配：luggage on the conveyor belt (傳送帶上的行李)。"}, {"sentence": "She realized she had forgotten a piece of <target>luggage</target> in the hotel room, so she had to call the front desk immediately.", "translation": "她意識到自己忘記了一件行李在飯店房間裡，因此必須立即致電櫃檯。", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。使用 a piece of luggage 來量化不可數名詞 luggage。"}, {"sentence": "The travel agent advised the students to pack light and bring only the most necessary <target>luggage</target> for their short study trip.", "translation": "旅行社建議學生輕裝上陣，這次短期的留學旅行僅攜帶最必要的行李。", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"lung","explanation":"名詞「肺」。生物學或醫療相關的基礎詞彙。","entries":[{"sentence":"Smoking can cause severe damage to the <target>lungs</target>, increasing the risk of developing serious respiratory diseases over time.","translation":"吸菸會對肺造成嚴重損傷，隨著時間推移，增加患嚴重呼吸系統疾病的風險。","explanation":"名詞「肺」。通常以複數形式 lungs 出現，指一對肺。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the <target>lungs</target> are responsible for exchanging oxygen and carbon dioxide between the air and the blood.","translation":"醫生解釋說，肺負責在空氣和血液之間交換氧氣和二氧化碳。","explanation":"名詞「肺」。"}],"related_forms":["lungs"]}

{"headword":"magical","explanation":"形容詞「神奇的、魔幻的」。可用於描述超自然力量或令人驚嘆、極其美好的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children were fascinated by the <target>magical</target> <pattern>powers</pattern> of the fairy godmother, who could turn a pumpkin into a carriage.","translation":"孩子們被仙女教母的神奇力量所吸引，她能將南瓜變成馬車。","explanation":"形容詞「神奇的」。常用搭配：magical powers (神奇力量)。"},{"sentence":"The view from the mountain top was absolutely <target>magical</target>, with the golden sunlight reflecting off the snowy peaks.","translation":"山頂的風景絕對是神奇且迷人的，金色的陽光在雪山頂端反射。","explanation":"形容詞「神奇的、美妙的」。描述令人驚嘆的景象。"}],"related_forms":["magic","magically"]}

{"headword":"magician","explanation":"名詞「魔術師」。指表演魔術的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>magician</target> amazed the audience by making a white rabbit disappear from his hat with a quick flick of his wrist.","translation":"魔術師用手腕快速地揮動一下，讓一隻白兔從帽子中消失，令觀眾驚訝不已。","explanation":"名詞「魔術師」。"},{"sentence":"During the school talent show, the <target>magician</target> <pattern>performed</pattern> a series of card tricks that left everyone in the room wondering how he did it.","translation":"在學校才藝表演中，魔術師表演了一系列紙牌魔術，讓房間裡的每個人都好奇他是如何做到的。","explanation":"名詞「魔術師」。常用搭配：perform a trick (表演魔術)。"}],"related_forms":["magic","magicians"]}

{"headword":"magnet","explanation":"名詞「磁鐵」，也可比喻為「吸引人的事物或人」。常用搭配：a magnet for (吸引...的磁鐵/中心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a strong <target>magnet</target> to show the students how metal objects are attracted to it during the science experiment.","translation":"老師在科學實驗中使用了強大的磁鐵向學生展示金屬物體是如何被它吸引的。","explanation":"名詞「磁鐵」。"},{"sentence":"The beautiful beaches and sunny weather make this island a <target>magnet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> tourists from all over the world.","translation":"美麗的沙灘和陽光天氣使這個島嶼成為吸引全世界遊客的中心。","explanation":"名詞「吸引人的事物」。比喻用法，常用搭配 a magnet for sth。"}],"related_forms":["magnets"]}

{"headword":"maid","explanation":"名詞「女僕、女傭」。在現代語境中，常用於酒店（housekeeping）或私人家庭的清潔人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel <target>maid</target> comes every morning to clean the room, replace the towels, and make sure everything is tidy for the guests.","translation":"酒店的女傭每天早晨來清理房間，更換毛巾，並確保所有事情對客人來說都是整潔的。","explanation":"名詞「女僕、女傭」。"},{"sentence":"In the old story, the kind <target>maid</target> worked hard to take care of the wealthy family and their large house.","translation":"在古老的故事中，善良的女傭辛苦地照顧那個富裕的家庭及其大房子。","explanation":"名詞「女僕、女傭」。"}],"related_forms":["maids"]}

{"headword": "majority", "explanation": "名詞「大多數，大部分」。指一個群體中數量較大的一部分。常用片語 a majority of (大多數的...)。注意與 minority (少數) 相對。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>majority</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students voted for the class trip to the amusement park, showing a clear preference over the museum visit.", "translation": "大多數學生投票支持班級旅行去遊樂園，顯示出對博物館參觀的明顯偏好。", "explanation": "名詞「大多數」。常用片語 a majority of + N (複數動詞或單數動詞依N而定)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite some opposition, the proposal was approved by a <pattern>slim</pattern> <target>majority</target> in the student council, indicating close voting results.", "translation": "儘管有些反對，這項提案仍以學生會的微弱多數通過，顯示投票結果非常接近。", "explanation": "名詞「大多數」。常用形容詞：large/vast majority (絕大多數), slim/bare majority (微弱多數)。"}], "related_forms": ["major"]}

{"headword":"mall","explanation":"名詞「購物中心」。指一個大型的室內或室外商業區，包含許多商店和餐廳。","entries":[{"sentence":"On weekends, many teenagers like to hang out at the <target>mall</target> with their friends to shop for clothes and eat snacks.","translation":"週末，許多青少年喜歡和朋友一起在購物中心閒逛，買衣服並吃零食。","explanation":"名詞「購物中心」。"},{"sentence":"The new shopping <target>mall</target> in the city center is so huge that it takes an hour just to walk from one end to the other.","translation":"市中心的購物中心如此巨大，以至於從一端走到另一端就得花一個小時。","explanation":"名詞「購物中心」。"}],"related_forms":["malls"]}

{"headword": "mankind", "explanation": "名詞「人類」。humankind 較為中性，mankind 較傳統。常用於討論人類歷史、發展或對地球的影響。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The invention of the internet has completely changed the way <target>mankind</target> communicates and shares information across the globe.", "translation": "網際網路的發明完全改變了人類在全球溝通和分享資訊的方式。", "explanation": "名詞「人類」。指全人類。"}, {"sentence": "Exploring outer space is one of the greatest achievements of <target>mankind</target>, showing our curiosity and desire to learn about the universe.", "translation": "探索外太空是人類最偉大的成就之一，展現了我們對宇宙的好奇心和學習慾望。", "explanation": "名詞「人類」。"}], "related_forms": ["humankind"]}

{"headword":"marble","explanation":"名詞「大理石」。常用於建築、雕刻或描述地板、台面。","entries":[{"sentence":"The grand hallway of the museum is paved with polished white <target>marble</target>, giving the building a luxurious and elegant appearance.","translation":"博物館的大廳鋪著拋光過的白色大理石，使建築物顯得豪華且優雅。","explanation":"名詞「大理石」。"},{"sentence":"The artist spent months carving a beautiful statue out of a single piece of <target>marble</target> to capture the detail of the human body.","translation":"藝術家花了好幾個月時間，用一塊大理石雕刻出一尊美麗的雕像，以捕捉人體的細節。","explanation":"名詞「大理石」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"march","explanation":"動詞「齊步走、行軍」；名詞「三月」或「行軍」。在 GSAT 中，注意其動詞用法以及名詞作為「進軍/前進」的含義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers were ordered to <target>march</target> in perfect unison, keeping their steps synchronized as they moved toward the camp.","translation":"士兵們被命令齊步走，在向營地移動時保持步調一致。","explanation":"動詞「齊步走、行軍」。"},{"sentence":"During the peaceful <target>march</target> for climate change, thousands of people walked through the city to demand a better future for the planet.","translation":"在這次為了氣候變遷的和平遊行中，數千人走過城市，要求為地球創造更好的未來。","explanation":"名詞「遊行、行軍」。"},{"sentence":"Since the exam is in <target>March</target>, students should start reviewing their notes and practicing past papers now to be well-prepared.","translation":"因為考試在三月，學生現在應該開始複習筆記並練習歷屆試題，以便做好充分準備。","explanation":"名詞「三月」。"}],"related_forms":["marched","marching"]}
comment: Note: 'March' as a month is a proper noun, but the creator handled it correctly.

response: {"headword":"marker","explanation":"名詞「標記、標記筆」。可指用於標記位置的物體，或指用於書寫的筆（如 whiteboard marker）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a blue <target>marker</target> to highlight the key points on the whiteboard, making them easier for the students to see.","translation":"老師用藍色標記筆在白板上標出重點，使學生更容易看到。","explanation":"名詞「標記筆」。"},{"sentence":"The hikers left a small stone <target>marker</target> on the trail to help other travelers find their way back to the campsite.","translation":"登山客在小徑上留下了一個小石頭標記，以幫助其他旅人找到回營地的路。","explanation":"名詞「標記」。"}],"related_forms":["markers"]}

{"headword":"marvelous","explanation":"形容詞「極好的、令人驚嘆的」。用於表達強烈的讚美，同義詞為 wonderful 或 extraordinary。","entries":[{"sentence":"The view from the top of the mountain was <target>marvelous</target>, offering a clear sight of the entire valley and the surrounding forests.","translation":"山頂的風景極其壯麗，可以清楚地看到整個山谷和周圍的森林。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的、令人驚嘆的」。"},{"sentence":"After months of hard work, the student received a <target>marvelous</target> score on her final project, which made her parents very proud.","translation":"經過數月努力，這名學生在期末專題中獲得了極佳的分數，讓她的父母感到非常自豪。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的」。"}],"related_forms":["marvelously","marvel"]}

{"headword": "mathematical", "explanation": "形容詞「數學的」。常用於描述數學方法、公式或能力。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To solve the physics problem, the students had to apply complex <target>mathematical</target> <pattern>formulas</pattern> to calculate the speed of the light.", "translation": "為了解決這個物理問題，學生必須應用複雜的數學公式來計算光速。", "explanation": "形容詞「數學的」。常用搭配：mathematical formula (數學公式)。"}, {"sentence": "The architect used precise <target>mathematical</target> <pattern>calculations</pattern> to ensure that the building would be stable and safe for the people inside.", "translation": "建築師使用了精確的數學計算，以確保建築物對內部人員來說是穩定且安全的。", "explanation": "形容詞「數學的」。常用搭配：mathematical calculation (數學計算)。"}], "related_forms": ["mathematics", "mathematician"]}

{"headword":"mayor","explanation":"名詞「市長」。指一個城市的最高行政長官。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>mayor</target> gave a speech at the city hall to announce the new plan for improving public transportation and reducing traffic jams.","translation":"市長在市政廳發表演講，宣布改善大眾運輸並減少交通擁堵的新計畫。","explanation":"名詞「市長」。"},{"sentence":"During the annual festival, the <target>mayor</target> welcomed the visitors and thanked the local businesses for their support of the community.","translation":"在年度節慶期間，市長歡迎了訪客，並感謝當地企業對社區的支持。","explanation":"名詞「市長」。"}],"related_forms":["mayors"]}

{"headword":"meadow","explanation":"名詞「草地，牧場」。通常指一片長滿草且適合放牧或種植乾草的開闊地。常用於描述自然風景。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children spent the afternoon running through the flower-filled <target>meadow</target>, enjoying the fresh air and the sound of birds.","translation":"孩子們花了一個下午在開滿鮮花的草地上奔跑，享受著清新空氣和鳥鳴聲。","explanation":"名詞「草地」。描述自然環境中的開闊草地。"},{"sentence":"Cows were grazing peacefully in the wide <target>meadow</target> behind the farmhouse, waiting for the farmer to lead them back.","translation":"牛隻在農舍後方寬廣的牧場中安詳地吃草，等待農夫將牠們領回去。","explanation":"名詞「牧場」。指用於放牧的草地。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"meaningful","explanation":"形容詞「有意義的」。指事物具有重要價值、深刻影響或能傳達明確訊息。常用搭配：meaningful conversation (有意義的對話), meaningful relationship (有意義的關係)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Volunteering at the local animal shelter provided the student with a <target>meaningful</target> <pattern>experience</pattern>, teaching him the importance of compassion.","translation":"在當地的動物收容所擔任志工為這名學生提供了一次有意義的經驗，教會他同情心的重要性。","explanation":"形容詞「有意義的」。常用搭配：meaningful experience (有意義的經驗)。"},{"sentence":"Instead of just chatting about the weather, they had a <target>meaningful</target> <pattern>discussion</pattern> about their future goals and personal values.","translation":"他們沒有只是聊聊天氣，而是就他們的未來目標和個人價值觀進行了一場有意義的討論。","explanation":"形容詞「有意義的」。常用搭配：meaningful discussion (有意義的討論)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave her a <target>meaningful</target> <pattern>look</pattern>, suggesting that she should stop talking and focus on the upcoming exam.","translation":"老師給了她一個有意義的眼神，暗示她應該停止交談並專注於即將到來的考試。","explanation":"形容詞「有意義的」。在此指眼神傳達了特定的訊息。"}],"related_forms":["meaningfully"]}

{"headword":"meanwhile","explanation":"副詞「在此同時，與此同時」。用於連接兩個同時發生的動作或情況，或用於對比兩個不同的場景。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students were diligently studying for their final exams in the library; <target>meanwhile</target>, their classmates were playing basketball on the court.","translation":"學生們在圖書館裡勤奮地準備期末考；與此同時，他們的同學正在球場上打籃球。","explanation":"副詞「與此同時」。用於對比兩個同時發生的動作。"},{"sentence":"The government is working to reduce pollution; <target>meanwhile</target>, citizens are encouraged to use public transport to protect the environment.","translation":"政府正努力減少污染；與此同時，公民被鼓勵使用大眾運輸工具來保護環境。","explanation":"副詞「與此同時」。連接兩個相關但不同的行動。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"medal","explanation":"名詞「獎牌」。通常指為了表彰成就、勇氣或在競賽中獲勝而授予的金屬圓盤。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete felt an overwhelming sense of pride as she received a gold <target>medal</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her outstanding performance in the Olympics.","translation":"這位運動員在因為其在奧運會上的傑出表現而獲得金牌時，感到一種壓倒性的自豪感。","explanation":"名詞「獎牌」。常用搭配：medal for sth (因...而獲得的獎牌)。"},{"sentence":"The soldier was awarded a <target>medal</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>honor</pattern> for his bravery during the rescue operation in the war zone.","translation":"這名士兵因在戰爭地帶救援行動中的勇敢表現而獲頒榮譽勳章。","explanation":"名詞「獎牌/勳章」。常用搭配：medal of honor (榮譽勳章)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"medium","explanation":"名詞「媒介；手段；中等大小」。複數形式為 media。作媒介時，指傳遞訊息或藝術創作的工具。作大小時，指中等。","entries":[{"sentence":"English has become the primary <target>medium</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>instruction</pattern> in many international schools to facilitate global communication.","translation":"英語已成為許多國際學校的主要教學媒介，以促進全球交流。","explanation":"名詞「媒介」。常用搭配：medium of instruction (教學媒介)。"},{"sentence":"The artist chose oil paint as his preferred <target>medium</target> for creating realistic portraits of people in his hometown.","translation":"藝術家選擇油畫顏料作為他創作家鄉人寫實肖像畫的首選媒介。","explanation":"名詞「媒介」。指藝術創作使用的材料。"},{"sentence":"Since the shirt was too large for him, he decided to change it to a <target>medium</target> size to fit his body better.","translation":"因為這件襯衫對他來說太大了，他決定將其更換為中號，以更好地適合他的身材。","explanation":"名詞「中等大小」。"},{"sentence":"The rise of social <target>media</target> has fundamentally changed the way people share information and connect with others worldwide.","translation":"社群媒體的興起從根本上改變了人們分享資訊並與他人建立聯繫的方式。","explanation":"名詞「媒體」。medium 的複數形式，指傳遞資訊的媒介。"}],"related_forms":["media"]}

{"headword":"melon","explanation":"名詞「瓜類」。指一類大型且多汁的果實，如西瓜 (watermelon) 或哈密瓜 (cantaloupe)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the hot summer days, nothing is more refreshing than a chilled slice of <target>melon</target> to cool down the body.","translation":"在炎熱的夏季，沒有什麼比一片冰冷的瓜類果實更能讓身體冷卻下來且令人感到清爽了。","explanation":"名詞「瓜類」。"},{"sentence":"The farmer's market offered a variety of sweet, ripe <target>melons</target> that were grown locally using organic farming methods.","translation":"農夫市場提供多種在地使用有機農法種植的甜美成熟瓜類。","explanation":"名詞「瓜類」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"melt","explanation":"動詞「融化；消融」。指固體因熱量而變為液體，或指冰雪消融。也可指心靈被觸動。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the sun rose higher in the sky, the snow on the mountain peaks began to <target>melt</target> and flow into the nearby streams.","translation":"隨著太陽在空中升得更高，山頂的雪開始融化並流入附近的溪流。","explanation":"動詞「融化」。指冰雪因熱而變液體。"},{"sentence":"The chocolate bars in the student's backpack began to <target>melt</target> because of the extreme heat in the classroom during the afternoon.","translation":"學生背包裡的巧克力棒因為下午教室裡的極端高溫而開始融化。","explanation":"動詞「融化」。指固體因熱變液體。"},{"sentence":"The mother's heart <target>melted</target> when she saw her young son's sincere apology and his small, handmade gift.","translation":"當母親看到幼子誠懇的道歉和他的小手工禮物時，她的心融化了。","explanation":"動詞「融化」。比喻指心靈被觸動。"}],"related_forms":["melting"]}

{"headword":"mend","explanation":"動詞「修理；修補」。指將損壞的事物（如衣服、關係或骨折）恢復到正常狀態。常用片語：mend a relationship (修補關係)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student decided to <target>mend</target> the hole in his favorite old jeans using a needle and thread, rather than buying a new pair.","translation":"這名學生決定用針線修補他最喜歡的那條舊牛仔褲上的洞，而不是買一條新褲子。","explanation":"動詞「修理；修補」。指修補衣服或物品。"},{"sentence":"After a long and bitter argument, the two friends tried to <target>mend</target> <pattern>their relationship</pattern> by talking honestly about their feelings.","translation":"經過一場漫長而激烈的爭吵後，這兩個朋友試圖透過誠實地討論感受來修補他們的關係。","explanation":"動詞「修補」。常用搭配：mend a relationship (修補關係)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor told the athlete that his broken bone would take several weeks to <target>mend</target> completely before he could return to the sport.","translation":"醫生告訴這位運動員，他的骨折處會需要幾個星期才能完全癒合，之後他才能回到運動場。","explanation":"動詞「修補/癒合」。指身體組織的恢復。"}],"related_forms":["mender"]}

{"headword": "mental", "explanation": "形容詞「心理的、精神的」。常用於描述與心智、思想相關的事物，如 mental health (心理健康)、mental illness (精神疾病)。注意與 physical (身體的) 相對。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Maintaining good <target>mental</target> <pattern>health</pattern> is crucial for students to cope with academic pressure and daily challenges effectively.", "translation": "維持良好的心理健康對學生有效應對學業壓力和日常挑戰至關重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「心理的、精神的」。常用搭配：mental health (心理健康)。"}, {"sentence": "Solving complex puzzles and reading challenging books are excellent ways to provide <target>mental</target> <pattern>exercise</pattern> and keep the brain active.", "translation": "解決複雜的謎題和閱讀有挑戰性的書籍是提供心智鍛鍊並保持大腦活躍的絕佳方式。", "explanation": "形容詞「心智的」。常用搭配：mental exercise (心智鍛鍊)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher observed that the student possessed exceptional <target>mental</target> <pattern>abilities</pattern>, allowing him to grasp difficult concepts quickly.", "translation": "老師觀察到這名學生擁有卓越的心智能力，使他能快速理解困難的概念。", "explanation": "形容詞「心智的」。常用搭配：mental ability (心智能力)。"}], "related_forms": ["mentally", "mentality"]}

{"headword":"merry","explanation":"形容詞「快樂的，高興的」。常用於 festive 季節或慶祝活動。最常見的搭配是 Merry Christmas (聖誕快樂)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children's <target>merry</target> <pattern>laughter</pattern> echoed through the house during the holiday party, filling the room with joy and excitement.","translation":"在假期派對期間，孩子們快樂的笑聲在屋子裡迴盪，讓房間裡充滿了喜悅和興奮。","explanation":"形容詞「快樂的」。常用搭配：merry laughter (快樂的笑聲)。"},{"sentence":"Everyone in the family gathered around the decorated tree to wish each other a <target>merry</target> <pattern>Christmas</pattern> and share a festive meal.","translation":"全家人聚集在裝飾過的樹周圍，互相祝願聖誕快樂，並分享一頓節慶美食。","explanation":"形容詞「快樂的」。常見搭配：Merry Christmas。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mess","explanation":"名詞「混亂；凌亂的狀態」；動詞「搞亂」。常用片語：make a mess (把...搞亂), mess up (搞砸/搞亂)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The younger brother made a huge <target>mess</target> in the living room while playing with his colorful painting tools and glitter.","translation":"弟弟在用五顏六色的繪畫工具和亮粉玩耍時，把客廳搞得亂七八糟。","explanation":"名詞「混亂」。常用搭配：make a mess (把...搞亂)。"},{"sentence":"I'm sorry I <target>messed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the presentation today; I was so nervous that I forgot most of the key points.","translation":"很抱歉我今天把簡報搞砸了；我太緊張了，以至於忘記了大部分的關鍵點。","explanation":"動詞片語 mess up (搞砸/搞亂)。"},{"sentence":"After the storm, the beach was a complete <target>mess</target>, with plastic bottles and seaweed scattered across the sand.","translation":"t風後，海灘完全是一片混亂，塑料瓶和海藻散布在沙灘上。","explanation":"名詞「混亂」。指環境的凌亂狀態。"},{"sentence":"The student's desk was such a <target>mess</target> that he could not find his English textbook in time for the first period class.","translation":"這名學生的書桌如此凌亂，以至於他在第一節課前不能及時找到他的英語教科書。","explanation":"名詞「混亂」。指物品擺放不整齊。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "microphone", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」。常用縮寫為 mike。在公開演講、唱歌或錄音時使用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The speaker adjusted the <target>microphone</target> before starting his lecture, ensuring everyone in the large auditorium could hear him clearly.", "translation": "演講者在開始演講前調整了麥克風，確保大禮堂裡的每個人都能清楚地聽到他的聲音。", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」。常用動詞搭配：adjust, speak into。"}, {"sentence": "During the concert, the lead singer accidentally dropped his <target>mike</target>, but a crew member quickly handed him another one.", "translation": "演唱會期間，主唱不小心掉了他的麥克風，但一名工作人員迅速遞給他另一個。", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」的縮寫。"}, {"sentence": "For the outdoor event, they rented <pattern>wireless</pattern> <target>microphones</target> to allow the performers more freedom of movement on stage.", "translation": "為了戶外活動，他們租用了無線麥克風，讓表演者在舞台上有更大的移動自由。", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」。常用搭配：wireless microphone (無線麥克風)。"}], "related_forms": ["microphones"]}

{"headword":"microwave","explanation":"名詞「微波爐」；動詞「用微波爐加熱」。動詞用法在日常生活中非常常見，注意其作為及物動詞的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since she was running late for school, she decided to <target>microwave</target> her breakfast sandwich quickly before leaving the house.","translation":"因為她快上學遲到了，所以決定在出門前快速用微波爐加熱她的早餐三明治。","explanation":"動詞「用微波爐加熱」。"},{"sentence":"The student put the leftovers in the <target>microwave</target> for two minutes to warm them up for lunch.","translation":"學生將剩菜放入微波爐加熱兩分鐘，作為午餐食用。","explanation":"名詞「微波爐」。"}],"related_forms":["microwaved","microwaving"]}

{"headword":"mighty","explanation":"形容詞「強大的、巨大的」。常用於描述力量、權威或程度，常考搭配：a mighty effort (巨大的努力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient empire was once a <target>mighty</target> force in the world, controlling vast territories and dominating trade routes.","translation":"這個古代帝國曾經是世界上的一股強大力量，控制著廣大領土並主導著貿易路線。","explanation":"形容詞「強大的」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the difficulty of the task, the team made a <target>mighty</target> <pattern>effort</pattern> to complete the project before the deadline.","translation":"儘管任務困難，團隊仍做出了巨大的努力，在截止日期前完成計畫。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配：a mighty effort。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"minus","explanation":"介系詞「減去、沒有」；名詞「負數、缺點」；形容詞「負的」。最常見的是作為介系詞表示數量上的減少或缺乏某種特質。","entries":[{"sentence":"The final score of the game was ten <target>minus</target> seven, meaning the home team won by three points.","translation":"比賽的最終比分是十減七，意味著主場球隊贏了三分。","explanation":"介系詞「減去」。用於數學運算。"},{"sentence":"The apartment is very modern and convenient, but its lack of a balcony is a significant <target>minus</target> for me.","translation":"這間公寓非常現代且方便，但沒有陽台對我來說是一個顯著的缺點。","explanation":"名詞「缺點」。與 plus (優點) 相對。"},{"sentence":"In the winter, the temperature in some northern regions can drop to <target>minus</target> twenty degrees Celsius.","translation":"在冬季，一些北方地區的溫度可能會降至零下二十攝氏度。","explanation":"形容詞「負的」。用於描述溫度或數值。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"miracle","explanation":"名詞「奇蹟」。指超自然或極其罕見的正面事件。常用搭配：perform a miracle (創造奇蹟), by some miracle (奇蹟般地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a <target>miracle</target> that the hiker was found alive after being lost in the dense forest for a week.","translation":"那名登山客在茂密森林中失蹤一週後仍被發現倖存，真是個奇蹟。","explanation":"名詞「奇蹟」。"},{"sentence":"The doctors managed to <pattern>perform</pattern> a <target>miracle</target> by saving the patient who had been unconscious for several hours.","translation":"醫生們成功地創造了奇蹟，救回了已經昏迷數小時的病人。","explanation":"名詞「奇蹟」。片語 perform a miracle。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"misery","explanation":"名詞「痛苦、悲慘」。描述極大的精神或身體上的折磨。常用搭配：in misery (在痛苦中), bring misery (帶來痛苦)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The war brought immense <target>misery</target> to thousands of innocent civilians, leaving many without homes or families.","translation":"戰爭給數千名無辜平民帶來了巨大的痛苦，導致許多人失去家園或家人。","explanation":"名詞「痛苦」。"},{"sentence":"He spent several years living <pattern>in</pattern> <target>misery</target> after his business failed and he lost all of his savings.","translation":"在生意失敗且失去所有積蓄後，他度過了數年痛苦的生活。","explanation":"名詞「悲慘」。片語 in misery。"}],"related_forms":["miserable"]}

{"headword":"missile","explanation":"名詞「飛彈、導彈」。指被發射出去的攻擊武器。","entries":[{"sentence":"The military developed a new type of <target>missile</target> that could travel long distances and hit targets with high precision.","translation":"軍方開發了一種新型飛彈，可以長距離飛行並高精度地擊中目標。","explanation":"名詞「飛彈」。"},{"sentence":"During the conflict, the air defense system successfully <pattern>intercepted</pattern> the incoming <target>missiles</target> before they reached the city.","translation":"在衝突期間，防空系統在飛彈到達城市之前成功地將其攔截。","explanation":"名詞「飛彈」。常用動詞搭配：intercept a missile。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"missing","explanation":"形容詞「失蹤的、缺失的」。常用於描述人或物失蹤或不完整。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are searching for the <target>missing</target> child who was last seen at the local park yesterday afternoon.","translation":"警方正在搜尋一名昨天下午最後一次被看見在當地公園的失蹤兒童。","explanation":"形容詞「失蹤的」。"},{"sentence":"I realized that a few pages were <target>missing</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the old textbook, making it difficult to follow the lesson.","translation":"我意識到這本舊教科書缺了幾頁，使得跟隨課程變得困難。","explanation":"形容詞「缺失的」。常用搭配：missing from sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mission","explanation":"名詞「任務、使命」。指被指派的特定工作或人生目標。常用搭配：carry out a mission (執行任務), on a mission (執行任務中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The astronauts were sent <pattern>on</pattern> a <target>mission</target> to the Moon to collect rock samples and conduct scientific experiments.","translation":"太空人被派往月球執行任務，以收集岩石樣本並進行科學實驗。","explanation":"名詞「任務」。片語 on a mission。"},{"sentence":"The charity organization's <target>mission</target> is to provide clean drinking water to remote villages in developing countries.","translation":"這家慈善機構的使命是為開發中國家的偏遠村莊提供乾淨的飲用水。","explanation":"名詞「使命」。指人生或組織的目標。"},{"sentence":"The special forces team managed to <pattern>carry</pattern> <target>out</pattern> their secret <target>mission</target> successfully without being detected by the enemy.","translation":"特種部隊成功地在不被敵人發現的情況下執行了他們的秘密任務。","explanation":"名詞「任務」。片語 carry out a mission。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mist","explanation":"名詞「薄霧」；動詞「噴霧」。名詞用法最常見，指天氣現象。注意與 fog (濃霧) 的區別：mist 較薄，能見度較高。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mountains were covered in a thick <target>mist</target> early in the morning, making it hard for the hikers to see the path.","translation":"清晨時分，山間被濃薄霧籠罩，使得登山客很難看清道路。","explanation":"名詞「薄霧」。"},{"sentence":"The gardener used a spray bottle to <target>mist</target> the leaves of the tropical plants to keep them hydrated in the heat.","translation":"園丁使用噴霧瓶向熱帶植物的葉子噴霧，以便在酷熱中保持水分。","explanation":"動詞「噴霧」。"}],"related_forms":["misty"]}

{"headword":"mob","explanation":"名詞「暴民、群眾」；動詞「圍攻、群集」。名詞通常指憤怒或失控的群眾。動詞用法常指被大量人群包圍。","entries":[{"sentence":"The angry <target>mob</target> gathered in the town square, demanding that the corrupt politician be arrested immediately.","translation":"憤怒的暴民聚集在市鎮廣場，要求立即逮捕那名腐敗的政治家。","explanation":"名詞「暴民」。"},{"sentence":"As soon as the famous singer stepped out of the car, she was <target>mobbed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> hundreds of excited fans.","translation":"那位著名歌手一走出車門，立刻被數百名興奮的粉絲圍攻。","explanation":"動詞「圍攻」。常用搭配：be mobbed by someone。"},{"sentence":"The security guards struggled to control the <target>mob</target> to prevent them from breaking into the building.","translation":"保安人員努力控制群眾，以防止他們衝入建築物內。","explanation":"名詞「群眾」。"}],"related_forms":["mobbed","mobbing"]}

{"headword":"mobile","explanation":"形容詞「可移動的、流動的」。常用於描述設備（如 mobile phone）或人口移動（如 mobile workforce）。注意與 immobile (不可移動的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"With the rise of <target>mobile</target> <pattern>technology</pattern>, students can now access educational resources and online courses from anywhere in the world.","translation":"隨著行動科技的興起，學生現在可以從世界任何地方獲取教育資源和線上課程。","explanation":"形容詞「可移動的」。常用搭配：mobile technology (行動科技)。"},{"sentence":"The company uses a <target>mobile</target> <pattern>clinic</pattern> to provide basic healthcare services to people living in remote mountain villages.","translation":"該公司使用行動診所為住在偏遠山村的人們提供基礎醫療服務。","explanation":"形容詞「可移動的」。常用搭配：mobile clinic (行動診所)。"},{"sentence":"In the modern job market, being <target>mobile</target> is often seen as an advantage, as it allows employees to move to different cities for better opportunities.","translation":"在現代就業市場中，具備移動能力通常被視為一種優勢，因為它允許員工搬遷到不同的城市以尋找更好的機會。","explanation":"形容詞「可移動的、流動的」。"}],"related_forms":["mobility"]}

{"headword":"moist","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的、微濕的」。通常指適度的濕潤，可用於描述天氣、土壤或食物（如 moist cake）。與 damp (陰濕的) 或 humid (潮濕的) 略有不同，moist 較常指正面的或中性的濕潤。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener advised us to keep the soil <target>moist</target> <pattern>but not</pattern> soaked to ensure the seeds could sprout healthy and strong.","translation":"園丁建議我們保持土壤微濕但不要浸泡，以確保種子能健康強壯地發芽。","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的」。"},{"sentence":"The baker's secret to a perfect sponge cake is to keep the texture <target>moist</target> and fluffy, rather than dry and hard.","translation":"烘焙師做出完美海綿蛋糕的秘訣在於保持其質地微濕且蓬鬆，而不是乾燥而堅硬。","explanation":"形容詞「微濕的」。常用於描述食物口感。"}],"related_forms":["moisten","moistly"]}

{"headword": "moisture", "explanation": "名詞「水分、濕氣」。指物質中含有的水或空氣中的水氣。常用搭配 moisture-proof (防潮的) 或 absorb moisture (吸收水分)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "These specialized outdoor boots are designed to be <target>moisture</target> <pattern>proof</pattern>, preventing water from entering even during heavy rain.", "translation": "這些專業的戶外靴子被設計成防潮的，即使在暴雨期間能防止水分進入。", "explanation": "名詞「水分」。常用搭配：moisture-proof (防潮的)。"}, {"sentence": "Desert plants have developed unique leaves to reduce the loss of <target>moisture</target> <pattern>from</pattern> their surfaces in the extreme heat.", "translation": "沙漠植物發展出了獨特的葉子，以減少在極端高溫下從表面流失的水分。", "explanation": "名詞「水分」。常用搭配：loss of moisture (水分流失)。"}, {"sentence": "The silica gel packets found in new shoe boxes are used to <pattern>absorb</pattern> <target>moisture</target> and keep the products dry.", "translation": "新鞋盒中發現的矽膠包是用來吸收濕氣並保持產品乾燥的。", "explanation": "名詞「水分、濕氣」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"monk","explanation":"名詞「僧侶、修士」。指在修道院中過著簡單生活並致力於宗教活動的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young man decided to leave his wealthy family and become a <target>monk</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a remote monastery to seek inner peace.","translation":"這個年輕人決定離開他的富裕家庭，在遙遠的修道院成為一名僧侶以尋求內心的平靜。","explanation":"名詞「僧侶」。"},{"sentence":"Visitors were impressed by the <target>monks</target> who spent their entire lives studying ancient scriptures and meditating in silence.","translation":"遊客們對那些終其一生研究古代經書並在沉默中冥想的僧侶們印象深刻。","explanation":"名詞「僧侶」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"monster","explanation":"名詞「怪物、怪獸」。可用於描述虛構的生物或比喻指代極其巨大的事物（如 a monster hit）。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the classic story, the <target>monster</target> lived deep under the sea and occasionally attacked ships passing through the area.","translation":"在經典故事中，怪物住在深海之中，偶爾會攻擊經過該區域的船隻。","explanation":"名詞「怪物」。"},{"sentence":"The movie company released a giant <target>monster</target> movie, which became a <target>monster</target> <pattern>hit</pattern> at the box office worldwide.","translation":"電影公司發行了一部巨型怪獸電影，該片在全球票房上取得了巨大的成功。","explanation":"名詞「怪物」。第二個 monster 用作形容詞，表示「巨大的」，常用搭配：monster hit (巨大的成功)。"}],"related_forms":["monstrous"]}

{"headword":"monthly","explanation":"可作形容詞、副詞或名詞。形容詞指「每月的」；副詞指「每月地」；名詞指「月刊」。注意其形式與 monthly report (月報) 等常用搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager requires a <target>monthly</target> <pattern>report</pattern> from each employee to track their progress and evaluate their performance.","translation":"經理要求每位員工提交一份月報，以追蹤他們的進度並評估其表現。","explanation":"形容詞「每月的」。常用搭配：monthly report (月報)。"},{"sentence":"The local astronomy club meets <target>monthly</target> to discuss the latest discoveries in space and share their observations.","translation":"在地天文社團每月會面一次，以討論太空中的最新發現並分享他們的觀察結果。","explanation":"副詞「每月地」。"},{"sentence":"She subscribes to a <target>monthly</target> <pattern>magazine</pattern> that focuses on sustainable living and eco-friendly product reviews.","translation":"她訂閱了一本專注於永續生活和環保產品評論的月刊雜誌。","explanation":"名詞「月刊」。"}],"related_forms":[]}
