{"headword":"moral","explanation":"形容詞「道德的」；名詞「寓意、教訓」。注意區分 moral (道德的) 與 morale (士氣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to discuss whether it is <target>moral</target> to use artificial intelligence to write their entire essays.","translation":"老師要求學生討論使用人工智慧撰寫整篇論文是否符合道德。","explanation":"形容詞「道德的」。"},{"sentence":"After reading the fable, the children learned the <target>moral</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the story: slow and steady wins the race.","translation":"讀完寓言後，孩子們學到了故事的寓意：慢而穩地前行才能贏得比賽。","explanation":"名詞「寓意、教訓」。常用搭配：moral of the story (故事的寓意)。"},{"sentence":"Facing a <target>moral</target> <pattern>dilemma</pattern>, the young man had to decide between telling the truth or protecting his best friend.","translation":"面對道德困境，這個年輕人必須在說實話或保護他最好的朋友之間做出選擇。","explanation":"形容詞「道德的」。常用搭配：moral dilemma (道德困境)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mosquito","explanation":"名詞「蚊子」。常見於環境或健康相關的主題，如 malaria (瘧疾) 或 dengue fever (登革熱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To prevent the spread of dengue fever, the city government urged citizens to remove standing water where <target>mosquitoes</target> <pattern>breed</pattern>.","translation":"為了防止登革熱的傳播，市政府敦促市民清除積水，因為那是蚊子滋生的地方。","explanation":"名詞「蚊子」。常用搭配：breed (滋生)。"},{"sentence":"The campers used a <target>mosquito</target> <pattern>repellent</pattern> to avoid being bitten while they were hiking through the dense forest.","translation":"露營者們使用了蚊蟲驅趕劑，以避免在穿過茂密森林徒步旅行時被叮咬。","explanation":"名詞「蚊子」。常用搭配：mosquito repellent (蚊蟲驅趕劑)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mostly","explanation":"副詞「大部分地、主要地」。常用於描述群體、情況或成分組成。","entries":[{"sentence":"The audience at the art exhibition was <target>mostly</target> <pattern>composed of</pattern> college students and professional artists from the city.","translation":"藝術展的觀眾大部分是由大學生和城市裡的專業藝術家組成的。","explanation":"副詞「大部分地」。常用搭配：be composed of (由...組成)。"},{"sentence":"The students' failure to complete the project on time was <target>mostly</target> <pattern>due to</pattern> a lack of communication among team members.","translation":"學生們未能準時完成項目的原因是主要由於團隊成員之間缺乏溝通。","explanation":"副詞「主要地」。常用搭配：due to (由於)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "motel", "explanation": "motel 作為名詞，指「汽車旅館」。它是一種專為開車旅行者設計的住宿設施，通常提供直接從停車場進入房間的便利。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long day of driving, the family decided to stop at a <target>motel</target> by the highway for a much-needed rest before continuing their journey.", "translation": "經過漫長一天的駕駛後，這家人決定在高速公路旁的一家汽車旅館停留，好好休息一下再繼續旅程。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車旅館」。通常位於公路旁，方便開車旅客入住。"}, {"sentence": "Unlike traditional hotels, <target>motels</target> typically offer direct access to rooms from the parking lot, catering to travelers with cars.", "translation": "與傳統飯店不同，汽車旅館通常提供從停車場直接進入房間的通道，以迎合開車旅行者的需求。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車旅館」。強調其與飯店的區別，特別是停車和房間出入的便利性。"}], "related_forms": ["motels"]}

{"headword": "moth", "explanation": "名詞「蛾」。常與 butterfly (蝴蝶) 相比，且常被描述為為其對布料的損害而知名。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old wool sweater was ruined by <target>moths</target> that had eaten small holes into the fabric over the winter.", "translation": "這件舊羊毛衫被蛾子毀了，因為蛾子在冬天將布料咬出了小洞。", "explanation": "名詞「蛾」。"}, {"sentence": "Unlike butterflies, <target>moths</target> are mostly active <pattern>at</pattern> night and are attracted to bright lights in the dark.", "translation": "與蝴蝶不同，蛾子大部分在夜晚活躍，並被黑暗中的亮光吸引。", "explanation": "名詞「蛾」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"motor","explanation":"名詞，意為「馬達」或「引擎」。常用於描述機械動力來源。在日常生活中，motor 常用於較小或電力的馬達，而 engine 則較常用於汽車或大型機器的內燃機，但兩者在許多情境下可通用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The electric <target>motor</target> in the small fan started making a strange noise, so he decided to take it to the repair shop.","translation":"小電風扇裡的馬達開始發出奇怪的聲音，所以他決定把它送到修理店。","explanation":"名詞「馬達」。指提供動力地電能轉換裝置。"},{"sentence":"Many people prefer electric cars because their <target>motors</target> are quieter and more environmentally friendly than traditional gas engines.","translation":"許多人偏好電動車，因為它們的馬達比傳統汽油引擎更安靜且更環保。","explanation":"名詞「馬達/引擎」。在電動車情境中，motor 指的是驅動馬達。"}],"related_forms":["motors"]}

{"headword":"multiply","explanation":"動詞，意為「乘 (數學)」、「增加」或「繁殖」。在 GSAT 中，常用於數學計算或描述人口/動物數量迅速增加的情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the math class, the teacher showed us how to <target>multiply</target> large numbers using a simple technique to save time.","translation":"在數學課上，老師教我們如何使用簡單的技巧來乘大數字以節省時間。","explanation":"動詞「乘」。數學運算中的乘法。"},{"sentence":"If you <target>multiply</target> five <pattern>by</pattern> six, the result is thirty, which is a basic calculation every student should know.","translation":"如果你將五乘以六，結果是三十，這是每個學生都應該知道的基本計算。","explanation":"動詞「乘」。常用搭配：multiply A by B (A 乘以 B)。"},{"sentence":"Without any natural predators in the new environment, the population of rabbits began to <target>multiply</target> rapidly, causing problems for farmers.","translation":"在新的環境中，由於沒有天然的掠食者，兔子的數量開始迅速增加，給農民帶來了麻煩。","explanation":"動詞「增加、繁殖」。指數量上的快速成長。"}],"related_forms":["multiplication","multiplied"]}

{"headword":"murder","explanation":"名詞和動詞同形，意為「謀殺」。動詞用法為 murder someone。名詞用法常與動詞 commit 或 carry out 搭配，如 commit murder (犯下謀殺案)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective spent weeks gathering evidence to prove that the suspect had <target>murdered</target> the victim in cold blood.","translation":"偵探花了好幾週收集證據，以證明嫌疑人冷酷地謀殺了受害者。","explanation":"動詞「謀殺」。指蓄意地奪取他人生命。"},{"sentence":"The police are investigating a terrible <target>murder</target> case that happened in the quiet neighborhood last Friday night.","translation":"警察正在調查上週五晚上發生在安靜社區的一個可怕的謀殺案。","explanation":"名詞「謀殺」。指非法且蓄意地殺害他人。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that his client did not <pattern>commit</pattern> <target>murder</target>, but instead acted in self-defense during the fight.","translation":"律師辯稱他的當事人並沒有犯下謀殺罪，而是在打鬥中為了自衛而採取行動。","explanation":"名詞「謀殺」。常用搭配：commit murder (犯下謀殺罪)。"}],"related_forms":["murderer","murdered"]}

{"headword": "muscle", "explanation": "名詞，意為「肌肉」。常用於描述身體構造或體能。在比喻用法中， muscle 也可以指「力量」或「影響力」，例如 political muscle (政治影響力)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Regular exercise and a high-protein diet help athletes <pattern>promote</pattern> <target>muscle</target> growth and keep their bodies strong and healthy.", "translation": "規律的運動和高蛋白飲食有助於運動員增加肌肉成長並保持身體強健健康。", "explanation": "名詞「肌肉」。指身體內用於運動的組織。"}, {"sentence": "After lifting heavy boxes for the entire afternoon, he felt a sharp pain in his back <target>muscles</target> the next morning.", "translation": "搬運重箱子整個下午後，他第二天早晨感覺到背部肌肉劇痛。", "explanation": "名詞「肌肉」。"}, {"sentence": "The government decided to flex its economic <target>muscle</target> by imposing high tariffs on imported goods to protect local industries.", "translation": "政府決定透過對進口商品徵收高關稅來保護本地產業，以展示其經濟力量。", "explanation": "名詞「力量/影響力」。比喻用法，指強大的能力或影響力。"}], "related_forms": ["muscular"]}

{"headword":"mushroom","explanation":"名詞意為「蘑菇」，動詞意為「迅速增加/成長」。動詞用法常指某事物（如城鎮、產業、公司）突然地、快速地增加，類似於蘑菇雨後春筍般生長。","entries":[{"sentence":"While hiking in the forest, the students found several types of wild <target>mushrooms</target>, but they were warned not to eat them.","translation":"在森林中徒步旅行時，學生發現了幾種野生蘑菇，但他們被警告不要食用它們。","explanation":"名詞「蘑菇」。"},{"sentence":"Since the new highway was built, small coffee shops have <target>mushroomed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> along the road to attract travelers.","translation":"自從新高速公路建成後，沿路上的小咖啡店如雨後春筍般迅速增加。","explanation":"動詞片語 mushroom up 意為「迅速增加」。"},{"sentence":"With the rise of online shopping, many delivery companies have <target>mushroomed</target> in the city to meet the growing demand.","translation":"隨著網購的興起，城市中出現了許多快遞公司以滿足日益增長的需求。","explanation":"動詞「迅速增加」。指某事物突然地、快速地擴張。"}],"related_forms":["mushrooms"]}

{"headword":"mystery","explanation":"名詞，意為「謎、秘密、神秘之事」。常與形容詞 mysterious 搭配。常用片語 include solving a mystery (解開謎團) 或 it is a mystery to me (對我來說是個謎)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The disappearance of the ancient city remains a <target>mystery</target> to historians, as no clear records were left behind.","translation":"這座古城的消失對歷史學家來說仍然是一個謎，因為沒有留下任何清晰的記錄。","explanation":"名詞「謎/秘密」。指無法解釋的事物。"},{"sentence":"She loves reading <pattern>mystery</pattern> <target>novels</target> because she enjoys trying to figure out who the killer is before the end of the book.","translation":"她喜歡讀推理小說，因為她喜歡在書末之前嘗試找出兇手是誰。","explanation":"名詞（作定語）「謎」。mystery novels 指「推理小說」。"},{"sentence":"It is a complete <target>mystery</target> <pattern>to</pattern> me why the teacher decided to change the exam date at the last minute.","translation":"老師為什麼在最後一刻決定更改考試日期，對我來說完全是一個謎。","explanation":"名詞「謎」。常用搭配：it is a mystery to someone (對某人來說是個謎)。"}],"related_forms":["mysterious"]}

{"headword":"naked","explanation":"形容詞，意為「赤裸的」或「不加掩飾的」。在 GSAT 中，常考一個重要片語：the naked eye (肉眼)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The stars are beautiful tonight, but some of the distant galaxies can only be seen with a telescope, not with the <target>naked</target> <pattern>eye</pattern>","translation":"今晚的星星很漂亮，但有些遙遠的銀河只能用望遠鏡看到，不能用肉眼看到。","explanation":"形容詞「赤裸的」。常用搭配：the naked eye (肉眼)。"},{"sentence":"The baby was <target>naked</target> before his mother put on his clean clothes for the day.","translation":"這個寶寶在母親為他穿上當天乾淨的衣服之前是赤裸的。","explanation":"形容詞「赤裸的」。指沒有穿衣服。"},{"sentence":"The politician's speech revealed the <target>naked</target> <pattern>truth</pattern> about the corruption in the city's government, shocking everyone.","translation":"這位政治家的演講揭露了關於城市政府腐敗的赤裸裸的真相，令每個人都感到震驚。","explanation":"形容詞「不加掩飾的」。比喻用法，指真相被直接地揭露。"}],"related_forms":["nakedness"]}

{"headword":"nap","explanation":"名詞和動詞同形，意為「小睡」。指短時間的睡眠，通常在白天。注意與 sleep (睡眠) 的區別：nap 側重於短時間的休息。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a stressful morning of studying, the student decided to take a quick <target>nap</target> to refresh his mind before dinner.","translation":"經過一個壓力巨大的學習早晨後，這個學生決定小睡一會兒，以便在晚餐前讓精神恢復。","explanation":"名詞「小睡」。常用片語 take a nap (小睡)。"},{"sentence":"The cat likes to <target>nap</target> in the sun on the balcony, waking up only when it hears the sound of food.","translation":"這隻貓喜歡在陽台的陽光下小睡，只有在聽到食物的聲音時才會醒來。","explanation":"動詞「小睡」。"}],"related_forms":["naps","napping"]}

{"headword":"napkin","explanation":"名詞，意為「餐巾、餐巾紙」。常用於餐桌禮儀描述或日常生活中用餐時使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The waiter placed a neatly folded <target>napkin</target> on the guest's lap to prevent any food from staining their clothes.","translation":"服務生將一張摺疊整齊的餐巾放在客人的大腿上，以防止食物弄髒衣服。","explanation":"名詞「餐巾」。"},{"sentence":"Since there were no more <target>napkins</target> on the table, he asked the waiter for a few more to clean up the spilled drink.","translation":"由於桌上沒有更多餐巾紙了，他請服務生再拿一些來清理掉在地上的飲料。","explanation":"名詞「餐巾紙」。"}],"related_forms":["napkins"]}

{"headword":"native","explanation":"形容詞和名詞同形，意為「本土的、原生的」或「本地人、原住民」。常用片語 include native speaker (母語使用者) 或 native language (母語)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you want to improve your speaking skills, it is helpful to practice with a <target>native</target> <pattern>speaker</pattern> of English.","translation":"如果你想想提高你的口說能力，與一位英語母語使用者練習會很有幫助。","explanation":"名詞/形容詞用法。常用搭配：native speaker (母語使用者)。"},{"sentence":"The researchers traveled to the rainforest to study <target>native</target> <pattern>plants</pattern> that are only found in that specific region.","translation":"研究人員前往雨林研究僅在該特定地區發現的本土植物。","explanation":"形容詞「本土的」。指原生地在該處的生物。"},{"sentence":"As a <target>native</target> of Taipei, she knows all the best hidden gems and local restaurants that tourists usually miss.","translation":"由於她是台北本地人，她知道所有遊客通常會錯過的最佳隱藏景點和在地美食餐廳。","explanation":"名詞「本地人」。指出生地在該處的人。"}],"related_forms":["nativity","nativism"]}

{"headword":"navy","explanation":"名詞，意為「海軍」或「深藍色」。指國家海軍部隊或一種特定的深藍色調。常用搭配：join the navy (加入海軍), the Royal Navy (皇家海軍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After graduating from college, he decided to <pattern>join</pattern> the <target>navy</target> to travel the world and serve his country with pride.","translation":"大學畢業後，他決定加入海軍，以自豪地環遊世界並服務於國家。","explanation":"名詞「海軍」。指國家的海上軍事力量。"},{"sentence":"The professional woman chose to wear a <target>navy</target> <pattern>blue</pattern> suit for her job interview, as it conveys a sense of reliability and professionalism.","translation":"這位職場女性選擇在求職面試時穿一件深藍色的西裝，因為這能傳達出可靠與專業的感覺。","explanation":"名詞/形容詞「深藍色」。常用搭配：navy blue (深藍色)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"neat","explanation":"形容詞，意為「整潔的」或「俐落的」。常用於描述環境、外觀或解決方案。注意其口語用法中也可表示「很棒的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student for keeping her desk <target>neat</target> <pattern>and tidy</pattern>, which helped her stay organized and focused during class.","translation":"老師稱讚這名學生將書桌保持整潔，這幫助她在課堂上保持組織良好且專注。","explanation":"形容詞「整潔的」。常用搭配：neat and tidy (整潔的)。"},{"sentence":"He came up with a <target>neat</target> <pattern>solution</pattern> to the complex math problem, impressing everyone with his creative and efficient approach.","translation":"他為這個複雜的數學問題想到了一個俐落的解決方案，用其創意且高效的方法讓每個人印象深刻。","explanation":"形容詞「俐落的、巧妙的」。指解決方案簡潔且有效。"}],"related_forms":["neatly","neatness"]}

{"headword":"necessity","explanation":"名詞，意為「必要」或「必需品」。可用於描述必須要做的事情或生活中不可或缺的東西。常用片語：a necessity for... (對...是必需的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In today's digital age, having a reliable internet connection has become a <target>necessity</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to complete their online assignments.","translation":"在如今的數位時代，擁有可靠的網路連線已成為學生完成線上作業的必需品。","explanation":"名詞「必需品」。指生活中不可或缺的事物。"},{"sentence":"The government realized that improving public transportation was a <target>necessity</target> to reduce traffic congestion and pollution in the city center.","translation":"政府意識到改善大眾運輸是減少市中心交通擁堵和污染的必要之舉。","explanation":"名詞「必要、必須」。指為了達到某個目的而必須採取的操作。"}],"related_forms":["necessary"]}

{"headword":"necktie","explanation":"名詞，意為「領帶」。常用於描述正式服裝。常用搭配：wear a necktie (繫領帶)。","entries":[{"sentence":"For the formal graduation ceremony, the school required all male students to <pattern>wear</pattern> a <target>necktie</target> as part of their official attire.","translation":"為了正式的畢業典禮，學校要求所有男學生將領帶作為正式服裝的一部分來穿戴。","explanation":"名詞「領帶」。指繫在脖子上的正式裝飾條。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"neighborhood","explanation":"名詞，意為「鄰近地區」或「鄰居」。常用於描述居住環境或社區氛圍。常用搭配：in the neighborhood (在附近)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local government decided to build a new community park in our <target>neighborhood</target> to provide a safe space for children to play.","translation":"地方政府決定在我們的社區建立一個新的社區公園，以提供孩子們一個安全的遊戲空間。","explanation":"名詞「鄰近地區、社區」。指居住的區域。"},{"sentence":"After moving to the city, she spent several weeks getting to know the people in her <target>neighborhood</target> to feel more welcome and connected.","translation":"搬到城市後，她花了幾週時間認識她社區裡的人，以便感到更受歡迎且更有連結感。","explanation":"名詞「鄰居、鄰里」。指居住在附近的人。"}],"related_forms":["neighbor"]}

{"headword":"nest","explanation":"名詞「鳥巢、巢穴」；動詞「築巢」或「嵌套」。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法最為常見，但動詞用法也應注意。","entries":[{"sentence":"The biology students observed a small bird <target>nest</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the branches of an old oak tree during their nature walk.","translation":"生物課學生在自然漫步時，觀察到一隻小鳥在老橡樹的樹枝上築巢。","explanation":"名詞「鳥巢」。常用搭配：nest in sth。"},{"sentence":"During the spring, many migratory birds return to the forest to <target>nest</target> and raise their young in a safe environment.","translation":"在春天，許多候鳥回到森林築巢並在安全環境中撫養後代。","explanation":"動詞「築巢」。指動物建造巢穴以產卵或育雛。"},{"sentence":"The designer created a set of <target>nested</target> bowls that fit perfectly inside one another, saving a lot of space in the kitchen cabinet.","translation":"設計師創造了一套嵌套的碗，它們可以完美地套在彼此內部，節省了廚房櫥櫃的大量空間。","explanation":"動詞「嵌套」。此處為過去分詞 nested 用作形容詞，指物體一個套一個地放置。"}],"related_forms":["nesting"]}

{"headword":"nickname","explanation":"名詞「綽號」；動詞「給...起綽號」。常用於描述非正式的稱呼。常用搭配：give someone a nickname (給某人起綽號)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because of his exceptional height, his classmates <pattern>gave</pattern> him the <target>nickname</target> \"Giant,\" which he actually found quite amusing.","translation":"因為他出類波絕的高度，他的同學給他起了一個「巨人」的綽號，而他其實覺得這挺有趣的。","explanation":"名詞「綽號」。指非正式的稱呼。"},{"sentence":"The experienced coach <target>nicknamed</target> the young athlete \"The Flash\" due to his incredible speed on the track during the competition.","translation":"經驗豐富的教練因為這名年輕運動員在比賽中驚人的速度，而給他起綽號叫「閃電」。","explanation":"動詞「起綽號」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"normal","explanation":"形容詞「正常的、平常的」。指符合一般標準、預期或習慣。常用於描述行為、天氣或健康狀態。注意與 abnormal (異常的) 相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"After recovering from a serious illness, the patient's blood pressure returned to <target>normal</target> levels, which greatly relieved the doctors.","translation":"在從嚴重疾病中恢復後，病人的血壓回到了正常水平，這讓醫生們大大地鬆了一口氣。","explanation":"形容詞「正常的」。常用搭配：normal levels (正常水平)。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>normal</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to feel nervous before a major exam, but learning how to manage stress is key to success.","translation":"學生在重大考試前感到緊張是正常的，但學習如何管理壓力才是成功的關鍵。","explanation":"形容詞「正常的」。常用句型：It is normal for someone to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The weather in this region is typically warm and humid, so a rainy afternoon in summer is completely <target>normal</target>.","translation":"這個地區的天氣通常溫暖潮濕，因此夏天的一個雨後下午完全是正常的。","explanation":"形容詞「平常的」。"}],"related_forms":["normally","norm","normalization"]}

{"headword":"novelist","explanation":"名詞，意為「小說家」。指專業寫小說的人。常用搭配：a successful novelist (一名成功的小說家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous <target>novelist</target> spent three years researching the history of the French Revolution to ensure the accuracy of her historical fiction.","translation":"這位著名小說家花了三年時間研究法國大革命的歷史，以確保其歷史小說的準確性。","explanation":"名詞「小說家」。指職業為寫小說的人。"},{"sentence":"After years of writing short stories, he finally published his first novel and became a recognized <target>novelist</target> in his country.","translation":"在寫了多年短篇小說後，他終於出版了他的第一本小說，並成為國內一名受認可的小說家。","explanation":"名詞「小說家」。"}],"related_forms":["novel"]}

{"headword":"nun","explanation":"名詞，意為「修女」。指在修道院中生活並奉獻於宗教信仰的人。常用搭配：become a nun (成為修女)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young woman decided to <pattern>become</pattern> a <target>nun</target> and devote her entire life to serving the poor and the sick in the hospital.","translation":"這位年輕女子決定成為一名修女，並將她整個生命奉獻給醫院裡的窮人和病患。","explanation":"名詞「修女」。指奉獻於宗教信仰的女性。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"oak","explanation":"名詞「橡樹」或「橡木」。常用於描述家具材質或自然景觀，象徵堅固與耐用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The antique dining table was made <pattern>of</pattern> solid <target>oak</target>, which is why it has remained sturdy for over a century.","translation":"這張古董餐桌是由實心橡木製成的，這就是為什麼它在一個世紀多以來依然堅固。","explanation":"名詞「橡木」。常用搭配 made of oak (由橡木製成)。"},{"sentence":"In the center of the school courtyard, there is a massive <target>oak</target> tree that provides a cool shade for students during lunch break.","translation":"在學校中庭的中心，有一棵巨大的橡樹，為學生在午休時間提供涼爽的陰 shade。","explanation":"名詞「橡樹」。"}],"related_forms":[]}
comment: Sentence 2: 'provide a cool shade for students during lunch break' - the word 'shade' is used as an uncountable noun here, but the translation includes '陰 shade', which is a translation error (mixing English and Chinese).

response: {"headword":"observe","explanation":"動詞「觀察；遵守；慶祝」。注意 observe a rule (遵守規則) 與 observe a holiday (慶祝節日) 的用法。在科學語境中，指細心地觀察現象。","entries":[{"sentence":"The biology students were asked to <target>observe</target> the behavior <pattern>of</pattern> the ants and record their findings in a detailed report.","translation":"生物課的學生被要求觀察螞蟻的行為，並將其發現記錄在詳細的報告中。","explanation":"動詞「觀察」。指細心觀察以獲取資訊。"},{"sentence":"It is essential for all visitors to <target>observe</target> the safety <pattern>regulations</pattern> while inside the chemistry laboratory to avoid accidents.","translation":"所有訪客在進入化學實驗室時，必須遵守安全規定以避免事故。","explanation":"動詞「遵守」。常用搭配 observe regulations/rules/laws (遵守規定/規則/法律)。"},{"sentence":"Many families in the region <target>observe</target> the traditional harvest festival <pattern>by</pattern> preparing special dishes and gathering together.","translation":"該地區的許多家庭透過準備特別的菜餚和聚集在一起來慶祝傳統的豐收節。","explanation":"動詞「慶祝」。指遵循傳統或法律來慶祝特定日子。"}],"related_forms":["observation","observant","observable"]}

{"headword":"occasion","explanation":"名詞「場合；時機；特殊的日子」。常用片語 on this occasion (這次), for some occasion (為了某些場合), on the occasion of (在...之際)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Graduation is a formal <target>occasion</target> where students and parents gather to celebrate the hard work and achievements of the graduates.","translation":"畢業典禮是一個正式的場合，學生和家長聚集在一起慶祝畢業生的努力與成就。","explanation":"名詞「場合」。指特定的活動或事件。"},{"sentence":"I have only met the principal <pattern>on a few</pattern> <target>occasions</target>, but he always seems very kind and supportive of the students.","translation":"我只在少數幾次機會遇到過校長，但他看起來總是對學生非常友善且支持。","explanation":"名詞「時機/次數」。常用片語 on occasions (有時/在某些場合)。"},{"sentence":"The school organized a special banquet <pattern>on the occasion of</pattern> the 50th anniversary of the university's founding.","translation":"學校在大學成立 50 週年之際舉辦了一場特別的宴會。","explanation":"名詞「特殊的日子」。片語 on the occasion of sth (在...之際)。"}],"related_forms":["occasional","occasionally"]}

{"headword":"odd","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的；單數的（奇數）」。指不尋常或不符合預期的。常用搭配 odd number (奇數), odd jobs (零工)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It seemed <target>odd</target> that the teacher didn't show up for class today, as she is usually very punctual and reliable.","translation":"老師今天沒來上課似乎很奇怪，因為她通常非常準時且可靠。","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的」。"},{"sentence":"During the summer vacation, the student took on a few <target>odd</target> <pattern>jobs</pattern> to save money for his college tuition.","translation":"暑假期間，這名學生接了一些零工來存錢支付大學學費。","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的/零碎的」。常用搭配 odd jobs (零工)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained that an <target>odd</target> <pattern>number</pattern> of students cannot be divided into two equal groups for the activity.","translation":"老師解釋說，奇數個學生無法在活動中被分成兩個相等的組別。","explanation":"形容詞「單數的/奇數的」。常用搭配 odd number (奇數)。"}],"related_forms":["oddly","oddity"]}

{"headword":"omit","explanation":"動詞「省略；遺漏」。指刻意或不小心地不包含某物。注意與 leave out 的意思相近。","entries":[{"sentence":"When writing the final draft of your essay, please make sure not to <target>omit</target> any important <pattern>details</pattern> from the original research.","translation":"在撰寫論文最終定稿時，請確保不要遺漏原研究中的任何重要細節。","explanation":"動詞「遺漏」。指不小心漏掉資訊。"},{"sentence":"The editor decided to <target>omit</target> the second paragraph of the article because it was too long and did not add any new information.","translation":"編輯決定省略文章的第二段，因為它太長且沒有提供任何新資訊。","explanation":"動詞「省略」。指刻意地不包含某部分。"}],"related_forms":["omission"]}

{"headword":"ongoing","explanation":"形容詞「持續進行中的」。常用於描述計畫、對話、研究或問題，強調其尚未結束。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is conducting an <target>ongoing</target> <pattern>investigation into</pattern> the causes of the recent environmental pollution in the river.","translation":"政府正對近期河流環境污染的原因進行持續的調查。","explanation":"形容詞「持續進行中的」。常用搭配 ongoing investigation into sth (對...持續調查)。"},{"sentence":"Despite the <target>ongoing</target> <pattern>discussions</pattern> between the two countries, a final agreement on trade has not yet been reached.","translation":"儘管兩國之間持續進行的討論，關於貿易的最終協議尚未達成。","explanation":"形容詞「持續進行中的」。常用搭配 ongoing discussions/negotiations (持續的討論/談判)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "onion", "explanation": "名詞「洋蔥」。常見於飲食或烹飪語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To make the soup more flavorful, the chef suggested adding a finely chopped <target>onion</target> to the pot during the first step.", "translation": "為了讓湯更有風味，主廚建議在第一步時將切碎的洋蔥加入鍋中。", "explanation": "名詞「洋蔥」。"}, {"sentence": "Some people find the smell of <target>onions</target> too strong, so they prefer to use garlic instead when cooking at home.", "translation": "有些人覺得洋蔥的味道太強，所以他們在家煮飯時更喜歡用大蒜代替。", "explanation": "名詞「洋蔥」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"onto","explanation":"介系詞「到...之上」。表示動作的方向，強調移動到某個表面的上方。注意與 on (在...之上) 的區別：onto 強調移動 (movement)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cat suddenly jumped <target>onto</target> the kitchen table to steal a piece of fish that was left there by the owner.","translation":"貓突然跳到廚房桌子上，去偷主人留在在那裡的一塊魚。","explanation":"介系詞「到...之上」。強調從一個位置移動到另一個位置。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to step <target>onto</target> the <pattern>platform</pattern> one by one to receive their certificates during the graduation ceremony.","translation":"老師要求學生們在畢業典禮上一個接一個地走上平台以領取證書。","explanation":"介系詞「到...之上」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"operation","explanation":"名詞「手術；運作；行動」。指醫療上的切除或修復，或指機器、系統的系統化運作。常用片語 in operation (在運作中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The patient had to undergo a complex heart <target>operation</target> to remove a blockage in his artery, but the surgery was successful.","translation":"病人必須接受一次複雜的心臟手術以移除動脈中的阻塞，但手術成功了。","explanation":"名詞「手術」。指醫療手術。"},{"sentence":"The new security system has been <pattern>in</pattern> <target>operation</target> since last month, significantly reducing the number of thefts in the building.","translation":"新的安全系統自上個月起開始運作，顯著減少了建築物內的盜竊數量。","explanation":"名詞「運作」。片語 in operation 表示「在運作中」。"},{"sentence":"The military launched a secret <target>operation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> rescue the hostages who were captured by the enemy forces in the jungle.","translation":"軍方發起了一場秘密行動以營救被敵軍在叢林中俘虜的人質。","explanation":"名詞「行動」。指有計畫的組織化行動。"}],"related_forms":["operate","operational","operator"]}

{"headword": "opportunity", "explanation": "名詞「機會」。常用於指有利於達成某事的時機或情況。注意搭配介系詞 for 或 to V。常考片語：take the opportunity (把握機會), miss an opportunity (錯失機會)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Studying abroad offers a unique <target>opportunity</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to experience different cultures and improve their language skills.", "translation": "出國留學為學生提供了體驗不同文化和提高語言技能的獨特機會。", "explanation": "名詞「機會」。常搭配介系詞 for + N 或 to + V。"}, {"sentence": "He <pattern>took</pattern> the <target>opportunity</target> <pattern>to</pattern> ask the professor about his research project after the lecture, gaining valuable insights.", "translation": "他利用講座結束後的機會向教授詢問他的研究計畫，獲得了寶貴的見解。", "explanation": "名詞「機會」。片語 take the opportunity to V 表示「把握機會做某事」。"}], "related_forms": ["opportunities"]}

{"headword": "opposite", "explanation": "形容詞「相反的；對面的」；名詞「相反的人/物」；介系詞「在...對面」；副詞「在對面」。詞性多變，需注意上下文。常考搭配：the opposite of (與...相反), on the opposite side (在對面)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite their similar appearances, the twins have completely <target>opposite</target> personalities; one is outgoing, and the other is shy.", "translation": "儘管外表相似，這對雙胞胎的個性卻完全相反；一個外向，另一個害羞。", "explanation": "形容詞「相反的」。"}, {"sentence": "What he said was the exact <target>opposite</target> <pattern>of</pattern> what he truly believed, which confused everyone in the meeting.", "translation": "他所說的與他真正相信的完全相反，這讓會議中的每個人都感到困惑。", "explanation": "名詞「相反的事物」。片語 the opposite of...。"}, {"sentence": "The new coffee shop is located directly <target>opposite</target> the main entrance of the university library, making it convenient for students.", "translation": "這家新咖啡店就位於大學圖書館正門的對面，對學生來說很方便。", "explanation": "介系詞「在...對面」。"}, {"sentence": "She waved to her friend who was standing <target>opposite</target> on the other side of the street, waiting for the bus.", "translation": "她向站在街對面等公車的朋友揮手。", "explanation": "副詞「在對面」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"optimistic","explanation":"形容詞「樂觀的」。指對未來持有正面看法。注意與 pessimistic (悲觀的) 相對。常用搭配 optimistic about sth (對...樂觀)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the difficult challenges of the project, the team leader remained <target>optimistic</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their chances of success.","translation":"儘管計畫面臨困難的挑戰，團隊領導者對他們成功的機會仍然保持樂觀。","explanation":"形容詞「樂觀的」。常用搭配 optimistic about sth (對...樂觀)。"},{"sentence":"The students felt <target>optimistic</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the upcoming exam after they had spent several weeks studying and reviewing their notes.","translation":"學生們在花了好幾週時間學習和複習筆記後，對即將到來的考試感到樂觀。","explanation":"形容詞「樂觀的」。"}],"related_forms":["optimism","optimistically","optimist"]}

{"headword":"oral","explanation":"形容詞指「口頭的、口述的」，名詞指「口試」。常考搭配 oral exam (口試) 或 oral hygiene (口腔衛生)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher decided to give an <target>oral</target> <pattern>exam</pattern> to test the students' speaking skills and their ability to communicate fluently.","translation":"老師決定舉行一次口試，以測試學生的口說技巧以及他們流利溝通的能力。","explanation":"形容詞「口頭的」。常用搭配：oral exam (口試)。"},{"sentence":"Dentists always emphasize the importance of maintaining good <target>oral</target> <pattern>hygiene</pattern> by brushing and flossing every day to prevent tooth decay.","translation":"牙醫總是強調每天刷牙和使用牙線以維持良好口腔衛生的重要性，以防止蛀牙。","explanation":"形容詞「口腔的」。常用搭配：oral hygiene (口腔衛生)。"},{"sentence":"Because the written report was too long, the professor asked the student to provide a brief <target>oral</target> <pattern>presentation</pattern> of the main points.","translation":"由於書面報告太長，教授要求學生對重點進行簡短的口頭簡報。","explanation":"形容詞「口頭的」。常用搭配：oral presentation (口頭簡報)。"},{"sentence":"The student felt nervous before her <target>oral</target>, but she managed to answer all the questions confidently and passed with a high score.","translation":"這名學生在口試前感到緊張，但她成功地自信地回答了所有問題，並以高分通過。","explanation":"名詞「口試」。"}],"related_forms":["orally"]}

{"headword":"organic","explanation":"形容詞「有機的」或「有機體的」。在 GSAT 中，最常出現的是指不使用化學肥料或農藥種植的食物，或是指生物體的構造。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many health-conscious consumers prefer to buy <target>organic</target> <pattern>vegetables</pattern> because they are grown without the use of synthetic pesticides or fertilizers.","translation":"許多注重健康的消費者偏好購買有機蔬菜，因為它們是在不使用合成農藥或化肥的情況下種植的。","explanation":"形容詞「有機的」。指不使用化學藥劑的農產品。"},{"sentence":"The local farmers' market offers a wide variety of <target>organic</target> <pattern>products</pattern>, attracting many people who care about environmental sustainability.","translation":"當地農夫市集提供各式各樣的有機產品，吸引了許多關注環境永續發展的人們。","explanation":"形容詞「有機的」。"},{"sentence":"In chemistry class, the teacher explained that <target>organic</target> <pattern>compounds</pattern> are primarily made of carbon atoms and hydrogen atoms.","translation":"在化學課上，老師解釋說有機化合物主要由碳原子和氫原子組成。","explanation":"形容詞「有機的」。指化學上的有機化合物。"}],"related_forms":["organically"]}

{"headword":"organize","explanation":"動詞「組織、籌備、整理」。常用搭配 organize a meeting (籌備會議) 或 organize one's thoughts (整理思緒)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council decided to <target>organize</target> a charity <pattern>event</pattern> to raise money for children in need across the country.","translation":"學生會決定籌備一場慈善活動，為全國有需要的孩子籌集資金。","explanation":"動詞「籌備、組織」。常用搭配：organize an event (籌備活動)。"},{"sentence":"Before writing the final essay, it is helpful to <target>organize</target> your <pattern>thoughts</pattern> into a clear outline to ensure a logical flow of ideas.","translation":"在寫最終論文前，將你的思緒整理成清晰的大綱會很有幫助，以確保想法的邏輯流暢。","explanation":"動詞「整理」。常用搭配：organize one's thoughts (整理思緒)。"},{"sentence":"The librarian spent the entire afternoon <target>organizing</target> the <pattern>books</pattern> on the shelves by genre and author to make them easier to find.","translation":"圖書管理員花了一整個下午將書架上的書按類別和作者整理，以便於查找。","explanation":"動詞「整理、組織」。"}],"related_forms":["organization","organizer","organized"]}

{"headword":"original","explanation":"形容詞「最初的」或「原創的」；名詞指「原件、原作」。注意區分 original (原創的) 與 creative (有創造力的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>original</target> <pattern>plan</pattern> was to visit the museum, but the group changed it to a hiking trip because of the heavy rain.","translation":"最初的計劃是參觀博物館，但由於大雨，該團體將其改為徒步旅行。","explanation":"形容詞「最初的」。"},{"sentence":"The student received a high grade for her <target>original</target> <pattern>idea</pattern> for the science project, which had never been tried before.","translation":"這名學生因其科學專題的獨創想法而獲得高分，這個想法之前從未被嘗試過。","explanation":"形容詞「原創的、獨創的」。"},{"sentence":"The museum carefully preserved the <target>original</target> <pattern>manuscript</pattern> of the novel, as it is far more valuable than the printed copies.","translation":"博物館小心地保存了這本小說的原稿，因為它比印刷本更有價值。","explanation":"名詞「原件、原作」。"},{"sentence":"While the movie is based on a book, the director added many <target>original</target> <pattern>scenes</pattern> to make the story more dramatic.","translation":"雖然這部電影是以一本書為基礎，但導演添加了許多原創場景，使故事更具戲劇性。","explanation":"形容詞「原創的」。"}],"related_forms":["originally","originate"]}

{"headword":"outdoor","explanation":"形容詞「戶外的」。通常放在名詞之前，修飾名詞。與 outdoors (副詞) 區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school provides various <target>outdoor</target> <pattern>activities</pattern>, such as camping and hiking, to encourage students to spend more time in nature.","translation":"學校提供各種戶外活動，如露營和徒步旅行，以鼓勵學生在自然中度過更多時間。","explanation":"形容詞「戶外的」。常用搭配：outdoor activities (戶外活動)。"},{"sentence":"Because of the unexpected storm, the <target>outdoor</target> <pattern>concert</pattern> was moved inside the gymnasium to ensure the safety of the crowd.","translation":"由於突如其來的暴風雨，這場戶外音樂會被移至體育館內，以確保人群的安全。","explanation":"形容詞「戶外的」。"}],"related_forms":["outdoors"]}

{"headword":"outdoors","explanation":"副詞「在戶外」。通常放在句末或動詞之後，不修飾名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"After spending all day inside the library studying for the final exam, the students decided to go <target>outdoors</target> for some fresh air.","translation":"在圖書館裡讀書準備期末考一整天後，學生們決定到戶外去呼吸新鮮空氣。","explanation":"副詞「在戶外」。"},{"sentence":"The children enjoyed playing <target>outdoors</target> in the autumn leaves, laughing and running around the park for several hours.","translation":"孩子們喜歡在戶外玩耍，在秋天的落葉中笑著在公園裡跑來跑去好幾個小時。","explanation":"副詞「在戶外」。"}],"related_forms":["outdoor"]}

{"headword":"outer","explanation":"形容詞「外部的、外層的」。常用於描述物理空間的外部，如 outer space (外太空) 或 outer layer (外層)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The astronaut described the silence of <target>outer</target> <pattern>space</pattern>, where there is no air to carry sound waves to the ears.","translation":"太空人描述了外太空的寂靜，因為那裡沒有空氣可以將聲波傳遞到耳朵。","explanation":"形容詞「外部的」。常用搭配：outer space (外太空)。"},{"sentence":"To protect the delicate inner parts of the machine, engineers designed a strong <target>outer</target> <pattern>shell</pattern> made of high-quality steel.","translation":"為了保護機器的脆弱內部的零件，工程師設計了一個由高品質鋼材製成的強力外殼。","explanation":"形容詞「外層的」。常用搭配：outer shell (外殼)。"},{"sentence":"The explorers discovered a hidden cave in the <target>outer</target> <pattern>regions</pattern> of the mountain range, far from any known cities.","translation":"探險家在山脈的外部區域發現了一個隱藏的洞穴，遠離任何已知的城市。","explanation":"形容詞「外部的」。"}],"related_forms":["outward"]}

{"headword":"outline","explanation":"名詞「大綱、輪廓」；動詞「概述、描繪輪廓」。常考搭配 outline a plan (概述計劃)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to write a detailed <target>outline</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their research paper before starting the actual writing process.","translation":"老師要求學生在開始實際寫作過程前，寫一份詳細的論文研究大綱。","explanation":"名詞「大綱」。常用片語：outline of sth (某事的大綱)。"},{"sentence":"During the first meeting, the manager <target>outlined</target> the <pattern>goals</pattern> for the next six months, explaining the steps needed to achieve them.","translation":"在第一次會議中，經理概述了未來六個月的目標，並解釋了達成目標所需的步驟。","explanation":"動詞「概述」。常用搭配：outline the goals/plan (概述目標/計劃)。"},{"sentence":"The artist used a thin pencil to draw the <target>outline</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the person's face, focusing on the overall shape before adding details.","translation":"藝術家使用細鉛筆描繪出人物臉部的輪廓，在添加細節前先專注於整體的形狀。","explanation":"名詞「輪廓」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"oven","explanation":"名詞「烤箱」。常用動詞搭配 bake in the oven (在烤箱中烘烤)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The smell of fresh cookies baking <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>oven</target> filled the entire house, making everyone feel warm and happy.","translation":"烤箱中烘烤新鮮餅乾的香味瀰漫整個房子，讓每個人都感到溫暖和快樂。","explanation":"名詞「烤箱」。常用搭配：bake in the oven (在烤箱中烘烤)。"},{"sentence":"Please remember to <pattern>turn off</pattern> the <target>oven</target> immediately after you take the cake out to prevent any fire hazards.","translation":"請記得在將蛋糕取出後立即關掉烤箱，以防止任何火災危險。","explanation":"名詞「烤箱」。常用動詞搭配：turn off the oven (關掉烤箱)。"}],"related_forms":["ovens"]}

{"headword":"overseas","explanation":"overseas 可作副詞或形容詞。作副詞時，指「在海外、往海外」；作形容詞時，指「海外的」。常考搭配 overseas students (海外學生) 或 study overseas (在海外學習)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students dream of studying <target>overseas</target> to experience different cultures and improve their English speaking skills in a real environment.","translation":"許多學生夢想在海外學習，以體驗不同文化並提高他們在真實環境中的英語口說技巧。","explanation":"副詞用法，表示「在海外」。"},{"sentence":"The company expanded its business <target>overseas</target> by opening new branches in Europe and Asia to attract more international customers.","translation":"公司將其業務擴展至海外，在歐洲和亞州開設新分店以吸引更多國際客戶。","explanation":"副詞用法，表示「往海外」。"},{"sentence":"The university welcomes <target>overseas</target> <pattern>students</pattern> from all over the world, providing them with scholarships and guidance for their adaptation.","translation":"大學歡迎來自世界各地的海外學生，提供他們獎學金和適應環境的指南。","explanation":"形容詞用法，後接名詞，表示「海外的」。常用搭配：overseas students (海外學生)。"},{"sentence":"The government signed an <target>overseas</target> <pattern>trade agreement</pattern> with another country to increase the export of local agricultural products.","translation":"政府與另一個國家簽署了一項海外貿易協定，以增加當地農產品的出口。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「海外的」。常用搭配：overseas trade (海外貿易)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"owe","explanation":"動詞「欠（錢、情、債）」。常用搭配：owe money to sb (欠某人錢), owe sth to sb (將某事歸功於某人)。注意 owe 與 borrow 的區別：borrow 指「借入」的動作，而 owe 指「欠著」的狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"After borrowing money for his college tuition, Mark realized he <target>owed</target> a large sum <pattern>to</pattern> his parents and felt grateful for their support.","translation":"在借錢支付大學學費後，馬克意識到他欠父母一大筆錢，並對他們的支持感到感激。","explanation":"動詞「欠錢」。常用搭配 owe money to someone。"},{"sentence":"The successful athlete believes she <target>owes</target> her achievements <pattern>to</pattern> the hard work and guidance of her coach over the last ten years.","translation":"這位成功的運動員相信，她的成就歸功於教練在過去十年間的努力指導。","explanation":"動詞「歸功於」。owe sth to sb 表示將成功或結果歸因於某人或某事。"},{"sentence":"I feel that I <target>owe</target> you <pattern>an apology</pattern> for missing your birthday party last weekend due to an unexpected family emergency.","translation":"我覺得我欠你一個道歉，因為上週末由於突發的家庭緊急情況而錯過了你的生日派對。","explanation":"動詞「欠（道歉、解釋等）」。常用搭配 owe an apology/explanation。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"owl","explanation":"名詞「貓頭鷹」。在英文文化中，owl 常象徵智慧 (wisdom)，但也有 nocturnal (夜行性的) 特徵。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>owl</target> is a nocturnal bird that hunts small animals at night, using its exceptional hearing and sight to find prey.","translation":"貓頭鷹是一種夜行性鳥類，在夜晚獵食小動物，利用其卓越的聽覺和視覺來尋找獵物。","explanation":"名詞「貓頭鷹」。描述其生物特性。"},{"sentence":"In many ancient stories, the <target>owl</target> is often depicted as a symbol of wisdom and knowledge because of its serious appearance.","translation":"在許多古代故事中，貓頭鷹常被描繪成智慧和知識的象徵，因為它嚴肅的外表。","explanation":"名詞「貓頭鷹」。提到其文化象徵意義。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ownership","explanation":"名詞「所有權、所有權的擁有」。常用於法律、房產或公司管理語境。注意 ownership 與 owner (所有者) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two companies reached an agreement to transfer the <target>ownership</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the land to the local government for the construction of a public park.","translation":"這兩家公司達成協議，將土地的所有權轉讓給地方政府，以便建設公共公園。","explanation":"名詞「所有權」。常用搭配 ownership of something。"},{"sentence":"Many young professionals now prefer renting apartments over home <target>ownership</target> because it provides more flexibility to move for better career opportunities.","translation":"許多年輕專業人士現在比起擁有房產更傾向於租公寓，因為這能提供更多搬遷以尋找更好職業機會的靈活性。","explanation":"名詞「所有權、擁有」。home ownership 指「住房所有權」。"}],"related_forms":["owner"]}

{"headword":"ox","explanation":"名詞「公牛、耕牛」。通常指被馴化用於農活的牛。複數形式為 oxen。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the past, farmers relied on the <target>ox</target> to pull heavy plows through the soil, making agriculture much more efficient than doing it by hand.","translation":"在過去，農民依靠耕牛拉著沉重的犁在土中耕作，使得農業比手工耕種高效得多。","explanation":"名詞「耕牛」。"},{"sentence":"The museum displayed a sculpture of two <target>oxen</target> pulling a cart, illustrating the traditional way of transporting goods in ancient times.","translation":"博物館展出了一尊兩頭耕牛拉車的雕塑，展示了古代運輸貨物的傳統方式。","explanation":"名詞「耕牛」。注意複數形式為 oxen。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pad","explanation":"名詞「墊子、筆記本」；動詞「填充、緩衝」。在現代用法中， notepad (記事本) 較常見，而 pad 也可用於指保護墊 (如 shoulder pad)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student quickly grabbed a <target>pad</target> <pattern>of</pattern> paper to jot down the main points of the lecture before the professor changed the slide.","translation":"學生迅速拿了一本記事本，在教授切換投影片之前記錄下講座的重點。","explanation":"名詞「筆記本/便條紙」。常用搭配 a pad of paper。"},{"sentence":"To prevent injuries during the football game, the players wore protective <target>pads</target> on their shoulders and knees to absorb the impact of collisions.","translation":"為了防止在足球賽中受傷，球員在肩膀和膝蓋上穿著保護墊，以吸收碰撞的衝擊力。","explanation":"名詞「墊子」。指保護用的緩衝墊。"},{"sentence":"The designer decided to <target>pad</target> the chair with extra foam to make it more comfortable for the customers who would sit for long hours.","translation":"設計師決定用額外的泡沫為椅子填充，使其對於需要久坐的顧客來說更舒適。","explanation":"動詞「填充、加墊」。"}],"related_forms":["padding"]}

{"headword":"painter","explanation":"名詞「畫家」或「油漆工」。根據語境區分是指藝術創作 (artist) 還是建築裝修 (house painter)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous <target>painter</target> spent years studying the way light hits the ocean, eventually creating a masterpiece that is now in the national gallery.","translation":"這位著名的畫家花了很多年研究光線照射海洋的方式，最終創作了一幅現存放於國家美術館的傑作。","explanation":"名詞「畫家」。指從事藝術創作的人。"},{"sentence":"The family hired a professional <target>painter</target> <pattern>to</pattern> repaint the exterior walls of their house to make it look fresh and modern.","translation":"這家人聘請了一位專業的油漆工來重新粉刷房子的外牆，使其看起來清新且現代。","explanation":"名詞「油漆工」。指從事刷漆工作的人。"}],"related_forms":["paint","painting"]}

{"headword":"pal","explanation":"名詞「好朋友、夥伴」。屬於非正式用语 (informal)，類似於 friend 或 buddy。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since they were in kindergarten, Leo and Sam have been best <target>pals</target>, sharing everything from their toys to their secret dreams for the future.","translation":"從幼稚園開始，利奧和山姆就是最好的好朋友，分享從玩具到對未來秘密夢想的一切。","explanation":"名詞「好朋友」。常用於非正式口語。"},{"sentence":"He spent the whole afternoon chatting with an old school <target>pal</target> he had not seen for over a decade, reminiscing about their teenage years.","translation":"他花了一整個下午與一位十多年沒見的舊校友聊天，回憶他們的青少年時期。","explanation":"名詞「夥伴、好友」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"palace","explanation":"名詞「宮殿」。指君主或高級貴族居住的豪華建築。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed by the grand architecture and golden decorations of the imperial <target>palace</target>, which had been the center of power for centuries.","translation":"遊客們被皇宮宏偉的建築和金色裝飾所震撼，這裡在數世紀以來一直是權力的中心。","explanation":"名詞「宮殿」。"},{"sentence":"During the royal ceremony, the king invited all the foreign ambassadors to the <target>palace</target> for a formal dinner to discuss international trade.","translation":"在皇家典禮期間，國王邀請所有外國大使前往宮殿參加正式晚宴，以討論國際貿易。","explanation":"名詞「宮殿」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"palm","explanation":"名詞「手掌」或「棕櫚樹」。注意在不同語境下的區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The magician placed a small coin in the <target>palm</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his hand and suddenly made it disappear, leaving the audience in complete shock.","translation":"魔術師將一枚小硬幣放在手掌中，突然使其消失，讓觀眾感到非常震驚。","explanation":"名詞「手掌」。常用搭配 palm of one's hand。"},{"sentence":"While walking along the tropical beach, they saw rows of tall <target>palms</target> swaying gently in the warm breeze, creating a relaxing atmosphere.","translation":"在熱帶海灘散步時，他們看到一排排高大的棕櫚樹在溫暖的微風中輕輕搖曳，營造出放鬆的氣氛。","explanation":"名詞「棕櫚樹」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pancake","explanation":"名詞「鬆餅」。一種常見的早餐食物。","entries":[{"sentence":"On Sunday mornings, the father often prepares a stack of fluffy <target>pancakes</target> topped with maple syrup and fresh berries for his children.","translation":"在週日早晨，父親經常為孩子們準備一疊鬆軟的鬆餅，上面淋著楓糖漿並放上新鮮莓果。","explanation":"名詞「鬆餅」。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant is famous for its unique <target>pancakes</target> that are filled with melted chocolate and served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.","translation":"這家餐廳以其獨特的鬆餅聞名，裡面填滿了融化的巧克力，並配有一球香草冰淇淋。","explanation":"名詞「鬆餅」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "panic", "explanation": "名詞「恐慌」，動詞「恐慌、使驚慌」。注意動詞用法 panic over sth (對...感到恐慌) 以及名詞用法 in a panic (在恐慌中)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "When the fire alarm suddenly rang throughout the building, some people started to <target>panic</target> and ran toward the exits in confusion.", "translation": "當火警警報突然在建築物內響起時，有些人開始驚慌失措，混亂地向出口跑去。", "explanation": "動詞「恐慌」。指突然感到強烈的恐懼而失去理智。"}, {"sentence": "Please try to stay calm and do not <target>panic</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the small mistakes you made during the oral presentation.", "translation": "請試著保持冷靜，不要對你在口頭報告中犯的小錯誤感到恐慌。", "explanation": "動詞「恐慌」。常用片語 panic over sth。"}, {"sentence": "The crowd was <pattern>in a</pattern> <target>panic</target> after the sudden announcement that the flight had been canceled due to severe weather conditions.", "translation": "在突然宣布航班因惡劣天氣而取消後，人群陷入了恐慌之中。", "explanation": "名詞「恐慌」。常用片語 in a panic。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher told the students that they should not <target>panic</target> if they encountered a difficult question on the exam.", "translation": "老師告訴學生，如果在考試中遇到困難的問題，他們不應該驚慌。", "explanation": "動詞「驚慌」。用於描述面對壓力時的心理狀態。"}], "related_forms": ["panicked", "panicking"]}

{"headword":"parade","explanation":"名詞「遊行、閱兵」，動詞「遊行、炫耀」。注意 parade through (穿過...遊行) 和 put on a parade (舉辦遊行)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of people gathered along the main street to watch the colorful <target>parade</target> celebrating the city's anniversary.","translation":"數千人聚集在主街上觀看慶祝城市週年紀念的多彩遊行。","explanation":"名詞「遊行」。指在公共場所舉行的慶祝活動。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers <target>paraded</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the city square, showing their discipline and strength to the cheering crowds.","translation":"士兵們穿過城市廣場閱兵，向歡呼的人群展示他們的紀律和力量。","explanation":"動詞「閱兵、遊行」。常用片語 parade through sth。"},{"sentence":"He liked to <target>parade</target> his new luxury watch <pattern>in front of</pattern> his classmates to show off his wealth.","translation":"他喜歡在同學面前炫耀他的新奢侈手錶，以展示他的財富。","explanation":"動詞「炫耀」。指刻意地讓他人看到以引起注意。"}],"related_forms":["paraded","parading"]}

{"headword":"paradise","explanation":"名詞「天堂、樂園」。常用於描述極其美好、完美的地方或狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"With its crystal clear water and white sandy beaches, the island is truly a tropical <target>paradise</target> for vacationers.","translation":"憑藉著晶瑩剔透的水域和白色沙灘，這個島嶼對度假者來說真的是個熱帶天堂。","explanation":"名詞「天堂、樂園」。常用於描述自然美景。"},{"sentence":"For many book lovers, a quiet library filled with thousands of old books is a perfect <target>paradise</target> <pattern>on earth</pattern>.","translation":"對於許多愛書之人來說，一個充滿數千本舊書的安靜圖書館就是人間完美的樂園。","explanation":"名詞「樂園」。常用搭配 paradise on earth (人間天堂)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"parcel","explanation":"名詞「包裹」，動詞「分裝」。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法最為常見。注意搭配 deliver a parcel (遞送包裹) 或 receive a parcel (收到包裹)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The courier delivered a large <target>parcel</target> <pattern>to</pattern> her front door this morning, but she was not home to receive it.","translation":"快遞員今天早上將一個大包裹送到她門前，但她不在家接收。","explanation":"名詞「包裹」。常用搭配：deliver a parcel to sb。"},{"sentence":"She carefully wrapped the gift in colorful paper and tied it with a ribbon before sending the <target>parcel</target> <pattern>by</pattern> mail.","translation":"她在用彩紙將禮物包裝好並用緞帶繫住後，才將包裹通過郵件寄出。","explanation":"名詞「包裹」。常用搭配：send a parcel by mail。"},{"sentence":"The baker had to <target>parcel</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the remaining cookies into small bags to give them to the children.","translation":"麵包師必須將剩下的餅乾分裝到小袋子裡，分發給孩子們。","explanation":"動詞片語 parcel out (分裝、分發)。"}],"related_forms":["parcels"]}

{"headword":"parrot","explanation":"名詞「鸚鵡」，動詞「機械地重複、模仿」。注意動詞用法指缺乏思考地重複他人所說的話。","entries":[{"sentence":"The colorful <target>parrot</target> in the pet shop could say a few simple phrases, which amazed all the visiting children.","translation":"寵物店裡那隻多彩的鸚鵡會說幾個簡單的短語，這讓所有參觀的孩子們都感到驚訝。","explanation":"名詞「鸚鵡」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students not to simply <target>parrot</target> the answers from the textbook without understanding the underlying concepts.","translation":"老師警告學生不要在不理解底層概念的情況下，單純地機械地重複教科書上的答案。","explanation":"動詞「機械地重複」。指不加思考地模仿他人。"}],"related_forms":["parroted","parroting"]}

{"headword":"passage","explanation":"名詞，意為「通道、走廊」或「（文章的）段落、篇章」。注意區分這兩種截然不同的意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The secret <target>passage</target> led from the library to the hidden room, allowing the owner to move around the house unnoticed.","translation":"這條秘密通道從圖書館通往隱藏的房間，讓主人能在屋內不被注意地移動。","explanation":"名詞「通道」。指物理上的路徑。"},{"sentence":"The students were asked to read a short <target>passage</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the novel and analyze the main theme of the story.","translation":"學生被要求閱讀小說中的一段短文，並分析故事的主題。","explanation":"名詞「段落、篇章」。常用搭配：a passage from sth。"},{"sentence":"The narrow <target>passage</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two buildings was often filled with trash, making it difficult for people to walk through.","translation":"兩棟建築物之間的狹窄通道經常堆滿垃圾，導致人們難以行走。","explanation":"名詞「通道」。"}],"related_forms":["passages"]}

{"headword":"passenger","explanation":"名詞「乘客」。常用搭配 include passengers (包含乘客) 或 board the plane as a passenger (作為乘客登機)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The train was so crowded that some <target>passengers</target> had to stand in the aisle for the entire journey to the city.","translation":"火車如此擁擠，以至於一些乘客在前往城市的整個旅程中都必須站在走道上。","explanation":"名詞「乘客」。"},{"sentence":"The flight attendant asked all <target>passengers</target> to fasten their seatbelts <pattern>before</pattern> the plane took off from the runway.","translation":"空服員要求所有乘客在飛機從跑道起飛前繫好安全帶。","explanation":"名詞「乘客」。"}],"related_forms":["passengers"]}

{"headword":"passion","explanation":"名詞「熱情、熱愛」。常用搭配 have a passion for sth (對...有熱情) 或 passion for something (對某事的熱情)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Ever since she was a child, Maria has had a deep <target>passion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> painting, spending hours every day in her studio.","translation":"從小起，瑪麗亞就對繪畫有深厚的熱情，每天在她的工作室花好幾個小時。","explanation":"名詞「熱情」。常用片語 have a passion for sth。"},{"sentence":"The speaker spoke with great <target>passion</target> about the importance of protecting the environment and reducing plastic waste.","translation":"演講者以極大的熱情談論保護環境和減少塑料垃圾的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「熱情」。描述說話者的情緒狀態。"}],"related_forms":["passionate","passionately"]}

{"headword":"passport","explanation":"名詞「護照」。常用搭配 apply for a passport (申請護照) 或 renew a passport (更新護照)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before booking the international flight, you should check if your <target>passport</target> is still valid or if you need to <pattern>renew</pattern> it.","translation":"在預訂國際航班前，你應該檢查你的護照是否仍然有效，或者你是否需要更新它。","explanation":"名詞「護照」。常用動詞搭配：renew (更新)。"},{"sentence":"The traveler realized he had forgotten his <target>passport</target> <pattern>at</pattern> home, which meant he could not board the plane.","translation":"旅人意識到他把護照忘在在家裡，這意味著他不能登機。","explanation":"名詞「護照」。"}],"related_forms":["passports"]}

{"headword":"pat","explanation":"動詞「輕拍」，名詞「輕拍」。注意動詞搭配 pat on the back (拍拍背，表示鼓勵)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The father gently <target>patted</target> his daughter <pattern>on the back</pattern> to comfort her after she failed her first music exam.","translation":"在女兒第一次音樂考試失敗後，父親輕輕拍拍她的背以安慰她。","explanation":"動詞「輕拍」。常用片語 pat on the back (拍拍背，表示安慰或鼓勵)。"},{"sentence":"The coach gave the player a <target>pat</target> <pattern>on the shoulder</pattern> to congratulate him on scoring the winning goal in the final.","translation":"教練輕拍玩家的肩膀以祝賀他在決賽中踢進了致勝球。","explanation":"名詞「輕拍」。"},{"sentence":"She <target>patted</target> her pockets to make sure she had her keys and phone before leaving the house for school.","translation":"她拍拍口袋，以確保在出門上學前她帶了鑰匙和手機。","explanation":"動詞「輕拍」。指用手掌輕輕敲擊。"}],"related_forms":["patted","patting"]}

{"headword":"patience","explanation":"名詞「耐心」。常用於描述在面對困難、延遲或挑釁時保持冷靜的能力。常考搭配：lose patience (失去耐心), have patience with (對...有耐心), test one's patience (考驗某人的耐心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher had a great deal of <target>patience</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the new students, helping them understand the difficult grammar rules step by step.","translation":"老師對新學生非常有耐心，一步步地幫助他們理解困難的文法規則。","explanation":"名詞「耐心」。片語 have patience with someone 表「對某人有耐心」。"},{"sentence":"Waiting for the delayed bus in the heavy rain for over an hour finally caused the passengers to <pattern>lose</pattern> <target>patience</target>.","translation":"在暴雨中等候延誤的公車超過一個小時，最終讓乘客們失去了耐心。","explanation":"名詞「耐心」。片語 lose patience 表「失去耐心」。"},{"sentence":"The complicated assembly instructions for the new toy really <pattern>tested</pattern> my <target>patience</target>, but I finally finished it after three hours.","translation":"這款新玩具複雜的組裝說明書真的考驗了我的耐心，但我三小時後終於完成了。","explanation":"名詞「耐心」。片語 test one's patience 表「考驗某人的耐心」。"}],"related_forms":["patient"]}

{"headword": "pause", "explanation": "名詞「暫停」；動詞「暫停」。指在說話、動作或過程中的短暫停止。常考搭配：a brief pause (短暫的暫停), pause for breath (停下來喘口氣)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The speaker made a <pattern>brief</pattern> <target>pause</target> before announcing the winner of the competition to create a sense of excitement.", "translation": "演講者在宣布比賽獲勝者之前短暫地停頓了一下，以營造一種興奮感。", "explanation": "名詞「暫停」。常用形容詞：brief (短暫的)。"}, {"sentence": "During the intense debate, the student <target>paused</target> <pattern>for</pattern> breath before continuing his argument with more energy.", "translation": "在激烈的辯論中，這名學生在繼續用更強而有力的論點反駁前先停下來喘口氣。", "explanation": "動詞「暫停」。片語 pause for breath 表「停下來喘口氣」。"}, {"sentence": "If you find the movie too fast, you can always <target>pause</target> the video and take a few minutes to think about the plot.", "translation": "如果你覺得電影進展太快，你可以隨時暫停影片，花幾分鐘思考劇情。", "explanation": "動詞「暫停」。指將播放或進行中的事物暫時停止。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"pave","explanation":"動詞「鋪設(路面)」。指用石頭、磚塊或混凝土鋪路。延伸用法：pave the way for (為...鋪路/奠定基礎)。注意 pavement (n.) 為鋪路材料或人行道。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to <target>pave</target> the old dirt road <pattern>with</pattern> concrete to make it safer for drivers and pedestrians.","translation":"市議會決定用混凝土將舊的泥土路鋪好，以便讓駕駛者和行人更安全。","explanation":"動詞「鋪設」。常用介系詞 with 表鋪路材料。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of new energy sources has <target>paved</target> <pattern>the way for</pattern> more sustainable development in the future.","translation":"新能源的發現為未來的永續發展奠定了基礎。","explanation":"動詞片語 pave the way for... 表「為...鋪路」或「奠定基礎」。"}],"related_forms":["pavement"]}

{"headword":"pea","explanation":"名詞「豌豆」。一種常見的圓形綠色蔬菜。","entries":[{"sentence":"For a healthy breakfast, she added a handful of fresh green <target>peas</target> to her vegetable omelet, which tasted delicious.","translation":"為了健康的早餐，她在蔬菜歐姆蛋中加入了一把新鮮的綠豌豆，味道非常好。","explanation":"名詞「豌豆」。"},{"sentence":"The toddler struggled to pick up the tiny <target>peas</target> with his fork, eventually deciding to use a spoon instead.","translation":"那個幼童掙扎著想用叉子夾起那些小豌豆，最後決定改用湯匙。","explanation":"名詞「豌豆」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"peanut","explanation":"名詞「花生」。一種常見的堅果，可用作食物或油料。注意 peanut butter (花生醬)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people enjoy eating <target>peanuts</target> while watching movies at the cinema, although some find the sound of crunching too loud.","translation":"許多人喜歡在電影院看電影時吃花生，儘管有些人覺得咀嚼的聲音太大。","explanation":"名詞「花生」。"},{"sentence":"Because of her severe <target>peanut</target> <pattern>allergy</pattern>, she always carefully reads the ingredients list before buying any packaged snacks.","translation":"因為她對花生嚴重過敏，她在購買任何包裝零食前總是仔細閱讀成分表。","explanation":"名詞「花生」。常用搭配：peanut allergy (花生過敏)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pearl","explanation":"名詞「珍珠」。由牡蠣等貝類分泌而成的寶石。常用於描述珠寶或比喻高品質的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bride wore a beautiful necklace made of white <target>pearls</target> on her wedding day, which looked elegant and classic.","translation":"新娘在婚禮那天戴著一條由白色珍珠製成的美麗項鍊，看起來優雅且經典。","explanation":"名詞「珍珠」。"},{"sentence":"The small coastal town is a hidden <target>pearl</target> of the region, offering stunning beaches and quiet surroundings for visitors.","translation":"這個沿海小鎮是該地區的一個隱藏珍珠（瑰寶），為遊客提供了迷人的海灘和寧靜的環境。","explanation":"名詞「珍珠」。在此處為比喻用法，指代高品質或珍貴的事物。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "peel", "explanation": "動詞「剝皮」；名詞「果皮」。動詞用法：peel off (剝掉)。注意與 skin 的區別：peel 側重於去除外層，如 peel an orange (剝橘子)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before eating the apple, you should <target>peel</target> it carefully to remove any pesticide residue on the skin.", "translation": "在吃蘋果之前，你應該小心地將皮剝掉，以去除皮上的任何農藥殘留。", "explanation": "動詞「剝皮」。指去除水果或蔬菜的外皮。"}, {"sentence": "The chef warned the staff to clean up the banana <target>peels</target> on the floor immediately to prevent anyone from slipping.", "translation": "主廚警告員工立即清理地板上的香蕉皮，以防止任何人滑倒。", "explanation": "名詞「果皮」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"penguin","explanation":"名詞「企鵝」。一種不能飛但擅長游泳的南極或南美洲鳥類。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the school trip to the zoo, the children were fascinated by how the <target>penguins</target> waddled slowly on land but swam fast.","translation":"在學校去動物園的校外教學期間，孩子們被企鵝在陸地上緩慢搖擺走，但在水中游泳很快的樣子吸引住了。","explanation":"名詞「企鵝」。"},{"sentence":"The scientists studied the behavior of <target>penguins</target> in Antarctica to understand how they survive in such an extremely cold environment.","translation":"科學家研究南極洲企鵝的行為，以了解牠們是如何在如此極端的寒冷環境中生存的。","explanation":"名詞「企鵝」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"penny","explanation":"名詞「便士」。英國或美國的最小面值貨幣單位。常用片語 not a penny more (多一分錢也不行), save every penny (省下每一分錢)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old man spent years <pattern>saving</pattern> every <target>penny</target> he earned to ensure his children could afford a university education.","translation":"這位老人花了很多年省下他賺到的每一分錢，以確保他的孩子能負擔得起大學教育。","explanation":"名詞「便士」。片語 save every penny 表示「省下每一分錢」。"},{"sentence":"The book was so cheap that it only cost a few <target>pennies</target>, making it an affordable option for all students.","translation":"這本書非常便宜，僅需幾便士，使它成為所有學生都能負擔得起的選擇。","explanation":"名詞「Penny's plural form is pennies」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pepper","explanation":"名詞「胡椒」或「辣椒」。指調味品或辣椒類蔬菜。注意區分 black pepper (黑胡椒) 與 bell pepper (甜椒)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef added a pinch of black <target>pepper</target> to the soup to enhance the flavor and make it more aromatic.","translation":"主廚在湯中加入了一小撮黑胡椒以增強風味，使其更香氣。","explanation":"名詞「胡椒」。"},{"sentence":"Some people find red <target>peppers</target> too spicy to eat, while others enjoy the heat they add to a dish.","translation":"有些人覺得紅辣椒太辣而無法食用，而有些人則喜歡牠們為菜餚增加的辣味。","explanation":"名詞「辣椒」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"perform","explanation":"動詞「演出、執行、履行」。常用於藝術表演、完成任務或履行職責。常用搭配 perform a task (執行任務), perform a play (演出劇本)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The talented students will <target>perform</target> a traditional dance <pattern>at</pattern> the school's annual arts festival next month.","translation":"才華橫溢的學生將在下個月學校的年度藝術節上表演傳統舞蹈。","explanation":"動詞「演出」。指在觀眾面前進行藝術表現。"},{"sentence":"Surgeons must <target>perform</target> the operation <pattern>with</pattern> extreme precision to ensure the patient's recovery and safety.","translation":"外科醫生必須極其精確地執行手術，以確保病人的康復和安全。","explanation":"動詞「執行」。指完成一項專業的技術性工作。"},{"sentence":"Every citizen is expected to <target>perform</target> their duties <pattern>to</pattern> the best of their ability for the benefit of society.","translation":"每位公民都被期望能盡其最大能力履行其職責，以造福社會。","explanation":"動詞「履行」。指按照規定或責任完成工作。"}],"related_forms":["performs","performed","performing"]}

{"headword":"performance","explanation":"名詞「表現、演出」。可指人或機器在特定情況下的表現，或指舞台上的演出。常用搭配 high performance (高效能), give a performance (演出)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete's outstanding <target>performance</target> in the final race earned him a gold medal and widespread admiration from the crowd.","translation":"這位運動員在最終比賽中的出色表現為他贏得了金牌和觀眾的廣泛讚賞。","explanation":"名詞「表現」。指在特定活動中的能力展現。"},{"sentence":"The theater company's latest <target>performance</target> of Romeo and Juliet was praised by critics for its emotional depth and creativity.","translation":"劇團最近一次的羅密歐與茱麗葉演出受到了評論家的稱讚，因為其情感深度和創意。","explanation":"名詞「演出」。指舞台上的表演。"},{"sentence":"Engineers are working to improve the <target>performance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new electric car to increase its speed and battery life.","translation":"工程師們正努力提高這款新電動車的效能，以增加其速度和電池壽命。","explanation":"名詞「表現/效能」。指機器或系統的運作效率。"}],"related_forms":["performances"]}

{"headword":"permission","explanation":"名詞「許可、同意」。指獲得允許去做某事。常用搭配 ask for permission (請求許可), grant permission (准許)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students must <pattern>ask for</pattern> <target>permission</target> <pattern>from</pattern> their teachers before they can leave the classroom during the lesson.","translation":"學生在課堂期間離開教室前必須向老師請求許可。","explanation":"名詞「許可」。常用搭配 ask for permission from sb。"},{"sentence":"The city council finally <pattern>granted</pattern> <target>permission</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the construction of a new public library in the downtown area.","translation":"市議會終於准許在市中心建設一座新的公共圖書館。","explanation":"名詞「許可」。常用搭配 grant permission for sth。"}],"related_forms":["permissible"]}

{"headword":"permit","explanation":"動詞「允許」；名詞「許可證」。作為動詞時，常用搭配 permit sb to do sth。作為名詞時，注意發音與動詞不同，重音在第一音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school rules do not <target>permit</target> students <pattern>to</pattern> use their mobile phones during the final examinations.","translation":"校規不允許學生在期末考試期間使用手機。","explanation":"動詞「允許」。常用搭配 permit sb to do sth。"},{"sentence":"To enter the restricted area of the laboratory, every researcher must carry a valid security <target>permit</target> at all times.","translation":"要進入實驗室的禁區，每位研究人員必須隨時攜帶有效的安全許可證。","explanation":"名詞「許可證」。指正式的文件證明。"}],"related_forms":["permits","permitted","permitting"]}

{"headword":"persuade","explanation":"動詞「說服」。指透過說理或請求使人同意或去做某事。常用搭配 persuade sb to do sth, persuade sb that... ","entries":[{"sentence":"My parents finally <target>persuaded</target> me <pattern>to</pattern> study medicine because they believed it would provide a more stable career path.","translation":"我的父母終於說服我學習醫學，因為他們認為這會提供更穩定的職業道路。","explanation":"動詞「說服」。常用搭配 persuade sb to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The salesperson tried to <target>persuade</target> the customers <pattern>that</pattern> the new product was the best choice for their needs.","translation":"銷售員試圖說服顧客這款新產品是滿足他們需求的最佳選擇。","explanation":"動詞「說服」。常用搭配 persuade sb that..."}],"related_forms":["persuasion","persuasive"]}

{"headword":"photographer","explanation":"名詞「攝影師」。指專業地或作為愛好者拍攝照片的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professional <target>photographer</target> used a special lens to capture the stunning beauty of the wildlife in the deep forest.","translation":"專業攝影師使用特製鏡頭捕捉深林中野生動物的驚人美景。","explanation":"名詞「攝影師」。"},{"sentence":"During the graduation ceremony, a <target>photographer</target> was hired to take high-quality photos of all the students and their families.","translation":"在畢業典禮期間，聘請了一位攝影師為所有學生及其家人拍攝高品質的照片。","explanation":"名詞「攝影師」。"}],"related_forms":["photographers","photography"]}

{"headword": "pigeon", "explanation": "名詞「鴿子」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In many city squares, <target>pigeons</target> often gather in large groups to wait for tourists to feed them crumbs of bread.", "translation": "在許多城市廣場上，鴿子經常大量聚集，等待遊客餵牠們吃麵包屑。", "explanation": "名詞「鴿子」。"}, {"sentence": "Long ago, <target>pigeons</target> were used as messengers to carry important letters across long distances before the invention of the internet.", "translation": "很久以前，在網路發明之前，鴿子被用作信使來攜帶重要信件跨越長距離。", "explanation": "名詞「鴿子」。"}, {"sentence": "The park ranger explained that the <target>pigeon</target> is a common bird found in urban areas worldwide due to its ability to adapt.", "translation": "公園管理員解釋說，鴿子由於其適應能力，是全球城市地區常見的一種鳥類。", "explanation": "名詞「鴿子」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pile", "explanation": "名詞「一堆」；動詞「堆積」。常用搭配 a pile of (一堆...), pile up (堆積起來)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There was a huge <target>pile</target> <pattern>of</pattern> old textbooks on the desk, which the teacher asked the students to organize.", "translation": "書桌上有一大堆舊教科書，老師要求學生將其整理。", "explanation": "名詞「一堆」。常用搭配 a pile of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The children <target>piled</target> the colorful building blocks <pattern>up</pattern> to create a tall tower that eventually fell over.", "translation": "孩子們將彩色積木堆高，以創造一座最終倒塌的高塔。", "explanation": "動詞「堆積」。常用搭配 pile up (堆積起來)。"}, {"sentence": "After returning from a two-week vacation, the office worker found that his emails had <target>piled</target> <pattern>up</pattern> to an overwhelming amount.", "translation": "在兩週的假期回來後，辦公室職員發現他的電子郵件已經堆積到了令人不堪負荷的數量。", "explanation": "動詞片語 pile up 表「積壓、堆積」，常用於工作、郵件或債務。"}, {"sentence": "The hikers noticed a <target>pile</target> <pattern>of</pattern> rocks at the summit, which served as a marker for other climbers to follow.", "translation": "登山者在山頂發現了一堆岩石，作為其他攀登者遵循的標記。", "explanation": "名詞「一堆」。"}, {"sentence": "During the winter storm, the snow <target>piled</target> <pattern>up</pattern> against the fence, making it impossible for cars to leave the driveway.", "translation": "冬季風暴期間，雪堆積在圍欄邊，導致汽車無法離開車道。", "explanation": "動詞片語 pile up 表「堆積起來」。"}], "related_forms": ["piles", "piled", "piling"]}

{"headword":"pill","explanation":"名詞「藥丸」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor advised the patient to take one <target>pill</target> <pattern>after</pattern> each meal to treat the infection and reduce the pain.","translation":"醫生建議病人每餐後服用一顆藥丸以治療感染並減輕疼痛。","explanation":"名詞「藥丸」。"},{"sentence":"Some people find it difficult to swallow a large <target>pill</target> without drinking a glass of water to help them.","translation":"有些人發現如果不喝一杯水，很難吞下大顆的藥丸。","explanation":"名詞「藥丸」。"}],"related_forms":["pills"]}

{"headword":"pilot","explanation":"動詞「駕駛、引導」；名詞「飛行員、試驗性的」。常用於描述駕駛飛機或作為試驗性的計畫。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experienced <target>pilot</target> managed to land the airplane safely during a heavy storm, ensuring all passengers were safe.","translation":"經驗豐富的飛行員在暴風雨中成功地讓飛機安全著陸，確保所有乘客都安全。","explanation":"名詞「飛行員」。"},{"sentence":"The government launched a <target>pilot</target> <pattern>project</pattern> to test a new education system before applying it to all schools nationwide.","translation":"政府啟動了一項試驗性計畫，在將其應用於全國所有學校之前測試一套新的教育系統。","explanation":"形容詞用法（名詞作形容詞）。pilot project 指「試驗性計畫」。"},{"sentence":"The captain will <target>pilot</target> the ship <pattern>through</pattern> the narrow channel to avoid hitting the hidden rocks under the water.","translation":"船長將引導船隻通過狹窄的渠道，以避免撞擊水下隱藏的岩石。","explanation":"動詞「引導、駕駛」。指引導船隻或飛機通過危險區域。"}],"related_forms":["pilots","piloted"]}

{"headword": "pine", "explanation": "名詞指「松樹」，也可指「松木」。動詞用法較少見，但在文學或舊式用法中可指「渴望、憔悴」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The mountains are covered with tall <target>pine</target> trees that stay green throughout the winter, providing a beautiful landscape for hikers.", "translation": "山區覆蓋著高大的松樹，冬天依然保持綠色，為登山者提供了美麗的風景。", "explanation": "名詞「松樹」。"}, {"sentence": "The old table was made of high-quality <target>pine</target> wood, which is known for its light color and durability in furniture making.", "translation": "這張舊桌子是用高品質的松木製成的，松木以其淺色和耐用性而被家具製造業所熟知。", "explanation": "名詞「松木」。"}, {"sentence": "After her best friend moved to another country, the young girl began to <target>pine</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her old life and companions.", "translation": "在她最好的朋友搬到另一個國家後，這個年輕女孩開始渴望她的舊生活和夥伴。", "explanation": "動詞「渴望」。常用搭配 pine for sth/sb。"}], "related_forms": ["pines"]}

{"headword":"pineapple","explanation":"名詞，指「鳳梨」。單純的物質名詞，注意其拼寫。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tropical fruit platter included fresh slices of <target>pineapple</target>, mango, and papaya, which were sweet and juicy for the guests.","translation":"熱帶水果拼盤包括新鮮的鳳梨、芒果和木瓜片，對客人來說又甜又多汁。","explanation":"名詞「鳳梨」。"},{"sentence":"She decided to bake a cake with <target>pineapple</target> as the main ingredient to add a refreshing and tangy flavor to the dessert.","translation":"她決定烤一個以鳳梨為主要成分的蛋糕，為甜點增添清新且酸甜的口感。","explanation":"名詞「鳳梨」。"}],"related_forms":["pineapples"]}

{"headword":"pint","explanation":"名詞，指「品脫」。這是一種英美制體積單位，常用於液體如牛奶或啤酒。","entries":[{"sentence":"The waiter brought a <target>pint</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cold milk for the children, which was just enough for them to share during breakfast.","translation":"服務生為孩子們帶來了一品脫冷牛奶，正好夠他們在早餐時分著喝。","explanation":"名詞「品脫」。常用搭配：a pint of sth。"},{"sentence":"In the traditional English pub, many customers prefer to order a <target>pint</target> <pattern>of</pattern> lager after a long day of work.","translation":"在傳統的英國酒吧中，許多顧客喜歡在長天工作後點一品脫拉格啤酒。","explanation":"名詞「品脫」。常用搭配：a pint of sth。"}],"related_forms":["pints"]}

{"headword":"pit","explanation":"名詞指「果核」或「深坑」。動詞用法指「使競爭」或「挖掘」。注意搭配 pit sth against sth (使...與...競爭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Be careful not to swallow the <target>pit</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the cherry, as it can be dangerous if you accidentally choke on it.","translation":"小心不要吞下櫻桃的果核，因為如果你不小心被它噎到，可能會很危險。","explanation":"名詞「果核」。常用搭配：the pit of sth。"},{"sentence":"The construction workers spent several hours digging a deep <target>pit</target> in the ground to prepare the foundation for the new building.","translation":"建築工人花了好幾個小時在地下挖掘一個深坑，為新建築準備地基。","explanation":"名詞「深坑」。"},{"sentence":"The tournament organizer decided to <target>pit</target> the two top-ranked players <pattern>against</pattern> each other in the final match for the championship.","translation":"錦標賽組織者決定在冠軍賽中讓兩位排名最高的球員對陣，以爭奪冠軍。","explanation":"動詞「使競爭」。常用搭配：pit sth against sth。"}],"related_forms":["pits"]}

{"headword":"pitch","explanation":"名詞指「球場」或「音高」。動詞指「投球」或「推銷/設定」。注意 pitch a tent (搭帳篷) 是常見片語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The football team practiced hard on the local <target>pitch</target> every afternoon to prepare for the upcoming regional competition.","translation":"足球隊每天下午在當地球場努力練習，為即將到來的區域賽做準備。","explanation":"名詞「球場」。指足球或曲棍球場。"},{"sentence":"The singer struggled to hit the correct <target>pitch</target> during the audition, causing the judges to notice her lack of vocal training.","translation":"歌手在試鏡期間努力唱出正確的音高，導致評審注意到她缺乏聲樂訓練。","explanation":"名詞「音高」。"},{"sentence":"The group of students decided to <target>pitch</target> a tent <pattern>in</pattern> the forest for their weekend camping trip to experience nature.","translation":"這群學生決定在森林裡搭帳篷，進行他們的週末露營旅行，以體驗大自然。","explanation":"動詞「搭（帳篷）」。常用搭配：pitch a tent。"},{"sentence":"The salesman used a persuasive <target>pitch</target> to convince the clients to buy the new software, highlighting its efficiency and low cost.","translation":"銷售員使用具有說服力的推銷詞，以說服客戶購買這款新軟體，強調其效率和低成本。","explanation":"名詞「推銷詞」。"}],"related_forms":["pitched","pitching"]}

{"headword":"pity","explanation":"名詞指「可惜的事」或「憐憫」。動詞指「憐憫」。常用片語 it is a pity that... (很可惜...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a <target>pity</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the museum is closed on Mondays, as many tourists miss the chance to see the famous paintings.","translation":"很可惜博物館在週一關門，許多遊客因此錯失了欣賞名畫的機會。","explanation":"名詞「可惜的事」。常用片語：It is a pity that...。"},{"sentence":"The teacher felt a deep sense of <target>pity</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the student who had to work a part-time job to support his family.","translation":"老師對那個必須打工養家的學生感到深深的憐憫。","explanation":"名詞「憐憫」。常用搭配：pity for sb。"},{"sentence":"I don't want to <target>pity</target> him; I want to encourage him to overcome his challenges and find his own strength.","translation":"我不想憐憫他；我想鼓勵他克服挑戰並找到他自己的力量。","explanation":"動詞「憐憫」。"}],"related_forms":["pitiful","pitiless"]}

{"headword":"plastic","explanation":"名詞指「塑膠」。形容詞指「塑膠製的」或「可塑的」。注意 plastic pollution (塑膠污染) 是環保議題常見考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"To reduce <target>plastic</target> pollution, many cities have banned the use of single-use <target>plastic</target> bags in supermarkets and convenience stores.","translation":"為了減少塑膠污染，許多城市已禁止在超市和便利店使用一次性塑膠袋。","explanation":"名詞「塑膠」。常用搭配：plastic pollution (塑膠污染)。"},{"sentence":"The artist used a <target>plastic</target> mold to shape the sculpture, showing that the material is very flexible and easy to manipulate.","translation":"藝術家使用一個塑膠模具來塑造雕塑，顯示出這種材料非常靈活且易於操作。","explanation":"形容詞「塑膠製的」。"},{"sentence":"The child's mind is very <target>plastic</target> and open to new ideas, which allows them to learn languages much faster than adults.","translation":"小孩的心智具有很強的可塑性且對新想法開放，這使他們學習語言的速度比成年人快得多。","explanation":"形容詞「可塑的」。"}],"related_forms":["plasticity"]}

{"headword":"playful","explanation":"形容詞，指「愛開玩笑的、調皮的、嬉戲的」。常用於描述寵物或小孩的個性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>playful</target> puppy kept jumping around the living room and chasing its own tail, making everyone in the family laugh.","translation":"那隻調皮的小狗在客廳裡不停地跳來跳去，追著自己的尾巴跑，讓全家人都開心地笑了。","explanation":"形容詞「調皮的」。"},{"sentence":"Although the teacher was strict in class, she had a <target>playful</target> sense of humor that made the students feel more relaxed.","translation":"雖然老師在課堂上很嚴格，但她有種幽默的調皮感，讓學生感到更放鬆。","explanation":"形容詞「愛開玩笑的」。"}],"related_forms":["playfully","playfulness"]}

{"headword":"plenty","explanation":"代名詞、名詞或副詞。意為「充足的、許多」。常用片語 plenty of (充足的...)。注意 plenty of 後接可數或不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Make sure you drink <target>plenty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> water during the hike to stay hydrated and avoid heatstroke in the summer heat.","translation":"登山時請確保飲用充足的水分，以在夏季高溫中保持水分並避免中暑。","explanation":"量詞片語 plenty of + 不可數名詞（水）。"},{"sentence":"There are <target>plenty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> opportunities for students to gain work experience through the school's internship program.","translation":"學校的實習計畫為學生提供了許多獲得工作經驗的機會。","explanation":"量詞片語 plenty of + 可數名詞複數（機會）。"},{"sentence":"Don't worry about the food for the party; we have <target>plenty</target> for everyone to enjoy, so you don't need to bring anything.","translation":"不用擔心派對的食物；我們有充足的量讓每個人都能享用，所以你不需要帶任何東西。","explanation":"代名詞「充足的量」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"plug","explanation":"名詞指「插頭」或「塞子」。動詞指「插入插頭」或「填滿/堵住」。注意 plug in (接通電源) 和 plug out/unplug (拔掉電源)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I need to find a power <target>plug</target> to charge my laptop because the battery is almost empty and I have a presentation tomorrow.","translation":"我需要找個電源插頭來為我的筆電充電，因為電量快沒了，而且我明天有一個簡報。","explanation":"名詞「插頭」。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>plug</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the lamp to see if the bulb is still working or if we need to buy a new one.","translation":"請把燈接通電源，看看燈泡是否還在運作，或者我們是否需要買一個新的。","explanation":"動詞片語 plug in (接通電源)。"},{"sentence":"The plumber used a special rubber <target>plug</target> to stop the water from leaking out of the broken pipe in the basement.","translation":"水管工使用一個特殊的橡膠塞子來阻止地下室破損水管中的水漏出。","explanation":"名詞「塞子」。"},{"sentence":"He tried to <target>plug</target> the gap in the wall with some cement to prevent the cold wind from coming inside during winter.","translation":"他試圖用一些水泥填滿牆上的縫隙，以防止冬天冷風進入室內。","explanation":"動詞「填滿/堵住」。"}],"related_forms":["plugs","plugged","plugging"]}

{"headword":"pole","explanation":"名詞「極點；長竿」。常用於地理（北極、南極）或物理（正極、負極），以及指長桿狀物品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The research team spent several months at the South <target>Pole</target> to study the effects of climate change on the Antarctic ice sheets.","translation":"研究團隊在南極洲待了幾個月，研究氣候變遷對南極冰蓋的影響。","explanation":"名詞「極點」。指地理上的極點。"},{"sentence":"The athletes used long skiing <target>poles</target> to help them balance and move faster through the deep snow during the winter competition.","translation":"運動員使用長滑雪杖來幫助他們在冬季比賽中保持平衡並在深雪中移動得更快。","explanation":"名詞「長竿/杖」。指長桿狀的工具。"}],"related_forms":["poles"]}

{"headword":"political","explanation":"形容詞「政治的」。常用於描述與政府、權力或政策相關的事物，如 political party (政黨)、political system (政治體制)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two countries spent months in <target>political</target> <pattern>discussions</pattern> to reach an agreement on the new trade treaty and avoid a potential conflict.","translation":"這兩個國家花了數月時間進行政治討論，以就新的貿易條約達成協議並避免潛在的衝突。","explanation":"形容詞「政治的」。常用搭配：political discussion (政治討論)。"},{"sentence":"Many university students are interested in <target>political</target> <pattern>science</pattern>, which allows them to analyze how governments function and make laws.","translation":"許多大學生對政治學感興趣，這讓他們能分析政府如何運作以及如何制定法律。","explanation":"形容詞「政治的」。常用搭配：political science (政治學)。"}],"related_forms":["politics","politically","politician"]}

{"headword":"politician","explanation":"名詞「政治家」。指從事政治活動的人。注意與 statesman (政治領袖/國父) 的區別，後者通常帶有更正面的評價。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experienced <target>politician</target> gave a powerful speech to convince the public that his new economic plan would benefit everyone.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的政治家發表了一場強而有力的演講，以說服大眾他的新經濟計畫將使每個人獲益。","explanation":"名詞「政治家」。"},{"sentence":"Young people are often skeptical of <target>politicians</target>, believing that they make promises during elections but fail to keep them after winning.","translation":"年輕人通常對政治家持懷疑態度，認為他們在選舉期間做出承諾，但在獲勝後卻未能履行。","explanation":"名詞「政治家」。"}],"related_forms":["politicians"]}

{"headword":"politics","explanation":"名詞「政治」。注意此詞雖然以 s 結尾，但通常被視為單數名詞，指學科或政治活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"Studying <target>politics</target> helps students understand the complex relationship between the government and the citizens in a democratic society.","translation":"學習政治能幫助學生理解民主社會中政府與公民之間複雜的關係。","explanation":"名詞「政治」。作為學科名稱，使用單數動詞。"},{"sentence":"He decided to leave the world of <target>politics</target> after years of service, wanting to spend more time with his family in a quiet town.","translation":"在服務多年後，他決定離開政治世界，想要在安靜的小鎮與家人共度更多時間。","explanation":"名詞「政治」。指從事政治活動的領域。"}],"related_forms":["political","politically","politician"]}

{"headword":"poll","explanation":"名詞「民意調查；投票」。動詞「進行民調/投票」。常考片語 an opinion poll (民意調查)。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to a recent <target>poll</target>, the <pattern>majority of</pattern> citizens believe that the government should invest more in public transportation.","translation":"根據最近的一項民意調查，大多數公民認為政府應該在公共交通上投入更多資金。","explanation":"名詞「民意調查」。常用片語 a majority of (大多數的)。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>poll</target> its employees <pattern>about</pattern> the new flexible working hours to see if they would improve productivity.","translation":"公司決定就新的彈性工作時間對員工進行調查，看看這是否會提高生產力。","explanation":"動詞「進行民調/調查」。常用搭配 poll sb about sth。"},{"sentence":"Thousands of people queued outside the voting stations to <target>poll</target> their votes in the national election held last Tuesday.","translation":"數以千計的人在投票站外排隊，在上週二舉行的全國大選中投下他們的一票。","explanation":"動詞「投票」。"}],"related_forms":["polling"]}

{"headword":"pollute","explanation":"動詞「污染」。指使環境（如水、空氣）變得不潔或有害。常用搭配 pollute the environment/water/air。","entries":[{"sentence":"Factories that <target>pollute</target> the <pattern>rivers with</pattern> toxic chemicals should be heavily fined to protect the local ecosystem and water quality.","translation":"將有毒化學物質排入河流而造成污染的工廠應該被處以重罰，以保護當地生態系統和水質。","explanation":"動詞「污染」。常用搭配 pollute sth with sth。"},{"sentence":"Many cities are trying to reduce the number of cars on the road to prevent exhaust fumes from <target>polluting</target> the air.","translation":"許多城市正努力減少道路上的汽車數量，以防止廢氣污染空氣。","explanation":"動詞「污染」。"}],"related_forms":["pollution","pollutant","polluted"]}

{"headword":"pollution","explanation":"名詞「污染」。指環境被污染的狀態。常見搭配 air pollution (空氣污染), water pollution (水污染), soil pollution (土質污染)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is implementing new laws to combat air <target>pollution</target> in the city, aiming to reduce smog and improve public health.","translation":"政府正在實施新法律以對抗城市中的空氣污染，旨在減少霧霾並改善公共健康。","explanation":"名詞「污染」。常用搭配 air pollution (空氣污染)。"},{"sentence":"Water <target>pollution</target> <pattern>caused by</pattern> industrial waste can destroy marine life and make the water unsafe for drinking or fishing.","translation":"由工業廢料引起的水污染會破壞海洋生物，並使水質不安全，無法飲用或捕魚。","explanation":"名詞「污染」。常用搭配 caused by (由...引起)。"}],"related_forms":["pollute","pollutant"]}
