{"headword":"porcelain","explanation":"名詞「瓷器」。一種高品質的白色陶瓷。常用於描述藝術品或餐具。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum displays a collection of ancient Chinese <target>porcelain</target> that is famous for its delicate patterns and pure white color.","translation":"博物館展出了一系列古代中國瓷器，以其精緻的圖案和純白色澤而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「瓷器」。"},{"sentence":"Because <target>porcelain</target> is very fragile, it must be packed carefully with bubble wrap before being shipped to the new owner.","translation":"由於瓷器非常脆弱，在運送到新主人之前必須用氣泡紙仔細包裝。","explanation":"名詞「瓷器」。"}],"related_forms":["porcelains"]}

{"headword":"portion","explanation":"名詞「一部分；一份(食物)」。動詞「分配」。常用片語 a portion of (一部分的...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"A large <target>portion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the budget was spent on improving the school's library and purchasing new computers for students.","translation":"預算的大部分被用於改善學校圖書館以及為學生購買新電腦。","explanation":"名詞「一部分」。常用片語 a portion of sth。"},{"sentence":"The waiter served a generous <target>portion</target> of pasta, which was so large that I could not finish it all by myself.","translation":"服務生端上了一大份義大利麵，份量大到我一個人無法全部吃完。","explanation":"名詞「一份(食物)」。常用形容詞 generous portion (份量充足的)。"},{"sentence":"The manager decided to <target>portion</target> the remaining funds <pattern>equally among</pattern> the three different research projects to ensure fairness.","translation":"經理決定將剩餘資金平均分配給三個不同的研究計畫，以確保公平。","explanation":"動詞「分配」。常用搭配 portion sth equally among sb/sth。"}],"related_forms":["proportion"]}

{"headword":"portrait","explanation":"名詞「肖像畫」。指描繪某人臉部或上半身的人像畫、照片或描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The art gallery features a stunning <target>portrait</target> of the former president, capturing his thoughtful expression and strong character.","translation":"藝術畫廊展出了一幅令人驚嘆的前總統肖像畫，捕捉到了他深思的表情和強大的性格。","explanation":"名詞「肖像畫」。"},{"sentence":"The photographer specializes in taking professional <target>portraits</target> of business leaders to be used on company websites and official documents.","translation":"這位攝影師專長於為企業領袖拍攝專業肖像照，以便用於公司網站和官方文件。","explanation":"名詞「肖像照」。"}],"related_forms":["portraits"]}

{"headword":"poster","explanation":"名詞「海報」。通常指用於宣傳、廣告或裝飾目的的印刷品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students created a colorful <target>poster</target> to promote the upcoming school art festival, hoping to attract more visitors.","translation":"學生們製作了一張色彩繽紛的海報來宣傳即將到來的學校藝術節，希望能吸引更多遊客。","explanation":"名詞「海報」。"},{"sentence":"She spent the entire afternoon decorating her bedroom wall with a large <target>poster</target> of her favorite singer from the world tour.","translation":"她花了一整個下午用她最喜歡的歌手世界巡演的大海報來裝飾她的臥室牆壁。","explanation":"名詞「海報」。"}],"related_forms":["posters"]}

{"headword": "postpone", "explanation": "動詞「延期」。名詞形式為 postponement。常用搭配 postpone sth until... (將某事延期至...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to the heavy rain and strong winds, the school decided to <target>postpone</target> the outdoor sports meeting <pattern>until</pattern> next Friday.", "translation": "由於大雨和強風，學校決定將戶外運動會延期到下週五。", "explanation": "動詞「延期」。常用搭配 postpone sth until...。"}, {"sentence": "The manager asked the team to <target>postpone</target> the weekly meeting because several key members were still traveling for business.", "translation": "經理要求團隊將週會延期，因為幾位關鍵成員仍在出差。", "explanation": "動詞「延期」。"}, {"sentence": "The government decided to <target>postpone</target> the decision on the new tax law until more detailed research was conducted.", "translation": "政府決定將關於新稅法的決定延期，直到進行更詳細的研究。", "explanation": "動詞「延期」。指延後做出決定或採取行動。"}, {"sentence": "Because of a family emergency, the athlete had to <target>postpone</target> her training session <pattern>until</pattern> the following morning.", "translation": "由於家庭緊急情況，運動員不得不將她的訓練課程延期到第二天早上。", "explanation": "動詞「延期」。常用搭配 postpone sth until...。"}], "related_forms": ["postponement", "postponed"]}

{"headword":"pottery","explanation":"名詞「陶器」或「製陶術」。指用黏土製成並經過烘烤的器皿。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the art class, the students learned how to shape clay on a spinning wheel to create their own unique <target>pottery</target> pieces.","translation":"在美術課上，學生們學習如何在旋轉輪上塑造黏土，以製作出他們自己獨特的陶器作品。","explanation":"名詞「陶器」。"},{"sentence":"Archaeologists discovered many fragments of ancient <target>pottery</target> at the excavation site, providing clues about the daily life of early humans.","translation":"考古學家在挖掘現場發現了許多古代陶器的碎片，為早期人類的日常生活提供了線索。","explanation":"名詞「陶器」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pour","explanation":"動詞「傾倒；流出」。可用於液體，也可指雨下得很大 (pour down)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The waiter carefully <target>poured</target> the orange juice <pattern>into</pattern> the glass, making sure not to spill a single drop on the table.","translation":"服務生小心地將橘子汁倒入玻璃杯中，確保沒有一滴灑在桌上。","explanation":"動詞「傾倒」。常用搭配 pour sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"As soon as the students stepped outside the school building, it started to <target>pour</target> <pattern>down</pattern>, forcing them to run for cover.","translation":"學生們一走出校舍，大雨便傾盆而下，迫使他們趕緊找地方遮雨。","explanation":"動詞片語 pour down 指「傾盆大雨」。"},{"sentence":"She <target>poured</target> all her energy <pattern>into</pattern> studying for the final exams, hoping to achieve the best possible grades in all subjects.","translation":"她將所有精力投入到期末考的複習中，希望能所有科目都拿到最高分。","explanation":"動詞比喻用法「投入」。常用搭配 pour sth into sth。"}],"related_forms":["pouring"]}

{"headword": "poverty", "explanation": "名詞「貧困」。指缺乏基本生活必需品（如食物、住房）的狀態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many international organizations are working together to reduce <target>poverty</target> in developing countries by providing education and healthcare services.", "translation": "許多國際組織正共同努力，透過提供教育和醫療服務來減少開發中國家的貧困。", "explanation": "名詞「貧困」。"}, {"sentence": "Growing up in extreme <target>poverty</target>, the young man studied hard and eventually became a successful lawyer to help his family.", "translation": "在極度貧困中長大，這個年輕人努力學習，最終成為一名成功的律師以幫助他的家人。", "explanation": "名詞「貧困」。常用搭配 extreme poverty。"}, {"sentence": "The local government launched a new project to alleviate <target>poverty</target> by creating more job opportunities for rural villagers.", "translation": "當地政府啟動了一個新項目來緩解貧困，為農村村民創造更多就業機會。", "explanation": "名詞「貧困」。常用搭配 alleviate poverty。"}, {"sentence": "Many families in the region still live <pattern>in</pattern> <target>poverty</target>, struggling to afford basic food and clean drinking water.", "translation": "該地區的許多家庭仍然生活在貧困之中，努力地獲取基本的食物和乾淨的飲用水。", "explanation": "名詞「貧困」。常用搭配 live in poverty。"}], "related_forms": ["poor"]}

{"headword":"powder","explanation":"名詞「粉末」；動詞「將...變成粉末」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baker used a fine <target>powder</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cinnamon to sprinkle on top of the cake for a better smell and taste.","translation":"烘焙師用細小的肉桂粉撒在蛋糕頂部，以增加香味和口感。","explanation":"名詞「粉末」。常用搭配 a powder of sth。"},{"sentence":"The chemist <target>powdered</target> the dry leaves using a special machine to analyze the chemical components of the plant.","translation":"化學家使用一台特殊的機器將乾葉子磨成粉末，以分析該植物的化學成分。","explanation":"動詞「將...變成粉末」。"}],"related_forms":["powdery"]}

{"headword":"practical","explanation":"形容詞「實用的；實際的」。與 theoretical (理論上的) 相反。常用搭配 practical experience (實務經驗)。","entries":[{"sentence":"While the textbook provides a lot of theory, students need more <target>practical</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> to understand how the machine actually works.","translation":"雖然教科書提供了很多理論，但學生需要更多實務經驗才能理解這台機器實際上是如何運作的。","explanation":"形容詞「實用的；實際的」。常用搭配 practical experience。"},{"sentence":"When choosing a college major, it is more <target>practical</target> to consider your own interests and your future job opportunities in the market.","translation":"在選擇大學專業時，考慮自己的興趣和未來在市場上的工作機會會更實際。","explanation":"形容詞「實際的」。"},{"sentence":"A small Swiss Army knife is a <target>practical</target> tool for camping because it includes several useful functions in one small device.","translation":"瑞士軍刀是一個實用的露營工具，因為它在一個小裝置中包含了多個有用的功能。","explanation":"形容詞「實用的」。"}],"related_forms":["practically","practice"]}

{"headword": "precious", "explanation": "形容詞「珍貴的」。指價值高或具有重要情感意義的事物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum displays several <target>precious</target> <pattern>stones</pattern> and jewelry from the ancient Egyptian empire, attracting thousands of visitors every year.", "translation": "博物館展出了一些來自古埃及帝國的珍貴寶石和珠寶，每年吸引數以千計的遊客。", "explanation": "形容詞「珍貴的」。常用搭配 precious stones (寶石)。"}, {"sentence": "Time is the most <target>precious</target> resource we have, so we should use it wisely instead of wasting it on useless activities.", "translation": "時間是我們擁有的最珍貴的資源，所以我們應該明智地使用它，而不是將其浪費於無用之處。", "explanation": "形容詞「珍貴的」。"}, {"sentence": "The grandmother kept a small wooden box filled with <target>precious</target> memories and old photographs from her youth.", "translation": "奶奶保留了一個裝滿她年輕時珍貴回憶和舊照片的小木盒。", "explanation": "形容詞「珍貴的」。指具有重要情感意義的事物。"}, {"sentence": "Water is a <target>precious</target> resource in the desert, making every single drop extremely valuable for the survival of wildlife.", "translation": "水在沙漠中是一種珍貴的資源，使得每一滴水對於野生動物的生存都極其重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「珍貴的」。指價值極高或稀有。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"preparation","explanation":"名詞「準備」。動詞為 prepare。常用搭配 in preparation for (為了準備...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students spent several weeks <pattern>in</pattern> <target>preparation</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the national English speaking contest to ensure they were ready.","translation":"學生們花了好幾個星期準備全國英語口說比賽，以確保他們準備就緒。","explanation":"名詞「準備」。常用片語 in preparation for sth。"},{"sentence":"Careful <target>preparation</target> is the key to a successful presentation, as it allows the speaker to organize their thoughts and speak clearly.","translation":"仔細的準備是成功簡報的關鍵，因為它讓講者能組織自己的想法並清晰地表達。","explanation":"名詞「準備」。"}],"related_forms":["prepare","prepared"]}

{"headword":"presence","explanation":"名詞「出席；在場；存在」。源自於 present (形容詞/動詞)。常用搭配 in the presence of (在...面前)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher noticed the <target>presence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a strange smell in the classroom, which later turned out to be someone's strong perfume.","translation":"老師注意到教室裡有一股奇怪的味道，後來發現是某人的強烈香水味。","explanation":"名詞「存在」。常用搭配 presence of sth。"},{"sentence":"The witness had to sign the legal document <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>presence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a lawyer to make the agreement official.","translation":"證人必須在律師面前簽署法律文件，以使該協議正式生效。","explanation":"名詞「出席/在場」。常用片語 in the presence of sb。"},{"sentence":"The school principal's <target>presence</target> at the graduation ceremony made the students feel that their achievements were truly valued.","translation":"校長在畢業典禮上的出席，讓學生們覺得他們的成就真正得到了重視。","explanation":"名詞「出席」。"}],"related_forms":["present"]}

{"headword":"pretend","explanation":"動詞「假裝」。指故意使他人相信某事是真實的，而實際上並非如此。常搭配 to V 或 that 子句。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little boy decided to <target>pretend</target> <pattern>that</pattern> he was a brave knight fighting a dragon to entertain his younger sister.","translation":"那個小男孩決定假裝自己是一名勇敢的騎士在與龍戰鬥，以娛樂他的妹妹。","explanation":"動詞「假裝」。搭配 that 子句表示「假裝...」。"},{"sentence":"Some students <target>pretend</target> <pattern>to</pattern> be interested in the lecture, but they are actually daydreaming about their weekend plans.","translation":"有些學生假裝對講座感興趣，但他們實際上是在白日夢地想著週末的計畫。","explanation":"動詞「假裝」。搭配 to V 表示「假裝做某事」。"}],"related_forms":["pretending","pretension"]}

{"headword":"prevent","explanation":"動詞「防止、預防」。指透過採取行動來阻止某事發生。核心搭配為 prevent someone from doing something。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council installed new security cameras to <target>prevent</target> theft and vandalism in the public park after dark.","translation":"市議會安裝了新的監視攝影機，以防止在天黑後公共公園內發生盜竊和蓄意破壞行為。","explanation":"動詞「防止」。"},{"sentence":"The heavy rain and strong winds <target>prevented</target> the students <pattern>from</pattern> <pattern>attending</pattern> the school's outdoor sports meet on Friday.","translation":"大雨和強風使得學生們無法參加週五學校的戶外運動會。","explanation":"核心搭配 prevent someone from doing something，表示「防止某人做某事」或「使得某人無法...」。"}],"related_forms":["preventable","prevention"]}
comment: DENSITY_ERROR: Only 2 sentences provided. 'prevent' is a versatile word with multiple patterns (prevent sth from happening vs prevent sb from doing sth). Need more examples.

response: {"headword":"previous","explanation":"形容詞「先前的、之前的」。指在時間或順序上早於目前所討論的事物。常與 current (目前的) 或 following (接下來的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before starting the new project, the team reviewed all the <target>previous</target> research and data to avoid repeating the same mistakes.","translation":"在開始新計畫之前，團隊審查了所有先前的研究和數據，以避免重複同樣的錯誤。","explanation":"形容詞「先前的」。"},{"sentence":"The student's <target>previous</target> experience in volunteering at the animal shelter helped her gain admission to the veterinary school.","translation":"這名學生在動物收容所擔任志工的先前經驗幫助她進入獸醫學院。","explanation":"形容詞「先前的」。"}],"related_forms":["previously"]}

{"headword":"probable","explanation":"形容詞「可能的」。指某事發生的可能性很高。注意與 possible (可能的) 的區別：probable 表示可能性較高，而 possible 僅表示只要不違背邏輯或物理定律即可發生。","entries":[{"sentence":"Based on the current weather forecast, it is <target>probable</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the outdoor concert will be postponed until next week.","translation":"根據目前的天氣預報，戶外音樂會很可能會被推遲到下週。","explanation":"形容詞「可能的」。常用句型 it is probable that...。"},{"sentence":"The detective believed it was the most <target>probable</target> explanation for the mysterious disappearance of the painting from the museum.","translation":"偵探認為這是對博物館中畫作神秘失蹤最可能的解釋。","explanation":"形容詞「可能的」。"}],"related_forms":["probably","probability"]}

{"headword":"process","explanation":"名詞指「過程、程序」；動詞指「處理」。名詞用法常搭配 in the process of (在...過程中) 或 a lengthy process (冗長的過程)。動詞用法常指處理數據、文件或原材料。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning a new language is a gradual <target>process</target> <pattern>that</pattern> requires patience, consistent practice, and a lot of effort over time.","translation":"學習一門新語言是一個漸進的過程，需要耐心、持續的練習以及長時間的努力。","explanation":"名詞「過程」。"},{"sentence":"The university application <target>process</target> can be quite stressful for high school seniors who are trying to choose the right college.","translation":"對於試圖選擇正確大學的高三學生來說，大學申請程序可能會相當壓力大。","explanation":"名詞「程序」。"},{"sentence":"The computer system is designed to <target>process</target> large amounts of data quickly, allowing researchers to identify trends and patterns more efficiently.","translation":"該電腦系統旨在快速處理大量數據，讓研究人員能更有效地辨識趨勢和模式。","explanation":"動詞「處理」。"},{"sentence":"After the interview, the HR department will <target>process</target> your application and notify you of the result within two weeks.","translation":"面試後，人力資源部門將處理您的申請並在兩週內通知您結果。","explanation":"動詞「處理」。"}],"related_forms":["processing","processor"]}

{"headword":"producer","explanation":"名詞「生產者、製作人」。可指工業生產產品的人或公司，也可指電影、音樂或戲劇的製作人。","entries":[{"sentence":"Taiwan is one of the world's leading <target>producers</target> <pattern>of</pattern> high-quality semiconductors, which are essential components for modern electronic devices.","translation":"台灣是世界上高品質半導體的領先生產者之一，半導體是現代電子設備的基本組件。","explanation":"名詞「生產者」。常用搭配 producer of sth。"},{"sentence":"The film <target>producer</target> worked closely with the director to secure funding and manage the budget for the new science fiction movie.","translation":"電影製作人與導演密切合作，以確保新科幻電影的資金並管理預算。","explanation":"名詞「製作人」。"}],"related_forms":["produce"]}

{"headword":"product","explanation":"名詞「產品」。指透過製造或工作產生的結果。常用搭配 include a wide range of products (包含一系列產品) 或 a finished product (成品)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company launched a new <target>product</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the market to attract younger customers who prefer eco-friendly and sustainable materials.","translation":"公司在市場上推出了一款新產品，以吸引偏好環保且永續材料的年輕顧客。","explanation":"名詞「產品」。"},{"sentence":"Many students use a variety of digital <target>products</target> to organize their study schedules and keep track of their assignments.","translation":"許多學生使用各種數位產品來安排他們的學習進度表並記錄他們的作業。","explanation":"名詞「產品」。"}],"related_forms":["production","productive"]}

{"headword":"professor","explanation":"名詞「教授」。指大學或高等教育機構中的高級教師。","entries":[{"sentence":"The history <target>professor</target> encouraged the students to think critically about the past and analyze the causes of the world wars.","translation":"歷史教授鼓勵學生們批判性地思考過去並分析世界大戰的原因。","explanation":"名詞「教授」。"},{"sentence":"After the lecture, several students approached the <target>professor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> linguistics to ask for clarification on a difficult concept.","translation":"講座後，好幾個學生走向語言學教授，詢問關於一個困難概念的進一步說明。","explanation":"名詞「教授」。常用搭配 professor of [subject]。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"profit","explanation":"名詞指「利潤」；動詞指「獲益」。名詞用法常搭配 make a profit (獲利) 或 profit margin (利潤率)。動詞用法常搭配 profit from sth (從...中獲益)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small bookstore decided to increase its prices slightly to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>profit</target> and stay in business during the economic downturn.","translation":"這家小書店決定稍微調高價格，以便在經濟低迷時期獲利並維持經營。","explanation":"名詞「利潤」。片語 make a profit 表示「獲利」。"},{"sentence":"The company's annual <target>profit</target> <pattern>has</pattern> <pattern>increased</pattern> significantly because of its innovative new product line and efficient management.","translation":"由於其創新的新產品線和高效的管理，該公司的年度利潤顯著增加。","explanation":"名詞「利潤」。"},{"sentence":"Many students <target>profit</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the extra help provided by the school's tutoring center, improving their grades in mathematics.","translation":"許多學生從學校補習中心的額外幫助中獲益，提高了他們在數學方面的成績。","explanation":"動詞「獲益」。常用搭配 profit from sth。"},{"sentence":"The local community <target>profited</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the new high-speed railway station, as more tourists visited the area and spent money locally.","translation":"當地社區從新的高速鐵路站中獲益，因為更多遊客造訪該地區並在當地花錢。","explanation":"動詞「獲益」。常用搭配 profit from sth。"}],"related_forms":["profitable","profitability"]}

{"headword": "promote", "explanation": "動詞「晉升、推廣」。指將某人提升到更高職位，或將某某事物（如產品或理念）宣傳推廣。常用搭配 promote someone to [position] 或 promote a product。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The manager decided to <target>promote</target> the hardworking employee <pattern>to</pattern> the position of senior supervisor after a year of excellent performance.", "translation": "經理決定在該員工表現出色一年後，將其晉升為高級主管一職。", "explanation": "動詞「晉升」。常用搭配 promote someone to [position]。"}, {"sentence": "The school's student council is trying to <target>promote</target> a healthy lifestyle by organizing a series of workshops on nutrition and exercise.", "translation": "學校的學生會正試圖透過組織一系列關於營養和運動的研討會來推廣健康生活方式。", "explanation": "動詞「推廣」。"}, {"sentence": "The company launched a massive advertising campaign to <target>promote</target> their new eco-friendly cleaning products to young consumers.", "translation": "公司發起了一場大規模的廣告活動，向年輕消費者推廣他們的新環保清潔產品。", "explanation": "動詞「推廣」。指對產品進行市場宣傳。"}, {"sentence": "The organization works to <target>promote</target> peace and understanding between different cultures by organizing international student exchange programs.", "translation": "該組織致力於透過組織國際學生交換計畫，推廣不同文化之間的和平與理解。", "explanation": "動詞「促進/推廣」。指使某種正面狀態或理念得到發展。"}, {"sentence": "After consistently meeting all her sales targets, Sarah was <target>promoted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> regional manager last month.", "translation": "在持續達成所有銷售目標後，莎拉上個月被晉升為區域經理。", "explanation": "動詞「晉升」的被動語態，搭配 to 表示晉升到的職位。"}], "related_forms": ["promotion", "promotional"]}

{"headword": "pronounce", "explanation": "動詞「發音」或「宣布」。注意發音時常用搭配 pronounce A as B (將 A 發音為 B)，宣布時常用於正式的法律或官方宣告，如 pronounce someone dead (宣布某人死亡)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The English teacher carefully showed the students how to <target>pronounce</target> the new vocabulary words to avoid any misunderstandings in conversation.", "translation": "英文老師仔細地向學生展示如何發音這些新單字，以避免在對話中產生任何誤解。", "explanation": "動詞「發音」。指將單字讀出正確的聲音。"}, {"sentence": "Since he had never seen the word before, he was not sure how to <target>pronounce</target> it and had to ask his classmate for help.", "translation": "因為他以前從未見過這個單字，他不確定該如何發音，所以不得不請同學幫忙。", "explanation": "動詞「發音」。"}, {"sentence": "After examining the patient for several minutes, the doctor was forced to <target>pronounce</target> him dead at the scene of the accident.", "translation": "在對病人檢查了幾分鐘後，醫生被迫在事故現場宣布他死亡。", "explanation": "動詞「宣布」。常用於正式或醫療宣告。"}, {"sentence": "The judge is expected to <target>pronounce</target> the final sentence of the court case tomorrow morning in front of the jury.", "translation": "法官預計將於明天上午在陪審團面前宣布案件的最終判決。", "explanation": "動詞「宣布」。指正式地發布判決或決定。"}], "related_forms": ["pronunciation", "pronouncedly"]}

{"headword":"proof","explanation":"名詞「證據」或「證明」。注意 proof 是不可數名詞，而 prove 是動詞。常用搭配 include proof of (包含...的證明) 或 provide proof (提供證據)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective spent weeks searching for solid <target>proof</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the suspect's guilt before the police could make an official arrest.","translation":"在警方能正式逮捕之前，偵探花了好幾週尋找嫌疑犯有罪的確鑿證據。","explanation":"名詞「證據」。常用搭配 proof of sth。"},{"sentence":"To enter the university dormitory, students must provide <target>proof</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their identity by showing a valid student ID card.","translation":"為了進入大學宿舍，學生必須透過出示有效的學生證來提供身分證明。","explanation":"名詞「證明」。指證明某事屬實的文件或證據。"},{"sentence":"Despite the lawyer's arguments, there was no clear <target>proof</target> that the witness had lied during the trial to protect the defendant.","translation":"儘管律師辯論，但沒有明確的證據證明證人曾在審判期間說謊以保護被告。","explanation":"名詞「證據」。"}],"related_forms":["prove","provable"]}

{"headword":"property","explanation":"名詞，具有兩種主要意思：1. 「財產、房產」；2. 「特性、性質」。前者通常指擁有的東西，後者常用於科學或描述物質時。注意 property 的複數形式 properties 常指「特性」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wealthy businessman decided to donate a large part of his <target>property</target> to the local library to support community education.","translation":"這位富有的商人決定將他大部分的財產捐給當地圖書館，以支持社區教育。","explanation":"名詞「財產」。指個人擁有的土地或建築物。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the chemical <target>properties</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new material to see if it can be used for building safer bridges.","translation":"科學家正在研究這種新材料的化學特性，看看它是否可用於建造更安全的橋樑。","explanation":"名詞「特性」。常用於科學語境，常用複數形式 properties。"},{"sentence":"The laws regarding private <target>property</target> are designed to protect the rights of owners and prevent others from entering without permission.","translation":"關於私人財產的法律旨在保護所有者的權利，並防止他人未經許可進入。","explanation":"名詞「財產」。常用搭配 private property。"}],"related_forms":["properties"]}

{"headword":"protection","explanation":"名詞「保護」。由動詞 protect 衍生而來。常用搭配 include protection from (保護免於...) 或 provide protection (提供保護)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Sunscreen provides essential <target>protection</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the harmful ultraviolet rays of the sun, especially during the hot summer months.","translation":"防曬霜提供了免於太陽有害紫外線的必要保護，尤其是在炎熱的夏季月份。","explanation":"名詞「保護」。常用搭配 protection from sth。"},{"sentence":"The government has implemented new laws to provide better legal <target>protection</target> <pattern>for</pattern> endangered species and their natural habitats.","translation":"政府實施了新法律，以為瀕危物種及其自然棲息地提供更好的法律保護。","explanation":"名詞「保護」。常用搭配 protection for sth。"},{"sentence":"Wearing a helmet while riding a bicycle is a simple way to ensure personal <target>protection</target> in case of an unexpected accident.","translation":"騎自行車時戴頭盔是確保個人保護的一種簡單方法，以防止意外事故發生。","explanation":"名詞「保護」。"}],"related_forms":["protect","protective"]}

{"headword":"pub","explanation":"名詞「酒吧」。是 public house 的縮寫。在英國文化中，pub 不僅是喝酒的地方，也是社區社交中心。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the final exam, the group of friends decided to meet at a local <target>pub</target> to celebrate their hard work and relax together.","translation":"期末考後，這群朋友決定在當地的一家酒吧見面，慶祝他們的努力並一起放鬆。","explanation":"名詞「酒吧」。"},{"sentence":"The old <target>pub</target> on the corner of the street is famous for its traditional food and friendly atmosphere, attracting many tourists.","translation":"街角那家舊酒吧以其傳統食物和親切的氛圍而聞名，吸引了許多遊客。","explanation":"名詞「酒吧」。"}],"related_forms":["pubs"]}

{"headword":"pump","explanation":"名詞「幫浦、抽水機」；動詞「抽水、打氣」。常考動詞片語 pump up (打氣；使增加)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer used a mechanical <target>pump</target> to move water from the underground well to the fields during the dry season.","translation":"在乾季，農民使用機械抽水機將水從地下井抽到田裡。","explanation":"名詞「幫浦、抽水機」。"},{"sentence":"Before starting the long bike trip, he had to <target>pump</target> <pattern>up</pattern> his tires to ensure a smooth and safe ride.","translation":"在開始長途單車旅行前，他必須為輪胎打氣，以確保旅程順暢且安全。","explanation":"動詞片語 pump up 表示「打氣」。"},{"sentence":"The heart acts as a powerful <target>pump</target> that sends blood and oxygen to every part of the human body through the veins.","translation":"心臟扮演著一個強大的幫浦，透過靜脈將血液和氧氣送到人體的每個部分。","explanation":"名詞「幫浦」。在此指心臟的生理功能。"}],"related_forms":["pumps","pumping"]}

{"headword": "punch", "explanation": "名詞「拳擊、重擊」；動詞「打拳、打洞」。常用搭配 include take a punch (承受重擊) 或 punch a hole (打洞)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The boxer managed to <target>punch</target> the heavy bag with great force, showing his incredible strength and speed during the training session.", "translation": "拳擊手在訓練過程中以巨大的力量擊打沙袋，展現出他驚人的力量和速度。", "explanation": "動詞「擊打」。"}, {"sentence": "She used a special tool to <target>punch</target> a small hole in the leather belt so that it would fit her waist perfectly.", "translation": "她使用一個特殊工具在皮帶上打了一個小洞，以便皮帶能完美地貼合她的腰圍。", "explanation": "動詞「打洞」。"}, {"sentence": "The unexpected news of the failure was a heavy <target>punch</target> to his confidence, making him feel defeated for several days.", "translation": "失敗的意外消息對他的信心是一個沉重的打擊，讓他好幾天感到挫敗。", "explanation": "名詞「打擊」。此處為比喻用法，指精神上的重擊。"}, {"sentence": "The security guard had to <target>punch</target> the tickets of all the visitors as they entered the cinema to ensure no one entered for free.", "translation": "保全必須在所有訪客進入電影院時為其票券打孔，以確保沒有人免費進入。", "explanation": "動詞「打孔」。指使用工具在票券上打洞以示驗票。"}, {"sentence": "Although the fighter could <pattern>take</pattern> a <target>punch</target>, he struggled to find an opening to attack his opponent during the final round.", "translation": "儘管這名鬥士能夠承受重擊，但他很難在最後一輪中找到攻擊對手的機會。", "explanation": "名詞「重擊」。搭配 take a punch 表示承受重擊。"}], "related_forms": ["punched", "punching"]}

{"headword":"puppet","explanation":"名詞「傀儡、木偶」。除了指實體木偶，也常用於比喻指被他人操控的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children laughed with joy as the performer moved the <target>puppet</target> with strings, making it dance and sing on stage.","translation":"當表演者用繩子操縱木偶使其在舞台上跳舞唱歌時，孩子們開心地笑了。","explanation":"名詞「木偶」。指透過繩子或手操縱的玩偶。"},{"sentence":"In the political drama, the president was described as a <target>puppet</target> of the military, having no real power to make decisions.","translation":"在政治劇中，總統被描述為軍方的傀儡，沒有真正的權力做決定。","explanation":"名詞「傀儡」。比喻指被他人操控、沒有自主權的人。"}],"related_forms":["puppets"]}

{"headword":"pure","explanation":"形容詞「純粹的、純淨的」。常考搭配 pure water (純水) 或 pure chance (純粹的巧合)。注意其名詞形式 purity。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company claims that its new filter can produce <target>pure</target> drinking water by removing all harmful chemicals and bacteria.","translation":"該公司聲稱其新過濾器能透過去除所有有害化學物質和細菌來產生純淨的飲用水。","explanation":"形容詞「純淨的」。指不含雜質。"},{"sentence":"It was <target>pure</target> <pattern>chance</pattern> that they met each other at the airport after ten years of not seeing one another.","translation":"他們在十年沒見面後在機場相遇，完全是純粹的巧合。","explanation":"形容詞「純粹的」。常用搭配 pure chance (純粹的巧合)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student's <target>pure</target> interest in learning, as he studied hard without worrying about his final grades.","translation":"老師稱讚這位學生純粹的學習興趣，因為他努力學習而不擔心期末成績。","explanation":"形容詞「純粹的」。指沒有其他動機或雜質。"}],"related_forms":["purity","purely"]}

{"headword":"purse","explanation":"名詞「錢包、小手袋」。通常指女性使用的小型手袋。注意與 wallet 的區別：wallet 通常指較扁平的錢包，而 purse 則可能包含更多物品。","entries":[{"sentence":"She realized she had forgotten her <target>purse</target> at home, so she could not pay for the groceries she had already picked up.","translation":"她意識到自己把錢包忘在家裡，所以無法支付她已經挑好的雜貨費用。","explanation":"名詞「錢包」。"},{"sentence":"The woman carefully placed her phone and keys inside her <target>purse</target> before walking out of the library to meet her friends.","translation":"這位女士小心地將手機和鑰匙放入她的手袋中，然後走出圖書館去與朋友見面。","explanation":"名詞「小手袋」。"}],"related_forms":["purses"]}

{"headword":"queer","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的、古怪的」。在現代英語中，此詞在某些脈絡下可用於描述性傾向，但在 GSAT 考題中，通常指「異常的」或「不尋常的」，與 strange 或 odd 同義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective felt a <target>queer</target> sensation in his chest when he entered the abandoned house, as if someone were watching him.","translation":"偵探進入那座廢棄房屋時，胸口感到一種奇怪的感覺，彷彿有人在監視著他。","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的」。描述一種不尋常的感覺。"},{"sentence":"It seemed <target>queer</target> that the experienced pilot made such a simple mistake during the routine flight check.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的飛行員在例行飛行檢查中犯了如此簡單的錯誤，這似乎很奇怪。","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的」。指事情不合常理。"}],"related_forms":["queerly","queerness"]}

{"headword":"quit","explanation":"動詞「停止、放棄、離職」。指不再從事某項活動或離開某個職位。常用片語 quit doing sth (停止做某事) 或 quit a job (離職)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working for the same company for ten years, he decided to <target>quit</target> his job to pursue a degree in environmental science.","translation":"在同一家公司工作十年後，他決定辭掉工作，去攻讀環境科學的學位。","explanation":"動詞「離職」。指離開目前的工作職位。"},{"sentence":"The doctor strongly advised the patient to <target>quit</target> <pattern>smoking</pattern>, as it would significantly reduce the risk of lung disease.","translation":"醫生強烈建議病人戒菸，因為這將顯著降低患肺病的風險。","explanation":"動詞「停止」。常用搭配 quit doing sth，表示戒除某種習慣。"},{"sentence":"When the noise from the construction site became unbearable, the students <target>quit</target> <pattern>trying</pattern> to study in the library.","translation":"當建築工地的噪音變得無法忍受時，學生們停止嘗試在圖書館讀書。","explanation":"動詞「停止」。指放棄目前的嘗試。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"quote","explanation":"動詞「引用」或名詞「引文」。作為動詞時，指重複他人所說或寫過的話；作為名詞時，指引用的文字或價格報價。常用搭配 quote from (引用...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In her English essay, the student <target>quoted</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a famous poet to support her argument about the beauty of nature.","translation":"在那篇英文作文中，這名學生引用了一位著名詩人的話來支持她關於自然之美的論點。","explanation":"動詞「引用」。常用搭配 quote from sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"The journalist decided to <target>quote</target> the president's words exactly as they were spoken to avoid any misunderstanding of the message.","translation":"記者決定完全照著總統所說的話來引用，以避免對訊息產生任何誤解。","explanation":"動詞「引用」。指精確地重複原話。"},{"sentence":"The professor asked the students to include at least one direct <target>quote</target> in their research paper to strengthen their evidence.","translation":"教授要求學生在研究論文中至少包含一段直接引文，以強化他們的證據。","explanation":"名詞「引文」。指被引用的文字。"},{"sentence":"Before hiring the contractor, the homeowner asked for a written <target>quote</target> to know the total cost of the renovation project.","translation":"在聘請承包商之前，屋主要求提供一份書面報價單，以便了解裝修工程的總成本。","explanation":"名詞「報價」。在商業脈絡中，quote 指價格報價。"}],"related_forms":["quotation","quotable"]}

{"headword":"racial","explanation":"形容詞「種族的、種族上的」。通常用於描述與種族認同、歧視或關係相關的事物。常用搭配 racial equality (種族平等), racial discrimination (種族歧視)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government has implemented new laws to combat <target>racial</target> <pattern>discrimination</pattern> in the workplace and ensure fair treatment for all.","translation":"政府實施了新法律以打擊職場中的種族歧視，並確保所有人都能受到公平對待。","explanation":"形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配 racial discrimination (種族歧視)。"},{"sentence":"Many historians study <target>racial</target> <pattern>tensions</pattern> in the 19th century to understand how social conflicts shaped the modern world.","translation":"許多歷史學家研究 19 世紀的種族緊張關係，以了解社會衝突如何塑造現代世界。","explanation":"形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配 racial tensions (種族緊張關係)。"},{"sentence":"The international organization promotes <target>racial</target> <pattern>equality</pattern> and diversity, encouraging people of all backgrounds to work together in peace.","translation":"該國際組織推廣種族平等與多樣性，鼓勵不同背景的人們和平共處。","explanation":"形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配 racial equality (種族平等)。"}],"related_forms":["race"]}

{"headword":"rag","explanation":"名詞「抹布、破布」。指舊的、撕裂的布料。常用於描述清潔工作或破舊的衣服。","entries":[{"sentence":"After finishing the dinner, the student used an old <target>rag</target> to wipe the spilled milk off the kitchen table.","translation":"晚餐結束後，學生用一塊舊抹布將廚房桌上灑掉的牛奶擦乾淨。","explanation":"名詞「抹布」。指用於清潔的破布。"},{"sentence":"The beggar wore <target>rags</target> and looked very tired, so the kind strangers gave him some food and warm clothes.","translation":"乞丐穿著破爛的衣服，看起來很疲倦，因此親切的陌生人給了他一些食物和溫暖的衣服。","explanation":"名詞「破衣」。通常用複數 rags 表示破舊的衣服。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "rank", "explanation": "名詞「等級、階級」；動詞「排列、將...分級」。作為名詞時，指在組織或社會中的地位；作為動詞時，指確定某人的地位或將事物按順序排列。常用搭配 rank among (位列於...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After several years of hard work and training, the soldier finally achieved the <target>rank</target> of captain in the army.", "translation": "經過幾年的努力工作和訓練，這名士兵終於在軍隊中獲得了上尉的軍階。", "explanation": "名詞「軍階、等級」。指在組織中的職位。"}, {"sentence": "The university is <target>ranked</target> <pattern>among</pattern> the top ten institutions in the world for its exceptional research in medicine.", "translation": "這所大學因其卓越的醫學研究而位列世界前十名機構之列。", "explanation": "動詞「位列於」。常用搭配 rank among (位列於...之中)。"}, {"sentence": "Many students <target>rank</target> mathematics as their most challenging subject because of the complex formulas and abstract concepts.", "translation": "許多學生將數學視為他們最具挑戰性的科目，因為其複雜的公式和抽象概念。", "explanation": "動詞「將...分級/視為」。指將事物按重要性或難度排序。"}, {"sentence": "The new movie <target>ranks</target> as one of the most visually stunning films of the year, although the plot is quite simple.", "translation": "這部新電影被視為今年視覺效果最令人驚嘆的電影之一，儘管其情節相當簡單。", "explanation": "動詞「位列於/被視為」。"}, {"sentence": "The smell of the old fish in the market was so <target>rank</target> that the tourists decided to leave the area immediately.", "translation": "市場裡舊魚的氣味如此之臭，以至於遊客決定立即離開該區域。", "explanation": "形容詞「惡臭的」。指氣味極其糟糕。"}], "related_forms": ["ranking"]}

{"headword": "rate", "explanation": "名詞「速率、比率、價格」；動詞「評價、評級」。作為名詞時，指單位時間或空間內的量；作為動詞「動詞「評價、評級」。常用搭配 at a rate of (以...的速率/比率)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The car traveled <pattern>at a</pattern> <target>rate</target> <pattern>of</pattern> 100 kilometers per hour, allowing the family to reach the destination quickly.", "translation": "汽車以每小時 100 公里的速度行駛，使這家人能快速到達目的地。", "explanation": "名詞「速率」。常用搭配 at a rate of... (以...的速率)。"}, {"sentence": "Because of the sudden increase in hotel <target>rates</target>, many travelers decided to stay in cheaper hostels during their vacation.", "translation": "由於飯店價格突然增加，許多旅客在度假期間決定住在較便宜的青年旅館。", "explanation": "名詞「價格」。指服務或房間的收費標準。"}, {"sentence": "The students were asked to <target>rate</target> the quality of the school cafeteria food on a scale of one to five.", "translation": "學生們被要求在 1 到 5 分的量表上對學校食堂食物的品質進行評分。", "explanation": "動詞「評分、評價」。"}, {"sentence": "The unemployment <target>rate</target> has decreased significantly over the past year, showing a sign of economic recovery.", "translation": "失業率已在過去一年顯著降低，顯示出經濟復甦的跡象。", "explanation": "名詞「比率」。指特定群體中某部分的比例。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his extensive experience in the field, the young architect was not <target>rated</target> highly by the senior partners of the firm.", "translation": "儘管他在該領域有豐富的經驗，這位年輕的建築師並未受到公司高級合夥人的高度評價。", "explanation": "動詞「評價」。指被視為具有某種品質或能力。"}], "related_forms": ["rating"]}

{"headword":"raw","explanation":"形容詞「生的、未加工的」；亦可指「粗糙的、未經修飾的」或「寒冷刺骨的」。在 GSAT 中，常指食物未經烹煮或數據未經分析。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some people enjoy eating <target>raw</target> <pattern>fish</pattern>, such as sushi, while others prefer their seafood to be cooked thoroughly.","translation":"有些人喜歡吃生魚，例如壽司，而其他人則偏好海鮮被徹底烹煮。","explanation":"形容詞「生的」。指食物未經烹煮。"},{"sentence":"The researchers collected <target>raw</target> <pattern>data</pattern> from the survey, which they then analyzed to find common patterns in student behavior.","translation":"研究人員從調查中中收集了原始數據，隨後對其進行分析，以找出學生行為中的共同模式。","explanation":"形容詞「原始的」。常用搭配 raw data (原始數據)。"},{"sentence":"The wind was <target>raw</target> and cold during the winter storm, making it difficult for the hikers to keep their bodies warm.","translation":"風冷冽刺骨，在冬季風暴期間，使登山客很難讓身體保持溫暖。","explanation":"形容詞「寒冷刺骨的」。描述天氣冷且潮濕。"}],"related_forms":["rawly"]}

{"headword":"ray","explanation":"名詞「光線、射線」。指從一個點發出的直線光。常用搭配 a ray of hope (一線希望)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the sun rose over the mountains, a single <target>ray</target> of sunlight broke through the clouds and lit up the valley.","translation":"當太陽從山脈上升時，一束陽光穿透雲層，照亮了山谷。","explanation":"名詞「光線」。指一束光。"},{"sentence":"Despite the failure of his first project, the teacher's encouragement gave him a <target>ray</target> <pattern>of hope</pattern> to try again.","translation":"儘管他的第一個計畫失敗了，老師的鼓勵給了他一線希望再次嘗試。","explanation":"名詞「光線/希望」。常用比喻用法 a ray of hope (一線希望)。"},{"sentence":"In the physics class, the students learned how an X-<target>ray</target> can be used to see the bones inside the human body.","translation":"在物理課上，學生們學習了 X 光線如何被用於觀察人體內部的骨骼。","explanation":"名詞「射線」。指特定的電磁波。"}],"related_forms":["rays"]}

{"headword":"razor","explanation":"名詞「剃刀」。一種用於剃除毛髮的工具。常用搭配 a razor blade (剃刀片)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He bought a new electric <target>razor</target> because it was more convenient and faster for his daily morning grooming routine.","translation":"他買了一把新的電動剃刀，因為對於他的每日早晨理容習慣來說，它更法方便且快速。","explanation":"名詞「剃刀」。"},{"sentence":"The barber used a traditional <target>razor</target> to carefully shave the customer's beard, ensuring a smooth and precise cut.","translation":"理髮師使用傳統的剃刀小心地為顧客剃除鬍鬚，確保切割平滑且正確。","explanation":"名詞「剃刀」。"}],"related_forms":["razors"]}

{"headword":"react","explanation":"動詞「反應」。指對某種刺激或情況做出回應。常用片語 react to (對...做出反應)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some people <target>react</target> <pattern>differently to</pattern> the same news, while others may feel happy and some may feel sad.","translation":"有些人對同樣的消息反應不同，有些人可能感到開心，而有些人可能感到悲傷。","explanation":"動詞「反應」。常用片語 react to sth (對某事做出反應)。"},{"sentence":"The chemical <target>reacts</target> <pattern>violently with</pattern> water, so the students must handle it carefully during the science experiment.","translation":"這種化學物質與水反應劇烈，因此學生在科學實驗過程中必須小心處理。","explanation":"動詞「反應」。常用搭配 react with sth (與某物產生化學反應)。"},{"sentence":"It is important to remain calm and not <target>react</target> <pattern>immediately to</pattern> insults to avoid making a conflict worse.","translation":"保持冷靜且不要立即對侮辱做出反應，以避免使衝突惡化是很重要的。","explanation":"動詞「反應」。常用搭配 react immediately to sth (立即對某事做出反應)。"}],"related_forms":["reaction","reactive"]}

{"headword":"reaction","explanation":"名詞「反應」。指對某事的回應或化學反應。常用片語 in reaction to (作為對...的反應)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students' <target>reaction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the new school rule was mostly negative, as they felt it limited their freedom.","translation":"學生對新校規的反應大多是負面的，因為他們覺得這限制了他們的自由。","explanation":"名詞「反應」。常用搭配 reaction to sth (對某事的反應)。"},{"sentence":"The government's quick <target>reaction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the emergency helped save many lives during the severe earthquake.","translation":"政府對緊急情況的快速反應幫助在嚴重地震期間挽救了許多生命。","explanation":"名詞「反應」。常用搭配 quick reaction (快速反應)。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in prices was a direct <target>reaction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the shortage of raw materials in the market.","translation":"價格的突然增加是對市場原物料短缺的直接反應。","explanation":"名詞「反應」。常用搭配 direct reaction to sth (對某事的直接反應)。"}],"related_forms":["react","reactive"]}

{"headword":"reasonable","explanation":"形容詞「合理的；價格適中的」。可用於描述價格、決定或人的行為。注意與 unreasonable 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"After considering all the evidence, the judge reached a <target>reasonable</target> <pattern>conclusion</pattern> that the defendant was not guilty.","translation":"在考慮所有證據後，法官得出了一個合理的結論，認為被告無罪。","explanation":"形容詞「合理的」。常用搭配 reasonable conclusion (合理的結論)。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant is popular among students because it serves high-quality food at a <target>reasonable</target> <pattern>price</pattern>.","translation":"這家餐廳在學生中很受歡迎，因為它以適中的價格提供高品質的食物。","explanation":"形容詞「價格適中的」。常用搭配 reasonable price (適中的價格)。"},{"sentence":"It seems <target>reasonable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> assume that the team will win the game if they continue to practice hard.","translation":"如果球隊繼續努力練習，假設他們會贏得比賽似乎是合理的。","explanation":"形容詞「合理的」。常用句型 It is reasonable to V (做某事是合理的)。"}],"related_forms":["reasonably","reasonableness"]}

{"headword":"receipt","explanation":"名詞「收據；收到」。注意 receipt 作為名詞指收據時，發音中 p 不發音。常用片語 in receipt of (收到)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please keep your <target>receipt</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the electronic device in case you need to return it or claim a warranty.","translation":"請保留電子設備的收據，以防您需要退貨或申請保固。","explanation":"名詞「收據」。常用搭配 receipt for sth (某物的收據)。"},{"sentence":"The company confirmed that they were <pattern>in</pattern> <target>receipt</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the application documents sent by the candidate last week.","translation":"公司確認他們已收到上週由應徵者寄出的申請文件。","explanation":"名詞「收到」。片語 in receipt of sth 表示「收到某物」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"receiver","explanation":"名詞「接收者；電話聽筒」。指接收訊號、訊息或物品的人或設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"The football player was an excellent <target>receiver</target>, catching the ball perfectly every time his teammate threw it to him.","translation":"這名美式足球員是一名出色的接收者，每次隊友將球傳給他時都能完美接球。","explanation":"名詞「接收者」。"},{"sentence":"He slowly <pattern>put</pattern> the <target>receiver</target> <pattern>down</pattern> after the phone call ended, feeling exhausted by the long conversation.","translation":"電話結束後，他緩緩放下聽筒，對漫長的對話感到精疲力竭。","explanation":"名詞「聽筒」。常用搭配 put the receiver down (放下聽筒)。"}],"related_forms":["receive"]}

{"headword":"recognize","explanation":"動詞「認出；承認；認可」。常用片語 recognize as (認作/認可為)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I didn't <target>recognize</target> him <pattern>at</pattern> first because he had changed his hairstyle and was wearing glasses.","translation":"我起初沒認出他，因為他改變了髮型並且戴著眼鏡。","explanation":"動詞「認出」。"},{"sentence":"The school <target>recognizes</target> her <pattern>as</pattern> one of the most hardworking students in the history of the institution.","translation":"學校將她認可為該校歷史上最勤奮的學生之一。","explanation":"動詞「認可/承認」。常用搭配 recognize someone as sth (將某人認可為...)。"},{"sentence":"The government should <target>recognize</target> the <pattern>importance of</pattern> protecting the environment to prevent further climate change.","translation":"政府應該承認保護環境的重要性，以防止進一步的氣候變遷。","explanation":"動詞「承認」。常用搭配 recognize the importance of sth (承認...的重要性)。"}],"related_forms":["recognition","recognizable"]}

{"headword":"recorder","explanation":"名詞「錄音機；直笛」。指記錄聲音的設備或一種樂器。","entries":[{"sentence":"The journalist used a small digital <target>recorder</target> <pattern>to</pattern> capture the interview with the famous scientist more accurately.","translation":"記者使用小型數位錄音機來更準確地記錄與那位著名科學家的訪談。","explanation":"名詞「錄音機」。"},{"sentence":"In the music class, all the students are learning how <pattern>to</pattern> <target>play</target> the <target>recorder</target>, which is a simple wind instrument.","translation":"在音樂課上，所有學生都在學習如何演奏直笛，這是一種簡單的管樂器。","explanation":"名詞「直笛」。常用搭配 play the recorder (演奏直笛)。"}],"related_forms":["record"]}

{"headword": "rectangle", "explanation": "名詞「長方形」。幾何學基本圖形。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher asked the students to <target>draw</target> a <target>rectangle</target> with a length of ten centimeters and a width of five.", "translation": "老師要求學生畫一個長十公分、寬五公分的長方形。", "explanation": "名詞「長方形」。常用搭配 draw a rectangle (畫長方形)。"}], "related_forms": ["rectangular"]}

{"headword":"reduce","explanation":"動詞「減少；降低」。常用片語 reduce to (減少到/降低到)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council plans <pattern>to</pattern> <target>reduce</target> <pattern>the amount of</pattern> plastic waste by encouraging citizens to use reusable bags.","translation":"市議會計畫透過鼓勵市民使用可重複利用的購物袋來減少塑料垃圾的量。","explanation":"動詞「減少」。常用搭配 reduce the amount of sth (減少...的量)。"},{"sentence":"Many stores <target>reduce</target> their prices <pattern>during</pattern> the year-end sale to attract more customers and clear their inventory.","translation":"許多商店在年底特賣會期間降低價格，以吸引更多顧客並清理庫存。","explanation":"動詞「降低」。常用搭配 reduce prices (降低價格)。"},{"sentence":"The company <target>reduced</target> the workforce <pattern>to</pattern> 500 employees <pattern>to</pattern> save money during the economic downturn.","translation":"公司在經濟低迷期間將員工人數減少到500人，以節省資金。","explanation":"動詞片語 reduce to sth (減少到...)。"}],"related_forms":["reduction","reducible"]}

{"headword":"regional","explanation":"形容詞「區域的；地區的」。指特定區域內的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>regional</target> <pattern>office</pattern> of the company handles all the business operations within the northern part of the country.","translation":"公司的區域辦公室負責處理該國北部的所有業務運作。","explanation":"形容詞「區域的」。常用搭配 regional office (區域辦公室)。"},{"sentence":"Many students are interested in studying <target>regional</target> <pattern>languages</pattern> to better understand the local culture and traditions of different areas.","translation":"許多學生對學習區域語言感興趣，以便更好地理解不同地區的當地文化和傳統。","explanation":"形容詞「地區的」。常用搭配 regional languages (區域語言)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>regional</target> <pattern>difference</pattern> in weather patterns makes it difficult for the government to create a single national policy.","translation":"天氣模式的區域差異使得政府很難制定單一的國家政策。","explanation":"形容詞「區域的」。常用搭配 regional difference (區域差異)。"}],"related_forms":["region","regionally"]}

{"headword":"regret","explanation":"動詞「後悔；遺憾」；名詞「後悔；遺憾」。動詞用法：regret doing sth (後悔做了某事), regret to do sth (遺憾地要做某事)。注意兩者區別：前者指對已發生之事的後悔，後者指對即將要告知的不快消息感到遺憾。","entries":[{"sentence":"She deeply <target>regretted</target> <pattern>leaving</pattern> her hometown, as she missed her family and friends more than she had expected.","translation":"她深深地後悔離開她的家鄉，因為她比預期更想念她的家人和朋友。","explanation":"動詞「後悔」。regret doing sth 表示後悔做了某事。"},{"sentence":"We <target>regret</target> <pattern>to inform</pattern> you that your application for the scholarship has been denied due to a high number of applicants.","translation":"我們遺憾地通知您，由於申請人數過多，您的獎學金申請已被拒絕。","explanation":"動詞「遺憾」。regret to do sth 表示遺憾地要告知某事。"},{"sentence":"To his great <target>regret</target>, he failed the final exam because he spent too much time playing video games instead of studying.","translation":"令他非常遺憾的是，他這次期末考沒及格，因為他花太多時間玩電玩而非讀書。","explanation":"名詞「遺憾」。常用搭配 to one's regret (令某人遺憾的是)。"}],"related_forms":["regrettable","regretfully"]}

{"headword":"relax","explanation":"動詞「放鬆；休息」。常用搭配：relax from (從...中放鬆), relax the rules (放寬規則)。注意其名詞形式 relaxation。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a stressful week of exams, the students decided to <target>relax</target> <pattern>by</pattern> listening to music and taking a nap on the weekend.","translation":"在壓力巨大的考試週後，學生們決定在週末透過聽音樂和睡午覺來放鬆。","explanation":"動詞「放鬆」。常用搭配 relax by doing sth。"},{"sentence":"The school administration decided to <target>relax</target> <pattern>the rules</pattern> regarding the dress code, allowing students to wear casual clothes on Fridays.","translation":"學校管理層決定放寬關於服裝規範的規定，允許學生在週五穿便服。","explanation":"動詞「放寬」。指將規則、法律或限制變得不那麼嚴格。"}],"related_forms":["relaxation","relaxed","relaxing"]}

{"headword":"release","explanation":"動詞「釋放；發行；發布」；名詞「釋放；發行；新聞稿」。常用搭配：release from (從...中釋放), release a movie (發行電影)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The zoo decided to <target>release</target> the injured bird <pattern>back into</pattern> the wild after it had fully recovered from its wounds.","translation":"這隻受傷的鳥在傷口完全康復後，動物園決定將其放回野外。","explanation":"動詞「釋放」。指將被囚禁或受傷的動物放回自然環境。"},{"sentence":"The movie studio is planning to <target>release</target> <pattern>a new film</pattern> next month, which is expected to break all previous box office records.","translation":"電影工作室計劃下個月發行一部新電影，預計將打破所有之前的票房紀錄。","explanation":"動詞「發行」。指將產品或作品向大眾公開。"},{"sentence":"The government issued a press <target>release</target> to clarify the new laws and provide more information to the general public.","translation":"政府發布了一份新聞稿，以澄清新法律並提供更多資訊給一般大眾。","explanation":"名詞「新聞稿」。press release 意為新聞稿。"}],"related_forms":["released"]}

{"headword":"reliable","explanation":"形容詞「可靠的」。常考搭配：a reliable source (可靠的來源), reliable information (可靠的資訊)。注意其反義詞 unreliable。","entries":[{"sentence":"When writing a research paper, it is important to use <target>reliable</target> <pattern>sources</pattern> to ensure the accuracy of the information presented.","translation":"在撰寫研究論文時，使用可靠的來源以確保所呈現資訊的準確性是非常重要的。","explanation":"形容詞「可靠的」。指資訊或來源值得信任。"},{"sentence":"My older brother is the most <target>reliable</target> person I know; he always keeps his promises and finishes his work on time.","translation":"我哥哥是我認識最可靠的人；他總是信守承諾並按時完成工作。","explanation":"形容詞「可靠的」。指人的性格可靠，值得信賴。"}],"related_forms":["rely","reliance","reliability"]}

{"headword":"relief","explanation":"名詞「寬慰；解脫；救援」。常用搭配：a sense of relief (一種寬慰感), relief effort (救援行動), relief supplies (救援物資)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When she finally found her lost wallet, she felt a great sense of <target>relief</target>, knowing that her ID and money were safe.","translation":"當她終於找到遺失的錢包時，她感到非常寬慰，因為知道身分證件和金錢都安全。","explanation":"名詞「寬慰」。常用片語 a sense of relief。"},{"sentence":"International organizations provided emergency <target>relief</target> <pattern>supplies</pattern>, such as food and water, to the victims of the earthquake.","translation":"國際組織為地震災民提供了緊急救援物資，如食物和水。","explanation":"名詞「救援」。relief supplies 指救援物資。"},{"sentence":"The government launched a massive <target>relief</target> <pattern>effort</pattern> to rebuild the homes and infrastructure of the affected coastal towns.","translation":"政府發起了大規模的救援行動，以重建受影響沿海城鎮的房屋和基礎設施。","explanation":"名詞「救援」。relief effort 指救援行動。"}],"related_forms":["relieve"]}

{"headword":"religious","explanation":"形容詞「宗教的；虔誠的」。常用搭配：religious beliefs (宗教信仰), religious freedom (宗教自由)。","entries":[{"sentence":"People from different <target>religious</target> <pattern>beliefs</pattern> gathered together to promote peace and understanding among various cultural groups.","translation":"持有不同宗教信仰的人們聚集在一起，以促進不同文化群體之間的和平與理解。","explanation":"形容詞「宗教的」。指與宗教相關的事物。"},{"sentence":"The constitution of the country guarantees <target>religious</target> <pattern>freedom</pattern>, allowing citizens to practice their faith without fear of persecution.","translation":"該國的憲法保證宗教自由，允許公民在沒有恐懼被迫害的情況下實踐他們的信仰。","explanation":"形容詞「宗教的」。religious freedom 意為宗教自由。"},{"sentence":"My grandmother is a very <target>religious</target> woman who attends church every Sunday and spends hours praying for her family.","translation":"我的祖母是一位非常虔誠的女人，每週日都去教堂並花好幾個小時為家人祈禱。","explanation":"形容詞「虔誠的」。指對宗教有強烈信念的人。"}],"related_forms":["religion","religiously"]}

{"headword": "rely", "explanation": "動詞「依賴；依靠」。最重要搭配：rely on/upon sth/sb (依賴某人/某事)。注意與 depend on 的區別：rely 更側重於信任和依賴某人的能力或品質。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <target>rely</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the internet to find information for their school projects, but they must be careful about the sources.", "translation": "translation\":\"許多學生依賴網路來尋找學校專題的資訊，但他們必須對來源保持謹慎。", "explanation": "動詞「依賴」。常用搭配 rely on sth。"}, {"sentence": "In a team project, members must be able to <target>rely</target> <pattern>on</pattern> each other to complete their tasks on time and with quality.", "translation": "在團隊專題中，成員必須能夠互相依賴以按時且高品質地完成他們的任務。", "explanation": "動詞「依賴」。指信任並依賴某人完成某事。"}, {"sentence": "Many elderly people <target>rely</target> <pattern>on</pattern> their children <pattern>for</pattern> emotional support and physical care during their retirement years.", "translation": "許多老年人依賴他們的子女來獲得情感支持和身體照顧。", "explanation": "核心搭配 rely on sb for sth，表示「依賴某人以獲得某事」。"}, {"sentence": "The success of the project <target>relies</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the team's ability to communicate effectively and manage their time properly.", "translation": "專題的成功取決於團隊有效溝通和妥善管理時間的能力。", "explanation": "動詞「依賴/取決於」。"}], "related_forms": ["reliable", "reliance"]}

{"headword":"remain","explanation":"動詞「保持；依然是；剩下」。常用用法：remain + adj. (保持某種狀態), remain to be seen (尚待觀察)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the heavy rain, the students <target>remained</target> <pattern>calm</pattern> and waited patiently for the bus to arrive at the school gate.","translation":"儘管下著大雨，學生們依然保持冷靜，耐心地在校門口等待公車到達。","explanation":"動詞「保持」。remain + 形容詞，表示保持某種狀態。"},{"sentence":"After the party was over, only a few pieces of cake <target>remained</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the table for the guests to take home.","translation":"派對結束後，桌上只剩下幾塊蛋糕讓客人可以帶回家。","explanation":"動詞「剩下」。指某物在大部分被使用或移除後依然存在。"},{"sentence":"Whether the new policy will actually improve student performance <target>remains</target> <pattern>to be seen</pattern>, as we need more data to evaluate it.","translation":"這項新政策是否真的能提高學生的表現，目前尚待觀察，因為我們需要更多數據來評估。","explanation":"動詞片語 remain to be seen 意為「尚待觀察」。"}],"related_forms":["remainder","remaining"]}

{"headword":"remind","explanation":"動詞「提醒；使想起」。常用搭配：remind sb of sth (使某人想起某事), remind sb to do sth (提醒某人做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Could you please <target>remind</target> <pattern>me</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> bring my textbooks to class tomorrow morning, as I often forget them?","translation":"你能請你提醒我明天早上帶教科書來上課嗎？因為我經常忘記。","explanation":"動詞「提醒」。remind sb to do sth 表示提醒某人做某事。"},{"sentence":"The old photograph <target>reminded</target> <pattern>him</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> the wonderful summer vacation he spent with his grandparents in the countryside.","translation":"這張舊照片使他想起了在鄉下與祖父母共度的美好夏季假期。","explanation":"動詞「使想起」。remind sb of sth 表示使某人想起某事。"}],"related_forms":["reminder"]}

{"headword":"remote","explanation":"形容詞「偏遠的；遙遠的；渺茫的」。常用搭配：a remote area (偏遠地區), a remote possibility (渺茫的可能性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The research team traveled to a <target>remote</target> <pattern>village</pattern> in the mountains to study the unique language spoken by the local people.","translation":"研究團隊前往山區一個偏遠的村莊，以研究當地人所說的獨特語言。","explanation":"形容詞「偏遠的」。指地理位置遠離市中心或人群。"},{"sentence":"Although the two teams are very different in skill, there is still a <target>remote</target> <pattern>possibility</pattern> that the underdog will win the game.","translation":"雖然這兩隊的技能差異很大，但弱勢隊伍贏得比賽仍有渺茫的可能性。","explanation":"形容詞「渺茫的」。指可能性非常低。"},{"sentence":"With the help of modern technology, students can now attend classes from <target>remote</target> <pattern>locations</pattern> using high-speed internet and laptops.","translation":"藉由現代科技的幫助，學生現在可以使用高速網路和筆記型電腦從偏遠地區參加課程。","explanation":"形容詞「偏遠的」。指遠離主要中心的地點。"}],"related_forms":["remotely"]}

{"headword":"replace","explanation":"動詞「取代、更換」；名詞 replacement 「替代品、接替人」。常用搭配：replace A with B (用B取代A)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the old laptop was too slow for the new software, the school decided to <target>replace</target> it <pattern>with</pattern> a modern computer.","translation":"由於舊筆記型電腦運行新軟體太慢，學校決定用一台現代電腦來更換它。","explanation":"動詞「更換」。常用搭配 replace A with B。"},{"sentence":"The company is looking for a suitable <target>replacement</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the manager who retired last month, hoping to find someone with similar experience.","translation":"公司正在為上個月退休的經理尋找合適的替代人選，希望找到具有相似經驗的人。","explanation":"名詞「接替人」。常用搭配 replacement for someone。"},{"sentence":"As digital cameras became more popular, they quickly <target>replaced</target> traditional film cameras in the photography market.","translation":"隨著數位相機變得更流行，它們迅速取代了攝影市場中的傳統底片相機。","explanation":"動詞「取代」。指一個事物取代另一個事物。"}],"related_forms":["replacement"]}

{"headword":"represent","explanation":"動詞「代表、象徵」。常用於描述代表某個群體、國家或象徵某種意義。常考搭配：represent a change (代表著一種改變)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council members were chosen to <target>represent</target> their classmates in the meeting with the school principal.","translation":"學生會成員被選出來在與校長的會議中代表他們的同學。","explanation":"動詞「代表」。指代為發言或行動。"},{"sentence":"In many cultures, the white dove is used to <target>represent</target> peace and purity throughout the world.","translation":"在許多文化中，白鴿被用來代表全世界的和平與純潔。","explanation":"動詞「象徵」。指某個符號代表某個抽象概念。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in temperature <target>represents</target> a significant shift in the local climate patterns over the past decade.","translation":"溫度的突然增加代表了過去十年當地氣候模式的重大轉變。","explanation":"動詞「代表、意味著」。指某個現象顯示出某種狀態。"}],"related_forms":["representative","representation"]}

{"headword":"representative","explanation":"形容詞「有代表性的」；名詞「代表、代理人」。常用於描述典型特徵或作為某機構的發言人。常考搭配：a representative sample (有代表性的樣本)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The researcher selected a <target>representative</target> <pattern>sample</pattern> of the population to ensure the survey results were accurate and unbiased.","translation":"研究人員選擇了具有代表性的人口樣本，以確保調查結果準確且公正。","explanation":"形容詞「有代表性的」。常用搭配 representative sample。"},{"sentence":"If you have any problems with the product, you can contact a customer service <target>representative</target> to resolve the issue.","translation":"如果您對產品有任何問題，可以聯繫客服代表來解決問題。","explanation":"名詞「代表」。指被委託處理特定事務的人。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer acted as the legal <target>representative</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the family, handling all the court documents and negotiations.","translation":"律師作為該家庭的法律代表，處理所有法院文件和協商。","explanation":"名詞「代表」。常用搭配 representative for someone。"}],"related_forms":["represent","representation"]}

{"headword":"republic","explanation":"名詞「共和國」。指一種不設君主，由選舉產生領導人的政治體制。注意與 monarchy (君主制) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The historical document explains how the country transitioned from a monarchy to a <target>republic</target> after the revolution.","translation":"這份歷史文件解釋了該國在革命後如何從君主制轉變為共和國。","explanation":"名詞「共和國」。"},{"sentence":"In a democratic <target>republic</target>, citizens have the right to vote for their leaders and participate in the government.","translation":"在一個民主共和國中，公民有權投票選擇他們的領導者並參與政府管理。","explanation":"名詞「共和國」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"request","explanation":"名詞/動詞「請求、要求」。動詞用法常考搭配：request sth from sb (向某人請求某事)；名詞用法常用於 request for (對...的請求)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student sent a formal <target>request</target> <pattern>for</pattern> an extension on the final project deadline due to unexpected illness.","translation":"該學生因意外生病，提交了一份正式的請求，要求延長期末專題的截止日期。","explanation":"名詞「請求」。常用搭配 request for sth。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <target>requested</target> that the students <pattern>remain</pattern> quiet during the exam to avoid distracting others in the classroom.","translation":"老師要求學生在考試期間保持安靜，以避免分心影響教室內的其他人在。","explanation":"動詞「要求」。注意其後的 that 子句中使用原形動詞 (remain)。"},{"sentence":"The visitors <target>requested</target> more information <pattern>from</pattern> the museum guide about the history of the ancient artifacts.","translation":"訪客們向博物館導覽員請求更多關於古代文物的歷史資訊。","explanation":"動詞「請求」。常用搭配 request sth from sb。"}],"related_forms":["requested"]}

{"headword":"reserve","explanation":"動詞「預訂、保留」；名詞「保留地、儲備」。動詞常考搭配：reserve a table/seat (預訂桌位/座位)；名詞常用於 nature reserve (自然保護區)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the restaurant is very popular during the weekends, it is highly recommended to <target>reserve</target> a table in advance.","translation":"由於這家餐廳在週末非常受歡迎，強烈建議提前預訂桌位。","explanation":"動詞「預訂」。"},{"sentence":"The government established a large nature <target>reserve</target> to protect endangered species and preserve the natural habitat of the animals.","translation":"政府建立了一個大型自然保護區，以保護瀕危物種並維護動物的自然棲息地。","explanation":"名詞「保護區」。常用搭配 nature reserve。"},{"sentence":"The athlete decided to <target>reserve</target> some energy <pattern>for</pattern> the final lap of the race to ensure he could win.","translation":"該運動員決定為比賽的最後一圈保留一些體力，以確保他能獲勝。","explanation":"動詞「保留」。指將某物留給特定用途或時間。"},{"sentence":"The company maintains a financial <target>reserve</target> to handle unexpected expenses and ensure the business remains stable during crises.","translation":"公司維持一定的財務儲備，以處理意外開支並確保企業在危機期間保持穩定。","explanation":"名詞「儲備」。"}],"related_forms":["reservation","reserved"]}

{"headword":"resist","explanation":"動詞「抵抗、抵制」。常用搭配：resist the temptation (抵制誘惑)；resist the urge (抵制衝動)。注意與 withstand (承受) 的區別：resist 強調主動地反對或阻止，而 withstand 側重於承受壓力或壓力下不被破壞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the sweet smell of the chocolate cake, the boy tried his best to <target>resist</target> the temptation to eat it.","translation":"儘管巧克力蛋糕的味道很香，男孩還是盡力抵制吃蛋糕的誘惑。","explanation":"動詞「抵制」。常用搭配 resist the temptation。"},{"sentence":"The new material was designed to <target>resist</target> water and heat, making it ideal for outdoor clothing and camping gear.","translation":"這種新材料被設計成防水且耐熱，使其成為戶外服裝和露營裝備的理想選擇。","explanation":"動詞「抵抗」。指物體能承受某種外部影響而不會損壞。"},{"sentence":"Many people in the city <target>resisted</target> the plan to build a new shopping mall, fearing it would destroy the local park.","translation":"市中許多人抵制建新購物中心的計劃，擔心這會摧毀當地公園。","explanation":"動詞「抵抗」。指對某個決定或改變主動反對。"}],"related_forms":["resistance","resistant"]}

{"headword":"resource","explanation":"名詞「資源」。指可利用的資產、金錢、人員或資訊。常用搭配：natural resources (自然資源), human resources (人力資源)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The country is rich in natural <target>resources</target>, such as oil and minerals, which has helped its economy grow rapidly.","translation":"這個國家擁有豐富的自然資源，如石油和礦產，這幫助其經濟快速成長。","explanation":"名詞「資源」。常用搭配 natural resources。"},{"sentence":"The school library provides a wide variety of learning <target>resources</target>, including digital databases and academic journals, for students to use.","translation":"學校圖書館提供多樣化的學習資源，包括數位資料庫和學術期刊，供學生使用。","explanation":"名詞「資源」。指可用於學習的資訊或工具。"},{"sentence":"The company's human <target>resources</target> department is responsible for hiring new employees and managing their training and benefits.","translation":"公司的人力資源部門負責招聘新員工並管理他們的訓練和福利。","explanation":"名詞「資源」。常用搭配 human resources。"}],"related_forms":["resourceful"]}

{"headword":"response","explanation":"名詞「回應、反應」。常用片語：in response to (作為對...的回應)。注意與 reply (回覆) 的區別：response 較為正式，且可用於描述生理或情感上的反應，如 emotional response (情感反應) 或 immune response (免疫反應)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government issued a statement <pattern>in</pattern> <target>response</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the public's concerns about the new environmental laws.","translation":"政府針對公眾對新環境法的擔憂發表了一份聲明，作為回應。","explanation":"名詞片語 in response to... 意為「作為對...的回應」。"},{"sentence":"The patient showed a positive <target>response</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the new medicine, and his condition improved significantly within a week.","translation":"患者對新藥產生了積極的反應，其病情在一個星期內顯著改善。","explanation":"名詞「反應」。常用搭配 response to sth。"},{"sentence":"The teacher was surprised by the students' quick <target>response</target> to the difficult question, as most of them answered correctly.","translation":"老師對學生們對困難問題的快速回應感到驚訝，因為他們大多數都回答正確。","explanation":"名詞「回應」。"}],"related_forms":["respond","responsive"]}

{"headword":"responsibility","explanation":"名詞「責任、職責」。常用搭配：take responsibility for (為...承擔責任), a sense of responsibility (責任感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the class president, it is his <target>responsibility</target> to organize the class meetings and ensure everyone's voice is heard.","translation":"作為班長，組織班級會議並確保每個人的聲音被聽到是他的職責。","explanation":"名詞「職責」。指被賦予的任務。"},{"sentence":"The driver admitted that it was his <target>responsibility</target> to avoid the accident, but he <pattern>took</pattern> full <target>responsibility</target> <pattern>for</pattern> it.","translation":"駕駛員承認避免事故是他的責任，但他為此承擔了全部責任。","explanation":"名詞「責任」。常用搭配 take responsibility for sth。"},{"sentence":"Parents should encourage their children to develop a strong <pattern>sense</pattern> <target>of</target> <target>responsibility</target> by giving them small chores to do at home.","translation":"父母應該鼓勵孩子通過在家庭中分擔小家務來培養強烈的責任感。","explanation":"名詞片語 a sense of responsibility 意為「責任感」。"}],"related_forms":["responsible"]}

{"headword":"restrict","explanation":"動詞「限制；限定」。常用搭配 restrict A to B (將 A 限制在 B 範圍內)。注意與 limit 的區別：restrict 較常用於法律、規則或物理上的限制。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>restrict</target> <pattern>access to</pattern> the computer lab after 6 p.m. to ensure that the facility is properly maintained.","translation":"學校決定限制晚上六點後進入電腦實驗室，以確保設施得到妥善維護。","explanation":"動詞「限制」。常用搭配 restrict access to sth。"},{"sentence":"Due to the strict dietary guidelines, the patient had to <target>restrict</target> his <pattern>intake of</pattern> sugar and salt to improve his health.","translation":"由於嚴格的飲食指南，患者必須限制糖分和鹽分的攝取量以改善健康。","explanation":"動詞「限制」。常用搭配 restrict the intake of sth。"},{"sentence":"The government may <target>restrict</target> the number of tourists visiting the fragile coral reef <pattern>to</pattern> prevent further environmental damage.","translation":"政府可能會限制造訪脆弱珊瑚礁的遊客數量，以防止進一步的環境破壞。","explanation":"動詞「限制」。常用搭配 restrict sth to a certain number/amount。"}],"related_forms":["restriction","restrictive"]}

{"headword":"reveal","explanation":"動詞「揭露；透露」。指將原本隱藏或秘密的事物展現出來。常見搭配 reveal the truth (揭露真相), reveal a secret (洩漏秘密)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective's careful investigation eventually <target>revealed</target> the truth about the missing painting, shocking everyone in the city.","translation":"偵探仔細的調查最終揭露了關於失蹤畫作的真相，讓全城的人都感到震驚。","explanation":"動詞「揭露」。常用於揭開秘密或真相。"},{"sentence":"The company is expected to <target>reveal</target> its latest smartphone model during the annual technology conference next month.","translation":"該公司預計將在下個月的年度科技會議上揭曉其最新的智慧型手機機型。","explanation":"動詞「透露/公開」。指將新產品或計畫首次展現給大眾。"},{"sentence":"Despite her efforts to remain calm, her trembling hands <target>revealed</target> how nervous she actually felt before the big presentation.","translation":"儘管她努力保持冷靜，但她顫抖的雙手透露了她在重大簡報前實際上有多緊張。","explanation":"動詞「透露」。指無意中展現出真實的情緒或狀態。"}],"related_forms":["revelation","revealing"]}

{"headword":"ribbon","explanation":"名詞「緞帶；絲帶」。常用於裝飾或禮物包裝。常用搭配 tie with a ribbon (用緞帶繫住)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The girl carefully tied a red <target>ribbon</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the gift box to make it look more attractive for her mother's birthday.","translation":"女孩小心地在禮物盒上繫了一條紅緞帶，讓它在母親生日時看起來更吸引人。","explanation":"名詞「緞帶」。"},{"sentence":"The mayor held a pair of golden scissors to cut the <target>ribbon</target> during the opening ceremony of the new community library.","translation":"市長在社區新圖書館的開幕典禮上拿著一把金剪刀剪綵。","explanation":"名詞「緞帶」。cut the ribbon 是指開幕剪綵。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"rid","explanation":"形容詞「擺脫的」；動詞「使擺脫」。最常用於片語 get rid of (擺脫/除掉)。注意 rid 是不規則動詞，過去式和過去分詞均為 rid。","entries":[{"sentence":"To create more space in her small bedroom, Sarah decided to <pattern>get</pattern> <target>rid</target> <pattern>of</pattern> all her old textbooks and clothes.","translation":"為了在她的小臥室裡創造更多空間，莎拉決定扔掉所有舊教科書和衣服。","explanation":"動詞片語 get rid of 表示「擺脫/除掉」。"},{"sentence":"The city council is trying to find a permanent way to <pattern>get</pattern> <target>rid</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the stray cats that wander around the park.","translation":"市議會正試圖尋找一個永久的方法來清除在公園周圍遊蕩的流浪貓。","explanation":"動詞片語 get rid of 表示「除掉」。"},{"sentence":"After using a special cleaning solution, he finally <pattern>got</pattern> <target>rid</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the stubborn stains on his white shirt.","translation":"在使用了一種特殊的清潔溶液後，他終於去除了白色襯衫上頑固的污漬。","explanation":"動詞片語 get rid of 表示「去除」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ripe","explanation":"形容詞「成熟的」。常用於描述水果、農作物。比喻用法指「時機成熟」。常用搭配 be ripe for (適合...的/時機成熟的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer told us that the mangoes would be <target>ripe</target> and ready for harvest by the end of next week.","translation":"農夫告訴我們，芒果將在下週結束前成熟並可以採收。","explanation":"形容詞「成熟的」。描述水果狀態。"},{"sentence":"You should wait until the bananas are fully <target>ripe</target> and have a few brown spots before using them to make banana bread.","translation":"在用香蕉做香蕉麵包之前，你應該等到香蕉完全成熟且出現幾個褐斑。","explanation":"形容詞「成熟的」。"},{"sentence":"After years of planning and preparation, the company felt that the market was <target>ripe</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a new type of eco-friendly energy product.","translation":"經過多年的規劃與準備，公司認為市場已經為一種新型環保能源產品準備就緒（時機成熟）。","explanation":"形容詞「時機成熟的」。片語 be ripe for sth。"}],"related_forms":["ripen","ripeness"]}

{"headword":"risk","explanation":"名詞「風險」；動詞「冒險」。常用搭配 take a risk (冒險), at risk (處於危險中), run the risk of (有...的風險)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young entrepreneurs are willing to <pattern>take</pattern> a <target>risk</target> by starting their own businesses instead of looking for a stable job.","translation":"許多年輕創業家願意冒險創立自己的公司，而不是尋找一份穩定的工作。","explanation":"名詞「風險」。片語 take a risk 表示「冒險」。"},{"sentence":"If you do not wear a helmet while riding a bicycle, you <pattern>run</pattern> the <target>risk</target> <pattern>of</pattern> suffering a serious head injury in an accident.","translation":"如果你騎自行車時不戴頭盔，你在發生事故時就有遭受嚴重頭部受傷的風險。","explanation":"名詞「風險」。片語 run the risk of V-ing 表示「有...的風險」。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists warn that many rare species are <pattern>at</pattern> <target>risk</target> of extinction due to the loss of their natural habitats.","translation":"環境保護主義者警告說，由於自然棲息地的喪失，許多稀有物種正處於滅絕的危險之中。","explanation":"名詞「風險」。片語 at risk 表示「處於危險之中」。"},{"sentence":"The climber decided to <target>risk</target> the dangerous weather conditions to reach the mountain peak before the sun set.","translation":"登山者決定冒著危險的天氣條件，在太陽下山前到達山頂。","explanation":"動詞「冒險」。"}],"related_forms":["risky"]}

{"headword":"roar","explanation":"名詞/動詞「吼叫；咆哮」。可用於動物（如獅子）或大自然的聲音（如海浪、風）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists were terrified when they heard the powerful <target>roar</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a lion echoing through the safari park.","translation":"當遊客們聽到獅子強而有力的吼聲在野生動物園中迴盪時，他們感到非常恐懼。","explanation":"名詞「吼叫」。"},{"sentence":"As the wave crashed against the shore, its loud <target>roar</target> could be heard from a great distance, warning people to stay away.","translation":"當海浪拍擊岸邊時，其巨大的咆哮聲在很遠的地方都能聽到，警告人們遠離。","explanation":"名詞「咆哮」。"},{"sentence":"The crowd began to <target>roar</target> with excitement when the home team scored the winning goal in the final seconds of the game.","translation":"當主隊在比賽最後幾秒攻入致勝球時，人群開始興奮地歡呼（咆哮）。","explanation":"動詞「吼叫/歡呼」。"}],"related_forms":["roaring"]}

{"headword":"roast","explanation":"形容詞「烤的」；名詞「烤肉」；動詞「烤」。常用於描述用高溫烘烤的食物，如 roast chicken (烤雞), roast beef (烤牛肉)。","entries":[{"sentence":"For the family gathering on Thanksgiving, my grandmother prepared a large <target>roast</target> turkey with a side of cranberry sauce.","translation":"為了感恩節的家庭聚會，我的祖母準備了一隻大烤火雞，並配上蔓越莓醬。","explanation":"形容詞「烤的」。"},{"sentence":"The chef taught the students how to <target>roast</target> vegetables in the oven to bring out their natural sweetness and flavor.","translation":"主廚教學生如何用烤箱烤蔬菜，以激發其天然的甜味和風味。","explanation":"動詞「烤」。"},{"sentence":"We ordered a plate of <target>roast</target> beef with gravy, which was tender and juicy, making it the most popular dish on the menu.","translation":"我們點了一盤配有肉汁的烤牛肉，口感鮮嫩多汁，是菜單上最受歡迎的菜餚。","explanation":"名詞「烤肉」。"}],"related_forms":["roasting","roaster"]}

{"headword":"rob","explanation":"動詞「搶劫」。注意rob 的對象是「人」或「地點」(rob someone/some place)，而 steal 的對象是「被偷的東西」(steal something)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Two masked men attempted to <target>rob</target> the local bank last Friday, but the police arrived quickly and arrested them.","translation":"上週五，兩名蒙面男子企圖搶劫當地銀行，但警察迅速趕到並將他們逮捕。","explanation":"動詞「搶劫」。對象是地點 (bank)。"},{"sentence":"The tourist was <target>robbed</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his wallet and passport while he was walking through the crowded night market.","translation":"這名遊客在逛擁擠的夜市時，錢包和護照被搶走了。","explanation":"動詞「搶劫」。常用片語 rob someone of sth (搶走某人的某物)。"},{"sentence":"The witness described the suspects who <target>robbed</target> the jewelry store, providing the police with important clues about their appearance.","translation":"證人描述了搶劫珠寶店的嫌疑人，為警方提供了關於他們外貌的重要線索。","explanation":"動詞「搶劫」。對象是地點 (jewelry store)。"}],"related_forms":["robber","robbery"]}

{"headword":"robbery","explanation":"名詞「搶劫案」。指非法使用暴力或恐嚇手段奪取財產的行為。常用搭配 commit a robbery (犯搶劫罪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are currently reviewing the security camera footage to identify the individuals who committed the <target>robbery</target> at the convenience store.","translation":"警方目前正在查看監視器畫面，以辨識在便利商店犯下搶劫案的人。","explanation":"名詞「搶劫案」。片語 commit a robbery 表示「犯搶劫罪」。"},{"sentence":"After the armed <target>robbery</target> occurred in the neighborhood, many residents felt the need for more police patrols at night.","translation":"在社區發生持械搶劫案後，許多居民覺得晚上需要更多的警察巡邏。","explanation":"名詞「搶劫案」。"}],"related_forms":["rob","robber"]}

{"headword":"robe","explanation":"名詞「長袍、禮袍」。常用於描述正式場合、宗教儀式或在浴室穿著的舒適長袍。","entries":[{"sentence":"The judge entered the courtroom wearing a black <target>robe</target>, which symbolized the authority and impartiality of the legal system.","translation":"法官穿著一件黑色長袍進入法庭，象徵著法律系統的權威與公正。","explanation":"名詞「長袍」。指正式場合穿著的長袍。"},{"sentence":"After taking a warm bath, she put on a soft white <target>robe</target> to stay warm while getting ready for bed.","translation":"洗完熱水澡後，她穿上一件柔軟的白色浴袍，以便在準備睡覺時保持溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「浴袍」。"}],"related_forms":["robes"]}

{"headword":"rocket","explanation":"名詞「火箭」，動詞「迅速上升」。名詞用法最為常見，指用於太空探索或軍事用途的飛行裝置。","entries":[{"sentence":"The space agency successfully launched a <target>rocket</target> to explore Mars, hoping to find evidence of ancient life on the red planet.","translation":"太空機構成功發射了一枚火箭去探索火星，希望能發現紅行星上古代生命的證據。","explanation":"名詞「火箭」。"},{"sentence":"The price of gold <target>rocketed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> after the sudden economic crisis, causing concern among investors worldwide.","translation":"在突然的經濟危機後，金價迅速飆升，引起了全球投資者的關注。","explanation":"動詞「迅速上升」。常用搭配：rocket up。"}],"related_forms":["rockets"]}

{"headword":"romantic","explanation":"形容詞「浪漫的」；名詞「浪漫的人」。形容詞用法最常見，指充滿情感、理想化或與愛情相關的事物。注意與 romance (名詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The couple enjoyed a <target>romantic</target> dinner by the beach, with candles and soft music creating a peaceful atmosphere.","translation":"這對夫婦在海邊享用了一頓浪漫的晚餐，燭光與柔和的音樂營造出寧靜的氛圍。","explanation":"形容詞「浪漫的」。"},{"sentence":"Although he is a <target>romantic</target> at heart, he usually tries to be practical when making important life decisions.","translation":"雖然他內心是一個浪漫的人，但他做重要的人生決定時通常試圖保持務實。","explanation":"名詞「浪漫的人」。"}],"related_forms":["romance","romantically"]}

{"headword":"rot","explanation":"動詞「腐爛」；名詞「腐爛」。指有機物質因細菌或真菌作用而分解。常用於描述食物或植物。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you leave the fruit <target>rot</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the sun for too long, it will soon become soft and smell unpleasant.","translation":"如果你將水果在陽光下放置太久讓其腐爛，它很快會變軟並散發出不愉快的氣味。","explanation":"動詞「腐爛」。"},{"sentence":"The old wooden fence had begun to <target>rot</target> because of the constant rain and high humidity of the tropical climate.","translation":"由於熱帶氣候持續的降雨和高濕度，這座舊木圍欄已經開始腐爛。","explanation":"動詞「腐爛」。"},{"sentence":"The inspectors found significant <target>rot</target> in the support beams of the ancient building, making it unsafe for the public to enter.","translation":"檢查員在古老建築的支撐樑中發現了嚴重的腐爛，使得公眾進入其中並不安全。","explanation":"名詞「腐爛」。"}],"related_forms":["rotted","rotting"]}

{"headword": "rotten", "explanation": "形容詞「腐爛的、糟糕的」。除了指食物腐爛外，還常用於比喻指人的品格糟糕或情況極其糟糕。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The smell of <target>rotten</target> eggs filled the kitchen after the refrigerator broke down and the food inside spoiled.", "translation": "冰箱故障後，廚房裡充滿了臭雞蛋的味道，因為裡面的食物腐壞了。", "explanation": "形容詞「腐爛的」。常用搭配：rotten eggs (臭雞蛋)。"}, {"sentence": "He felt that he had <target>rotten</target> luck this week because he lost his wallet and failed two important exams.", "translation": "他覺得這週運氣極差，因為他丟了錢包且兩門重要考試不及格。", "explanation": "形容詞「糟糕的」。比喻用法。"}], "related_forms": ["rot"]}

{"headword":"rough","explanation":"形容詞「粗糙的、艱難的、大致的」；副詞「粗魯地」；名詞「草圖」。用法多樣，需根據上下文判斷。","entries":[{"sentence":"The worker used sandpaper to smooth out the <target>rough</target> <pattern>surface</pattern> of the wooden table before painting it.","translation":"工人用砂紙磨平木桌的粗糙表面，然後才對其進行上漆。","explanation":"形容詞「粗糙的」。常用搭配：rough surface (粗糙表面)。"},{"sentence":"Many students find the first few weeks of university life <target>rough</target> as they struggle to adapt to the new environment.","translation":"許多學生發現大學生活的頭幾週很艱難，因為他們努力適應新環境。","explanation":"形容詞「艱難的」。"},{"sentence":"The captain warned the passengers that the sea would be <target>rough</target> today, so they should stay seated and hold on tight.","translation":"船長警告乘客今天海面會波濤洶湧，因此他們應該留在座位上並抓穩。","explanation":"形容詞「波濤洶湧的」。"},{"sentence":"Before writing the final essay, she made a <target>rough</target> <pattern>draft</pattern> to organize her main ideas and arguments logically.","translation":"在撰寫最終論文前，她先寫了一份草稿，以便將主要想法和論點邏輯地組織起來。","explanation":"形容詞「大致的」。常用搭配：rough draft (草稿)。"},{"sentence":"The artist drew a <target>rough</target> sketch of the landscape, capturing only the basic shapes and colors of the mountains.","translation":"藝術家畫了一幅風景的草圖，僅捕捉山脈的基本形狀和顏色。","explanation":"名詞「草圖」。"}],"related_forms":["roughly"]}

{"headword":"roughly","explanation":"副詞「大約、粗略地」。常用於描述數量或程度，與 approximately 同義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher estimated that <target>roughly</target> eighty percent of the students had completed the assignment on time.","translation":"老師估計大約百分之八十的學生準時完成了作業。","explanation":"副詞「大約」。用於描述數量。"},{"sentence":"The rough sketch was <target>roughly</target> drawn, but it clearly showed the basic structure of the building the architect planned.","translation":"這幅草圖畫得很粗略，但它清楚地顯示了建築師所規劃的建築基本結構。","explanation":"副詞「粗略地」。"}],"related_forms":["rough"]}

{"headword":"routine","explanation":"名詞「常規、例行公事」；形容詞「例行的、慣常的」。常用於描述每天重複的活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"Establishing a morning <target>routine</target> of exercise and meditation helps many students stay focused and energetic throughout the day.","translation":"建立早晨運動和冥想的例行公事，能幫助許多學生在一天中保持專注和精力充沛。","explanation":"名詞「常規」。"},{"sentence":"The pilot performed a <target>routine</target> <pattern>check</pattern> of the aircraft's systems before takeoff to ensure everything was functioning correctly.","translation":"飛行員在起飛前對飛機系統進行了例行檢查，以確保一切運作正常。","explanation":"形容詞「例行的」。常用搭配：routine check (例行檢查)。"},{"sentence":"She felt bored with her daily <target>routine</target> and decided to travel to a foreign country to experience something new.","translation":"她對每天的例行公事感到厭倦，決定去國外旅行以體驗新事物。","explanation":"名詞「常規」。"}],"related_forms":["routinely"]}

{"headword":"rug","explanation":"名詞「小地毯」。通常指覆蓋地板一部分的小塊地毯，與 carpet (大地毯/全室地毯) 有所區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family placed a colorful <target>rug</target> in the living room to make the space feel warmer and more welcoming.","translation":"這家人在客廳鋪了一塊彩色小地毯，使空間感覺更溫暖且更溫馨。","explanation":"名詞「小地毯」。"},{"sentence":"She accidentally spilled coffee on the white <target>rug</target>, and spent the whole afternoon trying to clean the stain.","translation":"她不小心將咖啡灑在白色小地毯上，花了一整個下午試圖清除污漬。","explanation":"名詞「小地毯」。"}],"related_forms":["rugs"]}

{"headword":"rumor","explanation":"名詞「謠言」；動詞「傳言」。常用片語 spread a rumor (散佈謠言), hear a rumor (聽到謠言)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school principal decided to address the <target>rumor</target> directly to stop the students from spreading false information about the exam.","translation":"校長決定直接處理這個謠言，以防止學生散佈關於考試的錯誤資訊。","explanation":"名詞「謠言」。"},{"sentence":"I <pattern>heard</pattern> a <target>rumor</target> that the famous singer would visit our school during the graduation ceremony, but it was not confirmed.","translation":"我聽到一個傳言，說那位著名歌手會在畢業典禮期間訪問我們學校，但尚未得到證實。","explanation":"名詞「謠言」。常用搭配：hear a rumor (聽到傳言)。"},{"sentence":"Some people tried to <pattern>spread</pattern> <target>rumors</target> about the competitor's product to lower its reputation in the market.","translation":"有些人試圖散佈關於競爭對手產品的謠言，以降低其在市場上的聲譽。","explanation":"名詞「謠言」。常用搭配：spread rumors (散佈謠言)。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>rumored</target> that the old mansion on the hill is haunted by ghosts, although no one has ever proven it.","translation":"動詞「傳言」。此處為被動語態 rumored that... (據傳...)。","explanation":"動詞「傳言」。"}],"related_forms":["rumors"]}
