{"headword":"rush","explanation":"動詞「衝、趕」。名詞「匆忙、衝擊」。注意動詞片語 rush into (倉促決定) 或 rush to (趕往)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the bus was leaving in five minutes, he had to <target>rush</target> to the station to avoid missing his train.","translation":"由於公車五分鐘後就開車，他必須趕往車站，以免錯過火車。","explanation":"動詞「趕」。常用搭配 rush to a place。"},{"sentence":"The teacher advised the students not to <target>rush</target> <pattern>into</pattern> making a decision about their college majors without careful research.","translation":"老師建議學生在沒有仔細研究的情況下，不要倉促決定大學專業。","explanation":"動詞片語 rush into sth 表示「倉促決定某事」。"},{"sentence":"During the morning <target>rush</target>, the subway stations are often crowded with people trying to get to work on time.","translation":"在早晨的尖峰時段，地鐵站通常擠滿了試圖準時上班的人。","explanation":"名詞「匆忙、尖峰」。常用搭配 morning rush (早晨尖峰時段)。"},{"sentence":"The emergency room was in a <target>rush</target> as doctors and nurses worked quickly to treat the patients after the major accident.","translation":"急診室陷入了一陣匆忙之中，醫生和護士在重大事故後迅速地為病人治療。","explanation":"名詞「匆忙」。"}],"related_forms":["rushed"]}

{"headword":"rust","explanation":"名詞「鐵鏽」。動詞「生鏽」。常用於描述金屬氧化過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old bicycle had been left in the rain for weeks, and now the chain is covered in <target>rust</target> and cannot move.","translation":"這輛舊單車在雨中放了幾週，現在鏈條上佈滿了鐵鏽，無法移動。","explanation":"名詞「鐵鏽」。"},{"sentence":"To prevent the iron fence from <target>rusting</target>, the homeowner decided to paint it with a thick layer of protective coating.","translation":"為了防止鐵欄杆生鏽，屋主決定在上面刷一層厚厚的保護漆。","explanation":"動詞「生鏽」。"}],"related_forms":["rusty"]}

{"headword":"sack","explanation":"名詞「大袋子」或「解僱」。注意動詞片語 get the sack (被解僱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmers carried a heavy <target>sack</target> <pattern>of</pattern> potatoes from the field to the storage room using a wooden cart.","translation":"農民用木車將一袋沉重的馬鈴薯從田裡運到儲藏室。","explanation":"名詞「大袋子」。常用搭配 a sack of sth。"},{"sentence":"After being late for work for the third time this month, the employee was afraid that he might <pattern>get</pattern> the <target>sack</target> from his boss.","translation":"這個月第三次上班遲到後，該員工擔心他可能會被老闆解僱。","explanation":"名詞「解僱」。片語 get the sack 表示「被解僱」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sake","explanation":"名詞「緣故、目的」。最常用於片語 for the sake of (為了...的緣故/利益)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The parents decided to move to a quieter neighborhood for the <target>sake</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their children's education and well-being.","translation":"為了孩子們的教育和福祉，父母決定搬到一個更安靜的社區。","explanation":"名詞「緣故」。常用片語 for the sake of sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"For the <target>sake</target> <pattern>of</pattern> clarity, the professor used simple diagrams and examples to explain the complex scientific theory.","translation":"為了清晰起見，教授使用簡單的圖表和例子來解釋複雜的科學理論。","explanation":"名詞「目的/緣故」。常用於 for the sake of clarity (為了清晰起見)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"salary","explanation":"名詞「薪水」。通常指按月或按年計算的固定薪資，與 wage (時薪/週薪) 不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"After graduating from university, she was happy to receive a competitive <target>salary</target> from the international marketing firm.","translation":"大學畢業後，她很高興能從這家國際行銷公司獲得具有競爭力的薪水。","explanation":"名詞「薪水」。常用搭配 competitive salary (具競爭力的薪水)。"},{"sentence":"The employees demanded a <target>salary</target> increase to keep up with the rising cost of living in the big city.","translation":"員工們要求調薪，以跟上大城市中不斷上升的生活成本。","explanation":"名詞「薪水」。常用搭配 salary increase (加薪)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"satisfactory","explanation":"形容詞「令人滿意的」。指達到基本要求或標準的狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's essay was <target>satisfactory</target>, but the teacher suggested that he could improve his arguments with more evidence.","translation":"這個學生的作文令人滿意，但老師建議他可以用更多證據來增強論點。","explanation":"形容詞「令人滿意的」。"},{"sentence":"The company provided a <target>satisfactory</target> explanation for the delay in shipping the products, which calmed the angry customers.","translation":"公司對產品配送延遲提供了令人滿意的解釋，這讓憤怒的顧客冷靜下來。","explanation":"形容詞「令人滿意的」。"}],"related_forms":["satisfactorily","satisfaction"]}

{"headword":"sauce","explanation":"名詞「醬汁」。用於增加食物味道的液體調味料。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef added a special tomato <target>sauce</target> to the pasta, giving it a rich and savory flavor that everyone loved.","translation":"廚師在義大利麵中加入了一種特殊的番茄醬汁，賦予其濃郁且鹹鮮的味道，每個人都非常喜歡。","explanation":"名詞「醬汁」。"},{"sentence":"Many people enjoy dipping their fried chicken <pattern>in</pattern> a spicy <target>sauce</target> to make the meal more exciting.","translation":"許多人喜歡將炸雞沾在辣醬中，讓餐點更令人興奮。","explanation":"名詞「醬汁」。常用搭配 dip in sauce。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"saucer","explanation":"名詞「茶碟、小碟子」。通常指放在茶杯底下的碟子。","entries":[{"sentence":"The guest accidentally knocked over the tea cup, and tea spilled <pattern>onto</pattern> the <target>saucer</target> before flowing onto the table.","translation":"客人不小心撞翻了茶杯，茶水灑在茶碟上，然後流到了桌子上。","explanation":"名詞「茶碟」。"},{"sentence":"She placed a small piece of chocolate on the <target>saucer</target> next to her cup of coffee as a little treat.","translation":"她將一小塊巧克力放在咖啡杯旁的茶碟上，作為一個小獎勵。","explanation":"名詞「茶碟」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sausage","explanation":"名詞「香腸」。一種將碎肉填入腸衣中的肉類產品。","entries":[{"sentence":"For breakfast, the students enjoyed grilled <target>sausages</target> and scrambled eggs, which gave them energy for the school day.","translation":"早餐時，學生們享用了烤香腸和炒蛋，讓他們在校日有足夠的能量。","explanation":"名詞「香腸」。"},{"sentence":"The butcher prepared a variety of <target>sausages</target> with different flavors, including spicy and garlic versions, for the local food festival.","translation":"屠夫為當地的美食節準備了各種口味的香腸，包括辣味和蒜味版本。","explanation":"名詞「香腸」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "savings", "explanation": "名詞「存款」。通常使用複數形式 savings 時指儲蓄的錢。單數 saving 指「節省」或「折扣」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She decided to use all her life <target>savings</target> to start her own small bakery in the center of the city.", "translation": "她決定到使用她一生的儲蓄來在市中心開一家自己的小麵包店。", "explanation": "名詞「存款」。常用搭配 life savings。"}, {"sentence": "By switching to energy-efficient light bulbs, the family managed to achieve a significant <target>saving</target> <pattern>on</pattern> their monthly electricity bill.", "translation": "透過更換為節能燈泡，這家人成功地在每月電費上節省了可觀的金額。", "explanation": "名詞「節省」。常用搭配 saving on sth。"}], "related_forms": ["save"]}

{"headword":"scale","explanation":"名詞有多種含義：1. 「規模、程度」；2. 「尺度、比例」；3. 「天平、秤」；4. 「魚鱗、鱗片」。注意 scale as a measurement tool 通常使用複數 scales。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to increase the <target>scale</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the rescue operation to ensure that every missing person was found quickly.","translation":"政府決定擴大救援行動的規模，以確保每一位失蹤者都能被迅速找到。","explanation":"名詞「規模、程度」。常用搭配：scale of sth。"},{"sentence":"Architects use a specific <target>scale</target> <pattern>on</pattern> their blueprints to represent large buildings accurately on a small piece of paper.","translation":"建築師在藍圖上使用特定的比例，以便在小張紙上準確地呈現大型建築物。","explanation":"名詞「比例、尺度」。常用搭配：on a scale of... (在...的比例下)。"},{"sentence":"The chef placed the ingredients on the digital <target>scales</target> to measure the exact amount of flour needed for the cake recipe.","translation":"廚師將食材放在電子秤上，以測量蛋糕食譜所需的精確面粉量。","explanation":"名詞「秤、天平」。指測量重量的工具，通常用複數形式 scales。"},{"sentence":"Biologists observed that the shiny <target>scales</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the fish helped it blend in with the sunlight reflecting off the water.","translation":"生物學家觀察到魚的閃亮鱗片有助於它與水面反射的陽光融為一體。","explanation":"名詞「鱗片」。常用搭配：scales of a fish/reptile。"}],"related_forms":["scaling"]}

{"headword":"scarce","explanation":"形容詞「缺乏的、稀少的」。指某物數量不足，無法滿足需求。常用於描述資源、食物或機會。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the severe drought, fresh water became <target>scarce</target>, forcing the villagers to travel long distances to find a reliable well.","translation":"在嚴重的乾旱期間，淡水變得稀少，迫使村民們長途跋涉去尋找一口可靠的水井。","explanation":"形容詞「稀少的」。指資源不足。"},{"sentence":"Qualified teachers are <target>scarce</target> <pattern>in</pattern> rural areas, which often leads to a lower quality of education for students in those regions.","translation":"偏鄉地區缺乏合格的教師，這往往導致那些地區學生的教育品質較低。","explanation":"形容詞「缺乏的」。常用搭配：scarce in/at a place。"}],"related_forms":["scarcity","scarcely"]}

{"headword":"scarf","explanation":"名詞「圍巾」。常用於冬季保暖或作為時尚配件。","entries":[{"sentence":"She wrapped a thick wool <target>scarf</target> <pattern>around</pattern> her neck to protect herself from the biting cold wind during the winter trip.","translation":"她在冬天旅行時將一條厚羊毛圍巾圍在脖子上，以保護自己免受刺骨寒風的侵襲。","explanation":"名詞「圍巾」。常用搭配：wrap a scarf around one's neck。"},{"sentence":"The flight attendant wore a colorful silk <target>scarf</target> as part of her professional uniform, adding a touch of elegance to her look.","translation":"空服員穿著一件色彩繽紛的絲巾作為專業制服的一部分，為她的外貌增添了一抹優雅。","explanation":"名詞「絲巾」。"}],"related_forms":["scarves"]}

{"headword":"scary","explanation":"形容詞「可怕的、令人恐懼的」。指讓人感到害怕的事物或情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students felt it was <target>scary</target> <pattern>to</pattern> walk through the dark, abandoned building during the school's annual ghost story night.","translation":"學生們覺得在學校年度鬼故事之夜走過那棟黑暗且廢棄的建築非常可怕。","explanation":"形容詞「可怕的」。常用搭配：it is scary to V。"},{"sentence":"Watching a <target>scary</target> <pattern>movie</pattern> with friends can be an exciting experience, as long as you don't watch it alone at midnight.","translation":"與朋友一起看恐怖電影可能是一種刺激的體驗，只要你不是在午夜單獨觀看。","explanation":"形容詞「可怕的」。常用搭配：scary movie (恐怖電影)。"}],"related_forms":["scare","scared"]}

{"headword":"scatter","explanation":"動詞「撒、散佈；驅散」。名詞「零星、分散」。常用於描述物體隨機分佈或人群被驅散的情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer <target>scattered</target> the seeds <pattern>across</pattern> the field by hand, hoping that the spring rains would help them grow quickly.","translation":"農夫用手將種子撒在田野上，希望春雨能幫助它們快速生長。","explanation":"動詞「撒、分佈」。常用搭配：scatter sth across/over sth。"},{"sentence":"When the alarm suddenly went off, the crowd of protesters <target>scattered</target> <pattern>in</pattern> all directions to avoid being caught by the police.","translation":"當警報突然響起時，抗議人群向四方散開，以避免被警察抓住。","explanation":"動詞「驅散、四散」。常用搭配：scatter in all directions。"},{"sentence":"There were only a <target>scatter</target> <pattern>of</pattern> clouds in the bright blue sky, making it a perfect day for the school's outdoor sports meet.","translation":"明亮的藍天中只有零星的雲朵，這使得今天成為學校戶外運動會的完美日子。","explanation":"名詞「零星、少量」。常用搭配：a scatter of sth。"}],"related_forms":["scattering"]}

{"headword":"scholar","explanation":"名詞「學者」。指在特定學科領域有深厚知識並從事研究的人。注意與 scholarship (獎學金) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university invited a world-renowned <target>scholar</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ancient history to give a special lecture on the lost civilizations of Egypt.","translation":"大學邀請了一位世界聞名的古代歷史學者來就埃及失落文明發表特別演講。","explanation":"名詞「學者」。常用搭配：scholar of sth (某領域的學者)。"},{"sentence":"After years of intensive study and research, she finally became a respected <target>scholar</target> in the field of environmental science.","translation":"經過多年的密集學習與研究，她終於成為環境科學領域一名受人尊敬的學者。","explanation":"名詞「學者」。"}],"related_forms":["scholarly","scholarship"]}

{"headword":"scholarship","explanation":"名詞「獎學金」或「學問」。在 GSAT 語境中，最常考的是「獎學金」，指為了支持學生學習而提供的金錢資助。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because of her outstanding academic performance, the girl was awarded a full <target>scholarship</target> <pattern>to</pattern> study at a top university in the United States.","translation":"由於其卓越的學業表現，這名女孩被授予全額獎學金前往美國頂尖大學就讀。","explanation":"名詞「獎學金」。常用搭配：award a scholarship to someone。"},{"sentence":"Many students apply for a <target>scholarship</target> <pattern>to</pattern> reduce the financial burden on their parents while pursuing their higher education.","translation":"許多學生申請獎學金，以便在追求高等教育時減輕父母的財務負擔。","explanation":"名詞「獎學金」。常用搭配：apply for a scholarship。"}],"related_forms":["scholar"]}

{"headword":"scientific","explanation":"形容詞「科學的」。指基於科學方法、實驗或系統化知識的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"Researchers used a <target>scientific</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to analyze the data, ensuring that the conclusions were based on evidence rather than guesses.","translation":"研究人員使用科學方法分析數據，確保結論基於證據而非猜測。","explanation":"形容詞「科學的」。常用搭配：scientific approach (科學方法)。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of the new vaccine was the result of years of <target>scientific</target> <pattern>research</pattern> and rigorous testing in the laboratory.","translation":"新疫苗的發現是多年科學研究和實驗室嚴格測試的結果。","explanation":"形容詞「科學的」。常用搭配：scientific research (科學研究)。"}],"related_forms":["science","scientist"]}

{"headword":"scientist","explanation":"名詞「科學家」。指從事科學研究、實驗並試圖發現自然規律的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>scientist</target> spent months observing the behavior of dolphins in the wild to understand how they communicate with each other.","translation":"這位科學家花了好幾個月觀察野生海豚的行為，以了解它們如何彼此溝通。","explanation":"名詞「科學家」。"},{"sentence":"Modern <target>scientists</target> use advanced technology and computer models to predict how climate change will affect the global food supply.","translation":"現代科學家利用先進技術和電腦模型來預測氣候變遷將如何影響全球糧食供應。","explanation":"名詞「科學家」。"}],"related_forms":["science","scientific"]}

{"headword":"scissors","explanation":"名詞「剪刀」。這是一個複數名詞 (plural noun)，通常與 a pair of 搭配使用，且動詞需用複數形式。","entries":[{"sentence":"Could you please pass me a <pattern>pair of</pattern> <target>scissors</target> so I can cut the wrapping paper for the birthday gift?","translation":"能請你把剪刀遞給我嗎？這樣我才能剪開生日禮物的包裝紙。","explanation":"名詞「剪刀」。常用搭配：a pair of scissors。"},{"sentence":"The teacher reminded the students that the <target>scissors</target> <pattern>are</pattern> sharp, so they should be very careful when using them for the art project.","translation":"老師提醒學生剪刀很鋒利，所以他們在進行藝術計畫時使用時應非常小心。","explanation":"名詞「剪刀」。注意 scissors 恆為複數，動詞需用 are。"}],"related_forms":["scissors"]}

{"headword":"scout","explanation":"名詞可指「童軍」或「偵察兵」；動詞則指「偵察」或「搜尋」。注意動詞用法時常搭配介系詞 for，表示搜尋特定目標。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the summer camp, the young <target>scouts</target> learned how to build a fire and navigate using a compass in the forest.","translation":"在夏季營隊中，年輕的童軍們學習了如何在森林中生火以及使用指南針導航。","explanation":"名詞「童軍」。指參加童軍活動的青少年。"},{"sentence":"The professional basketball <target>scout</target> traveled to different cities to look for talented high school players for the national team.","translation":"職業籃球球探前往不同的城市，為國家隊尋找有才華的高中球員。","explanation":"名詞「球探」。指專門搜尋新人才的人員。"},{"sentence":"The team decided to <target>scout</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a suitable location for the upcoming outdoor concert before finalizing the event plan.","translation":"團隊決定在敲定活動計劃之前，先為即將到來的大型戶外音樂會偵察合適的地點。","explanation":"動詞「偵察、搜尋」。常搭配 for 表示搜尋對象。"}],"related_forms":["scouting"]}

{"headword":"scream","explanation":"動詞指「尖叫」或「大聲喊叫」；名詞指「尖叫聲」。注意 scream 常用於表達強烈的恐懼、疼痛或極度興奮。常用片語 scream with joy/fear (因興奮/恐懼而尖叫)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the girl saw a huge spider on her shoulder, she let out a loud <target>scream</target> that startled everyone in the room.","translation":"當女孩看到肩膀上有一隻巨大的蜘蛛時，她發出了一聲大聲的尖叫，嚇到了房間裡的每個人。","explanation":"名詞「尖叫聲」。"},{"sentence":"The fans <target>screamed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> excitement when their favorite pop star finally appeared on the concert stage.","translation":"粉絲們在他們最愛的流行歌手終於出現在演唱會舞台上時，興奮地尖叫。","explanation":"動詞「尖叫」。片語 scream with excitement 表示「因興奮而尖叫」。"},{"sentence":"He <target>screamed</target> <pattern>for</pattern> help after he accidentally fell into the deep hole while hiking in the mountains.","translation":"他在山中健行時不小心掉入深洞後，大聲呼救。","explanation":"動詞「大聲喊叫」。常用搭配 scream for help 表示「大聲呼救」。"}],"related_forms":["screams"]}

{"headword":"screw","explanation":"名詞指「螺絲釘」；動詞指「用螺絲固定」或「擰」。在口語中， screw up (搞砸) 是一個非常常見的片語，在 GSAT 閱讀中需注意其非正式用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"He used a screwdriver to tighten the <target>screw</target> in the chair leg, making sure the furniture was stable and safe to use.","translation":"他使用螺絲起子將椅子腿上的螺絲擰緊，確保家具穩固且安全使用。","explanation":"名詞「螺絲釘」。"},{"sentence":"The carpenter <target>screwed</target> the wooden planks <pattern>together</pattern> to build a strong and durable bookshelf for the school library.","translation":"木工將木板用螺絲固定在一起，為學校圖書館建造了一個堅固耐用的書架。","explanation":"動詞「用螺絲固定」。"},{"sentence":"I was so nervous during the final presentation that I <target>screwed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> my speech, forgetting several important points.","translation":"我在期末報告時非常緊張，以至於把演講搞砸了，忘記了幾個重點。","explanation":"動詞片語 screw up 表「搞砸」。"}],"related_forms":["screwed"]}

{"headword":"scrub","explanation":"動詞指「用力刷洗」；名詞指「刷洗」。在醫療情境中， scrub in (準備手術) 是專業術語，但 GSAT 學生應優先掌握其基礎清潔用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"After spending the whole afternoon gardening, the children had to <target>scrub</target> their dirty hands <pattern>with</pattern> soap and water.","translation":"在花園工作一整個下午後，孩子們必須用肥皂和水用力刷洗他們髒髒的手。","explanation":"動詞「用力刷洗」。常用搭配 scrub with sth。"},{"sentence":"The volunteer spent hours <target>scrubbing</target> the old graffiti <pattern>off</pattern> the school walls to make the campus look cleaner.","translation":"志工花了好幾個小時將學校牆上的舊塗鴉刷洗掉，使校園看起來更乾淨。","explanation":"動詞「刷洗掉」。常用搭配 scrub off。"},{"sentence":"The nurse gave the doctor a quick reminder to <target>scrub</target> his hands thoroughly before entering the operating room.","translation":"護理師快速提醒醫生在進入手術室之前要徹底刷洗雙手。","explanation":"動詞「刷洗」。此處指醫療上的洗手程序。"}],"related_forms":["scrubber"]}

{"headword": "seal", "explanation": "動詞用法包括「密封」和「蓋章」，名詞則可指「印章」或「海豹」。動詞的密封用法及名詞的印章用法是常見考點，注意其介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company decided to <target>seal</target> the confidential documents <pattern>in</pattern> an envelope before sending them to ensure privacy and security.", "translation": "公司決定在寄送機密文件前將其密封在信封中，以確保隱私和安全。", "explanation": "動詞「密封」。常用搭配：seal sth in/with sth。"}, {"sentence": "After signing the contract, the lawyer <target>sealed</target> it <pattern>with</pattern> a special stamp to make it legally binding and official.", "translation": "律師簽署合約後，用特殊印章蓋章，使其具有法律約束力並正式生效。", "explanation": "動詞「蓋章」。常用搭配：seal with a stamp/signature。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient letter still bore the king's <pattern>official</pattern> <target>seal</target>, indicating its authenticity and historical significance.", "translation": "這封古老的信件上仍帶有國王的官方印章，表明其真實性和歷史意義。", "explanation": "名詞「印章」。常用搭配：official seal, break a seal (拆封)。"}, {"sentence": "A large grey <target>seal</target> was spotted basking on the rocks near the coastline, attracting many curious tourists.", "translation": "一隻大型灰色海豹被發現在海岸線附近的岩石上曬太陽，吸引了許多好奇的遊客。", "explanation": "名詞「海豹」。"}], "related_forms": ["seals", "sealed", "sealing"]}

{"headword": "security", "explanation": "名詞，意為「安全」或「保全」。常與介係詞 for 或 against 搭配，表示「為…提供安全」或「防範…」。注意與形容詞 secure 的區別：security 是指整體的安全體系、機構或受保護的狀態，例如 airport security (機場安檢) 或 national security (國家安全)；而形容詞 secure 則描述一個特定的狀態，表示穩固、可靠或無憂無慮的，例如 a secure job (穩定的工作) 或 feel secure (感到安心)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The airport implemented strict <target>security</target> <pattern>measures</pattern> to prevent unauthorized access and ensure the safety of all passengers.", "translation": "機場實施了嚴格的安檢措施，以防止未經授權的進入並確保所有乘客的安全。", "explanation": "名詞「安全、保全」。常用搭配：security measures (安全措施), airport security (機場安檢)。"}, {"sentence": "The company hired a private <target>security</target> <pattern>guard</pattern> to protect its valuable assets and monitor the premises overnight.", "translation": "公司聘請了一名私人保全人員，以保護其寶貴資產並在夜間監控場所。", "explanation": "名詞「保全人員」。security guard 指「保全人員」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people invest in insurance as a form of financial <target>security</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their future and their families.", "translation": "許多人投資保險作為他們未來和家庭的財務保障。", "explanation": "名詞「保障、安全感」。常用搭配：financial security (財務保障), job security (工作保障)。"}], "related_forms": ["secure"]}

{"headword":"semester","explanation":"名詞「學期」。指學校一年分成的兩個主要學習期間。注意與 term (學期/期限) 的區別，semester 通常特指分兩半的學期制。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students are studying hard for their final exams, which will take place at the end of the <target>semester</target>.","translation":"學生們正為他們的期末考努力學習，考試將在學期末舉行。","explanation":"名詞「學期」。"},{"sentence":"I plan to take an advanced English course in the next <target>semester</target> to better prepare myself for the university entrance exam.","translation":"我計畫在下個學期修一門高級英語課程，以便為大學入學考試做好更好的準備。","explanation":"名詞「學期」。"},{"sentence":"Many students feel stressed during the first <target>semester</target> of freshman year because they have to adapt to a new environment.","translation":"許多學生在一年級的第一個學期感到壓力大，因為他們必須適應新環境。","explanation":"名詞「學期」。"}],"related_forms":["semesters"]}

{"headword":"senior","explanation":"形容詞指「較年長的」或「資歷較深的」；名詞指「高年級生」或「長輩」。在美國教育體系中， senior 特指高中或大學的最後一年學生。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a <target>senior</target> in high school, he is under a lot of pressure to choose the right major for college.","translation":"作為一名高三學生，他面臨著巨大的壓力去選擇大學正確的專業。","explanation":"名詞「高年級生」。指高中或大學的最後一年學生。"},{"sentence":"The <target>senior</target> manager provided valuable guidance to the new employees, helping them understand the company's internal rules.","translation":"資深經理為新員工提供了寶貴的指導，幫助他們理解公司的內部規則。","explanation":"形容詞「資深、資歷較深的」。"},{"sentence":"The company offers special discounts and healthcare benefits for <target>senior</target> citizens to improve their quality of life in old age.","translation":"公司為年長公民提供特別折扣和醫療福利，以提高他們晚年的生活品質。","explanation":"形容詞「年長的」。常用搭配 senior citizen (年長公民)。"}],"related_forms":["seniority"]}

{"headword":"sensible","explanation":"形容詞「明智的、理智的」。注意與 sensitive (敏感的) 的區別：sensible 指的是判斷力好，會做正確的決定；而 sensitive 則指對刺激反應快，或對他人情感敏感。","entries":[{"sentence":"It would be <target>sensible</target> to save a portion of your monthly allowance for unexpected expenses instead of spending it all.","translation":"將每月零用錢的一部分儲蓄起來以應對意外支出，而不是全部花光，會是明智的。","explanation":"形容詞「明智的」。指做出合理的決定。"},{"sentence":"The teacher advised the students to wear <target>sensible</target> shoes for the field trip to the mountains, as the terrain was rocky.","translation":"老師建議學生在去山區校外教學時穿著舒適實用的鞋子，因為地形多岩石。","explanation":"形容詞「理智的、實用的」。此處指選擇適合環境的物品。"},{"sentence":"Instead of arguing, they reached a <target>sensible</target> agreement that satisfied both parties after a long and detailed discussion.","translation":"他們沒有爭論，而是在經過漫長且詳細的討論後，達成了一項令雙方都滿意的明智協議。","explanation":"形容詞「明智的」。"}],"related_forms":["sensibly","sensibility"]}

{"headword":"separation","explanation":"名詞「分離、分隔」。常搭配介系詞 from，表示從某人或某物分離。常用片語 separation anxiety (分離焦慮)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>separation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> church and state is a fundamental principle in many democratic countries to ensure religious freedom.","translation":"政教分離是許多民主國家的基本原則，以確保宗教自由。","explanation":"名詞「分離」。常用搭配 separation of A and B。"},{"sentence":"Many young children experience <target>separation</target> anxiety when they start school and have to be away from their parents.","translation":"許多幼童在開始上學且必須離開父母時，會經歷分離焦慮。","explanation":"名詞「分離」。常用片語 separation anxiety (分離焦慮)。"},{"sentence":"After ten years of marriage, the couple decided on a legal <target>separation</target> before deciding whether to get a final divorce.","translation":"結婚十年後，這對夫妻在決定是否最終離婚之前，決定先進行法律上的分居。","explanation":"名詞「分居、分離」。"}],"related_forms":["separate"]}

{"headword":"sexual","explanation":"形容詞「性的、兩性的」。常用於生物學、社會學或健康教育討論中，指與性別或生殖相關的事宜。","entries":[{"sentence":"In biology class, we learned about <target>sexual</target> reproduction, where an organism is created from the union of two parents.","translation":"在生物課上，我們學習了有性生殖，即生物體是由父母雙方結合而產生的。","explanation":"形容詞「性的」。指與生殖相關的過程。"},{"sentence":"The health center provides comprehensive <target>sexual</target> health education to teenagers to help them make responsible decisions.","translation":"健康中心為青少年提供全面的性健康教育，以幫助他們做出負責任的決定。","explanation":"形容詞「性的」。常用搭配 sexual health education。"},{"sentence":"Some animal species exhibit <target>sexual</target> dimorphism, meaning the males and females have different physical characteristics.","translation":"某些動物物種表現出性二型性，意思是雄性和雌性具有不同的身體特徵。","explanation":"形容詞「性的」。指性別之間的差異。"}],"related_forms":["sexuality"]}

{"headword":"sexy","explanation":"形容詞「性感的、吸引人的」。雖然常用於描述外貌，但在現代英語中也可用於描述事物（如新科技或新想法）非常有吸引力或令人興奮。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actress wore a <target>sexy</target> red dress to the awards ceremony, capturing the attention of everyone in the room.","translation":"這位女演員在頒獎典禮上穿了一件性感的紅色禮服，吸引了房間裡所有人的注意。","explanation":"形容詞「性感的」。描述外貌上的吸引力。"},{"sentence":"The tech company promoted their new smartphone with a <target>sexy</target> design and cutting-edge features that appealed to young users.","translation":"這家科技公司以其性感的設計和頂尖的功能推廣他們的新款智慧型手機，吸引了年輕用戶。","explanation":"形容詞「吸引人的」。此處非指性吸引力，而指設計精美且具吸引力。"},{"sentence":"While some find the new marketing strategy <target>sexy</target>, the manager believes that a steady and reliable approach is more important.","translation":"雖然有些人認為新的行銷策略非常有吸引力，但經理認為穩健可靠的方法更重要。","explanation":"形容詞「吸引人的」。指想法或計畫令人興奮或有吸引力。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"shadow","explanation":"名詞指「影子」或「陰影」，動詞指「跟蹤」或「使陷入陰影」。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法最常見，而動詞用法則常出現在閱讀中，指某人為了學習而跟隨他人。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the sun began to set, the trees cast long <target>shadows</target> across the park, creating a peaceful and mysterious atmosphere.","translation":"當太陽開始下山時，樹木在公園中投下長長的影子，營造出一種寧靜而神秘的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「影子」。指光線被遮擋而產生的暗區。"},{"sentence":"The dark <target>shadow</target> of the clouds covered the entire valley, signaling that a heavy storm was about to arrive.","translation":"雲層的深色陰影覆蓋了整個山谷，預示著一場大暴風雨即將到來。","explanation":"名詞「陰影」。指光線不足的區域。"},{"sentence":"During his first week of internship, the student was asked to <target>shadow</target> a senior doctor to learn how to handle patients.","translation":"在實習的第一週，這名學生被要求跟蹤一名資深醫生，以學習如何處理病人。","explanation":"動詞「跟蹤」。指為了學習而密切觀察某人的工作。"},{"sentence":"The fear of failure continued to <target>shadow</target> his every move, preventing him from taking risks and pursuing his dreams.","translation":"失敗的恐懼持續地陰影化他的每一步行動，使他無法採取風險並追求夢想。","explanation":"動詞「使陷入陰影」。比喻指某種負面情緒或情況持續影響某人。"}],"related_forms":["shadows","shadowed","shadowing"]}

{"headword":"shallow","explanation":"形容詞，意為「淺的」或「膚淺的」。實體層面指水深較淺，比喻層面指思想、性格或討論不夠深入。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children played safely in the <target>shallow</target> end of the swimming pool, where the water only reached their ankles.","translation":"孩子們在游泳池的淺水區安全地玩耍，那裡的水僅到他們的腳踝。","explanation":"形容詞「淺的」。指水深較淺。"},{"sentence":"The river was so <target>shallow</target> that we could easily walk across it without getting our clothes completely wet.","translation":"這條河如此之淺，以至於我們能輕鬆地走過去而不會讓衣服完全弄濕。","explanation":"形容詞「淺的」。"},{"sentence":"The critic argued that the movie's plot was too <target>shallow</target> and failed to explore the complex emotions of the characters.","translation":"評論家認為這部電影的劇情太過膚淺，未能探索角色複雜的情緒。","explanation":"形容詞「膚淺的」。比喻指缺乏深度或思考。"}],"related_forms":["shallower","shallowest"]}

{"headword":"shampoo","explanation":"名詞指「洗髮精」，動詞指「洗髮」或「洗地毯/沙發」。注意其發音及拼寫。","entries":[{"sentence":"She realized she had forgotten to pack her <target>shampoo</target> and conditioner for the school trip, so she had to buy some at the store.","translation":"她意識到自己忘了為校外教學準備洗髮精和護髮素，所以她必須在商店買一些。","explanation":"名詞「洗髮精」。"},{"sentence":"The hairdresser carefully <target>shampooed</target> the customer's hair before starting the haircut to ensure a clean and precise style.","translation":"理髮師在開始剪髮前仔細地為顧客洗髮，以確保髮型乾淨且精確。","explanation":"動詞「洗髮」。"}],"related_forms":["shampoos","shampooed","shampooing"]}

{"headword": "shepherd", "explanation": "名詞指「牧羊人」。在文學或閱讀中，常與照顧、引導等概念相關聯。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The experienced <target>shepherd</target> used his dog to help guide the sheep back to the village before the winter snow arrived.", "translation": "經驗豐富的牧羊人利用他的狗來幫助將羊群引導回村莊，以免冬雪降臨。", "explanation": "名詞「牧羊人」。指照顧羊群的人。"}, {"sentence": "A dedicated <target>shepherd</target> must be patient and observant to ensure that no sheep wander off or get lost in the mountains.", "translation": "一名敬業的牧羊人必須耐心且觀察敏銳，以確保沒有羊群走失或在山中迷路。", "explanation": "名詞「牧羊人」。"}, {"sentence": "In many ancient stories, the <target>shepherd</target> is portrayed as a humble and caring figure who protects his flock from predators.", "translation": "在許多古代故事中，牧羊人被描繪成一個謙卑且 caring 的人物，保護他的羊群免受掠食者侵害。", "explanation": "名詞「牧羊人」。"}], "related_forms": ["shepherds"]}

{"headword":"shiny","explanation":"形容詞，意為「發光的、閃亮的」。常用於描述表面光滑且能反射光線的物體。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little girl was fascinated by the <target>shiny</target> gold coin she found buried in the sand on the beach.","translation":"小女孩對她在海邊沙灘上發現的埋在沙中的閃亮金幣感到著迷。","explanation":"形容詞「閃亮的」。指表面反射光線。"},{"sentence":"After spending hours polishing the shoes, they looked <target>shiny</target> and new, making the student feel confident for his presentation.","translation":"經過數小時的拋光後，鞋子看起來閃亮如新，讓這名學生對他的簡報感到自信。","explanation":"形容詞「閃亮的」。"}],"related_forms":["shinier","shiniest"]}

{"headword":"shorten","explanation":"動詞，意為「縮短」。可用於指時間、長度或距離的縮短。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tailor decided to <target>shorten</target> the sleeves of the dress to make it fit the customer's arm length perfectly.","translation":"裁縫決定縮短裙子的袖子，使其完美符合顧客的手臂長度。","explanation":"動詞「縮短」。指物理長度的縮短。"},{"sentence":"The teacher suggested that students <target>shorten</target> their essays to meet the word limit required for the final exam.","translation":"老師建議學生縮短他們的文章，以符合期末考要求的字數限制。","explanation":"動詞「縮短」。指內容或長度的縮短。"},{"sentence":"Due to the unexpected traffic jam, the school bus driver had to <target>shorten</target> the route to arrive at school on time.","translation":"由於意外的交通堵塞，校車司機必須縮短路線以準時到達學校。","explanation":"動詞「縮短」。指距離的縮短。"}],"related_forms":["shortened","shortening"]}

{"headword":"shortly","explanation":"副詞，意為「不久、很快」。常與 will 或 shall 搭配，表示即將發生某事。注意與 short (短的) 之區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal announced that the graduation ceremony would begin <target>shortly</target>, and all students should gather in the hall.","translation":"校長宣布畢業典禮將在不久後開始，所有學生應聚集在禮堂。","explanation":"副詞「不久、很快」。指時間上的接近。"},{"sentence":"After the meeting ended, the manager told the employees that she would contact them <target>shortly</target> with a final decision.","translation":"會議結束後，經理告訴員工，她很快就會與他們聯繫並告知最終決定。","explanation":"副詞「不久、很快」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"shovel","explanation":"名詞指「鏟子」，動詞指「鏟」。常用於描述清理雪或土壤的場景。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener used a heavy-duty <target>shovel</target> to dig a deep hole in the soil for planting the new oak tree.","translation":"園丁使用一把重型鏟子在土壤中挖一個深洞，用以種植新的橡樹。","explanation":"名詞「鏟子」。"},{"sentence":"During the winter in Canada, many residents must <target>shovel</target> the snow <pattern>off</pattern> their driveways to keep them clear and safe.","translation":"在加拿大的冬天，許多居民必須將雪從車道上鏟除，以保持車道暢通且安全。","explanation":"動詞「鏟」。常用搭配：shovel sth off sth。"}],"related_forms":["shovels","shoveled","shoveling"]}

{"headword": "shrimp", "explanation": "名詞「蝦」。單複數同形。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For dinner, we enjoyed a delicious pasta dish with fresh <target>shrimp</target> and a creamy garlic sauce, which was very satisfying.", "translation": "晚餐我們享用了一道美味的義大利麵，裡面有新鮮的蝦和奶油蒜醬，非常令人滿足。", "explanation": "名詞「蝦」（單數）。"}, {"sentence": "The chef prepared a large platter of grilled <target>shrimp</target> for the party, seasoned with herbs and lemon juice for a fresh taste.", "translation": "廚師為派對準備了一大盤烤蝦，用香草和檸檬汁調味，以帶來清新的口感。", "explanation": "名詞「蝦」（複數）。單複數同形。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"shrink","explanation":"動詞，意為「縮小、萎縮」或「退縮」。物理上指衣物縮水，比喻上指對某事感到恐懼而退縮。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you wash the wool sweater in hot water, it will likely <target>shrink</target> and become too small for you to wear.","translation":"如果你用熱水洗羊毛衫，它很可能會縮水，變得太小而無法穿著。","explanation":"動詞「縮小」。指物理上的縮水。"},{"sentence":"The small town's population continued to <target>shrink</target> as more young people moved to the big city for better job opportunities.","translation":"小鎮的人口持續萎縮，因為更多年輕人移往大城市尋找更好的工作機會。","explanation":"動詞「萎縮」。指數量或規模的減少。"},{"sentence":"Despite the danger, the brave soldier did not <target>shrink</target> <pattern>from</pattern> his duty to protect the citizens during the disaster.","translation":"儘管有危險，勇敢的士兵並沒有從他的職責中退縮，在災害期間保護公民。","explanation":"動詞片語 shrink from sth 意為「對...退縮/恐懼」。"}],"related_forms":["shrank","shrunk","shrinking"]}

{"headword":"sigh","explanation":"名詞和動詞同形，意為「嘆息」。通常表示失望、疲憊或釋放壓力。","entries":[{"sentence":"With a heavy <target>sigh</target>, the student closed his textbook and realized he still had three more chapters to read before tomorrow.","translation":"學生沉重地嘆了一口氣，關上課本，意識到在明天之前他還有三章要讀。","explanation":"名詞「嘆息」。指一種表達情緒的呼吸方式。"},{"sentence":"After the teacher finally answered the difficult question, the entire class <target>sighed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> relief, knowing the test was over.","translation":"當老師終於回答那個困難的問題後，全班同學都鬆了一口氣，意識到考試結束了。","explanation":"動詞片語 sigh with relief 意為「鬆了一口氣」。"}],"related_forms":["sighs","sighed","sighing"]}

{"headword":"signal","explanation":"名詞「信號、跡象」；動詞「發信號、示意」。名詞常用於通訊或警示，而動詞則常用於通過肢體動作或光線來表達意圖。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lifeguard gave a <target>signal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the swimmers, warning them that the tide was coming in and it was time to leave the beach.","translation":"救生員向游泳者發出信號，警告他們潮汐正在漲潮，該離開海邊了。","explanation":"名詞「信號」。常用搭配：give a signal to sb (向某人發出信號)。"},{"sentence":"The sudden drop in temperature was a clear <target>signal</target> <pattern>that</pattern> winter was approaching, prompting people to prepare their warm clothes.","translation":"氣溫驟降是一個明顯的跡象，顯示冬季即將到來，促使人們準備冬衣。","explanation":"名詞「跡象」。指某事即將發生或某種狀態的指標。"},{"sentence":"The conductor <target>signaled</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the musicians to begin playing, and the entire orchestra started the symphony in perfect harmony.","translation":"指揮示意音樂家開始演奏，整個管弦樂團以完美的和諧開始了交響曲。","explanation":"動詞「示意」。常用搭配：signal for sb to do sth (示意某人做某事)。"},{"sentence":"When the driver <target>signaled</target> <pattern>to</pattern> turn left, the car behind him slowed down to allow him to merge into the lane.","translation":"當駕駛員示意要左轉時，後方的車輛減速以允許他併入車道。","explanation":"動詞「發信號」。常用於交通情境。"}],"related_forms":["signaled","signaling"]}

{"headword":"significant","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的、重要的」。指數量、程度或影響力達到足以引起注意的程度。常用搭配：significant change, significant difference。注意與 important 的區別：significant 側重於數量或程度的顯著性，而 important 側重於價值或地位的重要性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new education policy led to a <target>significant</target> <pattern>increase in</pattern> student performance, as more teachers were trained in modern methods.","translation":"新的教育政策導致學生表現顯著提高，因為更多老師接受了現代方法的培訓。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。常用搭配：significant increase in (在...方面顯著增加)。"},{"sentence":"There is a <target>significant</target> <pattern>difference between</pattern> the two study groups, with one showing much higher scores on the final exam.","translation":"這兩組學習小組之間存在顯著差異，其中一組在期末考試中表現出更高的分數。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。常用搭配：significant difference between... (在...之間存在顯著差異)。"},{"sentence":"Saving energy is a <target>significant</target> <pattern>part of</pattern> the global effort to combat climate change and protect the environment for future generations.","translation":"節能是全球對抗氣候變遷並為後代保護環境之努力的重要部分。","explanation":"形容詞「重要的」。常用搭配：significant part of (重要部分)。"}],"related_forms":["significantly","significance"]}

{"headword":"silk","explanation":"名詞「絲綢」。指從蠶繭中提取的天然纖維製成的布料。常用於描述高價、光滑的織物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bride wore a beautiful <target>silk</target> gown that shimmered under the lights, making her look elegant and sophisticated on her wedding day.","translation":"新娘穿著一件美麗的絲綢禮服，在燈光下閃閃發光，使她在婚禮那天看起來優雅且高貴。","explanation":"名詞「絲綢」。指一種天然纖維織物。"},{"sentence":"Because <target>silk</target> is a natural protein fiber, it requires special care and should be dry-cleaned to maintain its quality and shine.","translation":"由於絲綢是一種天然蛋白質纖維，它需要特殊照顧，且應採取乾洗以維持其品質和光澤。","explanation":"名詞「絲綢」。描述其材質特性。"}],"related_forms":["silken","silky"]}

{"headword":"similarity","explanation":"名詞「相似之處」。指兩者或多者之間共同的特徵。常與介係詞 to 或 between 搭配，例如 similarity to... 或 similarities between...。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher pointed out the <target>similarity</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two poems, noting that both used nature to express deep emotions of sadness.","translation":"老師指出這兩首詩之間的相似之處， noting that both used nature to express deep emotions of sadness.","explanation":"名詞「相似之處」。常用搭配：similarity between A and B (A與B之間的相似之處)。"},{"sentence":"There is a striking <target>similarity</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the way the two artists paint landscapes, as both focus on the light and shadow of the mountains.","translation":"這兩種藝術家繪製風景畫的方式有著驚人的相似之處，因為兩者都專注於山脈的光影。","explanation":"名詞「相似之處」。常用搭配：similarity to sth (與...的相似之處)。"}],"related_forms":["similar"]}
comment: The translation of sentence 1 is incomplete; it repeats the English text instead of translating it into Traditional Chinese.

response: {"headword":"sin","explanation":"名詞「罪孽、罪行」；動詞「犯罪、觸犯」。通常指違反宗教道德或神聖律法而犯下的錯。注意與 crime 的區別：crime 指法律定義上的犯罪，而 sin 指道德或宗教上的罪孽。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many ancient stories, the main character must suffer for their <target>sin</target> and seek forgiveness to find inner peace.","translation":"在許多古代故事中，主角必須為其罪孽受苦並尋求原諒以獲得內心的平安。","explanation":"名詞「罪孽」。指違反道德或宗教律法的行為。"},{"sentence":"Some people believe that wasting food is a <target>sin</target> when millions of people around the world are still starving.","translation":"有些人認為，當全球仍有數百萬人飢餓時，浪費食物是一種罪孽。","explanation":"名詞「罪孽」。此處指嚴重的道德缺失。"},{"sentence":"The monk explained that everyone <target>sins</target> at some point in their lives, but the most important thing is to learn from mistakes and change.","translation":"僧侶解釋說，每個人在生活中都會在某些時候觸犯罪孽，但最重要的事情是從錯誤中學習並改變。","explanation":"動詞「觸犯、犯罪」。指違反宗教或道德規範。"}],"related_forms":["sinful","sinner"]}

{"headword":"sincere","explanation":"形容詞「真誠的、誠實的」。指沒有欺騙、不虛偽的態度。常用搭配：sincere apology, sincere effort。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager accepted the employee's <target>sincere</target> <pattern>apology</pattern> after he admitted his mistake and promised to improve his performance in the future.","translation":"經理在員工承認錯誤並承諾未來會改善表現後，接受了他的真誠道歉。","explanation":"形容詞「真誠的」。常用搭配：sincere apology (真誠的道歉)。"},{"sentence":"She made a <target>sincere</target> <pattern>effort to</pattern> learn the local language, which earned her the respect and friendship of the people in the village.","translation":"她做出了真誠的努力去學習當地語言，這讓她贏得了村莊裡人們的尊重和友誼。","explanation":"形容詞「真誠的」。常用搭配：sincere effort (真誠的努力)。"},{"sentence":"I want to express my <target>sincere</target> <pattern>gratitude to</pattern> everyone who helped me during the difficult times of my final year in high school.","translation":"我想向所有在高中最後一年困難時期幫助我的人表達我的真誠感激。","explanation":"形容詞「真誠的」。常用搭配：sincere gratitude (真誠的感激)。"}],"related_forms":["sincerely","sincerity"]}

{"headword": "sink", "explanation": "動詞「下沉、沉沒」，名詞「水槽」。動詞為不規則變化：sink-sank-sunk。常考動詞片語 sink into (陷入)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old ship slowly <target>sank</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the ocean after hitting an iceberg, leaving behind a tragic story for history.", "translation": "這艘老船撞上冰山後緩緩沉入大海，留下了一個悲劇性的歷史故事。", "explanation": "動詞「下沉、沉沒」。不規則動詞變化：sink-sank-sunk。指物體沒入水中。"}, {"sentence": "After a long day, she just wanted to <target>sink</target> <pattern>into</pattern> her comfortable armchair and read a good book, forgetting all her worries.", "translation": "經過漫長的一天，她只想陷入舒適的扶手椅中，讀一本好書，忘記所有的煩惱。", "explanation": "動詞片語 sink into sth 意為「陷入...中」。指身體或精神上進入某種狀態。"}, {"sentence": "The kitchen <target>sink</target> was full of dirty dishes after the party, so they decided to clean them together the next morning.", "translation": "派對後廚房水槽裡堆滿了髒盤子，所以他們決定第二天早上一起清洗。", "explanation": "名詞「水槽」。指廚房或浴室中用於洗滌的盆狀裝置。"}], "related_forms": ["sinks", "sank", "sunk", "sinking"]}

{"headword":"sip","explanation":"動詞「啜飲」；名詞「一小口」。指小口地喝飲料，通常是因為飲料太燙或為了品味味道。","entries":[{"sentence":"The woman <target>sipped</target> her hot tea <pattern>slowly</pattern>, enjoying the aroma and the quiet atmosphere of the morning before the children woke up.","translation":"那名女子緩慢地啜飲著她的熱茶，在孩子們醒來之前享受著早晨的香氣和寧靜的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「啜飲」。指小口地喝。"},{"sentence":"He took a small <target>sip</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the soup to check if it was too hot before giving it to the child to eat.","translation":"他在將湯給孩子吃之前，先小口喝了一口湯來確認是否太燙。","explanation":"名詞「一小口」。常用搭配：take a sip of sth (喝一小口...)。"}],"related_forms":["sips","sipping"]}

{"headword":"situation","explanation":"名詞「情況、處境」。描述特定時間和地點發生的事情或狀態。常用搭配：difficult situation, handle a situation, in a situation。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher tried to handle the difficult <target>situation</target> <pattern>by</pattern> calmly talking to the two students who were arguing in the classroom.","translation":"老師試圖透過冷靜地與教室中爭吵的兩名學生交談來處理這個困難的情況。","explanation":"名詞「情況、處境」。常用搭配：handle a situation (處理情況)。"},{"sentence":"The city is currently in a critical <target>situation</target> <pattern>due to</pattern> the sudden increase in the number of infectious diseases among the residents.","translation":"由於居民中傳染病人數的突然增加，該市目前處於危急的情況中。","explanation":"名詞「情況」。常用搭配：in a situation (處於某種情況中)。"},{"sentence":"Depending on the <target>situation</target>, you may need to adjust your study plan to ensure you have enough time to review all the subjects for the GSAT.","translation":"根據情況，你可能需要調整你的學習計劃，以確保你有足夠的時間複習所有科目以應對學測。","explanation":"名詞「情況」。常用搭配：depending on the situation (根據情況)。"}],"related_forms":["situational"]}

{"headword":"skate","explanation":"動詞「溜冰」；名詞「溜冰鞋」。指在冰上或滾輪上滑行的動作或工具。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the winter vacation, many students enjoy <target>skating</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the frozen lake near their hometown to exercise and have fun with friends.","translation":"在寒假期間，許多學生喜歡在故鄉附近的凍湖上溜冰，以運動並與朋友一起玩樂。","explanation":"動詞「溜冰」。常用搭配：skate on the ice (在冰上溜冰)。"},{"sentence":"She bought a new pair of <target>skates</target> for her daughter, as the girl had shown a great interest in learning how to ice skate professionally.","translation":"她為女兒買了一雙新溜冰鞋，因為這個女孩對學習專業溜冰表現出了極大的興趣。","explanation":"名詞「溜冰鞋」。通常用複數 skates。"}],"related_forms":["skating","skater"]}

{"headword":"ski","explanation":"動詞「滑雪」；名詞「滑雪板」。指在雪地上使用滑雪板滑行的動作或工具。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family decided to <target>ski</target> <pattern>down</pattern> the mountain, enjoying the fresh air and the beautiful white snow that covered the entire slope.","translation":"這家人決定沿著山坡下滑雪，享受新鮮的空氣和覆蓋整個山坡的美麗白雪。","explanation":"動詞「滑雪」。常用搭配：ski down the mountain (沿山而下)。"},{"sentence":"Before starting the trip, you must ensure that your <target>skis</target> are properly <pattern>fastened to</pattern> your boots to prevent any serious accidents on the slope.","translation":"在開始旅程前，你必須確保你的滑雪板已正確地固定在靴子上，以防止在山坡上發生任何嚴重事故。","explanation":"名詞「滑雪板」。常用搭配：fasten to (固定於...)。"}],"related_forms":["skiing","skier"]}

{"headword":"skillful","explanation":"形容詞「熟練的、技巧高超的」。常用於描述一個人處理某項工作、演奏樂器或運動時展現出的高水準技巧。與 skilled 相似，但 skillful 更強調技巧的精湛程度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The surgeon's <target>skillful</target> hands allowed him to perform the complex operation with precision, ensuring the patient's full recovery.","translation":"外科醫生的熟練雙手使他能夠精確地執行這項複雜的手術，確保患者完全康復。","explanation":"形容詞「熟練的」。描述操作的高超技巧。"},{"sentence":"Through years of practice, the pianist became <target>skillful</target> <pattern>at</pattern> playing difficult classical pieces, earning praise from the audience.","translation":"經過多年的練習，這名鋼琴家在演奏困難的古典曲目方面變得熟練，贏得了觀眾的讚賞。","explanation":"形容詞「熟練的」。常用搭配：skillful at sth (在某方面熟練)。"}],"related_forms":["skillfully","skillfulness"]}

{"headword":"skinny","explanation":"形容詞「瘦的、皮包骨的」。通常帶有負面或中性的色彩，指一個人過於瘦削，缺乏肌肉或脂肪。與 slender 或 slim (苗條的) 不同，skinny 傾向於描述「太瘦」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After being sick for several weeks, the boy looked <target>skinny</target> and pale, which worried his parents greatly.","translation":"生病好幾週後，這個男孩看起來很瘦且臉色蒼白，這讓他的父母非常擔心。","explanation":"形容詞「瘦的」。描述體型過於瘦削。"},{"sentence":"She prefers wearing <target>skinny</target> jeans because they fit her body closely and make her feel more confident in her fashion choices.","translation":"她喜歡穿緊身牛仔褲，因為它們貼合她的身體，讓她在時尚選擇上感到更有信心。","explanation":"形容詞「瘦的」。在服裝中，skinny jeans 指緊身牛仔褲。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"skip","explanation":"動詞「跳過、省略」；名詞「跳過」。在學業背景下，常用於 skip class (翹課)。此外，也可指輕快地跳躍。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student decided to <target>skip</target> the first chapter of the book because he had already read it during the summer break.","translation":"這個學生決定跳過書的第一章，因為他在暑假期間已經讀過了。","explanation":"動詞「跳過、省略」。指不閱讀或不做某一部分。"},{"sentence":"He was warned by the teacher that <target>skipping</target> class would lead to a lower grade in the final exam.","translation":"老師警告他，翹課會導致期末考成績較低。","explanation":"動詞「翹課」。skip class 是常見的口語用法。"},{"sentence":"The little girl started to <target>skip</target> happily down the street after receiving a gold star from her teacher.","translation":"小女孩在從老師那裡拿到金星後，快樂地在街道上蹦蹦跳跳。","explanation":"動詞「跳躍」。指輕快地跳著走。"},{"sentence":"Due to the heavy rain, the school decided to <target>skip</target> the morning assembly and start classes immediately.","translation":"由於大雨，學校決定取消早會並立即開始上課。","explanation":"動詞「跳過」。指取消原定計畫的一部分。"}],"related_forms":["skipped","skipping"]}

{"headword": "slave", "explanation": "「奴隸」。名詞和動詞同形。動詞 slave away (辛勤工作) 是常見片語。注意其名詞形式 slavery 意為「奴隸制度」或「奴役狀態」，例如 the abolition of slavery (廢除奴隸制度) 或 fall into slavery (淪為奴役)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Historically, many people were forced to live as <target>slaves</target>, enduring harsh conditions and losing their basic human rights.", "translation": "歷史上，許多人被迫過著奴隸的生活，忍受惡劣的條件並失去他們基本的人權。", "explanation": "名詞「奴隸」。指失去自由並被迫為他人工作的人。"}, {"sentence": "The abolitionist movement fought tirelessly to end <target>slavery</target> and ensure freedom and equality for all individuals.", "translation": "廢奴運動不懈地努力，旨在結束奴隸制度，並確保所有人的自由與平等。", "explanation": "名詞「奴隸制度」。由 slave 衍生的名詞。"}, {"sentence": "After working long hours, he felt like he was <target>slaving</target> <pattern>away</pattern> at his desk, with little time for rest or personal life.", "translation": "長時間工作後，他覺得自己像是在辦公桌前辛勤工作，幾乎沒有時間休息或享受個人生活。", "explanation": "動詞片語 slave away「辛勤工作」。此處為現在進行式 slaving away。"}], "related_forms": ["slavery", "slaves"]}

{"headword":"sleeve","explanation":"名詞「袖子」。常用於描述衣服的長度（long sleeve / short sleeve）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student rolled up his <target>sleeves</target> and began to clean the chemistry lab after the experiment was finished.","translation":"這個學生捲起袖子，在實驗結束後開始清理化學實驗室。","explanation":"名詞「袖子」。roll up one's sleeves 也有「準備努力工作」的隱喻義。"},{"sentence":"Because the weather was getting colder, she decided to wear a long-<target>sleeve</target> shirt to keep herself warm during the lecture.","translation":"因為天氣越來越冷，她決定穿一件長袖襯衫，以便在聽課時保持溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「袖子」。long-sleeve shirt 為長袖襯衫。"}],"related_forms":["sleeves"]}

{"headword":"slender","explanation":"形容詞「苗條的、纖細的」。與 skinny 不同，slender 通常帶有褒義，指體型匀稱且好看的瘦，或指物體纖細。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ballerina had a <target>slender</target> figure that allowed her to move with grace and elegance on the stage.","translation":"這名芭蕾舞者擁有苗條的身材，使她能在舞台上優雅地舞動。","explanation":"形容詞「苗條的」。描述體型好看的瘦。"},{"sentence":"The old tree had <target>slender</target> branches that swayed gently in the wind, creating a peaceful atmosphere in the park.","translation":"這棵老樹有纖細的枝條，在風中輕輕搖曳，在公園中營造出寧靜的氛圍。","explanation":"形容詞「纖細的」。描述物體形狀細長。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"slice","explanation":"名詞「薄片」；動詞「切片」。常用於食物描述，如 a slice of bread 或 a slice of pizza。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef used a sharp knife to <target>slice</target> the fresh bread <pattern>into</pattern> thin pieces for the guests' breakfast.","translation":"廚師用一把快刀將新鮮麵包切成薄片，給客人的早餐用。","explanation":"動詞「切片」。常用搭配：slice sth into pieces。"},{"sentence":"Could you please give me a <target>slice</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cake to celebrate the end of the semester with my classmates?","translation":"你能給我一片蛋糕來和同學們一起慶祝學期結束嗎？","explanation":"名詞「薄片」。常用搭配：a slice of sth。"}],"related_forms":["sliced","slicing"]}

{"headword":"slippery","explanation":"形容詞「滑的」。常用於描述路面、表面或人（不可靠的人）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The marble floor was extremely <target>slippery</target> after the cleaning staff mopped it, so people were warned to walk slowly.","translation":"清潔人員拖完地後，大理石地板變得非常滑，因此人們被警告要慢慢行走。","explanation":"形容詞「滑的」。描述表面的物理屬性。"},{"sentence":"Be careful when walking on the grass in the morning because the dew makes the surface very <target>slippery</target>.","translation":"早晨在草地上行走時要小心，因為露水使表面變得非常滑。","explanation":"形容詞「滑的」。描述自然環境。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"slope","explanation":"名詞「斜坡、坡度」。常用於描述山坡或滑雪場的坡道。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers decided to climb the steep <target>slope</target> of the mountain to reach the peak before the sun set.","translation":"登山者決定攀登陡峭的山坡以在太陽下山前到達山頂。","explanation":"名詞「斜坡」。常用形容詞：steep slope (陡坡)。"},{"sentence":"Many tourists visit the Alps in winter to enjoy skiing down the snowy <target>slopes</target> of the high mountains.","translation":"許多遊客在冬天造訪阿爾卑斯山，享受在雪山坡道上滑雪的快感。","explanation":"名詞「斜坡」。常用於滑雪場的坡道描述。"}],"related_forms":["slopes"]}

{"headword":"snap","explanation":"動詞「突然折斷、猛然拍擊」；名詞「突然折斷的聲音、情緒爆發」。常用片語 snap at someone (對某人發脾氣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dry branch <target>snapped</target> with a loud noise when the heavy snow finally became too much for it to hold.","translation":"當積雪最終變得太重而無法承載時，這根乾枯的枝條發出大聲地折斷了。","explanation":"動詞「突然折斷」。描述物體受壓而斷裂。"},{"sentence":"After working for ten hours without a break, the tired employee finally <target>snapped</target> <pattern>at</pattern> his boss during the meeting.","translation":"在不休息地工作十個小時後，疲憊的員工終於在會議中對他的老闆發脾氣。","explanation":"動詞片語 snap at someone (對某人猛然發脾氣)。"},{"sentence":"The photographer tried to <target>snap</target> a quick photo of the rare bird before it flew away into the forest.","translation":"攝影師試圖在稀有鳥類飛入森林前拍一張快照。","explanation":"動詞「拍快照」。informal 用法。"},{"sentence":"She heard a loud <target>snap</target> when the rubber band broke, which startled her and made her drop her pen.","translation":"她聽到橡皮筋斷掉時的一聲脆響，這讓她受驚並掉了筆。","explanation":"名詞「折斷的聲音」。"}],"related_forms":["snapped","snapping"]}

{"headword":"solid","explanation":"形容詞「固體的；堅固的；可靠的」。指物質狀態或結構的穩定性，也可指人的知識或性格可靠。","entries":[{"sentence":"In science class, we learned that water can exist in three states: liquid, gas, and <target>solid</target> ice.","translation":"在科學課上，我們了解到水可以以三種狀態存在：液體、氣體和固體冰。","explanation":"形容詞「固體的」。描述物質的物理狀態。"},{"sentence":"The engineer ensured that the foundation of the building was <target>solid</target> enough to withstand strong earthquakes.","translation":"工程師確保建築物的地基足夠堅固，以承受強烈的地震。","explanation":"形容詞「堅固的」。描述結構的穩定性。"},{"sentence":"The student's essay provided <target>solid</target> evidence to support his argument, making it very convincing to the teacher.","translation":"這個學生的論文提供了可靠的證據來支持他的論點，使其對老師來說非常有說論服力。","explanation":"形容詞「可靠的」。描述證據、理由或知識的基礎紮實。"}],"related_forms":["solidly","solidity"]}

{"headword":"someday","explanation":"副詞「有一天」，指未來某個不確定的時間點。注意與 some day (兩個單字) 的區別：someday 是副詞，通常放在句末或句首，而 some day 是形容詞 some 加上名詞 day，可接名詞（如 some day in June）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he is currently a student, he hopes that <target>someday</target> he will travel around the world and explore different cultures.","translation":"雖然他目前是一名學生，但他希望有一天他能環遊世界並探索不同的文化。","explanation":"副詞「有一天」。指未來某個不確定的時間點。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"somehow","explanation":"副詞「不知怎麼地、以某種方式」。常用於表示方法不確定或結果令人驚訝。例如：somehow I can't open this door (不知為何我打不開這扇門)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the heavy rain and strong winds, the hikers <target>somehow</target> managed to reach the mountain peak before sunset.","translation":"儘管下著大雨且強風陣陣，登山者們不知怎麼地在日落前成功到達了山頂。","explanation":"副詞「不知怎麼地」。表示以某種不確定或令人驚訝的方式達成目標。"},{"sentence":"I know the exam is very difficult, but we must <target>somehow</target> find a way to complete the project on time.","translation":"我知道這項考試很困難，但我們必須以某種方式找到方法按時完成這個專案。","explanation":"副詞「以某種方式」。表示雖然方法不確定，但仍要達成目的。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "sometime", "explanation": "副詞「在某個時間（不確定）」。注意區分 sometime (副詞：某個不確定的時間), some time (名詞片語：一段時間), 以及 sometimes (副詞：有時)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Let's get together <target>sometime</target> next month to discuss our plan for the graduation trip and share our ideas.", "translation": "我們下個月找個時間聚在一起，討論畢業旅行的計畫並分享我們的想法。", "explanation": "副詞「在某個時間」。指未來或過去某個不確定的特定時間點。"}, {"sentence": "If you have any questions about the assignment, please stop by my office <target>sometime</target> this week for a detailed explanation.", "translation": "如果你對作業有任何疑問，請在本週找個時間來我的辦公室，以便獲得詳細的解釋。", "explanation": "副詞「在某個時間」。"}, {"sentence": "The old man mentioned that he had lived in this small village <target>sometime</target> in the early 1900s before moving to the city.", "translation": "這位老人提到他在 1900 年代初期曾在這個小村莊住過一段時間，之後才搬到城市。", "explanation": "副詞「在某個時間」。指過去某個不確定的時間點。"}, {"sentence": "The professor is <target>sometime</target> a consultant for the government, providing expert advice on urban planning and public transport.", "translation": "這位教授有時兼任政府的顧問，為城市規劃和公共交通提供專家建議。", "explanation": "形容詞用法。指某人曾擔任某種職位或身份。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"sorrow","explanation":"名詞「悲傷、憂愁」。常用搭配：feel deep sorrow (感到深切悲痛), express sorrow (表達悲傷)。注意與 sadness 的區別：sorrow 通常指更深層、更持久的痛苦，常與喪親或重大損失相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The entire village felt a deep sense of <target>sorrow</target> after the sudden passing of the beloved old teacher.","translation":"在深受愛戴的老教師突然去世後，整個村莊感到深切的悲痛。","explanation":"名詞「悲傷」。指因重大損失而產生的深刻痛苦。"},{"sentence":"In the novel, the main character struggles to overcome his <target>sorrow</target> after losing his childhood home in the fire.","translation":"在小說中，主角努力在火災中失去童年家園後克服他的悲傷。","explanation":"名詞「悲傷」。指長期的憂愁。"}],"related_forms":["sorrowful","sorrowfully"]}

{"headword":"spaghetti","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。不可數名詞，指長條形的義大利麵。常用動詞搭配：boil, cook, eat。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children were laughing because the <target>spaghetti</target> was sticking to their faces while they were eating dinner.","translation":"孩子們在笑，因為他們在吃晚餐時義大利麵黏在了臉上。","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。指長條形的義大利麵。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"specific","explanation":"形容詞「特定的、明確的」。常考搭配：be specific about (對...明確), specific reason (特定原因), specific goal (明確目標)。注意與 special (特別的) 的區別：specific 強調「明確、具體」，而 special 強調「與眾不同、特殊」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to be more <target>specific</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their research goals to make the project more manageable.","translation":"老師要求學生對其研究目標更加明確，以使該專案更容易管理。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。片語 be specific about... 表示對某事描述具體。"},{"sentence":"Could you give me a <target>specific</target> <pattern>example</pattern> of how this new technology can improve our daily lives in the future?","translation":"您能給我一個關於這項新技術在未來如何改善我們日常生活的具體例子嗎？","explanation":"形容詞「具體的」。常用搭配 specific example (具體例子)。"},{"sentence":"There is no <target>specific</target> <pattern>reason</pattern> why she chose to study architecture, but she has always loved drawing buildings.","translation":"沒有什麼特定的原因讓她選擇學習建築學，但她一直很喜歡畫建築物。","explanation":"形容詞「特定的」。常用搭配 specific reason (特定原因)。"}],"related_forms":["specifically","specification"]}

{"headword":"spice","explanation":"名詞「香料、調味料」；動詞「添加香料、使...增色」。名詞常指乾燥的植物部分（如肉桂、胡椒）。動詞用法中，spice up (使...更有趣/更有滋味) 是常見的口語片語。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many Asian cuisines use a wide variety of <target>spices</target> to add rich flavor and aroma to their traditional dishes.","translation":"許多亞洲料理使用多種香料來為其傳統菜餚增加豐富的風味和香氣。","explanation":"名詞「香料」。指用於調味食物的植物種子、皮或根。"},{"sentence":"The chef decided to <target>spice</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the plain soup by adding a pinch of cinnamon and some fresh herbs.","translation":"主廚決定在清淡的湯中加入一小撮肉桂和一些新鮮香草來增加滋味。","explanation":"動詞片語 spice up 表示「使...更有趣或更有滋味」。"}],"related_forms":["spicy"]}

{"headword":"spill","explanation":"動詞「濺出、溢出、流出」；名詞「濺出、溢出」。常用於描述液體不小心地流出容器。常考搭配：spill the beans (揭露秘密)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student accidentally <target>spilled</target> a glass of water on his laptop, causing the screen to flicker and then go black.","translation":"學生不小心將一杯水濺在筆記型電腦上，導致螢幕閃爍然後變黑。","explanation":"動詞「濺出」。指液體不小心地流出。"},{"sentence":"Please be careful not to <target>spill</target> your coffee while walking across the classroom, as it might damage the textbooks.","translation":"在教室走動時請小心不要將咖啡濺出，以免損壞教科書。","explanation":"動詞「濺出」。"},{"sentence":"After the argument, Sarah finally <target>spilled</target> <pattern>the beans</pattern> and told everyone the secret about the surprise party.","translation":"爭論後，莎拉終於揭露了秘密，告訴了大家關於驚喜派對的事。","explanation":"動詞片語 spill the beans 意為「揭露秘密」。"},{"sentence":"The oil <target>spill</target> in the ocean caused severe pollution, killing thousands of sea creatures and damaging the coastal environment.","translation":"海洋中的漏油事件造成了嚴重污染，殺死了數千隻海洋生物並破壞了沿海環境。","explanation":"名詞「溢出、漏油」。指液體大量地流出。"}],"related_forms":["spills","spilled","spilling"]}
comment: Note: 'spill the beans' is a common idiom, though not a strict grammatical collocation, it is acceptable here.

response: {"headword":"spin","explanation":"動詞「旋轉、紡織」；名詞「旋轉」。常用於描述物體快速地繞著中心軸轉動。常考搭配：spin around (旋轉), give it a spin (試試看)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ballerina <target>spun</target> <pattern>around</pattern> gracefully on the stage, impressing the audience with her perfect balance and elegance.","translation":"芭蕾舞者在舞台上優雅地旋轉，以其完美的平衡感和優雅地讓觀眾印象深刻。","explanation":"動詞「旋轉」。不規則變化：spin-spun-spun。"},{"sentence":"The spider spent hours <target>spinning</target> a complex web to catch insects, showing the incredible instinct of nature.","translation":"蜘蛛花了好幾個小時紡織一個複雜的網來捕捉昆蟲，展示了自然的驚人本能。","explanation":"動詞「紡織」。指用纖維製造絲網或布料。"},{"sentence":"The children were excited to <pattern>give</pattern> the new toy car <target>a spin</target>, seeing how fast it could move on the floor.","translation":"孩子們興奮地想試試這輛新玩具車，看看它在地面上跑得有多快。","explanation":"名詞片語 give it a spin 意為「試試看」。"}],"related_forms":["spins","spun","spinning"]}

{"headword":"spinach","explanation":"名詞「菠菜」。一種深綠色的葉菜，富含鐵質和維生素，常用於健康飲食討論中。","entries":[{"sentence":"My mother always encourages me to eat more <target>spinach</target> because it is rich in iron and essential vitamins for growth.","translation":"我母親總是鼓勵我多吃菠菜，因為它富含鐵質和生長所需的必需維生素。","explanation":"名詞「菠菜」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spit","explanation":"spit 作為動詞指「吐出」，通常指吐唾液；作為名詞指「唾液」或「烤肉用的叉子」。注意動詞片語 spit out (吐出)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach told the athlete to <target>spit</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the water after the workout to clear his mouth before speaking.","translation":"教練告訴運動員在運動後把水吐出來，以在說話前清理口腔。","explanation":"動詞片語 spit out 表示「吐出」。"},{"sentence":"It is considered very rude in many cultures to <target>spit</target> on the ground in public places, as it is unhygienic.","translation":"在許多文化中，在公共場所向地面吐痰被認為是非常粗魯的，因為這樣不衛生。","explanation":"動詞「吐出」。指將唾液從口中吐出。"},{"sentence":"The child's clothes were covered in <target>spit</target> after the baby started teething and drooling throughout the afternoon.","translation":"寶寶整個下午都在長牙且流口水，導致孩子的衣服上沾滿了唾液。","explanation":"名詞「唾液」。指口中分泌的液體。"}],"related_forms":["spits","spat","spitting"]}

{"headword": "spite", "explanation": "名詞「惡意、怨恨」。最常見的用法是介系詞片語 in spite of (儘管)，表示讓步，與 despite 同義。注意 spite 本身作為名詞時，較少單獨使用，多見於此片語中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The team managed to win the championship <pattern>in</pattern> <target>spite</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their lack of experience and several key injuries to players.", "translation": "儘管缺乏經驗且幾名關鍵球員受傷，該隊仍成功贏得了冠軍。", "explanation": "片語 in spite of 表示「儘管」。後接名詞或動名詞。"}, {"sentence": "She decided to go for a walk <pattern>in</pattern> <target>spite</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the heavy rain, as she had promised to meet her friend.", "translation": "儘管下著大雨，她還是決定出去散步，因為她約好要見她的朋友。", "explanation": "片語 in spite of 表示「儘管」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"splash","explanation":"splash 可作名詞或動詞，指「濺起」或「濺出的水花」。常用搭配 splash water (濺水) 或 a splash of color (一點色彩)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children had a great time jumping into the swimming pool, creating a huge <target>splash</target> each time they dove in.","translation":"孩子們在游泳池裡跳來跳去玩得很開心，每次潛水時都會濺起巨大的水花。","explanation":"名詞「濺起的水花」。"},{"sentence":"Be careful not to <target>splash</target> muddy water on your clean white dress when you walk near the puddles after the rain.","translation":"雨後走在水窪附近時，小心不要把泥水濺到你潔白的洋裝上。","explanation":"動詞「濺」。指液體被撞擊而飛散。"},{"sentence":"The interior designer suggested adding a <target>splash</target> <pattern>of</pattern> bright yellow to the gray room to make it feel more energetic.","translation":"室內設計師建議在灰色的房間裡加入一點亮黃色，讓房間感覺更有活力。","explanation":"名詞「一點、少量」。比喻用法，指少量的色彩或氣味。"}],"related_forms":["splashes","splashing"]}

{"headword":"spoil","explanation":"動詞「毀掉、弄壞」或「溺愛」。常用於指食物腐敗 (spoil) 或讓某事變得糟糕 (spoil the fun)。注意名詞形式 spoiler (劇透者/劇透內容)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you leave the milk on the kitchen counter for too long, the heat will <target>spoil</target> it very quickly.","translation":"如果你把牛奶在廚房檯面上放太久，熱氣會很快地使它變質。","explanation":"動詞「變質、腐敗」。指食物不再適合食用。"},{"sentence":"I don't want to <target>spoil</target> the surprise for everyone, so please do not tell the birthday girl about the party yet.","translation":"我不想毀掉大家的驚喜，所以請先不要告訴壽星關於派對的事。","explanation":"動詞「毀掉」。指使某事失去原有的樂趣或效果。"},{"sentence":"Many parents tend to <target>spoil</target> their only child by giving them everything they want, which can lead to behavioral problems.","translation":"許多父母傾向於溺愛他們唯一的孩子，給他們想要的一切，這可能會導致行為問題。","explanation":"動詞「溺愛」。指過度寵愛而使人變壞。"}],"related_forms":["spoiled","spoiling","spoiler"]}

{"headword":"spray","explanation":"spray 可作名詞或動詞，指「噴霧」或「噴灑」。常用於指噴霧罐 (spray can) 或噴灑藥劑 (spray pesticides)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener used a <target>spray</target> <pattern>bottle</pattern> to lightly mist the indoor plants, helping them stay hydrated during the summer.","translation":"園丁使用噴霧瓶輕輕地向室內植物噴霧，幫助它們在夏天保持水分。","explanation":"名詞「噴霧」。指液體被噴成微小顆粒的形式。"},{"sentence":"To keep mosquitoes away during the camping trip, the students <target>sprayed</target> insect repellent on their arms and legs.","translation":"為了在露營旅行中防止蚊子，學生們在手臂和腿上噴了驅蚊劑。","explanation":"動詞「噴灑」。指將液體以噴霧形式散布。"},{"sentence":"The ocean waves <target>sprayed</target> salt water onto the tourists as they walked along the windy beach during the storm.","translation":"暴風雨期間，遊客在風大的海邊行走時，海浪將鹽水噴灑在他們身上。","explanation":"動詞「噴灑」。指液體因撞擊而飛散。"}],"related_forms":["sprays","spraying"]}

{"headword":"spy","explanation":"spy 可作名詞或動詞。名詞指「間諜」；動詞指「秘密地觀察」或「當間諜」。常用搭配 spy on (監視/偷看)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the movie, the secret <target>spy</target> traveled to several countries to collect intelligence and prevent a global conflict.","translation":"在電影中，這位秘密間諜前往數個國家收集情報並防止全球衝突。","explanation":"名詞「間諜」。指秘密收集資訊的人。"},{"sentence":"The curious student tried to <target>spy</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his classmates' test answers, but the teacher noticed him immediately.","translation":"好奇的學生試圖偷看同學的考試答案，但老師立刻發現了他。","explanation":"動詞片語 spy on 表示「偷看、監視」。"},{"sentence":"The government suspected that the foreign embassy was sending a <target>spy</target> to gather information about their national defense.","translation":"政府懷疑外國大使館派遣了一名間諜來收集關於他們國防的資訊。","explanation":"名詞「間諜」。"}],"related_forms":["spies","spying"]}

{"headword":"squeeze","explanation":"squeeze 可作動詞或名詞，指「用力擠壓」。常用搭配 squeeze into (擠進) 或 a tight squeeze (很擠的情況)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She had to <target>squeeze</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the crowded subway train during the morning rush hour to get to school on time.","translation":"為了準時到校，她在早晨的高峰時段必須擠進擁擠的地鐵列車。","explanation":"動詞片語 squeeze into 表示「擠進」。"},{"sentence":"The chef told the students to <target>squeeze</target> a fresh lemon over the fish to add a touch of acidity to the dish.","translation":"主廚告訴學生在魚肉上擠一些新鮮檸檬汁，為這道菜增加一點酸味。","explanation":"動詞「擠壓」。指用力將液體擠出。"},{"sentence":"Fitting all the luggage into the small car trunk was a <target>squeeze</target>, but they eventually managed to close the lid.","translation":"將所有行李放入小車後車廂非常擁擠，但他們最終設法關上了蓋子。","explanation":"名詞「擠壓、擁擠」。指空間非常有限的情況。"}],"related_forms":["squeezed","squeezing"]}

{"headword":"squirrel","explanation":"名詞「松鼠」。常見於描述其儲存食物的習性，例如 store nuts for winter (為冬天儲存堅果)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>squirrel</target> quickly climbed up the oak tree and hid its acorn in a hole to save for the winter.","translation":"松鼠迅速爬上橡樹，將橡子藏在洞中以備冬天之用。","explanation":"名詞「松鼠」。"},{"sentence":"While walking in the park, the children were amused by a <target>squirrel</target> chasing another one across the grass.","translation":"在公園散步時，孩子們被一隻松鼠在草地上追著另一隻跑逗樂了。","explanation":"名詞「松鼠」。"}],"related_forms":["squirrels"]}

{"headword":"stable","explanation":"stable 作為形容詞指「穩定的、堅固的」，作為名詞指「馬廄」。常用搭配 a stable condition (穩定狀態) 或 remain stable (保持穩定)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the surgery, the patient's condition <pattern>remained</pattern> <target>stable</target>, and the doctors expected a full recovery soon.","translation":"手術後，病人的情況保持穩定，醫生預計很快會完全康復。","explanation":"形容詞「穩定的」。指狀態沒有劇烈波動。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new economic policies to ensure that the price of basic goods remains <target>stable</target> for everyone.","translation":"政府實施了新的經濟政策，以確保基本商品的價格對每個人來說都保持穩定。","explanation":"形容詞「穩定的」。指價格或情況不變動。"},{"sentence":"The farmer led his horse back to the <target>stable</target> after a long day of working in the fields.","translation":"農夫在田間工作了一整天後，將他的馬領回馬廄。","explanation":"名詞「馬廄」。指馬居住的場所。"}],"related_forms":["stability","stabilize"]}

{"headword":"stadium","explanation":"名詞「體育場」。常用搭配 a crowded stadium (擁擠的體育場) 或 fill the stadium (填滿體育場)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of fans gathered at the national <target>stadium</target> to cheer for their favorite team during the championship game.","translation":"數千名球迷聚集在國家體育場，在冠軍賽期間為他們最喜歡的隊伍加油。","explanation":"名詞「體育場」。指大型的戶外體育設施。"},{"sentence":"The city decided to build a new <target>stadium</target> with modern facilities to attract more international sporting events.","translation":"這座城市決定建造一座擁有現代設施的新體育場，以吸引更多的國際體育賽事。","explanation":"名詞「體育場」。"}],"related_forms":["stadiums","stadia"]}

{"headword":"staff","explanation":"名詞指「全體職員」，通常視為集合名詞，可用單複數動詞。動詞 staff 意為「為...配置人員」。注意 staff 與 employee 的區別：staff 強調的是一個組織的整體人員，而 employee 指個體的僱員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university <target>staff</target> <pattern>are</pattern> working hard to prepare the campus for the upcoming international conference next month.","translation":"大學的職員們正努力為下個月即將舉行的國際會議準備校園。","explanation":"名詞「全體職員」。此處視為複數，強調個體職員。"},{"sentence":"The hotel <target>staff</target> <pattern>was</pattern> extremely helpful and polite, making the guests feel welcome throughout their stay.","translation":"飯店的職員表現得非常友善且有禮貌，讓客人在入住期間感到賓至如歸。","explanation":"名詞「全體職員」。此處視為單數，強調一個整體單位。"},{"sentence":"The new research center needs to <target>staff</target> its laboratories <pattern>with</pattern> experienced scientists to conduct high-level experiments.","translation":"新的研究中心需要為其實驗室配置經驗豐富的科學家，以進行高水準的實驗。","explanation":"動詞「配置人員」。常用搭配：staff sth with sb」。"}],"related_forms":["staffs"]}

{"headword":"stale","explanation":"形容詞「不新鮮的、陳舊的」。常用於描述食物（如麵包）或想法、空氣等不再新鮮或有趣的事物。常用反義詞為 fresh。","entries":[{"sentence":"The leftover pizza had become <target>stale</target> after being left on the counter overnight, so he decided to throw it away.","translation":"剩下來的披薩在櫃檯放了一整晚後變得不新鮮了，所以他決定把它扔掉。","explanation":"形容詞「不新鮮的」。常用於描述麵包、餅乾等乾貨食物。"},{"sentence":"The room felt stuffy because the <target>stale</target> <pattern>air</pattern> had not been replaced by fresh air from the open window.","translation":"房間感覺很悶，因為陳舊的空氣沒有被開窗後的新鮮空氣所取代。","explanation":"形容詞「陳舊的」。常用搭配：stale air (陳舊的空氣)。"},{"sentence":"The politician's speech was filled with <target>stale</target> <pattern>jokes</pattern> that no one in the audience found funny or original.","translation":"這位政治家的演講充滿了陳舊的笑話，沒有一個聽眾覺得好笑或有創意。","explanation":"形容詞「陳舊的、乏味的」。常用於描述想法、笑話或內容。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "stare", "explanation": "動詞或名詞「凝視、盯著看」。通常指因為驚訝、好奇或憤怒而長時間地看。常用搭配 stare at (盯著...看)。注意與 gaze (深情凝視) 或 glance (瞥視) 的區區。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It is considered impolite to <target>stare</target> <pattern>at</pattern> strangers in public, as it can make them feel uncomfortable or judged.", "translation": "在公共場所盯著陌生人看被認為是不禮貌的，因為這會讓他們感到不舒服或被評判。", "explanation": "動詞「凝視」。常用搭配：stare at sb (盯著某人看)。"}, {"sentence": "The boy gave the strange sculpture a long, curious <target>stare</target> before asking the teacher about its mysterious origin.", "translation": "男孩對這座奇怪的雕塑進行了長時間的好奇凝視，然後向老師詢問其神秘的起源。", "explanation": "名詞「凝視」。指長時間地看。"}, {"sentence": "She <target>stared</target> <pattern>in</pattern> horror at the car accident, unable to believe what she had just witnessed on the road.", "translation": "她驚恐地盯著車禍看，不敢相信她剛剛在路上目睹了什麼。", "explanation": "動詞「凝視」。常用搭配：stare in horror/amazement (驚恐/驚訝地盯著看)。"}], "related_forms": ["staring"]}

{"headword":"starve","explanation":"動詞「飢餓、挨餓」。除了指生理上的飢餓，也常用於誇張地表示「非常渴望」某種事物。常用搭配 starve to death (餓死)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many refugees in the war-torn region are <target>starving</target> because they have no access to clean water and sufficient food.","translation":"戰爭蹂躪地區的許多難民正處於飢餓之中，因為他們無法獲得乾淨的水和充足的食物。","explanation":"動詞「飢餓」。指生理上的極端飢餓。"},{"sentence":"I haven't eaten anything since breakfast, and I am <target>starving</target>! Let's find a restaurant and have a big lunch.","translation":"我從早餐後就沒吃任何東西，我快餓死了！我們找家餐廳吃頓豐盛的午餐吧。","explanation":"動詞「飢餓」。在口語中常用於誇張地表示非常飢餓。"},{"sentence":"The stray dog was so thin that it looked as if it were about to <target>starve</target> <pattern>to death</pattern> without help.","translation":"這隻流浪狗如此瘦弱，看起來就像如果不幫忙的話就快要餓死了。","explanation":"動詞片語 starve to death 表「餓死」。"}],"related_forms":["starvation","starving"]}

{"headword":"statue","explanation":"名詞「雕像、雕塑」。通常指人或動物的全身像。注意與 sculpture (雕塑) 的區別：statue 專指雕像，而 sculpture 是更廣義的雕塑藝術。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists gathered around the giant bronze <target>statue</target> of the national hero, admiring the detailed craftsmanship of the artwork.","translation":"遊客們聚集在國家英雄的巨大青銅雕像周圍，讚賞這件藝術品精細的工藝。","explanation":"名詞「雕像」。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to erect a <target>statue</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the center of the park to commemorate the city's founder.","translation":"市議會決定在公園中心豎立一座雕像，以紀念城市的創始人。","explanation":"名詞「雕像」。常用搭配：erect a statue (豎立雕像)。"}],"related_forms":["statues"]}

{"headword":"steady","explanation":"形容詞「穩定的、持續的」；動詞「使穩定」；副詞「穩定地」。常用於描述速度、心跳、手部動作或情緒狀態。常用搭配 keep a steady pace (保持穩定的步伐)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To improve your long-distance running performance, it is important to maintain a <target>steady</target> <pattern>pace</pattern> throughout the race.","translation":"為了提高長距離跑步的表現，在比賽過程中保持穩定的步伐非常重要。","explanation":"形容詞「穩定的」。常用搭配：steady pace (穩定的步伐)。"},{"sentence":"The surgeon's hands must remain <target>steady</target> during the operation to ensure the precision and safety of the procedure.","translation":"外科醫生的手在手術期間必須保持穩定，以確保手術的精確度和安全性。","explanation":"形容詞「穩定的」。指動作或位置不搖晃。"},{"sentence":"He <target>steadied</target> himself <pattern>against</pattern> the wall after feeling a sudden dizzy spell, waiting for the world to stop spinning.","translation":"在感到突然暈眩後，他扶著牆壁穩住身體，等待世界停止旋轉。","explanation":"動詞「使穩定」。常用搭配：steady oneself against sth (扶著...穩住身體)。"},{"sentence":"The car moved <target>steadily</target> up the steep mountain road, eventually reaching the peak just before the sun set.","translation":"汽車穩定地沿著陡峭的山路向上行駛，最終在太陽下山前到達了山頂。","explanation":"副詞「穩定地」。指持續且不變的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["steadily","steadiness"]}

{"headword":"steal","explanation":"動詞「偷竊」。注意與 rob (搶劫) 的區別：steal 後接「被偷的東西」，而 rob 後接「被搶的人或地點」，例如 steal money (偷錢) 或 rob a bank (搶銀行)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Someone tried to <target>steal</target> his wallet from his pocket while he was crowded in the subway during the rush hour.","translation":"在他趕上下班高峰時段的地鐵擠單時，有人試圖從他的口袋裡偷走他的錢包。","explanation":"動詞「偷竊」。後接被偷的物品。"},{"sentence":"The thief managed to <target>steal</target> a precious diamond ring from the museum, but the police caught him a few hours later.","translation":"小偷成功從博物館偷走了一枚珍貴的鑽戒，但警察在幾個小時後將他抓獲。","explanation":"動詞「偷竊」。"},{"sentence":"It is said that some people <target>steal</target> ideas <pattern>from</pattern> others to claim them as their own in academic papers.","translation":"據說有些人從他人那裡偷取想法，以便在學術論文中將其據為己有。","explanation":"動詞「偷竊」。此處指抽象的偷取想法。"}],"related_forms":["stolen","stealing","stealth"]}

{"headword": "steam", "explanation": "名詞「蒸氣」；動詞「蒸」。常用於描述水加熱後產生的氣體，或指用蒸氣加熱食物。口語中 run out of steam 意為「失去動力/動力不足」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Thick white <target>steam</target> rose from the boiling pot of water on the stove, filling the kitchen with a warm mist.", "translation": "爐子上沸騰的水鍋中升起濃濃的蒸氣，使廚房充滿了溫暖的霧氣。", "explanation": "名詞「蒸氣」。"}, {"sentence": "The chef decided to <target>steam</target> the vegetables instead of frying them to preserve more nutrients and a healthier taste.", "translation": "廚師決定將蔬菜蒸熟而不是油炸，以保留更多營養和更健康的口感。", "explanation": "動詞「蒸」。指用蒸氣烹飪。"}, {"sentence": "The athlete started the race with great energy, but he <pattern>ran</pattern> <target>out of steam</target> in the last hundred meters.", "translation": "這名運動員以極大的能量開始比賽，但在最後一百公尺處失去了動力。", "explanation": "動詞片語 run out of steam 意為「失去動力」。"}, {"sentence": "Although the project team worked hard for the first few months, they eventually <pattern>ran</pattern> <target>out of steam</target> before the deadline arrived.", "translation": "雖然專案小組在最初的幾個月裡非常努力工作，但他們最終在截止日期前失去了動力。", "explanation": "動詞片語 run out of steam 意為「失去動力」。"}], "related_forms": ["steaming", "steamy"]}

{"headword":"steep","explanation":"形容詞「陡峭的、價格昂貴的」。除了描述地理形狀（如山坡），也常用於描述價格突然升高或非常高。常用反義詞為 gentle (平緩的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers struggled to climb the <target>steep</target> <pattern>slope</pattern> of the mountain, as the path was narrow and covered in loose rocks.","translation":"登山客們辛苦地攀登山上的陡坡，因為路徑狹窄且佈滿鬆動的岩石。","explanation":"形容詞「陡峭的」。常用搭配：steep slope (陡坡)。"},{"sentence":"Many students find the <target>steep</target> <pattern>price</pattern> of university textbooks too expensive, leading them to buy used books instead.","translation":"許多學生發現大學教科書的價格太高，導致他們轉而購買二手書。","explanation":"形容詞「昂貴的」。常用搭配：steep price (昂貴的價格)。"},{"sentence":"There has been a <target>steep</target> <pattern>increase</pattern> in the cost of living over the past few years, affecting many young families.","translation":"過去幾年生活成本大幅增加，影響了許多年輕家庭。","explanation":"形容詞「大幅的、劇烈的」。常用搭配：steep increase (劇增)。"}],"related_forms":["steeply"]}

{"headword":"sticky","explanation":"形容詞「黏的、棘手的」。常用於描述觸感（如蜂蜜）或困難處理的情況（situation）。","entries":[{"sentence":"After eating the honey-glazed chicken, the child's hands became <target>sticky</target>, so his mother asked him to wash them immediately.","translation":"在吃完蜜汁雞後，孩子的手變得黏黏的，所以他的母親要求他立即洗手。","explanation":"形容詞「黏的」。指觸感黏稠。"},{"sentence":"The humid weather in Taiwan during the summer makes the air feel <target>sticky</target> and uncomfortable for many people.","translation":"台灣夏季潮濕的天氣讓空氣感覺黏膩且不舒服。","explanation":"形容詞「黏膩的」。常用於描述潮濕的天氣。"},{"sentence":"The manager found himself in a <target>sticky</target> <pattern>situation</pattern> when two of his best employees started arguing during the meeting.","translation":"當兩名最優秀的員工在會議中開始爭吵時，經理發現自己陷入了一個棘手的局面。","explanation":"形容詞「棘手的」。常用搭配：sticky situation (棘手的局面)。"}],"related_forms":["stickiness","stick"]}

{"headword":"stiff","explanation":"形容詞「僵硬的、死板的」。可用於描述肌肉僵硬、物體不易彎曲，或指價格、態度死板。常考搭配：stiff competition (激烈的競爭), stiff breeze (強風)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After running a marathon for the first time, the athlete felt her leg muscles were <target>stiff</target> and sore the next morning.","translation":"第一次跑馬拉松後，這位運動員發現第二天早上她的腿部肌肉僵硬且酸痛。","explanation":"形容詞「僵硬的」。指肌肉或身體部位因疲勞或受傷而僵硬。"},{"sentence":"The new employee felt a bit <target>stiff</target> during the interview, but he eventually relaxed and answered the questions confidently.","translation":"新員工在面試過程中感到有些僵硬，但最終他放鬆下來並自信地回答了問題。","explanation":"形容詞「僵硬的」。指人的態度或舉止死板、不自然。"},{"sentence":"The company faced <target>stiff</target> <pattern>competition</pattern> from several international brands, forcing them to lower their prices to stay competitive.","translation":"這家公司面臨來自幾個國際品牌的激烈競爭，迫使他們降低價格以保持競爭力。","explanation":"形容詞「激烈的」。常用搭配：stiff competition (激烈競爭)。"}],"related_forms":["stiffness"]}

{"headword": "sting", "explanation": "動詞「刺、螫」或「感到刺痛」；名詞「刺痛、螫傷」。注意其比喻用法，如 a sting in the tail (出乎意料的糟糕結果)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hiker was careful not to be <target>stung</target> by any bees while walking through the forest, as he was allergic to their venom.", "translation": "徒步旅行者在森林中行走時很小心不要被蜜蜂螫到，因為他對蜜蜂毒液過敏。", "explanation": "動詞「螫」。指昆蟲用針刺人。"}, {"sentence": "The cold wind <target>stung</target> her cheeks as she waited for the bus in the middle of winter, making her face feel numb.", "translation": "冬日正午她在等公車時，寒風刺痛了她的臉頰，讓她的臉感到麻木。", "explanation": "動詞「刺痛」。指強烈的感覺，如寒冷或化學物質產生的痛感。"}, {"sentence": "He felt a sharp <target>sting</target> in his finger after accidentally touching a jellyfish while swimming in the ocean during the summer vacation.", "translation": "在暑假游泳游泳時，他不小心觸碰到水母後，手指感到一陣銳利的刺痛。", "explanation": "名詞「刺痛」。指突然而強烈的痛感。"}], "related_forms": ["stings", "stung", "stinging"]}

{"headword":"stir","explanation":"動詞「攪拌」或「激起(情緒)」；名詞「騷動、興奮」。常考片語 stir up (激起、挑起)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef told the students to <target>stir</target> the soup slowly <pattern>with</pattern> a wooden spoon to prevent it from burning at the bottom.","translation":"廚師告訴學生用木匙緩緩攪拌湯品，以防止底部燒焦。","explanation":"動詞「攪拌」。常用搭配：stir sth with sth。"},{"sentence":"The politician's controversial speech <target>stirred</target> <pattern>up</pattern> a lot of anger among the local residents, leading to a large protest in the city center.","translation":"這位政治家的爭議性演講激起了當地居民的強烈憤怒，導致市中心發生大規模抗議。","explanation":"動詞片語 stir up 意為「激起/挑起」某種負面情緒或爭議。"},{"sentence":"The sudden announcement of the school's new policy caused a great <target>stir</target> among students and teachers alike.","translation":"學校新政策的突然宣布在學生和教師之間引起了巨大的騷動。","explanation":"名詞「騷動」。指引起人們關注或興奮的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["stirs","stirring"]}

{"headword":"stitch","explanation":"名詞「一針、縫線」或「側腹痛」；動詞「縫」。常用片語 in stitches (大笑不止)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tailor carefully made every <target>stitch</target> in the luxury dress to ensure it looked perfect for the wedding ceremony.","translation":"裁縫師在奢華禮服上的每一針都小心地縫製，以確保它在婚禮儀式上看起來完美無瑕。","explanation":"名詞「一針、縫線」。指縫紉時的單個線圈。"},{"sentence":"The doctor used several <target>stitches</target> to close the deep cut on the athlete's arm after the accident during the basketball game.","translation":"醫生用幾針縫線閉合了運動員在籃球賽事故中手臂上的深切口。","explanation":"名詞「縫線」。指手術或醫療上的縫合。"},{"sentence":"The comedian's jokes were so funny that the entire audience was <pattern>in</pattern> <target>stitches</target> for several minutes.","translation":"喜劇演員的笑話太好笑了，以至於整個觀眾席在幾分鐘內大笑不止。","explanation":"名詞片語 in stitches 意為「大笑不止」。"},{"sentence":"She decided to <target>stitch</target> the torn part of her favorite bag <pattern>by</pattern> hand to save money instead of buying a new one.","translation":"她決定親手縫補她最喜歡的包包破損的部分，以省錢而非購買新包。","explanation":"動詞「縫」。"}],"related_forms":["stitched","stitching"]}

{"headword":"stomach","explanation":"名詞「胃、肚子」；動詞「忍受」。注意其動詞用法，常以否定形式出現，如 cannot stomach (無法忍受)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student felt a sharp pain in his <target>stomach</target> after eating too much spicy food at the night market, which made him feel sick.","translation":"這名學生在夜市吃了太多辛辣食物後，胃部感到劇痛，令他感到不適。","explanation":"名詞「胃」。指身體器官。"},{"sentence":"I simply cannot <target>stomach</target> the way he treats his colleagues with such rudeness, even though he is the manager of the company.","translation":"我實在無法忍受他對待同事如此粗魯的方式，即使他是公司的經理。","explanation":"動詞「忍受」。常指對某事感到厭惡而無法容忍。"},{"sentence":"She had a <target>stomach</target> <pattern>ache</pattern> before the important presentation, which is a common symptom of nervousness and stress.","translation":"在重要的簡報前，她感到胃痛，這是緊張和壓力常見的症狀。","explanation":"名詞搭配 stomach ache (胃痛)。"}],"related_forms":["stomachs"]}
