{"headword":"stool","explanation":"名詞「凳子」或「糞便」。在 GSAT 考題中，通常指簡單的無靠背凳子。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist sat on a high wooden <target>stool</target> while painting the portrait, allowing him to see the model from a better angle.","translation":"藝術家在畫肖像時坐在高木凳上，使他能從更好的角度觀察模特兒。","explanation":"名詞「凳子」。指無靠背的座椅。"},{"sentence":"In the laboratory, students used a <target>stool</target> to reach the high shelves where the chemicals were stored.","translation":"在實驗室中，學生使用凳子來夠到存放化學藥劑的高層架子。","explanation":"名詞「凳子」。"}],"related_forms":["stools"]}

{"headword":"stormy","explanation":"形容詞「暴風雨的、激烈的」。可用於描述天氣或指情緒、關係緊張。常用片語 a stormy relationship (緊張的關係)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sailors struggled to keep the ship steady during the <target>stormy</target> night, as huge waves crashed against the boat.","translation":"在暴風雨之夜，水手們努力讓船保持穩定，因為巨浪不斷拍擊船身。","explanation":"形容詞「暴風雨的」。描述天氣。"},{"sentence":"The couple had a <target>stormy</target> <pattern>relationship</pattern> for years, characterized by frequent arguments and sudden emotional outbursts.","translation":"這對夫妻多年來關係緊張，其特點是經常爭吵和突然的情緒爆發。","explanation":"形容詞「激烈的、緊張的」。常用搭配：stormy relationship (緊張的關係)。"}],"related_forms":["storm"]}

{"headword":"stove","explanation":"名詞「爐灶、爐子」。指用於烹飪或加熱的設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please be careful not to touch the <target>stove</target> while it is hot, as you could get a serious burn on your hand.","translation":"爐灶發熱時請小心不要觸碰，否則你的手可能會被嚴重燙傷。","explanation":"名詞「爐灶」。"},{"sentence":"She placed the pot of boiling water on the electric <target>stove</target> and waited for the pasta to cook through.","translation":"她將一鍋沸水放在電爐上，等待義大利麵煮熟。","explanation":"名詞「爐灶」。常用搭配：electric stove (電爐)。"}],"related_forms":["stoves"]}

{"headword":"strategy","explanation":"名詞「策略、計畫」。指為了達成特定目標而制定的周密計畫。常用片語 employ a strategy (採取策略), implement a strategy (執行策略)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The basketball coach developed a new <target>strategy</target> <pattern>to</pattern> defeat the opposing team, focusing on a strong defense and quick fast breaks.","translation":"籃球教練制定了一套新策略以擊敗對手，側重於強大的防守和快速反擊。","explanation":"名詞「策略」。搭配 to + V 表示目的。"},{"sentence":"To improve her English grades, the student <pattern>employed</pattern> a different study <target>strategy</target>, such as using flashcards and practicing speaking every day.","translation":"為了提高英文成績，這名學生採取了不同的學習策略，例如使用單字卡和每天練習口說。","explanation":"名詞「策略」。常用動詞搭配：employ a strategy (採取策略)。"},{"sentence":"The company <pattern>implemented</pattern> a long-term <target>strategy</target> <pattern>to</pattern> increase their market share by expanding into new international markets.","translation":"公司執行了一項長期策略，透過擴展到新的國際市場來增加其市場佔有率。","explanation":"名詞「策略」。常用動詞搭配：implement a strategy (執行策略)。"}],"related_forms":["strategic","strategically"]}

{"headword": "straw", "explanation": "名詞「稻草」或「吸管」。常用片語 the last straw (最後一根稻草/壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer used bundles of dry <target>straw</target> to cover the ground, protecting the young plants from the freezing winter cold.", "translation": "農夫用捆好的乾稻草覆蓋地面，保護幼苗免於冬季的嚴寒。", "explanation": "名詞「稻草」。"}, {"sentence": "To reduce plastic waste, many cafes now provide paper <target>straws</target> instead of plastic ones to protect the ocean environment.", "translation": "名詞「吸管」。為了減少塑料垃圾，許多咖啡店現在提供紙吸管而非塑料吸管，以保護海洋環境。", "explanation": "名詞「吸管」。"}, {"sentence": "After months of stress and failure, the small mistake became the last <target>straw</target> that finally made her decide to quit her job.", "translation": "經過數月的壓力與失敗，這個小錯誤成了壓垮她的最後一根稻草，終於讓她決定辭職。", "explanation": "名詞片語 the last straw 意為「最後一根稻草」，指導致情況惡化而無法忍受的最終事件。"}], "related_forms": ["straws"]}

{"headword":"strength","explanation":"名詞，意為「力量」、「強度」或「長處」。常用於描述身體力量 (physical strength)、心理韌性 (mental strength) 或某人的優勢 (one's strength)。注意與形容詞 strong 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite his small size, the athlete possessed incredible physical <target>strength</target>, allowing him to lift heavy weights with ease.","translation":"儘管體型嬌小，這位運動員擁有驚人的體力，使他能輕鬆舉起沉重的重量。","explanation":"名詞「力量」。指身體上的力量。"},{"sentence":"The bridge was built with high-quality steel to ensure its <target>strength</target> and durability against strong winds and earthquakes.","translation":"這座橋是用高品質鋼材建造的，以確保其強度和耐用性，能抵禦強風和地震。","explanation":"名詞「強度」。指物體的堅固程度。"},{"sentence":"When writing a college application essay, students are often encouraged to focus on their <target>strengths</target> rather than their weaknesses.","translation":"在撰寫大學申請論文時，學生通常被鼓勵專注於他們的長處而非缺點。","explanation":"名詞「長處」。常用於描述人的優勢。"}],"related_forms":["strengths"]}

{"headword":"strip","explanation":"名詞指「條、帶」，動詞指「剝去、脫掉」或「剝奪」。注意動詞用法 strip sth of sth (剝奪某人某物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist used a long <target>strip</target> <pattern>of</pattern> colored paper to create a unique border for the school's art exhibition poster.","translation":"藝術家使用一條長長的彩色紙條來為學校藝術展的海報製作一個獨特的邊框。","explanation":"名詞「條、帶」。常用搭配 a strip of sth。"},{"sentence":"To prepare the old wooden table for painting, the carpenter had to <target>strip</target> the old varnish <pattern>off</pattern> the surface.","translation":"為了準備將舊木桌上漆，木工必須將表面的舊漆剝除。","explanation":"動詞「剝除」。常用搭配 strip sth off sth。"},{"sentence":"The athlete was <target>stripped</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his Olympic gold medal after the committee discovered he had used banned substances.","translation":"在委員會發現他使用禁藥後，這位運動員被剝奪了奧運金牌。","explanation":"動詞「剝奪」。常用片語 strip sb of sth。"}],"related_forms":["strips","stripped","stripping"]}

{"headword":"structure","explanation":"名詞可指「建築物」、「結構」或「組織方式」。常用於描述物體的物理組成或文章、語言的邏輯結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient stone <target>structure</target> found in the jungle was believed to be a temple built by a lost civilization.","translation":"在叢林中發現的古代石造建築被認為是由一個失落文明建造的寺廟。","explanation":"名詞「建築物」。指物理上的構造物。"},{"sentence":"To improve their writing, students should learn how to <pattern>organize</pattern> the <target>structure</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their essays more logically.","translation":"為了提高寫作能力，學生應該學習如何更邏輯地組織文章的結構。","explanation":"名詞「結構」。指文章或系統的組織方式。"},{"sentence":"Scientists use X-ray crystallography to study the molecular <target>structure</target> <pattern>of</pattern> proteins to understand how they function in the body.","translation":"科學家使用 X 射線晶體學來研究蛋白質的分子結構，以了解它們在體內如何運作。","explanation":"名詞「結構」。指物質的微觀組成。"}],"related_forms":["structural"]}

{"headword":"stubborn","explanation":"形容詞「頑固的、倔強的」。指不願意改變想法或意見的人。常用於描述性格或困難解決的問題。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>stubborn</target> child refused to eat his vegetables, even though his parents promised him a toy if he finished them.","translation":"那個頑固的孩子拒絕吃蔬菜，儘管他的父母承諾如果他吃完會給他一個玩具。","explanation":"形容詞「頑固的」。指人不想改變主意。"},{"sentence":"Despite the teacher's patient explanation, the student remained <target>stubborn</target> and insisted that his answer was correct.","translation":"儘管老師耐心地解釋，該學生仍然頑固地堅持認為自己的答案是正確的。","explanation":"形容詞「頑固的」。"},{"sentence":"The cleaning crew spent hours trying to remove a <target>stubborn</target> <pattern>stain</pattern> from the white carpet in the school library.","translation":"清潔人員花了數小時試圖去除學校圖書館白色地毯上的一塊頑固污漬。","explanation":"形容詞「頑固的/難除的」。常用搭配 stubborn stain (難除的污漬)。"}],"related_forms":["stubbornly","stubbornness"]}

{"headword":"studio","explanation":"名詞「工作室、攝影棚、錄音室」。指專門用於藝術創作、錄音或拍攝的場所。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist spent most of her time in her <target>studio</target>, painting large canvases of the city's skyline and busy streets.","translation":"這位藝術家大部分時間都在她的工作室裡，繪製城市天際線和繁忙街道的大型畫布。","explanation":"名詞「工作室」。指藝術家的創作空間。"},{"sentence":"The band traveled to a professional recording <target>studio</target> to record their first album with a high-quality sound system.","translation":"該樂團前往一家專業的錄音室錄製他們的第一張專輯，使用了高品質的音響系統。","explanation":"名詞「錄音室」。"},{"sentence":"The news anchor was nervous before stepping into the <target>studio</target> for the live broadcast of the national election results.","translation":"新聞主播在進入攝影棚進行全國選舉結果的現場直播前感到緊張。","explanation":"名詞「攝影棚」。"}],"related_forms":["studios"]}

{"headword":"stuff","explanation":"名詞「東西、材料」；動詞「填充、塞滿」。名詞用法較為非正式，常用於指代不具體的事物。動詞用法注意搭配 stuff sth into sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before leaving for the trip, he quickly packed all his <target>stuff</target> into a large suitcase, forgetting some of his basic needs.","translation":"出發旅行前，他迅速將所有東西裝進一個大行李箱，卻忘記了一些基本需求。","explanation":"名詞「東西」。非正式用法。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to put away their <target>stuff</target> and focus on the lesson before the final bell rang.","translation":"老師要求學生在最後一聲鐘響前把東西收拾好，並專注於課程。","explanation":"名詞「東西」。"},{"sentence":"The boy tried to <target>stuff</target> his dirty laundry <pattern>into</pattern> the small drawer, but it was too full to close properly.","translation":"男孩試圖將髒衣服塞進小抽屜，但抽屜太滿而無法正常關閉。","explanation":"動詞「塞滿」。常用搭配 stuff sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"To make the scarecrow look more realistic, the farmers <target>stuffed</target> the old clothes <pattern>with</pattern> straw and dry leaves.","translation":"為了讓稻草人看起來更真實，農民用稻草和乾葉將舊衣服填充起來。","explanation":"動詞「填充」。常用搭配 stuff with sth。"}],"related_forms":["stuffs","stuffed","stuffing"]}

{"headword":"substance","explanation":"名詞「物質、實體」。常用於科學語境中描述化學物質或實體物。注意區分 substance 與 material 的區別：substance 側重於化學組成或性質，而 material 側重於用途。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientists discovered a mysterious <target>substance</target> in the water sample, which they suspected was a harmful chemical pollutant.","translation":"科學家在水樣中發現了一種神祕的物質，他們懷疑這是一種有害的化學污染物。","explanation":"名詞「物質」。指化學成分。"},{"sentence":"The police found a sticky <target>substance</target> on the handle of the safe, which helped them identify the thief's fingerprints.","translation":"警方在保險箱的把手發現了一種黏稠的物質，這有助於他們辨識小偷的指紋。","explanation":"名詞「物質」。指物理狀態的實體物。"},{"sentence":"The critic argued that the movie's plot lacked <target>substance</target>, focusing only on special effects rather than a deep story.","translation":"評論家認為這部電影的劇情缺乏深度（實體），僅專注於特效而非深刻的故事。","explanation":"名詞「實體/深度」。比喻用法，指內容缺乏實質內容。"}],"related_forms":["substantial","substantially"]}

{"headword":"subtract","explanation":"動詞「減去、扣除」。數學運算中的減法，對應的名詞為 subtraction。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the elementary math class, the teacher showed the students how to <target>subtract</target> a smaller number <pattern>from</pattern> a larger one.","translation":"在小學數學課上，老師向學生展示如何從較大的數字中減去較小的數字。","explanation":"動詞「減去」。常用搭配 subtract A from B。"},{"sentence":"If you <target>subtract</target> the cost of shipping <pattern>from</pattern> the total price, the actual price of the product is quite affordable.","translation":"如果你從總價中扣除運費，該產品的實際價格相當實惠。","explanation":"動詞「扣除」。"}],"related_forms":["subtraction"]}

{"headword":"suburb","explanation":"名詞「郊區」。指城市邊緣的住宅區。常用搭配 in the suburbs (在郊區)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many families prefer to live <pattern>in the</pattern> <target>suburbs</target> because the environment is quieter and the air is fresher than in the city center.","translation":"許多家庭喜歡住在郊區，因為那裡的環境較安靜且空氣比市中心更清新。","explanation":"名詞「郊區」。常用搭配 in the suburbs。"},{"sentence":"The new shopping mall was built in a quiet <target>suburb</target> of the city, making it more accessible for residents living nearby.","translation":"這個新購物中心建在該市的一個安靜郊區，使附近居民更容易前往。","explanation":"名詞「郊區」。"}],"related_forms":["suburban"]}

{"headword":"suck","explanation":"動詞「吸、吮」。名詞指「吸力」。注意動詞片語 suck up (吸乾、吸收)。注意在口語中 suck 亦可指「拍馬屁」或「表現糟糕」，但 GSAT 考點考查的是基本義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baby began to <target>suck</target> <pattern>on</pattern> her thumb when she felt tired and wanted to fall asleep.","translation":"寶寶在感到疲倦想睡覺時，開始吮吸她的拇指。","explanation":"動詞「吮吸」。常用搭配 suck on sth。"},{"sentence":"The powerful vacuum cleaner can <target>suck</target> <pattern>up</pattern> all the dust and small pieces of paper from the carpet.","translation":"強大的吸塵器能將地毯上的所有灰塵和小紙屑吸乾。","explanation":"動詞片語 suck up 表「吸入、吸收」。"},{"sentence":"The scientist used a special pump to <target>suck</target> the air <pattern>out of</pattern> the glass container to create a vacuum.","translation":"科學家使用特殊泵將玻璃容器中的空氣吸出，以製造真空。","explanation":"動詞「吸出」。常用搭配 suck out of sth。"}],"related_forms":["sucking"]}

{"headword":"suffer","explanation":"動詞，意為「遭受、忍受」。常考搭配 suffer from (患有...病/遭受...苦), suffer a loss (遭受損失)。注意 suffer from 側重於長期的疾病或狀態，而 suffer 單接名詞時，常指遭受具體的損失或打擊。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many elderly people <target>suffer</target> <pattern>from</pattern> loneliness after their children move away to start their own lives in other cities.","translation":"許多長者在孩子們搬到其他城市開始自己的生活後，遭受著孤單之苦。","explanation":"動詞片語 suffer from 表示「患有」或「遭受」某種長期的負面狀態。"},{"sentence":"The local economy <target>suffered</target> <pattern>a heavy loss</pattern> after the factory closed down, leaving many workers unemployed and without income.","translation":"工廠倒閉後，當地經濟遭受了沉重損失，導致許多工人失業且沒有收入。","explanation":"動詞「遭受」。常用搭配 suffer a loss (遭受損失)。"},{"sentence":"Students who do not get enough sleep often <target>suffer</target> <pattern>from</pattern> poor concentration in class, which affects their overall academic performance.","translation":"睡眠不足的學生經常在課堂上注意力不集中，這影響了他們的整體學業表現。","explanation":"動詞片語 suffer from 表「患有」或「受...之苦」。"}],"related_forms":["suffered","suffering","sufferer"]}

{"headword":"sufficient","explanation":"形容詞，意為「充足的」。近義詞為 enough。常用搭配 sufficient amount of (足夠量的...), sufficient evidence (充足的證據)。注意它比 enough 更正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government must ensure that there is a <target>sufficient</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> clean water for all residents during the severe drought.","translation":"政府必須確保在嚴重乾旱期間，所有居民都有充足的乾淨飲用水。","explanation":"形容詞「充足的」。常用搭配 sufficient amount of (足夠量的)。"},{"sentence":"The police decided to release the suspect because they did not have <target>sufficient</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> to prove his guilt in court.","translation":"警方決定釋放嫌疑人，因為他們沒有充足的證據在法庭上證明他的有罪。","explanation":"形容詞「充足的」。常用搭配 sufficient evidence (充足的證據)。"}],"related_forms":["sufficiently","insufficiency","insufficient"]}

{"headword": "suicide", "explanation": "名詞，意為「自殺」。常考搭配 commit suicide (自殺)。注意 commit 在此處指進行某種非法或不道德的行為。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The mental health counselor worked hard to prevent teenagers from <pattern>committing</pattern> <target>suicide</target> by providing them with emotional support and guidance.", "translation": "心理健康諮詢師努力防止青少年自殺，透過為他們提供情感支持和指導。", "explanation": "名詞「自殺」。常用搭配 commit suicide (自殺)。"}, {"sentence": "The city government is launching a new campaign to raise awareness about the warning signs of <target>suicide</target> and provide emergency help.", "translation": "市政府正在發起一項新活動，以提高人們對自殺預警信號的認識並提供緊急幫助。", "explanation": "名詞「自殺」。作為主語或賓語使用。"}, {"sentence": "A high level of stress and loneliness can increase the risk of <target>suicide</target> among young adults who feel isolated from society.", "translation": "高水準的壓力與孤獨感會增加年輕成年人自殺的風險，尤其是那些感到與社會隔絕的人。", "explanation": "名詞「自殺」。"}], "related_forms": ["suicidal"]}

{"headword": "sum", "explanation": "名詞意為「金額」或「總額」；動詞意為「概括」或「總結」。名詞常用搭配 a sum of money (一筆錢)；動詞常用片語 sum up (總結)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scholarship provided a large <target>sum</target> <pattern>of money</pattern> to help the student pay for his university tuition and living expenses.", "translation": "該獎學金提供了一筆巨額資金，幫助該學生支付大學學費和生活費。", "explanation": "名詞「金額」。常用搭配 a sum of money (一筆錢)。"}, {"sentence": "At the end of the presentation, the teacher <target>summed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the main points of the lecture to help students remember the key information.", "translation": "在簡報結束時，老師總結了講座的主要重點，以幫助學生記住關鍵資訊。", "explanation": "動詞片語 sum up 表示「總結」。"}, {"sentence": "The total <target>sum</target> of the items in the shopping cart was surprising, so she decided to remove a few things to stay within her budget.", "translation": "購物車中物品的總額令人驚訝，因此她決定刪除幾件東西以保持在預算之內。", "explanation": "名詞「總額」。"}, {"sentence": "To <target>sum</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the situation, the new policy has brought more benefits than drawbacks, but it still needs some adjustments.", "translation": "總結來說，這種新政策帶來的好處多於缺點，但仍需要一些調整。", "explanation": "動詞片語 sum up 表示「總結」。"}, {"sentence": "The company invested a substantial <target>sum</target> in research and development to ensure their products remain competitive in the global market.", "translation": "公司投資了一筆可觀的金額在研發方面，以確保其產品在全球市場上保持競爭力。", "explanation": "名詞「金額」。"}], "related_forms": ["summation", "summary"]}

{"headword": "summary", "explanation": "名詞，意為「概要、總結」。常用搭配 in summary (總結來說)。注意它與 sum up (動詞) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before submitting the final report, the student wrote a brief <target>summary</target> of the research findings to provide an overview for the reader.", "translation": "在提交最終報告之前，學生寫了一份研究結果的簡短概要，為讀者提供一個概覽。", "explanation": "名詞「概要」。指對文章或研究的簡短總結。"}, {"sentence": "<pattern>In</pattern> <target>summary</target>, the new policy aims to reduce pollution and improve the overall quality of life for all citizens in the city.", "translation": "總結來說，新政策旨在減少污染並提高城市中所有公民的整體生活品質。", "explanation": "名詞片語 In summary 表示「總結來說」，常用於文章結尾。"}], "related_forms": ["summarize", "summarization"]}

{"headword":"summit","explanation":"名詞，意為「頂峰」或「最高級會議」。常用於描述山頂或最高級別的政治領導人會議。","entries":[{"sentence":"After days of climbing, the team of explorers finally reached the <target>summit</target> of Mount Everest and planted their flag in the snow.","translation":"經過數日的攀登，探險隊終於到達了聖母峰的頂峰並在雪地中插上了他們的旗幟。","explanation":"名詞「頂峰」。指山頂。"},{"sentence":"The world leaders met at the annual <target>summit</target> to discuss urgent global issues such as climate change and international trade agreements.","translation":"世界領導人參加了年度最高級會議，討論緊急的全球議題，如氣候變遷和國際貿易協定。","explanation":"名詞「最高級會議」。指國家領導人的會議。"}],"related_forms":["summits"]}

{"headword":"superior","explanation":"形容詞意為「較優秀的」或「上級的」；名詞意為「上司」。形容詞常接介系詞 to (superior to...)，表示「比...更優秀」。注意不要用 than。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new model of the smartphone is <target>superior</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the previous version in terms of battery life and camera quality.","translation":"這款新手機在電池壽命和相機品質方面比之前的版本更優秀。","explanation":"形容詞「較優秀的」。常用搭配 superior to (比...更優秀)。"},{"sentence":"The employee decided to report the problem to his <target>superior</target> after he realized that he could not solve it on his own.","translation":"員工在意識到自己無法獨自解決問題後，決定將問題報告給他的上司。","explanation":"名詞「上司」。指職位比自己高的人。"},{"sentence":"The manager believed that her leadership skills were <target>superior</target> <pattern>to</pattern> those of her colleagues, which made her very confident.","translation":"經理相信她的領導能力比同事們的更優秀，這使她非常有信心。","explanation":"形容詞「較優秀的」。常用搭配 superior to (比...更優秀)。"}],"related_forms":["superiority"]}

{"headword":"surround","explanation":"動詞，意為「圍繞、包圍」。常用搭配 be surrounded by (被...圍繞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small village is <target>surrounded</target> <pattern>by</pattern> high mountains and a clear blue lake, making it a peaceful place to live.","translation":"這個小村莊被高山和清澈的藍色湖泊所圍繞，使其成為一個寧靜的居住地。","explanation":"動詞「圍繞」。常用搭配 be surrounded by (被...圍繞)。"},{"sentence":"When the fire alarm went off, the students were <target>surrounded</target> <pattern>by</pattern> smoke, making it difficult for them to find the exit.","translation":"當火警警報響起時，學生們被煙霧包圍，導致他們很難找到出口。","explanation":"動詞「圍繞」。常用搭配 be surrounded by (被...圍繞)。"}],"related_forms":["surroundings","surrounding"]}

{"headword": "survey", "explanation": "名詞意為「調查、問卷」；動詞意為「調查、概觀」。常用搭配 conduct a survey (進行調查), take a survey (填寫問卷)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The marketing team decided to <pattern>conduct</pattern> a <target>survey</target> to understand why customers were not satisfied with the new product.", "translation": "行銷團隊決定進行一項調查，以了解為什麼客戶對新產品不滿意。", "explanation": "名詞「調查」。常用搭配 conduct a survey (進行調查)。"}, {"sentence": "Many students were asked to <pattern>take</pattern> a <target>survey</target> regarding their study habits to help the school improve its teaching methods.", "translation": "許多學生被要求填寫一份關於學習習慣的問卷，以幫助學校改善教學方法。", "explanation": "名詞「調查/問卷」。常用搭配 take a survey (填寫問卷)。"}, {"sentence": "From the top of the hill, the hiker <target>surveyed</target> the landscape, admiring the beauty of the green valley below.", "translation": "從山頂上，徒步旅行者概觀了風景，讚賞著下方綠色山谷的美麗。", "explanation": "動詞「概觀」。指用目光掃視整體情況。"}], "related_forms": ["surveyor"]}

{"headword":"survivor","explanation":"名詞，意為「倖存者」。常用搭配 survivor of (某事後的倖存者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>survivor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the plane crash shared his story with the media to raise awareness about aviation safety.","translation":"飛機失事後的倖存者與媒體分享了他的故事，以提高人們對航空安全的意識。","explanation":"名詞「倖存者」。常用搭配 survivor of (...的倖存者)。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>survivors</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the earthquake needed professional counseling to overcome the trauma and return to a normal life.","translation":"許多地震的倖存者需要專業的心理諮詢，以克服創傷並回歸正常生活。","explanation":"名詞「倖存者」。常用搭配 survivors of (...的倖存者)。"}],"related_forms":["survive"]}

{"headword": "suspect", "explanation": "詞性多變。動詞意為「懷疑」，名詞意為「嫌疑犯」。形容詞意為「可疑的」。注意動詞 suspect (懷疑) 與名詞 suspect (嫌疑犯) 的發音不同（動詞重音在第二音節，名詞重音在第一音節）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police <target>suspected</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the thief had entered the building through a small window in the back of the house.", "translation": "警察懷疑小偷是從房子後面的小窗戶進入建築物的。", "explanation": "動詞「懷疑」。常用搭配：suspect that... (懷疑...)。"}, {"sentence": "After reviewing the security footage, investigators identified a primary <target>suspect</target> who was seen leaving the scene shortly after the crime.", "translation": "在查看安全監視錄像後，調查人員確定了一名主要嫌疑犯，他在犯罪後不久被看到離開現場。", "explanation": "名詞「嫌疑犯」。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher noticed the <target>suspect</target> <pattern>behavior</pattern> of the student who was constantly glancing at his classmate's paper during the exam.", "translation": "老師注意到那個在考試期間不斷瞥視同學試卷的學生，其行為十分可疑。", "explanation": "形容詞「可疑的」。常用搭配：suspect behavior (可疑行為)。"}], "related_forms": ["suspected", "suspecting", "suspicion"]}

{"headword":"suspicion","explanation":"名詞「懷疑」。指對某人或某事是否真實、誠實或合法而產生的不信任感。常用搭配：arouse suspicion (引起懷疑), under suspicion (受到懷疑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden change in his story <target>aroused</target> <pattern>suspicion</pattern> among the detectives, who then began to investigate his background more closely.","translation":"他故事的突然改變引起了偵探們的懷疑，隨後他們開始更仔細地調查他的背景。","explanation":"名詞「懷疑」。常用搭配：arouse suspicion (引起懷疑)。"},{"sentence":"The athlete was <target>under</target> <pattern>suspicion</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> using illegal substances to improve his performance in the international competition.","translation":"這位運動員因涉嫌在國際比賽中使用非法物質以提升表現而受到懷疑。","explanation":"名詞「懷疑」。常用片語：under suspicion of... (涉嫌...)。"}],"related_forms":["suspicious"]}

{"headword":"swan","explanation":"名詞「天鵝」。","entries":[{"sentence":"During their walk in the park, the couple saw a graceful <target>swan</target> swimming slowly across the quiet lake, reflecting the sunset.","translation":"在公園散步時，這對夫婦看到一隻優雅的天鵝在寧靜的湖面上緩緩游動，映照著夕陽。","explanation":"名詞「天鵝」。"},{"sentence":"The children were excited to feed the <target>swans</target> at the local pond, watching them glide effortlessly through the water.","translation":"孩子們興奮地在當地池塘餵天鵝，看著它們毫不費力地在水中滑行。","explanation":"名詞「天鵝」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"swear","explanation":"動詞，具有兩種主要意思：一是「發誓」；二是「咒罵」。在 GSAT 考點中，「發誓」較為常見。常用片語 swear by (極力推薦)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The witness was asked to <target>swear</target> <pattern>to</pattern> tell the truth in court, promising that every word he spoke was accurate.","translation":"證人被要求在法庭上發誓說實話，承諾他所說的每個字都是準確的。","explanation":"動詞「發誓」。常用搭配：swear to do sth (發誓要做某事)。"},{"sentence":"Many professional photographers <target>swear</target> <pattern>by</pattern> this particular brand of camera for its reliability and amazing image quality.","translation":"許多專業攝影師極力推薦這個特定品牌的相機，因為其可靠性和驚人的影像品質。","explanation":"動詞片語 swear by sth 意為「極力推薦」或「對...深信不疑」。"},{"sentence":"The angry driver began to <target>swear</target> loudly at the other car after the minor accident, which shocked the pedestrians nearby.","translation":"在發生輕微事故後，憤怒的駕駛員開始大聲咒罵另一輛車，這讓附近的行人感到震驚。","explanation":"動詞「咒罵」。"}],"related_forms":["swore","sworn"]}

{"headword": "sweat", "explanation": "名詞「汗水」；動詞「流汗」。常考搭配：break into a sweat (突然流汗/緊張)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After running five kilometers in the hot summer sun, the athlete's shirt was soaked with <target>sweat</target>, showing his hard work.", "translation": "在炎熱的夏日陽光下跑了五公里後，運動員的襯衫被汗水浸透了，顯示出他的努力。", "explanation": "名詞「汗水」。"}, {"sentence": "He <target>sweated</target> profusely during the final presentation of his project, as he was extremely nervous about the judges' reactions.", "translation": "在專案的最終演示期間，他大量流汗，因為他對評審的反應極其緊張。", "explanation": "動詞「流汗」。"}, {"sentence": "The student <pattern>broke</pattern> <target>into</target> <pattern>a</pattern> <target>sweat</target> when the teacher asked him a difficult question that he could not answer.", "translation": "當老師問他一個他無法回答的困難問題時，該學生突然流汗（感到緊張）。", "explanation": "動詞片語 break into a sweat 意為「突然流汗」，常用於描述緊張或恐懼狀態。"}], "related_forms": ["sweaty"]}

{"headword":"swell","explanation":"動詞「腫脹；增加」；名詞「腫脹」。指物體體積增加或數量迅速增長。常用於醫療或自然現象描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you hit your ankle on the table, the area will likely <target>swell</target> and become painful within a few hours.","translation":"如果你把腳踝撞到桌子，該區域可能會在幾小時內腫脹並變得疼痛。","explanation":"動詞「腫脹」。指身體部位因受傷而體積增加。"},{"sentence":"The number of tourists visiting the small island has <target>swollen</target> <pattern>to</pattern> thousands every month, causing traffic problems.","translation":"每月造訪這個小島的遊客數量已增加到數千人，導致交通問題。","explanation":"動詞「增加」。指數量或規模迅速擴大。不規則變化：swell-swelled/swollen-swollen。"},{"sentence":"The doctor examined the <target>swelling</target> on the patient's knee and suggested using an ice pack to reduce the inflammation.","translation":"醫生檢查了病人膝蓋上的腫脹，並建議使用冰敷以減輕炎症。","explanation":"名詞「腫脹」。"}],"related_forms":["swollen"]}

{"headword":"swift","explanation":"形容詞「迅速的；快捷的」。指速度快，常用於動作或反應。注意與 fast 或 quick 相對，swift 較常用於正式語境或文學描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government promised a <target>swift</target> <pattern>response</pattern> to the natural disaster, sending emergency supplies and rescue teams immediately.","translation":"政府承諾對自然災害做出迅速反應，立即派遣緊急物資和救援隊。","explanation":"形容詞「迅速的」。常用搭配：swift response (迅速反應)。"},{"sentence":"The cat made a <target>swift</target> <pattern>movement</pattern> to catch the mouse, showing its amazing speed and precision.","translation":"貓做出迅速的動作來捕捉老鼠，展現出其驚人的速度和精準度。","explanation":"形容詞「迅速的」。常用搭配：swift movement (迅速的動作)。"},{"sentence":"Because the company's <target>swift</target> <pattern>action</pattern> stopped the leak, the environment was saved from serious pollution.","translation":"由於公司迅速的行動停止了洩漏，環境免於受到嚴 serious pollution。","explanation":"形容詞「迅速的」。常用搭配：swift action (迅速行動)。"}],"related_forms":["swiftly","swiftness"]}

{"headword":"sword","explanation":"名詞「劍」。通常用於歷史或奇幻語境。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient warrior carried a sharp <target>sword</target> <pattern>at</pattern> his side, ready to defend his kingdom from enemy attacks.","translation":"這位古代戰士在身邊攜帶一把鋒利的劍，準備防禦敵人的攻擊以保衛他的王國。","explanation":"名詞「劍」。"},{"sentence":"In the museum, we saw a collection of <target>swords</target> from the Middle Ages, each with a beautifully decorated handle.","translation":"在博物館中，我們看到了一組來自中世紀的劍，每把劍的把手都裝飾精美。","explanation":"名詞「劍」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "tablet", "explanation": "名詞，具有兩種主要意思：一是「平板電腦」；二是「藥片」。在 GSAT 考點中兩者均常見。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students now use a <target>tablet</target> <pattern>to</pattern> take notes during lectures, as it is more convenient than carrying heavy books.", "translation": "許多學生現在使用平板電腦在課堂上記錄筆記，因為這比攜帶沉重的書籍更方便。", "explanation": "名詞「平板電腦」。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor told the patient to take one <target>tablet</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the medicine twice a day after meals to treat the infection.", "translation": "醫生告訴病人每天餐後服用兩次藥片以治療感染。", "explanation": "名詞「藥片」。"}, {"sentence": "The archaeologist found an ancient stone <target>tablet</target> <pattern>with</pattern> mysterious symbols, which provided clues about the lost civilization.", "translation": "考古學家發現了一塊帶有神秘符號的古代石板，這為失落的文明提供了線索。", "explanation": "名詞「石板」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tag", "explanation": "名詞「標籤」；動詞「貼標籤」或「標記」。在數位時代，標記他人（如在社交媒體上）也是常見用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before buying the dress, she checked the price <target>tag</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the sleeve, but found it was too expensive for her budget.", "translation": "在買這件洋裝之前，她檢查了袖子上的價格標籤，但發現它超出了她的預算。", "explanation": "名詞「標籤」。常用搭配：price tag (價格標籤)。"}, {"sentence": "The scientists <target>tagged</target> the sea turtles with electronic devices to track their migration patterns across the ocean.", "translation": "科學家在海龜身上貼上電子標記，以追蹤它們在海洋中的遷徙模式。", "explanation": "動詞「貼標籤/標記」。"}, {"sentence": "After posting the photo on Instagram, he <target>tagged</target> his friends <pattern>in</pattern> the picture so they would be notified of the post.", "translation": "在將照片上傳到 Instagram 後， he 將朋友標記在照片中，以便他們收到貼文的通知。", "explanation": "動詞「標記」。常用於社交媒體語境。"}], "related_forms": ["tags", "tagging"]}

{"headword":"tailor","explanation":"名詞「裁縫」。動詞「量身定制」或「調整」。動詞用法在 GSAT 中常指將計畫、課程或服務調整至符合特定需求。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>tailor</target> carefully measured the groom's shoulders and waist to ensure the wedding suit fit him perfectly for the big day.","translation":"裁縫仔細地測量了新郎的肩膀和腰圍，以確保婚禮西裝在重要日子裡非常合身。","explanation":"名詞「裁縫」。指專業製作或修改衣服的人。"},{"sentence":"The language center decided to <target>tailor</target> its courses <pattern>to</pattern> the needs of individual students, allowing them to learn at their own pace.","translation":"語言中心決定將其課程量身定制以符合個別學生的需求，讓他們能按自己的步調學習。","explanation":"動詞「量身定制」。常用搭配 tailor sth to sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"To improve student performance, the teacher <target>tailored</target> her teaching methods <pattern>to</pattern> the different learning styles of her students.","translation":"為了提高學生的表現，老師將她的教學方法調整至符合學生的不同學習風格。","explanation":"動詞「量身定制」。指調整內容以適應特定對象。"}],"related_forms":["tailored","tailoring"]}

{"headword":"talent","explanation":"名詞「天賦，才華」。指天生的能力。常用片語 have a talent for (有...的天賦)。","entries":[{"sentence":"From a young age, the girl showed a remarkable <target>talent</target> <pattern>for</pattern> painting, creating detailed landscapes that amazed her teachers.","translation":"這女孩從小就展現出卓越的繪畫天賦，創作出的詳細風景畫讓她的老師們驚訝不已。","explanation":"名詞「天賦」。常用片語 have a talent for + N/V-ing。"},{"sentence":"The company is searching for new <target>talents</target> to join their marketing team and bring fresh, creative ideas to their global campaigns.","translation":"公司正在尋找新的人才加入他們的行銷團隊，為其全球活動帶來新鮮且具創意的新想法。","explanation":"名詞「人才」。在此指具有特定能力的人。"}],"related_forms":["talented"]}

{"headword":"talkative","explanation":"形容詞「健談的，愛說話的」。通常指一個人喜歡說很多話。注意與 quiet (安靜的) 或 reserved (內斂的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"My younger sister is very <target>talkative</target>, often spending hours describing every detail of her school day to our parents after coming home.","translation":"我的妹妹非常健談，回家後經常花好幾個小時向父母描述她學校生活中的每個細節。","explanation":"形容詞「健談的」。"},{"sentence":"Although the new student was <target>talkative</target> and friendly, some of his classmates found his constant chatting a bit distracting during lessons.","translation":"雖然新學生很健談且友善，但有些同學覺得他在課堂上不斷聊天有點令人分心。","explanation":"形容詞「健談的」。"}],"related_forms":["talkatively"]}

{"headword":"tame","explanation":"形容詞「溫馴的，馴服的」。動詞「馴服」。指動物不再害怕人類或不再兇猛。常用搭配 tame animals (馴服動物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After weeks of patient training and feeding, the wild rabbit became <target>tame</target> enough to eat carrots directly from the boy's hand.","translation":"經過數週耐心的訓練和餵食，這隻野兔變得足夠溫馴，可以直接從男孩手中吃胡蘿蔔。","explanation":"形容詞「溫馴的」。指動物對人類沒有恐懼或攻擊性。"},{"sentence":"The circus trainer spent years trying to <target>tame</target> the fierce lions, teaching them to perform tricks without causing any danger.","translation":"馬戲團訓練師花了很多年試圖馴服兇猛的獅子，教牠們表演技巧而不會造成任何危險。","explanation":"動詞「馴服」。指透過訓練使動物溫馴。"}],"related_forms":["tamed","taming"]}

{"headword":"tangerine","explanation":"名詞「橘子，柑橘」。指一種小型、甜且皮容易剝的柑橘類水果。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the winter break, my grandmother often prepares a plate of fresh <target>tangerines</target> for the family to enjoy while watching television.","translation":"在寒假期間，我的祖母經常為家人準備一盤新鮮的橘子，讓大家在看電視時享用。","explanation":"名詞「橘子」。"},{"sentence":"The bright orange color of the <target>tangerine</target> makes it a popular choice for decorating fruit baskets during the traditional holiday season.","translation":"橘子亮橙色的外觀使其成為傳統節日期間裝飾水果籃的熱門選擇。","explanation":"名詞「橘子」。"}],"related_forms":["tangerines"]}

{"headword":"tank","explanation":"名詞「儲槽，水箱」或「坦克」。在 GSAT 中，儲槽（如 water tank）或水族箱（fish tank）是常見考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The village suffered from a water shortage because the main water <target>tank</target> had a leak and lost most of its stored water.","translation":"由於主水槽漏水且失去了大部分儲水，該村莊遭受了缺水之苦。","explanation":"名詞「儲槽」。指存放液體的容器。"},{"sentence":"The student bought a large fish <target>tank</target> for his bedroom and spent hours carefully choosing the right plants and gravel for his fish.","translation":"學生在他的臥室買了一個大型魚缸，並花了好幾個小時仔細選擇適合魚類的植物和砂礫。","explanation":"名詞「水族箱」。"},{"sentence":"During the history lesson, the teacher explained how the use of <target>tanks</target> changed the nature of warfare during the first World War.","translation":"在歷史課上，老師解釋了坦克的運用如何改變了第一次世界大戰期間戰爭的性質。","explanation":"名詞「坦克」。指軍用裝甲車。"}],"related_forms":["tanks"]}

{"headword": "tap", "explanation": "動詞「輕敲」或「開啟水龍頭」。名詞「水龍頭」。注意搭配 tap on (輕敲)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher gently <target>tapped</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the student's shoulder to get his attention before explaining the difficult math problem again.", "translation": "老師輕輕地敲了敲學生的肩膀以引起他的注意，然後再次解釋就這個困難的數學問題再次解釋。", "explanation": "動詞「輕敲」。常用搭配 tap on sth/sb。"}, {"sentence": "Please remember to turn off the <target>tap</target> <pattern>completely</pattern> after brushing your teeth to save water and protect the environment.", "translation": "刷牙後請記得將水龍頭完全關掉，以節約用水並保護環境。", "explanation": "名詞「水龍頭」。"}, {"sentence": "He <target>tapped</target> his fingers <pattern>on</pattern> the table nervously while waiting for the results of his college entrance examination to be announced.", "translation": "在等待大學入學考試結果公布時，他的手指在桌上緊張地輕敲。", "explanation": "動詞「輕敲」。"}], "related_forms": ["taps", "tapping"]}

{"headword": "tasty", "explanation": "形容詞「美味的」。常用於描述食物或飲料的味道好。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef prepared a <target>tasty</target> meal using local ingredients, which received high praise from all the food critics who visited the restaurant.", "translation": "主廚使用當地食材準備了一頓美味的餐點，受到了所有造訪該餐廳的美食評論家的讚賞。", "explanation": "形容詞「美味的」。"}, {"sentence": "My mother's homemade apple pie is so <target>tasty</target> that my siblings and I always ask for a second piece after dinner.", "translation": "我母親自製的蘋果派如此美味，以至於我和我的兄弟姐妹在晚餐後總是要求再吃一塊。", "explanation": "形容詞「美味的」。"}, {"sentence": "The small bakery on the corner is famous for its <target>tasty</target> pastries, which are made fresh every single morning.", "translation": "轉角的小麵包店以其美味的糕點聞名，這些糕點每天早晨都是新鮮製作的。", "explanation": "形容詞「美味的」。"}], "related_forms": ["tastiness"]}

{"headword": "tease", "explanation": "動詞「戲弄，開玩笑」。指透過嘲笑或挑逗來讓對方感到不舒服或好笑。注意與 mock (嘲笑) 相對，tease 較為輕微。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The older students sometimes <target>tease</target> the freshmen about their nervous expressions during the first week of the new school year.", "translation": "高年級學生有時會在新學年第一週戲弄新生們緊張的表情。", "explanation": "動詞「戲弄」。"}, {"sentence": "Although he liked to <target>tease</target> his younger sister about her hobby, he always supported her when she entered a painting competition.", "translation": "雖然他喜歡戲弄妹妹的愛好，但當妹妹參加繪畫比賽時， he 總是支持她。", "explanation": "動詞「戲弄」。"}, {"sentence": "It is important to teach children that while some jokes are harmless, they should not <target>tease</target> others if it makes them feel sad or upset.", "translation": "教導孩子們雖然有些玩笑是無害的，但如果會讓他人感到悲傷或心煩，就不應該戲弄他人。", "explanation": "動詞「戲弄」。指較為溫和的內容，但仍需注意界限。"}, {"sentence": "The little girl <target>teased</target> her brother by hiding his favorite toy, but she soon apologized after seeing his disappointed face.", "translation": "小女孩透過隱藏她哥哥最喜歡的玩具來戲弄他，但在看到他失望的臉色後很快就道歉了。", "explanation": "動詞「戲弄」。用於描述日常生活中輕微的挑逗。"}], "related_forms": ["teasing"]}

{"headword":"technical","explanation":"形容詞「技術性的，專業的」。指與特定技能、機械或科學相關的知識。常用搭配 technical skills (技術能力), technical problems (技術問題)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The software engineer explained the <target>technical</target> <pattern>details</pattern> of the new app, but the audience found the terminology too difficult to understand.","translation":"軟體工程師解釋了新應用程式的技術細節，但聽眾發現專業術語太難理解。","explanation":"形容詞「技術性的」。常用搭配 technical details (技術細節)。"},{"sentence":"The online exam was delayed for thirty minutes because the school's server experienced some <target>technical</target> <pattern>difficulties</pattern> that required immediate repair.","translation":"由於學校伺服器出現了一些技術困難，線上考試被延後了三十分鐘。","explanation":"形容詞「技術性的」。常用搭配 technical difficulties (技術困難)。"},{"sentence":"Students who wish to pursue a career in robotics must develop strong <target>technical</target> <pattern>skills</pattern> in both programming and electronic engineering.","translation":"希望從事機器人產業的學生必須在程式設計和電子工程方面培養強大的技術能力。","explanation":"形容詞「技術性的」。常用搭配 technical skills (技術能力)。"}],"related_forms":["technically","technician"]}

{"headword":"technique","explanation":"名詞「技巧、技術」。指完成特定任務所需的熟練方法或程序。常用搭配：modern technique (現代技術), painting technique (繪畫技巧)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist spent hours practicing a new <target>technique</target> to play the difficult piece more smoothly and with more emotion.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家花了好幾個小時練習一種新的技巧，以便更流暢且更有感情地演奏這首困難的曲子。","explanation":"名詞「技巧」。指在藝術或運動中使用的特定技巧。"},{"sentence":"Many students use a specific <target>technique</target> <pattern>for</pattern> memorizing long lists of vocabulary words by associating them with vivid images.","translation":"許多學生使用一種特定的記憶技巧來記憶長長的單字表，將單字與生動的圖像聯繫起來。","explanation":"名詞「技巧」。常用搭配：technique for doing something (做某事的技巧)。"},{"sentence":"The coach explained that improving your breathing <target>technique</target> is essential for long-distance runners to maintain their energy throughout the race.","translation":"教練解釋說，改善呼吸技巧對於長跑運動員在整個比賽過程中保持體力至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「技術」。指生理或物理上的操作方法。"}],"related_forms":["techniques"]}

{"headword": "teenage", "explanation": "形容詞「青少年的」。指年齡在 13 到 19 歲之間的人。常用搭配：teenage years (青少年時期), teenage pregnancy (青少年懷孕)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>teenage</target> <pattern>years</pattern> are often filled with emotional changes and the struggle to find one's own identity in a complex world.", "translation": "青少年時期通常充滿了情緒上的變化以及在複雜的世界中尋找自我認同的掙扎。", "explanation": "形容詞「青少年的」。常用搭配：teenage years (青少年時期)。"}, {"sentence": "Many <target>teenage</target> <pattern>students</pattern> spend a lot of time on social media, which can sometimes lead to problems with their sleep and study habits.", "translation": "許多青少年學生花很多時間在社群媒體上，這 idea 導致睡眠和學習習慣的問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「青少年的」。"}, {"sentence": "Psychologists suggest that <target>teenage</target> <pattern>rebellion</pattern> is often a natural part of growing up and a way for youth to assert their independence.", "translation": "心理學家認為青少年叛逆是成長過程中的自然部分，也是年輕人主張獨立的一種方式。", "explanation": "形容詞「青少年的」。常用搭配：teenage rebellion (青少年叛逆)。"}, {"sentence": "The community center offers various sports programs specifically designed for <target>teenage</target> <pattern>girls</pattern> to encourage them to stay active.", "translation": "社區中心提供各種專門為青少年女孩設計的體育計畫，以鼓勵她們保持活躍。", "explanation": "形容詞「青少年的」。"}], "related_forms": ["teenager"]}

{"headword":"temper","explanation":"名詞「脾氣」。指一個人容易生氣或情緒不穩定的程度。常用搭配：lose one's temper (發脾氣), keep one's temper (保持冷靜)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the teacher was usually patient, he finally <pattern>lost</pattern> his <target>temper</target> when the students refused to stop talking during the exam.","translation":"雖然老師通常很有耐心，但當學生在考試期間拒絕停止說話時，他終於發脾氣了。","explanation":"名詞「脾氣」。常用片語 lose one's temper (發脾氣)。"},{"sentence":"It is important for athletes to <pattern>keep</pattern> their <target>temper</target> during a high-pressure game to avoid making mistakes that could cost them the victory.","translation":"運動員在高壓比賽中保持冷靜非常重要，以避免犯下可能導致他們失去勝利的錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「脾氣」。常用片語 keep one's temper (保持冷靜)。"},{"sentence":"The young boy has a <pattern>short</pattern> <target>temper</target>, which means he gets angry very quickly and often argues with his classmates.","translation":"這個小男孩脾氣很暴躁，這意味著他很快就會生氣，且經常與同學爭吵。","explanation":"名詞「脾氣」。常用形容詞 short temper (暴躁的脾氣)。"}],"related_forms":["tempered"]}

{"headword":"temporary","explanation":"形容詞「暫時的」。指持續時間短且不永久的。注意與 permanent (永久的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the main bridge was under repair, the city set up a <target>temporary</target> <pattern>bridge</pattern> to allow cars to cross the river.","translation":"由於主橋正在維修，該市搭建了一座臨時橋樑，以允許車輛跨越河流。","explanation":"形容詞「暫時的」。"},{"sentence":"The company offered her a <target>temporary</target> <pattern>job</pattern> for three months during the holiday season to help with the increased workload.","translation":"公司在假日期間為她提供了一份為期三個月的臨時工作，以幫助處理增加的工作量。","explanation":"形容詞「暫時的」。常用搭配：temporary job (臨時工作)。"},{"sentence":"The power outage was only <target>temporary</target>, and the electricity was restored within an hour, so the students could finish their homework.","translation":"停電只是暫時的，電在一個小時內就恢復了，所以學生們可以完成他們的作業。","explanation":"形容詞「暫時的」。"}],"related_forms":["temporarily","temporariness"]}

{"headword":"tend","explanation":"動詞「傾向於、習慣於」。常用片語 tend to (傾向於.../習慣於...)。注意與 attend (參加) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students who study in a quiet environment <target>tend</target> <pattern>to</pattern> concentrate better and achieve higher scores on their final exams.","translation":"在安靜環境中學習的學生傾向於能更專注，並在期末考中取得更高的分數。","explanation":"動詞片語 tend to do something (傾向於做某事)。"},{"sentence":"In the winter, temperatures in this city <target>tend</target> <pattern>to</pattern> drop significantly, making it necessary for everyone to wear thick coats.","translation":"在冬天，這個城市的氣溫傾向於大幅下降，使得每個人都必須穿厚外套。","explanation":"動詞片語 tend to do something (傾向於...)。"},{"sentence":"Young children <target>tend</target> <pattern>to</pattern> be more curious about the world around them than adults, which is why they ask so many questions.","translation":"幼兒傾向於對周圍的世界比成年人更好奇，這就是為什麼他們問這麼多問題。","explanation":"動詞片語 tend to do something (傾向於...)。"}],"related_forms":["tendency"]}

{"headword":"tender","explanation":"形容詞「溫柔的、溫馨的」或「嫩的」。常用搭配：tender heart (溫柔的心), tender meat (嫩的肉)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mother gave her newborn baby a <target>tender</target> <pattern>kiss</pattern> on the forehead, showing her deep love and care for the child.","translation":"母親在新生兒的額頭上給了一個溫柔的親吻，展現出她對孩子的深愛與照顧。","explanation":"形容詞「溫柔的」。常用搭配：tender kiss (溫柔的親吻)。"},{"sentence":"The chef used a special slow-cooking method to make the beef <target>tender</target> and juicy, which impressed all the guests at the dinner.","translation":"廚師使用了一種特殊的慢煮法使牛肉變得鮮嫩多汁，這給晚餐的所有賓客留下了深刻印象。","explanation":"形容詞「嫩的」。指食物的質地。"},{"sentence":"Despite his tough exterior, the old man had a <target>tender</target> <pattern>heart</pattern> and always helped the homeless people in his neighborhood.","translation":"儘管外表強悍，這位老人卻有一顆溫柔的心，總是幫助鄰居中的無家可歸者。","explanation":"形容詞「溫柔的」。常用搭配：tender heart (溫柔的心)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "tent", "explanation": "名詞「帳篷」。常用搭配：pitch a tent (搭帳篷)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students spent their weekend camping in the mountains, and they had to <pattern, ", "translation": "學生們在山中露營過週末，他們必須在下雨前搭好帳篷。", "explanation": "名詞「帳篷」。常用片語 pitch a tent (搭帳篷)。"}, {"sentence": "Because the wind was so strong, the <target>tent</target> was almost blown away, so the group had to secure it with strong ropes.", "translation": "因為風太大，帳篷幾乎被吹走了，所以這組人必須用強韌的繩子將其固定。", "explanation": "名詞「帳篷」。"}, {"sentence": "During the music festival, the organizers set up a large <target>tent</target> to serve as a first-aid station for anyone who felt unwell.", "translation": "在音樂祭期間，主辦方搭建了一個大帳篷作為急救站，為任何感到不適的人提供服務。", "explanation": "名詞「帳篷」。此處指活動用的大型帳篷。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "terrific", "explanation": "形容詞「極好的、很棒的」。注意：在現代英語中，常用於表示正面肯定，但其原意包含「令人恐懼的」，但在 GSAT 考試中，請優先考慮「極好的」之意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school choir gave a <target>terrific</target> <pattern>performance</pattern> at the annual concert, receiving a standing ovation from the entire audience.", "translation": "學校合唱團在年度音樂會上帶來了極好的表演，贏得了全場觀眾的起立鼓掌。", "explanation": "形容詞「極好的」。常用搭配：terrific performance (極好的表演)。"}, {"sentence": "I think you did a <target>terrific</target> <pattern>job</pattern> on your science project, and your teacher will surely be impressed by your hard work.", "translation": "I think you did a terrific job on your science project, and your teacher will surely be impressed by your hard work.", "explanation": "形容詞「極好的」。常用搭配：terrific job (極好的工作/表現)。"}, {"sentence": "The driver was speeding at a <target>terrific</target> <pattern>pace</pattern>, which made the passengers feel nervous as they approached the winding mountain road.", "translation": "司機以極快的速度行駛，這使得乘客在接近蜿蜒的山路時感到緊張。", "explanation": "形容詞「極好的」之意在某些語境下可表示「極大的、極快的」，用於強調程度之強。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"territory","explanation":"名詞「領土、領地」。指一個國家、動物或組織所控制的區域。常用搭配：disputed territory (爭議領土), uncharted territory (未開發的領域/未知領域)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two countries have been arguing for decades over the <target>territory</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the islands in the south sea, leading to political tension.","translation":"這兩個國家為了南海島嶼的領土問題爭論了數十年，導致政治緊張。","explanation":"名詞「領土」。常用搭配：territory of... (...的領土)。"},{"sentence":"When the researchers entered the <target>territory</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the tigers, they had to be extremely careful to avoid any dangerous encounters.","translation":"當研究人員進入老虎的領地時，他們必須非常小心，以避免任何危險的遭遇。","explanation":"名詞「領地」。指動物的生存區域。"},{"sentence":"Starting a new business in a completely different industry is like entering <pattern>uncharted</pattern> <target>territory</target>, which can be both exciting and risky.","translation":"在一個完全不同的行業中開始新生意就像進入未知領域，這既令人興奮又具有風險。","explanation":"名詞「未知領域」。常用搭配：uncharted territory (未知領域)。"}],"related_forms":["territorial"]}

{"headword": "thankful", "explanation": "形容詞「感激的」。常用片語 thankful for (對...感激), be thankful that (感激...的事情)。注意與 grateful (感激的) 的意思非常接近，通常可互換使用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students were <target>thankful</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the extra time the teacher gave them to finish their final project before the deadline.", "translation": "學生們對老師在截止日期前給予他們額外時間完成最終專題感到感激。", "explanation": "形容詞「感激的」。常用片語 thankful for sth (對某事感激)。"}, {"sentence": "I am <target>thankful</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the rain stopped just in time for the school's outdoor sports meet, allowing everyone to participate.", "translation": "我很感激雨正好在學校戶外運動會開始前停止，讓每個人都能參與。", "explanation": "形容詞「感激的」。常用句型 be thankful that + 子句 (感激...的事情)。"}, {"sentence": "After the long and difficult recovery process, the patient was deeply <target>thankful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the doctors who had saved her life.", "translation": "經過漫長而困難的康復過程，病人對救她命的醫生們深表感激。", "explanation": "形容詞「感激的」。常用搭配 thankful to sb (對某人感激)。"}], "related_forms": ["thankfully"]}

{"headword": "theory", "explanation": "名詞「理論；假說」。指對某事物的解釋或系統性的觀點。常用搭配 include a theory that... (包含一個...的理論) 或 in theory (理論上)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientist proposed a new <target>theory</target> <pattern>that</pattern> explained how the planets were formed billions of years ago.", "translation": "這位科學家提出了一個新的理論，解釋了數十億年前行星是如何形成的。", "explanation": "名詞「理論」。指科學上的假說或解釋。"}, {"sentence": "While the plan seems perfect <pattern>in</pattern> <target>theory</target>, it might be very difficult to put into practice due to lack of funding.", "translation": "雖然這個計畫在理論上看起來很完美，但由於缺乏資金，在實踐中可能會非常困難。", "explanation": "片語 in theory 表示「理論上」，常用於對比實際情況。"}, {"sentence": "My <target>theory</target> <pattern>about</pattern> why the movie ended so unexpectedly was different from what most of my classmates thought.", "translation": "我關於為什麼這部電影結尾如此出人意料的理論（想法），與大多數同學的想法不同。", "explanation": "名詞「理論」。在非正式語境中， 可指個人的猜想或想法。"}], "related_forms": ["theoretical", "theoretically"]}

{"headword": "thirst", "explanation": "名詞「口渴；強烈的渴望」。除了生理上的口渴，也常用於比喻對知識、權力或成功的渴望。常用搭配 thirst for (對...的渴望)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After hiking for three hours under the hot sun, the students felt a burning <target>thirst</target> and drank all their water quickly.", "translation": "在烈日下徒步旅行三小時後，學生們感到口渴難耐，迅速喝光了所有的水。", "explanation": "名詞「口渴」。指生理上需要水分的感覺。"}, {"sentence": "The young student's <target>thirst</target> <pattern>for</pattern> knowledge led her to read dozens of books on history and philosophy every month.", "translation": "這名年輕學生對知識的強烈渴望，使她每個月閱讀數十本關於歷史和哲學的書。", "explanation": "名詞「渴望」。比喻用法，常用搭配 thirst for + N。"}, {"sentence": "The ambitious politician's insatiable <target>thirst</target> <pattern>for</pattern> power led him to make decisions that harmed the interests of the general public.", "translation": "這位野心勃勃的政治家對權力的不滿足之渴望，使他導致他做出損害公眾利益的決定。", "explanation": "名詞「渴望」。比喻用法，常用搭配 thirst for power (對權力的渴望)。"}], "related_forms": ["thirsty"]}

{"headword":"thread","explanation":"名詞「線；線索」。動詞「穿線；將...穿過」。在現代語境中，thread 也常用於指論壇或社交媒體上的「討論串」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tailor carefully picked up the needle and began to <target>thread</target> it <pattern>with</pattern> a strong red string to fix the torn dress.","translation":"裁縫小心地拿起針，開始用一根強韌的紅線穿針，以修理那件撕裂的洋裝。","explanation":"動詞「穿線」。常用搭配 thread sth with sth。"},{"sentence":"The detective tried to follow the <target>thread</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the conversation to find the hidden clue that would lead him to the suspect.","translation":"偵探試圖跟隨對話的線索，以尋找能引導他找到嫌疑人的隱藏線索。","explanation":"名詞「線索」。指邏輯上的聯繫或脈絡。"},{"sentence":"Many users joined the online <target>thread</target> to discuss the new movie, sharing their opinions and debating the ending for hours.","translation":"許多用戶加入了這個線上討論串來討論這部新電影，分享他們的看法並爭論結局好幾個小時。","explanation":"名詞「討論串」。指網路上的系列對話。"}],"related_forms":["threading"]}

{"headword": "threat", "explanation": "名詞「威脅」。指可能造成傷害或危險的人或事。常用搭配 pose a threat to (對...構成威脅) 或 under threat (受到威脅)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Climate change <pattern>poses</pattern> a serious <target>threat</target> <pattern>to</pattern> many coastal cities, which may be flooded by rising sea levels.", "translation": "氣候變遷對許多沿海城市構成了嚴重威脅，這些城市可能會被上升的海平面淹沒。", "explanation": "名詞「威脅」。常用片語 pose a threat to sth/sb。"}, {"sentence": "The rare species of birds is currently <pattern>under</pattern> <target>threat</target> of extinction because their natural habitat is being destroyed.", "translation": "這種稀有的鳥類目前面臨著滅絕的威脅，因為它們的自然棲息地正在被摧毀。", "explanation": "名詞「威脅」。片語 under threat of... 表示「受到...的威脅」。"}, {"sentence": "The residents of the small town live under a <target>threat</target> <pattern>of</pattern> constant flood risk due to their location near the riverbank.", "translation": "由於他們位於河岸邊，這個小鎮的居民生活在不斷的洪水風險威脅之下。", "explanation": "名詞「威脅」。此處強調 a constant threat (持續的威脅)。"}], "related_forms": ["threaten", "threatening"]}

{"headword":"threaten","explanation":"動詞「威脅；恐嚇；（跡象顯示）可能發生」。注意其用法 threaten to V (威脅要做某事) 或 threaten sb with sth (用某事威脅某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The angry customer <target>threatened</target> <pattern>to</pattern> report the store manager to the headquarters if the problem was not solved immediately.","translation":"憤怒的顧客威脅說，如果問題沒有立即解決，他將向總部舉報店經理。","explanation":"動詞「威脅」。用法 threaten to + V。"},{"sentence":"The kidnapper <target>threatened</target> the family <pattern>with</pattern> a weapon, demanding a large amount of money for the safe return of the child.","translation":"綁架者用武器威脅該家庭，要求支付一大筆錢以安全地接回孩子。","explanation":"動詞「威脅」。用法 threaten sb with sth。"},{"sentence":"Looking at the dark clouds in the sky, the hikers realized that a heavy storm <target>threatened</target> to ruin their weekend trip.","translation":"看著天空中的烏雲，登山者意識到一場暴雨可能會毀掉他們的周末旅行。","explanation":"動詞「跡象顯示可能發生」。指不良情況即將發生。"}],"related_forms":["threat","threateningly"]}

{"headword": "thumb", "explanation": "名詞「拇指」。動詞則有 thumb through (快速翻閱) 的常用片語。注意 thumb index (拇指索引) 等專有名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He accidentally hit his <target>thumb</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the hammer while trying to build a small wooden birdhouse for his daughter.", "translation": "在試著為女兒蓋一個小型木製鳥屋時，他不小心用錘子砸到了拇指。", "explanation": "名詞「拇指」。"}, {"sentence": "While waiting for the bus, she <target>thumbed</target> <pattern>through</pattern> a fashion magazine, glancing at the pictures without reading the articles.", "translation": "在等公車時，她快速翻閱了一本時尚雜誌，只看圖片而沒有閱讀文章。", "explanation": "動詞片語 thumb through sth 意為「快速翻閱」。"}, {"sentence": "As a general <pattern>rule</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>thumb</target>, you should always double-check your answers before submitting your exam paper to the teacher.", "translation": "根據經驗法則，你在將考卷提交給老師之前，應該總是 double-check 你的答案。", "explanation": "名詞「拇指」。片語 rule of thumb (經驗法則)。"}], "related_forms": ["thumbs"]}

{"headword": "tide", "explanation": "名詞「潮汐；潮流」。除了指海洋的漲潮與落潮，也常用來比喻社會趨勢。常用片語 turn the tide (扭轉局面)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The fishermen had to wait for the <target>tide</target> <pattern>to</pattern> come in before they could sail their boats out to the open sea.", "translation": "漁民必須等待漲潮才能將船駛向公海。", "explanation": "名詞「潮汐」。指海水受月球引力影響而產生的漲落。"}, {"sentence": "Although the team was losing by ten points, a sudden goal in the last minute helped them <pattern>turn</pattern> the <target>tide</target> of the game.", "translation": "雖然該隊落後十分，但在最後一分鐘的一個突然進球幫助他們扭轉了比賽局面。", "explanation": "名詞「潮流」。片語 turn the tide 意為「扭轉局面」。"}, {"sentence": "We spent the afternoon walking along the shore, watching the <target>tide</target> <pattern>go</pattern> out, leaving behind many small shells and crabs.", "translation": "我們整個下午在岸邊散步，看著潮汐退潮，留下了許多小貝殼和螃蟹。", "explanation": "名詞「潮汐」。指實際的海水漲落 (tide go out / come in)。"}], "related_forms": ["tidal"]}

{"headword":"tight","explanation":"形容詞「緊的；狹窄的；吝嗇的」。副詞則指「緊緊地」。常用搭配 keep a tight grip on (緊緊掌控) 或 tight budget (預算吃緊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shoes were too <target>tight</target> for him, causing blisters on his heels after he walked for only ten minutes.","translation":"這雙鞋對他來說太緊了，導致他才走了十分鐘，腳後跟就起了水泡。","explanation":"形容詞「緊的」。指尺寸太小。"},{"sentence":"Because the family was on a <target>tight</target> <pattern>budget</pattern>, they decided to cook at home instead of eating at expensive restaurants.","translation":"因為這家人預算吃緊，他們決定在自家煮飯而不是去昂貴的餐廳用餐。","explanation":"形容詞「吃緊的」。常用搭配 tight budget。"},{"sentence":"The manager <pattern>kept</pattern> a <target>tight</target> <pattern>grip on</pattern> every detail of the project to ensure that no mistakes were made.","translation":"經理緊緊掌控專案的每一個細節，以確保沒有出錯。","explanation":"形容詞「緊的」。片語 keep a tight grip on sth 表示「緊緊掌控」。"},{"sentence":"She held the railing <target>tightly</target> as the bus suddenly braked, preventing her from falling forward.","translation":"當公車突然煞車時，她緊緊握住扶手，防止自己向前跌倒。","explanation":"副詞「緊緊地」。"}],"related_forms":["tighten","tightly"]}

{"headword":"tighten","explanation":"動詞「變緊；加強；縮減」。常用於描述物理上的拉緊，或政策、控制上的加強。常用搭配 tighten security (加強安保) 或 tighten one's belt (省吃儉用)。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should <target>tighten</target> the screws on the chair <pattern>with</pattern> a screwdriver to make sure it is stable and safe to sit on.","translation":"你應該用螺絲起子把椅子上的螺絲擰緊，以確保它穩定且坐起來安全。","explanation":"動詞「變緊」。指物理上的緊固。"},{"sentence":"The airport decided to <target>tighten</target> <pattern>security</pattern> measures after the discovery of a suspicious package in the luggage area.","translation":"在行李區發現可疑包裹後，機場決定加強安保措施。","explanation":"動詞「加強」。常用搭配 tighten security。"},{"sentence":"With the economic downturn affecting many families, people were forced to <target>tighten</target> <pattern>their belts</pattern> and spend less on luxury items.","translation":"隨著經濟衰退影響許多家庭，人們被迫省吃儉用，減少在奢侈品上的花費。","explanation":"動詞片語 tighten one's belt 意為「省吃儉用」。"}],"related_forms":["tight","tightness"]}

{"headword": "timber", "explanation": "名詞「木材」。特指可用於建築或製造家具的木材。注意與 wood (木頭/森林) 的區別，timber 強調其作為建築材料的用途。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old house was built using heavy <target>timber</target> from the mountains, which has kept the structure strong for over a hundred years.", "translation": "這座舊房子是用山上的厚重木材建造的，這使得結構在一百多年來依然強固。", "explanation": "名詞「木材」。指用於建築的木材。"}, {"sentence": "The government implemented new laws to protect the rainforest and rainforests, and stop the illegal trade of precious <target>timber</target> to other countries.", "translation": "政府實施了新法律以保護雨林，並阻止將珍貴木材非法貿易至其他國家。", "explanation": "名詞 হয়েছেindak 於建築的木材。"}, {"sentence": "The local community worked together to build a new community center using sustainably sourced <target>timber</target> to reduce their environmental impact.", "translation": "當地社區共同努力地使用可持續發展來源的木材來建造一個新的社區中心，以減少對環境的影響。", "explanation": "名詞「木材」。指作為商品的木材。"}], "related_forms": ["timbering"]}

{"headword": "headword", "explanation": "名詞「菸草」。常用於討論健康問題或農業。常見搭配：tobacco products (菸草製品), tobacco industry (s菸草工業)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many governments have implemented strict laws to limit the use of <target>tobacco</target> <pattern>products</pattern> in public spaces to protect people from secondhand smoke.", "translation": "翻譯：許多政府實施了嚴格的法律，限制在公共空間使用菸草製品，以保護公司員免於二手菸。", "explanation": "名詞「菸草」。常用搭配：tobacco products (菸草製品)。"}, {"sentence": "Doctors repeatedly warn that using <target>tobacco</target> can lead to severe lung diseases and increase the risk of heart problems over time.", "translation": "醫生反覆警告說，使用菸草可能會導致嚴重的肺部疾病，並隨著時間增加心臟問題的風險。", "explanation": "名詞「菸草」。指種植用來製造菸草製品的植物或其產品。"}, {"sentence": "The farmers in this region have switched from growing <target>tobacco</target> to organic vegetables, as the global demand for smoking products has declined.", "translation": "這個地區的農民已將種植菸草轉向種植有機蔬菜，由於全球對抽菸製品的需求下降。", "explanation": "名詞「菸草」。指種植的作物作物。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"ton","explanation":"名詞「噸」。重量單位。除了表示實際重量，也可在非正式用法中表示「大量」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cargo ship carried over ten thousand <target>tons</target> <pattern>of</pattern> steel to the port, providing necessary materials for the city's new bridge project.","translation":"這艘貨船將一萬多噸的鋼材運送到港口，為這座城市的跨海大橋工程提供必要材料。","explanation":"名詞「噸」。重量單位。常用搭配：tons of (大量的...)。"},{"sentence":"I have a <target>ton</target> <pattern>of</pattern> homework to finish before the weekend, so I will probably spend my entire Saturday in the library.","translation":"我在週末前有大量的作業要完成，所以我的整個星期六可能會在圖書館度過。","explanation":"名詞「噸」。此處為非正式用法，表示「大量」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"toss","explanation":"動詞「隨意地扔、拋」；名詞「拋擲」。常見片語 toss and turn (輾轉反側), toss a coin (擲硬幣決定)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student <target>tossed</target> his notebook <pattern>onto</pattern> the desk and sighed, feeling exhausted after a long day of intense studying.","translation":"學生將他的筆記本隨意地扔在桌上並嘆了口氣，在經歷了一整天的高強度學習後感到筋疲力盡。","explanation":"動詞「隨意地扔」。"},{"sentence":"When the two friends could not decide which movie to watch, they decided to <target>toss</target> <pattern>a coin</pattern> to make the final decision.","translation":"當兩個朋友無法決定要看哪部電影時，他們決定擲硬幣來做最終決定。","explanation":"動詞「拋」。常用搭配：toss a coin (擲硬幣)。"},{"sentence":"Last night, he <target>tossed</target> <pattern>and</pattern> <target>turned</target> in bed for hours, unable to sleep because he was so nervous about the exam.","translation":"昨晚他在床上輾轉反側好幾個小時，因為對考試太緊張而無法入睡。","explanation":"動詞片語 toss and turn 意為「輾轉反側」。"},{"sentence":"With a quick <target>toss</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the ball, the coach threw it to the player, who caught it skillfully with one hand.","translation":"教練快速地拋出球，球員熟練地用一隻手接住了它。","explanation":"名詞「拋擲」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"tough","explanation":"形容詞「艱難的、強韌的、堅硬的」。常用於描述困難的決定、強硬的性格或食物質地。常見搭配：tough decision (艱難的決定), tough luck (不幸)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Choosing which university to apply to was a <target>tough</target> <pattern>decision</pattern> for the student, as both options offered great programs.","translation":"選擇申請哪所大學對這名學生來說是一個艱難的決定，因為兩個選項都提供了很棒的課程。","explanation":"形容詞「艱難的」。常用搭配：tough decision (艱難的決定)。"},{"sentence":"The coach praised the athlete's <target>tough</target> spirit, noting that he never gave up even after suffering a serious leg injury.","translation":"教練稱讚這名運動員的強韌精神，指出他即使在遭受嚴重的腿傷後也沒有放棄。","explanation":"形容詞「強韌的」。指性格或意志堅強。"},{"sentence":"The steak was overcooked and became too <target>tough</target> to chew, making the dining experience disappointing for the guests.","translation":"牛排被煮過頭了，變得太硬而無法咀嚼，讓客人的用餐體驗令人失望。","explanation":"形容詞「堅硬的」。指食物質地硬且難以咀嚼。"}],"related_forms":["toughen","toughness"]}

{"headword": "tourism", "explanation": "名詞「觀光業、旅遊業」。指作為商業活動的旅遊行為。常用搭配：mass tourism (大量觀光), sustainable tourism (永續觀光)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The local government is promoting <pattern>sustainable</pattern> <target>tourism</target> to protect the natural environment while still allowing visitors to enjoy the island's beauty.", "translation": "地方政府正在推廣永續觀光，以便在允許遊客欣賞島嶼美景的同時保護自然環境。", "explanation": "名詞「觀光業」。常用搭配：sustainable tourism (永續觀光)。"}, {"sentence": "Many coastal towns rely heavily on <target>tourism</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their economic growth, as visitors spend money on hotels, restaurants and souvenirs.", "translation": "許多沿海小鎮嚴重依賴觀光業來獲得經濟增長，因為遊客在酒店、餐廳和紀念品上花錢。", "explanation": "名詞「觀光業」。常用搭配：rely on tourism for sth。"}], "related_forms": ["tourist"]}

{"headword":"tourist","explanation":"名詞「遊客、觀光客」。指前往某地旅遊的人。常用搭配：tourist attraction (觀光景點), tourist trap (觀光陷阱/遊客專屬的昂貴店鋪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Taipei 101 is one of the most popular <target>tourist</target> <pattern>attractions</pattern> in Taiwan, attracting millions of visitors from all over the world every year.","translation":"台北101是台灣最受歡迎的觀光景點之一，每年吸引數百萬來自世界各地的遊客。","explanation":"名詞「遊客」。常用搭配：tourist attraction (觀光景點)。"},{"sentence":"The small village has become a <target>tourist</target> <pattern>trap</pattern>, where shops sell overpriced souvenirs to visitors who do not know the local prices.","translation":"這個小村莊變成了觀光陷阱，商店向不知道當地價格的遊客銷售價格過高的紀念品。","explanation":"名詞「遊客」。常用搭配：tourist trap (觀光陷阱)。"},{"sentence":"The guide provided the <target>tourists</target> with a detailed map and a list of must-visit museums to ensure they had a great trip.","translation":"導遊為遊客提供了詳細的地圖和必須參觀的博物館清單，以確保他們有一次愉快的旅行。","explanation":"名詞「遊客」。"}],"related_forms":["tourism"]}

{"headword":"tow","explanation":"動詞「拖、拉」；名詞「拖曳」。常用片語 tow away (拖走)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the student's car broke down on the highway, he had to call a service truck to <target>tow</target> it <pattern>to</pattern> the nearest garage.","translation":"當學生的車在高速公路上故障時，他必須呼叫救援車將其拖到最近的修理廠。","explanation":"動詞「拖、拉」。常用於車輛故障時。"},{"sentence":"The driver received a ticket because he parked his car in a restricted area, and soon the vehicle was <target>towed</target> <pattern>away</pattern> by the city.","translation":"駕駛因為將車停在禁停區而收到罰單，很快地，車輛就被市府拖走了。","explanation":"動詞片語 tow away 意為「拖走」。"},{"sentence":"The boat was in need of a <target>tow</target> after its engine failed during the storm, and another vessel quickly came to help.","translation":"這艘船在風暴期間引擎故障，需要被拖曳，而另一艘船很快地趕來幫忙。","explanation":"名詞「拖曳」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"tower","explanation":"名詞「塔」。指高聳的建築物。常見搭配：clock tower (鐘樓), control tower (管制塔)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university's old <target>tower</target> is a famous landmark, and students often gather beneath it to take photos before their graduation ceremony.","translation":"大學的老塔是一個著名的地標，學生們經常在畢業典禮前聚集在塔下拍照。","explanation":"名詞「塔」。"},{"sentence":"The air traffic <target>tower</target> monitors all planes entering and leaving the airport to ensure that flights are safe and organized.","translation":"航空管制塔監控所有進入和離開機場的飛機，以確保航班安全且有序。","explanation":"名詞「塔」。常用搭配：control tower / air traffic tower (管制塔)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "trace", "explanation": "名詞「痕跡；微量」。動詞「追蹤；查出」。注意動詞片語 trace back to (追溯到)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Forensic scientists found only a faint <target>trace</target> <pattern>of</pattern> gunpowder at the crime scene, making it difficult to identify the suspect.", "translation": "鑑識科學家在犯罪現場只發現了微量的火藥痕跡，這使得辨識嫌疑犯變得困難。", "explanation": "名詞「痕跡；微量」。常用片語 a trace of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Investigators are working hard to <target>trace</target> <pattern>the origin of</pattern> the mysterious package that caused a security alert at the airport.", "translation": "調查人員正努力追查導致機場安全警報的神秘包裹的來源。", "explanation": "動詞「追蹤；查出」。常用搭配 trace the origin/source of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient pottery found in the excavation site can be <target>traced</target> <pattern>back to</pattern> a civilization that existed thousands of years ago.", "translation": "在挖掘現場發現的古代陶器可以追溯到數千年前存在的一個文明。", "explanation": "動詞片語 trace back to (追溯到)。常用於歷史或考古語境。"}], "related_forms": ["traceable"]}

{"headword":"trader","explanation":"名詞「商人、貿易商」。指從事貿易或買賣的人或公司。常用搭配：international trader (國際貿易商), stock trader (股票交易員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient city was a major center for <target>traders</target> who traveled from different countries to exchange silk and spices.","translation":"這座古城是貿易商的主要中心，他們來自不同國家，以交換絲綢和香料。","explanation":"名詞「商人」。"},{"sentence":"He works as a professional stock <target>trader</target>, spending his entire day monitoring market trends and making quick decisions to buy or sell shares.","translation":"他是一名專業的股票交易員，整天監控市場趨勢並快速決定買入或賣出股票。","explanation":"名詞「交易員」。常用搭配：stock trader (股票交易員)。"}],"related_forms":["trade"]}

{"headword":"trail","explanation":"名詞「小徑、痕跡」；動詞「追蹤、拖曳」。常用片語 trail behind (落在後面)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers followed a narrow <target>trail</target> through the dense forest, hoping to find the hidden waterfall before the sun set.","translation":"徒步旅行者沿著穿過茂密森林的狹窄小徑前行，希望在太陽下山前找到隱藏的瀑布。","explanation":"名詞「小徑」。"},{"sentence":"The detectives followed a <target>trail</target> <pattern>of</pattern> clues left by the suspect, which eventually led them to an old warehouse near the harbor.","translation":"偵探們追隨嫌疑犯留下的線索痕跡，這最終將他們引導至港口附近的一一棟舊倉庫。","explanation":"名詞「痕跡」。常用搭配：a trail of clues (線索痕跡)。"},{"sentence":"During the school race, the youngest student <target>trailed</target> <pattern>behind</pattern> the other runners, but he never gave up and finished the race.","translation":"在學校競賽中，最年輕的學生落在其他跑者後面，但他從未放棄並完成了比賽。","explanation":"動詞片語 trail behind 意為「落在後面」。"},{"sentence":"The dog <target>trailed</target> its leash across the floor, walking slowly and looking sad because it had not been received a treat.","translation":"狗狗將牽繩拖在地上走，走得很慢且看起來很悲傷，因為它沒有得到獎勵。","explanation":"動詞「拖曳」。"}],"related_forms":["trailblazer"]}

{"headword":"transport","explanation":"名詞「運輸、交通」，動詞「運輸、運送」。名詞時常用於描述系統或方式，如 public transport (大眾運輸)。動詞時常搭配 to 或 from，表示將某物從一處移至另一處。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city government is investing in better public <target>transport</target> <pattern>systems</pattern> to reduce traffic congestion and encourage more people to use buses.","translation":"市政府正投資於更好的大眾運輸系統，以減少交通擁堵並鼓勵更多人乘坐巴士。","explanation":"名詞「運輸、交通」。常用搭配：public transport (大眾運輸)。"},{"sentence":"Specialized trucks are used to <target>transport</target> the heavy machinery <pattern>from</pattern> the factory <pattern>to</pattern> the construction site safely.","translation":"專用卡車被用來將重型機械安全地從工廠運送到建築工地。","explanation":"動詞「運送」。常用介係詞搭配：transport ... from ... to ...。"},{"sentence":"During the winter, the government must ensure that emergency <target>transport</target> <pattern>services</pattern> remain operational despite the heavy snowfall.","translation":"在冬季，政府必須確保儘管大雪紛飛，緊急運輸服務仍能正常運作。","explanation":"名詞「運輸」。常用搭配：transport services (運輸服務)。"}],"related_forms":["transportation","transporter"]}

{"headword":"traveler","explanation":"名詞「旅行者」。指在旅途中或進行長途旅行的人。常用於描述探索新文化或體驗新事物的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experienced <target>travelers</target> carried only a small backpack, allowing them to move quickly and easily between different cities.","translation":"經驗豐富的旅行者只攜帶一個小背包，使他們能夠在不同城市之間快速且輕鬆地移動。","explanation":"名詞「旅行者」。"},{"sentence":"The local guide provided helpful tips for foreign <target>travelers</target> to avoid common scams and explore the hidden gems of the city.","translation":"當地導遊為外國旅行者提供了有用的建議，以避免常見的詐騙並探索城市的隱藏寶藏。","explanation":"名詞「旅行者」。"}],"related_forms":["travel"]}

{"headword":"tray","explanation":"名詞「托盤」。指一個扁平的容器，用於承載食物、飲料或工具。","entries":[{"sentence":"The waiter carefully carried a <target>tray</target> <pattern>full of</pattern> drinks to the table, making sure not to spill any liquid on the guests.","translation":"服務生小心地端著一個裝滿飲料的托盤走到桌邊，確保沒有任何液體灑在客人身上。","explanation":"名詞「托盤」。常用搭配：a tray full of (裝滿...的托盤)。"},{"sentence":"In the science lab, students placed their test tubes in a plastic <target>tray</target> to keep them organized and prevent them from rolling away.","translation":"在科學實驗室中，學生將試管放入塑料托盤中，以保持整齊並防止它們滾走。","explanation":"名詞「托盤」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"trend","explanation":"名詞「趨勢」。指事物發展的 general direction 或 common pattern。常用搭配：follow a trend (遵循趨勢), a growing trend (成長中的趨勢), a downward trend (下降趨勢)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a growing <target>trend</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students using digital tablets instead of traditional notebooks for taking notes in class.","translation":"現在有一種日益增長的趨勢，學生們使用數位平板電腦代替傳統筆記本在課堂上做筆記。","explanation":"名詞「趨勢」。常用搭配：a growing trend of (一種日益增長的趨勢)。"},{"sentence":"Fashion experts often analyze the latest <target>trends</target> to predict what colors and styles will be popular in the next season.","translation":"時尚專家經常分析最新趨勢，以預測下一個季節什麼顏色和風格會流行。","explanation":"名詞「趨勢」。"},{"sentence":"The company's sales figures showed a steady <target>trend</target> <pattern>of</pattern> increase over the past three years, indicating a successful marketing strategy.","translation":"公司的銷售數字在過去三年中顯示出穩定的增長趨勢，表明其營銷策略成功。","explanation":"名詞「趨勢」。常用搭配：a trend of increase (增長趨勢)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"tribe","explanation":"名詞「部落」。指一群擁有共同語言、文化或祖先的人們，通常在較原始的社會結構中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The anthropologist spent several months living with a remote <target>tribe</target> in the Amazon rainforest to study their unique customs and traditions.","translation":"人類學家在亞馬遜雨林中一個偏遠的部落中生活了幾個月，以研究他們獨特的習俗和傳統。","explanation":"名詞「部落」。"},{"sentence":"Each <target>tribe</target> in the region had its own distinct language and social structure, which helped them maintain their cultural identity.","translation":"該地區的每個部落都有其獨定的語言和社會結構，這有助於他們維持文化認同。","explanation":"名詞「部落」。"}],"related_forms":["tribal"]}

{"headword":"tricky","explanation":"形容詞「棘手的；狡猾的」。常用於描述問題、任務或情況複雜且難以處理。注意與 difficult 的區別：tricky 強調的是「微妙」或「容易出錯」的難度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The final exam included a few <target>tricky</target> questions that required students to think carefully and avoid simple mistakes.","translation":"期末考包含幾個棘手的問題，要求學生仔細思考並避免簡單的錯誤。","explanation":"形容詞「棘手的」。指問題複雜且容易讓人落入陷阱。"},{"sentence":"Installing the new software can be <target>tricky</target> <pattern>for</pattern> those who are not familiar with computer programming.","translation":"對於那些不熟悉電腦編程的人來說，安裝新軟體可能很棘手。","explanation":"形容詞「棘手的」。常用搭配：tricky for someone (對某人來說很棘手)。"},{"sentence":"The detective found it <target>tricky</target> to identify the suspect because the evidence left at the crime scene was very limited.","translation":"偵探發現辨識嫌疑犯很棘手，因為留在犯罪現場的證據非常有限。","explanation":"形容詞「棘手的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"troop","explanation":"名詞「部隊」。通常使用複數形 troops 指士兵或軍隊。常用搭配：deploy troops (部署部隊), withdraw troops (撤軍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <pattern>deploy</pattern> <target>troops</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the border to maintain peace and provide humanitarian aid to the local people.","translation":"政府決定向邊境部署部隊以維持和平並向當地民眾提供人道主義援助。","explanation":"名詞「部隊」。常用搭配：deploy troops to (向...部署部隊)。"},{"sentence":"After the conflict ended, the international organization ordered the <target>troops</target> to <pattern>withdraw</pattern> <pattern>from</pattern> the area immediately.","translation":"衝突結束後，國際組織命令部隊立即從該地區撤軍。","explanation":"名詞「部隊」。常用搭配：withdraw troops from (從...撤軍)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"tropical","explanation":"形容詞「熱帶的」。指位於熱帶地區（Tropical Zone）的氣候或植物。常用搭配：tropical rainforest (熱帶雨林), tropical climate (熱帶氣候)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>tropical</target> <pattern>rainforest</pattern> is home to a vast variety of plants and animals, many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.","translation":"熱帶雨林是大量種類的植物和動物的家園，其中許多在地球上其他地方都找不到。","explanation":"形容詞「熱帶的」。常用搭配：tropical rainforest (熱帶雨林)。"},{"sentence":"Traveling to a <target>tropical</target> <pattern>island</pattern> during the winter is a great way to escape the cold weather and relax on the beach.","translation":"在冬季前往熱帶島嶼是一個逃避寒冷天氣並在海灘上休息的絕佳方式。","explanation":"形容詞「熱帶的」。常用搭配：tropical island (熱帶島嶼)。"},{"sentence":"Because of the <target>tropical</target> <pattern>climate</pattern>, the region experiences high temperatures and heavy rainfall throughout the entire year.","translation":"因為熱帶氣候，該地區全年高溫且降雨量大。","explanation":"形容詞「熱帶的」。常用搭配：tropical climate (熱帶氣候)。"}],"related_forms":["tropics"]}

{"headword":"trumpet","explanation":"名詞「小號」。一種黃銅管樂器。在某些語境下，也可指用於發出警報或號令的喇叭。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student joined the school band and spent hours practicing the <target>trumpet</target> every day to prepare for the annual concert.","translation":"這名學生加入了學校樂團，每天花數小時練習小號，為年度音樂會做準備。","explanation":"名詞「小號」。"},{"sentence":"The loud sound of the <target>trumpet</target> signaled the start of the competition, and all the athletes began to run toward the finish line.","translation":"小號的嘹亮聲音信號著比賽的開始，所有運動員開始向終點線奔跑。","explanation":"名詞「喇叭/小號」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"trunk","explanation":"名詞，意為「樹幹」、「象鼻」或「汽車後車廂」。此詞為多義詞，需根據上下文判斷。常用搭配：car trunk (汽車後車廂), elephant's trunk (象鼻)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The storm was so powerful that it knocked over a large oak tree, splitting the thick <target>trunk</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the tree in half.","translation":"暴風雨如此強大，以至於將一棵巨大的橡樹吹倒，將樹幹劈成兩半。","explanation":"名詞「樹幹」。"},{"sentence":"The elephant used its long <target>trunk</target> to pick up food and spray water over its body to keep cool in the heat.","translation":"大象使用其長長的象鼻來拾取食物並向身體噴水以在炎熱中保持涼爽。","explanation":"名詞「象鼻」。"},{"sentence":"Before leaving for the trip, the family put all their heavy suitcases and camping gear in the <target>trunk</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the car.","translation":"出發旅行前，這家人將所有沉重的行李箱和露營裝備放在汽車的後車廂中。","explanation":"名詞「後車廂」。常用搭配：the trunk of the car。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"truthful","explanation":"形容詞「誠實的、真實的」。指一個人習慣說實話或陳述符合事實。常用於描述人的性格或陳述內容。注意與 true 的區別：truthful 通常描述人或其說法（如 a truthful person, a truthful answer），而 true 則強調事實的正確性或真實性（如 a true story, a true friend）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The judge encouraged the witness to be <target>truthful</target> <pattern>about</pattern> everything she saw during the accident to ensure a fair trial.","translation":"法官鼓勵證人對她在事故期間所見的一切誠實作答，以確保審判公正。","explanation":"形容詞「誠實的」。常用搭配：be truthful about sth。"},{"sentence":"It is important to give a <target>truthful</target> <pattern>account of</pattern> what happened, even if the truth is uncomfortable or embarrassing.","translation":"提供關於發生之事的誠實描述是很重要的，即使真相令人不安或尷尬。","explanation":"形容詞「真實的」。常用搭配：a truthful account of sth (對某事的誠實描述)。"}],"related_forms":["truthfully","truth"]}

{"headword":"tub","explanation":"名詞「浴缸；大桶」。通常指圓形或深形的容器，用於洗澡或存放大量液體。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a long day of hiking in the mountains, she decided to soak in a hot <target>tub</target> to relax her tired muscles.","translation":"在山中徒步旅行一整天後，她決定泡在熱浴缸中以放鬆疲憊的肌肉。","explanation":"名詞「浴缸」。"},{"sentence":"The farmer filled a large plastic <target>tub</target> <pattern>with</pattern> fresh water to give his thirsty animals a drink during the hot summer.","translation":"農夫用一個大的塑料桶裝滿新鮮的水，以便在炎熱的夏天讓口渴的動物喝水。","explanation":"名詞「大桶」。常用搭配：fill a tub with sth。"}],"related_forms":["tubs"]}

{"headword":"tug","explanation":"動詞「用力拉；猛拉」；名詞「用力一拉」。常用於描述突然且用力地拉動某物。注意片語 tug at sth (猛拉某物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little girl continued to <target>tug</target> <pattern>at</pattern> her mother's sleeve to get her attention while they were shopping in the crowded mall.","translation":"在擁擠的購物中心購物時，小女孩不斷猛拉母親的衣袖以引起她的注意。","explanation":"動詞「用力拉」。常用片語：tug at sth。"},{"sentence":"With one final, powerful <target>tug</target>, the rescuers managed to pull the heavy rope and save the stranded hiker from the ravine.","translation":"隨著最後一次強有力的猛拉，救援人員成功地用粗繩將受困於峽谷的徒步旅行者救出。","explanation":"名詞「用力一拉」。"}],"related_forms":["tugs","tugged","tugging"]}

{"headword":"tune","explanation":"名詞「曲調；旋律」；動詞「調音；調整」。名詞用法指音樂的旋律，動詞用法則指調整樂器使其音準正確，或比喻指調整某事以適應新情況。注意片語 stay in tune (音準正確) 或 be out of tune (走音)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The pianist spent several minutes <target>tuning</target> her instrument before the concert began, ensuring every note was perfectly accurate.","translation":"鋼琴家在音樂會開始前花了幾分鐘調整樂器音準，確保每個音符都完全正確。","explanation":"動詞「調音」。"},{"sentence":"The catchy <target>tune</target> of the popular song was played repeatedly on the radio, making it hard for students to forget it.","translation":"那首流行歌曲朗朗上口的曲調在廣播中反覆播放，讓學生們很難忘記它。","explanation":"名詞「曲調」。"},{"sentence":"During the music class, the teacher noticed that the student's singing was slightly <target>out of tune</target>, so he suggested some breathing exercises.","translation":"在音樂課上，老師注意到學生的唱歌稍微走音，因此建議了一些呼吸練習。","explanation":"形容詞片語 be out of tune 表示「走音」或「不協調」。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to <target>tune</target> its economic policies <pattern>to</pattern> the current market needs to reduce the unemployment rate.","translation":"政府正試圖將其經濟政策調整至符合目前的市場需求，以降低失業率。","explanation":"動詞「調整」。常用搭配：tune sth to sth。"}],"related_forms":["tunes","tuned","tuning"]}

{"headword":"tunnel","explanation":"名詞「隧道」；動詞「挖掘隧道」。通常指地下或山體內的人造通道。","entries":[{"sentence":"To avoid the heavy traffic on the mountain road, the government decided to build a new <target>tunnel</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the ridge.","translation":"為了避免山路上的交通擁堵，政府決定在山脊之間建造一座新隧道。","explanation":"名詞「隧道」。常用搭配：tunnel through sth。"},{"sentence":"The engineers spent years <target>tunneling</target> <pattern>under</pattern> the river to create a convenient transportation link between the two cities.","translation":"工程師們花了數年時間在河底挖掘隧道，以便在兩座城市之間建立便捷的交通連接。","explanation":"動詞「挖掘隧道」。常用搭配：tunnel under sth。"}],"related_forms":["tunnels","tunneled","tunneling"]}

{"headword":"tutor","explanation":"名詞「家教；導師」；動詞「指導；教導」。指提供個體化教學的專業人員或行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since he struggled with advanced mathematics, his parents hired a professional <target>tutor</target> to help him prepare for the final exam.","translation":"由於他在進階數學方面有困難，他的父母請了一位專業家教來幫助他準備期末考。","explanation":"名詞「家教」。"},{"sentence":"The university provides free peer <target>tutoring</target> services, allowing senior students to <target>tutor</target> freshmen in writing academic essays.","translation":"大學提供免費的同儕指導服務，讓高年級學生能指導新生撰寫學術論文。","explanation":"名詞 tutoring (指導) 與 動詞 tutor (指導)。"}],"related_forms":["tutors","tutored","tutoring"]}
