{"headword": "twin", "explanation": "名詞「雙胞胎」；形容詞「成對的、相似的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>twins</target> look so similar that even their own parents sometimes have trouble telling them apart at first glance.", "translation": "這對雙胞胎長得如此相像，以至於他們的父母有時第一眼也很難分辨他們。", "explanation": "名詞「雙胞胎」。"}, {"sentence": "The two cities are often called <target>twin</target> cities because they share similar economic goals and cultural exchange programs.", "translation": "這兩座城市常被稱為姐妹城市（對等城市），因為它們擁有相似的經濟目標和文化交流計畫。", "explanation": "形容詞「相似的、成對的」。"}, {"sentence": "Many students find it helpful to have a <target>twin</target> study partner who shares the same goals and keeps them motivated throughout the semester.", "translation": "許多學生發現擁有一個目標相同且能在整個學期激勵自己的學習夥伴非常有幫助。", "explanation": "形容詞「相似的、成對的」。"}, {"sentence": "The new hotel features <target>twin</target> beds in most of its rooms, providing a comfortable option for friends traveling together.", "translation": "這家新酒店的大多數房間都配有兩張單人床，以提供給一同旅行的朋友們一個舒適的選擇。", "explanation": "形容詞「成對的」。"}], "related_forms": ["twinned"]}

{"headword":"twist","explanation":"名詞「扭轉；轉折」；動詞「扭轉；使扭曲」。動詞可用於物理上的扭轉，或比喻指改變故事的走向（如 a plot twist）。注意片語 twist sth into sth (將某物扭轉成某物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"While playing basketball, the athlete accidentally <target>twisted</target> his ankle and had to leave the game immediately to see a doctor.","translation":"打籃球時，這名運動員不小心扭到了腳踝，必須立即離開比賽去看醫生。","explanation":"動詞「扭到」。"},{"sentence":"The movie ended with a surprising <target>twist</target> that no one in the audience had expected, changing the entire meaning of the story.","translation":"電影以一個出人意料的轉折結束，觀眾中沒有人預料到，這改變了整個故事的含義。","explanation":"名詞「轉折」。常用於 plot twist (劇情轉折)。"},{"sentence":"She carefully <target>twisted</target> the piece of wire <pattern>into</pattern> a small circle to create a handmade piece of jewelry.","translation":"她小心地將這根電線扭成一個小圓圈，以製作一件手工珠寶。","explanation":"動詞「扭轉」。常用片語：twist sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"Some people <target>twist</target> the truth <pattern>to</pattern> fit their own interests, which makes it difficult for others to trust their words.","translation":"有些人會扭曲事實以符合自己的利益，這使得他人很難信任他們的話。","explanation":"動詞「扭曲 (比喻用法)」。常用搭配：twist the truth。"}],"related_forms":["twists","twisted","twisting"]}

{"headword": "underlying", "explanation": "形容詞「潛在的、底層的」。指不表面地存在但具有重要影響力的因素或原因。常用於描述原因 (underlying cause) 或問題 (underlying problem)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The doctor explained that the patient's fever was just a symptom, and they needed to find the <target>underlying</target> <pattern>cause of</pattern> the infection.", "translation": "醫生解釋說病人的發燒只是一個症狀，他們需要找到感染的潛在原因。", "explanation": "形容詞「潛在的」。常用搭配：underlying cause of sth。"}, {"sentence": "To solve the conflict between the two students, the teacher tried to understand the <target>underlying</target> <pattern>tension</pattern> that had been building up for months.", "translation": "為了解決兩名學生之間的衝突，老師試圖理解數月來一直累積的潛在緊張關係。", "explanation": "形容詞「潛在的」。常用搭配：underlying tension。"}, {"sentence": "The researchers argued that the <target>underlying</target> <pattern>assumption</pattern> of the study was flawed, leading to incorrect conclusions about the drug's effectiveness.", "translation": "研究人員認為該研究的潛在假設有缺陷，導致關於該藥物有效性的結論錯誤。", "explanation": "形容詞「潛在的」。常用搭配：underlying assumption (潛在假設)。"}, {"sentence": "Understanding the <target>underlying</target> <pattern>principles</pattern> of physics is more important than simply memorizing formulas for the final examination.", "translation": "理解物理學的底層原理比單純為期末考試背誦公式更重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「底層的」。常用搭配：underlying principle (底層原理)。"}], "related_forms": ["underlie"]}

{"headword":"underwear","explanation":"名詞「內衣」。不可數名詞，通常指穿在衣服內面的衣物。","entries":[{"sentence":"When packing for the camping trip, he remembered to bring enough <target>underwear</target> for the entire week to maintain good personal hygiene.","translation":"在準備露營旅行的行李時，他記得帶足夠一週份量的內衣，以維持良好的個人衛生。","explanation":"名詞「內衣」。不可數名詞。"},{"sentence":"The store sells a wide variety of comfortable <target>underwear</target> made <pattern>from</pattern> organic cotton, which is gentle on the skin.","translation":"這家店販售多種由有機棉製成且舒適的內衣，使用起來對皮膚很溫和。","explanation":"名詞「內衣」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"union","explanation":"名詞「聯盟；工會；結合」。常用於指政治上的聯合、勞工組織或兩人的結合。注意搭配 join a union (加入工會) 或 form a union (組成聯盟)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The workers decided to join a labor <target>union</target> to <pattern>fight for</pattern> better wages and safer working conditions in the factory.","translation":"工人們決定加入勞工工會，以爭取更好的工資和工廠中更安全的工作條件。","explanation":"名詞「工會」。常用搭配：labor union (勞工工會), fight for (爭取)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>union</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the two small companies created a more powerful business that could compete on a global scale.","translation":"這兩家小公司的合併創造了一家更強大的企業，能夠在全球範圍內競爭。","explanation":"名詞「聯盟；結合」。常用搭配：the union of A and B。"},{"sentence":"After years of friendship and shared goals, the marriage represented a perfect <target>union</target> <pattern>of</pattern> two souls who truly understood each other.","translation":"經過多年的友誼和共同目標，這場婚姻代表了兩個真正理解彼此的靈魂的完美結合。","explanation":"名詞「結合」。指人與人之間的關係結合。"}],"related_forms":["unite","unity","unions"]}

{"headword":"unique","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的；唯一的」。指某物在特質上與眾不同，且通常是正面的。注意與 unique (唯一的) 和 unusual (不尋常的) 的區別。常搭配 unique to (對...而言是獨特的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The island is home to several <target>unique</target> species of birds that cannot be found anywhere else in the world.","translation":"這個島嶼是幾種獨特鳥類的家鄉，在世界上其他任何地方都找不到。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。指特質與眾不同。"},{"sentence":"Each student has a <target>unique</target> way <pattern>of</pattern> learning, so teachers should use different methods to help everyone succeed.","translation":"每個學生都有獨特的學習方式，因此老師應該使用不同的方法來幫助每個人成功。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。常用搭配：unique way of V-ing。"},{"sentence":"The traditional architecture of this small village is <target>unique</target> <pattern>to</pattern> this region and reflects its rich history.","translation":"這個小村莊的傳統建築是該地區特有的，反映了其豐富的歷史。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。片語 unique to sth 表示「對...而言是獨特/特有的」。"}],"related_forms":["uniquely","uniqueness"]}

{"headword":"unite","explanation":"動詞「團結；統一」。指將分離的個體或群體結合在一起。注意搭配 unite with (與...團結) 或 unite in (在...方面團結)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two neighboring countries decided to <target>unite</target> <pattern>to</pattern> fight against a common enemy and protect their borders.","translation":"這兩個鄰國決定團結起來對抗共同的敵人並保護他們的邊界。","explanation":"動詞「團結」。指為了共同目標而結合。"},{"sentence":"The tragedy <target>united</target> the community <pattern>in</pattern> a shared sense of grief and a strong desire to help those affected.","translation":"這場悲劇讓社區在共同的悲痛感和幫助受災者的強烈願望中團結起來。","explanation":"動詞「團結」。片語 unite in sth 表示「在某方面團結」。"},{"sentence":"The leader urged the citizens to <target>unite</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other regardless of their political beliefs to save their city.","translation":"領導者敦促公民不論政治信仰如何，都要彼此團結，以拯救他們的城市。","explanation":"動詞「團結」。片語 unite with sb 表示「與某人團結」。"}],"related_forms":["unity","union","united"]}

{"headword":"unity","explanation":"名詞「團結；統一」。指一個整體中各個部分之間的和諧與一致性。常用於描述政治、社會或藝術作品的整體感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The team showed great <target>unity</target> when they <pattern>stood</pattern> <target>together</target> to support their teammate who was injured during the game.","translation":"當球隊成員共同站在一起支持在比賽中受傷的隊友時，他們展現了極大的團結。","explanation":"名詞「團結」。常用搭配：show unity (展現團結)。"},{"sentence":"The government's goal is to promote national <target>unity</target> and reduce conflicts between different ethnic groups within the country.","translation":"政府的目標是促進國家團結並減少國內不同族群之間的衝突。","explanation":"名詞「統一/團結」。常用搭配：national unity (國家團結)。"},{"sentence":"The artist aimed for a sense of <target>unity</target> <pattern>in</pattern> her painting by using a similar color palette throughout the work.","translation":"藝術家旨在透過在整幅畫中使用相似的色調，來營造一種統一感。","explanation":"名詞「統一感」。指藝術作品中的和諧一致。"}],"related_forms":["unite","union"]}

{"headword":"urban","explanation":"形容詞「城市的；都市的」。常用於與 urban area (都市區) 或 urban planning (都市計畫) 等詞彙搭配。注意與 rural (鄉村的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young people move from rural areas to <target>urban</target> <pattern>centers</pattern> in search of better job opportunities and education.","translation":"許多年輕人從鄉村地區移往都市中心，以尋找更好的工作機會和教育。","explanation":"形容詞「城市的」。常用搭配：urban center (都市中心)。"},{"sentence":"The city council is discussing new <target>urban</target> <pattern>planning</pattern> strategies to reduce traffic congestion and increase green spaces for residents.","translation":"市議會正在討論新的都市計畫策略，以減少交通擁堵並增加居民的綠地空間。","explanation":"形容詞「城市的」。常用搭配：urban planning (都市計畫)。"},{"sentence":"Living in an <target>urban</target> <pattern>environment</pattern> can be stressful due to the noise and pollution, but it offers more convenience.","translation":"居住在都市環境中可能會因為噪音和污染而感到壓力，但它提供了更多便利。","explanation":"形容詞「都市的」。常用搭配：urban environment (都市環境)。"}],"related_forms":["urbanization","urbanly"]}

{"headword":"vacant","explanation":"形容詞「空缺的；空置的」。常用於描述房間、座位或職位空缺。注意與 empty (空的) 的區別：vacant 通常指「本應有主或有人的地方現在沒人」，而 empty 則是指「裡面沒東西」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel manager informed the guests that there were no <target>vacant</target> <pattern>rooms</pattern> available for the weekend, as it was peak season.","translation":"飯店經理告知客人，由於是旺季，週末沒有空房可供預訂。","explanation":"形容詞「空置的」。常用搭配：vacant room (空房)。"},{"sentence":"After the manager retired, the company announced that there was a <target>vacant</target> <pattern>position</pattern> in the marketing department for a new leader.","translation":"經理退休後，公司宣布行銷部門有一個領導者空缺職位。","explanation":"形容詞「空缺的」。常用搭配：vacant position (空缺職位)。"},{"sentence":"She looked around the library and found a <target>vacant</target> <pattern>seat</pattern> near the window, where she could study in peace.","translation":"她在圖書館四處看了一眼，發現窗邊有一個空位，在那裡她可以安靜地學習。","explanation":"形容詞「空置的」。常用搭配：vacant seat (空位)。"}],"related_forms":["vacancy","vacate"]}

{"headword":"van","explanation":"名詞「廂車；貨車」。一種小型貨車，常用於運送貨物或人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The delivery driver parked his <target>van</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the curb and quickly carried the packages to the customer's front door.","translation":"快遞員將他的廂車停在路邊，並迅速地將包裹送到顧客的前門。","explanation":"名詞「廂車」。指運貨用的貨車。"},{"sentence":"The school hired a large <target>van</target> <pattern>to</pattern> transport the sports team to the national competition in the other city.","translation":"學校聘請了一輛大廂車，將體育隊運送到另一個城市的全國性比賽。","explanation":"名詞「廂車」。指運送人員的車輛。"}],"related_forms":["vans"]}

{"headword":"vanish","explanation":"動詞「消失」。指某物突然地或完全地消失。注意搭配 vanish from (從...消失) 或 vanish into (消失在...中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The magician performed a trick where he made the rabbit <target>vanish</target> <pattern>into</pattern> thin air, leaving the audience completely amazed.","translation":"魔術師表演了一個技巧，讓兔子在空氣中突然消失，讓觀眾完全驚訝。","explanation":"動詞「消失」。常用片語 vanish into thin air (突然消失)。"},{"sentence":"As the sun rose higher in the sky, the morning mist slowly <target>vanished</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the valley, revealing the beautiful landscape.","translation":"隨著太陽升到天空更高處，早晨的霧氣慢慢從山谷中消失，展現出美麗的風景。","explanation":"動詞「消失」。片語 vanish from sth 表示「從...消失」。"},{"sentence":"Many traditional customs have <target>vanished</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the years as people's lifestyles and values have changed in the modern era.","translation":"隨著現代時代人們的生活方式和價值觀改變，許多傳統習俗多年來已逐漸消失。","explanation":"動詞「消失」。指逐漸消失。"}],"related_forms":["vanishing"]}

{"headword": "variety", "explanation": "名詞「多樣性；各種」。常用於指同一類別中不同的種類。注意搭配 a variety of (各種各樣的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The supermarket offers a wide <target>variety</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fresh fruits and vegetables from different countries to satisfy customers' tastes.", "translation": "這家超市提供各種各樣來自不同國家的新鮮水果和蔬菜，以滿足顧客的口味。", "explanation": "名詞「多樣性」。常用片語 a variety of + 複數名詞 (各種各樣的)。"}, {"sentence": "To make the lesson more interesting, the teacher used a <target>variety</target> <pattern>of</pattern> teaching methods, including games, discussions and videos.", "translation": "為了讓課程更有趣，老師使用了各種各樣的教學方法，包括遊戲、討論和影片。", "explanation": "名詞「多樣性」。常用片語 a variety of + 複數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "Biologists study a great <target>variety</target> <pattern>of</pattern> plants in the rainforest to find new medicines that can cure rare diseases.", "translation": "生物學家在雨林中研究各種各樣的植物，以尋找能治療罕見疾病的新藥物。", "explanation": "名詞「多樣性」。常用片語 a variety of and variety (多樣性)。"}], "related_forms": ["various", "variable", "varied"]}

{"headword":"various","explanation":"形容詞「各種各樣的」。指不同種類的或數量較多的。常用於修飾複數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university provides <target>various</target> <pattern>resources</pattern>, such as online libraries and tutoring centers, to help students achieve academic success.","translation":"大學提供各種各樣的資源，例如在線圖書館和輔導中心，以幫助學生取得學業成功。","explanation":"形容詞「各種各樣的」。常用於修飾複數名詞。"},{"sentence":"Despite <target>various</target> <pattern>attempts</pattern> to fix the old computer, the technician told the student that it was time to buy a new one.","translation":"儘管嘗試了各種各樣的方法來修理舊電腦，技術人員告訴學生該買一台新電腦了。","explanation":"形容詞「各種各樣的」。常用搭配：various attempts (各種嘗試)。"},{"sentence":"The travel agent suggested <target>various</target> <pattern>options</pattern> for the graduation trip, including a beach resort or a mountain hiking trail.","translation":"旅行社建議了各種各樣的畢業旅行選項，包括海邊度假村或山區徒步路徑。","explanation":"形容詞「各種各樣的」。常用搭配：various options (各種選項)。"}],"related_forms":["variety","variously"]}

{"headword":"vary","explanation":"動詞「改變、變動」或「不同」。指事物在程度、形式、數量或性質上有所差異。常用搭配 vary from... to... (從...到...不等) 或 vary with (隨...而改變)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather in this region can <target>vary</target> <pattern>greatly</pattern> <pattern>from</pattern> one day <pattern>to</pattern> another, making it difficult for tourists to plan their activities.","translation":"這個地區的天氣一天之間可能有很大差異，使得遊客很難計劃他們的活動。","explanation":"動詞「變動」。常用搭配：vary from A to B (從A到B不等)。"},{"sentence":"The cost of hotel rooms usually <target>varies</target> <pattern>depending on</pattern> the season, with prices peaking during the summer holidays.","translation":"飯店房間的價格通常根據季節而有所不同，在夏季假期期間價格最高。","explanation":"動詞「不同」。指價格隨季節變化。"},{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the students to <target>vary</target> their writing style by using different sentence structures to make their essays more interesting.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生通過使用不同的句子結構來改變他們的寫作風格，使他們的論文更有趣。","explanation":"動詞「改變」。指刻意使事物變得多樣化以避免單調。"}],"related_forms":["various","variety","variable"]}

{"headword":"vase","explanation":"名詞「花瓶」。用於裝花或裝飾品的容器。","entries":[{"sentence":"She carefully placed the fresh lilies in a crystal <target>vase</target> on the dining table to brighten up the room for the guests.","translation":"她小心地將新鮮的百合花放入餐桌上的水晶花瓶中，為客人點亮整個房間。","explanation":"名詞「花瓶」。"},{"sentence":"While cleaning the living room, the child accidentally knocked over the expensive <target>vase</target>, causing it to shatter into many pieces.","translation":"在清理客廳時，孩子不小心撞翻了昂貴的花瓶，導致它碎成了許多片。","explanation":"名詞「花瓶」。"}],"related_forms":["vases"]}

{"headword": "vehicle", "explanation": "名詞「車輛」或「媒介」。指用於運輸的工具，或是達成某種目的的手段或媒介。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Electric cars are becoming a popular <target>vehicle</target> <pattern>for</pattern> reducing air pollution in big cities across the world.", "translation": "電動車正成為全球大城市減少空氣污染的一種流行車輛。", "explanation": "名詞「車輛」。指運輸工具。"}, {"sentence": "For many artists, painting is a powerful <target>vehicle</target> <pattern>for</pattern> expressing their deepest emotions and social concerns.", "translation": "對於許多藝術家來說，繪畫是表達他們最深層情感和社會關懷的強大媒介。", "explanation": "名詞「媒介」。指達成某種目的的手段。"}, {"sentence": "The government hopes that the new cultural festival will serve as a <target>vehicle</target> <pattern>for</pattern> promoting local traditions to young people.", "translation": "政府希望新的文化節將成為向年輕人推廣當地傳統的媒介。", "explanation": "名詞「媒介」。常用搭配：serve as a vehicle for sth。"}, {"sentence": "The police officer asked the driver to step out of the <target>vehicle</target> so that they could check his identification documents.", "translation": "警察要求駕駛員走出車輛，以便核對其身份證明文件。", "explanation": "名詞「車輛」。指運輸工具。"}, {"sentence": "Television has often been used as a <target>vehicle</target> <pattern>for</pattern> advertising new products to a wide audience of consumers.", "translation": "電視經常被用作向廣大消費者廣告新產品的媒介。", "explanation": "名詞「媒介」。"}], "related_forms": ["vehicles"]}

{"headword":"verse","explanation":"名詞「詩句」或「韻文」。指具有特定節奏或韻律的文字，常用於詩歌或聖經的章節。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student spent hours carefully analyzing each <target>verse</target> of the poem to understand the hidden metaphors and the poet's intentions.","translation":"學生花了幾個小時仔細分析這首詩的每一句，以理解隱藏的隱喻和詩人的意圖。","explanation":"名詞「詩句」。指詩歌中的一行或一段。"},{"sentence":"The songwriter wrote a beautiful <target>verse</target> that perfectly captured the feeling of longing and sadness in the bridge of the song.","translation":"詞作者寫了一段美麗的韻文，在歌曲的橋段中完美地捕捉到了渴望與悲傷的情感。","explanation":"名詞「韻文」。指歌曲中重複副歌之前的段落。"}],"related_forms":["verses"]}

{"headword":"vest","explanation":"名詞「背心」。指一種沒有袖子的上衣，常穿在襯衫外面或作為內衣。","entries":[{"sentence":"The groom wore a formal black <target>vest</target> over his white shirt to look more professional and elegant during the wedding ceremony.","translation":"新郎在白色襯衫外穿了一件正式的黑色背心，以便在婚禮儀式上看起來更專業且優雅。","explanation":"名詞「背心」。指正式服裝中的馬甲。"},{"sentence":"During the summer, he often wears a light cotton <target>vest</target> to stay cool and comfortable while working in the garden.","translation":"在夏天，他經常穿一件輕便的棉質背心，以便在花園工作時保持涼爽舒適。","explanation":"名詞「背心」。指休閒的內衣或背心。"}],"related_forms":["vests"]}

{"headword":"victim","explanation":"名詞「受害者」。指遭受傷害、疾病或欺騙的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are searching for witnesses who may have seen the accident, hoping to find more information to help the <target>victim</target> of the crime.","translation":"警方正在尋找可能看到事故的目擊者，希望找到更多資訊以幫助犯罪的受害者。","explanation":"名詞「受害者」。"},{"sentence":"Many elderly people often <pattern>fall</pattern> <target>victim</target> <pattern>to</pattern> online scams because they are less familiar with how the internet works.","translation":"許多老年人經常成為網路詐騙的受害者，因為他們對網路運作方式較不熟悉。","explanation":"名詞「受害者」。常用片語 fall victim to (成為...的受害者)。"}],"related_forms":["victims"]}

{"headword":"violence","explanation":"名詞「暴力」。指使用體力或武力造成傷害的行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to implement new laws to reduce <target>violence</target> <pattern>in</pattern> schools and promote a peaceful learning environment.","translation":"政府正試圖實施新法律以減少校園暴力，並促進一個和平的學習環境。","explanation":"名詞「暴力」。常用搭配：violence in schools (校園暴力)。"},{"sentence":"Many parents are concerned that exposure to extreme <target>violence</target> <pattern>in</pattern> video games may lead to aggressive behavior in young children.","translation":"許多家長擔心接觸到電子遊戲中極端的暴力內容可能會導致年幼兒童產生攻擊行為。","explanation":"名詞「暴力」。"}],"related_forms":["violent"]}

{"headword":"violent","explanation":"形容詞「暴力的、激烈的」。指使用武力的行為，或是程度極其強烈的狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The protesters became <target>violent</target> after the police tried to move them, resulting in several broken windows and damaged street furniture.","translation":"在警方試圖將抗議者移走後，抗議者變得暴力，導致數扇窗戶被打破以及街道設施受損。","explanation":"形容詞「暴力的」。指行為具有攻擊性。"},{"sentence":"The coast was hit by a <target>violent</target> storm that destroyed many houses and forced thousands of people to evacuate their homes.","translation":"海岸線被一場激烈的風暴襲擊，摧毀了許多房屋並迫使數千人撤離家園。","explanation":"形容詞「激烈的」。指自然現象程度強烈。"}],"related_forms":["violence","violently"]}

{"headword":"violet","explanation":"形容詞「紫羅蘭色的、紫色的」；名詞「紫羅蘭」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The garden was filled with beautiful <target>violet</target> flowers that bloomed in early spring, attracting many bees and butterflies.","translation":"花園裡開滿了美麗的紫羅蘭花，在早春綻放，吸引了許多蜜蜂和蝴蝶。","explanation":"名詞「紫羅蘭」。"},{"sentence":"She chose a <target>violet</target> dress for the graduation party, which perfectly matched the color of her eyes and looked very elegant.","translation":"她選擇了一件紫色的禮服參加畢業派對，這完美地搭配了她的眼睛顏色，看起來非常優雅。","explanation":"形容詞「紫色的」。"}],"related_forms":["violets"]}

{"headword":"visible","explanation":"形容詞「可見的、明顯的」。指可以用眼睛看到，或者某種特質或情感非常明顯。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mountain peak was <target>visible</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the window of the hotel, giving the tourists a breathtaking view of the landscape.","translation":"從飯店的窗戶可以看到山峰，讓遊客能欣賞到壯麗的風景。","explanation":"形容詞「可見的」。常用搭配：visible from (從...可見)。"},{"sentence":"There was a <target>visible</target> <pattern>difference</pattern> <pattern>between</pattern> the two paintings, as one used bright colors while the other used dark tones.","translation":"這兩幅畫之間有明顯的差異，因為一幅使用了明亮的色彩，而另一幅使用了暗色調。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。常用搭配：visible difference (明顯差異)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher could see the <target>visible</target> <pattern>relief</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> the student's face when he finally finished the difficult exam.","translation":"老師能看到學生在終於完成艱難考試時，臉上顯露出的明顯寬慰。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。指情感或狀態外在可見。"}],"related_forms":["visibility","visibly"]}

{"headword":"vision","explanation":"名詞「視力、景象、願景」。指視覺能力、夢境中的景象或對未來的想像。常用搭配 vision for (對...的願景) 或 a vision of (某種景象)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After wearing glasses for several years, the boy's <target>vision</target> gradually improved, and he could finally see the blackboard clearly.","translation":"戴眼鏡好幾年後，男孩的視力逐漸改善，他終於能清楚地看到黑板了。","explanation":"名詞「視力」。"},{"sentence":"The CEO presented a clear <target>vision</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the company's future, inspiring the employees to work harder toward a shared goal.","translation":"執行長提出了公司未來的清晰願景，激勵員工們為了共同目標而更加努力工作。","explanation":"名詞「願景」。常用搭配 vision for sth。"},{"sentence":"In his dream, he had a sudden <target>vision</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a beautiful city floating in the clouds, which felt incredibly real to him.","translation":"在夢中，他突然看到一座漂浮在雲端之上的美麗城市，這對他而言感覺異常真實。","explanation":"名詞「景象」。常用搭配 a vision of sth。"}],"related_forms":["visual","visionary"]}

{"headword": "vitamin", "explanation": "名詞「維生素」。指身體健康所需的必需營養素。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Eating a variety of fresh fruits and vegetables is the best way to <pattern>get enough</pattern> <target>vitamins</target> to stay healthy.", "translation": "食用多樣的新鮮水果和蔬菜是確保身體獲得足夠維生素以保持健康的最佳方式。", "explanation": "名詞「維生素」。常用搭配：get enough vitamins (獲得足夠的維生素)。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor recommended taking a <target>vitamin</target> <pattern>supplement</pattern> every morning to boost the patient's immune system during the cold winter.", "translation": "醫生建議每天早上服用維生素補充劑，以在寒冷的冬天增強患者的免疫系統。", "explanation": "名詞「維生素」。常用搭配 vitamin supplement (維生素補充劑)。"}, {"sentence": "Many students feel tired during exams because they lack essential <target>vitamins</target> and minerals in their daily diet.", "translation": "許多學生在考試期間感到疲倦，因為他們的日常飲食中缺乏必要的維生素和礦物質。", "explanation": "名詞「維生素」。"}], "related_forms": ["vitamins"]}

{"headword":"vivid","explanation":"形容詞「生動的、鮮明的」。可用於描述顏色鮮豔、回憶清晰或描述詳細且生動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author used <target>vivid</target> descriptions of the scenery to make the readers feel as if they were actually visiting the ancient temple.","translation":"作者對風景使用了生動的描述，使讀者感覺就像他們真的在參訪那座古廟一樣。","explanation":"形容詞「生動的」。常用搭配 vivid description。"},{"sentence":"Even though the accident happened many years ago, she still has a <target>vivid</target> memory <pattern>of</pattern> the events that occurred that day.","translation":"儘管事故發生在許多年前，她對那天發生的事情依然有著鮮明的記憶。","explanation":"形容詞「鮮明的」。常用搭配 vivid memory of sth。"},{"sentence":"The sunset painted the sky in <target>vivid</target> colors of orange and purple, creating a breathtaking view for the tourists on the beach.","translation":"夕陽將天空染成鮮豔的橘色和紫色，為海邊的遊客創造了令人屏息的美景。","explanation":"形容詞「鮮豔的」。"}],"related_forms":["vividly"]}

{"headword": "vocabulary", "explanation": "名詞「詞彙、詞彙量」。指某人掌握的單字量或某種語言的所有單字。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Reading a wide range of English books is an effective way for students to <pattern>expand</pattern> their <target>vocabulary</target> and improve their writing skills.", "translation": "閱讀各種英文書籍是學生擴展詞彙量並提高寫作能力的有效方式。", "explanation": "名詞「詞彙量」。常用搭配 expand vocabulary (擴展詞彙量)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher encouraged the students to use new <target>vocabulary</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their essays to make their writing more professional and precise.", "translation": "老師鼓勵學生在作文中運用新詞彙，使他們的寫作更專業且精確。", "explanation": "名詞「詞彙」。"}], "related_forms": ["vocabularies"]}

{"headword":"volleyball","explanation":"名詞「排球」。一種球類運動。","entries":[{"sentence":"After school, many students gather at the gym to play <target>volleyball</target>, which is a great way to exercise and build teamwork.","translation":"放學後，許多學生聚集在體育館打排球，這是一個運動和培養團隊合作的絕佳方式。","explanation":"名詞「排球」。"},{"sentence":"The school's <target>volleyball</target> team practiced hard every afternoon to prepare for the upcoming inter-school competition next month.","translation":"學校的排球隊每天下午努力練習，為下個月即將到來的校際比賽做準備。","explanation":"名詞「排球」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"volume","explanation":"名詞「音量、體積、卷」。指聲音的大小、物體的空間大小或書籍的系列之中的一卷。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please turn down the <target>volume</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the radio so that I can concentrate on my homework without any loud distractions.","translation":"請調低收音機的音量，這樣我才能在沒有大聲干擾的情況下專注於我的作業。","explanation":"名詞「音量」。常用搭配 turn down/up the volume。"},{"sentence":"The scientist measured the <target>volume</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the liquid in the beaker to ensure the chemical reaction would occur correctly.","translation":"科學家測量了燒杯中液體的體積，以確保化學反應能正確發生。","explanation":"名詞「體積」。"},{"sentence":"The library has a complete set of the encyclopedia, consisting of twenty-four <target>volumes</target> that cover a vast range of human knowledge.","translation":"圖書館擁有一套完整的百科全書，由二十四卷組成，涵蓋了人類知識的廣泛範圍。","explanation":"名詞「卷」。指書籍的系列分卷。"}],"related_forms":["voluminous"]}

{"headword":"voter","explanation":"名詞「投票者」。指參與選舉投票的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The political candidate spent months traveling across the country to meet <target>voters</target> and explain his plans for improving the economy.","translation":"這位政治候選人花了好幾個月在全國各地旅行，以會見投票者並解釋他改善經濟的計畫。","explanation":"名詞「投票者」。"},{"sentence":"To increase the number of <target>voters</target>, the government launched a campaign to encourage young people to participate in the democratic process.","translation":"為了增加投票者的數量，政府發起了一場運動，鼓勵年輕人參與民主進程。","explanation":"名詞「投票者」。"}],"related_forms":["vote"]}

{"headword": "wage", "explanation": "名詞「工資」。通常指按小時或按週支付的報酬。動詞則指「發動（戰爭、運動等）」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The workers decided to go on strike to demand a higher minimum <target>wage</target> to cope with the rising cost of living.", "translation": "工人們決定採取罷工，要求提高最低工資以應對生活成本的上升。", "explanation": "名詞「工資」。常用搭配 minimum wage (最低工資)。"}, {"sentence": "Since he started working part-time at the cafe, he has been earning a decent <target>wage</target> that allows him to save money for college.", "translation": "自從他開始在咖啡廳兼職後，他一直賺著相當不錯的工資，讓他能為大學存錢。", "explanation": "名詞「工資」。"}, {"sentence": "The two nations decided to <target>wage</target> a war <pattern>against</pattern> each other after years of failed diplomatic negotiations.", "translation": "這兩國在經歷多年的外交談判失敗後，決定對彼此發動戰爭。", "explanation": "動詞「發動」。常用搭配 wage a war against sth。"}], "related_forms": ["wages"]}

{"headword":"wagon","explanation":"名詞「貨車、馬車」。指一種用於運送貨物或小孩的乘客車。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmers used a wooden <target>wagon</target> <pattern>pulled by</pattern> horses to transport their harvested corn to the local market.","translation":"農夫們使用由馬匹牽引的木製貨車將收割的玉米運送到當地市場。","explanation":"名詞「貨車」。常用搭配 pulled by horses。"},{"sentence":"The little girl pulled her favorite red <target>wagon</target> across the garden, filling it with her toys and colorful flowers.","translation":"小女孩在花園中拉著她最喜歡的紅色小貨車，裡面裝滿了她的玩具和色彩繽紛的花朵。","explanation":"名詞「小貨車」。"}],"related_forms":["wagons"]}

{"headword": "wander", "explanation": "動詞「漫遊、閒逛」。指漫無目的地地走或思想地分心。名詞形式則指這種行為。", "entries": [{"sentence": "On their first day in Paris, the tourists decided to <target>wander</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the narrow streets, exploring the hidden cafes and art galleries.", "translation": "在巴黎的第一天，遊客們決定在狹窄的街道上閒逛，探索隱藏的咖啡館和藝術畫廊。", "explanation": "動詞「閒逛」。常用搭配 wander through sth。"}, {"sentence": "During the boring lecture, the student's mind began to <target>wander</target>, and she started imagining her upcoming summer vacation.", "translation": "在無聊的演講期間，學生的大腦開始分心，她開始想像她即將到來的暑假。", "explanation": "動詞「分心」。指思想漫遊。"}, {"sentence": "The hikers were warned not to <target>wander</target> <pattern>off</pattern> the marked trail, as the forest was dense and easy to get lost in.", "translation": "登山客被警告在標記的步道上行走，不要離開步道，因為森林茂密且容易迷路。", "explanation": "動詞片語 wander off 表示「離開（路徑/關注點）」。"}], "related_forms": ["wanderer"]}

{"headword":"warmth","explanation":"名詞，意為「溫暖」或「熱情」。可用於描述物理上的溫度，也可指人對待他人時表現出的親切感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soft <target>warmth</target> of the sun on her face made her feel relaxed and peaceful as she walked through the autumn park.","translation":"陽光灑在她臉上的溫暖讓她在走過秋天公園時感到放鬆且平靜。","explanation":"名詞「溫暖」。指物理上的溫度。"},{"sentence":"Everyone was touched by the <target>warmth</target> of the villagers' welcome, as they provided food and shelter to the tired travelers.","translation":"每個人都被村民們歡迎的熱情所感動，因為他們為疲憊的旅人提供了食物和住所。","explanation":"名詞「熱情」。指情感上的親切感。"}],"related_forms":["warm"]}

{"headword":"warn","explanation":"動詞「警告」。提醒某人可能發生的危險或問題。常用搭配：warn someone of/about something (警告某人注意某事), warn someone not to do something (警告某人不要做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lifeguard <target>warned</target> the swimmers <pattern>about</pattern> the strong currents near the rocks, advising them to stay in the safe zone.","translation":"救生員警告游泳者注意岩石附近的強勁水流，建議他們留在安全區域。","explanation":"動詞「警告」。常用搭配：warn someone about something。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <target>warned</target> the students <pattern>not to</pattern> cheat during the exam, reminding them that honesty is more important than grades.","translation":"老師警告學生不要在考試中作弊，提醒他們誠實比成績更重要。","explanation":"動詞「警告」。常用搭配：warn someone not to do something。"},{"sentence":"Dark clouds and strong winds <target>warned</target> the sailors <pattern>of</pattern> an approaching storm, prompting them to return to the harbor quickly.","translation":"烏雲和強風警告水手們暴風雨即將到來，促使他們迅速返回港口。","explanation":"動詞「警告」。常用搭配：warn someone of something。"}],"related_forms":["warning","warned"]}

{"headword":"waterfall","explanation":"名詞「瀑布」。指水流從高處落下的自然景觀。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hiking for three hours, the group finally reached a breathtaking <target>waterfall</target> that flowed into a crystal-clear blue pool below.","translation":"經過三小時的徒步旅行後，這群人終於到達了一個令人驚嘆的瀑布，水流注入下方清澈的藍色水池中。","explanation":"名詞「瀑布」。"},{"sentence":"The sound of the <target>waterfall</target> was so loud that we had to shout to be heard, but the view was absolutely magnificent.","translation":"瀑布的聲音如此之大，以至於我們必須大聲喊叫才能被聽到，但風景絕對壯麗。","explanation":"名詞「瀑布」。"}],"related_forms":["waterfalls"]}

{"headword":"wax","explanation":"名詞「蠟」；動詞「增加、增長」或「塗蠟」。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法最為常見，但需注意其與 wane (衰退) 的對比用法，常用於描述月相或權力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The birthday cake was decorated with colorful <target>wax</target> candles that melted slowly as the party continued throughout the night.","translation":"生日蛋糕上裝飾著彩色蠟燭，隨著派對在整晚持續，蠟燭緩緩融化。","explanation":"名詞「蠟」。"},{"sentence":"The museum curator used a special <target>wax</target> to preserve the ancient sculptures, ensuring they would not be damaged by moisture.","translation":"博物館館長使用一種特殊的蠟來保存古代雕塑，確保它們不會被潮氣損壞。","explanation":"名詞「蠟」。"},{"sentence":"As the king's influence began to <target>wax</target>, he gained more power over the neighbouring kingdoms and expanded his territory.","translation":"隨著國王的影響力開始增加，他對鄰國獲得了更多權力並擴展了他的領土。","explanation":"動詞「增加、增長」。常用於描述權力、影響力或月相。"},{"sentence":"The car enthusiast spent the whole afternoon <target>waxing</target> his vintage car to make the paint look shiny and new again.","translation":"汽車愛好者花了一整個下午為他的老爺車塗蠟，使車漆看起來再次閃亮如新。","explanation":"動詞「塗蠟」。"}],"related_forms":["waxes","waxed","waxing"]}

{"headword":"weaken","explanation":"動詞「削弱」。指使某物變得較弱，可用於身體健康、權力、信心或結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"The long illness <target>weakened</target> his body, making it difficult for him to return to sports and school activities quickly.","translation":"長期的疾病削弱了他的身體，使他難以迅速恢復運動和學校活動。","explanation":"動詞「削弱」。指生理上的虛弱。"},{"sentence":"The constant criticism from the coach <target>weakened</target> the athlete's confidence, causing her to perform poorly during the important competition.","translation":"教練持續的批評削弱了這位運動員的信心，導致她在重要比賽中表現不佳。","explanation":"動詞「削弱」。指精神上的打擊。"},{"sentence":"Severe weathering and erosion <target>weakened</target> the foundation of the old bridge, leading to its eventual collapse during the flood.","translation":"嚴重的風化和侵蝕削弱了老橋的基礎，導致它在洪水期間最終崩塌。","explanation":"動詞「削弱」。指結構上的不穩固。"}],"related_forms":["weak","weakness"]}

{"headword":"wealthy","explanation":"形容詞「富有的」。指擁有大量金錢或財富。常與 rich 通用，但 wealthy 通常強調長期且穩定的富裕狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>wealthy</target> businessman donated a large sum of money to the local hospital to help poor patients receive better medical care.","translation":"這位富有的商人捐贈了一大筆錢給當地醫院，以幫助貧困患者獲得更好的醫療照顧。","explanation":"形容詞「富有的」。"},{"sentence":"Growing up in a <target>wealthy</target> family, she had access to the best education and travel opportunities from a very young age.","translation":"在一個富有的家庭中長大，她從小就擁有最好的教育和旅遊機會。","explanation":"形容詞「富有的」。"}],"related_forms":["wealth"]}

{"headword":"weapon","explanation":"名詞「武器」。除了指實體武器外，也可指用於達成目的的手段或工具。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police ordered the suspect to drop his <target>weapon</target> and put his hands up to avoid any further violence.","translation":"警察命令嫌疑人放下武器並舉起雙手，以避免進一步的暴力。","explanation":"名詞「武器」。指實體武器。"},{"sentence":"For the diplomat, a deep understanding of history and language was the most powerful <target>weapon</target> in international negotiations.","translation":"對於外交官來說，對歷史和語言的深刻理解是在國際談判中最強大的武器。","explanation":"名詞「武器」。比喻用法，指達成目的的手段。"}],"related_forms":["weapons"]}

{"headword":"weave","explanation":"動詞「編織」；名詞「編織方式」。動詞用法最常見，可用於描述織布、編籃子，或比喻地將故事、線索將其編在一起。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local artisans <target>wove</target> beautiful baskets <pattern>from</pattern> dried palm leaves, which they sold to tourists at the market.","translation":"當地工匠用乾棕櫚葉編織了美麗的籃子，並在市場上將其賣給遊客。","explanation":"動詞「編織」。不規則變化：weave-wove-woven。"},{"sentence":"The writer managed to <target>weave</target> several different plot lines <pattern>into</pattern> one complex story, creating a mysterious atmosphere for the reader.","translation":"作者成功地將幾條不同的情節線索編織成一個複雜的故事，為讀者營造了一種神秘的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「編織」。比喻用法，指將多個元素結合在一起。常用搭配：weave into。"},{"sentence":"The fabric has a unique <target>weave</target> that makes it both strong and breathable, making it ideal for summer clothing.","translation":"這種布料具有獨特的編織方式，使其既強韌又透氣，非常適合夏季衣裝。","explanation":"名詞「編織方式」。"}],"related_forms":["wove","woven","weaving"]}

{"headword": "web", "explanation": "名詞「蜘蛛網」或「網路」。在現代英語中， web 常指 World Wide Web (全球資訊網)，即網際網路。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The spider carefully spun a <target>web</target> in the corner of the ceiling, waiting for a small insect to get trapped in its sticky trap.", "translation": "蜘蛛小心地在天花板的角落結網，等待小昆蟲陷入其黏稠的陷阱中。", "explanation": "名詞「蜘蛛網」。"}, {"sentence": "Millions of people use the <target>web</target> to search for information, shop for clothes, and connect with friends around the world.", "translation": "數百萬人使用網路來搜尋資訊、購買衣服以及與世界各地的朋友聯繫。", "explanation": "名詞「網路」。指 World Wide Web。"}, {"sentence": "The detective discovered a complex <target>web</target> <pattern>of</pattern> lies told by the suspect, making it difficult to find the actual truth.", "translation": "偵探發現了嫌疑人編造的一張複雜的謊言之網，使得很難找到真正的真相。", "explanation": "名詞「網」。比喻用法，指複雜且相互關連的體系。常用搭配：a web of lies。"}], "related_forms": ["webs"]}

{"headword":"wed","explanation":"動詞「結婚」。這是 marry 的較正式或文學性的用法。在 GSAT 中，常出現於閱讀理解中，指兩個人結合或兩件事物結合。","entries":[{"sentence":"The couple decided to <target>wed</target> in a small, private ceremony on the beach, surrounded by their closest friends and family.","translation":"這對夫婦決定在海邊舉行一場小型、私人的婚禮，在他們最親近的朋友和家人環繞下結婚。","explanation":"動詞「結婚」。"},{"sentence":"The new city plan <target>weds</target> modern architecture <pattern>with</pattern> traditional elements, creating a unique urban landscape that attracts many visitors.","translation":"新的城市計畫將現代建築與傳統元素結合，營造出獨特且吸引許多遊客的都市景觀。","explanation":"動詞「結合」。比喻用法，指將兩者結合在一起。常用搭配：wed with。"}],"related_forms":["wedding","wedded"]}

{"headword":"weed","explanation":"名詞「雜草」；動詞「除草」。注意名詞時可指不需要的植物，動詞時則指清除這些植物的過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener spent the entire afternoon pulling <target>weeds</target> from the flowerbed to ensure that the roses had enough space to grow.","translation":"園丁花了一個整個下午從花壇中拔除雜草，以確保玫瑰有足夠的生長空間。","explanation":"名詞「雜草」。"},{"sentence":"To keep the vegetable garden healthy, farmers usually <target>weed</target> the soil regularly to prevent unwanted plants from taking nutrients.","translation":"為了保持蔬菜園健康，農民通常會定期為土壤除草，以防止不必要的植物奪走養分。","explanation":"動詞「除草」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"weekly","explanation":"形容詞「每週的」；副詞「每週地」；名詞「週刊」。注意其在句子中扮演的角色，判斷是描述頻率還是指一種出版物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school magazine publishes a <target>weekly</target> <pattern>newsletter</pattern> to keep students and parents informed about upcoming campus events and deadlines.","translation":"學校雜誌每週出版一份通訊，讓學生和家長了解即將到來的校園活動和截止日期。","explanation":"形容詞「每週的」。常用搭配：weekly newsletter。"},{"sentence":"Because she wants to improve her English, the student decides to visit the library <target>weekly</target> to borrow new books and practice reading.","translation":"因為她想提高英語能力，這名學生決定每週去一次圖書館借新書並練習閱讀。","explanation":"副詞「每週地」。"},{"sentence":"My father reads a local <target>weekly</target> every morning during breakfast to stay updated on the news of our small town.","translation":"我父親每天早餐時會閱讀一份當地週刊，以掌握我們小鎮的新聞。","explanation":"名詞「週刊」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"weep","explanation":"動詞「哭泣」。較其正式或文學色彩較強，比 cry 更強調悲傷或深沉的淚水。","entries":[{"sentence":"After receiving the heartbreaking news about the accident, the woman could not stop <target>weeping</target> and had to be comforted by her friends.","translation":"在收到關於意外的令人心碎的消息後，這名女子無法停止哭泣，必須由她的朋友們安慰。","explanation":"動詞「哭泣」。"},{"sentence":"The old man <target>wept</target> <pattern>with</pattern> joy when he finally saw his son return home after ten years of studying abroad.","translation":"當這位老人終於看到兒子在國外留學十年後回家時，他喜極而泣。","explanation":"動詞「哭泣」。常用搭配：weep with joy (喜極而泣)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"wheat","explanation":"名詞「小麥」。常用於討論農業、糧食或營養。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many parts of the world, <target>wheat</target> is one of the most important crops used to produce flour for bread and pasta.","translation":"在世界許多地方，小麥是用於生產麵粉製造麵包和義大利麵最重要的作物之一。","explanation":"名詞「小麥」。"},{"sentence":"Some people have a <target>wheat</target> <pattern>allergy</pattern>, which means they must avoid foods containing gluten to prevent serious health problems.","translation":"有些人對小麥過敏，這意味著他們必須避免食用含麩質的食物以防止嚴重的健康問題。","explanation":"名詞「小麥」。常用搭配：wheat allergy (小麥過敏)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"whip","explanation":"名詞「鞭子」；動詞「鞭打」或「快速移動」。注意在烹飪中 whip up 指快速準備食物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rider used a leather <target>whip</target> to guide the horse, although many modern trainers now prefer more gentle methods.","translation":"騎手使用皮革鞭子來引導馬匹，儘管現在許多現代訓練員更傾向於溫和的方法。","explanation":"名詞「鞭子」。"},{"sentence":"The angry boss <target>whipped</target> the table with his hand to get everyone's attention during the loud and chaotic meeting.","translation":"憤怒的老闆用手拍擊桌子，在嘈雜混亂的會議中引起所有人的注意。","explanation":"動詞「快速移動/拍擊」。"},{"sentence":"Since the guests were arriving in ten minutes, the mother decided to <target>whip</target> <pattern>up</pattern> a quick meal using leftovers in the fridge.","translation":"由於客人十分鐘後就要到達，母親決定利用冰箱裡的剩菜快速準備一頓飯。","explanation":"動詞片語 whip up 表「快速準備（食物）」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"whistle","explanation":"名詞「口哨/哨子」；動詞「吹口哨」。注意 whistle for sth 表「用口哨招呼某物」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The referee blew his <target>whistle</target> loudly to signal the end of the football match and indicate that the game was over.","translation":"裁判大聲吹響哨子，以發出足球賽結束的信號並表明比賽已經結束。","explanation":"名詞「哨子」。"},{"sentence":"Walking home alone in the evening, the boy started to <target>whistle</target> a happy tune to keep himself from feeling scared.","translation":"傍晚獨自走回家時，男孩開始吹起快樂的曲調，以免自己感到害怕。","explanation":"動詞「吹口哨」。"},{"sentence":"The trainer <target>whistled</target> <pattern>for</pattern> his dog, and the animal immediately ran across the park to jump into his arms.","translation":"訓練師對他的狗吹口哨招呼，那隻動物立即跑過公園跳進他的懷裡。","explanation":"動詞片語 whistle for sth 表「吹口哨招呼」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "wicked", "explanation": "形容詞「邪惡的、惡毒的」。在非正式口語中，有時可用於表示「極好的」或「厲害的」，但 GSAT 側重於其原意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In many fairy tales, the <target>wicked</target> witch tries to trick the main character into entering her dark and dangerous forest.", "translation": "在許多童話故事中，邪惡的女巫試圖欺騙主角進入她那陰暗且危險的森林。", "explanation": "形容詞「邪惡的」。"}, {"sentence": "The villain's <target>wicked</target> plan to steal the city's treasure was eventually discovered by the brave detectives before it could happen.", "translation": "反派竊取城市寶藏的邪惡計畫最終在實施前被勇敢的偵探發現了。", "explanation": "形容詞「邪惡的」。"}], "related_forms": ["wickedly", "wickedness"]}

{"headword":"widen","explanation":"動詞「加寬；擴大」。常用於物理空間的增加，或抽象地指增加知識、視野或範圍。","entries":[{"sentence":"To reduce the traffic jams during rush hour, the city government decided to <target>widen</target> the main road leading to the downtown area.","translation":"為了減少尖峰時段的交通堵塞，市政府決定拓寬通往市中心的主幹道。","explanation":"動詞「加寬」。指物理空間的擴大。"},{"sentence":"Traveling to different countries and meeting new people is a great way for students to <target>widen</target> their <pattern>horizons</pattern> and learn about the world.","translation":"前往不同國家並結識新朋友是學生開拓視野、了解世界的絕佳方式。","explanation":"動詞「擴大」。常用搭配：widen one's horizons (開拓視野)。"}],"related_forms":["width"]}

{"headword":"wipe","explanation":"動詞「擦拭；抹除」；名詞「擦拭」。注意 wipe out 表「徹底消滅/抹除」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After finishing the experiment in the chemistry lab, the student used a clean cloth to <target>wipe</target> the table surface clean.","translation":"在化學實驗室完成實驗後，學生用乾淨的布將桌面擦乾淨。","explanation":"動詞「擦拭」。"},{"sentence":"The athlete <target>wiped</target> the sweat <pattern>off</pattern> his forehead with a towel after running a long distance in the hot summer sun.","translation":"在炎熱的夏日陽光下長距離奔跑後，這名運動員用毛巾擦掉額頭上的汗水。","explanation":"動詞「擦拭」。常用搭配：wipe sth off sth。"},{"sentence":"Historians worry that a massive natural disaster could <target>wipe</target> <pattern>out</pattern> an entire species of rare plants if the environment changes too quickly.","translation":"歷史學家擔心，如果環境變化太快，一場巨大的自然災害可能會徹底消滅整個稀有植物物種。","explanation":"動詞片語 wipe out 表「徹底消滅」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "wisdom", "explanation": "名詞「智慧」。指具備判斷力、經驗和知識的能力。注意與 knowledge (知識) 的區別：knowledge 是資訊，wisdom 是如何運用資訊。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young leader often sought the <target>wisdom</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the village elders to make fair decisions for the entire community.", "translation": "年輕的領導者經常尋求村莊長輩的智慧，以便為整個社區做出公平的決定。", "explanation": "名詞「智慧」。常用搭配：the wisdom of someone。"}, {"sentence": "It is common <target>wisdom</target> that eating a balanced diet and exercising regularly will help you maintain a healthy lifestyle throughout your life.", "translation": "一般常識認為，飲食均衡且規律運動將有助於你在一生中維持健康的lifestyle。", "explanation": "名詞「智慧」。常用搭配：common wisdom (常識)。"}], "related_forms": ["wise"]}

{"headword": "wrap", "explanation": "動詞「包裹；包圍」；名詞「包裹；外衣」。注意動詞片語 wrap up (完成；包裹起來)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully used colorful paper and a ribbon to <target>wrap</target> the birthday present for her best friend, making it look beautiful.", "translation": "她小心地用彩色紙和絲帶包裹她最好的朋友的生日禮物，讓它看起來很漂亮。", "explanation": "動詞「包裹」。常用搭配 wrap a present。"}, {"sentence": "The director decided to <target>wrap</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the filming of the movie by midnight, so the cast and crew could finally go home.", "translation": "導演決定在午夜前完成電影的拍攝，這樣演員和劇組人員終於可以回家了。", "explanation": "動詞片語 wrap up 表示「完成」。"}, {"sentence": "Because it was freezing outside, he decided to put on a warm <target>wrap</target> over his clothes to keep himself warm during the walk.", "translation": "因為外面寒冷至極，他決定在衣服外披一件保暖的外衣，以便在散步時保持溫暖。", "explanation": "名詞「外衣」。指一種披在肩上的輕便外衣。"}], "related_forms": ["wrapped", "wrapping"]}

{"headword":"wrist","explanation":"名詞「手腕」。常用於描述身體部位或穿戴飾品（如手錶、手環）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete accidentally twisted his <target>wrist</target> during the basketball game, which forced him to miss the next few matches.","translation":"這名運動員在籃球賽中不小心扭到了手腕，這使他不得不缺席接下來的幾場比賽。","explanation":"名詞「手腕」。常用動詞搭配：twist one's wrist。"},{"sentence":"She wore a delicate gold bracelet around her <target>wrist</target> that was given to her by her grandmother on her graduation day.","translation":"她手腕上戴著一條纖細的金手鍊，那是她奶奶在畢業那天送給她的。","explanation":"名詞「手腕」。"}],"related_forms":["wrists"]}

{"headword":"yearly","explanation":"形容詞「每年的；年度的」；副詞「每年地」。常用於描述定期發生的事件或報告。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company publishes a <target>yearly</target> report to inform shareholders about its financial performance and growth over the past twelve months.","translation":"公司每年出版一份年度報告，以告知股東關於過去十二個月的財務表現和增長情況。","explanation":"形容詞「年度的」。常用搭配：yearly report。"},{"sentence":"The family visits their grandparents in the countryside <target>yearly</target> during the summer vacation to maintain their close relationship.","translation":"這家人每年在暑假期間都會去鄉下拜訪他們的祖父母，以維持親密的關係。","explanation":"副詞「每年地」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"yell","explanation":"動詞「大喊；叫喊」；名詞「大喊」。注意 yell at someone (對某人大吼) 與 yell to someone (向某人大喊) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach began to <target>yell</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the players after they made several mistakes during the championship game.","translation":"在球員們於冠軍賽中犯了幾個錯誤後，教練開始對他們大吼。","explanation":"動詞「大喊」。片語 yell at someone 表示「對某人憤怒地大吼」。"},{"sentence":"Since the music was too loud, she had to <target>yell</target> <pattern>to</pattern> her friend across the room to let her know the meeting was starting.","translation":"由於音樂太大聲，她必須向房間另一頭的朋友大喊，讓她知道會議要開始了。","explanation":"動詞「大喊」。片語 yell to someone 表示「向某人大喊」以被聽見。"},{"sentence":"A loud <target>yell</target> echoed through the silent hallway after the student accidentally broke the expensive laboratory equipment.","translation":"在學生不小心打破昂貴的實驗室設備後，一聲大喊在寂靜的走廊中迴盪。","explanation":"名詞「大喊」。"}],"related_forms":["yells","yelling"]}

{"headword":"yolk","explanation":"名詞「蛋黃」。通常與 egg white (蛋白) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef explained that for a perfect omelet, you should separate the <target>yolk</target> from the white of the egg carefully.","translation":"廚師解釋說，要做出完美的歐姆蛋，你應該小心地將蛋黃與蛋白分開。","explanation":"名詞「蛋黃」。常用搭配：separate the yolk from the white。"},{"sentence":"Some people prefer their eggs with a runny <target>yolk</target>, which adds a rich and creamy texture to the breakfast toast.","translation":"有些人喜歡蛋黃流動的蛋，這會為早餐吐司增加濃郁且滑順的口感。","explanation":"名詞「蛋黃」。runny yolk 指「流心蛋黃」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"youngster","explanation":"名詞「年輕人；少年」。通常指青少年或年幼的孩子。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the past, <target>youngsters</target> spent more time playing outdoors, but now many prefer to spend their free time on electronic devices.","translation":"在過去，年輕人花更多時間在戶外玩耍，但現在許多人更喜歡將空閒時間花在電子設備上。","explanation":"名詞「年輕人」。"},{"sentence":"The community center offers various sports programs to encourage <target>youngsters</target> to stay active and develop healthy habits.","translation":"社區中心提供各種體育計畫，以鼓勵年輕人保持活躍並培養健康習慣。","explanation":"名詞「年輕人」。"}],"related_forms":["youngsters"]}

{"headword":"zipper","explanation":"名詞「拉鍊」；動詞「用拉鍊拉上」。","entries":[{"sentence":"He struggled to pull up the <target>zipper</target> on his heavy winter jacket because it was stuck on the inner lining of the cloth.","translation":"他很吃力地拉上厚冬裝外套的拉鍊，因為拉鍊卡在衣服的內裡了。","explanation":"名詞「拉鍊」。常用動詞搭配：pull up the zipper。"},{"sentence":"She quickly <target>zippered</target> her bag before leaving the library, ensuring that all her notebooks and pens were safely inside.","translation":"她在離開圖書館前迅速拉上包包的拉鍊，以確保她的筆記本和筆都安全地在裡面。","explanation":"動詞「用拉鍊拉上」。"}],"related_forms":["zippers"]}

{"headword": "zone", "explanation": "名詞「區域；地帶」；動詞「劃分區域」。常考搭配：time zone (時區), safety zone (安全區)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Because the two cities are in different <target>time zones</target>, they have to schedule their video calls very carefully.", "translation": "因為這兩個城市處於不同的時區，他們必須非常小心地安排視訊通話的時間。", "explanation": "名詞「時區」。常用搭配：time zone。"}, {"sentence": "The city council decided to <target>zone</target> this part of the downtown area <pattern>for</pattern> residential use only to reduce traffic congestion.", "translation": "市議會決定將市中心的這個部分劃分為僅限住宅用途，以減少交通擁堵。", "explanation": "動詞「劃分區域」。常用搭配 zone sth for...。"}, {"sentence": "Passengers are reminded to stay within the designated safety <target>zone</target> while waiting for the train to arrive at the platform.", "translation": "提醒乘客在等待火車到達月台時，請留在指定的安全區域內。", "explanation": "名詞「區域」。常用搭配：safety zone。"}], "related_forms": ["zones", "zoning"]}
